name: Berserk Changeling
lore: Changelings can be hyper-sensitive to certain environmental hazards, such as the poison gas encountered on planet L-S VI. Progressive degradation causes uncontrollable outbursts.
game_text: Unless 2 hand weapons OR 3 SECURITY OR Changeling Sweep OR Shape-Shift Inhibitor OR Interphase Generator OR Mora Pol present, kills a non-changeling present (random selection).

name: Chula: The Dice
lore: The throw of the dice is the foundation of chula. Each combination of Wadi symbols determines which challenge next awaits the game's participants.
game_text: To get past requires one personnel with INTEGRITY>6, another with CUNNING>7 and a third with STRENGTH>8.

name: Dal'Rok
lore: Terrifying energy creature created and manipulated using an Orb fragment. The controller of the Dal'Rok channels the fears of Bajoran villagers into a powerful destructive force.
game_text: Place on mission. Now and start of each turn, kills personnel with lowest total attributes at this location. May be nullified by INTEGRITY+CUNNING+STRENGTH>150 at this location.

name: Edo Probe
lore: When the Federation tried to contact the pre-industrial society on Rubican III, the Edo Probe demanded in ship-shuddering tones that Jean-Luc Picard "State the purpose!"

name: Lack of Preparation
lore: An Away Team that is unprepared to complete its mission will undoubtedly experience delays. Mission progress may be impossible until additional personnel arrive.
game_text: Non-Borg: Cannot get past (lose 10 points) unless you could have met mission requirements at start of attempt.Borg: Must have Borg Communication subcommand, Borg Navigation subcommand and Borg Defense subcommand personnel to proceed.

name: Tarellian Plague Ship
lore: Ship containing the survivors of a Tarellia war plague. Infected from biological weapons, they are now refused entry everywhere.
game_text: Entire crew immediately dies from plague unless MEDICAL "beams over" to Tarellians. Discard dilemma.

name: Alternate Universe Door
game_text: Place one on table during the seed phase. Door is now open, allowing your Alternate icon cards to enter play. OR Stock in deck and use as follows:Plays to nullify one Revolving Door or Subspace Schism. (Discard doorway.) OR Allows one ship to pass through Q-Net. (Discard doorway.) OR Nullify one Temporal Rift, and return doorway to your hand.

name: Bajoran Wormhole
game_text: Requires two Bajoran Wormhole cards; each inserts into a spaceline to create a location (span 1). Play one in Alpha Quadrant (Bajor Region); download the other to Gamma Quadrant . Limit one per quadrant. While in play, any ship may move from one end to the other, then is "stopped." OR Plays at any time to nullify any card which is closing or destroying Bajoran Wormhole (discard doorway).

name: Bat'leth
lore: Traditional blade weapon of the Klingon warrior. According to legend, the first bat'leth, or "sword of honor," was forged by Kahless the Unforgettable some fifteen centuries ago.
game_text: Each of your Klingons present is STRENGTH +2, and in each battle one of them may mortally wound one adversary they just stunned. (Cumulative.)

name: Gold-Pressed Latinum
lore: Valuable liquid latinum encased in relatively worthless gold dust. Standard of exchange throughout the Ferengi Alliance. Typically traded in bars, strips, and slips; 1 bar = 20 strips = 2,000 slips.
game_text: Once each turn, on a Trading Post, homeworld or Quark's Bar, you may discard two latinum (one if your Acquisition present) to download a non-Latinum Equipment card there.

name: 34th Rule of Acquisition
lore: "War is good for business."
game_text: Plays on your arms dealer or Acquisition personnel. Once every turn, if a non-Rogue Borg battle was just initiated or opponent's ship was just damaged, download two Gold‑Pressed Latinum here (three if an arms dealer) OR draw two cards.

name: Genetronic Replicator
lore: Medical device invented by Dr. Toby Russell. Capable of growing replacements for damaged organs.

name: Kivas Fajo - Collector
lore: Treacherous collector of rare one-of-a-kind antiquities. Once tried to add Lt. Commander Data to his collection.
game_text: Choose any player to immediately draw three new cards from the top of their draw deck. Discard event after use.

name: Masaka Transformations
lore: Masaka attempted to transform the U.S.S. Enterprise into an ancient temple and grounds by rearranging its matter.
game_text: Plays on any player. That player must shuffle entire hand, place on bottom of draw deck, then draw the same number of cards from the top. Discard event after use.

name: The Traveler: Transcendence
lore: Benevolent humanoid from Tau Alpha C who could transcend space and time with thought.
game_text: '''Place beside any player's draw deck. That player must draw one extra card at the end of each turn. Also, while in play, nullifies Static Warp Bubble (Not cumulative.)

name: Amanda Rogers
lore: Female Q raised as a human on Earth. Was taken to the Q continuum by Q after she could not resist the benevolent use of her powers.

name: Distortion of Space/Time Continuum
lore: Time effects can be caused by the unusual warping or rifting of space.

name: Kevin Uxbridge
lore: Immortal omnipotent being called a Douwd. Lived secretly as a human. Took a human wife who was killed by the Husnocks at Delta Rana IV.

name: Q2
lore: Member of the Q who observed Q's act of self-sacrifice and re-instated him in the Q continuum.

name: Patrol Neutral Zone
lore: Neutral Zone Region ● Nebula: Prevent incursions along Federation/Romulan border.
game_text: X=number of Neutral Zone locations in play.

name: Borg Cube
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BORG CUBETASK: Explore galaxy for biological and technological distinctiveness. Assimilate.

name: Plasma Torpedo
game_text: ATTACK bonus +2 if you have a Romulan ship firing. Hit = Tactic DrawTactic Draw.Direct hit = Tactic DrawTactic DrawTactic Draw.

name: Cryosatellite
lore: An ancient sublight vessel. Designed to carry and store cryogenically frozen humanoids until a cure for their death could be found and used to regenerate them.
game_text: Seed at a space location. May seed one additional artifact and up to 3 Alternate Universe personnel here. They are earned when Cryosatellite earned; then discard Cryosatellite.

name: Horga'hn
lore: Mysterious symbol of sexuality from the pleasure planet of Risa. To own one is to call forth its powers. To display one is to announce that the owner is seeking jamaharon.
game_text: Immediately plays on table. Each turn, gain an additional normal card play OR at end of turn, draw an extra card.

name: Horga'hn
lore: Mysterious symbol of sexuality from the pleasure planet of Risa. To own one is to call forth its powers. To display one is to announce that the owner is seeking jamaharon.
game_text: Immediately plays on table. Each turn, gain an additional normal card play OR at end of turn, draw an extra card.

name: Iconian Gateway
lore: The now-extinct Iconians were "Demons of Air and Darkness" due to their advanced technology such as this instant transport portal to farflung planets.
game_text: Place in hand. Play as Event on a planet mission: personnel present may walk to other planet missions.

name: Interphase Generator
lore: Experimental Romulan device that both cloaks and phases matter, allowing it to pass through normal matter.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. Where present, nullifies: Chalnoth, Archer, Rebel Encounter, Impassable Door, Phased Matter, Crystalline Entity, Armus and Nausicaans dilemmas.

name: Ressikan Flute
lore: Artifact from Kataan, a now-dead planet. 1,000 years after Kataan's demise, a space probe gave Jean-Luc Picard this flute and a lifetime of memories in less than an hour.
game_text: Immediately score points; X=the number of different Music personnel present (limit 5). Then, play on table; points may be nullified by The Devil. (Not duplicatable.)

name: The Genesis Device
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
lore: Torpedo created by Project Genesis. Reorganizes matter at the subatomic level to achieve rapid terraforming on a planetary scale. Its matrix utilizes dangerously unstable protomatter.
game_text: Use as Equipment (until placed). On your turn, if not playing Federation, may place on Planet mission here. If unsolved at start of your next turn, choose: worth double points OR zero points. (Unique.)

name: Zefram Cochrane's Telescope
lore: Gazing at the celestial harmony, Zefram Cochrane escaped the squalor of his time and dreamed of the conquest of space. And how much money he could make.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. Once each turn, if on a planet with your personnel, allows you to glance at bottom seed card at one adjacent non-planet location.

name: Abandon Ship!
lore: Krenim attacks repeatedly damaged the U.S.S. Voyager. Failing life support systems led Kathryn Janeway to order the evacuation of all personnel except senior staff.
game_text: If ship damaged or RANGE reduced, personnel not needed for staffing are placed with dilemma atop mission. Rescue (opponent may capture) personnel with different ship here.

name: Alien Abduction
lore: Solanagan-based aliens, existing in a subspace domain, can access our universe and abduct humanoids for study.

name: Alien Abduction
lore: Solanagan-based aliens, existing in a subspace domain, can access our universe and abduct humanoids for study.
game_text: Most CUNNING Away Team member (owner's choice if tie) is held by atop mission. Cure with 3 Leadership. Nullified when mission completed.

name: Ankari "Spirits"
lore: Nucleogenic lifeforms that relentlessly assaulted U.S.S. Equinox in retaliation for the crew's actions. Their attack causes a thermolytic reaction, desiccating every cell in a victim's body.
game_text: Unless 3 Honor and INTEGRITY>35 present, place on ship. Now and start of each turn, kills two crew members (random selection). Cure with 3 ENGINEER and Exobiology.

name: Armus - Skin of Evil
lore: A malevolent being was formed when the inhabitants of Vagra II rid themselves of all the evil they had inside.
game_text: Kills one Away Team (random selection). Discard dilemma.

name: Armus: Sticky Situation
lore: Armus, a remnant of the Vagrans, engulfed William T. Riker in his skin of evil. Only the finesse and skillful negotiation of Jean-Luc Picard resulted in his release.
game_text: Away Team member with highest STRENGTH is stopped if another personnel present has Diplomacy and CUNNING>7, killed otherwise. To get past requires any personnel remaining.

name: Birth of "Junior"
lore: Large infant spaceborne life-form. Attached itself to the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368, sucking energy from the ship.
game_text: Place on ship. End of each turn, RANGE reduced by 1; if reduced to 0, ship destroyed. Nullify with 3 ENGINEER.

name: Borg Ship
lore: Gigantic cubic ship of the Borg collective. Possesses powerful weapons and remarkable regenerative abilities.
game_text: Place at furthest spaceline end. End of every turn: Attacks all ships, then moves. Worth points if destroyed in battle.

name: Balancing Act
lore: Deadly plasma coolant flooded main engineering through a rupture opened by Data. Survival depended upon balance and strength. Resistance was futile.
game_text: Each player whose missions with point boxes were mostly Space or mostly Planet (by a difference of 3 or more), when seeded, loses 50 points (even if playing Borg).

name: Balancing Act
lore: Rarely had Tuvok been in a more precarious position than at a Nezu colony, halfway between the ionosphere and the planet surface, dangling from the bottom of a mag-lev carriage.
game_text: Each player whose missions with point boxes were mostly Space or mostly Planet (by a difference of 3 or more) loses 50 points (even if playing Borg).

name: Cardassian Trap
lore: With rumors of a metagenic weapon on Celtris III, the Cardassians lured Jean‑Luc Picard into a trap in Cardassian space. He was captured in 2369.
game_text: Unless Empathy present, opponent captures one unique non- personnel from you (random selection) and places it on their side as a captive, along with trap.

name: Chinese Finger Puzzle
lore: An ancient novelty which baffled Lt. Commander Data. The solution to the puzzle, which involves relaxation of effort, he called "fascinating."
game_text: If android present, crew or Away Team is stopped until end of turn and androids are stopped for X full turns, where X = number of androids present. Discard dilemma.

name: Clan People
lore: In 2369, the U.S.S. Yangtzee Kiang crashed on a moon in the Gamma Quadrant. The crew members found themselves caught between enemy clans locked in a never‑ending war.
game_text: To get past, must have Kai Opaka present OR CUNNING>38 from up to five Away Team members.

name: Computer Weapon & Hyper-Aging
game_text: ICONIAN COMPUTER WEAPON: Unless SCIENCE present, reboot by discarding all non-Personnel cards in hand and replenishing from top of draw deck. (Not repeatable.)HYPER-AGING: Entire crew or Away Team is quarantined (dies when countdown expires). Cure with SCIENCE and 2 MEDICAL.

name: Conundrum
lore: In 2368, U.S.S. Enterprise personnel were given amnesia by Satarrans, who then attempted to trick the crew into attacking Lysian ships and a Lysian command station.
game_text: Unless INTEGRITY>40, this ship must do nothing but chase (at normal speed) and attack one of your opponent's ship on this spaceline (your choice). Discard dilemma.

name: DNA Metamorphosis
lore: Geordi La Forge was infected with alien DNA. Transformed into an invisible reptilian humanoid, he was observable only when scanned with ultraviolet light.
game_text: Place on one personnel present (random selection). At the end of your next turn, that personnel is placed in stasis. Cure, before then, with MEDICAL and I.P. Scanner.

name: Edo Probe
lore: When the Federation tried to contact the pre-industrial society on Rubicun III, the Edo Probe demanded in ship-shuddering tones that Jean-Luc Picard "State the purpose!"
game_text: Abandon mission attempt until any player completes a different mission OR continue but lose points if you do not solve mission this turn.

name: Edo Probe
lore: When the Federation tried to contact the pre-industrial society on Rubican III, the Edo Probe demanded in ship-shuddering tones that Jean-Luc Picard "State the purpose!"
game_text: Abandon mission attempt until any player completes a different mission OR continue but lose points if you do not solve mission this turn.

name: Engine Imbalance
lore: An improperly balanced warp drive system poses a serious hazard. Even a minor misalignment can propel a ship into an artificial wormhole.
game_text: Place on ship. It may not fly by a location without stopping, and its RANGE is exhausted each time it moves. Cure with 2 ENGINEER, Computer Skill, and Physics.

name: Female's Love Interest
lore: A genetically-engineered leader. Once romantically involved with Deanna Troi.
game_text: Female Away Team member (random selection) runs off with lover to furthest planet. Discard dilemma.

name: Female's Love Interest
lore: Genetically manipulated to become Taresian, the handsome Taymon was desired by Malia and two other Taresian females.
game_text: Relocates a female present (random selection) to furthest different planet on this spaceline.

name: Female's Love Interest & Garbage Scow
game_text: FEMALE'S LOVE INTEREST: Female crew or Away Team member (random selection) runs off with lover to furthest planet.RADIOACTIVE GARBAGE SCOW: Place on mission; mission attempt ends. Mission can't be attempted here. Ship with Tractor Beam and 2 ENGINEER can tow Scow.

name: Firestorm
lore: With advanced technology, personnel can work together to survive natural phenomenon such as the firestorms on Bersallis III.
game_text: Kills all Away Team members with INTEGRITY<5 unless thermal deflectors present (but Away Team may escape using Emergency Transporter Armbands). Discard dilemma.

name: Frame of Mind
lore: William Riker was captured in 2369 on Tilonus IV, tortured with neurosomatic techniques and made to believe he was someone else – until his illusions were shattered.
game_text: One personnel present (random selection) now becomes Non-Aligned with attributes of 3-3-3 and only two skills (opponent's choice). Cure with 3 Empathy present.

name: Hero Worship
lore: "Doctor Cochrane, I know this sounds silly, but can I shake your hand?"
game_text: Stops non-Borg crew or Away Team members with the most and fewest Skill Dot icons. (In case of ties, stops all tied personnel.)

name: Hippocratic Oath
lore: On stardate 49066.5, rogue Jem'Hadar detained Julian Bashir on Bopak III. He was compelled to seek a cure to their genetically engineered addiction to the drug ketracel-white.
game_text: To get past, most CUNNING MEDICAL must relocate with dilemma to nearest planet at another location (must still have MEDICAL upon arrival); stopped until countdown expires.

name: Hologram Ruse
lore: Holograms can be used to create realistic fantasy worlds.
game_text: To get past requires INTEGRITY>30 and CUNNING>30.

name: Hyper-Aging
lore: Disease created accidentally at the Darwin Genetic Research Station on Gagarin IV. Causes rapid aging and death.
game_text: Entire Away Team is quarantined (dies when countdown expires). Cure with SCIENCE and 2 MEDICAL.

name: In the Pale Moonlight
lore: In a desperate attempt to spark Romulan participation in the defense of the Alpha Quadrant, Benjamin Sisko enlisted Elim Garak's effective, but questionable, methods.
game_text: To get past requires a personnel who has INTEGRITY<4 OR a Federation Treachery personnel OR any Garak OR a Founder.

name: Make Us Go
lore: "We are Pakleds. We look for things...things to make us go. You are smart. Can you make our ship go? Do not try to trick us. We can tell."
game_text: To get past, place most CUNNING ENGINEER present atop mission with dilemma. At the end of your next turn, place both out of play if you do not have CUNNING>24 here.

name: Male's Love Interest
lore: One of the many beautiful women who reside on the paradise planet of Risa.
game_text: Male Away Team member (random selection) runs off with lover to furthest planet. Discard dilemma.

name: Male's Love Interest
lore: Mari fruit vendor whose waterplums caught Neelix's eye.
game_text: Relocates a male present (random selection) to furthest different planet on this spaceline.

name: Malfunctioning Door
lore: At times, Away Teams must open obstructed doors in confined passageways by hand, as did Data on stardate 41503.7.
game_text: To get past requires a Soong-Type android OR STRENGTH>27 from up to four personnel.

name: Malfunctioning Door
lore: At times, Away Teams must open obstructed doors in confined passageways by hand, as did Data on stardate 41503.7.
game_text: To get past requires a Soong-Type android OR STRENGTH>27 from up to four personnel.

name: Menthar Booby Trap
lore: Relic from ancient Menthar-Promellian war. Aceton assimilators trap passing ships, drain power, then emit deadly radiation.

name: Menthar Booby Trap
lore: Relic from ancient Menthar-Promellian war. Aceton assimilators trap passing ships, drain power, then emit deadly radiation.
game_text: Place on ship; it cannot move. MEDICAL present, one crew member killed (random selection). Cure with 2 ENGINEER.

name: Menthar Booby Trap
lore: Relic from ancient Menthar-Promellian war. Aceton assimilators trap passing ships, drain power, then emit deadly radiation.
game_text: Place on ship; it cannot move. MEDICAL present, one crew member killed (random selection). Cure with 2 ENGINEER.

name: Mission Fatigue
lore: When under extreme stress, even highly trained veterans can experience lapses in judgment. Miles O'Brien and Worf fought each other while they were besieged by Jem'Hadar in 2373.
game_text: Unless Empathy and Leadership present, place on mission; each subsequent dilemma seeded here stops one non-Borg personnel present (random selection) when revealed.

name: Nitrium Metal Parasites
lore: Microscopic life-forms that normally live in asteroids but can infest and damage ships by ingesting nitrium.
game_text: Place on ship. Ship is destroyed when countdown expires. Cure with 2 SCIENCE OR 2 ENGINEER.

page_title: Now Would Be a Good Time (TMP) (Errata)
name: Now Would Be a Good Time
base_name: Now Would Be a Good Time
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
lore: With insufficient transporter power for Scotty to beam him off the aircraft carrier Enterprise, Chekov was captured and interrogated by the U.S. Navy. Being Russian didn't help him.
game_text: Your Transporter Skill here with transporters may beam up Away Team. Otherwise, one personnel present (opponent's choice) is captured; others stopped. Discard dilemma..

name: Ooby Dooby
lore: "Well, you wiggle to the left, you wiggle to the right; you do the Ooby Dooby with all your might; Ooby Dooby; Ooby Dooby; Ooby Dooby, Dooby doo wah, doo wah, doo wah."
game_text: Draw a card for each Youth present (limit 6), then discard a card for each Music present. Stops all Youth, Music, and Zefram Cochrane present.

name: Parallel Romance
lore: Relationships in parallel universes take different courses. In one, Worf and Deanna Troi were married and had two children: Shanara, 2 and Eric Christopher, 3.
game_text: Randomly select a male and a female. (If you cannot, discard dilemma.) Until countdown expires, each of them is stopped and has STRENGTH reduced by 2.

name: Phased Matter
lore: Phased personnel vibrate out of sync with normal matter, rendering them undetectable. Phased people cannot interact with non-phased people.
game_text: Away Team is split into two Away Teams (your choice). Larger team is phased and cannot beam until cured by ENGINEER and SCIENCE in another Away Team on planet.

name: Q
lore: Incorrigible, extra-dimensional member of the Q Continuum, a race of omnipotent beings. Q exhibits a child-like petulance and sense of playfulness.

name: Q
lore: Incorrigible, extra-dimensional member of the Q Continuum, a race of omnipotent beings. Q exhibits a child-like petulance and sense of playfulness.
game_text: Unless 2 Leadership and INTEGRITY>60, opponent may download up to 2 Q cards and place them atop their Q-Continuum side deck; crew or Away Team has a Q-Flash of 4 cards, then is stopped. Discard dilemma.

name: Radioactive Garbage Scow
lore: Barges containing dangerous waste can be adrift for centuries. One such barge threatened Gamelon V in 2367.

name: Radioactive Garbage Scow
lore: Barges containing dangerous waste can be adrift for centuries. One such barge threatened Gamelon V in 2367.
game_text: Place on mission; mission attempt ends. Mission can't be attempted here. Ships with tractor beam and 2 ENGINEER can tow Scow.

name: Radioactive Garbage Scow
lore: The Malon civilization produces over six billion isotons of industrial by-product every day. Their freighters haul away the toxic waste and dispose of it in other regions of the galaxy.

name: REM Fatigue Hallucinations
lore: A crew can go insane from lack of REM (rapid eye movement) sleep.

name: REM Fatigue Hallucinations
lore: A crew can go insane from lack of REM (rapid eye movement) sleep.
game_text: Personnel who encountered dilemma die when countdown expires unless cured by 3 MEDICAL OR boarding your outpost.

name: Replicator Accident
lore: Nucleonic radiation from the explosion of a stolen – and incorrectly installed – food replicator mutated the cells of a Kazon-Nistrim crew, fusing them with inorganic matter.
game_text: Unless ENGINEER, Physics, and CUNNING>30 present, kills crew and damages ship. Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma

name: Spatial Rift
lore: A rupture in space connected U.S.S. Voyager with its duplicate created by a spatial scission. The two crews had to separate their "siamese ships" that shared a single supply of anti-matter.
game_text: Two personnel present (random selection) "disappear" (discarded) unless their combined CUNNING<15. To get past requires Astrophysics and 2 ENGINEER remaining.

name: Subspace Shock Wave
lore: Dangerous aftermath of a stellar, planetary, or lunar explosion. The shock wave created by the "incident" on Praxis was felt even beyond the boundaries of Klingon space.
game_text: style="text-align:left;width:500px;"Ship is damaged and two crew members are killed (random selection) unless a Navigation personnel who has CUNNING>7 present. Discard dilemma.

name: Tarellian Plague Ship
lore: Ship containing the survivors of a Tarellia war plague. Infected from biological weapons, they are now refused entry everywhere.
game_text: Entire crew immediately dies from plague unless MEDICAL "beams over" (discarded) to Tarellians. Discard dilemma.

name: Tarellian Plague Ship
lore: Ship containing the survivors of a Tarellia war plague. Infected from biological weapons, they are now refused entry everywhere.
game_text: Entire crew immediately diea from plague unless MEDICAL "beams over" (discarded) to Tarellians. Discard dilemma.

name: The Sheliak
lore: A reclusive race of strict legalists that considers humanoids inferior. Life-form classification R-3. The 2255 Treaty of Amens ceded several planets to the Sheliak.
game_text: Place at furthest spaceline end. End of every turn:, If at Planet where encountered, destroys all outposts and Away Teams here; mission worth -10 points; discard dilemma. Otherwise: moves.

name: The Weak Will Perish
lore: During brief telepathic connections, Kes learned the purpose of Species 8472's invasion of the Delta Quadrant. As the Borg discovered, they were quite capable of carrying out their threats.
game_text: Kills five Universal Borg drones (random selection) and each personnel present who has printed STRENGTH<5. (Immune to Adapt: Negate Obstruction).

name: The Whale Probe
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
lore: Alien space probe of unknown origin. Traveled to Earth to contact the extinct humpback whale. Its powerful transmission caused total power loss aboard nearby ships and starbases.
game_text: Place on mission. End of every turn, moves one location toward and off far end of spaceline. All ships, personnel, and facilities are in stasis while here. (Unique.)

name: Thought Fire
lore: In 2364, The Traveler took the U.S.S. Enterprise to a place where ideas and reality intermix. In such a place, one's own thoughts can be deadly.

name: Thought Fire
lore: In 2364, The Traveler took the U.S.S. Enterprise to a place where ideas and reality intermix. In such a place, one's own thoughts can be deadly.
game_text: Unless Empathy present, kills all personnel present with (INTEGRITY+CUNNING)<12. Nullified if The Traveler: Transcendence is not affecting you.

name: Tsiolkovsky Infection
lore: Variety of water-based Psi 2000 virus. Passed by perspiration. Creates dangerous intoxication-like instability among a crew.
game_text: Place aboard ship. It is now infected. Mission continues, but all personnel, while aboard, lose their first-listed skill. Cure with 3 MEDICAL. (Not cumulative.)

name: Two-Dimensional Creatures
lore: Perfectly flat spaceborne creatures from a two-dimensional spatial continuum. Ensnared the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2367 and impeded Counselor Deanna Troi's empathic abilities.
game_text: Place on ship. Empaths aboard are disabled. Ship can't move until SCIENCE and ENGINEER aboard, discarding dilemma and curing empaths.

name: Unscientific Method
lore: As part of his plan to steal the newly developed metaphasic shield technology, Jo'Bril sabotaged the initial testing, faked his own death and killed the inventor.
game_text: Most CUNNING SCIENCE personnel present without Greed or Treachery is killed. To get past requires CUNNING>24 remaining.

name: Wind Dancer
lore: Sentry of the Parallax Colony. Only allows those whose hearts are joyous to pass.
game_text: To get past, Lwaxana Troi must be present OR at least one Away Team member must have: Youth OR Music OR STRENGTH>9.

name: Your Galaxy Is Impure
lore: The genetic density of Species 8472 is superior to all known forms of life. Any wound inflicted by them will spread infection throughout a victim's body, consuming it from the inside out.
game_text: Randomly select a personnel to be killed. Place on mission. At the start of each mission or scouting attempt here, kills one personnel present (your choice). (Immune to Adapt: Negate Obstruction.)

name: Zaldan
lore: Zaldans, who look human except for their webbed fingers, are infuriated by courtesy. They view it as insulting dishonesty.
game_text: Unless 2 Treachery OR a disruptor OR Wesley Crusher OR Exobiology present, kills two Away Team members who have Diplomacy (random selection).

name: Bajoran Wormhole: Mirror Universe
game_text: Seeds (in any phase) or plays in Mirror Quadrant. Limit one. Inserts into spaceline to create a Bajor Region location (span 1); any player may download Bajoran Wormhole. Any ship may move between here and another Bajoran Wormhole if damaged or if ENGINEER and SCIENCE aboard, then is "stopped." OR Plays at any time to nullify any card which is closing or destroying Bajoran Wormhole (discard doorway).

name: Barzan Wormhole
game_text: Seeds (in any phase) or plays in Gamma or Delta Quadrant (limit one). Inserts into spaceline; creates a location (span 2). Any ship may move between Wormhole Terminus and here, then is "stopped." OR Once each turn, plays to relocate Barzan Wormhole to a new location in Gamma or Delta Quadrant; discard doorway.

name: Black Hole
game_text: Plays between two adjacent Universal missions named Space. Creates a location (span 1). End of every turn, destroys all cards here. Also, when countdown would expire, instead destroy an adjacent location and all cards there (left first, then alternating, while possible), then countdown resets. Does not count down the turn it is played. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Devidian Door
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, allows you to play a card "from the future." Once each turn, you may say "Devidian Door" and play one Personnel or Equipment card to any planet. At any time during your next turn (or at game end, if sooner), you must show a Devidian Door from hand and place it out-of-play, or you lose the game.

name: Devidian Door
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, allows you to play a card "from the future." Once each turn, you may say "Devidian Door" and play one Personnel or Equipment card to any planet. At any time during your next turn (or at game end, if sooner), you must show a Devidian Door from hand and place it out of play, or you lose the game.

name: Holodeck Door
game_text: Seeds (during facility phase) or plays on your ship (limit one per ship) or outpost, or on any headquarters. Adds Holodeck, and your compatible Hologram cards may report aboard. OR Plays once each turn to download a Holoprogram or any link=http://cardguide.wikia.com/wiki/Category:Hologram (Star Trek CCG 1E) or link=http://cardguide.wikia.com/wiki/Category:Barash card; place doorway out-of-play. OR Plays at any time to prevent the deactivation of any one link=http://cardguide.wikia.com/wiki/Category:Hologram personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E) personnel; discard doorway.

name: Launch Portal
game_text: Suspends play while you do any or all of the following: download Engage Shuttle Operations or Escape Pod; download (once per game) a scout ship, shuttle or Borg sphere to your ship with Tractor Beam; and (except during a mission attempt) launch any or all of your carried ships with crew. Discard or place on Engage Shuttle Operations to protect it from nullification and extend its effects to scout ships.

name: Q's Tent
game_text: Seeds on (opens) Q's Tent side deck (up to 13 different cards). You may examine cards in this side deck. OR Once each turn, plays to take a card from your Q's Tent into your hand, either your choice (discard doorway) or random selection (place doorway on top of your draw deck). Must show card to opponent. Draw no cards this turn.

name: Q's Tent
game_text: Seeds on (opens) Q's Tent side deck (up to 13 different cards). You may examine cards in this side deck. OR Once each turn, plays to take a card from your Q's Tent into your hand, either your choice (discard doorway) or random selection (place doorway on top of your draw deck). Must show card to opponent. Draw no cards this turn.

name: Q-Flash
game_text: Seeds on (opens) Q-Continuum side deck (any number of Q cards). When opponent's crew or Away Team has a Q-Flash, draw cards from here, one at a time, discarding duplicates. Dilemmas drawn are encountered (while personnel present only). Opponent plays other cards drawn (if possible). When Q cards leave play, place them face up here only (even if closed); when side deck empty, shuffle to replenish it.

name: Ready Room Door
game_text: Once per turn, plays to download to one of your ships its matching commander (draw no cards this turn) OR to download one Captain's Order. After any use, discard doorway; place it atop your draw deck; or place it atop one of your Captain's Order events to protect that event from nullification.

name: Ready Room Door
game_text: Once per turn, plays to download to one of your ships its matching commander (draw no cards this turn) OR to download one Captain's Order. After any use, discard doorway; place it atop your draw deck; or place it atop one of your Captain's Order events to protect that event from nullification.

name: Space-Time Portal
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Alternate cards may seed and (once per turn) play. At any time, discard doorway to download Alternate Universe Door (except to table) OR play Wormhole on a location to relocate your ship there (stopped) OR nullify Temporal Rift OR return one of your ships to owners' hands OR (once per game) report with up to four Alternate personnel an Alternate ship to any location.

name: Spacedoor
game_text: Seeds on your outpost during facility phase. Outpost is SHIELDS -8 (cumulative). In place of your normal card play, you may return your empty ship docked here (and all cards played on it) to owners' hands, nullifying any Static Warp Bubbles targeting you OR download Spacedock or one compatible Universal ship to outpost. Flip Spacedoor over after either use.

name: Temporal Micro-Wormhole
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. You may play Alternate personnel and Equipment. Once per game, you may download Space-Time Portal OR nullify its "report with" OR download Dr. Telek R'Mor. Your personnel may report aboard your ships, regardless of affiliation (limit once each turn, twice per game; discard doorway each time). Personnel played this way are compatible with your cards until they leave play.

name: The Nexus
game_text: '''Seeds like a Space/Planet dilemma. When encountered, place on far end of spaceline. End of every turn, moves one location toward other end. (Not duplicatable.) All personnel here are placed under Nexus (in play for uniqueness only). Destroys all ships here. At end of spaceline, place on table. At any time, players may relocate their personnel here to a Planet mission or time location. (Immune to Revolving Door.)

name: Transwarp Network Gateway
game_text: Seed one during facility phase on any spaceline end OR play on any spaceline location where you have a Navigation Borg. Any player may play a Transwarp Conduit (or another copy of this doorway) to allow moving any or all of that player's ships from this Transwarp Network Gateway to another. OR Downloads Transwarp Conduit (discard doorway).

name: Classic Communicator
lore: Typical 23rd-century personal communications device. Features flip-up antenna grid and multi-band tuning. Such equipment was developed by many races.
game_text: Once each turn, one of your Original Series personnel present may add a skill from one of your other compatible Original Series personnel at same location until end of turn. (Unique.)

name: Classic Medical Tricorder
lore: General-purpose medical reference and diagnostic tool. Representative of devices used in the latter half of the 23rd century. Such equipment was developed by many races.
game_text: Once each turn, you may select MEDICAL OR Biology OR Exobiology. Until re-selected, your MEDICAL- or SCIENCE- classification Original Series personnel present gain that skill. (Unique.)

name: Classic Tricorder
lore: Multipurpose hand-held device typical of those employed by many races in the late 23rd century. Jadzia Dax said of this one, "I just love classic 23rd-century design."
game_text: Once each turn, you may select ENGINEER OR SCIENCE OR Geology OR Physics. Until re-selected, your ENGINEER- and SCIENCE- classification Original Series personnel present gain that skill. (Unique.)

name: Engineering Kit
lore: Compact assortment of tools for making modifications and repairs to propulsion and computer systems. Many engineers develop a personal attachment to their set.
game_text: Your OFFICER-classification personnel present gain ENGINEER.

name: Hypospray
lore: Uses an aerosuspension delivery system to administer subcutaneous or intramuscular medication. Can also be used to sedate an adversary.
game_text: Once each battle, your MEDICAL present may stun their adversary OR change one personnel from mortally wounded to disabled. (Does not affect inorganics.) (Cumulative.)

name: Medical Kit
lore: Collection of medical instruments. Though no substitute for a fully equipped medical facility, such devices are often sufficient to save lives when nothing more is available.
game_text: Your OFFICER-classification personnel present gain MEDICAL.

name: Multidimensional Transport Device
lore: Modifies transporter function to allow beaming to an alternate universe. Developed in the mirror universe. Used by Smiley, Professor Sisko, the Intendant, and others to cross over.
game_text: Reports in Alpha or Mirror Quadrant. Twice each turn, where present, allows transporters to beam to opposite quadrant (anywhere at corresponding location), ignoring all SHIELDS.

name: Plasmadyne Relay
lore: Device designed by Geordi La Forge to improve warp engine quantum efficiency. Wesley Crusher opined that it was obsolete and needed a subprocessor matrix overhaul.
game_text: While on a ship, RANGE and SHIELDS are +2. While on a station or outpost, SHIELDS are +4. (Cumulative.)

name: Starfleet Phaser Pistol
lore: There are only two settings. Stun, and kill. Make sure to not get them mixed up.

name: Starfleet Phaser Pistol
lore: There are only two settings. Stun, and kill. Make sure to not get them mixed up.
game_text: Starfleet use only. Each of your personnel present is. STRENGTH +2 (or +3 if that personnel has SECURITY). (Cumulative).

name: Starfleet Type II Phaser
lore: Handheld weapon can be set for stun, heat and disruption. PHASER is an acronym for PHASed Energy Rectification.
game_text: Federation and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Starfleet Type II Phaser
lore: Versatile Starfleet hand weapon. Has 16 different power settings ranging from stun to disruption. Beam dispersal can be configured from broad-range to extreme precision.
game_text: If your Federation or Non-Aligned personnel present, each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Transport Inhibitor
lore: Device that emits an energy field preventing the operation of transporters within a radius of several meters. Used by the Enterprise crew in their defense against the Son'a.
game_text: If your personnel present, you may prevent any beaming to or from this equipment. Opponent may destroy equipment if their personnel are present and unopposed.

name: Transporter Drones
lore: Typical reconnaissance devices modified by the Son'a to fire isolinear tags. Transporters can lock onto a tagged object, overcoming any interference with normal targeting scanners.
game_text: Participates in battle like a personnel, using STRENGTH=8 (may not be modified) vs. adversary's CUNNING. May capture, and beam to your ship here, an adversary it stuns.

name: 211th Rule of Acquisition
lore: "Employees are the rungs on the ladder of success – don't hesitate to step on them."
game_text: Plays on Quark's Bar or Ferengi Trading Post. Each time opponent plays a card on your turn (except Q icon, Referee, or Tactic), opponent must first discard X cards; X = (your dabo girls and Ferengi waiters present) – (opponent's personnel present)..

name: Ancestral Vision
lore: Tribal lore tells of Sky Spirits who guided the Rubber Tree People in Earth's distant past. When Chakotay found the Spirits' home in the Delta Quadrant, he was beset with visions of his ancestors.
game_text: Seeds or plays on a Delta Quadrant planet. End of each turn, if your Honor personnel who has INTEGRITY>7 is present, draw an extra card. (May not be nullified if Chakotay present.

name: Anti-Time Anomaly
lore: Q-created phenomena. Rift caused by anti-time particles in the future. Anomaly grows backward in time endangering all life in the past.
game_text: Plays on table. Kills literally ALL personnel in play (both players' cards) at the end of your third full turn, unless anti-time anomaly destroyed first.

name: Atmospheric Ionization
lore: Charged particles in the atmosphere of planets which can disrupt transporter beams.
game_text: Plays crosswise on any planet location. Maximum of three personnel per turn can be beamed up or down at this location. (Unique.)

name: Baryon Buildup
lore: Baryon particles build up on a ship's hull after prolonged warp travel. Particles must be periodically removed with a baryon sweep, which requires evacuation of the ship.
game_text: Plays on ship. RANGE is reduced by 2. (Cumulative.) Nullified if ship is empty and docked at your facility at the beginning of your turn.

name: Bynars Weapon Enhancement
lore: Binary race closely integrated with computers. Always work in pairs. Bynars have the ability to enhance specific computerized systems.
game_text: Plays on ship. Ship is WEAPONS +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Captain's Log
lore: A commanding officer's journal of events. While on the surface of El-Adrel IV, Tamarian Captain Dathon made entries into his log by hand.
game_text: Plays on table. Each of your ships with its matching commander aboard is SHIELDS and WEAPONS +3. (Captain's Order.)

name: Distortion Field
lore: Atmospheric phenomena that inhibits use of transporters, as on Nervala IV.
game_text: Plays crosswise face up on any planet location. Once each turn, flip card over. While face up, prevents all beaming down/up here. (Unique.)

name: Duj Saq
property_logo: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
lore: Klingon for "land the ship." Though K'Vort-class ships were larger and more heavily armed than the B'rel design they were based upon, only the 23rd-century original had this ability.
game_text: Plays on table. Your B'rel-class ships may report on planets that have a matching affiliation icon. Each may use 1 RANGE to land or take off once each turn. (Captain's Order.)

name: Engage Shuttle Operations
lore: As starships grew in size, shuttlepod launch bays evolved into large hangars, able to launch and recover support craft.
game_text: Plays on table. Your shuttlecraft may take off and land (using full RANGE) and be loaded, carried, and launched by your ships with Tractor Beam and ENGINEER aboard (uses 0 RANGE).

name: Espionage: Bajoran on Cardassian
lore: Bajorans have investigated Cardassian activities before, during and after the 30-year occupation. In 2371, Odo contacted an old Cardassian acquaintance to investigate the Obsidian Order.
game_text: Plays on a Cardassian mission (for free if your Resistance personnel is there). Your cards may attempt it as if it were Bajoran. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).

name: Espionage: Cardassian on Bajoran
lore: Since withdrawing from Bajor in 2369, Cardassians have kept a watchful eye on Bajoran activities.
game_text: Plays on a Bajoran mission. Your cards may attempt it as if it were Cardassian. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).

name: Espionage: Cardassian on Federation
lore: Cardassian spies are masters of undercover operations. In 2371, Miles O'Brien was framed by a surgically altered Cardassian posing as retired Starfleet officer Raymond Boone.
game_text: Plays on a Federation mission. Your cards may attempt it as if it were Cardassian. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).

name: Espionage: Cardassian on Klingon
lore: Cardassians have long been suspicious of the Klingon Empire. The unprovoked Klingon invasion of 2372 demonstrated the need to step up the Union's intelligence-gathering activities.
game_text: Plays on a Klingon mission. Your cards may attempt it as if it were Cardassian. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).

name: Espionage: Dominion on Federation
lore: Dominion intelligence operations conducted against the Federation have included the initial Eris ruse, Borath's virtual invasion scenario and even changeling infiltration of Earth.
game_text: Plays on a Federation mission (for free if your Federation Infiltrator personnel is there). Your cards may attempt it as if it were Dominion . Discard when solved (just after points are scored).

name: Espionage: Dominion on Klingon
lore: A changeling impersonating General Martok manipulated Gowron so craftily that the Chancellor abandoned the Khitomer Accords and declared war on its long-time ally the Federaton.
game_text: Plays on a Klingon mission (for free if your Klingon Infiltrator personnel is there). Your cards may attempt it as if it were Dominion. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).

name: Espionage: Dominion on Romulan
lore: Romulan counter-espionage protocols are second to none. The vigilance of the Tal Shiar protected the Star Empire from enemy spies for decades – until the Dominion arrived.
game_text: Plays on a Romulan mission (for free if your Romulan Infiltrator personnel is there). Your cards may attempt it as if it were Dominion. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).

name: Espionage: Romulan on Bajoran
lore: Romulan spies are still everywhere.
game_text: Plays on a Bajoran mission. Your cards may attempt it as if it were Romulan. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).

name: Espionage: Romulan on Cardassian
lore: Romulan infiltration of Cardassian facilities has gone largely undetected for decades.
game_text: Plays on a Cardassian mission. Your cards may attempt it as if it were Romulan. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).

name: Fair Play
lore: When Miles O'Brien discovered his publicized racquetball match was unfairly influenced by an alien gambling device, he refused to take advantage of an unfair situation.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; may not be nullified. No player may solve an opponent's unique mission unless its point box shows at least 40 points OR both players have a copy of it in play.

name: Fal-tor-pan
property_logo: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
lore: Vulcan refusion of the body and katra. The ritual was performed successfully for the first time since ancient legend between Leonard H. McCoy, son of David, and Spock, son of Sarek.
game_text: Plays on table. At any time, if top card of your discard pile is a Vulcan personnel, you may place it here. Personnel here may report to the planet Vulcan as if from your hand.

name: Genetronic Replicator
lore: Medical device invented by Dr. Toby Russell. Capable of growing replacements for damaged organs.
game_text: Plays on table. When a personnel is targeted to die, you may stop 2 MEDICAL present (who are not also targeted to die) to return that personnel to hand instead.

name: Genetronic Replicator
lore: Medical device invented by Dr. Toby Russell. Capable of growing replacements for damaged organs.
game_text: Plays on table. When a personnel is targeted to die, you may stop 2 MEDICAL present (who are not also targeted to die) to return that personnel to hand instead.

name: Holo-Projectors
lore: The hologram projector on Minos is an example of planet-based interactive holographic technology.
game_text: Plays on a planet mission. Hologram cards may exist on this planet.

name: Holo-Projectors
lore: Technology which the escaped Hirogen holograms hoped to use to establish a permanent home planet. B'Elanna Torres helped Kejal bring the device online.
game_text: Plays on a planet. Hologram cards may exist on this planet (activated or deactivated). If nullified, Hologram cards that depended on these Holo-Projectors for existence are erased.

name: Intermix Ratio
lore: Zefram Cochrane struggled to maintain the optimum balance of matter and anti-matter injection for the Phoenix warp systems. The proper ratio, of course, is 1 to 1.
game_text: Plays on table. If any player's ratio of bonus points to non-bonus points exceeds 1:1, the excess bonus points do not count toward winning. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Interrogation
lore: In violation of the Seldonis IV convention, Gul Madred interrogated Jean-Luc Picard, seeking Starfleet strategic secrets. He kept asking, "How many lights do you see?"
game_text: Plays on your captive (limit one; discard if released). Once each turn per copy, ask, "How many lights?" If opponent replies "Five," score 10 points; relocate captive anywhere (opponent's choice; released). Otherwise, score 1 point.

name: Interrogation
lore: In violation of the Seldonis IV convention, Gul Madred interrogated Jean-Luc Picard, seeking Starfleet strategic secrets. He kept asking, "How many lights do you see?"
game_text: Plays on your captive (limit one; discard if released). Once each turn per copy, ask, "How many lights?" If opponent replies "Five," score 10 points; relocate captive anywhere (opponent's choice; released). Otherwise, score 1 point.

name: Invasive Beam-In
lore: Dominion transporter technology is optimized for combat operations. The ability to breach enemy shields allows rapid deployment of Jem'Hadar warriors in most battle scenarios.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Each of your ships with Invasive Transporters and Transporter Skill aboard may beam your personnel matching that ship through opponent's SHIELDS.

name: Klim Dokachin
lore: Zakdorn quartermaster controlling the Starfleet surplus depot at Qualor II. A typical bureaucrat of the type that delights in delays that make life difficult for officers.

name: Klim Dokachin
lore: Zakdorn quartermaster controlling the Starfleet surplus depot at Qualor II. A typical bureaucrat of the type that delights in delays that make life difficult for officers.
game_text: Plays on table. Opponent loses their normal card draw if they played a unique personnel this turn.

name: Lower Decks
lore: Junior officers aboard all starships cooperate in their duties while competing for promotion and advancement, such as Ensigns Taurik, Sito, Lavelle and Ogawa.
game_text: Plays on table. Each of your non-holographic, universal personnel is attributes all +2. (Captain's Order.)

name: Memory Wipe
lore: Satarran operatives use bioelectric fields to cause selective memory suppression. Victims retain basic skills and aptitudes, but lose their sense of identity and affiliation.
game_text: Seeds on table; your opponent's cards may mix regardless of affiliation. OR Plays on a non-Borg affiliation ship; ship, crew, and ship's Away Teams lose affiliation and become Non-Aligned affiliation.

name: Metaphasic Shields
lore: Revolutionary shields using overlapping subspace fields. Invented by Ferengi Dr. Reyga.
game_text: Plays on your ship. SHIELDS +2 for each SCIENCE classification personnel aboard.

name: Mirror Image
lore: Jean-Luc Picard reflected upon introducing an unstable element into a critical situation.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. All Red Alert!, Kivas Fajo - Collector, Masaka Transformations and The Traveler: Transcendence cards affect all players. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Nutational Shields
lore: Nutation adjusts the shield frequency phase rotation, thereby increasing shield efficiency. Used against the Borg in 2367.
game_text: Plays on your ship. SHIELDS +2 for each ENGINEER-classification personnel aboard.

name: Ocular Implants
lore: In 2371, Geordi La Forge received implants allowing him to see without his VISOR. They include enhanced capabilities such as infrared and zoom focus over 500 meters.
game_text: Plays on your Borg, android, or any Geordi. Once each turn, you may examine either one Away Team present OR bottom seed card of mission here.

name: Ocular Implants
lore: In 2371, Geordi La Forge received implants allowing him to see without his VISOR. They include enhanced capabilities such as infrared and zoom focus over 500 meters.
game_text: Plays on your Borg, android, or any Geordi. Once each turn, you may examine either one Away Team present OR bottom seed card of mission here.

name: Red Alert!
lore: The state of maximum crew and systems readiness aboard starships.
game_text: Plays on table. In place of your normal card play, you may report for duty any number of Ship, Personnel, and Equipment cards.

name: Revolving Door
lore: Surreal door created by unknown aliens, found on Theta 116 VIII. Open to entry but seemingly closed to exit.

name: Revolving Door
lore: Surreal door created by unknown aliens, found on Theta 116 VIII. Open to entry but seemingly closed to exit.
game_text: Plays on any non-Shield Doorway or Iconian Gateway; it is closed while this card is face up. At start of any player's turn, that player may discard a non-personnel card from hand to "revolve" (flip) this card. (Unique.) OR Nullifies Revolving Door.

name: Revolving Door
lore: Surreal door created by unknown aliens, found on Theta 116 VIII. Open to entry but seemingly closed to exit.

name: Revolving Door
lore: Surreal door created by unknown aliens, found on Theta 116 VIII. Open to entry but seemingly closed to exit.
game_text: Plays on any non-Shield Doorway or Iconian Gateway; it is closed while this card is face up. At start of any player's turn, that player may discard a non-personnel card from hand to "revolve" (flip) this card. (Unique.) OR Nullifies Revolving Door.

name: Rishon Uxbridge
lore: In his grief, the Douwd Kevin Uxbridge re-created his dead wife, Rishon. As if she were real, he responded to her stubborn tendency to keep him calm at tense moments.
game_text: Plays atop one Event card in play; it is immune to Kevin Uxbridge.

name: The Next Emanation
lore: Believing themselves bound for an afterlife, the Vhnori used a device to send their dead through spectral ruptures, unaware the bodies were being sent to decompose on distant asteroids.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Opponent's non-Universal personnel discarded from play are placed under here instead of in discard pile.

page_title: To Be or Not to Be (TMP) (Errata)
name: To Be or Not to Be
base_name: To Be or Not to Be
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: taH pagh taHbe'. DaH mu'tlheghvam vlqelnlS. quv'a', yabDaq San vaQ cha, pu' je SIQDI'? pagh, Seng blQ'a'Hey SuvmeH nuHmey SuqDI', 'ej, Suvmo', rlnmoHDI'?
game_text: Plays on table. May discard event just after a battle your opponent initiated to damage all opposing ships (including cloaked ships) in that battle. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Torture
lore: Jean-Luc Picard was captured by Cardassians in 2369. He was subjected to intense physiological and psychological torture in an effort to obtain strategic Federation information.

name: Treaty: Federation/Romulan/Klingon
lore: Three major Alpha Quadrant powers, in an uncharacteristic show of solidarity in 2373, focused their resources against the Dominion threat in a united stand at station Deep Space 9.
game_text: Plays on table. While you have no open side decks, your Federation, Romulan and Klingon affiliations are compatible and ignore affiliation battle restrictions. They may not attempt opponent's missions.

name: Yellow Alert
lore: State of increased readiness and watchfulness. Declared by a captain in anticipation of danger or when a crisis situation has lessened.
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, cancels (discards) and prevents Red Alert! AND all of your Personnel are each CUNNING +1 (Not cumulative.) (Captain's Order.)

name: Yellow Alert
lore: State of increased readiness and watchfulness. Declared by a captain in anticipation of danger or when a crisis situation has lessened.
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, cancels (discards) and prevents Red Alert! AND all of your Personnel are each CUNNING +1 (Not cumulative.) (Captain's Order.)

name: Bajoran Outpost
lore: The Bajoran homeworld is Bajor. The Bajorans establish outposts throughout their territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Bajoran ENGINEER.

name: Borg Outpost
lore: Identification: BORG OUTPOSTTask: Construct Borg vessels. Disseminate acquired resources.
game_text: Seed one at any Space mission with no affiliation icons OR build at such a mission (or at an assimilated planet) where you have a Borg ENGINEER. Download Transwarp Network Gateway.

name: Cardassian Outpost
lore: Cardassia Prime is the homeworld of the Cardassians. The Cardassion Union establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Cardassian ENGINEER.

name: Deep Space Nine (front)
lore: Formerly known as Terok Nor. Now a Bajoran trading center and administrative facility run by the Federation.
game_text: Seeds at a Bajor Region location. If commandeered by any personnel who is not Bajoran or Federation}20px , flip card over.

name: Terok Nor (back)
lore: Mining station in Bajoran system. Operated by Cardassians using Bajorans in forced-labor conditions.
game_text: Seeds at Bajor Region location. If commandeered by any personnel who is Bajoran or Federation affiliation, flip card over.

name: Empok Nor (front)
lore: Cardassian mining station abandoned in 2372.
game_text: Seeds (uncontrolled) during mission phase at a Universal mission. Dilemmas with "Empok Nor" in gametext or lore may seed beneath station; may not be commandeered while dilemmas remain. No reporting aboard. flip over if commandeered.

name: Empok Nor (back)
lore: Abandoned mining station recently repaired and activated.
game_text: When first flipped, each player may download to station up to ten different Site and/or Equipment cards that may play there. (Normal reporting now allowed.)

name: Mirror Terok Nor (front)
lore: Cardassian ore processing facility commandeered by the Terran Rebellion in the mirror universe.
game_text: 'Seeds at Bajor. If commandeered, new controller may flip card over. Quark's Bar may seed or play here. Ops may only seed or play here if Terran Empire in gametext.''

name: Mirror Terok Nor (back)
lore: Cardassian ore processing facility controlled by the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance in the mirror universe.
game_text: Seeds at Bajor. If commandeered, new controller may flip card over. Quark's Bar may seed or play here. Ops may only seed or play here if Klingon Cardassian Alliance in gametext.

name: Nor
lore: Ore mining and processing station representative of facilities throughout Cardassian territory.
game_text: Seeds or plays at any Cardassian mission location or (except a Bajor Region location).

name: Primary Supply Depot
lore: Gamma Quadrant space facility. Long-time source of ketracel-white for Jem'Hadar troops.
game_text: Seeds at any non-homeworld Gamma Quadrant mission. Your non-weapon equipment may seed aboard (limit three). Resets countdowns of Ketracel-White aboard. Does not repair ships.

name: Remote Supply Depot
lore: Recently constructed space facility designed to support Dominion expansion into other quadrants.
game_text: Build where you have a Dominion ENGINEER. Your equipment may report aboard, for free, regardless of quadrant. Resets countdowns of Ketracel-White aboard. Does not repair ships.

name: Federation Outpost
lore: Earth is a member of the United Federation of Planets. The Federation establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Federation ENGINEER.

name: Klaestron Outpost
lore: Klaestron IV is a member of the United Federation of Planets. Its inhabitants also maintain a strong alliance with the Cardassian Union.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Klaestron ENGINEER.

name: Ferengi Outpost
lore: Ferenginar is a rainy, soggy homeworld of the highly capitalistic Ferengi people. The Ferengi Alliance establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Ferengi ENGINEER.

name: Klingon Outpost
lore: The Klingon Homeworld is Qo'noS. The Klingon Empire establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Klingon ENGINEER.

name: Colony
lore: Communities are commonly founded on uninhabited planets. Many are not charted by the Federation.
game_text: Build on any planet mission you completed. Each unopposed CIVILIAN inside at start of its owner's turn scores 1 point.

name: Neutral Outpost
lore: A common space station design used by many races for research or trade. Personnel and ships from all affiliations are frequent visitors at such facilities.
game_text: Seed one at any Space mission OR build at any Space mission where you have any ENGINEER. Does not repair ships.

name: Neutral Outpost
lore: A common space station design used by many races for research or trade. Personnel and ships from all affiliations are frequent visitors at such facilities.
game_text: Seed one at any Space mission OR build at any Space mission where you have any ENGINEER. Does not repair ships.

name: Husnock Outpost
lore: The sudden eradication of the entire Husnock race left it's many outposts vacant. Various affiliations take advantage of these available facilities.
game_text: Seed at any Non-Aligned location. You may seed one Universal Husnock Ship face up here. Extends only 25% of its SHIELDS to ships.

name: Romulan Outpost
lore: Romulus is one of the two homeworlds for the Romulans. The Romulan Star Empire establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Romulan ENGINEER.

name: Access Denied
game_text: [:Category:Seed cards (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Seeds]] or plays on table. While in play, nullifies all Establish Gateway objectives targeting your missions. You may suspend play while you discard incident to download Fractal Encryption Code.

name: Blood Oath
game_text: Plays on a non-Borg personnel who has INTEGRITY<8 and no Honor. Adds Nemesis Red left icon beginning at start of your next turn. OR Plays on table. While you have two Nemesis Red Right personnel present together, all Nemesis Red left personnel lose their first-listed skill and, in place of your normal card draw, you may download to that location I.K.C. Ning'tao, I.K.C. Lukara, I.K.C. Gr'oth, Bat'leth, Blood Oath or one Nemesis Red right personnel.

name: Captured
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. During your turn, your non-Borg crew or Away Team may capture one opposing personnel present (random selection) if you have more SECURITY present than opponent, or more hand weapons present than opponent. OR During any player's turn, you may capture one personnel just stunned in battle by your non-Borg SECURITY. Discard incident after either use.

name: Caretaker's Array
game_text: Seeds at Ocampa planet (limit one here). Each player may seed a non-Borg Delta Quadrant ship here. OR Plays once each turn to relocate your ship in the Badlands Region to Caretaker's Array. OR Plays at any time, for free, if a ship is about to be destroyed by Navigate Plasma Storms. Instead relocate ship to Ocampa planet or owner's hand.

name: Ceti Eel
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
game_text: Plays on table (once each turn, for free). On your turn, you may place on a personnel present with Khan. Personnel becomes Non-Aligned, is under your control, is attributes all –3, and is not discarded at end of turn by Revenge Is A Dish Best Served Cold. Nullified if personnel is an android or Hologram. You may not place more than two Ceti Eels on personnel during any turn (even with Mas'ud).

name: Children of Light
lore: Iden liberated enslaved photonics, recruiting them to his cause.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Hologram personnel are compatible with each other and have no affiliation attack restrictions. OR Plays to capture all Hologram personnel present with your Iden, or (if he is aboard Olarra) all personnel aboard one damaged ship at his location; discard incident.

name: Clone Machine
game_text: Seeds or plays on Mariposa, Boreth, a Dominion facility, or an Infirmary. Your unique personnel (except a Hologram, android, or dual personnel) may report here if a copy is already in play (limit once each turn; requires Koroth OR a personnel with INTEGRITY<6 and MEDICAL, Biology, or Exobiology present). Once every turn, if your Vorta just died, you may download any version of that persona here, ignoring uniqueness.

name: Cybernetics Expertise
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, your android may report for free to your matching outpost (if your personnel with printed Cybernetics is aboard) OR to your personnel with printed Cybernetics x2. Also, once each turn, you may exchange a card from hand for an android in your discard pile.

name: Delta Quadrant Spatial Scission
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. You may have up to two copies of each unique Delta Quadrant Personnel or Ship card in play. Also, once each turn, you may place a unique Delta Quadrant Personnel or Ship card from your hand out-of-play if you have a copy of that card in play (once per game per card title): all copies in play are attributes all +2 until start of your next turn, and you may play a personnel or draw a card.

name: Hirogen Hunt
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. In place of your normal card draw, you may download Rituals of the Hunt, Hirogen Hunt or any Hirogen ship. Also, once each turn, you may report an Alpha‑Hirogen (or any Hirogen card that names in its lore an Alpha-Hirogen you already have in play) for free. OR Plays on your Hirogen ship; its transporters may be used to beam through SHIELDS of any damaged ship here (even if landed).

name: Holoprogram: Fortress of Doom
game_text: Seeds or plays on your ship with a Holodeck. In place of your normal card play, you may download Chaotica (or any card with his name in lore) aboard. While Chaotica is aboard (and Captain Proton is not at same location), opponent must discard two cards to attempt mission at this location unless they have a Hologram personnel participating in the attempt.

name: Intruder Alert!
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; nullifies all seeded Memory Wipe cards. At any time, you may capture a one- or two-person Away Team in your Ops or assimilate one personnel intruder on your Borg ship or facility if your Talon Drone is present (discard incident) OR download Intruder Force Field (place incident atop event to protect it from nullification and extend its effects to all intruders on your ships).

name: Obelisk of Masaka
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Each time a card provides multiple card draws, only one may be converted to a download. Also, to move or initiate battle, each ship with one or more staffing icons (and each Interceptor) requires at least two crew members aboard. Once each turn (unless opponent has The Mask of Korgano in play), you may download Masaka Transformations targeting yourself, then discard incident.

name: Panel Overload
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Discard incident to nullify Bynars Weapon Enhancement or Genetronic Replicator. You may place incident on any outpost to prevent its Spacedoors from re-opening (nullified by 4 ENGINEER aboard).

name: Q the Referee
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, you may play one Referee card for free OR discard (or place beneath draw deck) one of your Referee cards from hand or in play to draw a card. Also, you may suspend play while you download any other Referee card (ignoring Computer Crash), then discard incident.

name: Reactor Overload
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Place on your ship or facility. Erases all Hologram aboard, disables all androids aboard (until Cybernetics present), kills all Borg aboard (unless their controller controls a Communications drone at this location), and nullifies all Rogue Borg aboard. Return incident to hand.

name: Release This Pain
property_logo: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier

name: Release This Pain
property_logo: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
lore: "Share your pain with me… and gain strength from the sharing."
game_text: Plays once each turn (for free) on a personnel present with your Sybok. Personnel loses all Treachery, is under your control, gains Sha Ka Ree, and is compatible with your Sha Ka Ree cards.

name: Relics of the Chase
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once per battle, your Hirogen may capture an opposing personnel he just stunned. Also, once each turn, your Hirogen using a Hirogen Talon may place in point area one opponent's personnel he just killed in personnel battle (or, if he is an Alpha-Hirogen, one captive he is escorting); score points equal to that personnel's highest printed attribute.

name: Scanner Interference
game_text: Plays on table. Adds 1 Computer Skill to requirements of Scan and Full Planet Scan. After an opponent examines a dilemma outside of a mission attempt (after seed cards are replaced) you may discard incident to download and seed one Botany Bay dilemma there (even from discard pile).

name: Sphere Encounter
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Each of your Borg spheres is RANGE +4. Also, whenever opponent initiates an attempt of one of your Space missions with your Borg Only on it, you may download there any number of personnel, equipment and/or Borg Spheres each may initiate battle (regardless of your current objective) or move away.

name: Strategema
lore: Against an opponent of equivalent skill, a game of Strategema can last well over one thousand moves.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Ooby Dooby is nullified. Q's Planet may not enter play. Your opponent may not initiate battle at a homeworld against your force containing a card matching that homeworld's affiliation.

name: The Kazon Collective
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Kazon affiliation is immune to assimilation. Once each turn, if you have a Maje in play, you may report another Kazon of his sect for free. OR Plays on your Kazon Warship. Your Kazon Personnel and Ship cards (except other Warships) may report aboard.

name: The Vidiian Sodality
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, you may report either a MEDICAL-classification Vidiian personnel or an Equipment with "MEDICAL" in gametext for free. OR Plays on your Vidiian cruiser. Your Vidiian personnel may report aboard.

name: Vidiian Boarding Claw
game_text: Plays on any undocked ship present with your staffed, unstopped Vidiian cruiser (discard if you lose control of cruiser). Those ships may not fire WEAPONS at each other; yours may not move. Your personnel may walk through Claw to and from other ship. If other ship moves, both ships are first damaged (discard Claw). You may discard Claw during your turn.

name: War Council
game_text: Seeds or play on your Neutral or Non-Aligned facility, except Colony or a Nor. Your Non-Aligned cards do not work with aligned cards and have standard attack restrictions. Each of your Non-Aligned CIVILIAN and V.I.P. personnel native to this quadrant is CUNNING +2; once each turn, one such personnel reporting aboard may do so for free. OR Plays on your crew or Away Team that has 4 Treachery. Draw up to three cards; discard incident.

name: Writ of Accountability
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once per game, downloads an FCA personnel; discard incident OR Seeds or plays on table. Place on your Ferengi FCA personnel. If opponent has used Subspace Schism or Brain Drain more than twice OR played Static Warp Bubble, Anti-Time Anomaly or Black Hole more than once OR used their own dilemma(s) to score more than 15 points or to discard other dilemmas, they lose the game.

name: A Change of Plans
lore: Sensing that her plans for the interplexing beacon had been thwarted, the Borg Queen immediately implemented a new goal for the hive.
game_text: Plays to do any or all of the following: discard your current objective; return it to your hand if you have Borg Queen in play; and download one Borg Only Objective card.

name: Adapt: Negate Obstruction
lore: The first experience of a hazard can be as dangerous to a Borg drone as to anyone. However, the Borg soon adapt and learn to nullify it.
game_text: Nullifies a dilemma (except a Q-related dilemma) just encountered by your Communications Borg if your Borg encountered that dilemma (or a copy) on a previous turn.

name: Amanda Rogers
lore: Female Q raised as a human on Earth. Was taken to the Q continuum by Q after she could not resist the benevolent use of her powers.
game_text: Nullifies any one Interrupt card just played OR any other card just played as an Interrupt card. (Immune to Amanda Rogers.)

name: Amanda Rogers
lore: Female Q raised as a human on Earth. Was taken to the Q continuum by Q after she could not resist the benevolent use of her powers.
game_text: Nullifies any one Interrupt card just played OR any other card just played as an Interrupt card. (Immune to Amanda Rogers.)

name: Auto-Destruct Sequence
lore: Computer controlled self-destruct countdown which can be set by the senior officers aboard a ship.
game_text: Plays on your ship. Ship self-destructs at end of your turn. Explosion damages all other ships at same location that have SHIELDS<8.

name: Auto-Destruct Sequence
lore: When in a hopeless situation facing insurmountable odds, most starship captains would sooner destroy their own vessel than let it fall into enemy hands.
game_text: Plays on your ship. When countdown expires, destroys ship. Then, damages all other ships present with SHIELDS<8.

name: Beyond the Subatomic
lore: In 2374, Kes' mental abilities began to grow at an astonishing rate. Soon she was able to perceive and control a new level of reality that exists in the space between subatomic particles.
game_text: Name a card type. Reveals cards from top of draw deck until you reveal a card of selected type; take into hand, remove other revealed cards from game. (If you exhaust draw deck, lose the game.)

name: Brain Drain
lore: In Lt. Commander Data's dream, his perception of the leach-like interphasic creatures aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise was symbolized by the surreal actions of his friends.
game_text: Plays (once every turn) on any crew or Away Team. Remove all skills and CUNNING from one personnel present until end of turn. OR Plays on Interphasic Plasma Creatures, doubling effects.

name: Data Laughing
lore: When Lt. Commander Data rescued the temporarily mortal Q from the Calamarain in 2366, Q awarded him with the gift of laughter.
game_text: Nullifies Calamarain OR doubles Data's Head this turn. OR Plays on a ship affected by Lore Returns; you gain control of that ship and all Rogue Borg Mercenaries aboard.

name: Data, Keep Dealing
lore: Data could shuffle playing cards as if they were isolinear chips removed by an intoxicated engineer. Will Riker often quipped, "Sometimes I wonder if he's stacking the deck."
game_text: If you have in play any Data or any Hollander, look at the top two and bottom two cards of your draw deck. Replace in any order, two on top and two on bottom.

name: Disruptor Overload
lore: A directed-energy weapon can be set on overload and left to explode like a bomb.
game_text: Plays on any ship or Away Team. Where present, destroys one Equipment card or one card used as an Equipment card (random selection).

name: Distortion of Space/Time Continuum
lore: Time effects can be caused by the unusual warping or rifting of space.
game_text: Plays on any ship. "Unstops" ship, crew, and ship's Away Teams and restore any of this turn's RANGE already used by that ship.

name: Distortion of Space/Time Continuum
lore: Even minor temporal incursions can cause shock waves with far-reaching effects. Annorax's sweeping interference changed both ancient and recent history throughout the Delta Quadrant.
game_text: Plays on your non-Alternate Universe ship just after opponent plays an Alternate Universe card. You may discard to unstop ship and crew OR restore full RANGE OR unstop an Away Team here. (Unique.)

name: Distortion of Space/Time Continuum
lore: Time effects can be caused by the unusual warping or rifting of space.
game_text: Plays on any ship. "Unstops" ship, crew, and ship's Away Teams and restore any of this turn's RANGE already used by that ship.

name: Emergency Transporter Armbands
lore: Devices which allow quick remote activation of a transporter when in danger.
game_text: Beam your Personnel up or down at any time, except during a dilemma (unless specifically permitted). May be used during battle before the winner is determined.

name: End Transmission
lore: Subspace communications are sometimes abruptly terminated by the transmitter.
game_text: Play on table. Immediately end your turn. (Unique.)

name: Escape Pod
lore: Rapid-deploy emergency evacuation modules. Most starships are equipped with such systems.
game_text: Plays at a location just after your ship there is destroyed; relocate its crew(s) atop this card. You may later relocate them to your ship here, then discard interrupt.

name: Full Planet Scan
lore: Sensor instruments can make detailed scans of a planet surface and atmosphere.

name: Full Planet Scan
lore: Sensor instruments can make detailed scans of a planet surface and atmosphere.

name: Full Planet Scan
lore: Sensor instruments can make detailed scans of a planet surface and atmosphere.
game_text: Plays at the start of your turn on your ship with at least two staffing icons at a Planet mission. Stop your Computer Skill and Geology aboard to examine the bottom seed card here.

name: Going to the Top
lore: Kira Nerys went directly to Admiral Rollman when she disagreed with one of Benjamin Sisko's command decisions. Sisko and Rollman were not exactly pleased with her action.
game_text: Plays if you have two Command personnel together on a facility. Download a compatible personnel with Leadership x2 to them (once per game per affiliation).

name: Humuhumunukunukuapua'a
lore: A reef triggerfish, Rhinecamthus aculeatus, found near Earth's tropical islands. An animated versions is a symbolic "guide" on the U.S.S. Enterprise schoolroom computers.
game_text: Plays on any location. Your Youth personnel here are CUNNING and STRENGTH +4; opponent's personnel here are CUNNING and STRENGTH –4.

page_title: I'm a Doctor, Not a Bricklayer (Errata) (MM)
name: I'm a Doctor, Not a Bricklayer
base_name: I'm a Doctor, Not a Bricklayer
lore: Despite his protestations to Captain Kirk, Dr. McCoy treated a grievously wounded Horta. Thermal concrete from the supplies of the Starship Enterprise made an excellent wound covering.
game_text: Nullifies Horta. OR One MEDICAL personnel gains Geology until end of turn. OR Once per game, downloads a Geology personnel to your MEDICAL and OFFICER.

name: I've Been Waiting for You
lore: Upon learning of Quark's plan to feature her in a lascivious holoscenario, Kira Nerys enlisted Odo's help in making a small change to the program. The client got far more than he paid for.
game_text: Once every turn, plays to exchange your unique Hologram personnel in play with a Hologram personnel from your hand.

name: Incoming Message: Bajoran
