lore: Originally, submicroscopic robots used for medical therapy. Now, self‑replicating sentient life-forms who can disable computer systems.
game_text: Damages afflicted ship unless 2 SCIENCE OR Diplomacy present. Discard Dilemma.

name: Nausicaans
lore: Tall humanoid species with a quick temper. A Nausicaan once stabbed Jean‑Luc Picard through the heart with a knife.
game_text: Three Nausicaans pick a fight. One Away Team member is killed (random selection) unless STRENGTH>44. Discard dilemma.

name: Nitrium Metal Parasites
lore: Microscopic life-forms that normally live in asteroids but can infest and damage ships by ingesting nitrium.

name: Null Space
lore: A rare, invisible pocket of space caused by turbulence during star formation. Absorbs all energy.
game_text: Ship hits null space turbulence and is damaged unless 2 Navigation aboard. Discard dilemma.

name: Phased Matter
lore: Phased personnel vibrate out of sync with normal matter, rendering them undetectable. Phased people cannot interact with non-phased people.

name: Portal Guard
lore: Portal 63 is the last remaining protector of the Tkon Empire, which went extinct 600,000 years ago. Challenges those who awaken him.
game_text: Unless at least one Away Team member has CUNNING>7 OR Honor, the entire Away Team must abort mission and beam up or die.

name: Q
lore: Incorrigible, extra-dimensional member of the Q Continuum, a race of omnipotent beings. Q exhibits a child-like petulance and sense of playfulness.

name: Radioactive Garbage Scow
lore: Barges containing dangerous waste can be adrift for centuries. One such barge threatened Gamelon V in 2367.

name: Rebel Encounter
lore: Belligerent rebels from war-torn worlds often hide out on other planets and can endanger an Away Team.
game_text: Kills one Away Team member (random selection) unless STRENGTH>44 OR you bribe rebels first by discarding an Equipment card, if present. Discard dilemma.

name: REM Fatigue Hallucinations
lore: A crew can go insane from lack of REM (rapid eye movement) sleep.

name: Sarjenka
lore: Alien child from Drema IV. Her radio pleas for help were answered by Lt. Commander Data in violation of the Prime Directive.
game_text: Primitive alien begs for help. Ignore her (discard dilemma) OR help her and earn Bonus points, but all Away Teams here are "stopped."

name: Shaka, When the Walls Fell
lore: "Shaka, when the walls fell," means inability to understand. The incomprehensible Tamarians spoke entirely in metaphors.
game_text: Must have 2 Diplomacy and CUNNING>30 to communicate and proceed.

name: Tarellian Plague Ship
lore: Ship containing the survivors of a Tarellia war plague. Infected from biological weapons, they are now refused entry everywhere.

name: Temporal Causality Loop
lore: Localized distortion causes time to repeat ad infinitum. U.S.S. Bozeman was trapped for 90 years in a temporal loop that held the U.S.S. Enterprise for 17.4 days.
game_text: Unless SCIENCE and CUNNING>35, undo your last two actions of this turn and end turn. Discard dilemma.

name: Tsiolkovsky Infection
lore: Variety of water-based Psi 2000 virus. Passed by perspiration. Creates dangerous intoxication-like instability among a crew.

name: Two-Dimensional Creatures
lore: Perfectly flat spaceborne creatures from a two-dimensional spatial continuum. Ensnared the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2367 and impeded Counselor Deanna Troi's empathic abilities.

name: Wind Dancer
lore: Sentry of the Parallax Colony. Only allows those whose hearts are joyous to pass.

name: Engineering Kit
lore: Representative of specialized engineering instruments. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Gives all of your OFFICER-classification personnel the extra skill of ENGINEER where present.

name: Engineering PADD
lore: Representative of Personal Access Display Devices designed specifically for engineering functions. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Gives all of your SCIENCE-classification personnel the extra skill of ENGINEER where present.

name: Federation PADD
lore: Standard Federation Personnel Access Display Device for computerized information.
game_text: Federation use only. Each of your personnel CUNNING +2 where present. (Cumulative.)

name: Klingon Disruptor
lore: Phase-disruptor used by Klingons and other races. Similar to a phaser.
game_text: Klingon and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel STRENGTH +2 where present. (Cumulative.)

name: Klingon PADD
lore: Standard Klingon Personnel Access Display Device for computerized information.
game_text: Klingon use only. Each of your personnel CUNNING +2 where present. (Cumulative.)

name: Medical Kit
lore: Representative of specialized medical equipment. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Gives all of your OFFICER-classification personnel the extra skill of MEDICAL where present.

name: Medical Tricorder
lore: Representative of specialized tricorder optimized for medical use. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Gives all of your SCIENCE-classification personnel the extra skill of MEDICAL where present.

name: Romulan Disruptor
lore: Directed-energy weapon used by Romulans and other races. Disruptor fire can be identified by a high residue of antriprotons that linger for several hours.
game_text: Romulan and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel STRENGTH +2 where present. (Cumulative.)

name: Romulan PADD
lore: Standard Romulan Personnel Access Display Device for computerized information.
game_text: Romulan use only. Each of your personnel CUNNING +2 where present. (Cumulative.)

name: Starfleet Type II Phaser
lore: Handheld weaponc an be set for stun, heat and disruption. PHASER is an acronym for PHASed Energy Rectification.

name: Tricorder
lore: Representative of multipurpose handheld device combining sensors, computers and recorders. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Gives all of your ENGINEER-classification personnel the extra skill of SCIENCE where present.

name: Alien Probe
lore: Space probes of unknown origin are frequently encountered by starships. Often such probes seek information or contact.
game_text: Plays on table. Both players continue the game with their hands (cards) exposed, face up on table.

name: Anti-Time Anomaly
lore: Q-created phenomena. Rift caused by anti-time particles in the future. Anomaly grows backward in time endangering all life in the past.

name: Atmospheric Ionization
lore: Charged particles in the atmosphere of planets which can disrupt transporter beams.

name: Bynars Weapon Enhancement
lore: Binary race closely integrated with computers. Always work in pairs. Bynars have the ability to enhance specific computerized systems.

name: Distortion Field
lore: Atmospheric phenomena that inhibits use of transporters as on Nervala IV.

name: Espionage: Federation on Klingon
lore: Federation intelligence-gathering has often relied upon sympathetic informants and electronic surveillance.
game_text: Plays on any Klingon mission. Your Federation personnel may now attempt this mission. Discard after mission completed.

name: Espionage: Klingon on Federation
lore: Klingon espionage against the Federation has included data stolen from Relay Station 47 by Morag.
game_text: Plays on any Federation mission. Your Klingon personnel may now attempt this mission. Discard after mission completed.

name: Espionage: Romulan on Federation
lore: Romulan spies are everywhere.
game_text: Plays on any Federation mission. Your Romulan personnel may now attempt this mission. Discard after mission completed.

name: Espionage: Romulan on Klingon
lore: Romulan espionage against Klingons has included efforts to de-stabilize the Klingon government by programming assassins and supporting rebel forces.
game_text: Plays on any Klingon mission. Your Romulan personnel may now attempt this mission. Discard after mission completed.

name: Gaps in Normal Space
lore: Pockets of space, such as those in the Mar Oscura nebula, dangerously phase out when coming in contact with a ship.
game_text: Place between two Mission cards. Creates a gap with a span of 4. Ships stopping on the gap kill one personnel (random selection).

name: Genetronic Replicator
lore: Medical device invented by Dr. Toby Russell. Capable of growing replacements for damaged organs.

name: Goddess of Empathy
lore: Lt. Reginald Barclay created a fantasy holodeck simulation of Counselor Deanna Troi. Her empathic abilities help other personnel anticipate danger.
game_text: Plays on table until the end of your turn. Neither you nor your opponent can play Interrupt cards (except Kevin Uxbridge or Q2). Discard event after use.

name: Holo-Projectors
lore: The hologram projector on Minos is an example of planet-based interactive holographic technology.

name: Kivas Fajo - Collector
lore: Treacherous collector of rare one-of-a-kind antiquities. Once tried to add Lt. Commander Data to his collection.
game_text: Choose any player to immediately draw three new cards from the top of their draw deck. Discard event after use.

name: Lore Returns
lore: Data's charismatic android brother. Identical except has more emotional ability. Had a negative effect on Data. Became Borg leader known as The One.
game_text: Plays where Rogue Borg have eliminated a ship's crew. With Lore, your Rogue Borg may now use ship to attack ships and/or beam to battle Away Teams.

name: Lore's Fingernail
lore: Circuitry in Lore's finger was used to control and manipulate Lt. Commander Data with emotions.
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, all Soong-type androids (including Lt. Cmdr. Data) and Exocomps lose their affiliation and are non-aligned personnel.

name: Masaka Transformations
lore: Masaka attempted to transform the U.S.S. Enterprise into an ancient temple and grounds by rearranging its matter.
game_text: Plays on any player. That player must shuffle entire hand, place on bottom of draw deck, then draw the same number of cards from the top. Discard event after use.

name: Metaphasic Shields
lore: Revolutionary shields using overlapping subspace fields. Invented by Ferengi Dr. Reyga.

name: Neural Servo Device
lore: Device which can be used to control a crew by activating pain causing implants.
game_text: Plays on any non-aligned ship. Unless 2 SECURITY aboard, use ship and crew for one turn as your own. Discard event.

name: Nutational Shields
lore: Nutation adjusts the shield frequency phase rotation, thereby increasing shield efficiency. Used against the Borg in 2367.

name: Pattern Enhancers
lore: Devices which amplify transporter signals to enhance transporter beam power in hazardous areas.
game_text: Plays on table. Allows your personnel and equipment unlimited beaming through atmospheric ionization or distortion fields.

name: Plasma Fire
lore: Intensely hot combustion of ionized plasma gas. Dangerous fire which can destroy a ship.
game_text: Plays on any ship, except Borg ship. Fire damages ship at end of next turn and continues damaging each turn. SECURITY puts it out. Discard after use.

name: Q-Net
lore: Q used an enormous forcefield grid in space to stop the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2364.
game_text: Plays between two adjacent spaceline locations. No ship may pass the Q-Net unless 2 Diplomacy aboard.

name: Raise the Stakes
lore: Weekly poker game aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise honed the tactical and bluffing skills of many officers.
game_text: Your opponent must forfeit the game OR agree the eventual winner may randomly select and keep one card from loser's 60-card deck. (Cumulative.)

name: Red Alert!
lore: The state of maximum crew and systems readiness aboard starships.

name: Res-Q
lore: Q once saved Captain Jean-Luc Picard's life following an injury from a compressed teryon beam.
game_text: Regenerates a card. Exchange this event for any one card from your discard pile.

name: Spacedock
lore: Orbital repair and building facility for starships. Such facilities have been developed by many races.
game_text: Plays on outpost. Instantly repairs your damaged ships if they stop here. Also repairs non-aligned ships.

name: Static Warp Bubble
lore: Dr. Beverly Crusher experienced a shrinking universe, shaped by her own thoughts, inside a static warp bubble created by Ensign Wesley Crusher.
game_text: Plays on table. Opponent must discard one card before ending each turn. (Not cumulative.)

name: Subspace Warp Rift
lore: Dr. Serova proved in 2370 that disastrous rifts occur in the fabric of space due to the excessive use of warp drive. Discovery led to a Federation-wide speed limit of warp 5.
game_text: Plays crosswise on any spaceline location. Any ship passing over here without stopping incurs damage.

name: Supernova
lore: The explosion of a star, usually caused by natural processes toward the end of its life cycle.
game_text: You must have Tox Uthat on table. Place atop any mission. Everything there is destroyed (discarded), but leave Mission card underneath for span reference.

name: Telepathic Alien Kidnappers
lore: Unknown aliens abducted Captain Jean-Luc Picard for telepathic studies about authority in 2366.
game_text: Plays on table. At end of each turn, guess a card type and point to a card in your opponent's hand. Card must be shown. If guessed correctly, card is discarded.

name: Tetryon Field
lore: Intense masses of subspace particles, unstable in normal space, which require ships to route through safe corridors.
game_text: Plays crosswise on any spaceline location. All ships must stop here before proceeding on next turn, unless Navigation aboard.

name: The Traveler: Transcendence
lore: Benevolent humanoid from Tau Alpha C who could transcend space and time with thought.
game_text: '''Place beside any player's draw deck. That player must draw one extra card at the end of each turn. Also, while in play, nullifies Static Warp Bubble (Not cumulative.)

name: Treaty: Federation/Klingon
lore: Past treaties between these powers included the Treaty of Alliance creating mutual aide and defense without intervention.
game_text: Plays on table. Your Federation and Klingon affiliations recognize this treaty. They can now mix and cooperate.

name: Treaty: Federation/Romulan
lore: Past treaties between these powers included the Treaty of Algeron, which created a neutral zone and outlawed Federation cloaking devices.
game_text: Plays on table. Your Federation and Romulan affiliations recognize this treaty. They can now mix and cooperate.

name: Treaty: Romulan/Klingon
lore: Historically bitter enemies, these two powers had a brief, failed alliance to share technology around 2268.
game_text: Plays on table. Your Romulan and Klingon affiliations recognize this treaty. They can now mix and cooperate.

name: Warp Core Breach
lore: In warp propulsion systems, if the magnetic confinement field collapses, matter and antimatter collide causing the ship to explode.
game_text: Plays on any ship, except Borg ship. Ship explodes at end of owner's next turn, unless ENGINEER aboard by then. Discard after use.

page_title: Where No One Has Gone Before (CT)
name: Where No One Has Gone Before
base_name: Where No One Has Gone Before
lore: The Traveler transcends space with thought. Took the U.S.S. Enterprise to Galaxy M-33, then to an even greater extragalactic distance.
game_text: Plays on table. Allows all your ships to leave one end of the spaceline and enter the other end.

name: Federation Outpost
lore: Earth is a member of the United Federation of Planets. The Federation establishes outposts throughout its territory.

name: Klingon Outpost
lore: The Klingon Homeworld is Qo'noS. The Klingon Empire establishes outposts throughout its territory.

name: Romulan Outpost
lore: Romulus is one of the two homeworlds for the Romulans. The Romulan Star Empire establishes outposts throughout its territory

name: Alien Groupie
lore: Lanel, a Malcorian nurse, agreed to help Commander William T. Riker, but only if he would...
game_text: Plays on any Away Team which has just completed a planet mission. Female groupie delays beam up of one male (random selection) for one full turn.

name: Amanda Rogers
lore: Female Q raised as a human on Earth. Was taken to the Q continuum by Q after she could not resist the benevolent use of her powers.

name: Asteroid Sanctuary
lore: Hoping to avoid detection by a Romulan Warbird, the U.S.S. Enterprise entered a giant asteroid cavern in 2370.
game_text: Plays on any ship. If 2 Navigation aboard, hides ship to prevent any battle initiated against that ship for this turn.

name: Auto-Destruct Sequence
lore: Computer controlled self-destruct countdown which can be set by the senior officers aboard a ship.

name: Crosis
lore: Fanatical Borg lieutenant of Lore. Captured Lt. Commander Data with the lure of emotions.
game_text: Plays on Rogue Borg. Doubles their STRENGTH, including himself. Two Borg =4 STRENGTH each, three Borg =6 STRENGTH each, etc. (Not cumulative.)

name: Disruptor Overload
lore: A directed-energy weapon can be set on overload and left to explode like a bomb.

name: Distortion of Space/Time Continuum
lore: Time effects can be caused by the unusual warping or rifting of space.

name: Emergency Transporter Armbands
lore: Devices which allow quick remote activation of a transporter when in danger.

name: Energy Vortex
lore: Whirlpool-like space/time phenomena that can destroy a ship, as it nearly did the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2365.
game_text: Plays immediately after opponent plays any non-Interrupt card from hand. That card returns to their hand and a different one must be played instead.

name: Escape Pod
lore: Angosian escape pod used by Roga Danar in 2366. Escape pods can be used in an emergency to save a crew.
game_text: Plays on ship being destroyed . Escape pod saves entire crew. Unseen by enemy ships, crew remains in pod until personnel rescued. Discard after rescue.

name: Full Planet Scan
lore: Sensor instruments can make detailed scans of a planet surface and atmosphere.

name: Honor Challenge
lore: The call to glory inspires the Klingon warrior to maximum fierceness and honor, as symbolized by the Bat'telh (sic) championship trophy.
game_text: Plays just after an Away Team battle is initiated. Each Klingon with Honor immediately kills one opponent with Treachery. Battle continues.

name: Hugh
lore: The Federation named a rescued Borg, Hugh. When he returned, his newly acquired self-aware personality collapsed the Borg collective.
game_text: Nullifies attack by Borg Ship for this turn OR destroys (discard ) all Rogue Borg at one location.

name: Incoming Message - Federation
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals amplified by networks of relay stations.
game_text: "Your ship must immediately return to the nearest Federation outpost, full speed." Place on one Federation ship until outpost reached, then discard.

name: Incoming Message - Klingon
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals amplified by networks of relay stations.
game_text: "Your ship must immediately return to the nearest Klingon outpost, full speed." Place on one Klingon ship until outpost reached, then discard.

name: Incoming Message - Romulan
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals amplified by networks of relay stations.
game_text: "Your ship must immediately return to the nearest Romulan outpost, full speed." Place on one Romulan ship until outpost reached, then discard.

name: Jaglom Shrek - Information Broker
lore: Yridian dealer of information who uncovered the Romulan prison camp in the Carraya system.
game_text: Look at opponent's draw deck for twenty seconds, then replace unshuffled.

name: Kevin Uxbridge
lore: Immortal omnipotent being called a Douwd. Lived secretly as a human. Took a human wife who was killed by the Husnocks at Delta Rana IV.

name: Klingon Death Yell
lore: Warning for the dead to beware; a Klingon warrior is about to arrive. In Klingon myth, killed warriors with honor go to Sto-Vo-Kor. Dishonored dead go to Gre'thor.
game_text: Plays on any just killed Klingon with Honor. Yell to warn the dead and earn bonus points. May play only one death yell for each such Klingon.

name: Klingon Right of Vengeance
lore: Under Klingon law, Lieutenant Worf claimed right of vengeance against Duras in 2367.
game_text: If any Klingon is killed in an away team battle, all other Klingons present may immediately re-attack with double STRENGTH.

name: Life-Form Scan
lore: A special form of sensor scan capable of detecting life-forms on planets or in space.
game_text: Glance at the cards in your opponent's hand for ten seconds.

name: Long-Range Scan
lore: Detects ships and phenomena at interstellar distances using ship sensors.
game_text: Glance at the cards aboard any ship for ten seconds.

name: Loss of Orbital Stability
lore: If a ship's orbit decays, it can drawn toward a planet and burn out in its atmosphere.

name: Near-Warp Transport
lore: Physically disconcerting transport at high-speed.
game_text: Allows beaming from ship to a neighboring spaceline location . Transport a maximum of six of your personnel and/or your equipment.

name: Palor Toff - Alien Trader
lore: Rich merchant and trader from an unknown race. Friend of Kivas Fajo. Snappy dresser.

name: Particle Fountain
lore: Experimental orbital station built by Dr. Farallon for mining a planet from space. Rumored to be effective for atmospheric depletion.
game_text: If 2 ENGINEER present in Away Team, play particle fountain (maximum of one) on just completed planet mission for bonus points.

name: Q2
lore: Member of the Q who observed Q's act of self-sacrifice and re-instated him in the Q continuum.

name: Rogue Borg Mercenaries
lore: Upon Hugh's return to the Borg collective, the Borg became self-aware. Soon, many unquestioningly followed their first leader, Lore.
game_text: Plays on any occupied ship. Battles crew and at start of every players' turn. Two Borg =2 STRENGTH each, three =3 each, etc. Surviving Borg remain.

name: Scan
lore: Sensor instruments can detect life signs and molecular signatures at a distance with accuracy.

name: Ship Seizure
lore: Tractor beams are focused linear graviton beams which can be used to seize or tow objects in space.
game_text: If your ship has tractor beams, tow away (discard) any empty ships in the same orbit as your own ship (except empty ships at their outpost).

name: Subspace Interference
lore: Disruptions of subspace communications can be caused by nebulae and other phenomena.
game_text: Prevents (nullifies) reception of Incoming Message OR Hail OR Subspace Schism. Both cards are discarded.

name: Subspace Schism
lore: Solanogen-based aliens from another subspace domain accessed our space to abduct people for experiments.
game_text: Plays within five seconds of either players' card draw. That player must discard that card and re-draw.

name: Tachyon Detection Grid
lore: Network of active tachyon beams between many ships. Devised by Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge in 2368 to detect cloaked vessels.
game_text: Must have at least four of your ships in play to use. Play on any cloaked ship to detect its presence. Ship is forced to de-cloak for rest of turn.

name: Temporal Rift
lore: Time displacement caused by ultra high energy explosions such as that which affected the U.S.S. Enterprise-C at Narendra III.

name: The Devil
lore: Ardra recreated the human mythical figure the Devil on Ventax II.
game_text: Destroys any one Treaty card on table OR one Horga'hn on table OR one Wind Dancer.

name: The Juggler
game_text: Choose any player to re-shuffle the cards in their draw deck.

name: Transwarp Conduit
lore: New Borg technology which creates an artificial subspace tunnel that increases effective warp speed.
game_text: Select a ship . It can move double range for this turn.

name: Vulcan Mindmeld
lore: Ancient Vulcan ritual which telepathically links minds to intimately share each other's thoughts and knowledge.

name: Wormhole
lore: An unstable tunnel through subspace that links to locations in normal space/time.

name: Avert Disaster
lore: Artrea: Aid project to delay solidification of the planet's core.

name: Covert Rescue
lore: Galorndon Core: Retrieve crashed scoutship in Federation territory.

name: Cultural Observation
lore: Mintaka III: Aid observation of primitive society.

name: Diplomacy Mission
lore: Peliar Zel: Mediate dispute between civilizations on Peliar Zel's two moons.

name: Evacuation
lore: Dorvan V: Evacuate American Indian colony.

name: Evaluate Terraforming
lore: Velara III: Evaluate progress of terraforming station.

name: Excavation
lore: Kurl: Assist new archaeological dig.

name: Explore Black Cluster
lore: Sector 97: Study and evaluate enormous cluster of collapsed protostars.

name: Explore Dyson Sphere
lore: Norpin V: Study gigantic structure completely enclosing a star.

name: Expose Covert Supply
lore: Qo'noS: Uncover covert supply lines supporting rebels on the Klingon Homeworld.

name: Extraction
lore: Cerebus II: Secretly acquire age-reversal drug reportedly under development.

name: Fever Emergency
lore: Nahmi IV: Coordinate aid for Correllium Fever outbreak.

name: First Contact
lore: Malcor III: Make initial contact with advancing civilization.

name: Hunt for DNA Program
lore: Vilmor II: Seek and secure last strand of DNA program on this desert planet.

name: Investigate Alien Probe
lore: Parvenium System: Study and evaluate mysterious probe sighted in this sector.

name: Investigate Anomaly
lore: Gamma Arigulon II: Trace radiation anomalies reported at this location.

name: Investigate Disappearance
lore: Hakaris Corridor: Trace disappearance of a medical transport ship.

name: Investigate Disturbance
lore: Boreth: Investigate disturbance at Boreth monastery.

name: Investigate Massacre
lore: Tarod IX: Initiate investigation into destruction of distant outpost.

name: Investigate Raid
lore: Ohniaka III: Investigate report of Borg attack.

name: Investigate Rogue Comet
lore: Sector 1156: Study unusual comet sighted in this sector.

name: Khitomer Research
lore: Khitomer: Reopen investigation into Khitomer massacre.

name: Krios Suppression
lore: Krios: Aid suppression of warring factions.

name: Medical Relief
lore: Beta Lankal: Respond to reported medical emergency.

name: New Contact
lore: Tau Alpha C: Seek contact with advanced civilization at this distant planet.

name: Pegasus Search
lore: Devlin System Asteroid Belt: Search for U.S.S. Pegasus, reported lost in this sector.

name: Plunder Site
lore: Barradas III: Search ancient civilization site for treasures or artifacts.

name: Relief Mission
lore: Penthara IV: Alleviate planet of Ice Age conditions following type-C asteroid impact.

name: Repair Mission
lore: Edge of Federation Space: Investigate malfunction of subspace radio telescope.

name: Restore Errant Moon
lore: Bre'el IV: Restore moon knocked off orbit by passage of nearby black hole.

name: Sarthong Plunder
lore: Sarthong V: Plunder rich ruins at this famous archaeological site.

name: Secret Salvage
lore: Wolf 359: Attempt retrieval of floating Federation wreckage at Borg massacre site.

name: Seek Life-Form
lore: Alpha Omicron: Study new spaceborne life-form reported in this system.

name: Study "Hole in Space"
lore: Morgana Quadrant: Investigate mysterious void.

name: Study Lonka Pulsar
lore: Lonka Cluster: Research vibrating neutron star

name: Study Nebula
lore: Gamma Erandi: Study and chart nebula.

name: Study Plasma Streamer
lore: Igo System: Study stream of plasma flowing between binary stars.

name: Study Stellar Collision
lore: Detrian System: Study rare collision between two gas giants.

name: Survey Mission
lore: Mar Oscura: Study and chart dark matter nebula.

name: Test Mission
lore: Praxillus System: Provide aid for a helium ignition project attempting to revitalize dying sun.

name: Albert Einstein
lore: Re-creation of the famed 20th century human. Author of the theory of relativity.

name: Alexander Rozhenko
lore: ¾ Klingon, ¼ Human male. Born on the 43rd day of Maktog. Son of Lieutenant Worf and K'Ehleyr.

name: Alynna Nechayev
lore: Vice-admiral Alynna Nechayev is an antagonistic superior of Captain Jean-Luc Picard. Responsible for liaison with the Cardassians and the Maquis.

name: Alyssa Ogawa
lore: Nurse Alyssa Ogawa is a medical assistant and friend to Dr. Beverly Crusher.

name: Benjamin Maxwell
lore: Captain Benjamin Maxwell of the U.S.S. Phoenix is a bitter enemy of the Cardassians.

name: Beverly Crusher
lore: Dr. Beverly Crusher is the chief medical officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Dancer and thespian. Widow of Jack Crusher. Mother of Ensign Wesley Crusher.

name: Calloway
lore: Ensign Calloway is representative of Starfleet medical technicians. Served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2370.

name: Christopher Hobson
lore: Lt. Commander Christopher Hobson is representative of staff officers in Starfleet. Served aboard the U.S.S. Sutherland in 2368.

name: Darian Wallace
lore: Ensign Darian Wallace is representative of Starfleet security officers. Held numerous positions aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Data
lore: Lt. Commander Data is a sentient android created by Dr. Noonien Soong. Has positronic brain. Desires to be human. Once left his head in San Francisco.

name: Deanna Troi
lore: Lt. Commander Deanna Troi is a ½ Betazoid, ½ Human empath. Counselor for U.S.S. Enterprise. Imzadi to William T. Riker. Loves chocolate.

name: Dr. La Forge
lore: Dr. La Forge is a Starfleet specialist in xenology and exobiology. Father of Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge. Husband of Captain Silva La Forge.

name: Dr. Leah Brahms
lore: Re-creation who said, "I'm with you every day, Geordi. Every time you look at this engine, you're looking at me. Every time you touch it, it's me."

name: Dr. Selar
lore: Dr. Selar is a female Vulcan medical doctor. Served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise for many years.

name: Eric Pressman
lore: Captain Eric Pressman commanded the U.S.S. Pegasus before it was lost in space following a failed experiment.

name: Exocomp
lore: Sentient artificial life-form incorporating an advanced microreplication system. Specializes in repair tasks. Servomechanism designed by Dr. Farallon.

name: Fleet Admiral Shanthi
lore: Fleet Admiral Shanthi authorized the blockade of Romulan forces covertly supporting the Klingon Civil War in 2368.

name: Geordi La Forge
lore: Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge is chief engineer aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Great sense of humor. Fortuitous holodeck programmer.

name: Hannah Bates
lore: Genetically engineered scientist from Moab IV. Granted asylum aboard U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
lore: Captain Jean-Luc Picard of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Born in LaBarre, France. Has an artificial heart. Reads Shakespeare. Something of a Renaissance man.

name: Jenna D'Sora
lore: Lieutenant Jenna D'Sora had a brief, unsuccessful romantic relationship with Lt. Commander Data. Wooed by crystillia flowers from Telemarius III.

name: K'Ehleyr
lore: ½ Klingon, ½ Human female. Federation Ambassador to the K'mpec government. Mate of Lieutenant Worf. Mother of Alexander.

name: Kareel Odan
lore: Famous Trill Ambassador Kareel Odan. Romantically involved with Dr. Beverly Crusher. Symbiont transplant from male to female host in 2367.

name: Leah Brahms
lore: Dr. Leah Brahms was responsible for much of the warp engine design for Galaxy-class starships.

name: Linda Larson
lore: Lieutenant Linda Larson is representative of staff engineers serving in Starfleet.

name: Lwaxanna Troi
lore: Betazoid mother of Deanna Troi. Daughter of the Fifth House, Holder of the Sacred Chalice of Rixx, Heir to the Holy Rings of Betazed.

name: McKnight
lore: Ensign McKnight is one of many helm officers serving aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Distant relative of a famous 20th century game designer.

name: Morgan Bateson
lore: Captain Morgan Bateson was in command of the U.S.S. Bozeman when it was caught in a temporal causality loop from 2278 to 2368.

name: Mot the Barber
lore: Bolian male. Convivial barber aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Snappy conversationalist.

name: Neela Daren
lore: Lt. Commander Neela Daren (sic) is a specialist in stellar cartography. Accomplished pianist. Romantically involved with Captain Jean-Luc Picard.

name: Nikolai Rozhenko
lore: Lieutenant Worf's human foster brother. Son of Sergey and Helena Rozhenko.

name: Norah Satie
lore: Admiral Norah Satie assigned Captain Jean-Luc Picard to the U.S.S. Enterprise. Zealous investigator who exposed the alien conspiracy in 2364.

name: Reginald Barclay
lore: Lieutenant Reginald Barclay is a talented but socially shy systems diagnostic engineer. Former victim of holodiction. Has phobia of travelling by transporter.

name: Richard Galen
lore: Professor Richard Galen was a mentor to Captain Jean-Luc Picard. Greatest archaeologist of the 24th century. Discoverer of the DNA program.

name: Riva
lore: Famed deaf mute mediator from Ramatis III. Spoke with a chorus of three telepaths.

name: Ro Laren
lore: Ensign Ro Laren is a Bajoran female. Protege (sic) of Captain Jean-Luc Picard. Sympathetic to the Maquis. A bit of a renegade.

name: Sarek
lore: Illustrous Vulcan Federation ambassador. Over 200 years old. Married at least three times: to a Vulcan princess, to Amanda and to Perrin. Father of Spock.

name: Satelk
lore: Captain Satelk is the Vulcan Starfleet officer who presided over the inquiry into Cadet Joshua Albert's death at the Academy Flight Range in 2368.

name: Shelby
lore: Lt. Commander Shelby is an ambitious Starfleet officer. Assigned to the U.S.S. Enterprise as a specialist on the Borg.

name: Simon Tarses
lore: Crewman First Class Simon Tarses is representative of Starfleet medical technicians. He is ¼ Romulan, ¾ Human.

name: Sir Isaac Newton
lore: Re-creation of the famous 18th century (sic) human. Originator of calculus and the classic laws of physics.

name: Sirna Kolrami
lore: Famed Federation strategist. Grandmaster of the game Stratagema.

name: Sito Jaxa
lore: Ensign Sito Jaxa, a Bajoran, is one of a number of navigation officers aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Soren
lore: Androgynous J'Naii. Illegally had female feelings. Once romantically involved with Commander William T. Riker. Underwent therapy for this perversity.

name: T'Pan
lore: Vulcan female. Dr. T'Pan served as director of the prestigious Vulcan Science Academy. Preeminent expert in subspace morphology.

name: Taitt
lore: Ensign Taitt is representative of science specialists from Starfleet Academy. Helped the U.S.S. Enterprise destroy a Borg ship in 2370.

name: Tam Elbrun
lore: Betazoid male with exceptional empathic abilities. Participated in the notorious Gharusda disaster. Specialist in first contact with new life-forms.

name: Tasha Yar
lore: Lieutenant Natasha Yar served as chief of security on the U.S.S. Enterprise. Courageous orphan of Turkana IV. Proved Lt. Commander Data fully functional.

name: Taurik
lore: Lieutenant Taurik is a Vulcan male representative of engineering junior officers serving in Starfleet.

name: Thomas Riker
lore: Lt. Commander Thomas Riker is William Riker's double. Created during a transporter accident in 2361.

name: Toby Russell
lore: Dr. Toby Russell is a controversial neurogeneticist. Creator of the genetronic replicator therapy for spinal injury that saved Lieutenant Worf.

name: Vash
lore: Extraordinary archaeology treasure hunter. Traveled with Q. Romantically involved with Captain Jean-Luc Picard. Lovable character, not to be trusted.

name: William T. Riker
lore: Commander William T. Riker is the executive officer of U.S.S. Enterprise. Imzadi to Deanna Troi. Gourmet cook. Jazz musician.

name: Worf
lore: Lieutenant Worf is chief of security on the U.S.S. Enterprise. Klingon warrior and Starfleet officer. Son of Mogh. Raised on Earth by foster parents.

name: B'Etor
lore: Plotted with Lursa to seize power from Gowron with the support of the Romulans. Younger of the two Duras sisters. The pretty one.

name: B'iJik
lore: Klingon male trained as an officer for the Klingon Defense Force. Served as junior adjutant to the diplomatic delegation for Gowron.

name: Ba'el
lore: ½ Klingon, ½ Romulan. Romantically involved with Lieutenant Worf. Born in Romulan prison camp in Carraya system.

name: Batrell
lore: Klingon trained as an officer for the Klingon Defense Force. Formerly in command of Narendra III outpost.

name: Divok
lore: Male trained in Klingon anatomy and medicine. Studied the effects of Tribbles on the Klingon nervous system.

name: Dukath
lore: Klingon trained in the field of science. Studied the effects of Berthold rays on plant life. Served aboard the I.K.C. Pagh.

name: Duras
lore: Son of Ja'rod. Contender for leadership of the Klingon High Council. Member of a powerful political family.

name: Fek'Ihr
lore: Re-creation of mythical Klingon beast. Guardian of Gre'thor, where the dishonored go to die.

name: Gorath
lore: Klingon trained in the field of security. Guarded the Klingon High Council chamber in the year of Maktag. Served as a security chief for the Hegh'bat division.

name: Gowron
lore: Son of M'Rel. Leader of the Klingon High Council after defeating the Duras forces in the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: J'Ddan
lore: Klingon trained in the field of science. Smuggled Federation secrets to the Romulans in the form of amino acid codes.

name: K'mpec
lore: Klingon High Council Leader prior to Gowron. Appointed Captain Jean-Luc Picard as Arbiter of Succession in 2367.

name: K'Tal
lore: Senior member of the Klingon High Council. Presided over the installation of Gowron as head of the council in 2367.

name: K'Tesh
lore: Re-creation who assisted in the Age of Ascension ritual. Perfected current pain-stick design for ritual use.

name: K'Vada
lore: Captain K'Vada transported Captain Jean-Luc Picard and Lt. Commander Data on an undercover mission to Romulus.

name: Kahless
lore: Cloned reincarnation of Klingon spiritual leader Kahless the Unforgettable. Installed as ceremonial Emperor in 2369.

name: Kargan
lore: Captain of the I.K.C. Pagh when Commander William T. Riker served as an exchange officer.

name: Kell
lore: Male High Council emissary. Covert Romulan agent. Attempted to use Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge to assassinate Klingon Governor Vagh.

name: Klag
lore: Second Officer Klag, of the I.K.C. Pagh, is representative of Klingon warriors throughout the Klingon Empire.

name: Kle'eg
lore: Klingon trained in the specific field of security. Guarded the House of K'mpec when K'mpec was poisoned in 2367.

name: Konmel
lore: Klingon warrior who destroyed the cruiser T'Acog and hijacked the Talarian ship, Batris, with Korris.

name: Koral
lore: Tall Klingon male. Captain of a shuttle who traded with mercenaries in 2370.

name: Koroth
lore: Klingon high cleric at Boreth Monastery. Responsible for cloning Kahless the Unforgettable in 2369.

name: Korris
lore: Klingon warrior who destroyed the cruiser T'Acog and hijacked the Tolarian ship, Batris, with Konmel.

name: Kromm
lore: Klingon trained in the field of engineering. Reputed to have consumed fifteen rokeg blood pies at one sitting.

name: Kurak
lore: Famed female Klingon scientist and warp-field specialist who evaluated the metaphasic shield.

name: Kurn
lore: Son of Mogh. Brother of Lieutenant Worf. Member of the Klingon High Council.

name: L'Kor
lore: Klingon warrior. Believed killed at Khitomer massacre. Actually held prisoner in Carraya system.

name: Lursa
lore: Elder of the two Duras sisters. Plotted with Romulan Sela to start the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: Morag
lore: Klingon officer who stole Federation data from Relay Station 47.

name: Nu'Daq
lore: Captain of the I.K.C. Maht-H'a. Pursued DNA program in 2369.

name: Toq
lore: Klingon male, born in Romulan prison camp in Carraya system. Protege (sic) of Lieutenant Worf.

name: Torak
lore: Governor Torak served near the Federation border commanding sector 2520 in 2369.

name: Torin
lore: Klingon trained in the field of science. Studied the effects of warp propulsion on subspace.

name: Vagh
lore: Klingon Governor of the Kriosian system. Target of an assassination attempt by Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge, acting under Romulan mind control.

name: Vekma
lore: Klingon female trained in Klingon anatomy and medicine. Propositioned Commander William T. Riker on the I.K.C. Pagh in 2365.

name: Amarie
lore: Four-armed pianist. Information broker. Ex-wife of arms smuggler. Four times widowed. Qualor II lounge performer. Knows Aktuh and Melota. Salt sucker.

name: Baran
lore: Male captain of a mercenary ship raiding archaeological sites to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Bok
lore: Former Ferengi DaiMon. Son killed by Captain Jean-Luc Picard in battle. Seeks revenge at all costs.

name: Devinoni Ral
lore: ¼ Betazoid, ¾ Human. Skilled negotiator. Abused his empathic powers to gain advantage. Had a dangerous liaison with Counselor Deanna Troi.

name: Dr. Farek
lore: Dr. Farek is representative of a male Ferengi trained in medicine. Seized control of the D'Kora class Ferengi Marauder, Krayton, in 2366.

name: Dr. Reyga
lore: Ferengi male scientist. Inventor of the revolutionary, but controversial, metaphasic shield technology. Endured skepticism from the scientific community.

name: Etana Jol
lore: Ktarian female. Attempted to use a psychotropically addictive game to gain control of the Federation in 2368.

name: Evek
lore: Gul Evek, Cardassian male officer. Administers area ceded to Cardassians in a treaty with the Federation.

name: Gorta
lore: Male of Dopterian race. Representative of non-aligned agents. An opportunist. Had an encounter with the sisters of Duras in 2370.

name: Ishara Yar
lore: Sister of Lieutenant Natasha Yar. Once betrayed the U.S.S. Enterprise crew in an attempt to aid the rebels on Turkana IV.

name: Jo'Bril
lore: Takaran male. Attempted to steal Dr. Reyga's metaphasic shield technology to claim as his own.

name: Narik
lore: Representative of male mercenaries operating throughout the galaxy. Worked with Baran to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Ocett
lore: Gul Ocett, Cardassian female officer. Commander of a Galor-class warship. Pursuer of DNA program.

name: Roga Danar
lore: Angosian male. Biochemically altered into a formidable perfect warrior ranked Subhadar.

name: Vekor
lore: Representative of female mercenaries operating throughout the galaxy. Worked with Baran to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Alidar Jarok
lore: Conscientious admiral who questioned Romulan policy. Eventually stole a scout ship and defected to the Federation in 2366.

name: Bochra
lore: Centurion serving the Romulan Star Empire. Once marooned on Galorndon Core with Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge.

name: Galathon
lore: Romulan officer representative of those serving the Romulan Star Empire. Pursuer of DNA program in 2369.

name: Jaron
lore: Romulan trained in the field of security. A former member of the Tal Shiar intelligence service.

name: Jera
lore: Re-creation of a female Romulan. Alien entity assumed this body in 2369.

name: Mendak
lore: Commander of the warbird Devoras. Aided the escape of Romulan operative Selok from the Federation.

name: Mirok
lore: Scientist in charge of developing and testing the interphase generator in 2368.

name: Movar
lore: Romulan general who secretly provided military supplies to Duras family forces during the Klingon Civil War in 2368.

name: N'Vek
lore: Member of the Romulan underground. Spearheaded defection of Vice-Proconsul M'ret to the Federation.

name: Neral
lore: Proconsul Neral of the Romulan Senate plotted with Sela and Pardek to invade Vulcan.

name: Palteth
lore: Romulan trained in the field of engineering. A specialist in artificial quantum singularity. Served aboard the Khazara in 2369.

name: Pardek
lore: Male senator from the Krocton Segment of Romulus. Delegate at the 2293 Khitomer conference. Betrayer of Spock.

name: Parem
lore: Romulan officer accidently phased by interphase generator equipment.

name: Sela
lore: ½ Romulan, ½ Human female. Daughter of alternate timeline Lieutenant Natasha Yar. Powerful operative and key figure in the Romulan hegemony.

name: Selok
lore: Subcommander Selok is a female Romulan agent. Successfully posed as Vulcan Ambassador T'Pel.

name: Taibak
lore: Scientist who developed a mind control device using E-band emissions. Controlled Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge through his VISOR.

name: Takket
lore: Romulan male trained in Romulan anatomy and medicine. Extensively trained in exobiology.

name: Tallus
lore: Romulan officer representative of those serving the Romulan Star Empire. Former commander of private forces under Commander Sela.

name: Tarus
lore: Representative of male Romulans trained in the field of science. Specialist in the study of extra-dimensional life-forms.

name: Taul
lore: Romulan male trained in the field of security. Assistant to Commander Konsab of the Romulan Intelligence Academy.

name: Tebok
lore: Commanding officer of the Romulan warbird that crossed the Romulan Neutral Zone in 2364.

name: Thei
lore: Subcommander Thei is representative of officers serving in the Romulan Star Empire. Ally of the sisters of Duras, during the Klingon Civil War.

name: Tokath
lore: Established a secret prison camp in the Carraya system for dishonored Klingon survivors of the Khitomer massacre.

name: Tomalak
lore: Commander of a D'deridex-class warbird. Frequent nemesis of the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Tomek
lore: Re-creation of a male Romulan. Alien entity assumed this body in 2369.

name: Toreth
lore: Female captain of Imperial Romulan warbird, Khazara. Father killed by Tal Shiar. Uncovered M'ret defection plot.

name: Varel
lore: Representation of female Romulans trained in the field of science. Assigned to assist with interphase generator project.

name: Runabout
lore: Resembles a large shuttle. Contains living accommodations. Modular design can be re‑configured for different mission profiles.

name: Type VI Shuttlecraft
lore: Modern Federation shuttle with warp capability. May be armed for special missions.

name: U.S.S. Brittain
lore: Starship found trapped in a Tyken's Rift in 2367. All but one of crew killed by REM sleep deprivation.

name: U.S.S. Enterprise
lore: The fifth Starfleet ship named Enterprise, launched in 2363. Built at the Utopia Planetia shipyards orbiting Mars.

name: U.S.S. Excelsior
lore: First launched in 2284 as a test for what proved to be the unsuccessful transwarp drive project. Now uses standard warp drive.

name: U.S.S. Galaxy
lore: Prototype in this elite class of ships was the U.S.S. Galaxy, after which the class was named.

name: U.S.S. Hood
lore: Registry number NCC-42296. Named for the 20th century admiral, Sir Horace Hood. Commanded by Captain Robert DeSoto.

name: U.S.S. Miranda
lore: Small ship class from the late 23rd century. Named for a character in Shakespeare's play, The Tempest.

name: U.S.S. Nebula
lore: Modern class of ship featuring large upper equipment modules customizable for specific mission uses.

name: U.S.S. Oberth
lore: Class of small ships often used for scientific missions. Named for the 20th century rocket scientist Hermann Oberth.

name: U.S.S. Phoenix
lore: Commanded by Captain Benjamin Maxwell. Last assigned to the Cardassian/Federation border.

name: U.S.S. Sutherland
lore: Named for Horatio Hornblower's fictional flagship. Briefly commanded by Lt. Commander Data during the Klingon Civil War blockade.

name: U.S.S. Yamato
lore: Named for a Japanese WWII battleship. Sister ship of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Commanded by Captain Donald Varley.

name: I.K.C. Buruk
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey used to transport Gowron to rendezvous with the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2367.

name: I.K.C. Hegh'ta
lore: Bird-of-Prey commanded by Kurn in support of Gowron during the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: I.K.C. K'Vort
lore: Class of ships identical in configuration to the classic B'rel class Klingon Bird-of-Prey, although much larger.

name: I.K.C. Pagh
lore: Battle cruiser under the command of Captain Kargan. Commander William T. Riker served aboard as an exchange officer in 2365.

name: I.K.C. Qu'Vat
lore: Attack cruiser that carried Governor Torak on an investigation into the death of a Stafleet officer at Relay Station 47.

name: I.K.C. Vorn
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey used to transport Duras to meet with the Klingon Arbiter of Succession in 2367.

name: Combat Vessel
lore: A little-known class of attack craft. One such vessel attacked the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368 at Surplus Depot Zed-15.

name: Husnock Ship
lore: With a single thought, Kevin Uxbridge killed the entire Husnock race (50 billion lives) everywhere in the universe. Their powerful ships remain.

name: Mercenary Ship
lore: Little-known ship. Difficult to track due to a unique hull design that renders it invisible to long-range scans. Baran captained one in 2370.

name: Yridian Shuttle
lore: Common shuttlecraft used by Yridian agents and others for covert activities.

name: Zibalian Transport
lore: Common class of merchant vessel used by traders such as Kivas Fajo.

name: D'deridex
lore: Imperial Romulan Warbird. A massive ship significantly larger than a Galaxy class starship.

name: Devoras
lore: Warbird used to accomplice the escape of Romulan spy Selak from the Federation in 2367. Commanded by Admiral Mendak.

name: Haakona
lore: Subcommander Taris' warbird. Responded to the Federation incursion of the Neutral Zone, near Iconia.

name: Khazara
lore: Commander Toreth's Warbird. Covertly used by N'Vek and Counselor Deanna Troi to accomplish the defection of Vice-Proconsul M'ret in 2369.

name: Pi
lore: Ship suspected of attempting a covert mission to Galorndon Core in Federation territory.

name: Science Vessel
lore: Specialized science ship used for an Interphase Generator in 2368.

name: Scout Vessel
lore: Class of small, versatile ships used by the Romulan Star Empire for reconnaissance and science missions.

name: Cryosatellite
lore: An ancient sublight vessel. Designed to carry and store cryogenically frozen humanoids until a cure for their death could be found and used to regenerate them.

name: Data's Head
lore: An excavation under the Earth city of San Francisco in 2369 discovered that the head of Lt. Commander Data had been lying there undisturbed for centuries.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. Head has CUNNING=10 and Computer Skill. While on a ship, RANGE, WEAPONS and SHIELDS are +2. (Not cumulative.)

name: Iconian Gateway
lore: The now-extinct Iconians were "Demons of Air and Darkness" due to their advanced technology such as this instant transport portal to farflung planets.

name: Ophidian Cane
lore: Disguised serpentine alien device used by the Devidians. When irrdiated with the correct energy, the head comes alive and allows Devidians to control their time travel.
game_text: Place in hand until played as an Interrupt card to allow 3 through Devidian Door OR double Devidian Foragers (to four personnel) OR double Empathic Touch.

name: Receptacle Stones
lore: Ves Alkar, a Lumerian, used these mysterious objects in a ritual that would turn another person into a "receptacle" for all negative thoughts, causing rapid aging and death.
game_text: Place in hand until played as an Event card on the crew of an opponent's ship. Any space dilemmas you encounter this turn also apply to that ship and crew. Discard event.

name: Ressikan Flute
lore: Artifact from Kataan, a now-dead planet. 1,000 years after Kataan's demise, a space probe gave Jean-Luc Picard this flute and a lifetime of memories in less than an hour.

name: Samuel Clemens' Pocketwatch
lore: This 19th century watch was discovered in a cave along with Data's head in 2369. After returning to the past, Clemens left the watch again to maintain the timeline.
game_text: Place in hand until played as an Interrupt card. Once action that must happen on your next turn (such as your card draw), happens now instead.

name: Alien Labyrinth
lore: Many planets, such as Mordan IV, have convoluted underground installations which require Away Teams to have specific technology or skills.
game_text: To get through this maze-like structure and continue, Away Team must have a Tricorder OR 2 ENGINEER.

name: Cardassian Trap
lore: With rumors of a metagenic weapon on Celtris III, the Cardassians lured Jean‑Luc Picard into a trap in Cardassian space. He was captured in 2369.
game_text: Unless Empathy present, opponent captures one unique, non-Cardassian personnel from you (random selection) and places it on their side as a captive, along with trap.

name: Coalescent Organism
lore: Rare colony of microscopic lifeforms which kill, absorb and then take the shape of other organisms. Must change form every few days.
game_text: Unless Exobiology present, one personnel (random selection) dies at end of your next turn. If others present at the death, organism is passed on to one of them (random selection), etc.

name: Conundrum
lore: In 2368, U.S.S. Enterprise personnel were given amnesia by Satarrans, who then attempted to trick the crew into attacking Lysian ships and a Lysian command station.
game_text: Unless INTEGRITY>40, this ship must do nothing but chase (at normal speed) and attack one of your opponent's ships (your choice). Discard dilemma.

name: Edo Probe
lore: When the Federation tried to contact the pre-industrial society on Rubicun III, the Edo Probe demanded in ship-shuddering tones that Jean-Luc Picard "State the purpose!"

name: Empathic Echo
lore: In 2370, following the suicide of partially empathic Lt. Daniel Kwan, Deanna Troi experienced visions of a past murder, reliving it through the participants' eyes.
game_text: One personnel present with Empathy (random selection) is killed unless SECURITY and MEDICAL present.

name: Ferengi Attack
lore: Ferengi attacked a Federation Away Team on a planet in the Delphi Ardu system using "whips" which fire discharges of high-energy plasma.
game_text: Kills on Away Team member (opponent's choice) unless total CUNNING+STRENGTH>68 OR Greed present. Discard dilemma.

name: Frame of Mind
lore: William Riker was captured in 2369 on Tilonus IV, tortured with neurosomatic techniques and made to believe he was someone else - until his illusions were shattered.
game_text: One Away Team member (random selection) now becomes non-aligned with attributes of 3-3-3 and only two skills (opponent's choice). Cure with 3 Empathy present.

name: Hidden Entrance
lore: Using his visor, Geordi La Forge discovered a doorway to an underground android laboratory hidden in a rock wall on Omicron Theta in 2364.
game_text: To locate the concealed entrance and continue, Away Team must have Geordi La Forge OR ENGINEER + CUNNING>32.

name: Hunter Gangs
lore: On some planets, civilization has devolved into a bitter struggle for survival. Violent gangs search for prey, such as those which chased Natasha Yar on Turkana IV.
game_text: Two Away Team members (random selection) are chased. Examine cards separately. Personnel escapes if CUNNING is even, killed if odd. Discard dilemma.

name: Interphasic Plasma Creatures
lore: Organisms from just beyond the range of visual acuity sucked cellular peptides from the U.S.S. Enterprise crew, similar to the way Terran leeches consume hemoglobin.
game_text: Unless 2 SCIENCE or Mindmeld present, play on table as an Event card. While in play, lowers STRENGTH of each of your personnel by 2. (Not cumulative.)

name: Maman Picard
lore: At the place where ideas and reality intermix, Jean-Luc Picard saw his mother Yvette Gessard Picard, who asked, "(Is this) the end of the universe, or... the beginning?"
game_text: If this is a Federation ship, immediately transport it to any end of the spaceline (opponent's choice)

name: Outpost Raid
lore: Rogue Borg conducted a brief but deadly raid on the remote Federation outpost Ohniaka III in 2369. 274 personnel were lost.
game_text: If at your outpost: two personnel are killed (opponent's choice) unless STRENGTH>81. Discard dilemma. OR Elsewhere: requires STRENGTH>18 to pass.

name: Parallel Romance
lore: Relationships in parallel universes take different courses. In one, Worf and Deanna Troi were married and had two children: Shanara, 2 and Eric Christopher, 3.

name: Punishment Zone
lore: On Rubicun III, mediators arrested Wesley Crusher when he fell into a garden. He was designated for death, which created a Prime Directive dilemma for Jean-Luc Picard.
game_text: One Away Team member (random selection) is killed OR beam up that personnel at a penalty. Double penalty if Federation.

name: Quantum Singularity Lifeforms
lore: Sentient dimensional beings whose young incubate in black holes. When nesting in a Romulan ship's artificial singularity engine, a frozen-time effect occurs.
game_text: If a Romulan ship present, all ships and personnel here are placed in stasis. Cure with Emergency Transporter Armbands, Timepod Ring or new ENGINEER arriving.

name: Rascals
lore: Passing through a molecular reversion field in a shuttle, Guinan, Ro Laren, Keiko O'Brien and Jean-Luc Picard reverted to children's bodies but retained adult knowledge.
game_text: All unique crew members (maximum of 4, random selection) are kids. STRENGTH=2 and Youth replaces first-listed skill. Cure with 2 MEDICAL and Biology.

name: Royale Casino: Blackjack
lore: Lt. Commander Data played blackjack while trapped in the surreal casino of the Hotel Royale. Tex said, "Boy, you have got the brass..." Data said, "Hit me."
game_text: Play one game of blackjack, using CUNNING numbers. Players must show entire hand. Closest to 21 without going over wins points. Others lose points. Ties=0.

name: The Gatherers
lore: Nomadic marauders and thieves from Acamar III. "We Gatherers value our freedom. We do what we want and we answer to no creature."
game_text: Unless Marouk OR INTEGRITY>36 present, discard all Equipment and Artifacts in Away Team, plus one card (random selection) from your hand. Discard dilemma.

name: The Higher... The Fewer
lore: The Parallax Poet's cosmic lesson for Alexander was, "Every moment requires a purpose. Every purpose requires a plan. The Higher... The Fewer."
game_text: Subtract X from your total score, where X=the number of personnel in this crew or Away Team.

name: Thought Fire
lore: In 2364, The Traveler took the U.S.S. Enterprise to a place where ideas and reality intermix. In such a place, one's own thoughts can be deadly.

name: Worshiper
lore: Advanced technology often causes natives to believe personnel are divine, as occurred for the U.S.S. Enterprise crew on Mintaka III and other worlds.
game_text: If Away Team's Greed>Honor, score bonus points. Otherwise, Away Team is stopped unless Edo Vessel or Anthropology present. Discard dilemma

name: Zaldan
lore: Zaldans, who look human except for their webbed fingers, are infuriated by courtesy. They view it as insulting dishonesty.

name: Alternate Universe Door
game_text: Place one on table during the seed phase. Door is now open, allowing your Alternate icon cards to enter play. OR Stock in deck and use as follows:Plays to nullify one Revolving Door or Subspace Schism. (Discard doorway.) OR Allows one ship to pass through Q-Net. (Discard doorway.) OR Nullify one Temporal Rift, and return doorway to your hand.

name: Echo Papa 607 Killer Drone
lore: A deadly hovering anti-personnel device with the ability to fire phasers and to anticipate and adapt to its target's defenses. Created by the Arsenal of Freedom on Minos.
game_text: Use during Away Team or Rogue Borg battles. First time used in battle, STRENGTH=10. Next time used in a separate battle, STRENGTH=20 etc.

name: I.P. Scanner
lore: The Interphasic Scanner has been used to detect signatures of phased matter, invisible interphasic creatures and beings from other subspace domains.
game_text: Where present, nullifies Interphasic Plasma Creatures, Brain Drain and Phased Matter.

name: Baryon Buildup
lore: Baryon particles build up on a ship's hull after prolonged warp travel. Particles must be periodically removed with a baryon sweep, which requires evacuation of the ship.

name: Captain's Log
lore: A commanding officer's journal of events. While on the surface of El-Adrel IV, Tamarian Captain Dathon made entries into his log by hand.

name: Engage Shuttle Operations
lore: Most major starships are outfitted with shuttle hangars and equipment necessary to launch and recover shuttlecraft.

name: Interrogation
lore: In violation of the Seldonis IV convention, Gul Madred interrogated Jean-Luc Picard, seeking Starfleet strategic secrets. He kept asking, "How many lights do you see?"
game_text: Plays on one personnel you've captured. Each turn, ask opponent, "How many lights do you see?" If reply is "Five", return captive to outpost, score 10 points. Otherwise, score 1 point, retain captive.

name: Intruder Force Field
lore: With one look from Jean-Luc Picard, the U.S.S. Enterprise crew captured two alien intruders in a force field on the bridge — turnabout for their own kidnapping activities.
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, reverses Telepathic Alien Kidnappers affecting you AND Rogue Borg invading your ships must be 3 or more to be effective.

name: Klim Dokachin
lore: Zakdorn quartermaster controlling the Starfleet surplus depot on Qualor II. A typical bureaucrat of the type that delights in delays that make life difficult for officers.

name: Lower Decks
lore: Junior officers aboard all starships cooperate in their duties while competing for promotion and advancement, such as Ensigns Taurik, Sito, Lavelle and Ogawa.

name: Mot's Advice
lore: Mr. Mot offered sage advice to his customers on a variety of subjects, but there was only one thing you could really learn from him.
game_text: Plays on any one personnel. While in play, that personnel gains the skill of Barbering.

name: Particle Scattering Field
lore: A Tamarian Ship used a particle scattering field to charge the atmosphere of El-Adrel IV, stranding Jean-Luc Picard and Dathon on the planet in 2368.
game_text: Plays on one of your ships with a Particle Scattering Device. No beaming to or from a planet is allowed where ship present. You may discard Field at any time.

name: Rishon Uxbridge
lore: In his grief, the Douwd Kevin Uxbridge re-created his dead wife, Rishon. As if she were real, he responded to her stubborn tendency to keep him calm at tense moments.

name: The Charybdis
lore: This wreckage was quickly dated to 2033-2079 due to its 52-star American flag, an example of the importance of such knowledge when dealing with ancient artifacts.
game_text: Plays on table. Artifacts at completed missions cannot be acquired until Archaeology present. (If Charybdis destroyed, anyone present may acquire artifact.)

name: The Mask of Korgano
lore: In legend, Masaka was chased by Korgano across the sky like the Terran moon chases the sun. Jean-Luc Picard masked himself as Korgano to fool Masaka.
game_text: Plays on one of your personnel. While in play, changes it from normal to Alternate icon personnel, or vice versa.

name: Thermal Deflectors
lore: Away Teams from the U.S.S. Enterprise used an array of Thermal Deflectors to delay Bersallis III firestorms long enough to allow evacuation of the population.
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, nullifies Firestorm, Thought Fire, Plasma Fire, Fire Sculptor and Phaser Burns.

name: Wartime Conditions
lore: In an alternate timeline caused by the events of Narendra III, the Federation entered into war against the Klingon Empire. 40 billion lives were lost.
game_text: Plays on table only if a Federation ship is attacked by another ship. While in play, the Federation may battle the attacking ship's affiliation at will.

name: Yellow Alert
lore: State of increased readiness and watchfulness. Declared by a captain in anticipation of danger or when a crisis situation has lessened.

name: Neutral Outpost
lore: A common space station design used by many races for research or trade. Personnel and ships from all affiliations are frequent visitors at such facilities.

name: Anti-Matter Spread
lore: Using harmless anti-matter explosions in a pyrotechnic display, acting-captain William Riker implemented a "brilliantly unorthodox" plan to confuse the Borg in battle.
game_text: Plays at start of ship battle. For this battle, opposing ships' WEAPONS -1 for each personnel aboard with CUNNING<8 OR Borg Ship WEAPONS=16 this turn.

name: Barclay Transporter Phobia
lore: Lt. Reginald Barclay refused to transport out of fear. When forced to transport in 2369, he saw creatures in the beam and believed he had transporter psychosis.
game_text: Plays during transport by beaming, Dimensional Shifting or Iconian Gateway. One personnel (random selection) refuses all transport until cured with Plexing.

name: Brain Drain
lore: In Lt. commander Data's dream, his perception of the leach-like interphasic creatures aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise was symbolized by the surreal actions of his friends.

name: Countermanda
lore: A Federation student intern when she discovered her true identity as a Q, Amanda took a dim view of the over-manipulative use of power upon other species.
game_text: '''Nullifies Telepathic Alien Kidnappers OR if opponent just played Res-Q or Palor Toff, suspend that action, look through opponent's discard pile and put any three cards out-of-play.

name: Dead In Bed
lore: Astronaut Colonel Stephen Richey was found 283 years after his death on Theta 116 VIII. He was caught in an unchanging eternal trap created by well-meaning aliens.
game_text: Kills any one personnel currently in stasis.

name: Destroy Radioactive Garbage Scow
lore: The U.S.S. Enterprise destroyed a radioactive garbage scow by towing it into a sun. It could have been destroyed in place, but the act would have contaminated Gamelan V.
game_text: Plays to discard Scow. Kills all personnel at that location unless aboard ship or Thermal Deflectors present. If mission not done yet, reduce its points.

name: Devidian Foragers
lore: Disguised beings from Devidia II traveled to troubled times and squalid places to steal and consume neural energy from souls who would not be missed.
game_text: Look through any one discard pile and place two personnel out-of-play. Add their attribute numbers to one of your Alternate icon personnel for this turn.

name: Eyes in the Dark
lore: Deanna Troi saved the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2367 by communicating through nightmarish visions with a telepathic species on the other side of a Tyken's Rift.
game_text: Plays when facing a dilemma. If Empathy present, add the skills and attribute numbers of one personnel (random selection) from any opponent's ship (your choice).

name: Fire Sculptor
lore: Native of the Parallax Colony who created intricate and artistic designs in the air with fire.
game_text: Plays on Plasma Fire or Warp Core Breach to move onto nearest opponent's ship OR "Melt" (place out-of-play) one card in any one discard pile.

name: Hail
lore: Using a universal translator and other communication technology, such as at Worf's station aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise, starships can greet any ships they encounter.
game_text: Plays on any ship "flying by" one of your ships; it must stop at your location. OR Select two ships; they cannot battle each other this turn.

name: Howard Heirloom Candle
lore: The anaphasic organism appearing as Ronin lived in and drew power from this special candle.
game_text: Plays to double effects of Anaphasic Organism or Empathic Echo OR nullifies Coalescent Organism OR prevents Anya or Salia from morphing this turn.

name: Humuhumunukunukuapua'a
lore: A reef triggerfish, Rhinecamthus aculeatus, found near Earth's tropical islands. An animated versions is a symbolic "guide" on the U.S.S. Enterprise schoolroom computers.

name: Incoming Message: Attack Authorization
lore: On several occasions, for purposes of Federation security, Starfleet Command has reluctantly or mistakenly ordered captains to attack certain enemy or rogue ships.
game_text: Plays on any Federation ship. If Treachery aboard, "This ship must immediately attack one ship (your choice) at this location." May ignore if V.I.P. aboard.

name: Isabella
lore: At the FGC-47 nebula, the U.S.S. Enterprise encountered an energy being who took the form a child's imaginary friend. It judged the crew from that perspective.
game_text: Plays on any non-Borg ship at a nebula; it is destroyed unless Youth aboard by end of your next turn. OR Kill any one Greed personnel who just exploited a Worshiper.

name: Jamaharon
lore: A mysterious sexual ritual from Risa. One signifies desire for Jamaharon by displaying a Horga'hn, as Jean-Luc Picard did accidentally in 2366, thereby attracting Joval.
game_text: Nullifies Horga'hn OR nullifies Parallel Romance OR if planet Risa is on spaceline, immediately move any one male personnel alone on a planet to Risa.

name: Kevin Uxbridge: Convergence
lore: A Douwd, a race of sentient energy beings of "disguises and false surroundings." He is capable of using his enormous powers to stop threats with a single thought.

name: La Forge Maneuver
lore: When attacked by a powerful cloaked drone at Minos, acting-captain Geordi La Forge used atmospheric turbulence to locate and target the hidden enemy.
game_text: Plays to expose any one cloaked ship at a planet location. It is vulnerable (as if it were decloaked) if the next action is an attack against that ship.

name: Latinum Payoff
lore: Gold-pressed latinum, which cannot be replicated, is a valuable metal used as currency in many less-developed sectors, primarily outside Federation space.

name: Phaser Burns
lore: Even on stun settings, phased energy weapons can cause severe injuries and burns if not fired judiciously in bursts.

name: Rescue Captives
lore: Away Teams led by Security Chiefs like Tasha Yar have at times been sent to rescue captured personnel, as on this occasion at Mordan IV in 2364.
game_text: All your personnel currently held captive are returned to your outpost(s), nullifying Interrogation, Brainwash and Torture, if any or all are in progress.

name: Romulan Ambush
lore: In 2367, Geordi La Forge was captured by a Romulan ship while piloting a shuttle to Risa. He was brainwashed into an assassination plot against Klingon Governor Vagh.
game_text: Destroys opponent's ship with SHIELDS<6 present with your D'deridex-class ship. Crew killed, except one personnel (your choice) is made captive.

name: Security Sacrifice
lore: Charged with ship and mission safety, security personnel are willing to voluntarily expose themselves to hazards or threats, as Tasha Yar did on many occasions.
game_text: One SECURITY personnel present may sacrifice (substitute) for another personnel who has been randomly selected to die.

name: Seize Wesley
lore: Influenced by the Ktarian ame, the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise chased and captured the last unaffected human crew member... Wesley Crusher.
game_text: Plays on opponent's ship under influence of Ktarian Game dilemma. All remaining personnel are disabled. If Wesley Crusher aboard, he is made your captive.

name: Senior Staff Meeting
lore: Standard operating procedures on starships is to call a meeting of senior officers or department heads to help find solutions of paramount problems.

name: Temporal Narcosis
lore: Debilitating disorientation caused by prolonged exposure to a temporal disturbance, similar to nitrogen narcosis ("the bends"). Jean-Luc Picard experienced this in 2369.

name: Thine Own Self
lore: Attempting a mission with only a few personnel is dangerous. Lt. Commander Data suffered amnesia while alone on Barkon IV. He was lost and eventually "killed."

name: Vorgon Raiders
lore: In 2366, two Vorgons from the 27th century attempted to steal the Tox Uthat artifact uncovered on Risa by Jean-Luc Picard and Vash.
game_text: If you have Ajur and Boratus together in play, discard them and "steal" (use as your own) any one artifact in play or just played as an Interrupt card.

name: Vulcan Nerve Pinch
lore: Vulcans are the only species known to used this method of rendering an opponent unconscious. However, Lt. Commander Data was able to master the technique.

name: Wolf
lore: Lwaxana Troi suffered a collapse as a Betazoid defense from psychic trauma. The wolf symbolized a barrier in her metaconscious mind.
game_text: Saves any personnel with Empathy who has been randomly selected to die or to be captured. OR Nullifies Barclay Transporter Phobia.

name: Brute Force
lore: Valt Minor: Suppress Kriosian rebels seeking foothold here.

name: Diplomatic Conference
lore: Parliament: Participate in historic interstellar conference at this neutral diplomatic site.

name: FGC-47 Research
lore: FGC-47: Study interior of nebula filled with energy strands that obstruct navigation.

name: Fissure Research
lore: Forkus Sector: Investigate quantum fissure between parallel universes reported here.

name: Qualor II Rendezvous
lore: Qualor II: Rendezvous with nefarious merchants at squalid camp.
game_text: Aligned personnel on planet in stasis until mission solved.

name: Quash Conspiracy
lore: Borka System: Negate Vulcan underground operation here.
game_text: No-ship-to-ship beaming at this location.

name: Reunion
game_text: X = 15 points if one present, 40 if all three.

name: Risa Shore Leave
lore: Risa: Have a good, relaxing holiday on the pleasure planet.

name: Beverly Picard
lore: Captain of medical ship U.S.S. Pasteur in 2395 in an alternate timeline. Although divorced from Jean-Luc Picard, she never could say no to him.

name: Ian Andrew Troi
lore: Human husband of Lwaxana. Father of Deanna. Seen in Lwaxana's surreal vision of home at Lake El'nar, Betazed. Friend of Steven Miller and Rettan Grax.

name: Jack Crusher
lore: Lt. Commander aboard U.S.S. Stargazer under best friend Jean-Luc Picard. Husband of Beverly Crusher. Advised their son Wesley to seek his own way.

name: Lt. (j.g.) Picard
lore: Jean-Luc Picard regretted his reckless youth until Q's alternate timeline antics revealed that he would have been a mere assistant astrophysics officer.

name: Paul Rice
lore: A highly regarded risktaker. Captained the U.S.S. Drake, lost at Minos in 2364. Former classmate of William Riker. Re-created by the Arsenal of Freedom.

name: Rachel Garrett
lore: Captain of U.S.S. Enterprise-C when it entered a temporal rift during the Battle of Narendra III in 2344. Ordered a return to the historic battle from 2366.

name: Richard Castillo
lore: Lieutenant and helm officer aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise-C. In 2366, served as liaison with U.S.S. Enterprise-D. Romantically involved with Tasha Yar.

name: Tasha Yar-Alternate
lore: Traveled to 2344 and helped prevent a disastrous war. Survivor of the Battle of Narendra III. Consort of Romulan general. Mother of Sela.

name: Governor Worf
lore: Former member of the Klingon High Council in an alternate timeline in which, by 2395, the Klingons had taken over the Romulan Empire.

name: K'mtar
lore: Worf's son Alexander returned from 40 years in the future to influence his younger self to embrace the way of the warrior and avoid life as a peacemaker.

name: Targ
lore: Horned, furry, ferocious boar-like animal. A popular Klingon pet. Lieutenant Worf had one as a child. Heart of Targ is a Klingon delicacy. This one is male.

name: Boratus
lore: Male Vorgon criminal from the future. Aims to steal artifacts with partner Ajur. Once hunted the Tox Uthat discovered by Jean-Luc Picard on Risa.

name: Lakanta
lore: Male of American Indian descent. Actually The Traveler in disguise. Wesley Crusher left Starfleet Academy to study transcendence of thought with him.

name: Maques
lore: Male leader of the Cairn, a telepathic species who had no concept of spoken language until Federation contact was initiated by Lwaxana Troi in 2370.

name: Mickey D.
lore: Villian of Hotel Royale, an early 21st century pulp novel written by Todd Matthews about shady casino characters. Made real by an unknown intelligence.

name: Commander Tomalak
lore: In an alternate future, the nemesis of the U.S.S. Enterprise confronted Captain Picard but cooperated to investigate an anomaly in the Neutral Zone.

name: D'Tan
lore: Romulan boy. A bright and active member of Spock's underground. Once showed Spock Romulan artifacts depicting the syllabic nucleus of the Vulcan alphabet

name: Stefan DeSeve
lore: Former Federation officer who defected to Romulus in 2349. Later, apparently had second thoughts. Joined Spock's Romulan underground in 2369.

name: Future Enterprise
lore: Commanded by Admiral Riker in an alternate future. U.S.S. Enterprise-D was fitted with a third warp engine nacelle, greatly enhancing its speed and power.

name: U.S.S. Enterprise-C
lore: Predecessor of U.S.S. Enterprise-D. Famous for heroic action in Battle of Narendra III, where it also entered a temporal rift. Commanded by Rachel Garrett.
game_text: Enters play damaged at any location.

name: I.K.C. Fek'Ihr
lore: Destroyed U.S.S. Pasteur in an alternate future, only to be thwarted by the future Enterprise. Named for the ferocious Guardian of Gre'thor.

name: I.K.C. K'Ratak
lore: Bird-of-Prey named in honor of the author of the classic work of Klingon literature, The Dream of the Fire.

name: Edo Vessel
lore: A ship discovered in 2364 by the U.S.S. Enterprise to be protecting the peaceful society on Rubicun III. It was described as "half in, half out of our universe."

name: Gomtuu
lore: Lifeform that normally exists in symbiotic empathic connection with its crew. Gomtuu's crew died prior to its discovery in 2366. Commanded by Tam Elbrun.

name: Tama
lore: "Children of Tama. Vorath's sword raised high. Dathon, speaking first. Tama and Enterprise at El-Adrel. Tama's tears, shivering in the wind."

name: Decius
lore: Powerful ship created in Barash's illusion. Commanded by Tomalak. Transported Admiral Picard and Deanna Troi to a Romulan peace conference.

name: Blade of Tkon
lore: The Tkon Empire was so advanced that it possessed the ability to move planets at will. The empire became extinct some 600,000 years ago during the age of Makto.
game_text: Immediately relocate any one planet location, and all cards there, to a different place on the spaceline. Discard artifact.

name: Canar
lore: A glowing device used by the Haliians to focus thoughts in a limited empathic form. Especially used to strengthen an emotional link during love.
game_text: Immediately play on one female personnel. Specify one male personnel at a different location. If those two personnel are ever present together, discard both.

name: Mona Lisa
lore: Priceless original oil painting by ancient Earth scientist Da Vinci. Stolen from the Louvre in 2243. Recovered from the collection of Kivas Fajo in 2366.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. If destroyed, the player directly causing the destruction (if any) loses points. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Android Nightmares
lore: An infestation of interphasic creatures caused Lt. Commander Data to experience surreal dreams and hallucinations, resulting in his attack on Deanna Troi.
game_text: If android present, one non-android personnel (random selection) killed (three if Interphasic Plasma Creatures affecting you) unless Empathy OR Dr. Soong present.

name: Bendii Syndrome
lore: Rare disease which affects aging Vulcans. A profound loss of mental control leads to emotional outbursts, elicits violence in others and eventually kills its victim.
game_text: One Vulcan with Youth present (opponent's choice) dies the next time you score points. Until then, all your personnel are INTEGRITY -2 where present.

name: Chinese Finger Puzzle
