lore: An ancient novelty which baffled Lt. Commander Data. The solution to the puzzle, which involves relaxation of effort, he called "fascinating."

name: Q's Vicious Animal Things
lore: Wearing Napoleonic uniforms and firing musket-shaped energy weapons, Q's creatures attacked William Riker and his away team. Worf gave them their colorful moniker.
game_text: Unless 22 < STRENGTH < 55, one Away Team member is killed (random selection) and opponent re-seeds dilemma under a different unsolved planet mission.

name: Royale Casino: Craps
lore: An away team from the U.S.S. Enterprise was trapped in the illusionary Hotel Royale until they won enough money in the casino to buy the bank and their way out.
game_text: Show a personnel from hand. If CUNNING = 7 or 11 OR opponent cannot match your number, win points. Otherwise, opponent wins points.

name: Security Precautions
lore: Dr. Manheim's laboratory deep inside a remote planetoid used a system of forcefields and targeting lasers to bar entry and protect a revolutionary experiment.
game_text: To get past, Away Team must have Jenice Manheim OR android OR phaser OR disruptor OR 3 SECURITY.

name: System-Wide Cascade Failure
lore: Lal was affected by a positronic matrix failure. Lt. Commander Data's incomplete knowledge of Dr. Soong's work led to subtle design flaws in the matrix.
game_text: Mission continues but one android present (your choice) dies at end of this turn unless Dr. Soong OR Ira Graves present. Discard dilemma.

name: Yuta
lore: An Acamarian of the clan Tralesta. Carrier of a microvirus engineered to instantly kill anyone with a particular genetic makeup.
game_text: Opponent chooses a number X. Randomly examine crew or Away Team one by one. If INTEGRITY + CUNNING - STRENGTH) = X, discard that personnel and dilemma.

name: Manheim's Dimensional Door
game_text: Plays on any planet. Affects all players. While in play, whenever any player has a card in hand matching one just played by the opponent, the Manheim Effect (a temporal "hiccup") may occur. Opponent's card is suspended while player shows matching card, returns it to hand and plays any card from hand as if played normally. (Not duplicatable.) Nullify with Anti-Matter Pod.

name: Anti-Matter Pod
lore: Magnetic anti-matter containment vessel used by the U.S.S. Enterprise crew to shut down the Manheim Effect and to mine Cardassian ships in the McAllister C-5 nebula.
game_text: May be left at any space mission. Damages next ship to stop here without 3 Navigation (discard pod). May be nullified by Transporter Skill. (Not cumulative.)

name: Plasmadyne Relay
lore: Device designed by Geordi La Forge to improve warp engine quantum efficiency. Wesley Crusher opined that it was obsolete and needed a subprocessor matrix overhaul.

name: Barber Pole
lore: The U.S.S. Enterprise features a fully equipped barber shop, including the traditional helical pole.
game_text: Plays on table.

name: Brainwash
lore: Geordi La Forge was mentally reprogrammed to do the Romulans' bidding by a machine that accessed his mind through his VISOR's direct neural implants.
game_text: Plays on one personnel you've captured. Captive reports to your outpost, is under your control and may mix with your personnel regardless of affiliation.

name: Calamarain
lore: An intelligent species that exists as ionized gas and can travel in space. Penetrated the shields of the U.S.S. Enterprise seeking revenge on Q in 2366.
game_text: Plays at location of opponent's choice. Moves like a ship (RANGE = 6). May damage (not destroy) one ship OR kill Mortal Q at same location (discard event). (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Discommendation
lore: naDHa'ghach. Klingon ritual of shame. A disgraced warrior (and his descendants for seven generations) are shunned and declared non-existent to the rest of Klingon society.
game_text: Plays on any Klingon who survived a losing battle. That Klingon is now Non‑Aligned, has no Honor and loses points.

name: Doppelganger
lore: On stardate 42679.2, the U.S.S. Enterprise encountered a duplicate of Jean‑Luc Picard from six hours in the future. He was eventually killed by Jean-Luc Picard.
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, if a unique personnel moves to the same location as its duplicate, the duplicate is discarded unless Clone Machine in play.

name: Drag Net
lore: When the U.S.S. Enterprise attempted to evade Q's energy net, the net collapsed into a sphere and chased the vessel at high warp.
game_text: Plays on table. At the end of each of your turns you may move any one Q-Net in play one location in either direction.

name: Drought Tree
lore: "This sapling is planted as an affirmation of life, in defiance of the drought, and with expectations of long life. Whatever comes, we will keep it alive as a symbol of our survival."
game_text: Plant on a planet mission you completed to score bonus points. Points may be nullified by any unopposed Away Team.

name: Heisenberg Compensators
lore: Transporter subsytem designed to circumvent the "uncertainty principle" of subatomic physics, allowing the derivation of quantum vector data required for beaming.
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, nullifies Alien Probe and all draw decks are turned face up. OR Nullifies another Heisenberg Compensators card (discard both).

page_title: I Am Not a Merry Man! (QC)
name: I Am Not a Merry Man!
base_name: I Am Not a Merry Man!
lore: "I will not play the fool for Q's amusement!"
game_text: Plays on any one Klingon. While in play, once per turn that Klingon may nullify one Q icon interrupt, event or dilemma where present. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Immortal Again
lore: Following Q's "selfless act," Q2 reluctantly restored his powers. He warned Q to try to stay out of trouble – just in time to save the Calamarain from further torment.
game_text: Nullifies Mortal Q (plus any Calamarain). Q-Continuum is active again. Discard event. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.) OR Exchange for one Amanda Rogers or Q2 card from your discard pile.

name: Klingon Civil War
lore: Powerful political "houses" in Klingon society can form factions that vie for control. Gowron and his supporters defeated the forces of Duras in the Civil war of 2367-68.
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, when a Klingon ship destroys any opponent's Klingon ship, winner scores points = loser's WEAPONS + SHIELDS. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Transfiguration
lore: John Doe was persecuted by other Zalkonians who did not understand his evolution into a higher form. He is now a benevolent energy being with metaphysical powers.
game_text: Plays on John Doe after he has prevented a death. Each turn he may nullify one Event card (except Transfiguration) where present. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Zalkonian Storage Capsule
lore: Alien information storage device salvaged from John Doe's escape pod. Uses a chemically based system for molecular energy encoding.
game_text: Plays on table. Each turn, you may store one hand card here (may be returned to hand at any time). If destroyed, shuffle stored cards and place group on top or bottom of draw deck.

name: Colony
lore: Communities are commonly founded on uninhabited planets. Many are not charted by the Federation.
game_text: Build on any planet mission you completed. Any Away Team unopposed here at start of its owner's turn scores 1 point for each personnel (2 for each CIVILIAN).

name: Terraforming Station
lore: Planets such as Velara IIi can be transformed to support life. The process takes many decades.
game_text: Seed on any planet mission. If still in play at end of game, redefine that mission's requirements for next game with same opponent.

name: Arbiter of Succession
lore: Jean-Luc Picard was chosen to administer the Klingon Rite of Succession to select a new High Council Leader. The ritual concluded when one challenger was killed in battle.
game_text: Two strongest Klingon leaders at one location battle. Place on winner to score points and nullify Klingon Civil War. If killed, points transfer to opponent. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Data's Medals
lore: Lt. Commander Data's citations include Starfleet Command Declaration for Valor and Gallantry, Medal of Honor with Clusters, Legion of Honor and Star Cross.
game_text: Plays on any leader in a battle you just won to score bonus points. Stays on that leader. Points lost if leader killed. (Not cumulative.)

name: End Transmission
lore: Subspace communications are sometimes abruptly terminated by the transmitter.

name: Klingon Painstik
lore: Device employed to verify death in the Sonchi ritual. Also used in the nentay (Rite of Ascension) to test courage. Can make a two-ton Rectyne monopod jump 5 meters.
game_text: Return your Arbiter of Succession to your hand at any time, nullifying its points. OR One unique personnel just killed may not be reported for duty again by any player.

name: Off Switch
lore: Lt. Commander Data has a deactivation switch hidden in his back. Reluctantly, he informed Dr. Crusher of its existence to aid in the re-assembly of Lore.
game_text: Place any android in stasis until end of turn. While in stasis, immune to Android Nightmares, Chinese Finger Puzzle and Dead in Bed. OR Nullifies another Off Switch.

name: Parallax Arguers
lore: At the Parallax Colony, one couple spent their lives endlessly contradicting each other, despite Alexander's reminding them about the higher... the fewer.
game_text: If that was cool, X=5 OR if you just argued, play an Event card now (X=0) OR Nullifies Parallax Arguers (X=opponent's Arguers points +5).

name: Plexing
lore: A Betazed relaxation method tought to Reginald Barclay by Deanna Troi. Stimulating a nerve cluster behind the ear releases natural endorphins and helps to reduce anxiety.
game_text: Nullifies Empathic Echo OR Parallax Arguers OR Frame of Mind OR System‑Wide Cascade Failure OR Thought Maker. (May not be nullified.)

name: Wrong Door
lore: Jean-Luc Picard had intended to step through an Iconian Gateway to the U.S.S. Enterprise, but lack of time forced him to settle for a nearby Romulan Warbird instead.

name: Investigate Legend
lore: Aldea: Verify existence of fabled utopian planet hidden by powerful cloaking device.
game_text: Cloaks or decloaks each time any points scored.

name: Nebula
lore: The McAllister C-5, near Minos Korva and the Cardassian border, is representative of nebulae in the Alpha Quadrant.
game_text: Scan must be played to initiate battle here.Face next dilemma here when opponent scores points.

name: Paxan "Wormhole"
lore: Ngame Nebula: Investigate M-class planet and wormhole reported near T-tauri-type star.
game_text: Relocate opponent's ship if no android aboard.

name: Samaritan Snare
lore: Rhomboid Dronegar Sector: Respond to distress call from Pakled ship.
game_text: Federation must attempt mission if present.

name: Space
lore: The final frontier....

name: Tarchannen Study
lore: Tarchannen III: Aid investigation of outpost that disappeared on this planet.
game_text: No outposts or stations allowed here.

name: Gibson
lore: Ensign Gibson served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise as helm specialist during the 2364 diplomatic mission to Daled IV.

name: Juliana Tainer
lore: Dr. Juliana O'Donnell Soong Tainer. Data's co-creator and "mother." Unaware that Dr. Soong stored her mind in a Soong-type android to prolong her life.

name: Katherine Pulaski
lore: Chief Medical Officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2365. Dislikes transporters and turbolifts.

name: Keiko O'Brien
lore: Botanist. Vegetarian. Keiko Ishikawa married Miles O'Brien aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2367. Lt. Commander Data served as father of the bride.

name: Mirasta Yale
lore: Malcorian scientist befriended by Jean-Luc Picard. Departed Malcor III aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Mordock
lore: Developer of the "Mordock Strategy." Became first Benzite in Starfleet, outscoring Wesley Crusher for appointment to the Academy. Looks like Mendon.

name: Mr. Homn
lore: Silent, imbibing, lurching, uttaberry-eating, faithful servant of Lwaxana Troi. The only words he was known to speak were, "Thank you for the drinks."

name: Rager
lore: Ensign Rager is an experienced conn officer. Served on the U.S.S. Enterprise from 2367 to 2369. Piloted the ship inside a Dyson Sphere found near Norpin V.

name: Robin Lefler
lore: Ensign transporter specialist. Romantically involved with Wesley Crusher. Lefler's Laws include "You gotta go with what works" and "Life isn't always fair."

name: Sakkath
lore: Vulcan male assistant of Sarek. Attempted to use his telepathic skills to repress Sarek's Bendii Syndrome during the crucial Legaran Conference of 2366.

name: Sonya Gomez
lore: Ensign Sonya Gomez is an anti-matter specialist. Snappy conversationalist. Once spilled hot chocolate on Captain Picard. Has total recall.

name: T'Shanik
lore: Vulcan female from Vulcana Regar. Competed against Wesley Crusher, Mordock and Oliana Mirren for acceptance to Starfleet Academy.

name: K'chiQ
lore: William Riker, vested with the powers of Q, created an "ideal mate" for Lieutenant Worf.

name: K'nera
lore: Pursued the criminals Korris and Konmel in 2364 until their deaths on the U.S.S. Enterprise. Offered Worf a position in the Klingon Defense Force.

name: Kahlest
lore: Female ghojmok to young Worf in the employ of the House of Mogh prior to the Khitomer Massacre. Spurned K'mpec because "he was too fat."

name: Kitrik
lore: A Klingon physician. Has a research laboratory and clinic at the Klingon outpost of Maranga IV. Plays the part of "Molor" in the annual Kot'baval Festival.

name: Data's Body
lore: Soong-type android body recovered at Devidia II.

name: Galen
lore: Jean-Luc Picard went undercover in 2370 posing as a mercenary and artifact smuggler.

name: Ira Graves
lore: A mentor of Dr. Soong and thus Lt. Commander Data's "grandfather." Arguably one of the greatest minds of the age. Has Darnay's Disease.

name: Jenice Manheim
lore: Dedicated wife of Paul Manheim. Once romantically involved with Jean-Luc Picard.

name: John Doe
lore: A Zalkonian male with amnesia and the ability to heal by touch alone. Romantically involved with Dr. Crusher. Later evolved into a pure energy being.

name: Kareen Brianon
lore: Technical assistant to Dr. ira Graves. Admitted to having been attracted to him, despite decades of age difference.

name: Kova Tholl
lore: A male from Mizar II. Mizarians value peace above all else and employ passive resistance. They have been conquered six times in 300 years.

name: Madam Guinan
lore: Adventurous El-Aurian who spent time exploring worlds such as Earth. Met a time-traveling crew from the U.S.S. Enterprise in the 19th century.

name: Madred
lore: Gul Madred, Cardassian officer in the Obsidian Order. Specializes in prisoner interrogation. Tortured Jean-Luc Picard time after time in 2369.

name: Marouk
lore: Chancellor of Acamar III. With the help of Captain Picard, she completed an amnesty agreement to return the Gatherers to Acamar in 2366.

name: Nick Locarno
lore: Natural leader kicked out of Starfleet Academy after the Nova Squadron accident and cover-up of 2368.

name: Paul Manheim
lore: Reclusive scientist who experimented with nonlinear time. Traveled to other dimensions, of which he said words paled "because the images are so vibrant."

name: Samuel Clemens
lore: Crotchety 19th Century (sic) author popularly known as Mark Twain. Visited the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2369 during the Devidian time travel incident.

name: Tarmin
lore: An Ullian "telepathic historian" who uses empathic skills to recall detailed historical information from his volunteers' memories.

name: Timicin
lore: Kaelonian. Romantically involved with Lwaxana Troi. Must submit to The Resolution at age 60.

name: Ves Alkar
lore: Treacherous Lumerian ambassador. Uses receptacle stones to deposit his negative emotions in others in order to enhance his negotiation skills.

name: Zon
lore: Nausicaan officer who stabbed young Jean-Luc Picard through the heart in a brawl at Starbase Earhart in 2327. Dom-jot player.

name: Sirol
lore: Commander of the Imperial Romulan Warbird Terix during the Pegasus Incident of 2370.

name: Taris
lore: Female subcommander. Captain of the Warbird Haakona. Investigated the Federation incursion of the Neutral Zone in the vicinity of Iconia.

name: Telak
lore: Male bodyguard of Sela. Stationed on Romulus. Lieutenant operative in the Tal Shiar's new Android Research section.

name: Go Back Whence Thou Camest
lore: "Thou art notified that thy kind has infiltrated the galaxy too far already. Thou art directed to return to thy own solar system immediately."

name: Guilty - Provisionally
lore: "You will now answer to the charge of being a grievously savage race... Soldiers, you will press those triggers if this criminal answers with any word other than 'guilty.'"

page_title: His Honor, The High Sheriff of Nottingham (QC)
name: His Honor, The High Sheriff of Nottingham
base_name: His Honor, The High Sheriff of Nottingham
lore: "Yes, but what about your merry men? Are you willing to jeopardize their lives as well?"

name: Mandarin Bailiff
lore: "Criminal! How plead you?"

name: Pla-Net
lore: "Damn it all to Hell!"
game_text: Immediately choose whether or not to nullify the next seed card at this location. If you choose to nullify, lose points. Otherwise, if that seed card turns out to be a dilemma and it "stops," disables or put in stasis any of your personnel, lose points.

name: Aldebaran Serpent
lore: "You will abandon that mission, Captain. My business with you takes precedence."

name: Amanda's Parents
lore: "They had assumed human form... in vulgar human fashion they proceeded to conceive a child. And like mockish humans they became attached to it.
game_text: Plays on table until any Q-Flash. Each time you play an Amanda Rogers card (except to nullify a Q icon card), opponent may take that Amanda Rogers card and any two other cards in your discard pile out-of-play.

name: Amanda's Parents
lore: "They had assumed human form... in vulgar human fashion they proceeded to conceive a child. And like mockish humans they became attached to it.
game_text: Plays on table until any Q-Flash. Each time you play an Amanda Rogers card (except to nullify a Q icon card), opponent may take that Amanda Rogers (and any two other cards) from your discard pile and place all three out-of-play.

name: Door-Net
lore: "Stay where thou art."

name: Frigid
lore: "SILENCE!"
game_text: Plays on table. The next time you play an Interrupt card during opponent's turn, opponent may place this event on any one of your SECURITY personnel in play. Personnel is in stasis until any Q-Flash, then discard event. May be nullified by Fire Sculptor .

name: Into the Breach
lore: "Ooh!"
game_text: Plays on table until any Q-Flash. While in play, nullifies all Warp Core Breach cards and immediately repairs all damaged ships in play, except Borg Ship. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Jealous Amanda
lore: "Do you love me?"
game_text: Plays on table. The next time any Away Team encounters a Love Interest, Parallel Romance or Alien Groupie, your opponent may override that card's normal result by relocating the affected personnel to any planet location. Discard event. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Military Privilege
lore: "Starfleet Admiral Q, at your service!"
game_text: Plays on table until any Q-Flash. All Federation and Non-Aligned personnel in play with OFFICER classification are now CIVILIAN instead, and vice versa.

name: Penalty Box
lore: "Unfortunately there's only one penalty box. If any of you should be sent there, dear Tasha must give the box up to you... and go into nothingness."
game_text: If any Penalty Box already in play, put its occupant out-of-play and replace with new victim (random selection). Discard event, Otherwise, place on table and put one personnel (random selection) here. (If nullified, return occupant to owner's hand.)

name: Scottish Setter
lore: "Crusher gets more shrill with each passing year."

name: Tijuana Crass
lore: "My brothers and sisters of the Continuum have taken me back!... I feel like celebrating!"
game_text: Plays on table. (May not be nullified.) While in play, any points derived from Ressikan Flute count for all players AND opponent's Data Laughing cards are converted to Event cards to be played on table when used.

name: Trust Me
lore: "You can do it, Amanda... close your eyes... remember them."
game_text: Plays on table until any Q-Flash. Each time you play an Amanda Rogers card (except to nullify a Q icon card), opponent may place two non-Artifact cards from outside the game into opponent's own discard pile.

name: You Will in Time
lore: "If I return you to your ship, will you agree to give my request a full hearing?"
game_text: If you began this mission attempt with only one personnel, opponent may name one of your unique personnel in play. That personnel is in stasis. On every turn, opponent may make a request of you; if you comply, remove personnel from stasis. (May not be nullified.)

page_title: Are These Truly Your Friends, Brother? (QC)
name: Are These Truly Your Friends, Brother?
base_name: Are These Truly Your Friends, Brother?
lore: "You have the power to leave each one of them with a gift proving your affection."
game_text: If you have more cards in your discard pile than personnel in this crew or Away Team, examine one card in your discard pile (random selection). If it has a point box with a number, give it to your opponent who immediately scores those points. Otherwise, place it out-of-play. (May not be nullfied.)

name: Dr. Q, Medicine Entity
lore: "Well, well, well. What seem to be the problem?"
game_text: Diagnosis: One of your Event cards on the spaceline (opponent's choice) is the problem.Treatment: Opponent must move the "problem card" to a different appropriate spaceline location.

name: Gift of the Tormentor
lore: "We have offered you a gift beyond all other gifts."
game_text: If your current score is zero, score bonus points. Otherwise, place this card in your discard pile. (May be nullified only by Countermanda.)

name: Incoming Message - The Continuum
lore: "Your progress, Q?" "As anticipated, there are some problems. I Need time."

name: Lemon-Aid
lore: "Wasn't it your own Hardy that said 'Nothing reveals humanity so well as the games it plays?' ...Actually, you reveal yourself best in how you play."
game_text: If you are at least 20 points ahead of your opponent, graciously give this card to opponent, who scores bonus points. (May not be nullified.)

name: Subsection Q, Paragraph 10
lore: "There will be no legal trickery."
game_text: Every player with more than ten cards in hand loses 1 point for each card in excess of ten. (May not be nullified.)

name: The Higher... The Q-er
lore: "You want to review your rapid progress? to where humans learned to control their military with drugs?"

name: The Issue Is Patriotism
lore: "You slaughtered millions in silly arguments about how to divide the resources of your little world."

name: The Naked Truth
lore: "Red Alert!"

name: Wesley Gets the Point
lore: "You have only one chance to save them now. Send them back to the ship."
game_text: If you have Wesley Crusher present or on any planet, he scores bonus point and dies.

name: Where's Guinan?
lore: "This creature is not what she appears to be. She's an imp, and where she goes trouble always follows."
game_text: If Guinan or Madam Guinan is in your crew or Away Team, relocate each El‑Aurian present to any planet of your opponent's choice. (May be nullified only by Guinan if she has not already nullified a card this turn.)

name: Q's Planet
lore: "This is the dressing for a game that we will play."
game_text: Owner inserts anywhere on spaceline. Each player may place up to three seed cards here from hand, discard pile or Q's Tent. Until solved, an additional 40 points are needed for any player to win. May also be stocked in Q's Tent. (May not be nullified. Not duplicatable.)

name: U.S.S. Stargazer
lore: Captained by Jean-Luc Picard on a historic 22-year mission of exploration. Thought destroyed in 2355 at Maxia Zeta until returned by DaiMon Bok.
game_text: Once each game, may be taken from discard pile to hand.

name: I.K.C. Maht-H'a
lore: Commanded by Nu'Daq during the chase for clues to a four-billion-year-old genetic message in 2369.

name: I.K.C. T'Ong
lore: A Klingon sleeper ship from the 23th century, an era when Klingons despised humans and attacked them on sight. Commanded by K'Temoc.

name: Zalkonian Vessel
lore: Typical Zalkonian defense vessel. One commanded by Sunad traveled at warp 9.72, hunt the fugitive known as John Doe in the Zeta Gelis Cluster.
game_text: Kills untransfigured John Doe if at same location at end of your turn.

name: T'Pau
lore: Vulcan merchant vessel named for the only person to ever turn down a seat on the Federation Council. Stolen from Surplus Depot Zed-15 at Qualor II.
game_text: May report for duty at Qualor II.

name: Terix
lore: Warbird commanded by Sirol. "Accidentally" sealed the U.S.S. Enterprise inside an asteroid in 2370.

name: Alien Labyrinth
lore: Many planets, such as Mordan IV, have convoluted underground installations which require Away Teams to have specific technology or skills.
game_text: To get through this maze-like structure and continue, Away Team must have a Tricorder OR 2 ENGINEER.

name: Ferengi Attack
lore: Ferengi attacked a Federation Away Team on a planet in the Delphi Ardu system using "whips" which fire discharges of high-energy plasma.
game_text: Kills on Away Team member (opponent's choice) unless total CUNNING+STRENGTH>68 OR Greed present. Discard dilemma.

name: Hidden Entrance
lore: Using his visor, Geordi La Forge discovered a doorway to an underground android laboratory hidden in a rock wall on Omicron Theta in 2364.
game_text: To locate the concealed entrance and continue, Away Team must have Geordi La Forge OR ENGINEER + CUNNING>32

name: Hunter Gangs
lore: On some planets, civilization has devolved into a bitter struggle for survival. Violent gangs search for prey, such as those which chased Natasha Yar on Turkana IV.
game_text: Two Away Team members (random selection) are chased. Examine cards separately. Personnel escapes if CUNNING is even, killed if oddd. Discard dilemma.

name: Malfunctioning Door
lore: At time, Away Teams must open obstructed doors in confined passageways by hand, as did Lt. Commander Data on stardate 41503.7.
game_text: To get through door, must have Soong-type Android present OR a combined STRENGTH>27 from up to four Away Team members.

name: The Gatherers
lore: Nomadic marauders and thieves from Acamar III. "We Gatherers value our freedom. We do what we want and we answer to no creature."
game_text: Unless Marouk OR INTEGRITY>36 present, discard all Equipment and Artifacts in Away Team, plus one card (random selection) from your hand. Discard dilemma.

name: Data Laughing
lore: When Lt. Commander Data rescued the temporarily mortal Q from the Calamarain in 2366, Q awarded him with the gift of laughter.

name: Kevin Uxbridge: Convergence
lore: A Douwd, a race of sentient energy beings of "disguises and false surroundings." He is capable of using his enormous powers to stop threats with a single thought.

name: A Good Place to Die
lore: Halee System: Study harsh planet where Klingon criminals are exiled "to die on their feet with honor."

name: Avert Danger
lore: Moab IV: Aid colony threated with destruction by a stellar core fragment.

name: Cargo Rendezvous
lore: Beltane IX: Appointed meeting to deliver cargo at this major commercial center.

name: Distress Mission
lore: Ligos VII: Respond to distress call and beware of Ferengi activity in this sector.

name: Gault
lore: Gault: Open secret inquiry on early history of Klingon foster child raised on this Federation planet.

name: Gravesworld
lore: Gravesworld: Investigate distress call received from lab of Dr. Ira Graves here.

name: Homeward
lore: Boral II: Aid study of primitive culture on planet threatened by intense radiation storms.

name: Hostage Situation
lore: Mordan IV: Coordinate with local authorities to free captives held hostage.

name: Reopen Dig
lore: Denius III: Revive excavation and seek rumored clues to Iconian artifacts.

name: Reported Activity
lore: Xendi Sabu: Probe reports of mysterious Ferengi activity in this sector.

name: Survey Instability
lore: Selcundi Drema Sector: Study this "live fast, die hard" volcanic planet in this sector.

name: Admiral McCoy
lore: Not a psychiatrist, mechanic, coal miner, bricklayer, scientist, physicist, moon shuttle conductor, escalator, magician or fish peddler. Just an old country doctor.

name: Admiral Picard
lore: The former captain of the U.S.S. Enterprise pursued an unprecedented treaty with the Romulans in Barash's illusion.

name: Commander Data
lore: In Barash's illusion, Data was second in command of the U.S.S. Enterprise under Captain Riker.

name: Commander Troi
lore: In Barash's illusion, Deanna Troi left the U.S.S. Enterprise to take a position at Starfleet Command as Admiral Picard's diplomatic counselor.

name: Spock
lore: ½ Vulcan, ½ Human son of Sarek and Amanda Grayson. Over 140-year-old ambassador. On private mission to Romulus. Mindmelded with Picard.

name: Gi'ral
lore: Survivor of Khitomer massacre. Wife of Tokath. Mother of Ba'el. Raised her daughter at a Romulan prison camp in the Carraya system.

name: Ja'rod
lore: Father of Duras, Lursa and B'Etor. Disappeared shortly after transmitting security codes to the Romulans, precipitating the Khitomer massacre.

name: Mogh
lore: Father of Worf and Kurn. Followed the traitor Ja'rod to Khitomer, suspecting him of conspiring with Romulans. Rumored to have survived the massacre.

name: I.K.C. K'Ratak
lore: Bird-of-Prey named in honor of the author of the classic work of Klingon literature, The Dream of the Fire.

name: Orb of Prophecy and Change
lore: Third of the nine mysterious energy vortices called Tears of the Prophets by the Bajorans. Grants visions of the future. Only Orb not stolen by Cardassians during the occupation.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. Once each turn, you may glance at the top card of your draw deck. Insert it anywhere within your draw deck if you wish. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Garak
lore: Cardassian male. Virtual player in the Vorta scenario testing the resolve of Alpha Quadrant species. Risked his life in the defense of his comrades.

name: Thomas Paris
lore: Convicted traitor. Maquis sympathizer. Best pilot Harry Kim has ever seen. In an alternate reality, a bar fight cost Tom Paris his future aboard the U.S.S. Voyager.

name: Dr. Telek R'Mor
lore: Romulan Astrophysical Academy member on deep space duty in 2351. Beamed to the present via a micro-wormhole to the U.S.S. Voyager.

name: 1962 Roger Maris Baseball Card
lore: One-of-a-kind trading card. Collectible icon of an ancient professional sport once played on Earth. Owned by Kivas Fajo. Still retains its original bubble gum aroma.
game_text: Immediately play on table. During your turn, you may trade this artifact for any opponent's artifact in play. Players must immediately play traded cards as their own. (Not duplicatable)

name: Persistence of Memory
lore: Surreal 1931 Salvador Dali painting stolen by Kivas Fajo.
game_text: Place in hand until played at any time on Horga'hn OR Thought Maker OR Mona Lisa OR Static Warp Bubble OR Kivas Fajo - Collector OR The Traveler: Transcendence OR "Devidian Door" OR Supernova OR Black Hole OR Anti-Time Anomaly. Reverses that card. (Not duplicatable.)

name: DNA Metamorphosis
lore: Geordi La Forge was infected with alien DNA. Transformed into an invisible reptilian humanoid, he was observable only when scanned with ultraviolet light.

name: Qapla'!
lore: DabuQlu’DI’ yISuv. bISovbejbe’DI’ tImer. Suvlu’taHvIS yapbe’ HoS neH. tIqDaq HoSna’ tu’lu’. may’meyDajvo’ Haw’be’ tlhIngan. [English: When threatened, fight. When in doubt, surprise them. Brute strength is not the most important asset in a fight. Real power is in the heart. A Klingon does not run away from his battles.]
game_text: DuHIvchugh ghol vaj qaStaHvIS may’vetlh HoSDaq ghob luchel quiv ghajboghtlhInganpu’lI’. [vI’be’.][English: If an opponent attacks you, during that battle your Klingons with Honor add INTEGRITY to STRENGTH. (Not cumulative.) ]

name: Dixon Hill's Business Card
game_text: Interrupt If any mug (what ain't Swedish) just got iced and there weren't no witnesses, finger any udda mug what's woikin' for da same boss. Put da bag on 'im. Event Plays on da table. The udda boss' next mug what shows up has gotta be univoisal or hologrammatical, den put dis card outta commission. (No duplicatin' dis here event.)

name: Locutus of Borg
lore: Assimilated counterpart who spoke to the Federation. "The knowledge and experience of the human – Jean Luc Picard – is part of us now."

name: Guinan
lore: 500-year-old El-Aurian. U.S.S. Enterprise bartender. Trusted advisor and confidant of Jean-Luc Picard.

name: Spot
lore: Female cat who lives aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Sometimes mistaken for a male. Finicky gourmet. Has refused over 74 different feline supplements.

name: Dr. Soong
lore: Reclusive genius who perfected the positronic brain originally proposed in the 20th century. Ex-husband of Juliana. "Father" of the androids Data and Lore.

name: Kivas Fajo
lore: Unscrupulous, murderous, conceited Zibalian trader. Collector. Notorious member of Stacius Trade Guild.

name: Lore
lore: Evil Soong-type android. Data's "elder brother."

name: Tallera
lore: Female Romulan mercenary. In reality a physically altered Vulcan isolationist seeking the Stone of Gol.

name: Sisters of Duras
lore: Lursa and B'Etor, like their father before them, collaborated with the Romulan Star Empire.

name: Picard's Artificial Heart
lore: "You might have lived if you'd had a real one, instead of this unreliable piece of technology."
game_text: Immediately seed under this mission (even if a space mission). When mission completed (or scouted), owner places in hand until played as an Interrupt card, once per game, on any one personnel in play. That personnel dies whenever that personnel's STRENGTH is used. (May be nullified only by Katherine Pulaski, if present.)

name: U.S.S. Pasteur
lore: Medical Relief vessel. Starfleet registry NCC-58928. Captained by Beverly Picard in an alternate future.

page_title: Doorway “Door to the Fajo Collection” Coupon
name: Doorway “Door to the Fajo Collection” Coupon
base_name: Doorway “Door to the Fajo Collection” Coupon

page_title: Premiere Unlimited 95 uncut sheets limited time offer coupon
name: Premiere Unlimited 95 uncut sheets limited time offer coupon
base_name: Premiere Unlimited 95 uncut sheets limited time offer coupon

name: Antique Machine Gun
lore: 21st century automatic weapon. Developed for faction wars against ECON in World War III. No stun setting. Rapid-fires small-caliber bullets. Owned and often used by Lily Sloane.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. At start of personnel battle, may target two opposing personnel or Rogue Borg (random selection). Mortally wounds targets (only stuns androids).

name: Magic Carpet Ride OCD
lore: High-res encoding of 20th century rock 'n' roll, known for its enervating rhythms and unbearable volume. "You don't know what we can find... on a Magic Carpet Ride."
game_text: May seed at a space location. Owner may relocate any ship at this location (and ship's Away Teams, if any) to any planet location on spaceline. Discard artifact.

name: Zefram Cochrane's Telescope
lore: Gazing at the celestial harmony, Zefram Cochrane escape the squalor of his time and dreamed of the conquest of space. And how much money he could make.

name: Balancing Act
lore: Deadly plasma coolant flooded main engineering through a rupture opened by Data. Survival depended upon balance and strength. Resistance was futile.

name: Blended
lore: Sometimes obtaining information from locals requires consuming beverages of dubious nutritional value. It's best not to criticize such "counseling techniques."
game_text: To get past requires Empathy, Diplomacy, Morn or any Scotty. All such personnel are "stopped," but if two or more present, one must continue (random selection).

name: Borg Servo
lore: Borg nanotechnological servomechanism. Can remain dormant and undetected until activated. Typical first evidence of assimilation. Rapidly takes over its victim.
game_text: Unless Cybernetics and MEDICAL present, opponent (if playing Borg) assimilates one personnel present (random selection). Discard dilemma.

name: Dead End
lore: A Borg force field prevented Data from accomplishing his first goal, and caused him to seek another option.
game_text: Unless you have at least 50 points, cannot get past; place dilemma atop mission; it may not be attempted by a player with less than 50 points. (Unique.)

name: Don't Call Me Ahab
lore: Jean-Luc Picard had an Ahab-like obsession with his revenge against the Borg. If his chest had been a cannon, he would have shot his heart upon them.
game_text: "Stops" one OFFICER with INTEGRITY>6 AND any number of Enterprise-E personnel present (opponent's choice).

name: Lack of Preparation
lore: An Away Team that is unprepared to complete its mission will undoubtedly experience delays. Mission progress may be impossible until additional personnel arrive.
game_text: Non-Borg: Cannot get past (lose 10 points) unless you could have met mission requirements at start of attempt. Borg: Must have Communications, Navigation and Defense personnel to proceed.

name: Maglock
lore: Maglocks such as those securing the U.S.S. Enterprise-E deflector dish require triple-input authorization. The need for coordinated effort prevents accidental activation.
game_text: To get past, crew must have at least 3 OFFICER with STRENGTH>5 each.

name: My First Raygun
lore: An intruder with a stolen phaser can pose an unpredictable threat, especially if she doesn't know the difference between "stun" and "maximum."
game_text: Immediately probe (then discard probe card):Event, Interrupt, Alternate, Enterprise-E: Kills a personnel (random selection).Otherwise: "Stops" a personnel (random selection).

name: Ooby Dooby
lore: "Well, you wiggle to the left, you wiggle to the right; you do the Ooby Dooby with all your might; Ooby Dooby; Ooby Dooby; Ooby Dooby, Dooby doo wah, doo wah, doo wah."

name: Primitive Culture
lore: First contact requires caution, subterfuge or force. Solkar's historic visit to Earth was peaceful, but Federation/Klingon contact in 2218 would ignite a century of hostilities.
game_text: To gest past, requires 3 Vulcans OR Anthropology and CIVILIAN OR Vorta and 4 Jem'Hadar OR 2 Tal Shiar OR 2 Obsidian Order OR Acquisition and 2 Greed OR 6 Klingons OR 4 Defense Borg.

name: Scout Encounter
lore: Many species send specially designed scout ships into unexplored sectors of space. If the species is aggressive, the arrival of a scout ships is a harbinger of trouble.
game_text: Opponent may download to this location one scout ship with one or two Universal crew members. That ship may (if possible) initiate battle against you or move away.

name: Shot in the Back
lore: Data protected his Away Team from machine gun fire by taking a few bullets from behind, then simply waiting until the magazine was empty. No vital systems were damaged.
game_text: "Stops" SECURITY androids and OFFICER androids, if any present. Otherwise, kills one non-android Away Team member (opponent's choice).

name: Strict Dress Code
lore: If the holographic maître d' hadn't delayed the Borg, they would have killed Jean-Luc Picard before he could have completed his plan.
game_text: Sacrifice one Diplomacy, one Hologram or two Defense personnel present (killed); otherwise, one personnel present is killed (opponent's choice). Mission continues.

name: Theta-Radiation Poisoning
lore: Damage to warp drive components, such as the throttle assembly of the Phoenix, can result in subspace-related theta particle emissions. Deadly if not inoculated quickly.
game_text: Place on any ship or outpost here (opponent's choice). End of each turn, one personnel present without Medical Kit killed (random selection). Cure with 6 ENGINEER.

name: Undetected Beam-In
lore: Borg refugees from a destroyed spherical vessel were able to beam aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise-E without being detected. This led to a nasty surprise for Inge Eiger.
game_text: Opponent may download to this location up to 4 Borg drones or Rogue Borg Mercenaries (they do not battle now). Nullify dilemma with Shelby OR 4 SECURITY.

name: Assimilation Table
lore: Functions: Equip drone initiates with specialized adaptive implants. Access counterpart biological data; encode heuristic pathways. Augment collective distinctiveness.
game_text: Holds one personnel (occupant killed if table destroyed). Once per turn, in place of one card draw, you may download to occupant an Implant card.

name: Starfleet Type III Phaser Rifle
lore: More powerful than other hand-held Federation energy weapons and has longer-lasting charge. Rotatable beam modulation. Stored aboard ship in armory racks.
game_text: Federation and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +3, but loses 1 Diplomacy unless aboard your ship. (Cumulative.)

name: Tommygun
lore: Holographic weapon. Version of Thompson submachinegun, model 1921. Can empty a 100-round drum in 4 seconds. "Pinched" from Nicky the Nose's henchman by Dixon Hill.
game_text: Use at start of personnel battles. May stun one Rogue Borg or personnel present (random selection) OR erase up to 100 Hologram personnel present (your choice).

name: Abandon Mission
lore: Jean-Luc Picard felt compelled to ignore his assigned patrol duties in the neutral zone and instead join the attack against the Borg.
game_text: Plays on any ship with its matching commander or any Enterprise-E personnel aboard. Crew may not attempt missions or beam off. Nullified if ship battles. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Activate Subcommands
lore: The Borg have huge numbers of available drones which normally perform internal functions for the collective. When a task is pending, some of these drones are activated.
game_text: Downloads one Communications Borg drone, one Navigation Borg drone and one Defense Borg drone. Discard event and draw no cards this turn.

name: Disengage Safety Protocols
lore: Jean-Luc Picard overrode the holodeck safety protocols during the Borg invasion of the U.S.S. Enterprise-E. Without those protocols, even a holographic bullet can kill.
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, suspends Holographic Safety Protocols (Hologram personnel may mortally wound). Also, Hologram weapons mortally wound instead of stun.

name: Intermix Ratio
lore: Zefram Cochrane struggled to maintain the optimum balance of matter and anti-matter injection for the Phoenix warp systems. The proper ratio, of course, is 1 to 1.
game_text: Plays on table. If any player's ratio of bonus points to non-bonus points exceeds 1:1, the excess bonus points do not count toward winning. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Mirror Image
lore: [Jean-Luc Picard reflected upon introducing an unstable element into a critical situation]
game_text: [Seeds or plays on table. All Red Alert (sic), Kivas Fajo - Collector, Masaka Transformations and The Traveler: Transcendence cards affect all players. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)]

name: Mission Debriefing
lore: Bureaucracies require field commanders to submit a complete "after action report" on any mission. Though necessary, the process can be time consuming.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Whenever any crew or Away Team finishes a mission attempt (whether successful or not), it is "stopped." (Captain's Order.)

name: Ocular Implants
lore: In 2371, Geordi La Forge received implants allowing him to see without his VISOR. They include enhanced capabilities such as infrared and zoom focus over 500 meters.

name: Regenerate
lore: The Borg use neural energy to collectively repair damaged biological and technological components. The Queen often serves as the focal point.
game_text: Plays to fully repair and "stop" any Borg Ship dilemma or Borg ship (nullifying any cards reducing its attributes) OR to shuffle your discard pile into draw deck. Discard event.

name: Retask
lore: Even a Borg cube ship can lose contact with the collective consciousness and begin marauding through space. Proper protocol re-establishment reintegrates it into the collective.
game_text: Downloads UniversalBorg Cube and seven drones (Borg affiliation, Borg affiliation, Borg affiliation, Communications, Navigation, Navigation, Defense) to replace any Borg Ship dilemma in play. Discard event and dilemma. Draw no cards this turn.

page_title: The Line Must Be Drawn Here (FC)
name: The Line Must Be Drawn Here
base_name: The Line Must Be Drawn Here
lore: "... And I will make them PAY for what they've done!"
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Any player who plays Amanda Rogers, Kevin Uxbridge or Q2 loses 5 points, even if playing Borg. (Cumulative. Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Wall of Ships
lore: A wall display of all ships to bear the name Enterprise is a tradition built into each new ship of the line. This exhibit is in the observation lounge aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise-E.
game_text: Downloads any Enterprise. Discard event. OR Plays on table. Adds 1 to RANGE, WEAPONS and SHIELDS of each of your Enterprises. (Cumulative.)

name: A Change of Plans
lore: Sensing that her plans for the interplexing beacon had been thwarted, the Borg Queen immediately implemented a new goal for the hive.

name: Adapt: Modulate Shields
lore: Borg quickly adapt countermeasures, such as drone energy shields, to fail any new weapon used against them. Remodulating an energy weapon helps only briefly.
game_text: Plays and remains on a phaser or disruptor just used to stun or mortally wound one of your Communications Borg. Your Borg are immune to all weapons with that exact card title.

name: Adapt: Negate Obstruction
lore: The first experience of a hazard can be as dangerous to a Borg drone as to anyone. However, the Borg soon adapt and learn how to nullify it.

name: Alas, Poor Queen
lore: Like all cybernetic life forms, the Borg cannot survive without their organic components. Loss of the Queen brings chaos to order.
game_text: Plays if Borg Queen (or Bluegill Queen) was just killed. All Borg (or Bluegills) in play of same player also die. (Immune to Amanda Rogers.) OR Nullifies Regenerate.

name: Android Headlock
lore: Although drones are physically stronger than humanoids, they cannot always overcome Soong-type androids. Data has strangled, thrown and "disarmed" various Borg.
game_text: Mortally wounds a Borg drone, Jem'Hadar, Rogue Borg or Hologram personnel who just engaged your android in combat. (Android engages next adversary.) OR Nullifies Borg Kiss.

name: Assimilate This!
lore: Proving that resistance is not always futile, Worf gave the Borg something else to assimilate.
game_text: Nullifies Build Interplexing Beacon OR Crosis OR Orbital Bombardment. (Also, owner of that card loses points, even if playing Borg.)

name: Assimilation Tubules
lore: Specially equipped drones use tubule-shaped talons capable of penetrating any known alloy or energy field. Nanaprobes in the bloodstream recode the victim's DNA.
game_text: Plays during battle after a winner is determined. Your Talon Drone may select one opposing mortally wounded personnel present to instead be assimilated.

name: Awaken
lore: Each Borg drone is tied into a sophisticated subspace communications network, allowing quick activation in response to a threat.
game_text: Downloads one Communications or Navigation drone. OR Plays at start of battle to download to one of your ships at that location one Defense drone (two if opponent initiated this battle).

name: Borg Kiss
lore: It had been eight years, seven months, sixteen days, four minutes and twenty‑two seconds since Data last experienced physical forms of pleasure.
game_text: Plays if you just probed for Assimilate Counterpart. Ignore result, draw probe card and probe again. OR Plays to draw one card for each Skill Dot on a male you've abducted.

name: Borg Neuroprocessor
lore: Picard used a tricorder to decode the memory chip implanted in the chest of a Borg drone. This chip records all instructions the drone has received from the collective.
game_text: Glance at one face-down Hidden Agenda card. OR Plays if a Borg or Rogue Borg has died and you have any tricorder in play. Nullifies a Borg Only interrupt or all Rogue Borg in play.

name: Deactivation
lore: Command codes, known only to key personnel, are needed to disable many system-level instructions.
game_text: Nullifies Auto-Destruct Sequence (unless Fractal Encryption Code present), Red Alert or Static Warp Bubble . OR Erases an Away Team of only Hologram personnel. (Captain's Order.)

name: Fractal Encryption Code
lore: Nearly unbreakable code. Based on infinitely recursive fractal algorithms. Data used one to isolate the main computer, storing the decryption codes in his neural net.
game_text: Plays on your ship or outpost if your android aboard. It may not be assimilated or commandeered and may not use RANGE or WEAPONS. Same android may nullify interrupt if aboard.

page_title: He Will Make an Excellent Drone (FC)
name: He Will Make an Excellent Drone
base_name: He Will Make an Excellent Drone
lore: Having apparently seduced a new counterpart to join the collective with temptations of flesh, the Queen had no further use for her old "equal."
game_text: Converts your counterpart to a drone. (Discard any Assimilate Counterpart objective placed on that Borg.)

page_title: I'm a Doctor, Not a Doorstop (FC)
name: I'm a Doctor, Not a Doorstop
base_name: I'm a Doctor, Not a Doorstop
lore: Interactive holograms sometimes balk at instructions not compatible with their programming. Dr. Crusher activated an unwilling E.M.H. Program to delay a group of Borg.
game_text: Plays to "stop" any one Hologram personnel. OR Plays to cancel a personnel battle by sacrificing (discarding) one of your Hologram personnel present.

name: Mercy Kill
lore: Assimilation is considered by many to be a fate worse than death. "Don't hesitate to fire. Believe me, you'll be doing them a favor."
game_text: Plays to immediately kill one of your personnel just abducted, captured or assimilated as a drone. OR "Kills" (nullifies) any one of your Event cards in play.

name: Remodulation
lore: With Borg intruders overrunning every defensive checkpoint, Jean-Luc Picard struggled with modifications to make resources more effective.

name: Scorched Hand
lore: Plasma gas from the ruptured coolant tank liquified all the organic skin grafted onto Data's endoskeletal structure.
game_text: Plays to cause each player who has more than 12 cards in hand to shuffle all but 6 (random selection) and place beneath draw deck. (Immune to Amanda Rogers.)

name: Sense the Borg
lore: "Yes, I know – the Borg."

name: Shipwreck
lore: Lily was stunned when Jean-Luc Picard, in a rage against the Borg, destroyed the traditional Enterprise exhibit in the observation lounge. "You broke your little ships."
game_text: Suspends ALL ship attribute enhancements for the rest of this turn. (May be played at start of battle.) OR Nullifies all Wall of Ships cards in play.

name: Temporal Wake
lore: The Borg sphere used chronometric particles to create a temporal vortex. The pursuing U.S.S. Enterprise-E was pulled in when it flew through the wake of the anomaly.

name: Three-Dimensional Thinking
lore: The Borg Queen was also on the first cube to attack Earth, even though all Borg on it were destroyed. "You think in such three-dimensional terms. How small you've become."
game_text: Plays if you have Borg Queen or a counterpart aboard one of your ships begin destroyed. Immediately relocate any or all crew to another of your ships in play.

name: Weak Spot
lore: Sensing the hive's thoughts, Jean-Luc Picard ordered all ships to fire on a critically vulnerable point, even though it did not appear to be a vital system.
game_text: Plays on a ship being targeted by two or more ships. For this battle, reduces its SHIELDS by 4 (not cumulative) OR suspends its SHIELDS enhancement from any one card.

name: Espionage Mission
game_text: Any "Espionage... on Federation" card may play here. Also, mission may be attempted if Selok in Away Team.

name: Patrol Neutral Zone
game_text: X=number of Neutral Zone locations in play.

name: Planet
lore: Class-M Planet: Investigate unsurveyed habitable planet with nitrogen‑oxygen atmosphere.

name: Assimilate Counterpart
game_text: Plays on table. Target an opponent's unique male personnel. Your Borg may beam to and battle target's crew or Away Team. One of your Borg who engages target in combat may abduct target. If target is occupying an Assimilation Table, you may probe: Communications, Navigation, Defense: Assimilated as a counterpart. Place on target. Worth 5 points perSkill Dot while objective on target.

name: Build Interplexing Beacon
game_text: Suspends your Assimilate Homeworld, targeting Earth, if your Stop First Contact was nullified. Target a ship. Your Borg may scout target. If your Borg are aboard target orbiting 2063 Earth, you may probe: Communications, Defense : Transponder rods are now set in place. Navigation : If transponder rods set, place on ship; Timeline disrupted in 2063 and suspended objective completed.

name: Prepare Assault Teams
game_text: Plays on table. You may download to one of your crews or Away Teams one hand weapon. While in play, your SECURITY may function as leaders. Also, at start of personnel battle, you may split your cards into two assault teams (face down). Attacker chooses one team to participate in battle. (The other team does not participate and is not "stopped.")

name: Stop First Contact
game_text: Suspends your Assimilate Homeworld targeting Earth, if scouting complete. Target Montana Missile Complex (downloading as necessary). If you have a staffed ship orbiting that location, you may probe: Defense: Phoenix destroyed here. Timeline disrupted in 2063. Discard objective. Suspended objective completed. May download one Objective card.

name: Borg Queen
lore: "I am the beginning; the end; the one who is many. I am the Borg... I am the collective."

name: Eight of Nineteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: ASSAULT DRONETASK: Supply enhanced control apparatus. Patrol.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Eighteen of Nineteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: ASTROGATION DRONETASK: Calibrate warp matrix, increase efficiency.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Human species.

name: Eleven of Nineteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BIO-MED DRONETASK: Reabsorb damaged biological components.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Fifteen of Seventeen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: COUNTERMEASURE DRONETASK: Nullify resistance to scout operations.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Klingon species.

name: Five of Eleven
lore: IDENTIFICATION: CYBER DRONETASK: Analyze suspended animation principles.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Klingon species.

name: Four of Eleven
lore: IDENTIFICATION: GUARD DRONETASK: Compute defense effectiveness. Maximize.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Nine of Eleven
lore: IDENTIFICATION: INTERLINK DRONETASK: Expedite optitude dissemination. Enhance.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Cardassian species.

name: Nine of Seventeen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: MULTIPLEXOR DRONETASK: Monitor multiple threat acquisition. Target.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Human species.

name: One of Eleven
lore: IDENTIFICATION: PROCUREMENT DRONETASK: Add technological distinctiveness to collective.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Bolian species.

name: Six of Eleven
lore: IDENTIFICATION: QUANTUM DRONETASK: Investigate parallel space/time. Analyze.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Human species.

name: Six of Seventeen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: SABOTAGE DRONETASK: Scan navigation/defense systems. Attenuate.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Sixteen of Nineteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: SURVEY DRONETASK: Identify exorelics. Examine. ClassifyBIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Ten of Nineteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: TACHYON DRONETASK: Neutralize concealment systems.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Thirteen of Nineteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: TACTICAL DRONETASK: Control offensive capabilities. Coordinate.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Three of Nineteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: TALON DRONETASK: Add biological distinctiveness to collective.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Two of Eleven
lore: IDENTIFICATION: TRANSPORT DRONETASK: Determine defensive screen harmonics. Adapt.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Klingon species.

name: Two of Nineteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: TRANSWARP DRONETASK: Expand transportation network.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Two of Seventeen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: UNITY DRONETASK: Study biological organisms. Analyze. Correlate.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Admiral Hayes
lore: Admiral in charge of coordinating Starfleet's anti-Borg forces. Led a fleet in defense of a Borg cube attack on Earth in 2373.

name: Alyssa Ogawa
lore: Lieutenant (j.g.) Alyssa Ogawa married shipmate Andrew Powell in 2370. A nurse assistant to Dr. Beverly Crusher, she is studying to be a doctor.

name: Beverly Crusher
lore: Dr. Beverly Crusher is the U.S.S. Enterprise-E chief medical officer. Swore she'd never use an E.M.H.

name: Data
lore: Lt. Commander Data had an emotion chip installed in 2371. Cries yellow tears. Soong-type android who, for 0.68 seconds, almost joined the Borg.

name: Deanna Troi
lore: Commander Deanna Troi is ship's counselor aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise-E. ½ Betazoid, ½ Human. Complained there wasn't time to argue about time.

name: Dr. Royse
lore: Male Bolian. Representative of Starfleet scientists. Molecular archaeologist on sabbatical from Daystrom Institute on Galor IV. Friend of Vash.

name: E.M.H. Program
lore: Generic interactive Emergency Medical Hologram. Programmed by Dr. Zimmerman. For short-term use.

name: Geordi La Forge
lore: In 2371, Chief Engineer Geordi La Forge received ocular implants that surpassed the functions of his old VISOR. Attended Zefram Cochrane High School.

name: Hawk
lore: Helm officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise-E. Lieutenant Hawk piloted the ship through a temporal vortex. Member of Picard's zero-G assault team.

name: Inge Eiger
lore: Typical diagnostical engineer on U.S.S. Enterprise-E. Assistant to Paul Porter. Female seismologist from Tycho City, Lunar Colony.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
lore: Captain of the U.S.S. Enterprise-E. Once assimilated by the Borg. Became obsessed with their destruction. Still hears echoes of the collective.

name: Joseph Travis
lore: Representative of the brave security personnel in Starfleet. Ensign Travis stood his ground against Borg intruders at defensive checkpoint 3 on deck 4.

name: Lightner
lore: Lieutenant (j.g.) Lightner is an expert marksman. Member of the winning team in the 2369 Starfleet Academy Parrises Squares Championship.

name: Lisa Azar
lore: Ex-wife of a Cardassian arms merchant on Turkana IV. Misses her old lifestyle, but likes the opportunities offered by the Federation.

name: Obarakeh
lore: Ensign Obarakeh is typical of Starfleet security personnel. She monitors and administrates computer encryption safeguards. Plays the Angolian chimes.

name: Paul Porter
lore: Senior systems engineer aboard U.S.S. Enterprise-E. Amateur geologist, studying with friend Inge Eiger. In command during Geordi La Forge's absence.

name: Reginald Barclay
lore: Lieutenant Reginald Barclay helped repair the Phoenix in time for its historic flight. Member of Alpha Team. Hypochondriac. Hero worshipper.

name: Richard Wilkins
lore: Typical scientist. Order to scan the Neutral Zone on stardate 50893. Found 20 particles of space dust per cm3, 52 UV radiation spikes and a class 2 comet.

name: Thomas McClure
lore: Senior security officer aboard U.S.S. Enterprise-E. Led the ship's internal defense during the Borg attack of 2373. Transferred from U.S.S. Hood.

name: William T. Riker
lore: Commander Will Riker led Earth's first defeat of the Borg in 2367. In 2063, led the secret effort to repair the Phoenix and reinstate Earth's first warp flight.

name: Worf
lore: Lt. Commander Worf was promoted in 2371. Klingon commander of U.S.S. Defiant during the Borg attack of 2373.

name: Kathleen Tonell
lore: Inspired in 2063 with a new view of humanity's place in the cosmos, her work helped end post-atomic horror and led to world government in 2113.

name: Lily Sloane
lore: Structural design engineer of Phoenix. Took first steps into the new frontier. Helped overcome Borg in 2063. Said, "Jean-Luc, blow up the damned ship!"

name: Sevek
lore: Male Vulcan scientist. An expert in planetary development and ecological systems. Served on Solkar's survey vessel.

name: Solkar
lore: Initiated Vulcan/Earth contact in 2063. The first Vulcan to wish Zefram Cochrane peace and long life.

name: T'Shonra
lore: Vulcan scientist. In 2063, on an extended survey far from Vulcan, her scanning instruments detected a warp signature emanating from an uncharted system.

name: Zefram Cochrane
lore: Inventor of warp drive. Reluctant hero. First human to make contact with an alien species. Like tequila, rock 'n' roll, money and naked women.

name: Borg Cube
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BORG CUBETASK: Explore galaxy for biological and technological distinctiveness. Assimilate.

name: Borg Scout Vessel
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BORG SCOUT VESSELTASK: Search for assimilation targets. Establish transwarp connections.

name: Borg Sphere
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BORG SPHERETASK: General purpose vessel. Provide contingency option when meeting resistance.

name: Queen's Borg Cube
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BORG CUBETASK: Assimilate human home world by direct attack, Earth date 2373. Borg Queen commands.

name: Queen's Borg Sphere
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BORG SPHERETASK: Contingency for Borg cube – Bombard Earth in the past; stop first contact. Borg Queen commands.

name: U.S.S. Bozeman
lore: Starship from the 23rd century. Registry number NCC-1941. Modernized to defend against Borg technology. Captained by Morgan Bateson.

name: U.S.S Enterprise-E
lore: Commissioned in 2372. Sixth starship in the Enterprise line. Optimized to battle the Borg. 700 meters long. Infiltratred by Borg in 2373.

name: Phoenix
lore: Earth's first faster-than-light-ship. Launched via a Titan missile. Commanded by Zefram Cochrane.

name: Vulcan Lander
lore: Tri-lateral symmetry. Entered the Sol system at 11 a.m. on April 5, 2063. Commanded by Solkar.

name: Montana Missile Complex
lore: 2063 Earth: Historic time of Earth's first warp flight and contact with extraterrestrials.
game_text: Plays on table. Seed Phoenix beneath this location from outside the game (any Zefram Cochrane may acquire it later); Borg player may download Stop First Contact. Once Phoenix has taken off or Vulcan Lander has landed here, nullifies Stop First Contact .Native to this timeline: Zefram Cochrane, Lily Sloane, Phoenix, Vulcan Lander, Solkar, Sevek, T'Shonra and Kathleen Tonell.

name: The Emissary
lore: Benjamin Sisko discovered the Celestial Temple in 2369. Reluctantly accepts Bajoran reverence.

name: The Traveler
lore: Tau Alpha C native able to transcend space. Phases out from exertion. Appeared to Wesley as Lakanta.

name: Abandon Ship!
game_text: If ship damaged or RANGE reduced, personnel not needed for staffing are placed with dilemma atop mission. Rescue (opponent may capture) personnel with different ship here.

name: Hippocratic Oath
lore: On Stardate 49066.5, rogue Jem'Hadar detained Julian Bashir on Bopak III. He was compelled to seek a cure to their genetically engineered addiction to the drug ketracel-white.

name: Make Us Go
lore: "We are Pakleds. We look for things... things to make us go. You are smart. Can you make our ship go? Do not try to trick us. We can tell."

name: Unscientific Method
lore: As part of his plan to steal the newly developed metaphasic shield technology, Jo'Bril sabotaged the initial testing, faked his own death and killed the inventor.

name: Treaty: Federation/Romulan/Klingon
lore: Three major Alpha Quadrant powers, in an uncharacteristic show of solidarity in 2373, focused their resources against the Dominion threat in a united stand at station Deep Space 9.

name: Husnock
lore: The sudden eradication of the entire Husnock race left its many outposts vacant. Various affiliations take advantage of these available facilities.
game_text: Seed at any Non-Aligned mission location. You may seed one Universal Husnock Ship face up here. Extends only 25% of its SHIELDS to ships.

name: Establish Relations
lore: Independent planet: Conduct negotiations to establish peaceful rapport and cultural exchange.
game_text: When you solve, download a Non-Aligned personnel here.

name: Impose Order
lore: Pre-unified world: Unify diverse nation-states via coercion and occupation.
game_text: *Unopposed OFFICER on planet may steal points.

name: Mineral Survey
lore: Planetoid: Survey planetoid with minimal atmosphere to determine value of mineral deposits.
game_text: When you solve, draw up to two cards.

name: Test Propulsion Systems
lore: Remote sector: Test upgrades to faster-than-light drive components.
game_text: Solving player's ships are RANGE +2. (Cumulative).

name: Hide and Seek
lore: "Why don't we play a little game? I'll hide.. you find me."

name: Alien Gambling Device
lore: Gaming device of unknown origin which alters the laws of probability. Martus Mazur replicated several of the devices for use in Club Martus. Many found the game irresistible.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. Once every turn, you may cause any one random selection at same or adjacent location to be canceled and re-selected. (Cumulative.)

name: Mysterious Orb
lore: In 2369, Jadzia Dax was transported from the Bajoran wormhole to Deep Space 9 by one of the objects Bajorans call "Tears of the Prophets."
game_text: May seed at a space location. Place in hand until played at any time to relocate any one personnel to anywhere in play, then discard artifact.

name: Orb Fragment
lore: Shard of a Bajoran orb from the Celestial Temple. The fragment was set in a bracelet and used by the Sirah to create and control the Dal'Rok.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. May keep Dal'Rok from killing at same location. Also, any player may play Dal'Rok from hand as an Event card at same mission. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Saltah'na Clock
lore: Benjamin Sisko constructed a clock while being affected by the energy matrix of Saltah'na telepathic spheres. The sphere were storing the energy of an ancient power struggle.
game_text: Place on ship or facility here (opponent's choice). Personnel aboard must initiate battle whenever possible (no leader is required and affiliation attack restrictions do not apply).

name: "Pup"
lore: An alien probe housing a playful software life-form exited the Bajoran wormhole in 2369. Miles O'Brien dubbed the program "Pup" after it disrupted computer systems to get attention.
game_text: Plays on ship. Disables RANGE until start of your next turn; then WEAPONS until start of your next turn; then SHIELDS; then repeats. Nullify with 4 Computer Skill OR any Miles.

name: "Subspace Seaweed"
lore: In 2370, a runabout piloted by Jadzia Dax collided with a protouniverse. The "subspace seaweed" lodged in the ship's warp nacelle until it was transferred to DS9's science lab.
game_text: Unless 3 Navigation aboard, place on ship. Reduces RANGE by 3 (cumulative). Your Transporter Skill may subsequently beam dilemma to your Science Lab at same location.

name: Altonian Brain Teaser
lore: To solve this holographic puzzle, its challenger must turn the multicolor sphere a solid hue using neural theta waves. The symbiont Dax tried unsuccessfully for over 140 years.
game_text: Most CUNNING personnel present is "stopped." If their CUNNING>15, bonus points score at this spaceline location do not count toward winning. Discard dilemma.

name: Angry Mob
lore: When Odo was under suspicion for murder, Bajoran nationals led by Zayra demanded that the changeling be handed over to them. Benjamin Sisko spared the constable from their "justice."
game_text: Kills a SECURITY or shape-shifter present (random selection) unless remaining Away Team has INTEGRITY>27 from up to four personnel present OR STRENGTH>50. Discard dilemma.

name: Aphasia Device
lore: Terrorist device developed by Dekon Elig and Surmak Ren to fight the Cardassian occupation. When activated, releases a deadly virus which interferes with language processing abilities.
game_text: Place on ship. Quarantined. Now and end of each turn, disables one personnel aboard (random selection). If all crew disabled, all die. Cure with 2 MEDICAL and 2 Biology.

name: Arms Deal
lore: In 2370, Quark was approached by Sakonna to arrange a covert arms deal to deliver weapons to the Maquis.
game_text: Unless Acquisition OR Vulcan with Treachery OR Smuggling OR Maquis personnel present, crew or Away Team "stopped". Discard dilemma.

name: Assassin's Blade
lore: The technological advances of the 24th century offer a wide variety of state-of-the-art weaponry. Nevertheless, some still prefer the simple charm of the assassin's blade.
game_text: Unless CUNNING>36 OR 2 SECURITY present, assassin kills one personnel present (opponent's choice) except a shape-shifter or android.

name: Brief Romance
lore: Jadzia Dax became romantically involved with Meridian native Deral. Dax was so enamored she attempted to follow Deral when Meridian returned to its non-corporeal state.
game_text: Opponent specifies "male" or "female." Place on one personnel present of that gender (random selection). That personnel is "stopped" until countdown expires.

name: Clan People
lore: In 2369, the U.S.S. Yangtzee Kiang crashed on a moon in the Gamma Quadrant. The crew members found themselves caught between enemy clans locked in a never-ending war.

name: Common Thief
lore: When Odo confronted a minor thief on the Deep Space 9 promenade, the cutthroat attempted to kill the constable.
game_text: If any equipment present, discard one (random selection). Otherwise, kills a personnel present (opponent's choice), who has STRENGTH+CUNNING<15. Discard dilemma.

name: Dal'Rok
lore: Terrifying energy creature created and manipulated using an Orb fragment. The controller of the Dal'Rok channels the fears of Bajoran villagers into a powerful destructive force.
game_text: Place on mission. Now and start of each turn, kills personnel with lowest total attributes at this location. May be nullified by INTEGRITY+CUNNING+STRENGTH>150 at this location.

name: DNA Clues
lore: Although a thorough analysis of DNA sample can be a time-consuming endeavor, it can also provide information crucial to successfully dealing with biochemical hazards.
game_text: Place on mission. Further dilemmas requiring any MEDICAL here require 2 more if you continue OR 2 less if crew or Away Team has Exobiology and "stops" now to investigate.

name: Duonetic Field Generator
lore: Device designed to interfere with electromagnetic radiation flow. Inhibits the use of transporter annular confinement beams and the electrical systems of most ships.
game_text: Place on planet. No beaming up or taking off from planet. Nullify with 3 ENGINEER OR Miracle Worker.

name: Extradition
lore: In 2370, Cardassian legal authorities coerced Miles O'Brien to lower his vessel's shields. They abducted him without explanation and forced him to stand trial on false charges.
game_text: If opponent's Law or Treachery here, up to four opponent's SECURITY personnel may beam to one of your ships here, capture a crew member of lower STRENGTH and/or beam off.

name: Flaxian Assassin
lore: Valued for their professionalism, Flaxian assassins are often employed by the Tal Shiar. Retaya was sent to eliminate Garak using a combinant poison disguised as perfumes.
game_text: Unless 2 SECURITY and Biology present, kills one personnel (two if opponent has Tal Shiar in play) with three or more Skill Dot icons (random selection).

name: Framed for Murder
lore: The convicted murderer Ibudan planted evidence implicating his prosecutor, Odo. To avoid a possible conflict of interest, Odo was relieved of duty during the investigation.
game_text: Place on a unique personnel present (opponent's choice). That personnel cannot use skills or staff ships. Nullify with any personnel who has CUNNING>9 and Biology OR Law.

name: Garak Has Some Issues
lore: Exposed to a psychotropic compound on Empok Nor, Elim Garak lost control. He hunted down and killed members of his away team because it seemed like "fun."
game_text: Place on ("stops") a personnel present (random selection). Start of each turn, they kill another personnel present with lower CUNNING (opponent's choice). Cure with 2 Exobiology.

name: Garanian Bolites
lore: As a prank, Jake Sisko and Nog released Garanian bolites in the Replimat. Though harmless, the bolites caused temporary pigmentation fluctuations and severe itching.
game_text: Two personnel (random selection) are "stopped" unless their combined CUNNING>15 OR Hypospray present. Mission continues.

name: Harvester Virus
lore: Nanobiogenic weapon used by both sides in the T'Lani-Kellerun war. Julian Bashir and Miles O'Brien developed a method for neutralizing the virus using muon frequencies.
game_text: Place on planet. End of every player's turn, one personnel on planet killed (random selection). Cure with 2 MEDICAL, Exobiology and Computer Skill.

name: Hate Crime
lore: Outraged by a crime on Deep Space 9, Bajorons defaced Odo's security office. The xenophobic vandals were quick to judge the "shifter" simply because he was different.
game_text: Place on a non-Borg personnel who is the only member of its species present (opponent's choice). That personnel may not use any of its skills.

name: Isolinear Puzzle
lore: Jake Sisko and Nog felt compelled to override the autopilot system of the U.S.S. Rio Grande. Unfortunately, they found it easier to take apart than to put back together.
game_text: Place on ship. Reduce RANGE by 4 and WEAPONS by 4. Nullify with 2 ENGINEER.

name: Kidnappers
lore: While vising Bajor, Kira Nerys was captured by the Alliance for Global Unity, also known as the Circle. The Alliance sought to overthrow the Bajoran provisional government.
game_text: Place on a female present (random selection). Until end of opponent's turn, she is "stopped" and may be captured by opponent's SECURITY present; then discard dilemma.

name: Lethean Telepathic Attack
lore: Altovar tried to steal biomimetic gel from the Deep Space 9 infirmary. When interrupted by Julian Bashir, he assaulted the doctor telepathically. Such attacks are usually fatal.
game_text: Unless 2 Empathy present, place on one personnel (Julian Bashir if present), otherwise random selection). Personnel is disabled (killed if CUNNING+STRENGTH<16).

name: Lockbox
lore: Quark's greed led him to critical evidence in a lockbox which ultimately solved a five-year-old murder case.
game_text: Unless Greed present, Away Team "stopped" (discard dilemma). Otherwise, score points if you solve mission this turn.

name: Misguided Activist
lore: Indoctrinated by Vedek Winn, Neela attempted to assassinate Vedek Bareil. She might have succeeded if not for the intervention of her superior officer, Miles O'Brien.
game_text: One V.I.P. or Command personnel present (random selection) is killed (only "stopped" if 2 SECURITY OR Miles O'Brien present). Mission continues.

name: No Loose Ends
lore: Seeking to purge all knowledge of the harvester virus, E'Tyshra captured Julian Bashir and Miles O'Brien. Keiko's persistence led to their rescue moments before they were to be killed.
game_text: Unless SCIENCE, OFFICER and Computer Skill OR Keiko O'Brien OR Resistance OR any Defense drone present, kills all MEDICAL and ENGINEER present.

name: None Shall Pass
lore: Some natives are highly suspicious of outsiders. The Ennis and Nol-Ennis rejected Benjamin Sisko's efforts to end their longstanding feud.
game_text: To get past requires STRENGTH>53 OR 3 Diplomacy OR 2 Anthropology OR Guramba.

name: Odo's "Cousin"
lore: In 2370, a Bajoran science probe revealed a life-form on L-S VI with DNA patterns similtar to those of Odo. Tests indicated that the entity had some shape-shifting properties.
game_text: To get past requires 2 Exobiology and Geology. If you overcome, one SCIENCE may stay behind ("stopped") to score points.

name: Punishment Box
lore: Correctional technique used on Orellius. Colonists who commit crimes are imprisoned in the box to suffer from heat and dehydration.
game_text: Place on planet. Now and start of each mission attempt here, cannot get past unless one OFFICER is "placed in the box" ("stopped") until end of turn.

name: Seismic Quake
lore: While on a scientific mission to planet L-S VI, Dr. Mora Pol's away team experienced a volcanic disturbance. The quake released noxious gases which cut short their research.
game_text: One Away Team member (random selection) is "stopped" if opponent score is odd, killed otherwise. Cannot get past (shuffle back into seed cards here) unless Geology present.

name: Skullduggery
lore: Quark was "encouraged" to help Rao Vantika commandeer a shipment of deuridium arriving at Deep Space 9.
game_text: One personnel present (random selection) is killed (only "stopped" if that personnel has Treachery OR Acquisition OR Greed OR Smuggling OR Integrity<5). Mission continues.

name: The Three Vipers
lore: A shattered comet created a danger to ships and the Bajoran wormhole. The three silithium-laden "vipers" had to be guided through the other side, fulfilling a Bajoran prophecy.
game_text: Ship damaged unless ENGINEER and 2 Navigation present. Even if not damaged, crew "stopped" unless SCIENCE, OFFICER and Astrophysics present. Discard dilemma.

name: Trauma
lore: Emotional trauma, such as the Prophets' first interrogation of The Sisko, can cause disability or even death. Others face the grim choice of lending aid or completing their mission.
game_text: Place on personnel present with the most icons (your choice if tie). That personnel is disabled. If you solve this mission before countdown expires, that personnel dies.

name: Untrustworthy Associate
lore: Pretending to be upset over Rom's departure from Deep Space 9, Quark disabled docking ring security sensors. His treachery allowed intruders to board and control the station.
game_text: Unless CUNNING>40, opponent places on any one ship or facility here. Opponent's cards may beam, dock and undock with ship or facility (as appropriate). Nullify with 4 SECURITY.

name: Vantika's Neural Pathways
lore: The dying criminal Rao Vantika used a microscopic generator to transfer his consciousness into Julian Bashir. Eventually Vantika's essence was beamed out of the possessed doctor.
game_text: Place on a non-changeling present (random selection). Loses skills, classification and INTEGRITY; gains Treachery x2. Cure at Infirmary site with MEDICAL and Transporter Skill.

name: Vendetta
lore: Grieving over the dead body of his brother Ro-Kel, Ah-Kel swore vengeance against the killer of his twin.
game_text: Unless Law present, place on one crew or Away Team member (opponent's choice). If that personnel dies, opponent scores points.

name: Vole Infestation
lore: If gone unchecked, Cardassian voles quickly multiply. Chewing through power conduits, the prolific rodents pose a serious and widespread threat to computer systems.
