game_text: Unless hand weapon OR ANIMAL OR Guard Drone present, place on ship. Disables special equipment; all attributes -2. To nullify, evacuate ship at your outpost until end of turn.

name: Airlock
game_text: Plays on a ship (with at least one staffing icon), outpost or docking site. Once each turn, any personnel present who has Computer Skill and either Treachery or Greed may target one opposing personnel (or Rogue Borg ) present of lower STRENGTH or CUNNING. Target is "tossed out the airlock" (Borg, Rogue Borg and androids float in space until beamed; others die). Target's owner may counter-attack next turn.

name: Bajoran Wormhole
game_text: Requires two Bajoran Wormhole cards; each inserts into a spaceline to create a location (span 1). Play one in Alpha Quadrant (Bajor Region); download the other to Gamma Quadrant. Limit one per quadrant. While in play, any ship may move from one end to the other, then is "stopped." OR Plays at any time to nullify any card which is closing or destroying Bajoran Wormhole (discard doorway).

name: Secret Compartment
game_text: Plays on a ship or facility. (Unique). If it is controlled by opponent and your Acquisition is present, you may probe: Interrupt, Doorway : Alarm. Opponent may capture one of your personnel present (random selection); discard doorway. Event, Equipment : Success. Download to here up to two Equipment cards or one "use as Equipment card" artifact (as if earned from a mission attempt); discard doorway.

name: Bajoran PADD
lore: Standard Bajoran Personal Access Display Device for computerized information.
game_text: Bajoran use only. Each of your personnel present is CUNNING +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Bajoran Phaser
lore: Standard-issue phased energy weapon of the Bajoran Militia. Provides firepower equivalent to that of the Starfleet Type II Phaser.
game_text: Bajoran and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Bajoran Phaser Rifle
lore: Enhanced energy rifle used by the Bajoran Militia. Popular among members of the resistance during the Cardassian occupation of Bajor.
game_text: Bajoran and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +3, but loses 1 Diplomacy unless aboard your ship. (Cumulative.)

name: Cardassian Disruptor
lore: Phase-disruption weapon used by Cardassian military and civilian personnel.
game_text: Cardassian and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Cardassian Disruptor Rifle
lore: Rifle version of the Cardassian phase disruptor. Has a 4.7 megajoule power capacity, 3 millisecond recharge and two beam settings.
game_text: Cardassian and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +3, but loses 1 Diplomacy unless aboard your ship. (Cumulative.)

name: Cardassian PADD
lore: Standard Cardassian Personal Access Display Device for computerized information.
game_text: Cardassian use only. Each of your personnel present is CUNNING +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Engineering Tricorder
lore: Representative of specialized tricorders optimized for engineering use. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Gives all of your MEDICAL-classification personnel the extra skill of ENGINEER where present.

name: Hypospray
lore: Uses an aerosuspension delivery system to administer subcutaneous or intramuscular medication. Can also be used to sedate an adversary.

name: Medical PADD
lore: Representative of Personal Access Display Devices designed specifically to facilitate medical diagnosis. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Gives all of your ENGINEER-classification personnel the extra skill of MEDICAL where present.

name: Science Kit
lore: Representative of specialized scientific analytical apparatus. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Gives all of your OFFICER-classification personnel the extra skill of SCIENCE where present.

name: Science PADD
lore: Representative of Personal Access Display Devices designed specifically for scientific analysis functions. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Gives all of your MEDICAL-classification personnel the extra skill of SCIENCE where present.

name: Automated Security System
lore: A hidden security subroutine on Deep Space 9 triggered an old Cardassian counterinsurgency program. It was designed to quell any uprising of non-Cardassian workers.
game_text: Plays on Ops. End of every turn, targets one personnel present (random selection). That personnel is killed unless its species is Cardassian. May be nullified by 3 ENGINEER.

name: Bajoran Civil War
lore: The xenophobic Alliance for Global Unity attempted to overthrow the Bajoran provisional government in 2370.
game_text: Plays on table. Your Bajoran leaders may initiate battle against other Bajorans. OR Downloads two Universal Bajoran OFFICER, SECURITY or Resistance personnel. Discard event.

name: Computer Crash
lore: Rao Vantika accessed the Deep Space 9 computer system through a temperature control panel. He sabotaged the data network by purging everything in active memory.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. No player may play a Q's Tent doorway, download any card or play any card that requires downloading. Discard event at end of your next turn.

name: Defiant Dedication Plaque
lore: Commemorative inscription mounted on the bridge of the U.S.S. Defiant. Serves as an inspiration to the Defiant crew.
game_text: Plays on table. Each of your ships with its matching commander aboard is RANGE +2, or +3 if ship is Defiant class. (Not cumulative. Captain's Order.)

name: Duranja
lore: Ceremonial Bajoran lamp lit in memory of a recently deceased loved one. The ornate candle burns continually, entreating the Prophets to guide the dead to the afterlife.
game_text: "Guides" your Bajoran who died on your previous turn from discard pile to point area (worth points equal to INTEGRITY; "in play" for uniqueness only. Discard event.

name: Espionage: Bajoran on Cardassian
lore: Bajorans have investigated Cardassian activities before, during and after the 30-year occupation. In 2371, Odo contacted an old Cardassian acquaintance to investigate the Obsidian Order.

name: Espionage: Cardassian on Bajoran
lore: Since withdrawing from Bajor in 2369, Cardassians have kept a watchful eye on Bajoran activities.

name: Espionage: Cardassian on Federation
lore: Cardassian spies are masters of undercover operations. In 2371, Miles O'Brien was framed by a surgically altered Cardassian posing as retired Starfleet officer Raymond Boone.

name: Espionage: Cardassian on Klingon
lore: Cardassians have long been suspicious of the Klingon Empire. The unprovoked Klingon invasion of 2372 demonstrated the need to step up the Union's intelligence-gathering activities.

name: Espionage: Romulan on Bajoran
lore: Romulan spies are still everywhere.

name: Espionage: Romulan on Cardassian
lore: Romulan infiltration of Cardassian facilities has gone largely undetected for decades.

name: Establish Landing Protocols
lore: Diligent adherence to landing procedures is crucial to the successful operation of runabouts, shuttles and other small spacecraft. (sic)
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Each of your ships which has no staffing requirements may use 1 RANGE to land or take off once each turn. (Captain's Order.)

name: HQ: War Room
lore: During the Bajoran civil war of 2370, General Krim charted troop movements for the Bajoran Militia from his fortified map room.
game_text: Plays on a homeworld. Your OFFICER, SECURITY, Leadership and Resistance personnel of same affiliation as that homeworld are CUNNING+2 and STRENGTH +2.

name: Reaction Control Thrusters
lore: In 2369, thrusters and subspace field technology were used to relocated Deep Space 9 near the Bajoran wormhole. This move guarded Bajor's claim to the Celestial Temple.
game_text: Plays for free to move your space facility, if your 2 ENGINEER aboard, to an adjacent location in same region OR plays to add 2 to each of your ships' RANGE this turn. Discard event.

name: Recruit Mercenaries
lore: Quark hired mercenaries in 2369 to help Rao Vantika steal a deuridium shipment. Individuals of questionable character are easily found for this kind of illegal operation.
game_text: Downloads Non-Aligned and/or Ferengi Treachery personnel with up to 7 total Skill Dot icons to where you have Treachery present. "Pay" them (lose points).

name: Renewal Scroll
lore: During the Bajoran Gratitude Festival, participants inscribe their troubles on small scrolls. Burning the renewal scrolls in a special brazier symbiolically turns their problems into ash.
game_text: Plays if you have three or more Bajorans in play. "Burn" (discard from hand) any number of cards and "renew" (draw) an equal amount, plus two more. Discard event.

name: System 5 Disruptors
lore: The Groumall was jury-rigged with large planetary disruptors salvaged from the destroyed outpost on Korma. The upgrade required emptying the cargo bay, which cost Dukat his profits.
game_text: Plays on your freighter, transport or merchant vessel. Ship is WEAPONS +4, but is SHIELDS -1 and no longer qualifies as a freighter, transport or merchant vessel.

name: Treaty: Bajoran/Klingon
lore: The Klingon Empire established a permanent military presence on the Bajoran station Deep Space 9 when Chancellor Gowron reinstated the Khitomer Accords in 2373.
game_text: Plays on table (for free if you have Chancellor Gowron in play). Your Bajoran and Klingon affiliations recognize this treaty. They can now mix and cooperate.

name: Treaty: Federation/Bajoran
lore: In 2369, the Bajoran provisional government applied for Federation membership. That same year, Bajor invited Starfleet to administer the recently acquired space station Terok Nor.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Federation and Bajoran affiliations recognize this treaty. They can now mix and cooperate.

name: Treaty: Federation/Cardassian
lore: The Federation and the Cardassian Union concluded three years of negotiation in 2370. The resulting treaty brought an end to hostilities and established the Demilitarized Zone.
game_text: Plays on table. Your Federation and Cardassian affiliations recognize this treaty. They can now mix and cooperate. (May be seeded if you have Klaestron outpost in play.)

name: Treaty: Romulan/Cardassian
lore: Responding to the Dominion threat, Romulans and Cardassians became secret allies in 2371 and assembled a joint Tal Shiar/Obsidian Order strike force in the Orias system.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Romulan and Cardassian affiliations recognize this treaty. They can now mix and cooperate.

name: Weapons Locker
lore: Arms storage compartment used aboard a space station or starship. Accessible only with the proper authorization codes.
game_text: Plays on Ops, Security Office, Cargo Bay or any ship. If your personnel present are unopposed, your hand weapons may report there (for free if at a site).

name: Bajoran Outpost
lore: The Bajoran homeworld is Bajor. The Bajorans establish outposts throughout their territory.

name: Chamber of Ministers
lore: Legislative body of Bajoran provisional government. Established following Cardassian withdrawal in 2369.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Bajor . A Nor may coexist here. Once per turn, one Bajoran Minister, Vedek or Kai OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Cardassian Outpost
lore: Cardassia Prime is the homeworld of the Cardassians. The Cardassian Union establishes outposts throughout its territory.

name: Central Command
lore: The Central Command controls every Cardassian ship, outpost and space station from its great War Room.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Cardassia Prime. Once per turn, one Cardassian Gul or Legate OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Nor
lore: Ore mining and processing station representative of facilities throughout the Cardassian territory.
game_text: Seeds or plays at any Cardassian mission location (except a Bajor Region location).

name: Terok Nor
lore: Mining station in Bajoran system. Operated by Cardassians using Bajorans in forced-labor conditions.

name: Klaestron Outpost
lore: Klaestron IV is a member of the United Federation of Planets. Its inhabitants also maintain a strong alliance with the Cardassian Union.

name: Activate Tractor Beam
lore: "Tractor beam" is the common term for the focused linear graviton force beam installed on most starships.
game_text: Plays on your ship with Tractor Beam; it may tow any ship present which is yours or is empty. OR Plays on your outpost or ship; adds Tractor Beam (but may not carry ships aboard).

name: Baseball
lore: Benjamin Sisko was forced to abandon Deep Space 9 to spare Bajor from the Dominion's wrath. He left his prized baseball behind as a message to Gul Dukat that he would return.
game_text: Plays to score points if you just commandeered opponent's facility. Lose points if opponent regains control.

name: Docking Procedures
lore: While comprehensive docking procedures are crucial for safeguarding life and property, proceeding "by the book" can also cause delays.
game_text: Plays on any ship just as it begins to dock or undock at any facility. Ship and crew are "stopped." Docking or undocking complete at end of turn.

name: Dropping In
lore: Ships and facilities are vulnerable to unwanted guests when their shields are lowered.
game_text: Plays if any SHIELDS are less than 4 or were just lowered for beaming. Your Transporter Skill may beam your cards through those SHIELDS. OR Nullifies your Dead End.

name: Extraordinary Methods
lore: Using unorthodox procedures, Julian Bashir was able to briefly prolong the life of Vedek Bareil. The process allowed Bareil to complete critical negotiations.
game_text: If 3 MEDICAL OR MEDICAL and Cybernetics present, plays on one of your personnel just selected to die. Death is delayed until end of your next turn.

name: Going to the Top
lore: Kira Nerys went directly to Admiral Rollman when she disagreed with one of Benjamin Sisko's command decisions. Sisko and Rollman were not exactly pleased with her action.

name: Hidden Fighter
lore: The resistance concealed small spacecraft throughout the Bajor system during the occupation. A decade later, Kira Nerys and Jadzia Dax recovered one from the abandoned Lunar V base.
game_text: Downloads one ship with no staffing requirements to your Away Team on a planet. (You may also download Establish Landing Protocols or Engage Shuttle Operations.)

name: Incoming Message - Bajoran
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals, amplified by networks of relay stations.

name: Incoming Message - Cardassian
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals amplified by networks of relay stations.

name: Magnetic North
lore: Miles O'Brien used the polar magnetic field of Parada IV to shield his runabout from the sensors of pursuing ships.
game_text: Plays on your ship that has no staffing requirements if it is orbiting a planet. Prevents battles from being initiated against that ship. Discard interrupt when ship moves.

name: Oof!
lore: Surprised by Benjamin Sisko's rather unconventional response to Q's antagonism, the allegedly omnipotent being protested, "You hit me! Picard never hit me!"

name: Orb Experience
lore: In 2369, Benjamin Sisko encountered the Orb of Prophecy and Change. This contact caused him to experience a flashback to his first meeting with his wife-to-be, Jennifer.

name: Preparation
lore: Mission briefings with senior staff are important for information and planning. Lack of preparation can be costly in some instances.

name: Protouniverse
lore: An unknown anomaly brought from the Gamma Quadrant was actually a protouniverse in its early stages. Its growth would have destroyed DS9 had it not been returned to space.
game_text: Plays on "Subspace Seaweed"; ship or facility destroyed when countdown expires. Nullify with Astrophysics, SCIENCE and 2 ENGINEER aboard, but ship or facility damaged.

name: Reclamation
lore: Cardassians sabotaged much of Terok Nor during their evacuation. The new Federation and Bajoran occupants salvaged and repaired what they could.
game_text: Plays to take into hand from your discard pile up to two Equipment or Site cards OR one previously earned "use as Equipment card" artifact (for re-use).

name: Smoke Bomb
lore: Small, hand-held device used to create a diversion in combat situations. Used by Deep Space 9 personnel during battle against occupying forces from the Circle.
game_text: Plays at start of personnel battle; any or all of your non-Borg personnel may hide from that battle. OR Plays to "stop" one crew or Away Team where you have personnel present.

name: The Walls Have Ears
lore: Deep Space 9 was besieged by the Alliance for Global Unity in 2370. Odo used his shape-shifting abilities to monitor the intruders' activities and report back to Commander Sisko.
game_text: Once each turn, plays on opponent's occupied ship or facility. Report a changeling there OR score points if you have an intruder aboard.

name: Time to Reconsider
lore: Gul Jasad paused for a moment on the brink of an assault against Deep Space 9. He eventually called off the attack and withdrew his ships.
game_text: Plays to "stop" your ship and crew. Prevents opponents (unless playing Borg) from initiating a counter-attack this turn at that location.

name: Unnatural Causes
lore: A murder in the holosuite puzzled Deep Space 9 authorities. How could someone have entered the room to commit the crime without leaving a trace?
game_text: Plays on any crew or Away Team if one of its members was just killed other than in battle. One personnel present (random selection) is "stopped" to investigate.

name: Wormhole Navigation Schematic
lore: The Bajoran wormhole is the only one known to be stable. One terminus is in the Alpha Quadrant near Bajor; the other, in the Gamma Quadrant near the Idran system.
game_text: Allows your ship with SCIENCE and Navigation aboard to travel through Bajoran Wormhole without being "stopped." (Immune to Amanda Rogers.) OR Nullifies The Three Vipers.

name: Access Relay Station
lore: Callinon VII: Analyze automated subspace relay station for information on the Dominion.

name: Acquire Illicit Explosives
lore: Bajor Region ● Bajor System: Purchase bilitrium from Klingon outposts for delivery to Bajoran insurgents.

name: Aid Fugitives
lore: Bopak III: Search for cure to Jem'Hadar addiction to ketracel-white.
game_text: Hippocratic Oath relocates here from any quadrant.

name: Alter Records
lore: Bajor Region ● Bajor: Create false documents on Bajoran homeworld pertaining to Cardassian occupation.

name: Camping Trip
lore: Forested planet: Escort students for botany experiment on presumably uninhabited world.
game_text: Gamma Quadrant Vorta and Jem'Hadar may report here.

name: Changeling Research
lore: L-S VI: Investigate possible changeling life signs on highly volcanic planet.
game_text: Each Seismic Quake here affects two personnel.

name: Characterize Neutrino Emissions
lore: Bajor Region ● Denorios Belt: Study and catalog neutrino discharge from charged plasma field.
game_text: Any number of Orb artifacts may seed here.

name: Colony Preparations
lore: Suitable planet: Survey uninhabited class-M world for possible colonization.
game_text: When you solve, may download Colony here.

name: Cure Blight
lore: Boranis III: Develop vaccine for Teplan Blight deliberately introduced here by the Dominion.
game_text: * +5 if MEDICAL-related Equipment card present.

name: Deliver Supplies
lore: Dreon VII: Take provisions and equipment to settlers.

name: Eliminate Virus
lore: T'Lani III: Return to analyze and destroy last traces of deadly nanobiogenic weapon accidentally re-released.
game_text: * Points do not count when Harvester Virus in play.

name: Establish Station
lore: Amleth Prime: Build remote station on this planet located in a cloak-disrupting emission nebula.
game_text: Cloaking Device s do not function here.

name: Intercept Maquis
lore: Demilitarized Zone Region ● Near Bryma: Prevent attack on secret Cardassian weapons depot.
game_text: May attempt only if your total WEAPONS>14 here.

name: Intercept Renegade
lore: Orias System: Intercept hijacked Starfleet vessel reportedly attacking facilities in Cardassian space.

name: Investigate Rumors
lore: Chamra Vortex: Search nebula for clues to origin of changelings.

name: Kressari Rendezvous
lore: Cardassia Region ● Near Cardassia: Complete covert weapons transfer to agents supplying the Circle.
game_text: * Discard up to four hand weapons for +5 each.

name: Orb Negotiations
lore: Cardassia Region ● Cardassia Prime: Negotiate for return of stolen Orbs still on Cardassian homeworld.
game_text: Any number of Orb artifacts may seed here.

name: Refuse Immigration
lore: Bajor Region ● Near Bajor: Prevent Skrreean refugee vessel from landing on Bajor.

name: Reignite Dead Star
lore: Epsilon 119: Use protomatter to re-initiate fusion process of this dead stellar core.

name: Relocate Settlers
lore: Bajor Region ● Jeraddo: Relocate settlers before moon becomes uninhabitable due to core tapping project.

name: Rescue Prisoners
lore: Cardassia Region ● Cardassia IV: Free Bajoran prisoners held secretly at Hutet labor camp.
game_text: May seed Universal Bajoran personnel under here.

name: Search and Rescue
lore: Badlands Region ● Class-M Planetoid: Search for officer kidnapped from Deep Space 9 by Maquis.

name: Search for Survivors
lore: Dozaria: Investigate possible crash location of Cardassian prisoner transport Ravinak.
game_text: May seed Universal Cardassian and Universal Bajoran under here.

name: Study Badlands
lore: Badlands Region ● Plasma Storms: Chart region of intense plasma activity.

name: Study Plasma Storm
lore: Plasma storm: Observe violent disturbance and compensate for disruption of computer operations.
game_text: Computer Skill required to use any equipment here.

name: Survey Star System
lore: Planetary system: Scan uncharted system for inhabited, habitable and resource-rich worlds.

name: Symbiont Diagnosis
lore: Trill: Identify treatment options for ailing Trill host and assess status of symbiont.

name: Verify Evidence
lore: Badlands Region ● Rendezvous point: Substantiate report of information broker working here.

name: Establish Tractor Lock
game_text: Plays on your Nor with Tractor Beam and your personnel unopposed in Ops OR on your staffed ship with Tractor Beam. Immediately target another ship at same location. That ship may not move or initiate battle. You may discard objective at any time. You must discard objective if your ship or Nor moves, battles or has SHIELDS < target's RANGE.

name: Explore Gamma Quadrant
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. At any time, place on your ship docked at a facility in the Alpha Quadrant. If ship's crew or Away Team solves a Gamma Quadrant mission, then ship returns and docks at that facility, draw three cards and score points. (discard objective).

name: File Mission Report
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. When one of your personnel has used a classification or skill to meet a mission requirement, and you have not yet attempted another mission, that personnel may "file a mission report" if unopposed at a site which allows this. Score points (discard objective). Limit one per mission.

name: HQ: Return Orb to Bajor
game_text: Plays on your Orb personnel. Where present, that personnel may earn Orb artifacts just encountered and may "reclaim" (steal) any Orb artifacts in play. If that personnel is on Bajor with Orb artifacts present, draw up to three cards for each one, discard objective and score points. (Each artifact may be "returned" only once per game.)

name: HQ: Secure Homeworld
game_text: Seeds or plays on a homeworld. Your Away Teams which include a personnel who matches homeworld's affiliation may attempt the mission using these requirements: Leadership x2 + SECURITY + (Honor OR Treachery) + any one attribute total > point value of mission When you solve mission, capture all opposing personnel on planet who do not match affiliation of homeworld.

name: Plans of the Obsidian Order
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Wherever you have an Obsidian Order personnel in play, your Cardassian espionage cards play at any time (for free) and may not be nullified. Also, once each turn, you may discard one of your Cardassian espionage cards from hand or table, then draw one card. At any time you may discard this objective from table to download one Cardassian espionage card.

name: Plans of the Tal Shiar
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Wherever you have a Tal Shiar personnel in play, your Romulan espionage cards play at any time (for free) and may not be nullified. Also, once each turn, you may discard one of your Romulan espionage card from hand or table, then draw one card. At any time you may discard this objective from table to download one Romulan espionage card.

name: Process Ore
game_text: Plays on an Ore Processing Unit. Start of each turn, if you control this Nor at a planet location and you have a matching ENGINEER or SECURITY personnel unopposed here, you may "process ore." Discard one card from hand, place bottom card of discard pile beneath draw deck or out-of-play, then draw up to two cards.

name: Rescue Personnel
game_text: Plays on your ship docked at a facility in the Alpha Quadrant. Target your Away Team on a planet which is either in a different quadrant or at a time location. If ship travels there, beams up Away Team and returns to facility, draw one card per personnel "rescued" (up to 5) and score points (discard objective). Limit one such "rescue" per location. (Unique).

name: Anara
lore: Representative of Bajoran engineering apprentices serving on Deep Space 9. Assisted Miles O'Brien with computer "pup" in 2369.

name: Bareil Antos
lore: Vedek. Follows springball religiously. Romantically involved with Kira Nerys. Began spiritual service as a gardener; still tending the grounds.

name: Colonel Day
lore: Member of Bajoran Militia and the Circle. Participated in DS9 siege of 2370. Deceived General Krim, under orders from Jaro Essa. Tried to kill Benjamin Sisko.

name: General Krim
lore: High-ranking Bajoran Militia leader. Member of the Circle. Took over Deep Space 9 in 2370, but returned the station when informed of Cardassian involvement.

name: Jabara
lore: Bajoran nurse representative of medical assistants on Deep Space 9. Helped Dr. Julian Bashir extend the life of Bareil Antos in 2371.

name: Jaro Essa
lore: Ambitious member of Chamber of Ministers. Leader of Alliance for Global Unity, a.k.a. the Circle. Minister Jaro was allied with Vedek Winn until exposed as a traitor.

name: Kai Opaka
lore: Revered Kai of Bajor. Lost her son in the Kendra Valley Massacre. First recognized Benjamin Sisko as the Emissary of the Prophets.

name: Kallis Ven
lore: One of the Bajoran deputies serving on Deep Space 9. During Cardassian occupation, helped chart Badlands and served as pilot on raids against Cardassian forces.

name: Kira Nerys
lore: Outspoken Major in Bajoran Militia. Assigned as first officer of Deep Space 9. Former member of Shakaar resistance cell. Romantically involved with Odo.

name: Lenaris Holem
lore: Colonel. Former member of Ornathia resistance cell. Part of historic Pullock V raid. Grateful to Shakaar for liberating his brother from Gallitep prison camp.

name: Li Nalas
lore: Hero of the Bajoran resistance. Cardassian prisoner at Hutet labor camp. Temporary first officer of Deep Space 9. Titled Navarch by provisional government.

name: Minister Rozahn
lore: Typical member of the Chamber of Ministers. Has background in the sciences. Led Bajoran delegates in talks with Skrreean refugees.

name: Mora Pol
lore: Member of Bajoran Institute of Science. Odo's foster father. Dr. Mora encouraged Odo to adopt humanoid form. Reconciled with his estranged "son" in 2373.

name: Nalan Bal
lore: Astrophysicist. Characteristic of Bajoran scientists now free of Cardassian rule. Had a brief encounter with Jem'Hadar on Deep Space 9 in 2371.

name: Neela
lore: Religious activist. Assassin. Sabotaged systems and planted a bomb on Deep Space 9 in 2369. Believed she was following the will of the Prophets.

name: Odo
lore: Changeling security chief of Deep Space 9. Not very good at pretense. Always investigates Quark.

name: Pallra
lore: Resident of Terok Nor during Cardassian occupation of Bajor. Wife of collaborator. Extortionist. Hired Quark to steal hidden list of other collaborators.

name: Prylar Mond
lore: Representative of Bajoran prylars. Interested in science. Escorted Benjamin Sisko to see Kai Opaka in 2369.

name: Rano Dake
lore: Characteristic of young, eager Bajorans serving on Deep Space 9. Assigned to security detachment under command of Odo.

name: Rase Norvan
lore: Representative of Bajorans entering science and medical studies after the Cardassian occupation. Serves in the infirmary on Deep Space 9.

name: Razka Karn
lore: Ex-resistance fighter pilot. Down on his luck. Deals in scrap metal. Sometime smuggler. Enjoys listening to classical Bajoran music such as Varani.

name: Rinnak Pire
lore: Captain of a Bajoran transport that docked at Deep Space 9 in 2369. Commanded all manner of Bajoran vessels during his long and successful career.

name: Surmak Ren
lore: Chief administrator of Ilvian Medical Complex. Former Bajoran resistance member. Helped develop an aphasia virus which years later would infect Deep Space 9.

name: Tahna Los
lore: Member of Kohn-Ma terrorist group. Wanted for crimes against the Cardassian people. Tried to collapse the entrance to the Bajoran wormhole in 2369.

name: Trazko
lore: Hireling used by Pallra during her extortion plan. Assassin. Recovered secret list of collaborators. Attempted to kill Quark - twice.

name: Varis Sul
lore: Orphan of parents killed by Cardassians. Succeeded her father as tetrach of the Paqu. Compromised with rival village of Navot. Friend of Jake Sisko and Nog.

name: Vedek Sorad
lore: Bajoran Vedek. Typical member of Vedek Assembly. Accompanied Minister Rozahn to Deep Space 9 in 2370 to deny Skrreean request to settle on Bajor.

name: Vedek Winn
lore: Religious leader who protested scientific teachings of Bajoran wormhole origins. Orchestrated assassination attempt on Bareil. Aspires to be Kai - by any means.

name: Weld Ram
lore: Typical of Bajorans studying the geosciences. Part of Dr. Mora Pol's research mission to L-S VI in 2370.

name: Ari
lore: Dissident. Typical member of Cardassian underground. Loyal to Ghemor. Helped Kira Nerys escape Obsidian Order in 2371. Has hopes for a better Cardassia.

name: Boheeka
lore: Glinn. Cardassian biotechnology expert. Jeopardized his career when he was bribed by Quark to order a classified cranial implant for Elim Garak.

name: Borad
lore: Male trained in science and exoarchaeology. Studied the effects of stolen Bajoran Orbs on the Cardassian nervous system. Had an unpleasant Orb experience.

name: Dakol
lore: Representative of Cardassian military security guards. Glinn assigned to guard prisoners at Hutet labor camp. Wanted to be initially involved with Major Kira.

name: Danar
lore: Gul. Commander of the Galor-class warship Aldara. Pursued the Bajoran terrorist Tahna Los in 2369. Enjoys vole fights.

name: Derell
lore: Representative of Cardassian medical personnel. Assigned to Terok Nor infirmary in 2358. Frequent patron of Quark's bar prior to the 2369 evacuation.

name: Dukat
lore: Gul. Ex-prefect of Bajor. Commander of the Prakesh. Father of Ziyal. Cardassian Union liaison with Dominion. Desires to regain control of Terok Nor.

name: Elim Garak
lore: Former member of Obsidian Order. Exiled to Terok Nor in 2368. Maintains some contact with Cardassian intelligence. Distrusts Dukat. Son of Enabran Tain.

name: Enabran Tain
lore: Estranged father of Elim Garak. Former head of the Obsidian Order. Led covert Obsidian Order/Tal Shiar raid on the Founders' homeworld.

name: Entek
lore: Trains Obsidian Order operatives. Enemy of Ghemor. Had Kira Nerys surgically altered to appear Cardassian in 2371. Rather liked by Garak.

name: Ghoren
lore: Male Cardassian characteristic of medical personnel in military service. Treated survivors of Klingon attack on Cardassia Prime in 2372.

name: Gilora Rejal
lore: Cardassian Ministry of Science member. Worked on the 2371 subspace relay project. Mistook Miles O'Brien's irritation with her as a Cardassian mating ritual.

name: Hogue
lore: Student of Natima Lang. Dissident. Member of Cardassian underground sentenced to death by Central Command. Sought refuge at Deep Space 9.

name: Jasad
lore: Representative Gul in the Seventh Order. In 2369, unsuccessfully attempted to reclaim Deep Space 9 for the Cardassian Union.

name: Jural
lore: Typical Cardassian officer. Proud, dedicated and constantly seeking to advance his rank. Posted to Cardassian Central Command in 2370.

name: Korinas
lore: High-ranking female intelligence operative. Often assigned by the Obsidian Order to keep a close watch on the Central Command.

name: Kotran Pa'Dar
lore: Powerful civilian leader. Former exarch of Cardassian settlement on Bajor. Believed his son Rugal was killed in 2362 terrorist attack.

name: Kovat
lore: One of the finest public conservator on Cardassia. Assigned to defend Miles O'Brien. Deeply disturbed when he "won" the case and O'Brien was freed.

name: Makbar
lore: Chief archon in Cardassian Judiciary. Presided over trial of Miles O'Brien. Outraged when human intervention forced her to acquit him. Tried to resist the Dominion.

name: Natima Lang
lore: Professor of Political Ethics. Dissident. Romantically involved with Quark. Member of Cardassian underground. Likes Samarian Sunsets.

name: Parn
lore: Legate. Member of Central Command. Tried to conceal Cardassian effort to supply weapons to Demilitarized Zone colonists in 2370.

name: Perak
lore: Characteristic of Cardassian security personnel. Helped provide protection for Detapa Council prior to its 2372 evacuation from Cardassia Prime.

name: Plain, Simple Garak
lore: Tailor. Merchant. Elim Garak is suspected of being a spy by his friend Julian Bashir. Raises Edosian orchids as a hobby. Haggled with the Sisters of Duras.

name: Rekelen
lore: Young dissident. Forced to flee Cardassia with Natima Lang and Hogue because of her political views. Member of Cardassian underground.

name: Tekeny Ghemor
lore: Legate. Exposed his status as a dissident to protect Kira Nerys. Has Yarim Fel syndrome. Knows more about the Cardassian government than anyone alive.

name: Toran
lore: Gul. Sent to Deep Space 9 to kill Natima Lang and other dissidents. Political enemy of Garak.

name: Turrel
lore: Legate. Politician and diplomat. Negotiated historic 2371 treaty between Cardassia Prime and Bajor with Bareil Antos and Kai Winn.

name: Ulani Belor
lore: Representative of Cardassian scientists. Member of Ministry of Science. Worked on subspace radio relay project in 2371 with her associate, Gilora Rejal.

name: Tora Ziyal
lore: Half-Bajoran daughter of Tora Naprem and Dukat. Survived crash of the Ravinok on Dozaria. Rescued in 2372. Talented artist. Fond of Elim Garak.

name: Benjamin Sisko
lore: Captain Benjamin Sisko commands Deep Space 9. Fought in Federation-Tzenkethi war. Helped design U.S.S. Defiant. Father of Jake. Loves baseball.

name: Graham Davis
lore: Representative of Starfleet engineers stationed aboard Deep Space 9. Assisted Miles O'Brien during repair and retrofit of the station.

name: Jace Michaels
lore: Representative of first officer serving in Starfleet. Assigned to the U.S.S. Odyssey. Courageously fought against the Jem'Hadar in 2370.

name: Jadzia Dax
lore: Lt. Commander Jadzia Dax is the eighth Trill host of the Dax symbiont. Underwent zhian'tara closure rite in 2371. Level 3 pilot. Married to Worf. Likes tongo.

name: Julian Bashir
lore: Lt. Julian Bashir. Genetically enhanced. Salutatorian at Starfleet Medical. Requested assignment to DS9 so he could practice "frontier medicine." Likes tennis.

name: Karen Loews
lore: Starfleet psychiatrist representative of Federation medical personnel. Came to Deep Space 9 in 2374 with a group of genetically engineered misfits.

name: Lojal
lore: Ambassador Lojal is typical of Vulcans dispatched to represent the Federation. Agreed to recommended Julian Bashir for a commendation in 2369.

name: Orren Ran
lore: Male representative of Klaestron engineers. Associate of Ilon Tandro. Aided in attempted kidnapping of Jadzia Dax in 2369.

name: Paxton Reese
lore: Stellar cartographer characteristic of Starfleet science personnel. Served aboard Deep Space 9 in 2372. Studied effects of the wormhole on the Denorios Belt.

name: T'Lor
lore: Male geologist from Tiburon. Typical of science personnel stationed aboard Deep Space 9. Guarded a Jem'Hadar warship salvaged in Gamma Quadrant.

name: Taylor Moore
lore: Typical of Federation security specialists serving aboard Deep Space 9. Had an encounter with an alien entity personifying Rumpelstiltskin. Likes dabo.

name: Jake and Nog
lore: Jake Sisko and Nog are best friends. Loiterers. Frequently chased away from "their spot" by Odo. Briefly owned 100 gross of self-sealing stem bolts.

name: Bo'rak
lore: Operative sent to Deep Space 9 in 2371 to spy on Romulan delegates. Modified a replicator to beam a surveillance device near the Romulans' quarters.

name: D'Ghor
lore: Crafty but dishonored head of wealthy Klingon House. Tried to acquire the assets of the House of Kozak – using money. Former member of High Council.

name: Grilka
lore: Klingon female. Leader of her own House due to special dispensation granted by Chancellor Gowron. Briefly married to Quark, Son of Keldar.

name: Morka
lore: Klingon agent sent by the High Council to keep Ruwon and Karina under surveillance. Accused Odo of insulting his honor. Threatened retribution.

name: T'Kar
lore: Klingon mercenary used by Verad. Helped capture Jadzia in an attempt to steal the Dax symbiont.

name: Yeto
lore: Particularly brusque Klingon who aided Verad's takeover of Deep Space 9 in 2370. Immobilized Odo in a containment device.

name: Altovar
lore: Lethean male. Attempted to steal biomimetic gel from Deep Space 9 infirmary in 2371. Attacked Julian Bashir, causing telepathically induced coma.

name: Amaros
lore: Maquis terrorist. Cal Hudson's co-pilot. Helped abduct Gul Dukat, blaming him for supplying illegal weapons to Cardassians in the Demilitarized Zone.

name: Coutu
lore: Male from Parada II. Typical of rebels who supported peace talks with the Paradan government. Rescued Miles O'Brien from government forces in 2370.

name: Dr. Nydom
lore: Male T'Lani. Typical medical technician. Worked on harvester virus elimination project in 2370.

name: E'Tyshra
lore: Female T'Lani ambassador. Worked with Sharat to end the war with the Kellerun. Schemed to eliminate everyone with knowledge of the harvester virus.

name: Jaheel
lore: Male humanoid. Typical transport captain operating around Deep Space 9. Attempted to violate the aphasia virus quarantine issued in 2369.

name: Kalita
lore: Longtime Maquis member. Helped Thomas Riker commandeer the U.S.S. Defiant. Helped Ro Laren steal medical supplies from the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Martus Mazur
lore: El-Aurian con artist. Proprietor of Club Martus. Rival of Quark. Replicated a gambling device which changes the laws of probability. Always knows when they're bluffing.

name: Rax'Na
lore: Typical male Kressari. Trader of botanical DNA. Aspires to become a weapon supplier

name: Retaya
lore: Flaxian. Posed as a perfume salesman. In reality an assassin who mixed his "fragrances" to create deadly toxins. Hired to kill Garak in 2371.

name: Rionoj
lore: Female Boslic freighter captain. Delivered the earring of Li Nalas to Quark in 2370. Suspected of trafficking in stolen Falangian diamonds.

name: Sakonna
lore: Female Vulcan. Gunrunner. Bought weapons from Quark in 2370. Helped the Maquis abduct Gul Dukat, but failed to establish a forced mindmeld with him.

name: Sharat
lore: Kellerun ambassador. Helped negotiate cease fire with the T'Lani. Worked on project to eliminate harvester virus and associated technology in 2370.

name: Ty Kajada
lore: Female Kobliad security officer. Representative of law enforcement agents found on non-aligned worlds. Pursued the criminal Rao Vantika for 20 years.

name: Zef'No
lore: Kressari male. Commander of the Calondon. Agent who supplied Cardassian weapons to the Circle in 2370.

name: Karina
lore: Female Romulan "delegate" and saboteur. Assistant to Ruwon. Planned to help him sabotage the Bajoran wormhole and Deep Space 9.

name: Ruwon
lore: Led Romulan delegation to DS9 to receive Starfleet's intelligence dossier on the Dominion. Had secret orders to destroy the station and nearby wormhole.

name: Selveth
lore: Female Romulan. Piloted a warbird in the secret Tal Shiar/Obsidian Order operation to destroy Dominion homeworld in 2371. Served under Colonel Lovok.

name: Sorus
lore: Technician who accompanied a Romulan delegation, led by Ruwon and Karina, to Deep Space 9 in 2369.

name: Vakis
lore: Tal Shiar agent. Aware of assassination plot against Elim Garak. Unhappy to discover that her records mischaracterized him as a cobbler, not a tailor.

name: Fightin' Words
lore: "Go on. Take a poke at me. That is what you want to do, isn't it?"
game_text: Place on table. All your personnel with three or more Skill Dot icons lose their first two listed skills. Nullified only by Oof! or if you initiate personnel battle.

name: I Tried to Warn You
lore: "You're making a terrible mistake."
game_text: If you began this mission attempt with only one non-Borg personnel, or if all your missions have the same icon (Space or Planet), opponent places dilemma on any one mission in play. Q makes that mission unattemptable and unscoutable; destroys any points already gained from solving that mission or completing an objective targeting that mission. (May not be nullified.)

name: Rhetorical Question
lore: "Still chasing your own tail?"
game_text: If crew or Away Team completes mission on this attempt, discard dilemma. Otherwise, opponent may place dilemma on any one of your non-Borg ships in play (at this location if possible). While dilemma in play, you may not re-attempt this mission and ship must do nothing but return to one of your facilities; then discard dilemma. (Immune to Q2 .)

name: Risky Business
lore: "Remember that bug bite?... The galaxy can be a dangerous place when you're on your own."
game_text: If only one personnel in crew or Away Team, that personnel dies (erased if Hologram; seed dilemma beneath mission to be encountered again. Otherwise, if you have any one-person crews or Away Teams anywhere in play, choose one of them to die OR lose points. (Dilemma does not affect Borg.)

name: Assault Vessel
lore: Mainstay of the Bajoran Militia. During the 2370 coup attempt by the Circle, assault vessels commanded by General Krim and Colonel Day invaded Deep Space 9.

name: Bajoran Freighter
lore: Typical freighter used by merchants and military. Based on a standard Bajoran hull design. Frequently hauls goods and passengers to Bajoran settlements.

name: Bajoran Interceptor
lore: Patrols high orbit of Bajor and surrounding region. Used by the Circle to shoot down a subimpulse raider during the attempted coup of 2370.

name: Bajoran Scout Vessel
lore: Used for scouting and scientific tasks. Bears a resemblance to other Bajoran vessels, although much smaller in size. Tahna Los stole and commanded one.

name: Aldara
lore: Warship commanded by Danar. Destroyed a scout vessel piloted by Bajoran terrorist Tahna Los after he stole a Cardassian antimatter converter.

name: Cardassian Shuttle
lore: Small ship configured for both military and civilian use. Ferried prisoners from Bajor to Terok Nor during the occupation. Natima Lang commanded one.

name: Galor
lore: Military spacecraft used by the Cardassian Union. The Type-3 Galor-class warship is the backbone of the Cardassian fleet.

name: Groumall
lore: Commanded by Dukat following his demotion over the Ziyal scandal. Armed with jury-rigged system 5 disruptors scavenged from Korma.

name: Military Freighter
lore: Large, moderately armed freighter vessel. Used by the Cardassian military to ferry troops and maintain supply lines.

name: Prakesh
lore: Type-3 Cardassian warship. Rescued the Detapa Council from Cardassia Prime just prior to the 2372 Klingon invasion. Commanded by Dukat.

name: U.S.S. Danube
lore: Class of runabout often named for Terran rivers. First commissioned in 2368. The following year, the U.S.S. Enterprise delivered three Danube-class vessels to DS9.

name: U.S.S. Defiant
lore: NX-74205. Built to battle Borg. Recommisioned to oppose the Dominion. First ship to test ablative armor and quantum torpedoes. Captain by Benjamin Sisko.

name: U.S.S. Yangtzee Kiang
lore: Starfleet runabout commanded by Kira Nerys during Tahna Los' 2369 encounter with the Sisters of Duras. Registry number NCC-72453.

name: I.K.C. Toh'Kaht
lore: Klingon cruiser dispatched to the Gamma Quadrant on a biosurvey mission. Commanded by first officer Hon'Tihl after its captain was killed in battle.

name: Flaxian Scout Vessel
lore: Scout ship of Flaxian registry. Retaya commanded one in 2371 during a Tal Shiar assignment to assassinate Garak.

name: Miradorn Raider
lore: Representative of Miradorn vessels. Alternately commanded by Ah-Kel and Ro-Kel. Hull design impervious to most scans.

name: Rigelian Freighter
lore: Large-volume ship typically used by various planetary consortiums. Primary energy supply optimized for defensive shielding.

name: Xepolite Freighter
lore: Xepolite merchants are suspected as fronts for secret Cardassian operations. They maintain their privacy via particle-diffusing hull alloys.

name: Cha'Joh
lore: Small, obsolete, twenty-year-old Bird-of-Prey commanded by Lursa and B'Etor, the Sisters of Duras.

name: Commander's Office
game_text: Once each turn, any player who has a matching Command OFFICER unopposed here, may in place of one card draw, download to hand one Captain's Order card (Captain's Log, Lower Decks, Yellow Alert, Senior Staff Meeting or any card so marked). Matching OFFICER personnel may file mission reports here. This site is always the "innermost" site of any Nor (may not separate Ops from any other site.

name: Docking Pads
game_text: Any ship with no staffing requirements may report, dock (land) and undock (take off) here if ship is compatible with station's affiliation OR Crew includes a V.I.P. OR player controlling ship has a Computer Skill personnel present at this site unopposed (just before undocking, that personnel may board ship). Player controlling station may, once per game, download Establish Landing Protocols.

name: Docking Ports
game_text: Any ship with fewer than three staffing icons may report, dock and undock here if ship is compatible with station's affiliation OR crew includes a V.I.P. OR player controlling ship has a Computer Skill personnel present at this site unopposed (just before undocking, that personnel may board ship). Freighters and transports report for free here.

name: Docking Pylons
game_text: Any ship with fewer than five staffing icons may dock and undock here if ship is compatible with station's affiliation OR crew includes a V.I.P. OR player controlling ship has a Computer Skill personnel present at this site unopposed (just before undocking, that personnel may board ship). Ships may not report here but may repair here.

name: Garak's Tailor Shop
game_text: Obsidian Order personnel may report here (for free if any Garak). Once each turn, any player who has a personnel unopposed here who has both Obsidian Order and Treachery may glance at top card of opponent's draw deck. Also, any player who doesn't control station but has Obsidian Order unopposed here may report Cardassian personnel and Cardassian-compatible Equipment cards here.

name: Guest Quarters
game_text: If unoccupied, any non-Borg V.I.P. may report here regardless of affiliation. Once each turn, any player who has V.I.P. unopposed here may, in place of one card draw, draw two cards and place on of them beneath draw deck. (Not cumulative.)

name: Infirmary
game_text: Compatible MEDICAL-classification personnel, MEDICAL-related Equipment cards and I.P. Scanner may report here. Once each turn, any MEDICAL personnel unopposed here may "revive" a personnel present who was disabled by a Hypospray (revived personnel is no longer disabled). Matching MEDICAL personnel may file mission reports here.

name: Ops
game_text: Compatible OFFICER-classification personnel may report here. Any player may, in place of their normal card play, download to an unopposed site on this station one card which may play there (if reporting a ship or personnel, must be of matching affiliation); player draws no cards that turn. Any Computer Skill personnel unopposed here may commandeer station.

name: Ore Processing Unit
game_text: Compatible ENGINEER-classification personnel and ENGINEER-related Equipment cards may report here. If Automated Security System on Ops at this station, personnel may not move to here from an adjacent site, or vice versa.This unit does not process ore when station is under Federation or Bajoran control.

name: Promenade Shops
game_text: Non-Borg CIVILIAN personnel may report here regardless of affiliation. Any player who has a non-Borg personnel present may probe:Event, Interrupt, Equipment : Shopping. Draw probe card. Objective, Cardassian, Klingon : Brawl. Must immediately initiate a personnel battle (if opposed by non-Borg) at this site.

name: Science Lab
game_text: Compatible SCIENCE-classification personnel, SCIENCE-related Equipment cards, I.P. Scanner and PADDs may report here. Once each turn, if station at a Space mission and player who controls station has a SCIENCE personnel unopposed here, that player may scan bottom seed card under mission. Matching SCIENCE personnel may file mission reports here.

name: Security Office
game_text: Compatible SECURITY-classification personnel and hand weapons may report here. Whenever a personnel battle was just initiated on this station, any player's personnel here, if one has SECURITY, may move there (if possible) and join the battle. Matching SECURITY personnel may file mission reports here.

name: Memory Wipe
lore: Satarran operatives use biolectric fields to cause selective memory suppression. Victims retain basic skills and aptitudes, but lose their sense of identity and affiliation.

name: Ferengi Trading Post
lore: Ferengi commercial centers are frequented by many races for trade, information, repair and resupply.
game_text: Seed one (you may also seed one Universal D'Kora face up here) OR build where you have a Ferengi ENGINEER. Each player's non-Borg cards may report and mix aboard regardless of affiliation.

name: Botanical Research
lore: Unexplored planet: Gather plant life for medical research from planet with highly ionized atmosphere.
game_text: Atmospheric Ionization may seed here.

name: Geological Survey
lore: Uncharted planet: Assess value of rich mineral deposits on planet near edge of explored space.
game_text: * +10 if 3 Geology OR 3 Greed present.

name: Military Exercises
lore: Unclaimed sector of space: Conduct flagship efficiency drills in remote sector of Alpha Quadrant.

name: Search for Weapons
lore: Demilitarized Zone Region ● Border planet: Search planet for illegal Maquis arms cache.
game_text: May seed hand weapons under here.

name: Study Cometary Cloud
lore: Cruses System: Research gaseous comet trail in this system's Oort cloud for military or commercial use.

name: Study Pulsar
lore: Uncharted space: Characterize radio and optical emissions from rapidly rotating neutron star.

name: Memory Wipe
lore: Satarran operatives use biolectric fields to cause selective memory suppression. Victims retain basic skills and aptitudes, but lose their sense of identity and affiliation.

name: Ferengi Trading Post
lore: Ferengi commercial centers are frequented by many races for trade, information, repair and resupply.
game_text: Seed one (you may also seed one Universal D'Kora face up here) OR build where you have a Ferengi ENGINEER. Each player's non-Borg cards may report and mix aboard regardless of affiliation.

name: Botanical Research
lore: Unexplored planet: Gather plant life for medical research from planet with highly ionized atmosphere.
game_text: Atmospheric Ionization may seed here.

name: Geological Survey
lore: Uncharted planet: Assess value of rich mineral deposits on planet near edge of explored space.
game_text: * +10 if 3 Geology OR 3 Greed present.

name: Military Exercises
lore: Unclaimed sector of space: Conduct flagship efficiency drills in remote sector of Alpha Quadrant.

name: Search for Weapons
lore: Demilitarized Zone Region ● Border planet: Search planet for illegal Maquis arms cache.
game_text: May seed hand weapons under here.

name: Study Cometary Cloud
lore: Cruses System: Research gaseous comet trail in this system's Oort cloud for military or commercial use.

name: Study Pulsar
lore: Uncharted space: Characterize radio and optical emissions from rapidly rotating neutron star.

name: Croden's Key
lore: Unusual necklace containing a shape-shifting key reminiscent of changelings. Used to secure a hidden stasis chamber protecting Croden's daughter, Yareth, in the Chamra Vortex.
game_text: Seeds only in Gamma Quadrant. Use as Equipment card. Where present, allows docking/undocking at, and walking in/out of, any player's ship or facility (as appropriate).

name: Orb of Prophecy and Change
lore: Third of the nine mysterious energy vortices called Tears of the Prophets by the Bajorans. Grants visions of the future. Only Orb not stolen by Cardassians during the occupation.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. Once each turn, you may glance at the top card of your draw deck. Insert it anywhere within your draw deck if you wish. (Not duplicatable.)

name: The Earring of Li Nalas
lore: Quark acquired a Bajoran earring in 2370. Kira Nerys quickly identified it as that of Bajoran resistance hero Li Nalas, leading to the rescue of Li and others from the Hutet labor camp.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. Once in play, if Li Nalas then earned from Rescue Prisoners, double its point box. Also Resistance personnel present are attributes all +3. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Berserk Changeling
lore: Changelings can be hyper-sensitive to certain environmental hazards, such as the poison gas encountered on planet LS-VI. Progressive degradation causes uncontrollable outbursts.
game_text: Unless 2 hand weapons OR 3 SECURITY OR Changeling Sweep OR Shape-Shift Inhibitor OR Interphase Generator OR Mora Pol present, kills a non-changeling present (random selection).

page_title: Chula: Pick One to Save Two (TD)
name: Chula: Pick One to Save Two
base_name: Chula: Pick One to Save Two
lore: In the game of chula, thialo is a decision point which requires the player to select one participant to be lost so that the others can continue.
game_text: To get past requires three personnel present (random selection) to face thialo. Choose one of those three to return to your hand, or all three are "stopped."

name: Chula: The Chandra
lore: The Chandra is part of an elaborate Wadi game which requires players to advance through several shaps, or levels. To get past this shap, players must precisely mimic the Chandra.
game_text: One person (random selection) continues, along with all crew or Away Team members who have at least one attribute number matching that personnel. Others are "stopped".

name: Chula: The Dice
lore: The throw of the dice is the foundation of chula. Each combination of Wadi symbols determines which challenge next awaits the game's participants.
game_text: To get past requires one personnel with INTEGRITY>6, another with CUNNING>7 and a third with STRENGTH>8.

name: Crisis
lore: The crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise-E faced concurrent problems in 2063. The Borg required Picard's attention on the ship while Riker and the away team worked with Cochrane on Earth.
game_text: To gest past requires Leadership (or Communication and Defense icons in Away Team and an OFFICER-classification personnel (or 2 Defense Borg) aboard your ship at this location.

name: Founder Secret
lore: Searching for the source of a jamming signal, Kira Nerys discovered a secret door on the Founders' homeworld. The lock was designed to be worked by changeling physiology.
game_text: To get past requires a changeling OR Interphase Generator OR Croden's Key OR CUNNING>40 and any tricorder OR STRENGTH>70 or four Defense drones OR Breen CRM114.

name: Friendly Fire
lore: Ferengi lack of leadership resulted in the untimely demise of the Vorta Keevan aboard Empok Nor. His death was a major setback in Quark and Rom's mission to rescue their Moogie.
game_text: Unless 2 Leadership and 2 SECURITY present, kills one personnel (random selection); place dilemma on this mission (or this Empok Nor); it cannot be attempted or scouted.

name: Mission Fatigue
lore: When under extreme stress, even highly trained veterans can experience lapses in judgment. Miles O'Brien and Worf fought each other while they were besieged by Jem'Hadar in 2373.

name: Navigational Hazards
lore: Successful completion of a mission in deep space requires proper charting and navigational skills. Maps of the known universe can be essential to a crew in unfamiliar territory.
game_text: To get past requires Stellar Cartography and 2 Navigation.

name: Sleeper Trap
lore: Stasis chambers holding homicidal Cardassians infected with a biogenic compound. Left aboard the abandoned Empok Nor and rigged to activate should anyone come aboard.
game_text: Opponent may download to one site or planet here up to three different Universal Cardassians and one hand weapon. They may (if possible) initiate personnel battle. Discard dilemma.

name: Surprise Assault
lore: Jem'Hadar soldiers have the capability to "shroud," or cloak themselves. this allows them to hide virtually anywhere, and they frequently take their adversaries by surprise.
game_text: Unless Leadership, 2 OFFICER and 2 SECURITY present OR 2 hand weapons present, kills two personnel (lowest CUNNING first, then lowest STRENGTH). Discard dilemma.

name: Dominion PADD
lore: Standard Personal Access Display Device for computerized information. This PADD was taken by Jem'Hadar from the New Bajor colony destroyed in 2370.
game_text: Dominion use only. Each of your personnel present is CUNNING +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Jem'Hadar Birthing Chamber
lore: Incubation module used to breed Jem'Hadar warriors. Each infant grows at a greatly accelerated rate, and is able to fight within days of emergence.
game_text: Where present, each of your Jem'Hadar Birthing Chambers allows you to report one UniversalYoung Jem'Hadar (for free) each turn, regardless of quadrant.

name: Jem'Hadar Disruptor
lore: Standard-issue Jem'Hadar sidearm. Energy from a tritium microfusion reaction is accumulated in a phased polaron source, the pulse-discharged through a parabolic arkenium emitter.
game_text: Dominion and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2 (Cumulative.)

name: Jem'Hadar Disruptor Rifle
lore: Jem'Hadar weapons have nonvariable energy settings, but their polaron beams can be enhanced with chemicals such as anticoagulants, nerve agents and osteosolvents.
game_text: Dominion and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +3, but loses 1 Diplomacy unless aboard your ship.. (Cumulative.)

name: Ketracel-White
lore: Isogenic enzyme controlled by the Vorta. Genetically addicted Jem'Hadar need a constant supply of "the white" to stay alive. Withdrawal prevents shrouding and leads to killing rampages.
game_text: Where present, prevents "white deprivation." Counts down only if you have Ketracel White personnel present. (Your Vorta may "ration" just one Ketracel-White present to count down.)

name: Crew Reassignment
lore: In 2063, U.S.S. Enterprise-E crew member William T. Riker participated in Zefram Cochrane's historic warp flight. He and Geordi La Forge substituted for the missing Phoenix crew.
game_text: Plays on table. Your Enterprise-E personnel may staff ships as Staff. Also, each of your personnel with a special staffing icon may report to your ships with same icon. (Captain's Order.)

name: Espionage - Dominion on Federation
lore: Dominion intelligence operations conducted against the Federation have included the initial Eris ruse, Borath's virtual invasion scenario and even changeling infiltration of Earth.

name: Espionage - Dominion on Klingon
lore: A changeling impersonating General Martok manipulated Gowron so craftily that the Chancellor abandoned the Khitomer Accords and declared war on its long-time ally the Federaton.

name: Espionage - Dominion on Romulan
lore: Romulan counter-espionage protocols are second to none. The vigilance of the Tal Shiar protected the Star Empire from enemy spies for decades – until the Dominion arrived.

name: Fair Play
lore: When Miles O'Brien discovered his publicized racquetball match was unfairly influenced by an alien gambling device, he refused to take advantage of an unfair situation.

name: Invasive Beam-In
lore: Dominion transporter technology is optimized for combat operations. The ability to breach enemy shields allows rapid deployment of Jem'Hadar warriors in most battle scenarios.

name: Sisko 197 Subroutine
lore: In anticipation of a Cardassian takeover in 2373, Benjamin Sisko sabotaged the Deep Space 9 central computer. The resulting damage hampered Terok Nor for quite some time.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Place on your Nor's Ops. Nor may not be moved or commandeered. Any player may nullify with 4 Computer Skill present. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Tactical Console
lore: Standard display on most modern starships. Combines weapons control with target acquisition and analysis subroutines. Highly effective in the hands of a trained tactical officer.
game_text: Plays on your ship docked at your facility. While you have Miles O'Brien (or a SECURITY-classification personnel aboard, ship is WEAPONS +3. (Captain's Order.)

name: Treaty: Bajoran/Dominion
lore: Bajor's non-aggression pact with the Dominion, signed in 2373, was endorsed by the Emissary himself. He hoped to spare Bajor from the inevitable Federation/Dominion war.
game_text: Plays on table (for free if you have Kai Winn or The Emissary in play). Your Bajoran and Dominion affiliations recognize this treaty. They can now mix and cooperate.

name: Treaty: Cardassian/Dominion
lore: Gul Dukat's secret negotiations with the Dominion in 2373 secured a strong ally for the Cardassian Union, and positioned Dukat as the new head of the Cardassian government.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table (plays for free if you have Dukat in play). Your Cardassian and Dominion affiliations recognize this treaty. They can now mix and cooperate.

name: Treaty: Romulan/Dominion
lore: On Proconsul Neral's authority, Senator Vreenak negotiated a strategic non-aggression pact with the Dominion, forcing the humans and Klingons to bear the brunt of Dominion aggression.
game_text: Plays on table (for free if you have Senator Vreenak in play). Your Romulan and Dominion affiliations recognize this treaty. They can now mix and cooperate.

name: Primary Supply Depot
lore: Gamma Quadrant space facility. Long-time source of ketracel-white for Jem'Hadar troops.
game_text: Seeds at any non-homeworld Gamma Quadrant mission. Your non-weapon equipment may seed aboard (limit three). Resets countdowns of Ketracel-White aboard. Does not repair ships.

name: Remote Supply Depot
lore: Recently constructed space facility designed to support Dominion expansion into other quadrants.
game_text: Build where you have a Dominion ENGINEER. Your equipment may report aboard, for free, regardless of quadrant. Resets countdowns of Ketracel-White aboard. Does not repair ships.

name: The Great Link
lore: Changelings intermingle in the Great Link, merging form and thought into one communal entity.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Founders' homeworld. Ketracel-White on planet does not count down. Once per turn, one Founder OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Office of the President
lore: From his office in Paris, the President of the United Federation of Planets leads the representative council.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Earth. Once per turn, one Federation Ambassador, Admiral, Vice-Admiral or President OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: The Great Hall
lore: The Great Hall on Qo'noS is the seat of power for the entire Klingon Empire.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Qo'noS. Once per turn, one Klingon Emperor, Chancellor or personnel with "High Council" in lore OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Empok Nor (front)
lore: Cardassian mining station abandoned in 2372.

name: Empok Nor (back)
lore: Abandoned mining station recently repaired and activated.

name: Office of the Proconsul
lore: The Proconsul heads the Romulan Senate. Neral was Proconsul during the 2368 Vulcan Unification ruse.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Romulus. Once per turn, one Romulan General, Admiral, Senator or Proconsul OR Sela or Tomalak OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Caught Red-Handed
lore: Odo used his instincts as both an investigator and a shape-shifter to expose a Founder spy masquerading as Admiral Leyton on Earth in 2372.
game_text: Exposes (may capture) an opponent's infiltrator present with your shape-shifter OR prevents a changeling from morphing this turn OR nullifies Common Thief. (May not be nullified.)

name: Flight of the Intruder
lore: When the changeling impersonating Admiral Leyton on Earth was caught red‑handed by Odo, the Founder quickly made a winged escape.
game_text: Except during the destruction of a location, ship or facility, suspends play while any or all of your shape-shifters present together morph into birds (return to your hand.)

name: In the Bag
lore: While investigating a Tallonian crystal smuggler, Odo took the form of a latinum-filled satchel. He was forced to abort the sting operation when Worf interfered.
game_text: Allows your Equipment card in play and your shape-shifter in hand to morph (exchange). May be played at start of battle (may also download Strike Three there).

name: Jem'Hadar Sacrifice
lore: Injured by phaser fire, Meso'Clan could no longer contribute to his unit. He requested that he be put to death rather than continue to consume ketracel-white.
game_text: Plays on your Ketracel-White personnel. He sacrifices (dies) to keep all your Ketracel-White present from counting down this turn OR to substitute for a Founder present who is about to die.

name: Shape-Shift
lore: From the Great Link, the Founders manipulate their expanding empire. The ability to appear as members of any species has proven invaluable to their success.
game_text: Allows your Founder in play to morph into a different Founder (exchange it with one in hand OR discard it to download one there). (Immune to Amanda Rogers.)

name: Strike Three
lore: Bearing a striking resemblance to a bag of explosives, Odo surprised three Jem'Hadar warriors on Vandros IV.
game_text: Plays at start of personnel battle. Each of your shape-shifters present may stun up to three opposing non-shape-shifters (random selection) and is exposed if infiltrating.

name: You Dirty Rat
lore: On more than one occasion, Odo has assumed the form of a rodent in order to remain undercover during an investigation or conceal himself from a potential threat.
game_text: Plays on your shape-shifter. It morphs into a rat (treated as disabled and may not be targeted or participate in battle). May morph back (discard interrupt) at any time.

name: Archanis Dispute
lore: Archanis IV: Force the Federation to forfeit claim to planet relinquished a century ago by the Klingon Empire.

name: Betazed Invasion
lore: Betazed: Strike deep into Federation territory and take control of this strategically important planet.

name: Bioweapon Ruse
lore: Celtris III: Install signal generator and leak rumors about mutagenic weapon production on this barren planet.

name: Intelligence Operation
lore: Founders' homeworld: Covertly compile data on current Dominion homeworld in the Omarion Nebula.

name: Investigate Coup
lore: Tzenketh: Investigate alleged coup that threatens to change the balance of power in this sector.

name: Mining Survey
lore: Trivas System: Scan system for mineral resources suitable for processing by mining station located here.

name: Protect Shipment
lore: Pentath System: Guard medical shipments to colony suffering from outbreak of Rudellian plague.

name: Quest for the Sword
lore: Hur'q planet: Search ancient vault for the Sword of Kahless and other artifacts plundered centuries ago.

name: Rescue Founder
lore: Torga IV: Negotiate with Federation survey team to recover injured Founder from shipwreck.

name: Security Briefing
lore: Korma: Attend joint intelligence exchange on this Cardassian world regarding Klingon military movements.
game_text: You may play System 5 Disruptors for free here.

name: Uncover DNA Clues
lore: Ruah IV: Investigate genetic research conducted here by Federation scientist Dr. Richard Galen.
game_text: Hunt for DNA Program adds Cardassian mission Bajoran mission Ferengi mission .

name: Engage Cloak
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. When your staffed ship cloaks or phases, it may relocate here (capacity one ship). Just before that ship decloaks or dephases, return it to its former location; it may immediately move (up to its full RANGE) once for each of your full turns it was on this objective. (If ship returns to spaceline on your turn, it may also use that turn's RANGE.)

name: Establish Dominion Foothold
game_text: Seeds or plays on a mission in Alpha or Delta Quadrant if none of your Dominion cards have been in that quadrant yet this game. If your Dominion personnel subsequently complete that mission, you may download a Dominion facility with up to five different Equipment cards there; score points (discard objective). You may complete this objective only once in each quadrant.

name: Install Autonomic Systems Parasite
game_text: Plays on opponent's ship if your Founder is aboard. That ship may not engage or disengage its special equipment, transporters and WEAPONS until your next turn; then you may use ship to move and/or battle opponent's other cards (ignoring staffing and affiliation restrictions); then discard objective. May be nullified by Miles O'Brien OR Odo OR 3 ENGINEER and 3 SECURITY aboard. (Unique.)

name: Issue Secret Orders
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Place on your V.I.P. or OFFICER who has been infiltrating opponent's ship since start of opponent's last turn. Target any opponent's mission in same quadrant. Ship and crew must do nothing but go to that mission (while infiltrator aboard) and attempt it if possible (any infiltrators may decline); then infiltrator is exposed. Discard objective whenever infiltrator exposed.

name: Post Garrison
game_text: Plays on any mission. Opponent may not attempt, scout or complete a Borg Only objective targeting that mission, but may battle your cards at that location regardless of affiliation attack restrictions. If on a planet, objective nullified if you have fewer than three Jem'Hadar or SECURITY personnel on planet; otherwise, nullified if you have fewer than two staffed ships at that location.

name: Subjugate Planet
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Place on a non-homeworld, non-Dominion mission planet mission you seeded. You may attempt that mission using these requirements:Vorta + Treachery + 4 Jem'Hadar + STRENGTH > (point value of mission x2)When you solve mission, you may download Remote Supply Depot (plus one Ketracel-White) here; discard objective.

name: General Hazar
lore: Typical high-ranking officer in Bajoran militia. Familiar with Bajoran defense technology. Issued the order to refuse landing privileges to Skrreean ships in 2370.

name: Kai Winn
lore: Vedek Winn became Kai of Bajor in 2370. Concluded Cardassian treaty negotiations begun by Bareil Antos. Finally accepted Benjamin Sisko's role as the Emissary.

name: Keeve Falor
lore: Typical leader of Bajoran colonists who fled Bajor during the Cardassian occupation. Resides on Valo II. Helped Jean-Luc Picard locate the terrorist Orta.

name: Orta
lore: Bajoran terrorist leader. Has an intense hatred for Cardassians as a result of being tortured while in captivity. Speaks with the aid of a voice synthesizer.

name: Zayra
lore: Bajoran male who operates the Transit Aid Center on Deep Space 9. Stirred xenophobic sentiment against Odo during the Ibudan murder investigation.

name: Seven of Nine
lore: IDENTIFICATION: PROFICIENCY DRONETASK: Tertiary adjunct of unimatrix zero one.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Human species

name: Damar
lore: Ambitious Glinn. Reports to Dukat. Witnessed his commanding officer's triumphal retaking of Terok Nor. Oversees engineering operations aboard the station.

name: Daro
lore: Glinn. Aide to Gul Macet. Attempted to discuss transporter technologies with Miles O'Brien aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise, but was rebuffed.

name: Dejar
lore: Female Obsidian Order operative. Sabotaged weapons systems of the U.S.S. Defiant in an attempt to ruin the joint scientific project between Bajor and Cardassia.

name: Macet
lore: Cardassian observer on board the U.S.S. Enterprise during the Phoenix incident of 2367. High-ranking Gul in the Central Command. Strict disciplinarian.

name: Silaran Prin
lore: Twisted male Cardassian living in exile. Disfigured in a terrorist attack during the occupation of Bajor. Nurtures a great hatred for the Bajorans who injured him.

name: Telle
lore: Glinn who accompanied Gul Macet aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2367. Confined to his quarters by Macet for attempting to access Federation tactical data.

name: Garak
lore: Cardassian male. Virtual player in the Vorta scenario testing the resolve of Alpha Quadrant species. Risked his life in the defense of his comrades.

name: Amat'igan
lore: Jem'Hadar bodyguard of Founder Leader. Third. Took the conn of the U.S.S. Defiant to navigate the ship to the Founders' homeworld.

name: Arak'Taral
lore: Jem'Hadar Second under Goran'Agar. Disapproved of Goran'Agar's use of Julian Bashir and Miles O'Brien in search for cure to ketracel-white addiction.

name: Azet'izan
lore: Third serving under Omet'iklan. Representative of Jem'Hadar officers. Participated in eradication of dishonorable Jem'Hadar renegades on Vandros IV.

name: Borath
lore: Vorta analyst. Subjected the captured crew members of the U.S.S. Defiant to a simulated invasion of the Alpha Quadrant in order to study their response.

name: Eris
lore: Duplicitous female agent. First Vorta to contact the Federation. Posed as an oppressed fugitive in order to win sympathy – and opportunities for espionage.

name: Founder
lore: Female member of the Dominion. Changeling. Characteristic of the members of the Great Link. Adept at mimicking the solids.

name: Founder Leader
lore: Female changeling. Center of power for the entire Dominion. Key figure in the Great Link. Told Odo of his origin; greatly desires his return to the link.

name: Goran'Agar
lore: First. Jem'Hadar soldier who overcame addiction to ketracel-white. Brought group of Jem'Hadar to Bopak III seeking freedom from the white and the Vorta.

name: Gurat'urak
lore: Typical Jem'Hadar navigator. Fifth under Omet'iklan. Responsible for safeguarding devices assigned to his unit.

name: Keevan
lore: Devious, aloof Vorta. Extorted a Federation Away Team into destroying his marooned, white-starved Jem'Hadar unit before it could turn on him. Hates Ferengi.

name: Kilana
lore: Female Vorta field operative. Dispatched to rescue an injured Founder shipwrecked on Torga IV. Distrusted Benjamin Sisko long enough to fail in her mission.

name: Kira Founder
lore: Changeling who, under the guise of Kira Nerys, attempted to understand Odo's loyalty to the solids. Discovered he had feelings for Kira.

name: Koret'alak
lore: Fifth. Representative of Jem'Hadar soldiers serving under Goran'Agar. Escorted Federation prisoners taken captive on Bopak III.

name: Leyton Founder
lore: Dominion changeling appearing as Admiral Leyton. Exposed by Odo outside Starfleet headquarters; escaped using his shape-shifting abilities.

name: Limara'Son
lore: Typical Jem'Hadar soldier. Reports to Remata'Klan. Demoted to Sixth for firing his weapon against orders.

name: Lovok Founder
lore: Changeling. Impersonated Colonel Lovok during the 2371 attack on the Dominion homeworld. Led the Romulan/Cardassian fleet into a Jem'Hadar ambush.

name: Makla'Gor
lore: Sixth. Typical Jem'Hadar guard and soldier. Assigned to station Terok Nor recently liberated by Dominion and Cardassian forces. Posted to security section.

name: Martok Founder
lore: Changeling who posed as General Martok. Advised Chancellor Gowron to end the Empire's long-standing alliance with the Federation.

name: Meso'Clan
lore: Jem'Hadar Fourth under Goran'Agar. Injured by discharge from Miles O'Brien's crude phaser. Willing to be sacrificed to preserve dwindling supply of the white.

name: O'Brien Founder
lore: Changeling posing as Miles O'Brien. Infiltrated Earth in 2372 with three other Founders. Gloated about their disruptive activities to Benjamin Sisko.

name: Omet'iklan
lore: First assigned to Weyoun. Sought to destroy rebel Jem'Hadar and their Iconian Gateway on Vandros IV. Killed the Weyoun 4 clone for questioning his loyalty.

name: Ornithar
lore: Typical male Karemma official. Broker of tulaberry wine for the Dominion. Well versed in valuable metals. One-time business partner of Quark.

name: Remata'Klan
lore: Jem'Hadar Third who was marooned with Keevan on a deserted planet. Took charge of his men after the First and Second were lost during the incident.

name: Talak'talan
lore: Jem'Hadar Third. Delivered the proclamation that Alpha Quadrant species were no longer welcome in the Gamma Quadrant... and would be destroyed.

name: Temo'Zuma
lore: Soldier under the command of Goran'Agar. Third. Typical of Jem'Hadar warriors trained to operate shield-penetrating transporter systems.

name: Toman'torax
lore: Jem'Hadar Second. Served under Omet'iklan for three years. In defiance of the First's orders, fought Worf during preparations for the joint Vandros IV mission.

name: Virak'kara
lore: Jem'Hadar soldier. Fourth reporting to Omet'iklan. Eight years old. Amazed at the longer lifespans of other species, especially Trill.

name: Weyoun
lore: Vorta field supervisor. Skilled negotiator. Key figure in the war effort. Reports directly to the Founder Leader. Self-proclaimed expert at telling – and spotting – lies.

name: Yak'Talon
lore: Seventh serving under Remata'Klan. Assigned to repair communication equipment damaged when his Jem'Hadar unit was marooned in 2374.

name: Yelgren
lore: Matter-of-fact Vorta. Met a disorganized group of Ferengi about Empok Nor. Agreed to release Ishka in exchange for Keevan. Got less than he bargained for.

name: Young Jem'Hadar
lore: Jem'Hadar youth. Typical juvenile recently emerged from birthing chamber.

name: Zyree
lore: Representative female of the Dosi, a physically aggressive merchant race aligned with the Dominion. Tulaberry wine expert.

name: Admiral Leyton
