Each ship fired upon is damaged = Tactic Draw for each Platform that targets it, and you may exclude that ship from that battle.

name: Make It So
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, if your staffed ship has its matching commander aboard, you may "unstop" it (once per game per Ship card title) OR download Ready Room Door (to download a Captain's Order) OR, if that ship is in battle (even during opponent's turn), download a Tactic card (once per game per Tactic card title). Discard incident after use, unless that matching commander has Enterprise-E icon.

name: Resistance Is Futile
game_text: Plays on your completed Establish Gateway, Assimilate Planet, or Salvage Starship objective. Increases objective's points by 10 while your Defense Borg is at that location. OR Plays on opponent's Q's Planet. The 40 additional points it requires are irrelevant to your Borg while your Communications Borg is at that location. OR Seeds or plays on table. Your Navigation Borg may report directly to your Borg spheres.

name: Tribble Bomb
game_text: Plays for free on your tribble group if your Barry Waddle at same location. (Unique). When countdown expires, kills one personnel present (your choice). Once per turn, any player's personnel present who has any tricorder may "search" for Bomb: Shuffle Bomb into all tribbles present (if any). That player randomly examines half of those cards (round up); Bomb is nullified if so examined.

name: We Look For Things
game_text: Plays on your staffed Pakled ship. May discard incident to "acquire" one artifact, event, or equipment enhancing attribute(s) of an opposing ship present (once per game per card title). Opponent must give you that card (or download a copy of it) for your use. OR Downloads a copy of any artifact (as if earned), event, or equipment enhancing attribute(s) of an opponent's ship. Discard incident.

name: Burial Ground
lore: Dukat and Kira Nerys found the wreckage of the Ravinok on Dozaria in 2371. Twelve crash victims, including Dukat's mistress Tora Naprem, were buried there.
game_text: Plays once per turn on any player. That player must "bury" (place out-of-play) from their discard pile one card (their choice) and all other cards there of the same card type.

name: Live Long and Prosper
lore: Traditional Vulcan greeting and farewell gesture. Originated by Surak, the father of Vulcan philosophy, who led Vulcan into its era of peace some 2,000 years ago.
game_text: Saves any Vulcan who was just randomly selected to die. OR Once per turn, returns an opponent's personnel who just died to opponent's hand; draw one card for each of its Skill Dot icons.

name: Obedience Brings Victory
lore: "First Omet'iklan, can you vouch for the loyalty of your men?" "We pledge our loyalty to the Founders from now until death." "Then receive this reward... may it keep you strong."
game_text: Plays once per turn if your Vorta just "rationed" Ketracel-White. Draw two cards (in place of one draw, may download Subjugate Planet to that location or Victory Is Life to hand).

name: Scan Cycle Check
lore: To protect the integrity of the timeline in 2267, Miles O'Brien monitored starship Enterprise scan cycles to identify when the U.S.S. Defiant could decloak without being detected.
game_text: Plays on your Transporter Skill. Your ships there decloak/dephase while that personnel operates transporters, then recloak/rephase. OR Nullifies Scan or Full Planet Scan.

name: Suicidal Attack
lore: During a prison break aboard Dominion Internment Camp 371, a captive Breen and a Jem'Hadar guard obligingly removed each other from existence.
game_text: Plays to kill one personnel (your choice) who is escorting your Breen or Romulan as a captive OR who just engaged one of your personnel in combat. Your personnel also dies.

name: Agricultural Assessment
lore: Sherman's Planet: Report on long-term progress of Quadrotriticale crop introduced here over a century ago.

name: Assign Support Personnel
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. (Unique). Your "support personnel" (those who have exactly two skills, but no special skills) may report aboard your compatible ships that have two or more staffing icons. Once each turn, you may discard objective to download a "support personnel" (once per game per Personnel card title) to your matching ship that has two or more staffing icons, or to your matching facility.

name: Council of Warriors
game_text: Plays on your Klingon mission showing less than 30 points (or on Qo'noS), if unattempted. Nullified if you play (or have played) Scan, Full Planet Scan, or a non-Klingon personnel. If you solve by end of your next turn, place objective in point area; place here all ships your ships destroy in battle and all personnel your Klingons kill in personnel battle to score points equal to WEAPONS or STRENGTH printed on card.

name: Hero of the Empire
game_text: Seeds or plays on Deep Space Station K-7. Download Captain Kirk aboard; he may not be moved. If he leaves play because of a Tribble Bomb (or an action your opponent iniatiated), timeline disrupted in 2267: place objective on table; each Alpha Quadrant mission solved this game is -10 points if solved by opponent, or +10 if showing Klingon mission icon and solved by your non-Federation crew or Away Team.

name: Sarish Rez
lore: Adjutant to First Minister Shakaar. Referred to by the First Minister as his entire "senior staff." Used to tend the gardens outside the Chamber of Ministers.

name: Six of Thirteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: SCOUT DRONETASK: Implement initial reconnaissance. Evaluate.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Third of Five
lore: IDENTIFICATION: TACTIC DRONETASK: Survey. Compile tactical data. Encode. Report. BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Broca
lore: Cardassian officer quickly promoted to legate in the wake of Damar's defection. Says he believes in the Dominion. Strives in vain to please the Founder.

name: Kira
lore: Ironically, Kira Nerys trained Legate Damar's freedom fighters in Resistance tactics. The Bajoran accepted a Starfleet commission to help ease the racial tensions.

name: Lam
lore: Breen soldier. One of Thot Gor's bodyguards. Secretly questions the advisability of the Dominion/Breen Alliance. As cold as a winter on his home planet.

name: Thot Gor
lore: General in the Breen Confederacy. Key figure in forging the Dominion/Breen alliance. Respects the Founder. Accepts Weyoun. Disregards Damar.

name: Thot Pran
lore: Breen general. Successor to Thot Gor. Ordered the installation of Breen weaponry on Jem'Hadar ships. Seeks to secure Romulus and Earth for the Breen.

name: Varat'idan
lore: Typical Jem'Hadar soldier. Fifth. Assigned to Terok Nor while station was occupied by the Dominion. Drilled in station defense tactics.

name: B.G. Robinson
lore: Bronwyn Gail Robinson served on the U.S.S. Enterprise. Romantically involved with Thadiun Okona. Responsible for reporting the daily planet-to-ship transport logs.

name: Captain Kirk
lore: Legendary starship captain. In 2267, met "lieutenant" Sisko. 17 temporal violations. "The man was a menace."

name: Dr. McCoy
lore: Leonard H. "Bones" McCoy. Chief medical officer of the starship Enterprise. Awarded the Legion of Honor.

name: Dulmer
lore: Agent of the Department of Temporal Investigations. Just wants the truth. Starts at the beginning. Hates jokes. Probably would have talked to Kirk himself.

name: Ensign Chekov
lore: Pavel Andreievich Chekov. Feisty 22-year-old Russian navigator of the starship Enterprise. Protege of Mr. Spock. Considers Klingons "cossacks."

name: Ensign O'Brien
lore: In 2267, Miles O'Brien beamed his away team aboard the original starship Enterprise to save Captain Kirk from Barry Waddle's assassination attempt.

name: Lt. Bailey
lore: Junior navigator of the starship Enterprise. Rapidly promoted by Captain Kirk. Remained on the Fesarius with Balok as an intercultural "exchange student."

name: Lt. Bashir
lore: When a chance encounter with Lt. Watley in 2267 suggested a predestination paradox, Julian Bashir began to believe he was his own great-grandfather.

name: Lt. D'Amato
lore: Senior geologist aboard the starship Enterprise. Eager to study a mysterious asteroid discovered in 2268.

name: Lt. Dax
lore: Though Jadzia Dax had never met the handsome Mr. Spock, the Trill fondly recalled her symbiont's encounter with Dr. McCoy: He had the hands of a surgeon."

name: Lt. Grant
lore: Typical security officer aboard the starship Enterprise. Eager to join the landing party to Capella IV, which he hopes will be the first of many such assignments.

name: Lt. Nagata
lore: Starship Enterprise engineering assistant. Discovered "Ensign" O'Brien incompetently performing a maintenance task.

name: Lt. Sisko
lore: Benjamin Sisko posed as a 23rd-century Starfleet lieutenant to thwart Barry Waddle's plot to kill Captain Kirk. Couldn't resist talking to the legendary captain.

name: Lt. Sulu
lore: Originally assigned to the starship Enterprise as senior physicist, Hikaru Sulu quickly transferred to the helm. Hobbies include botany, fencing, and antique firearms.

name: Lt. Uhura
lore: Dedicated communications officer of the starship Enterprise. Opened hailing frequencies countless times. In Swahili, her name means "freedom."

name: Lt. Watley
lore: Dierdre Watley recently transferred from the Lexington to the starship Enterprise. Plays flute and piccolo. Julian Bashir speculated that she was his great-grandmother.

name: Lucsly
lore: Agent of the Department of Temporal Investigations. Calculates dates over a century old to the exact day of the week. Hates predestination paradoxes.

name: Mr. Scott
lore: Chief engineer of the starship Enterprise. Nicknamed "Scotty." Big enough to take a few insults.

name: Mr. Spock
lore: Highly logical starship Enterprise first officer. First Vulcan in Starfleet. Suppresses his human half. Fascinating.

name: Nilz Baris
lore: Federation undersecretary in charge of Agricultural Affairs. Assigned to oversee development of Sherman's Planet. Misused the priority-one distress channel.

name: Falar
lore: Tactician aboard the Kreechta. Served under Bractor. Shocked when Jean-Luc Picard "destroyed" the U.S.S. Hathaway. Didn't think the Federation had such iron.

name: Lumba
lore: In a play to convince Nilva to support Grand Nagus Zek's reinstatement, Quark was altered to appear female.

name: Mordoc
lore: Security officer assigned to Taar's marauder. Member of Letek's away team to Portal 63's planet.

name: Arne Darvin
lore: Klingon saboteur. Disguised undercover operative. Assistant to Nilz Baris on Deep Space Station K-7.

name: Captain Koloth
lore: Commander of I.K.C. Gr'oth. Sent to protect Klingon interests in Sherman's Planet. Dear to Captain Kirk

name: Daval
lore: Klingon field scientist serving under Governor Kor. In 2267, helped establish the Klingon command center on Organia.

name: Kered
lore: Klingon soldier reporting to Governor Kor. Stationed on planet Organia in 2267. On Kor's orders, helped round up Organian citizens for execution.

name: Korax
lore: First officer of the I.K.C. Gr'oth under Captain Koloth. Klingon expert on Regulan blood worms and Denebian slime devils. Outspoken critic of Captain Kirk.

name: Kras
lore: Klingon who tried to acquire topaline mining rights on Capella IV. Interfered in Capellan politics by supporting Moab's attempt to overthrow Teer Akaar.

name: Thopok
lore: Lady Grilka's bodyguard and would-be suitor. Bad-tempered commander of the guard for the House of Grilka. Despises the Ferengi coward Son of Keldar.

name: Tumek
lore: Klingon elder. Longtime advisor and attendant to the House of Kozak. Conducted brek'tal ritual for the Lady Grilka and her Ferengi mate, Quark Son of Keldar.

name: Barry Waddle
lore: Outcast Klingon agent posing as human trader. Former alias: Arne Darvin. Plotted to destroy James T. Kirk. Envisioned his statue in the Hall of Warriors.

name: Danderdag
lore: "We are Pakleds. We want to be strong."

name: Gem
lore: Female Minoran empath. Tested by the Vians as a representative of her planet. Saved Dr. McCoy. Her willingness to sacrifice her own life saved her people.

name: Grebnedlog
lore: "We are Pakleds. Our ship is the Mondor. We look for things. We want to be nothing if not persistent."

name: Liam Bilby
lore: Low-ranking Orion Syndicate member. Obeys Raimus, his superior, in order to protect his wife and children. Holds that family is "the most important thing."

name: Odo
lore: Odo donned civilian clothes and went aboard Deep Space Station K-7 in 2267 to search for an explosive tribble. Recently made human by the Great Link.

name: Reginod
lore: "We are Pakleds. We have an engineer. He is Reginod."

name: Worf
lore: 24th-century Klingon disguised as a 23rd-century trader. Brought back in time by Barry Waddle. Refused to discuss the mystery of the Klingon forehead ridges.

name: Jenok
lore: Representative of young Romulan scientists trained in frontier exploration. Cited for his work in exploring uninhabited planets.

name: Kalenna
lore: Female Romulan. Member of task force sent to destroy the Founders. Helped Julian Bashir, Worf, and Elim Garak escape from Internment Camp 371.

name: Keras
lore: Expert strategist. Followed orders despite misgivings about provoking another war with the Federation. In a different reality, he could have called Kirk friend.

name: The Centurion
lore: Senior advisor and science officer aboard Gal Gath'thong during 2266 Neutral Zone incursion. Cautioned Keras to proceed carefully against the starship Enterprise.

name: Velal
lore: Romulan general. Commander of the Romulan fleet at the close of the Dominion war. Committed the Romulan Star Empire to the final attack on Cardassia.

name: Q-Type Android
lore: "Think fast, Commander Riker."

name: Bajoran Raider
lore: Nimble fighter used by the Bajoran resistance during the occupation. Kira Nerys commanded one in 2370.

name: Bok'Nor
lore: Old freighter suspected of transporting weapons to Cardassian colonies in the Demilitarized Zone. Briefly commanded by Boheeka early in his military career.
game_text: Smuggling personnel in crew may use hand weapons to complete "cargo runs."

name: Stolen Attack Ship
lore: Jem'Hadar attack ship briefly commanded by Luaran. Upgraded with Breen weapon technology. Stolen by members of Damar's rebellion; commanded by Kira.

name: Breen Warship
lore: Employs biological technology. Used in attack on San Francisco in 2375. Thot Gor commanded one.
game_text: Your Breen may report aboard.

name: Dominion Battleship
lore: Massive Jem'Hadar battleship developed during the Alpha Quadrant war. One easily withstood an ill-conceived attack by the U.S.S. Valiant in 2374.

name: Weyoun's Warship
lore: Jem'Hadar warship under the command of Weyoun. Stationed at Terok Nor during the Dominion/Cardassian reoccupation of the mining station.
game_text: Download Engage Shuttle Operations: Dominion

name: Columbus
lore: Typical Starfleet shuttlecraft, circa 2260s. Assisted in the search for the missing Galileo 7.
game_text: May be reported, carried, and launched aboard your Constitution-class ships.

name: Starship Constitution
lore: Class ship. Heavy cruiser designation. Mainstay of the Federation Starfleet in the 2260s. Registry number NCC-1700.
game_text: Download Any Universal Federation Original Series personnel.

name: Starship Enterprise
lore: Original U.S.S. Enterprise. Starfleet registry number NCC-1701. Responded to Deep Space Station K-7 distress call in 2267. Commanded by Captain Kirk.
game_text: Download Any Federation Original Series personnel

name: Brunt's Shuttle
lore: Personal shuttle commanded by Brunt during his numerous liquidations. Transported Quark's rag-tag negotiation team to Empok Nor to rescue Ishka.

name: I.K.C. Gr'oth
lore: Battle cruiser commanded by Koloth. Dispatched to Federation station K‑7, under pretense of shore leave, to further the Empire's plans for Sherman's Planet.
game_text: Download Any Klingon Original Series personnel

name: I.K.C. Ning'tao
lore: Bird-of-Prey command by Kor in 2375. Held off a fleet of ten pursuing Jem'Hadar warships. Presumed lost in glorious battle. Now the subject of legend.
game_text: SHIELDS +2 for each opposing Dominion ship here.

name: Mondor
lore: Commanded by Grebnedlog. Uses technology stolen from Romulans, Jarada, other races – and Geordi La Forge. "We are strong now, We have better weapons."

name: Gal Gath'thong
lore: Commanded by Keras during incursion of Neutral Zone in 2266. Possibly the first Romulan ship with a cloaking device. Named for the firefalls on Romulus.
game_text: Download Any Romulan Original Series personnel

name: Bajoran Shrine
game_text: Prylars, Vedeks and Kais may report here. Once each turn, any player who has a Prylar, Vedek, or Kai unopposed here with any other Bajoran may "conduct services": discard one card from hand, place bottom card of discard pile beneath draw deck or out-of-play, then draw one card (or two if any Orb artifact is present). Unless station is under Bajoran or Federation control, Shrine is suspended and may be destroyed by any personnel using a disruptor at an adjacent site.

name: Bajoran Phaser Banks
game_text: ATTACK and DEFENSE bonus +2 if you have a Bajoran ship firing with Resistance or Navigation aboard (or +4 if one crew member has both skills).Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Breen Energy-Dampening Weapon
game_text: Requires ship with Energy Dampener firing. Hit or direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw and, unless target is U.S.S. Sao Paulo, is I.K.C. Ki'tang or has Energy Dampener, "power surge" also disables RANGE and WEAPONS.

name: Chain Reaction Pulsar
game_text: Requires a staffed ship which has three or more staffing icons firing. ATTACK bonus +1 if Akira class. Hit or direct hit = Tactic Current and nullifies one Event card enhancing target's attributes (once per turn).

name: Sherman's Peak
lore: 2267 Sherman's Planet: 105 years, 1 month, and 12 days ago – a Friday.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; download Deep Space Station K-7 here. Any players may download Organian Peace Treaty. If a Tribble Bomb at this location is nullified by being examined, also nullifies Hero of the Empire. Native to this timeline: all cards with both Original Series icon and Alternate icon (except Mirror Quadrant cards).

name: 1 Tribble - Bonus
game_text: May report anywhere. Each non-Klingon present is CUNNING -1. Once every turn, may "stop" one personnel present (random selection).

name: 1 Tribble - Discard
game_text: May report anywhere. Each non-Klingon present is CUNNING -1. Once every turn, may "stop" one personnel present (random selection).

name: 1 Tribble - Go
game_text: May report anywhere. Each non-Klingon present is CUNNING -1. Once every turn, may "stop" one personnel present (random selection).

name: 10 Tribbles - Bonus
game_text: May report anywhere. Each Klingon present is INTEGRITY -1 and, unless Divok is present, loses their first-listed skill.

name: 10 Tribbles - Go
game_text: May report anywhere. Each Klingon present is INTEGRITY -1 and, unless Divok is present, loses their first-listed skill.

name: 10 Tribbles - Poison
game_text: May report anywhere. Each Klingon present is INTEGRITY -1 and, unless Divok is present, loses their first-listed skill.

name: 100 Tribbles - Bonus
game_text: Breeds from 10 tribbles. Where present, mission attempts require 2 Leadership. If on a planet, prevents scoring of Colony points there.

name: 100 Tribbles - Poison
game_text: Breeds from 10 tribbles. Where present, mission attempts require 2 Leadership. If on a planet, prevents scoring of Colony points there.

name: 100 Tribbles - Rescue
game_text: Breeds from 10 tribbles. Where present, mission attempts require 2 Leadership. If on a planet, prevents scoring of Colony points there.

name: 1,000 Tribbles - Bonus
game_text: Breeds from 100 tribbles. Each personnel present loses their first-listed skill. Prevents Ooby Dooby card draws at this location.

name: 1,000 Tribbles - Discard
game_text: Breeds from 100 tribbles. Each personnel present loses their first-listed skill. Prevents Ooby Dooby card draws at this location.

name: 1,000 Tribbles - Rescue
game_text: Breeds from 100 tribbles. Each personnel present loses their first-listed skill. Prevents Ooby Dooby card draws at this location.

name: 10,000 Tribbles - Go
game_text: Breeds from 1,000 tribbles. Where present mission attempts require 2 Exobiology. Cancels probing on non-Dilemma cards (and Borg Only cards targeting) this location.

name: 10,000 Tribbles - Poison
game_text: Breeds from 1,000 tribbles. Where present mission attempts require 2 Exobiology. Cancels probing on non-Dilemma cards (and Borg Only cards targeting) this location.

name: 10,000 Tribbles - Rescue
game_text: Breeds from 1,000 tribbles. Where present mission attempts require 2 Exobiology. Cancels probing on non-Dilemma cards (and Borg Only cards targeting) this location.

name: 100,000 Tribbles - Clone
game_text: Breeds from 10,000 tribbles. Where present, prevents personnel reporting "for free." If on a planet when that mission solved, reduces its points by 10.

name: 100,000 Tribbles - Discard
game_text: Breeds from 10,000 tribbles. Where present, prevents personnel reporting "for free." If on a planet when that mission solved, reduces its points by 10.

name: 100,000 Tribbles - Rescue
game_text: Breeds from 10,000 tribbles. Where present, prevents personnel reporting "for free." If on a planet when that mission solved, reduces its points by 10.

name: ...in the Engine Room
lore: "Aye, they're into the machinery, all right. And they're probably into all the food processors, too."
game_text: 100: On a ship , reduces WEAPONS -1 and RANGE -1.1,000: On a ship, it is "stopped" after each of its moves unless 3 ENGINEER aboard. At an Ore Processing Unit, suspends Process Ore.

name: ...in the Transporters
lore: So numerous were tribbles on the starship Enterprise that some were beamed to K-7 along with Captain Kirk and Mr. Spock.
game_text: 100 (or Tribble Bomb): On a ship or facility, when any personnel moves away from his group, up to 10 of this group's tribbles (and/or your Tribble Bomb present) may go with that personnel; discard trouble.

name: ...on the Bridge
lore: The starship Enterprise crew suffered numerous tribble distractions, not the least of which was Kirk sitting on one.
game_text: 100: On a ship , suspends attribute enhancements related to its matching commander.1,000: Where present, limits each mission attempt to 10 personnel.

name: ...on the Station
lore: 1,771,561 tribbles managed to fined their way into virtually every part of Deep Space Station K-7 and surrounding ships.
game_text: 1,000: Just after this group breeds, up to 100 of its tribbles may "spread" (move) to an adjacent site or into/out of a facility or a landed, docked, or carried ship; discard trouble.10,000: At Bajoran Shrine , prevents "conducting services."

name: Anaphasic Organism
lore: A male non-corporeal life-form that lives inside a female host which he enchants, as in the case of Dr. Beverly Crusher's late grandmother.
game_text: If Female(s) in Away Team, the one with highest total attributes numbers resigns (is discarded), unless SECURITY and MEDICAL present. Discard dilemma.

name: Archer
lore: Indigenous inhabitants, such as this Mintakan bowman, often attack an Away Team out of fear.
game_text: Away Team member with highest total attribute numbers is shot and dies unless SECURITY and MEDICAL present. Discard dilemma.

page_title: Chula: Pick One to Save Two
name: Chula: Pick One to Save Two
base_name: Chula: Pick One to Save Two

name: Chula: The Abyss
lore: In shap six of chula, players can fall into a deep crevasse. Three Deep Space 9 senior officers fell in, but landed in Quark's bar and learned it was only part of an elaborate game.
game_text: To get past, three personnel (random selection) must face the abyss. If their total CUNNING is odd, they are "stopped" and, if possible, relocated to Quark's Bar.

name: Chula: The Lights
lore: Players face several perils throughout the game of chula. In shap four of the game played in Quark's bar, Julian Bashir was singled out and "eliminated" by a burst of energy.
game_text: Crew or Away Team member with total attributes closest to 22 (your choice if tie) returns to hand. To get past requires CUNNING>24 remaining.

name: Hazardous Duty
lore: Jake Sisko was exposed to the horrors of war when caught in the Klingon attack on Ajilon Prime. Not a soldier, he was unprepared for the hazards he faced with the colonists.
game_text: To get past requires 2 OFFICER; then place on mission until solved. If any non-OFFICER dies here, its owner loses points (discard dilemma).

name: Lack of Preparation
lore: An Away Team that is unprepared to complete its mission will undoubtedly experience delays. Mission progress may be impossible until additional personnel arrive.
game_text: Non-Borg: Cannot get past (lose 10 points) unless you could have met mission requirements at start of attempt. ''Borg: ''Must have Communications, Navigation and Defense personnel to proceed.

name: Male's Love Interest
lore: One of the many beautiful women who reside on the paradise planet of Risa.

name: Matriarchal Society
lore: The planet Angel One was dominated by its women who were intolerant of dealing with men.
game_text: Cannot get past unless at least two female Away Team members are present.

name: Microvirus
lore: Genetic weapon designed to attack humanoids who have specific DNA sequences.
game_text: Kills one Away Team member (opponent's choice), unless MEDICAL and SECURITY present. Discard dilemma.

name: Primitive Culture
lore: First contact requires caution, subterfuge or force. Solkar's historic visit to Earth was peaceful, but Federation/Klingon contact in 2218 would ignite a century of hostilities.
game_text: To get past, requires 3 Vulcans OR Anthropology and CIVILIAN OR Vorta and 4 Jem'Hadar OR 2 Tal Shiar OR 2 Obsidian Order OR Acquisition and 2 Greed OR 6 Klingons OR 4 Defense Borg.

name: Scientific Method
lore: Beverly Crusher scanned Jo'Bril's body for tetryon traces during her 2369 "murder" investigation. Her scientific approach eventually revealed that Jo'Bril had faked his own death.
game_text: To get past requires MEDICAL and 3 SCIENCE.

name: Security Precautions
lore: Dr. Manheim's laboratory deep inside a remote planetoid used a system of forcefields and targeting lasers to bar entry and protect a revolutionary experiment.
game_text: To get past, Away Team must have Jenice Manheim OR android OR phaser OR disruptor OR 3 SECURITY.

name: Alternate Universe Door
game_text: Place one on table during the seed phase. Door is now open, allowing your Alternate icon cards to enter play. OR Stock in deck and use as follows:Plays to nullify one Revolving Door or Subspace Schism. (Discard doorway.) OR Allows one ship to pass through Q-Net. (Discard doorway.) OR Nullify one Temporal Rift, and return doorway to your hand.

name: Bat'leth
lore: Traditional blade weapon of the Klingon warrior. According to legend, the first bat'leth, or "sword of honor," was forged by Kahless the Unforgettable some fifteen centuries ago.
game_text: Each of your Klingons present is STRENGTH +2, and in each battle one of them may mortally wound one adversary they just stunned. (Cumulative.)

name: Medical Kit
lore: Representative of specialized medical equipment. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Gives all of your OFFICER-classification personnel the extra skill of MEDICAL where present.

name: Medical Tricorder
lore: Representative of specialized tricorder optimized for medical use. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Gives all of your SCIENCE-classification personnel the extra skill of MEDICAL where present.

name: Plasmadyne Relay
lore: Device designed by Geordi La Forge to improve warp engine quantum efficiency. Wesley Crusher opined that it was obsolete and needed a subprocessor matrix overhaul.
game_text: While on a ship, RANGE and SHIELDS are +2. While at a station or outpost, SHIELDS are +4. (Cumulative.)

name: Starfleet Type I Phaser
lore: Least powerful of the standard hand-held Federation defensive weapons. Low profile favored by Starfleet captains. Smaller in size than the type II phaser, and easily concealed.
game_text: Federation use only. Reports for free. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +1. (Cumulative.) May report to a just-initiated personnel battle involving your Federation card(s).

name: Res-Q
lore: Q once saved Captain Jean-Luc Picard's life following an injury from a compressed teryon beam.
game_text: Regenerates a card. Exchange this event for any one card from your discard pile.

page_title: Where No One Has Gone Before
name: Where No One Has Gone Before
base_name: Where No One Has Gone Before

name: Alyssa Ogawa
lore: Lieutenant (j.g.) Alyssa Ogawa married shipmate Andrew Powell in 2370. A nurse assistant to Dr. Beverly Crusher, she is studying to be a doctor.

name: Fleet Admiral Shanthi
lore: Fleet Admiral Shanthi authorized the blockade of Romulan forces covertly supporting the Klingon Civil War in 2368.

name: Thomas McClure
lore: Senior security officer aboard U.S.S. Enterprise-E. Led the ship's internal defense during the Borg attack of 2373. Transferred from U.S.S. Hood.

name: Morka
lore: Klingon agent sent by the High Council to keep Ruwon and Karina under surveillance. Accused Odo of insulting his honor. Threatened retribution.

name: Wo'Din
lore: Typical Klingon inspired by tales of glorious battle against the Dominion. Learned diplomatic skills from his father, a former Klingon negotiator.

name: Vekor
lore: Representative of female mercenaries operating throughout the galaxy. Worked with Baran to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Betazoid Gift Box
lore: Traditional device for presenting important gifts. Its sculpted face comes to life boisterously presenting its contents to the recipient.
game_text: Immediately look through your draw deck for up to thirty seconds and choose three cards to place in your hand. Reshuffle draw deck and discard artifact.

name: Cryosatellite
lore: An ancient sublight vessel. Designed to carry and store cryogenically frozen humanoids until a cure for their death could be found and used to regenerate them.
game_text: Seed at a space location. May seed one additional artifact and up to 3 Alternate Universe personnel here. They are earned when Cryosatellite earned; then discard Cryosatellite.

name: Data's Head
lore: An excavation under the Earth city of San Francisco in 2369 discovered that the head of Lt. Commander Data had been lying there undisturbed for centuries.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. Head has CUNNING=10 and Computer Skill. While on a ship, RANGE, WEAPONS and SHIELDS are +2. (Not cumulative.)

name: Horga'hn
lore: Mysterious symbol of sexuality from the pleasure planet of Risa. To own one is to call forth its powers. To display one is to announce that the owner is seeking jamaharon.

name: Kurlan Naiskos
lore: Statues which open to reveal a multitude of similar but smaller figurines inside, representing the belief that each person is a community of individual voices and desires.
game_text: Place in hand until played on any ship as an Event card. If ship has all 7 personnel types aboard, its RANGE, WEAPONS and SHIELDS are all tripled. (Not cumulative.)

name: Magic Carpet Ride OCD
lore: High-res encoding of 20th century rock 'n' roll, known for its enervating rhythms and unbearable volume. "You don't know what we can find... on a Magic Carpet Ride."
game_text: May seed at a space location. Owner may relocate any ship at this location (and ship's Away Teams, if any) to any planet location on spaceline. Discard artifact.

name: Ressikan Flute
lore: Artifact from Kataan, a now-dead planet. 1,000 years after Kataan's demise, a space probe gave Jean-Luc Picard this flute and a lifetime of memories in less than an hour.
game_text: Immediately play on table. X varies constantly, where X=5 points for each of your Music personnel in play. Destroy with The Devil. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Armus - Skin of Evil
lore: A malevolent being was formed when the inhabitants of Vagra II rid themselves of all the evil they had inside.
game_text: Kills one Away Team member (random selection). Discard dilemma.

name: Barclay's Protomorphosis Disease
lore: Contagious affliction which causes animals to de-evolve into ancestral forms. Disease named for Lieutenant Reginald Barclay.
game_text: Entire crew or Away Team (except Androids) de-evolves (dies) unless MEDICAL, SCIENCE and SECURITY present. Discard dilemma

name: Borg Ship
lore: Gigantic cubic ship of the Borg collective. Possesses powerful weapons and remarkable regenerative abilities.

name: Crystalline Entity
lore: Spaceborne life-form strips biological energy from planets and ships. Sensitive to modulation much like crystal can shatter from a high pitch note.
game_text: Space mission: Kills all life on ship unless SHIELDS>6 OR Music aboard. Planet mission: Kills entire Away Team unless SCIENCE and MEDICAL present. Discard dilemma.

name: Cytherians
lore: Race which explores the galaxy by giving other species the temporary ability and strong compulsion to come to them.
game_text: Place on ship. Ship must do nothing but travel to far end of spaceline at normal speed. When reached, discard dilemma. Score points.

name: DNA Clues
lore: Although a thorough analysis of a DNA sample can be a time-consuming endeavor, it can also provide information crucial to successfully dealing with biochemical hazards.
game_text: Place on mission. Further dilemmas requiring any MEDICAL here require 2 more if you continue OR 2 less if crew or Away Team has Exobiology and "stops" now to investigate.

name: Q
lore: Incorrigible, extra-dimensional member of the Q Continuum, a race of omnipotent beings. Q exhibits a child-like petulance and sense of playfulness.

name: Scout Encounter
lore: Many species send specially designed scout ships into unexplored sectors of space. If the species is aggressive, the arrival of a scout ships is a harbinger of trouble.
game_text: Opponent may download to this location one scout ship with one or two Universal crew members. That ship may (if possible) initiate battle against you or move away.

name: The Sheliak
lore: A reclusive race of strict legalists that considers humanoids inferior. Life-form classification R-3. The 2255 Treaty of Amens ceded several planets to the Sheliak.

name: Yuta
lore: An Acamarian of the clan Tralesta. Carrier of a microvirus engineered to instantly kill anyone with a particular genetic makeup.
game_text: Opponent chooses a number X. Randomly examine crew or Away Team one by one. If INTEGRITY + CUNNING - STRENGTH) = X, discard that personnel and dilemma.

name: Bynars Weapon Enhancement
lore: Binary race closely integrated with computers. Always work in pairs. Bynars have the ability to enhance specific computerized systems.

name: Interrogation
lore: In violation of the Seldonis IV convention, Gul Madred interrogated Jean-Luc Picard, seeking Starfleet strategic secrets. He kept asking, "How many lights do you see?"

name: Ocular Implants
lore: In 2371, Geordi La Forge received implants allowing him to see without his VISOR. They include enhanced capabilities such as infrared and zoom focus over 500 meters.

name: Regenerate
lore: The Borg use neural energy to collectively repair damaged biological and technological components. The Queen often serves as the focal point.
game_text: Plays to fully repair and "stop" any Borg Ship dilemma or Borg ship (nullifying any cards reducing its attributes) OR to shuffle your discard pile into draw deck. Discard event.

name: Retask
lore: Even a Borg cube ship can lose contact with the collective consciousness and begin marauding through space. Proper protocol re-establishment reintegrates it into the collective.
game_text: Downloads Universal Borg Cube and seven drones (Borg affiliation, Borg affiliation, Borg affiliation, Communications, Navigation, Navigation, Defense) to replace any Borg Ship dilemma in play. Discard event and dilemma. Draw no cards this turn.

name: Supernova
lore: The explosion of a star, usually caused by natural processes toward the end of its life cycle.
game_text: You must have Tox Uthat on table. Place atop any mission. Everything there is destroyed (discarded), but leave Mission card underneath for span reference.

name: System 5 Disruptors
lore: The Groumall was jury-rigged with large planetary disruptors salvaged from the destroyed outpost on Korma. The upgrade required emptying the cargo bay, which cost Dukat his profits.
game_text: Plays on your freighter, transport or merchant vessel. Ship is WEAPONS +4, but is SHIELDS -1 and no longer qualifies as a freighter, transport or merchant vessel.

name: Wall of Ships
lore: A wall display of all ships to bear the name Enterprise is a tradition built into each new ship of the line. This exhibit is in the observation lounge aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise-E.
game_text: Downloads any Enterprise. Discard event. OR Plays on table. Adds 1 to RANGE, WEAPONS and SHIELDS of each of your Enterprises. (Cumulative.)

name: Chamber of Ministers
lore: Legislative body of Bajoran provisional government. Established following Cardassian withdrawal in 2369.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Bajor . A Nor may coexist here. Once per turn, one Bajoran Minister, Vedek or Kai OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Central Command
lore: The Central Command controls every Cardassian ship, outpost and space station from its great War Room.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Cardassia Prime. Once per turn, one Cardassian Gul or Legate OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: The Great Link
lore: Changelings intermingle in the Great Link, merging form and thought into one communal entity.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Founders' homeworld. Ketracel-White on planet does not count down. Once per turn, one Founder OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Office of the President
lore: From his office in Paris, the President of the United Federation of Planets leads the representative council.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Earth. Once per turn, one Federation Ambassador, Admiral, Vice-Admiral or President OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: The Great Hall
lore: The Great Hall on Qo'noS is the seat of power for the entire Klingon Empire.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Qo'noS. Once per turn, one Klingon Emperor, Chancellor or personnel with "High Council" in lore OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Office of the Proconsul
lore: The Proconsul heads the Romulan Senate. Neral was Proconsul during the 2368 Vulcan Unification ruse.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Romulus. Once per turn, one Romulan General, Admiral, Senator or Proconsul OR Sela or Tomalak OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Alas, Poor Queen
lore: Like all cybernetic life forms, the Borg cannot survive without their organic components. Loss of the Queen brings chaos to order.
game_text: Plays if Borg Queen (or Bluegill Queen) was just killed. All Borg (or Bluegills) in play of same player also die. (Immune to Amanda Rogers.) OR Nullifies Regenerate.

name: Klingon Death Yell
lore: Warning for the dead to beware; a Klingon warrior is about to arrive. In Klingon myth, killed warriors with honor go to Sto-Vo-Kor. Dishonored dead go to Gre'thor.
game_text: Plays on any just killed Klingon with Honor. Yell to warn the dead and earn bonus points. May play only one death yell for each such Klingon.

name: Espionage Mission
game_text: Any "Espionage... on Federation" card may play here. Also, mission may be attempted if Selok in Away Team.

name: Investigate "Shattered Space"
lore: Neutral Zone Region • Near Neutral Zone: Study fragments of distorted space/time reported in this sector.

name: Investigate Rumors
lore: Chamra Vortex: Search nebula for clues to origin of changelings.

name: Pegasus Search
lore: Devlin System Asteroid Belt: Search for U.S.S. Pegasus, reported lost in this sector.

name: Study Nebula
lore: Gamma Erandi: Study and chart nebula.

name: Assimilate Homeworld
game_text: Plays on table. Target both an unassimilated homeworld on spaceline and your matching counterpart. Your Borg may scout that homeworld. If your counterpart is at that spaceline location, you may probe:Communications : Assimilated. Place on homeworld. Cards of that affiliation (except Alternate cards) may not report to any outpost for rest of game.'''

name: Plans of the Tal Shiar
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Wherever you have a Tal Shiar personnel in play, your Romulan espionage cards play at any time (for free) and may not be nullified. Also, once each turn, you may discard one of your Romulan espionage card from hand or table, then draw one card. At any time you may discard this objective from table to download one Romulan espionage card.

name: Bareil Antos
lore: Vedek. Follows springball religiously. Romantically involved with Kira Nerys. Began spiritual service as a gardener; still tending the grounds.

name: Kira Nerys
lore: Outspoken Major in Bajoran Militia. Assigned as first officer of Deep Space 9. Former member of Shakaar resistance cell. Romantically involved with Odo.

name: Odo
lore: Changeling security chief of Deep Space 9. Not very good at pretense. Always investigates Quark.

name: Borg Queen
lore: "I am the beginning; the end; the one who is many. I am the Borg... I am the collective."

name: Seven of Nine
lore: IDENTIFICATION: PROFICIENCY DRONETASK: Tertiary adjunct of unimatrix zero one.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Human species

name: Damar
lore: Ambitious Glinn. Reports to Dukat. Witnessed his commanding officer's triumphal retaking of Terok Nor. Oversees engineering operations aboard the station.

name: Dukat
lore: Gul. Ex-prefect of Bajor. Commander of the Prakesh. Father of Ziyal. Cardassian Union liaison with Dominion. Desires to regain control of Terok Nor.

name: Elim Garak
lore: Former member of Obsidian Order. Exiled to Terok Nor in 2368. Maintains some contact with Cardassian intelligence. Distrusts Dukat. Son of Enabran Tain.

name: Garak
lore: Cardassian male. Virtual player in the Vorta scenario testing the resolve of Alpha Quadrant species. Risked his life in the defense of his comrades.

name: Founder Leader
lore: Female changeling. Center of power for the entire Dominion. Key figure in the Great Link. Told Odo of his origin; greatly desires his return to the link.

name: Kira Founder
lore: Changeling who, under the guise of Kira Nerys, attempted to understand Odo's loyalty to the solids. Discovered he had feelings for Kira.

name: O'Brien Founder
lore: Changeling posing as Miles O'Brien. Infiltrated Earth in 2372 with three other Founders. Gloated about their disruptive activities to Benjamin Sisko.

name: Weyoun
lore: Vorta field supervisor. Skilled negotiator. Key figure in the war effort. Reports directly to the Founder Leader. Self-proclaimed expert at telling – and spotting – lies.

name: Admiral Riker
lore: Commander of Starbase 247 in an alternate future. At odds with Governor Worf. Battled Klingons near Devron.

name: Benjamin Sisko
lore: Captain Benjamin Sisko commands Deep Space 9. Fought in Federation-Tzenkethi war. Helped design U.S.S. Defiant. Father of Jake. Loves baseball.

name: Beverly Crusher
lore: Dr. Beverly Crusher is the chief medical officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Dancer and thespian. Widow of Jack Crusher. Mother of Ensign Wesley Crusher.

name: Beverly Picard
lore: Captain of medical ship U.S.S. Pasteur in 2395 in an alternate timeline. Although divorced from Jean-Luc Picard, she never could say no to him.

name: Data
lore: Lt. Commander Data is a sentient android created by Dr. Noonien Soong. Has positronic brain. Desires to be human. Once left his head in San Francisco.

name: Deanna Troi
lore: Lt. Commander Deanna Troi is a ½ Betazoid, ½ Human empath. Counselor for U.S.S. Enterprise. Imzadi to William T. Riker. Loves chocolate.

name: Geordi La Forge
lore: Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge is chief engineer aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Great sense of humor. Fortuitous holodeck programmer.

name: Jadzia Dax
lore: Lt. Commander Jadzia Dax is the eighth Trill host of the Dax symbiont. Underwent zhian'tara closure rite in 2371. Level 3 pilot. Married to Worf. Likes tongo.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
lore: Captain Jean-Luc Picard of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Born in LaBarre, France. Has an artificial heart. Reads Shakespeare. Something of a Renaissance man.

name: Julian Bashir
lore: Lt. Julian Bashir. Genetically enhanced. Salutatorian at Starfleet Medical. Requested assignment to DS9 so he could practice "frontier medicine." Likes tennis.

name: Tasha Yar-Alternate
lore: Traveled to 2344 and helped prevent a disastrous war. Survivor of the Battle of Narendra III. Consort of Romulan general. Mother of Sela.

name: William T. Riker
lore: Commander William T. Riker is the executive officer of U.S.S. Enterprise. Imzadi to Deanna Troi. Gourmet cook. Jazz musician.

name: Worf
lore: Lieutenant Worf is chief of security on the U.S.S. Enterprise. Klingon warrior and Starfleet officer. Son of Mogh. Raised on Earth by foster parents.

name: B'Etor
lore: Plotted with Lursa to seize power from Gowron with the support of the Romulans. Younger of the two Duras sisters. The pretty one.

name: Governor Worf
lore: Former member of the Klingon High Council in an alternate timeline in which, by 2395, the Klingons had taken over the Romulan Empire.

name: Gowron
lore: Son of M'Rel. Leader of the Klingon High Council after defeating the Duras forces in the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: Kahless
lore: Cloned reincarnation of Klingon spiritual leader Kahless the Unforgettable. Installed as ceremonial Emperor in 2369.

name: Kurn
lore: Son of Mogh. Brother of Lieutenant Worf. Member of the Klingon High Council.

name: Lursa
lore: Elder of the two Duras sisters. Plotted with Romulan Sela to start the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: Martok
lore: Highly decorated general and High Council member. Accepted Worf, Alexander and Jadzia into the House of Martok. Lost his left eye battling the Jem'Hadar.

name: Galen
lore: Jean-Luc Picard went undercover in 2370 posing as a mercenary and artifact smuggler.

name: Madam Guinan
lore: Adventurous El-Aurian who spent time exploring worlds such as Earth. Met a time-traveling crew from the U.S.S. Enterprise in the 19th century.

name: Roga Danar
lore: Angosian male. Biochemically altered into a formidable perfect warrior ranked Subhadar.

name: Dr. Telek R'Mor
lore: Romulan Astrophysical Academy member on deep space duty in 2351. Beamed to the present via a micro-wormhole to the U.S.S. Voyager.

name: Sela
lore: ½ Romulan, ½ Human female. Daughter of alternate timeline Lieutenant Natasha Yar. Powerful operative and key figure in the Romulan hegemony.

name: Taris
lore: Female subcommander. Captain of the Warbird Haakona. Investigated the Federation incursion of the Neutral Zone in the vicinity of Iconia.

name: Toreth
lore: Female captain of Imperial Romulan warbird, Khazara. Father killed by Tal Shiar. Uncovered M'ret defection plot.

name: Major Rakal
lore: Physically altered, the half-Betazoid, half-human Deanna Troi was coerced to assume the identity of a Tal Shiar major in the 2369 M'ret defection plot.

name: Queen's Borg Cube
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BORG CUBETASK: Assimilate human home world by direct attack, Earth date 2373. Borg Queen commands.

name: Keldon Advanced
lore: Faster than standard Keldon-class vessels. Secretly upgraded by the Obsidian Order. Staged in Orias System.

name: Prakesh
lore: Type-3 Cardassian warship. Rescued the Detapa Council from Cardassia Prime just prior to the 2372 Klingon invasion. Commanded by Dukat.

name: Future Enterprise
lore: Commanded by Admiral Riker in an alternate future. U.S.S. Enterprise-D was fitted with a third warp engine nacelle, greatly enhancing its speed and power.

name: U.S.S. Defiant
lore: NX-74205. Built to battle Borg. Recommisioned to oppose the Dominion. First ship to test ablative armor and quantum torpedoes. Captain by Benjamin Sisko.

name: U.S.S. Enterprise
lore: The fifth Starfleet ship named Enterprise, launched in 2363. Built at the Utopia Planetia shipyards orbiting Mars.

name: U.S.S. Enterprise-C
lore: Predecessor of U.S.S. Enterprise-D. Famous for heroic action in Battle of Narendra III, where it also entered a temporal rift. Commanded by Rachel Garrett.
game_text: Enters play damaged at any location.

name: I.K.C. Bortas
lore: Flagship commanded by Gowron during the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68. Lieutenant Worf briefly served aboard as a weapons officer.

name: I.K.C. Fek'Ihr
lore: Destroyed U.S.S. Pasteur in an alternate future, only to be thwarted by the future Enterprise. Named for the ferocious Guardian of Gre'thor.

name: I.K.C Hegh'ta
lore: Bird-of-Prey commanded by Kurn in support of Gowron during the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: I.K.C. Rotarran
lore: Bird-of-Prey station at Deep Space 9 during the war against the Dominion. Commanded by Martok. Led many raids into Cardassian and Dominion space.

name: Gomtuu
lore: Lifeform that normally exists in symbiotic empathic connection with its crew. Gomtuu's crew died prior to its discovery in 2366. Commanded by Tam Elbrun.

name: D'deridex Advanced
lore: Upgraded by the Tal Shiar near Orias III. Used in Tal Shiar/Obsidian Order attack of the Dominion of 2371.

name: Decius
lore: Powerful ship created in Barash's illusion. Commanded by Tomalak. Transported Admiral Picard and Deanna Troi to a Romulan peace conference.

name: Khazara
lore: Commander Toreth's Warbird. Covertly used by N'Vek and Counselor Deanna Troi to accomplish the defection of Vice-Proconsul M'ret in 2369.

name: Cha'Joh
lore: Small, obsolete, twenty-year-old Bird-of-Prey commanded by Lursa and B'Etor, the Sisters of Duras.

name: Montana Missile Complex
lore: 2063 Earth: Historic time of Earth's first warp flight and contact with extraterrestrials.
game_text: Plays on table. Seed Phoenix beneath this location from outside the game (any Zefram Cochrane) may acquire it later); Borg player may download Stop First Contact. Once Phoenix has taken off or Vulcan Lander has landed here, nullifies Stop First Contact .Native to this timeline: Zefram Cochrane, Lily Sloane, Phoenix, Vulcan Lander, Solkar, Sevek, T'Shonra and Kathleen Tonell.

name: 100,000 Tribbles - Clone
game_text: Breeds from 10,000 tribbles. Where present, prevents personnel reporting "for free." If on a planet when that mission solved, reduces its points by 10.

name: Beverly and Will
lore: When Data was lost with amnesia on Barkon IV, his human shipmates Beverly Crusher and William T. Riker disguised themselves as Barkonians to find him.

name: Data and Geordi
lore: When the Soong-type android Data began feeling emotions generated by Lore, Geordi La Forge performed a series of diagnostics on him.

name: Data and Picard
lore: To search for Spock on Romulus, the Soong-type android Data and his human captain, Jean-Luc Picard, disguised themselves as Romulan citizens.

name: Jean-Luc and Beverly
lore: Escaping from their captors on Kesprytt III, Jean-Luc Picard and Beverly Crusher discovered they had been telepathically linked by psi-wave implants.

name: Sons of Mogh
lore: Klingon brothers. Kurn and Worf fought together during the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68 to help Gowron restore stability and honor to the Empire.

name: Alien Parasites & REM Fatigue
game_text: ALIEN PARASITES: Unless INTEGRITY>32, Away Team (if any) beams back and opponent immediately controls ship and crew until "stopped."REM FATIGUE HALLUCINATIONS: Crew or Away Team dies at end of your third full turn unless cured by 3 MEDICAL OR docking at outpost.

name: Anaphasic Organism & Nagilum
game_text: ANAPHASIC ORGANISM: Unless SECURITY and MEDICAL present, female crew or Away Team member with highest total attributes resigns (is discarded). (Not repeatable.)NAGILUM: Half of crew or Away Team is killed (random selection, round down) unless 3 Diplomacy OR STRENGTH>40 present. Discard dilemma.

name: Ancient Computer & Microvirus
game_text: ANCIENT COMPUTER: To get past requires 2 Computer Skill OR 3 SCIENCE OR 3 ENGINEER.MICROVIRUS: Unless MEDICAL and SECURITY present, kills one crew or Away Team member (opponent's choice). Discard dilemma.

name: Male's Love Interest & Plague Ship
game_text: MALE'S LOVE INTEREST: Male crew or Away Team member (random selection) runs off with lover to furthest planet.TARELLIAN PLAGUE SHIP: Entire crew or Away Team immediately dies unless MEDICAL beams over (discarded). Discard dilemma.

name: Covert Installation II
lore: Neutral Zone Region ● Devora: Build station.
game_text: WORMHOLE: You may move your staffed ship between here and any other location if that location is a Wormhole Mission OR by playing one Wormhole interrupt there. Then flip this mission over.

name: Excavation II
lore: Kurl: Assist new archaeological dig.
game_text: WORMHOLE: You may move your staffed ship between here and any other location if that location is a Wormhole Mission OR by playing one Wormhole interrupt there. Then flip this mission over.

name: Explore Black Cluster II
lore: Sector 97: Study and evaluate collapsed proto-stars.
game_text: If destroyed, flip mission over.

name: Explore Typhon Expanse II
lore: Typhon Expanse: Trace reported time distortion.
game_text: If destroyed, flip mission over.

name: Investigate Anomaly II
lore: Gamma Arigulon II: Trace radiation anomalies.
game_text: If destroyed, flip mission over.

name: Investigate Sighting II
lore: Beta Stromgren: Investigate sighting of Gomtuu.
game_text: If destroyed, flip mission over.

name: Relief Mission II
lore: Penthara IV: Alleviate Ice Age conditions.
game_text: WORMHOLE: You may move your staffed ship between here and any other location if that location is a Wormhole Mission OR by playing one Wormhole interrupt there. Then flip this mission over.

name: Secret Salvage II
lore: Wolf 359: Retrieve wreckage at Borg massacre site.
game_text: If destroyed, flip mission over.

name: Test Mission II
lore: Praxillus System: Aid helium ignition project.
game_text: If destroyed, flip mission over.

name: Tantalus Field
lore: Alien device that vaporizes victims at the touch of a button. Used by James Tiberius Kirk to achieve his captaincy. A Kirk not form his universe revealed its secret to First Officer Spock.
game_text: Place on your Mirror Quadrant ship here. (Unique). Once each turn, may discard top card of draw deck to kill a Universal personnel here OR discard top three to kill a unique personnel here.

page_title: A Fast Ship Would Be Nice (MM)
name: A Fast Ship Would Be Nice
base_name: A Fast Ship Would Be Nice
lore: The mirror universe version of Bareil Antos unexpectedly beamed aboard Deep Space 9 and took Kira Nerys hostage. He demanded a ship in exchange for her life.
game_text: Kills one personnel (opponent's choice). You may substitute a bodyguard or Guard Drone present OR an empty ship here (moved to opponent's side of spaceline; commandeered).

name: Artillery Attack
lore: The Gorn attackers responsible for eradicating an outpost on Cestus III turned their deadly weaponry on the Enterprise landing party dispatched to investigate.
game_text: Kills X personnel (random selection); immediately probe: Skill Dot : X = number of Skill Dot icons on probe card. Equipment : X = 0 (discard probe card). Otherwise: X = 1.

name: Chula: The Game
lore: Shortly after discovery of the Bajoran wormhole in 2369, a delegation of Wadi visitors arrived from the Gamma Quadrant. They coerced Quark into playing their unusual game of chula.
game_text: Unless one personnel present has Greed and Treachery OR Greed and CUNNING>7, crew or Away Team is "stopped" until end of your next turn. Discard dilemma.

name: Denevan Neural Parasites
lore: Deadly flying parasites decimated the populations of Levinius V, Theta Cygni XII, Ingraham B, and finally Deneva, where they killed George Samuel Kirk and his wife, Aurelan.
game_text: Attacks half of Away Team (random selection, round up). You may protect one selected personnel for each phaser, disruptor, or unselected Defense Borg present; others are killed.

name: Distraction
lore: "You aren't very persistent, Mr. Sulu. The game has rules; you're ignoring them. I protest... and you come back. You didn't... come... back."
game_text: One male or female present (random selection) "distracts" a personnel of the opposite gender (opponent's choice). If neither has Honor, both are "stopped."

name: Emergency Conversion
lore: With the field density between the mirror universe and their own closing quickly, Mr. Scott and Dr. McCoy rushed to complete modifications to the transporters.
game_text: To get past requires 2 Astrophysics and Transporter Skill.

name: Gorn Encounter
lore: Large reptilian humanoid. Pitted against Captain Kirk by the Metrons in a contest of wits and brute strength. Showed no mercy.
game_text: Attacks personnel with most Leadership (opponent's choice if tie or none). Killed unless printed (CUNNING or STRENGTH) + (number of Skill Dot icons)>12. Discard dilemma.

name: Horta
lore: Silicon-based life-form native to Janus VI. Every 50,000 years, all Horta die off except one, which must repopulate the species through egg laying. Will kill to protect its young.
game_text: Place on planet. Now and end of every player's turn, kills one of that player's personnel present (random selection). Cure with 2 Leadership, 2 Mindmeld, and 2 Exobiology.

name: Kelvan Show of Force
lore: Aliens from the Andromeda Galaxy demonstrated their power to Captain Kirk by distilling two crew members to their chemical components. Crushing a container instantly killed the victim.
game_text: To get past, two non-android, non-holographic personnel present are selected (opponent's choice). One of those two is "crushed" (killed, random selection).

name: Quantum Fissure
lore: A fragile intersection of countless parallel realities. An attempt to scan one using a subspace differential pulse was interrupted by a Bajoran warship – with disastrous results.
game_text: To get past requires Astrophysics and Physics. Also, cannot get past if opponent has a ship here with two or more staffing icons that is staffed, undocked, and undamaged.

name: Royale Casino: Slots
lore: A U.S.S. Enterprise away team became trapped in an illusory world based on the badly written Hotel Royale, a Todd Matthews novel filled with "endless cliché and shallow characters."
game_text: Show a personnel from hand; if two of its attributes match, win points (if all three, win double points). Otherwise, lose points.

name: The Guardian of Forever
game_text: Plays on planet Gateway (limit one). Once per turn, one or more personnel present may time travel to a time location in this quadrant, or may return here from there (with any of owner's other personnel present). OR Plays once each turn to nullify any card that is closing Guardian, or to draw up to four cards if your Archaeology or Anthropology personnel just time traveled back to Guardian; place doorway out-of-play.

name: Agonizer
lore: Pain-inflicting device developed by the Terran Empire. Fear of punishment drives crew members to maintain maximum efficiency at all times. Ensures alertness, loyalty, and obedience.
game_text: Where present, each of your Mirror Quadrant personnel and Original Series Klingons is INTEGRITY and CUNNING +1. (Cumulative up to +3.)

name: Classic Disruptor
lore: Standard phase-disruption weapon used in the mid-23rd century. Technology shared between the Klingon and Romulan Empires during their brief alliance in the late 2260.
game_text: Klingon and Romulan use only. Each of your Original Series personnel present is STRENGTH +2 (cumulative). Each of your Original Series leaders present adds SECURITY.

name: Ferengi Whip
lore: Unconventional hand weapon. High-energy plasma discharge renders victims unconscious. Difficult to wield, it was phased out of use after a number of embarrassing accidents.
game_text: Each of your Ferengi present is STRENGTH +2, and in each battle one of them may stun one adversary they just engaged. (Cumulative.)

name: Mirror Dagger
lore: Small blade weapon used for personal protection. Ubiquitous in the mirror universe. Quite handy when an unexpected career-advancement opportunity presents itself.
game_text: Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +1. (Cumulative.) May report to a Mirror Quadrant facility for free OR to a just-initiated personnel battle involving your Mirror Quadrant card(s).

name: Multidimensional Transport Device
lore: Modifies transporter function to allow beaming to an alternate universe. Developed in the mirror universe. Used by Smiley, Professor Sisko, the Intendant, and others to cross over.

name: Romulan Cloaking Device
lore: 23rd-century device based on prototype successfully tested on the Gal Gath'thong. After one was lost to a Federation spy operation in 2268, the technology was revised and enhanced.
game_text: Reports only aboard your Romulan ship or to Sherman's Peak. While on your Romulan ship (or your Original Series ship with 2 ENGINEER aboard), ship has a Cloaking Device.

name: Self-Sealing Stem Bolts
lore: Used in producing reverse-ratcheting routing planers. Jake and Nog traded 5,000 wrappages of yamok sauce for 100 gross of stem bolts, which they sold for seven tessipates of Bajoran land.
game_text: Once each turn, may be downloaded from draw deck to replace (discard) your other Equipment card at a homeworld (or vice versa if you have any Jake or any Nog present).

name: Stolen Cloaking Device
lore: Regent Worf detained Zek in the mirror universe, demanding a cloaking device as ransom. To save their Nagus, Quark and Rom stole one from a Klingon ship. General Martok was not pleased.
game_text: May not report aboard a Mirror Quadrant facility. While on your ship with at least one staffing icon, ship has a Cloaking Device. On a Federation non-Mirror Quadrant ship, to cloak requires Federation Treachery aboard.

name: 35th Rule of Acquisition
lore: "Peace is good for business."
game_text: Plays on your Acquisition personnel. End of each turn, if no battles were initiated since end of your last turn, download a Gold-Pressed Latinum here OR draw a card. 35th Rule nullifies every 34th Rule, and vice versa, ignoring Scepter.

name: Blood Screening
lore: Blood tests are a standard method for exposing changelings. Though infiltrators are eventually found, the random testing engender distrust among suspicious crew members.
game_text: Plays on any shape-shifter who is infiltrating; exposed when countdown expires. Crew or Away Team is quarantined and may not pool their skills. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Treaty: Federation/Dominion
lore: Federation and Dominion forces led by Benjamin Sisko and Weyoun worked together in 2372 to attack renegade Jem'Hadar on Vandros IV and destroy their Iconian gateway.
game_text: Plays on table (for free if you have Weyoun or Benjamin Sisko in play). Your Federation and Dominion affiliations recognize this treaty. They can now mix and cooperate.

name: Alliance Nor
lore: Ore mining and processing station representative of facilities used by the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance.
game_text: Seeds or plays at any mission in Mirror Quadrant (except in the Badlands Region). Bajoran Wormhole Ops may not seed or play on this Nor.

name: Mirror Terok Nor
lore: Cardassian ore processing facility commandeered by the Terran Rebellion in the mirror universe.

name: Terran Outpost
lore: Hidden enclave and meeting place for the Terran rebels of the mirror universe.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Terran Empire ENGINEER. May be seeded or built at Terran Hideout if no headquarters there.

name: Terran Rebellion HQ
lore: Subterranean base of the Terran Rebellion. Hidden on a small planetoid in the treacherous Badlands.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Terran Hideout it is now the homeworld of Federation Terran Empire cards. Once per turn, one Terran Empire personnel (except Alternate ) OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Klingon Empire Outpost
lore: In the mirror universe, the Klingon Empire is a member of the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. The Alliance establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Klingon Cardassian Alliance ENGINEER.

name: Agony Booth
game_text: Plays on your Mirror Quadrant ship. Once every turn, if ship, its crew or one of its Away Teams solve a mission or wins a battle against opponent's cards, you may draw up to three cards. But whenever they fail a mission attempt or fail to win such a battle, one of your personnel involved (random selection) must do nothing but return to ship (if not already aboard), then is "stopped."

name: Crossover
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, your Mirror Quadrant personnel may ignore their Mirror Quadrant icon when reporting OR just after you report Smiley, Benjamin Sisko, Professor Sisko, Jake Sisko, Bareil, The Intendant, Grand Nagus Zek, Maihar'du, Ezri, Rom, or Quark, you may download a Multidimensional Transport Device to that personnel (or vice versa, if you reported Device as your normal card play; discard incident).

name: Emblem of the Alliance
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; you may download The Art of Diplomacy. Your Klingon Cardassian Alliance cards, Grand Nagus Zek, Maihar'du, Rom, and Quark may mix and have no affiliation attack restrictions. Once each turn, you may report a Klingon Cardassian Alliance personnel for free if you have a Klingon Cardassian Alliance leader who names (or is named by) them in lore. Ore Processing Units on Mirror Quadrant Nors are immune to Reactor Overload if 2 ENGINEER present.

name: Emblem of the Empire
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; you may download The Art of Diplomacy. Your Terran Empire cards, Benjamin Sisko, Jake Sisko, Rom, and Quark may mix and have no affiliation attack restrictions. YourTerran Empire facilities and staffed ships are immune to Navigate Plasma Storms. Ore Processing Unit on Mirror Terok Nor is immune to Reactor Overload if 2 ENGINEER present, and may Process Ore while under Federation control.

name: Hostage Trade
game_text: Seeds or plays on table (for free if you hold any captives). (Unique). Prisoner Exchange and Fajo's Gallery may each be used only once per turn. Where your personnel are escorting captive(s), you may release any or all of them (relocate to owner's crew or Away Team there) and capture an equal number of other personnel there, then discard incident.

name: No Way Out
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. All personnel must mortally wound and stun their adversaries when possible. Once every turn, if your unique personnel who has 2 Honor or Ketracel-White icon is killed in personnel battle, you may discard incident to place them in your point area (worth points equal to printed INTEGRITY; "in play" for uniqueness only).

name: The Art of Diplomacy
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Mirror Quadrant, Maquis, Resistance and Orion Syndicate personnel who are using a hand weapon may use 2 Treachery as if it were 1 Diplomacy (ignoring reductions from rifles) and, once each turn, may place incident out-of-play to kill one other personnel present. Once per game, you may discard incident to download one hand weapon to one of your personnel who has 2 Treachery.

name: Transporter Mixup
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. (Unique). If up to four of your personnel are beaming up from a planet in their native quadrant, you may replace (discard) them by downloading an equal number of others to complete the transport. Each Universal personnel may be replaced by any Universal personnel native to opposite quadrant; others may be replaced only by opposite versions of their personas. Discard incident.

page_title: I'm a Doctor, Not a Bricklayer (MM)
name: I'm a Doctor, Not a Bricklayer
base_name: I'm a Doctor, Not a Bricklayer

name: Vulcan "Death Grip"
lore: Vulcan technique which suppresses the life signs of a subject, simulating death until the individual is revived. Spock "killed" his captain in order to prevent Romulans from executing him.
game_text: Allows your Vulcan to save your other non-android present who was just mortally wounded or selected to be killed or captured. "Victim" is instead in stasis until end of turn.

name: Feldomite Rush
lore: Parsion III: Stake claim and exploit rich feldomite deposits recently struck here.

name: Mine Dilithium
game_text: Solving player's ships are RANGE +1.

name: Construct Starship
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. In place of your normal card play, you may download any outpost or headquarters (if you have a matching ENGINEER at an appropriate location) OR download Spacedock (even to a docking site) ORR download a unique ship to your facility that has a Spacedock (if you have an ENGINEER aboard who is that ship's matching commander). Discard objective OR draw no cards this turn.

name: For Cardassia!
game_text: Plays on your Legate (for free if they have Honor). All your Cardassians present are INTEGRITY and STRENGTH +2. When that Legate helps complete HQ: Secure Homeworld at Cardassia Prime, you may discard objective: download two Cardassians who have Honor OR once per game, place Legate and two other Cardassians who have Honor from that Away Team out-of-play to score points.

name: The Emperor's New Cloak
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Treachery personnel may steal unattended Equipment cards present and, if aboard an opponent's ship that has Cloaking Device, may place objective on ship: it may not be cloaked; steal a Cloaking Devise Equipment card aboard or download your own aboard. (If you bring Device aboard any Enterprise or same ship as Regent Worf, discard objective and score points.

name: Bareil
lore: Skilled thief and decryption expert. Bareil Antos was romantically involved with both the Intendant and Kira Nerys, who gave him an Orb experience.

name: Commander Leeta
lore: Leeta is one of the few Bajorans in the mirror universe to join the Terran Rebellion. Responsible for debriefing Ezri following the cloaking device affair.

name: Gantt
lore: Typical member of Shakaar resistance cell. Cared for the mortally wounded Kira Taban. Now a part of Kira Nerys' memories of her father's death.

name: Javek Len
lore: One of many Bajoran nationals living aboard Terok Nor. The Intendant, quite a fan of his talents, often invites him to perform at special functions.

name: Overseer Odo
lore: The mirror version of Odo supervises ore processing on Terok Nor. Has strict rules of obedience. The only changeling his contemporaries have ever seen.

name: Romara Cal
lore: Typical of personal physicians employed by important Alliance officials. Assigned to the Intendant. Surprised at how frequently she comes in for an exam.

name: Taymar Bern
lore: Representative of security officers serving in the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. Part of the Intendant's elite assault team. Helped track down Professor Sisko.

name: The Intendant
lore: Kira Nerys commands Terok Nor in the mirror universe. Enjoys being intimate with her friends – and enemies.

name: Weyoun of Borg
lore: Assimilated counterpart who spoke to the Dominion in a parallel universe.. "The knowledge and experience of the Vorta – Weyoun – is part of us now."

name: Aramax
lore: Representative of Cardassians in the mirror universe. Strives to be noticed – without raising the ire of Security Chief Garak. Has done neither thus far.

name: Dorza
lore: Female Cardassian in the mirror universe. Science officer aboard Terok Nor. Occasionally keeps high-profile visitors under surveillance for the Intendant.

name: Overseer Mardel
lore: Overseer of ore processing on Terok Nor in the mirror universe. Less demanding than his predecessor, Overseer Odo, but just as hated by the Terran slaves.

name: Security Chief Garak
lore: Although the mirror-universe Elim Garak hates the Intendant, he is still able to please her now and then. Not Regent Worf's type.

name: Thrax
lore: Cardassian forensics expert briefly stationed on Terok Nor during the occupation. Odo's impressions of him were superimposed over a dark memory from his past.

name: Luaran
lore: Female Vorta who supervised the installation of Breen weaponry on Dominion ships. Hopes one day her service will bring her to the Founder Leader's attention.

name: Captain Bashir
lore: Hot-headed Terran rebel. Julian Bashir interrogated and tortured the Intendant. One of many "captains" fighting to overthrow the Alliance.

name: Captain Dax
lore: Aggressive, roguish Trill. Host to Dax symbiont. Once the mistress of Mr. Sisko, Jadzia Dax is now romantically involved with Captain Bashir.

name: Chief Navigator Chekov
lore: Ensign Chekov arranged an attack on his captain in the hopes of moving up in rank. Spent time in the I.S.S. Enterprise agony booth for his misguided ambition.

name: Chief Surgeon McCoy
lore: I.S.S. Enterprise chief medical officer. Dr. McCoy runs one of the most feared sickbays in the Empire. Never loses a subject before completing their interrogation.

name: Comm Officer Uhura
lore: Communications officer aboard the I.S.S. Enterprise. Lt. Uhura is the object of Security Chief Sulu's constant advances. Knows how to handle him.

name: Crewman Wilson
lore: Typical crewman on the I.S.S. Enterprise. Seeks any opportunity to be made an officer. Isn't likely to find one on Kirk's ship.

name: Dr. Farallon
lore: Female humanoid from Tyrus VIIA. Scientist who invented the particle fountain mining system. Also developed exocomps.

name: Ensign Davis
lore: Security guard aboard I.S.S. Enterprise. Easily dispatched by Dr. McCoy and Mr. Scott with the old "you distract him, I'll hit him with the hypo" trick.

name: Ensign Gaffney
lore: Dedicated crewman aboard I.S.S. Enterprise. Abandoned a promising career in the sciences for the greater advancement opportunities in security.

name: First Officer Spock
lore: ½ Vulcan, ½ human. History will record that Mr. Spock rose to command the I.S.S. Enterprise, then reformed the Empire and ultimately caused its downfall.

name: Jake Sisko
lore: Federation News Service correspondent – and spy – during the Dominion War. Has his sources.

name: James Tiberius Kirk
lore: The ruthless Captain Kirk took command of the I.S.S. Enterprise by assassinating Captain Pike. Uses the deadly Tantalus Field to maintain his control.

name: Lt. Kyle
lore: John Kyle is relief helmsman and transporter technician aboard starship Enterprise. Born in Sheffield, England. Holds level 2 pilot certificate. Studies alien graphology.

name: Lt. Moreau
lore: Scientist recently assigned to the starship Enterprise. According to Captain Kirk, she seems like a "nice, likeable girl." He thinks they could become friends.

name: Marauder
lore: Terran rebel who faithfully followed Mr. Sisko for many years. Lost an eye in a dangerous stunt.

name: Marlena Moreau
lore: The mirror version of Lt. Moreau is assigned to the I.S.S. Enterprise chem lab. Romantically involved with James Tiberius Kirk. Likes being a "captain's woman."

name: Mr. Andrews
lore: Former Terran slave on Terok Nor in the mirror universe. Liberated when the Rebellion seized control in 2372.

name: Mr. Tuvok
lore: Vulcan in the mirror universe. Tuvok is a member of the rebellion that grew from the former Terran Empire. Still doesn't smile.

name: Nurse Chapel
lore: Christine Chapel is head nurse of the starship Enterprise. Holds degrees in medical archaeology and biological research. Hopelessly attracted to Mr. Spock.

name: Prot
lore: Ferengi ensign who manned the conn station in Barash's illusion. Riker thought him one of the few elements of the simulation he could get used to.

name: Security Chief Sulu
lore: The mirror universe equivalent of Lt. Sulu is chief of security and second officer aboard I.S.S. Enterprise. Desires command of both the ship and Uhura.

name: Smiley
lore: Second leader of the Terran Rebellion. Miles O'Brien commanded the Defiant, which he helped construct using plans stolen from Deep Space 9.

name: Transporter Chief Kyle
lore: Transporter chief aboard the I.S.S. Enterprise. Lt. Kyle was punished by First Officer Spock for failing to compensate for a transporter malfunction in 2267.

name: Mr. Brunt
lore: Ferengi mercenary. Very good engineer and cook. Brunt is loyal to his partner, Ezri, with whom he is secretly infatuated. Unfortunately, he's not her type.

name: Mr. Nog
lore: Nog is thankful to the Intendant for making him the bartender and owner of his uncle's bar. Distrusts tall men. Like tall women.

name: Mr. Quark
lore: Bartender who pretends to work for the Alliance. Quark secretly helps Terran slaves escape from Terok Nor.

name: Mr. Rom
lore: Ferengi soldier in the Terran Rebellion. The mirror version of Rom seeks vengeance against the Alliance.

name: Korvek
lore: Typical section head in Regent Worf's crew. Frequent target of the Regent's temperamental outbursts. Finds being a bridge officer to be a mixed blessing.

name: Loreva
lore: Female Klingon representative of medical assistants throughout the Alliance. Sees very few patients, but has assisted in countless interrogations and autopsies.

name: Regent Worf
lore: Commander in chief of the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance, General Worf rules with an iron fist – often literally.

name: Rinox
lore: Oafish crewman serving Regent Worf. Keeper of the key to Security Chief Garak's restraining collar. Accused the Cardassian of stealing it. Found it in his own boot.

name: Rukor
lore: Chief helmsman aboard Regency 1. Survivor of several Badlands expeditions in search of the rebel stronghold – more than any other pilot in the Alliance.

name: T'Vor
lore: Science officer in the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. Assigned to Terok Nor. Finds the station rife with gossip, backstabbing, and treachery. Likes it that way.

name: Telok
lore: Served for four years as a bodyguard in the house of Duras. Took a position aboard Terok Nor to escape the unpredictable demands of Lursa and B'Etor.

name: Vartoq
lore: First officer of the Alliance battle cruiser that intercepted Kira and Bashir's runabout when they first crossed over to the mirror universe.

name: Balok
lore: Humanoid envoy from the First Federation. Gentle, benevolent, and mature adult male, despite his youthful appearance. Enjoys drinking tranya.

name: Dr. Roger Korby
lore: "The Pasteur of archaeological medicine." Christine Chapel's missing fiancé. Disappeared on Exo III. Before dying, placed his consciousness in this android body.

name: Ezri
lore: Trill mercenary in the mirror universe. Unlike Ezri Dax, this Ezri is not joined to a symbiont. Partners with Mr. Brunt. Romantically involved with the Intendant.

name: Fontaine
lore: Enigmatic Terran rebel. In the mirror universe, Vic Fontaine inexplicably fights other Terran rebels. Even more inexplicably, he is not a hologram.

name: Mr. Sisko
lore: After years collecting duties for (and being romantically involved with) the Intendant, the mirror Benjamin Sisko became leader of the Terran Rebellion.

name: Professor Sisko
lore: Scientist who abandoned her work for the Alliance to join the Rebellion at the urging of Benjamin Sisko. Bonded with Jake, the son she would never have.

name: Ruk
