lore: Android created millennia ago by the Old Ones of Exo III. Used by Roger Korby as a bodyguard. Occasionally circumvents his programming. Mysterious and spooky.

name: Thomas Paris
lore: Convicted traitor. Maquis sympathizer. Best pilot Harry Kim has ever seen. In an alternate reality, a bar fight cost Tom Paris his future aboard the U.S.S. Voyager.

name: Wyatt Earp
lore: Famous lawman, gunfighter, and gambler. Reportedly never passed up an opportunity to earn money. Killed only when he had to. Recreated by the Melkotians.

name: Commander Charvanek
lore: Female commander of a fleet that intercepted starship Enterprise in 2268. Sought the heart of Mr. Spock.

name: D'vano
lore: Typical of mid-23rd century Romulan medical staff. Authored several papers studying the effects of cloaking fields and other technology on Romulan physiology.

name: Gorrus
lore: Representative security officer serving in the Romulan military, circa 2268. One of two men sent to starship Enterprise in exchange for Captain Kirk and Mr. Spock.

name: Subcommander Tal
lore: First officer serving under Commander Charvanek. Traced a communication signal that led to the discovery of Federation spies aboard his ship.

name: Tagus
lore: Representative security officer serving in the Romulan military. Assigned to bodyguard duties in the capital city on Romulus.

name: Alliance Interceptor
lore: Bajoran short-range interceptor used in the mirror universe. One of the few military contributions Bajor offers the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance.
game_text: May take off or land once each turn. X=4 moving withing a region.

name: Bajoran Warship
lore: In a parallel universe, the Bajorans grew increasingly hostile after overthrowing the Cardassian Empire. This massive ship attacked the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2370.

name: Alliance Galor
lore: Typical Cardassian warship in the mirror universe. Type 3 designation. Part of the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance fleet. Stationed at Terok Nor.

name: Enhanced Attack Ship
lore: Jem'Hadar attack ship constructed in Alpha Quadrant. One of the first Dominion fighter craft upgraded with Breen energy-dampening technology in 2375.

name: Defiant
lore: Constructed by the Terran Rebellion using station plans of the U.S.S. Defiant. Commanded by Benjamin Sisko during the defense of rebel-hold Terok Nor.

name: I.S.S. Constitution
lore: Typical battle cruiser of the Terran Empire. Outfitted for a variety of mission profiles, including conquest, domination, subjugation, and Imperial enforcement.
game_text: Download Any Universal Terran Empire Original Series personnel

name: I.S.S. Enterprise
lore: Imperial starship. Credited with many successful and profitable missions. I.S.S. Enterprise officers are frequently promoted – usually through assassination.
game_text: Download Any Terran Empire Original Series personnel

name: Rebel Interceptor
lore: Interceptor/fighter used by Terran rebels in the mirror universe. Typically stolen from the Bajorans. Smiley enhanced and commanded this one.
game_text: May take off or land once each turn. X=3 if moving within a region.

name: Type 18 Shuttlepod
lore: Small shuttlecraft. One commanded by Benjamin Sisko guided a silithium comet through the Bajoran wormhole.

name: Mirror Ferengi Shuttle
lore: Typical Ferengi shuttle in the mirror universe. Used by agents working for the Alliance or the Rebellion – or both. Mr. Brunt commanded one.
game_text: Your Mirror Quadrant Ferengi and Ezri may report aboard (if Mr. Brunt, reports for free).

name: Alliance K'Vort
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey. Standard patrol and pursuit craft of the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. One of the most expendable elements of the Regent's fleet.

name: Alliance Vor'Cha
lore: Fast and powerful battle cruiser. Backbone of the Alliance fleet. Their only weakness is their targeting systems; they've been known to chase warp shadows.

name: I.K.C. Ki'tang
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey that fought in the Dominion War. Immune to the Breen energy-dampening weapon due to a fortuitous tritium intermix adjustment.
game_text: Download Intermix Ratio

name: Regency 1
lore: Massive flagship of the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. Commanded by Regent Worf. Has a stolen cloaking device installed – and sabotaged – by Rom.
game_text: Download Stolen Cloaking Device

name: Fesarius
lore: Immense spherical vessel. Flagship of the First Federation. Commanded by Balok.
game_text: Your Balok may report aboard (for free).

name: Battle Cruiser
lore: Klingon battle cruiser, circa 2267. Some were provided to the Romulan Star Empire in exchange for cloaking technology. Commander Charvanek captained one.
game_text: Download Any Universal Original Series Klingon or Romulan

name: Ops: Mirror Universe
game_text: Cards with same Klingon Cardassian Alliance or Terran Empire icon as this Nor are considered to match its affiliation for purposes related to its sites. Compatible OFFICER-classification personnel may report here. Any player may, in place of their normal card play, download to an unopposed site on this station one card which may play there (if reporting a ship or personnel, must be of matching affiliation); player draws no cards that turn. Any Computer Skill personnel unopposed here may commandeer station.

name: Halkan Council
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; any players may download one Mirror QuadrantConstitution-class ship here. Native to this timeline: all cards with both Original Series icon and Mirror Quadrant icon, and all Original Series Equipment cards. Once per turn, one such card reporting at this location may report for free.

name: Aggressive Behavior
lore: In 2372, a spaceborn creature attacked U.S.S. Voyager, trying ot establish dominance. It perceived the ship as a potential rival.
game_text: Unless 2 Anthropology OR Leadership, Anthropology, and CUNNING>35 present, ship is damaged and one crew member is killed (random selection).

name: Assassin's Blade
lore: The Klingon dagger of kut'luch is used in a violent ritual of bloodletting that prepares one to become a warrior. Some also use the blade for more unscrupulous purposes.
game_text: Unless CUNNING>36 OR 2 SECURITY present, assassin kills one personnel present (opponent's choice) except a shape-shifter or android.

name: Astral Eddy
lore: Spatial phenomenon created by an intrusion of subspace into normal space. The resulting discharges of plasmatic energy caused the destruction of a Vostigye science station.
game_text: Unless Navigation, Physics, and 2 ENGINEER present, one crew member (random selection) is killed.

name: Balancing Act
lore: Rarely had Tuvok been in a more precarious position than at a Nezu colony, halfway between the ionosphere and the planet surface, dangling from the bottom of a mag-lev carriage.

name: Civil Unrest
lore: Civil disobedience can often escalate into full-scale conflict. A peaceful demonstration soon turned violent, entangling Captain Janeway and Tom Paris in a domestic brawl.
game_text: Two Away Team members are chosen (random selection). Unless one has Diplomacy, both are "stopped." Mission continues.

name: Common Thief
lore: Although Tau's theft of the main computer processor from U.S.S. Voyager was elaborately staged, Kathryn Janeway regarded him as little more than a petty criminal.
game_text: If any equipment present, discard one (random selection). Otherwise, kills a personnel present (opponent's choice) who has STRENGTH+CUNNING<15. Discard dilemma.

name: Crisis
game_text: To gest past requires Leadership (or Communication and Defense icons in Away Team and an OFFICER-classification personnel (or 2 Defense Borg) aboard your ship at this location.

name: Female's Love Interest
lore: Genetically manipulated to become Taresian, the handsome Taymon was desired by Malia and two other Taresian females.

name: Flash Plasma Storm
lore: Quarantined on a planet due to a viral illness, Janeway and Chakotay were forced to "rough it." They found the sudde plasma storms on the planet as dangerous as their disease.
game_text: Kills each Away Team member who has both STRENGTH<6 (ignoring hand weapon enhancements) and CUNNING<9. Nullified if you have Thermal Deflectors in play.

name: Gravimetric Distortion
lore: Species 8472 uses quantum singularities to cross from their realm of fluidic space into our galaxy. The singularities produce intense gravimetric distortions that can damage nearby ships.
game_text: Ship damaged unless 4 ENGINEER OR 2 Astrophysics OR a personnel who has 2 Navigation OR Guinan aboard.

name: Hanonian Land Eel
lore: While stranded on a savage world by the Kazon-Nistrim, the crew of U.S.S. Voyager encountered a carnivorous creature with an appetite for Starfleet engineers.
game_text: Unless SECURITY, SCIENCE, and STRENGTH>50 present, kills Away Team member with lowest CUNNING or fewest Skill Dot icons (opponent's choice).

name: Hazardous Duty
lore: Losing a crewman under one's command is one of the most difficult realities an officer must face. The tragic loss of life is significant even to a Vulcan.
game_text: To get past requires 2 OFFICER; then place on mission until solved. If any non-OFFICER dies here, its owner loses points (discard dilemma).

name: Hull Breach
lore: In 2372, a spatial scission caused explosive decompression aboard U.S.S. Voyager. Harry Kim was lost in the incident, and later replaced by a duplicate Harry from a duplicate Voyager.
game_text: Unless Environmental Suit present, kills one non-android (random selection) and another non-android of same classification (random selection). Mission continues.

name: Implication
lore: The manager of a Nekrit Supply Depot arrested Chakotay and Tom Paris on charges of conspiracy and murder, based solely on security footage that showed them conversing with the victim.
game_text: To get past requires 3 Diplomacy and INTEGRITY>30 OR Law and CUNNING>30.

name: Kazon Bomb
lore: Tierna's "rescue" by the Voyager crew was part of an elaborate ruse. The Kazon was on a suicide mission, carrying a chemical injection that would convert his blood into a powerful explosive.
game_text: Unless 3 SECURITY and CUNNING>35 OR 2 SECURITY and any tricorder OR 3 Defense Borg present, kills all personnel present who have printed STRENGTH<7. Discard dilemma.

name: Komar Possession
lore: Tuvok was possessed by trianic energy beings known as the Komar. The entities sought to collect neural energy from U.S.S. Voyager crew members.
game_text: Place on one personnel present (random selection). Now and start of each turn, "stops" that personnel and one other personnel present (random selection). Cure with 3 SECURITY.

name: Lack of Preparation
lore: Malon legend warns of poisonous monsters, the Vihaar. When aiding a damaged Malon ship in 2375, a U.S.S. Voyager away team discovered the threat they'd dismissed was all too real.
game_text: Non-Borg: Cannot get past (lose 10 points) unless you could have met mission requirements at start of attempt. ''Borg: ''Must have Communications, Navigation and Defense personnel to proceed.

name: Macrovirus
lore: Initially microscopic virus that absorbs growth hormones from host organisms to augment its own mass. After emerging, specimens continue to grow to billions of times their original size.
game_text: Place on ship. Now and start of each turn, kills lowest STRENGTH OR lowest CUNNING crew member (opponent's choice). Cure with 2 Exobiology and 2 SCIENCE.

name: Male's Love Interest
lore: Mari fruit vendor whose waterplums caught Neelix's eye.

name: Matriarchal Society
lore: The population of the planet Taresia is ninety percent female due to the low birth rate of males – and the fact that, in order to reproduce, the male must be killed.
game_text: Cannot get past unless at least two female Away Team members are present.

name: Navigational Hazards
lore: Seven of Nine and Harry Kim enhanced the Astrometrics Lab aboard U.S.S. Voyager, allowing the crew to plot a new course that took five years off their expected journey home.
game_text: To get past requires Stellar Cartography and 2 Navigation.

name: Radioactive Garbage Scow
lore: The Malon civilization produces over six billion isotons of industrial by-product every day. Their freighters haul away the toxic waste and dispose of it in other regions of the galaxy.

name: Spatial Rift
lore: A rupture in space connected U.S.S. Voyager with its duplicate created by a spatial scission. The two crews had to separate their "siamese ships" that shared a single supply of anti-matter.

name: Subspace Fracture
lore: Instabilities in subspace can cause fractures and chain reactions leading to temporal relocation, death, or worse.
game_text: Entire crew or Away Team is killed unless ENGINEER, SCIENCE, Leadership, and CUNNING>28 present. Discard dilemma.

name: The Cloud
lore: In 2371, U.S.S. Voyager entered what the crew thought was a nebula rich in omicron particles. It was in fact a massive life-form whose physiology reacted violently to the intrusion.
game_text: Unless 2 MEDICAL, 2 ENGINEER, and 2 Astrophysics present, ship is damaged and "stopped" until end of your next turn. Discard dilemma.

name: The Swarm
lore: Fiercely territorial species whose small ships disable enemy vessesl by emitting interferometric pulses. Dubbed "the Swarm" by those few who have survived their armadas.
game_text: Place on ship; WEAPONS are disabled and SHIELDS -2. After start of your next turn,. cure with 3 ENGINEER and Physics in crew. If countdown expires, ship destroyed.

name: Trabe Grenade
lore: Small incendiary devices can be used to create diversions and gain strategic control. An exploding grenade helped Neelix and Mabus escape an underground Kazon prison.
game_text: Kills one Away Team member who has SECURITY or Leadership (random selection) unless that personnel has CUNNING>8. Mission continues.

name: Twisted
lore: Intense electromagnetic charges caused Voyager to fall into a state of structural flux. The fluctuations created a warping effect, turning the ship into a constantly shifting maze.
game_text: Cannot get past unless at least half of personnel in crew or Away Team (round up) each have CUNNING>7.

name: Volcanic Eruption
lore: Many planets suffer from geological instabilities. This can cause problems for unsuspecting – and unprepared – guests.
game_text: Place on planet if no facility is on planet. Now and start of every player's turn, randomly kills one of their personnel present. Nullified if Thermal Deflectors is in play.

name: Bio-Neural Gel Pack
lore: Small, easily replaceable package housing synthetic neural cells in a gelatinous organic suspension. Part of the bio-neural computer system used aboard Intrepid-class starships.
game_text: May report aboard your Intrepid-class ship (for free on U.S.S. Voyager). While on your Intrepid-class ship or Delta Flyer, enhances its attributes all +1. (Cumulative up to +3.)

name: Engineering Kit
lore: Compact assortment of tools for making modifications and repairs to propulsion and computer systems. Many engineers develop a personal attachment to their set.

name: Engineering Tricorder
lore: Diagnostic device specially calibrated for use on mechanical systems. The layout of the Starfleet version is intentionally similar to their standard tricorder to allow easy operation.
game_text: Gives all of your MEDICAL-classification personnel the extra skill of ENGINEER where present.

name: Kazon Disruptor
lore: Typical sidearm employed by the various Kazon sects. Simple design is slightly less powerful than comparable Starfleet arms, but is easily mass-produced even without replicator technology.
game_text: Kazon use only. Reports for free (once each turn). Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Kazon Disruptor Rifle
lore: Relatively unsophisticated beam weapon used by the Kazon. No-frills design abandons aesthetic features in favor of inexpensive production. As deadly as it is ugly.
game_text: Kazon use only. Reports for free (once each turn). Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +3, but loses 1 Diplomacy unless aboard your ship. (Cumulative.)

name: Medical Kit
lore: Collection of medical instruments. Though no substitute for a fully equipped medical facility, such devices are often sufficient to save lives when nothing more is available.

name: Medical PADD
lore: Standard Personal Access Display Device pre-loaded with an extensive database of diseases, treatments, surgical procedures, and other medical information.
game_text: Gives all of your ENGINEER-classification personnel the extra skill of MEDICAL where present.

name: Mobile Holo-Emitter
lore: Portable holographic projector designed by Henry Starling. Based on 29th-century technology he stole from the Timeship Aeon. Acquired by The Doctor in 2373 – or was it 1996?
game_text: May be "worn" by (placed on) one of your Hologram personnel; you may remove it during your turn. Wearer moves normally. While worn, does not count as an Equipment card.

name: Science PADD
lore: Standard Personal Access Display Device pre-loaded with an extensive database of scientific information in a broad sampling of disciplines.
game_text: Gives all of your MEDICAL-classification personnel the extra skill of SCIENCE where present.

name: Starfleet Type II Phaser
lore: Versatile Starfleet hand weapon. Has 16 different power settings ranging from stun to disruption. Beam dispersal can be configured from broad-range to extreme precision.

name: Starfleet Type III Phaser Rifle
lore: Most powerful standard-issue Starfleet hand weapon. Equipped with fully autonomous recharge, multiple target acquisition, and gyrostabilization.
game_text: Federation and Non-Aligned use only. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +3, but loses 1 Diplomacy unless aboard your ship. (Cumulative.)

name: Transporter Control Module
lore: Crucial transporter systems component. Kazon of the Nistrim sect stole one from U.S.S. Voyager. First Maje Jal Culluh used this new technology against his enemies, the Kazon-Relora.
game_text: While aboard your ship or facility with your ENGINEER or Transporter Skill personnel present, that ship or facility has transporters.

name: Vidiian Harvester
lore: Combination disruptor/medical device. A neural resonator stuns potential victims; sophisticated quantum imaging scanners and microtransporters extract live organs from the unwilling donor.
game_text: Each of your Vidiians present is STRENGTH +2 and gains 1 MEDICAL, and in each battle one of them may stun one adversary they just engaged. (Cumulative.)

name: Ancestral Vision
lore: Tribal lore tells of Sky Spirits who guided the Rubber Tree People in Earth's distant past. When Chakotay found the Spirits' home in the Delta Quadrant, he was beset with visions of his ancestors.

name: Captain's Log
lore: A commanding officer's journal of events. Captain Ransom continued keeping his even after abandoning other military protocols and traditions.
game_text: Plays on table. Each of your ships with its matching commander aboard is WEAPONS and SHIELDS +3. (Captain's Order).

name: Fair Play
lore: In 2372, Tom Paris concocted a sweepstakes to guess the daily radiogenic particle count, skimming a tenth of the proceeds for himself. Chakotay put a stop to the game, confiscating the pot.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; may not be nullified. No player may solve an opponent's unique mission unless its point box shows at least 40 points OR both players have a copy of it in play.

name: Kal-Toh
lore: Vulcan game of intricate strategy. Players must find the seeds of order, even in the midst of profound chaos. Tuvok observed that novices often try merely to introduce a spatial balance.
game_text: Plays on table. Once each turn, unless Alien Probe in play, you may discard one card from hand; opponent must discard one of same type (if they cannot, discard Kal-Toh).

name: Lower Decks
lore: Close friendships often form between those serving together on a starship. This was especially true of Maquis who many time fought side-by-side before joining the U.S.S. Voyager crew.
game_text: Plays on table. Each of your non-holographic universal personnel is attributes all +2. (Captain's Order.)

name: Mission Debriefing
lore: Keeping detailed records of missions and discoveries is an essential part of any crew's daily routine. This is even more critical for the only Federation crew in the Delta Quadrant.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Whenever any crew or Away Team finishes a mission attempt (whether successful or not), it is "stopped." (Captain's Order.)

name: The Big Picture
lore: Though facing a long voyage across uncharted space, Kathryn Janeway never lost sight of her ultimate goal – to get her ship and crew home.
game_text: Plays on table. Each player who has not solved (or scouted) at least two missions with point boxes (one Space and one Planet) needs an additional 40 points to win. (May not be nullified.)

name: The Next Emanation
lore: Believing themselves bound for an afterlife, the Vhnori used a device to send their dead through spectral ruptures, unaware the bodies were being sent to decompose on distant asteroids.

name: Villagers with Torches
lore: After years of poverty, the Takarians were eager to be rid of their Great Sages. Fortunately, Chakotay and Tom Paris were there to keep them from being sent away on "wings of fire."
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Whenever opponent begins a planet mission attempt with fewer than three personnel, all are killed unless opponent has Thermal Deflectors in play.

name: Kazon Outpost
lore: Since losing its homeworld, the Kazon Collective raids others, establishing outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one at a Kazon Mission or Non-Aligned mission OR build at such a mission where you have a Kazon ENGINEER. Has no transporters. Download The Kazon Collective

name: Nekrit Supply Depot
lore: Trade center for mining and commercial vessels. Located on the border of the Nekrit Expanse.
game_text: Seed one at any mission that is in (or adjacent to) the Nekrit Expanse Region OR build at such a mission where you have a Non-Aligned Delta Quadrant ENGINEER.

name: Vidiian Outpost
lore: The Vidiian Sodality establishes outposts throughout its territory, often hiding them inside barren planetoids.
game_text: Seed one at a Vidiian Mission or Non-Aligned mission OR build at such a mission where you have a Vidiian ENGINEER. Download The Vidiian Sodality

name: Blue Alert
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Each of your Intrepid-class ships and ships with no staffing requirements may use 2 RANGE to land or take off once each turn. Also, your shuttlecraft may be carried aboard and launched from your ships that have Tractor Beam. (Captain's Order.)

name: Handshake
game_text: Plays once each turn (for free) if you have played no cards this turn and have fewer in hand than opponent; they must choose to discard three cards or allow you to draw three. OR Plays to look at top five cards in any draw deck or discard pile for ten seconds; rearrange as desired. OR Plays if you have at least three other cards in hand; discard entire hand and draw seven cards. Discard incident after any use.

name: Home Away From Home
game_text: Seeds or plays on your ship with one or more staffing icons. If a Delta Quadrant ship with "Alpha Quadrant" in lore: while not in Alpha Quadrant, your equipment and machting Delta Quadrant personnel may report aboard; once each turn, one who has Staff icon may do so for free. If any other non-Borg ship: while not in its native quadrant, your personnel who match ship's affiliation and native quadrant (and your equipment) may report aboard.

name: Auto-Destruct Sequence
lore: When in a hopeless situation facing insurmountable odds, most starship captains would sooner destroy their own vessel than let it fall into enemy hands.

name: Beyond the Subatomic
lore: In 2374, Kes' mental abilities began to grow at an astonishing rate. Soon she was able to perceive and control a new level of reality that exists in the space between subatomic particles.

name: Distortion of Space/Time Continuum
lore: Even minor temporal incursions can cause shock waves with far-reaching effects. Annorax's sweeping interference changed both ancient and recent history throughout the Delta Quadrant.

name: Escape Pod
lore: Rapid-deploy emergency evacuation modules. Most starships are equipped with such systems.

name: Mutation
lore: Tom Paris underwent a horrifying evolution after a transwarp test flight. His mutating DNA caused internal organs to shift, atrophy and reform. His outward transformation was no less disturbing.
game_text: Plays to shuffle top two cards of any discard pile into owner's draw deck. OR Plays once each turn; discard one card to draw two.

name: Nanoprobe Resuscitation
lore: Seven of Nine used a Borg procedure to resuscitate Neelix in 2374, nearly nineteen hours after his death. The Collective has restored drones after almost four times that duration.
game_text: Plays once every turn to return top card of your discard pile to hand. If it is a Personnel card and you have any Communication Borg in play, you may report it to that Borg's location.

name: Quinn
lore: Member of the Q who felt immortal life had become futile, meaningless, and unendurable. Lobbied to be made mortal so he could commit suicide and upset the Continuum's status quo.

name: The Gift
lore: Distortions from Kes' expanding powers threatened to destroy Voyager. To save her friends, she permanently left the ship. To thank them, she pushed them 9,500 lightyears closer to home.
game_text: If you have Kes aboard your ship at a spaceline location, place her out-of-play and relocate that ship to another spaceline location in same quadrant. Ship is "stopped."

name: The Phage
lore: Highly adaptive, deadly virus that has plagued the Vidiians for over two millennia. Destroys genetic codes and cellular structure, requiring constant replacement of decaying organs and tissue.
game_text: Plays at start of mission attempt or personnel battle to kill any one Vidiian present. OR Kills any one of your Vidiians; place that Vidiian beneath draw deck or in hand.

name: The Power
lore: Tanis taught Kes to reach out with her mind, embrace the essence of life, and then transform it into death. "Hurt people, help them... give life, kill. It's all the same."
game_text: Plays once each turn to draw a card OR draw to and discard one of them (your choice) OR draw three and discard one (opponent's choice). (May not be converted to downloads.)

name: Acquire Technology
lore: Sikaris: Obtain trajector transport system from society with strict laws against trading technology with outsiders.

name: Aftermath
lore: Lifeless world: Determine cause of a disaster that obliterated all life on this once-thriving planet.

name: Ambush Ship
lore: Ionized hydrogen cloud: Lure enemy ship to tactically advantageous space and launch an attack.
game_text: X=30 (or 45 if opponent's occupied ship here).

name: Answer Distress Signal
lore: Arrithean space: Respond to a call for help from malfunctioning isomorphic projection alone on alien ship.
game_text: * +10 if a Hologram in crew.

name: Assist Cooperative
lore: Nekrit Expanse Region ● Factionalized colony: Help group of former Borg to unite and end anarchy.
game_text: * +10 if you have a Communications personnel present.

name: Catalog Phenomena
lore: Nekrit Expansion Region ● Plasma storm: Map dust clouds and other hazards in the Expanse.

name: Combat Training
lore: Tarok: Survive training exercises at this formidable Kazon-Ogla base.
game_text: *+5 for each Kazon-Ogla present, up to four.

name: Contact Resistance
lore: Mokra planet: Seek aid from the Alsaurian resistance in freeing prisoners taken by the Mokra.

name: Cure Deadly Virus
lore: Biohazardous world: Develop anti-viral agent for fatal disease that lies dormant in its natural environment.

name: Expose Plot
lore: Banea: Exonerate crewman framed for murder, and reveal conspiracy to commit scientific espionage.

name: Heal Life-form
lore: Nucleogenic cloud: Provide medical aid to spaceborne life-form injured by starship.

name: Inversion Mystery
lore: Inversion nebula: Determine how plasma strands – typically unstable – have survived here for centuries.

name: Investigate Quantum Singularity
lore: Near Ilidaria: Investigate unidentified transmission emanating from this type-four quantum singularity.

name: Kazon Conference
lore: Sobras: Attend meeting of rival Kazon sects.
game_text: +5 for each different Maje present.

name: Liberation
lore: Ocampa planet: Liberate prisoner being held by Kazon sect on the surface of this desert planet.
game_text: Ocampa may report on planet (for free).

name: Prevent Annihilation
lore: Rakosa V: Stop malfunctioning Cardassian warhead from attacking defenseless, highly populated planet.

name: Prison Break
lore: Akritirian space: Locate secret alien prison facility and rescue wrongfully incarcerated crew members.
game_text: May seed up to two Delta Quadrant personnel under here.

name: Reinitialize Warp Reaction
lore: T-class gas giant: Collect radiogenic particles from the rings of this gas giant to restore full warp efficiency.
game_text: Restore solving ship's RANGE used this turn.

name: Research Phage
lore: Avery III: Conduct genetic research on lethal virus that destroys Vidiian cellular structure.

name: Restock Supplies
lore: Planet Hell: Search for fuel and food sources on this world with an inhospitable atmosphere.
game_text: Transporter Skill required to beam up/down here.

name: Restore Victims
lore: Talax: Attempt to restore civilians killed by metreon cascade weapon on the Talaxian moon of Rinax.
game_text: Talaxians may report on planet (for free).

name: Return Life-form
lore: Class-J Nebula: Communicate with electromagnetic life-form on ship and return it to its native environment.

name: Revive Settlers
lore: Kohl settlement: Awaken people trapped in cryonic hibernation on this planet recovering from a glacial freeze.

name: Stop Bombardment
lore: Nezu colony: Discovr cause of repeated asteroid impacts on this resource-abandunt planet.

name: Study Interment Site
lore: Ringed planet: Investigate appearance of humanoid remains on the asteroids of this planet's ring system.

name: Study Interstellar Colony
lore: Interstellar swarm: Study the behavior pattern of this colony of space-dwelling life-forms.
game_text: Ocampa are disabled while here.

name: Tak Tak Negotiation
lore: Tak planet: Obtain information and supplies from culture with highly ritualistic and gestural language.

name: Unseat Dictator
lore: Ilari: Retrieve crewman possessed by the consciousness of a despotic ruler and restore rightful leader.

name: Boarding Party
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, your Boarding Pod may move to "ram" any ship present. Personnel on Pod go aboard; discard Pod. Also, once each turn, your Kazon aboard opponent's ship may use its transporters (ignoring its SHIELDS) OR steal an Equipment card aboard (score points; discard objective) OR download Commandeer Ship there (score double points; discard objective).

name: Divert Power
game_text: Plays on table. At start of each of your turns, one of your ships with ENGINEER (or Navigation Borg) aboard may "transfer power" until start of your next turn; subtract 1 from two of its attributes and add 2 to the remaining attribute. OR Plays on your ship with ENGINEER (or Defense Borg) and Computer Skill aboard. WEAPONS or SHIELDS are +4 until start of your next turn, then discard objective. (Captain's Order.)

name: Tabor
lore: Bajoran whose brother and grandfather were killed in Crell Moset's grisly experiments. Under Teero's influence, helped his fellow Maquis seize U.S.S. Voyager in 2377.

name: Tabor
lore: Bajoran whose brother and grandfather were killed in Crell Moset's grisly experiments. Under Teero's influence, helped his fellow Maquis seize U.S.S. Voyager in 2377.

name: Seska
lore: Devious Cardassian operative. Broke her cover after becoming trapped in the Delta Quadrant aboard U.S.S. Voyager. Formed an alliance with the Kazon-Nistrim.

name: Seska
lore: Devious Cardassian operative. Broke her cover after becoming trapped in the Delta Quadrant aboard U.S.S. Voyager. Formed an alliance with the Kazon-Nistrim.

name: Ayala
lore: Versatile Maquis who has served exceptionally aboard U.S.S. Voyager. His many assignments have included tactical, ops, and guarding the brig.

name: Ayala
lore: Versatile Maquis who has served exceptionally aboard U.S.S. Voyager. His many assignments have included tactical, ops, and guarding the brig.

name: B'Elanna Torres
lore: Former Maquis who became chief engineer of U.S.S. Voyager. Her Klingon and human halves are often at odds with each other. Married Tom Paris in 2377.

name: B'Elanna Torres
lore: Former Maquis who became chief engineer of U.S.S. Voyager. Her Klingon and human halves are often at odds with each other. Married Tom Paris in 2377.

name: Cavit
lore: Lieutenant commander typical of executive officers stationed on smaller Starfleet ships. Posted to U.S.S. Voyager. Scornful of Maquis soldiers and sympathizers.

name: Chakotay
lore: Former Maquis leader now serving as first officer on U.S.S. Voyager. Deeply spiritual. Honors the heritage of his grandfathers, though far from their sacred places.

name: Chakotay
lore: Former Maquis leader now serving as first officer on U.S.S. Voyager. Deeply spiritual. Honors the heritage of his grandfathers, though far from their sacred places.

name: Chell
lore: Talkative Bolian. Underwent field training soon after coming aboard U.S.S. Voyager. Has been a model – though somewhat paranoid – crewman ever since.

name: Chell
lore: Talkative Bolian. Underwent field training soon after coming aboard U.S.S. Voyager. Has been a model – though somewhat paranoid – crewman ever since.

name: Dr. Fitzgerald
lore: Typical of chief medical officers assigned to starships on short tours of duty. Stationed on Caldik Prime during the accident resulting in Tom Paris' discharge from Starfleet.

name: Harry Kim
lore: U.S.S. Voyager operations officer, his first posting out of the Academy. Until then, had never missed calling home every week. Plays reed instruments. Unlucky at love.

name: Joseph Carey
lore: Representative of staff in engineering. Has a wife and two sons. Is building a model of U.S.S. Voyager. Doubts he'll finish before the real one returns home.

name: Kathryn Janeway
lore: Former science officer of U.S.S. Al-Batani. Dog lover. Inspired by Amelia Earhart, Leonardo da Vinci, and her father. Has promised herself to get her crew home.

name: Lon Suder
lore: Dangerous, violent Betazoid. Unable to sense even his own emotions. Murdered Crewman Darwin. Sought to atone after a mindmeld with Tuvok. Skilled floriculturuist.

name: Lon Suder
lore: Dangerous, violent Betazoid. Unable to sense even his own emotions. Murdered Crewman Darwin. Sought to atone after a mindmeld with Tuvok. Skilled floriculturuist.

name: Mariah Henley
lore: Typical of Maquis who initially had difficulty fitting in aboard U.S.S. Voyager. Her home colony was ceded to Cardassia in the formation of the Demilitarized Zone.

name: Mariah Henley
lore: Typical of Maquis who initially had difficulty fitting in aboard U.S.S. Voyager. Her home colony was ceded to Cardassia in the formation of the Demilitarized Zone.

name: Marla Gilmore
lore: Senior engineer on U.S.S. Equinox. Frequent attacks by the Ankari "spirits" have made her claustrophobic. Eventually became part of the U.S.S. Voyager crew.

name: Marla Gilmore
lore: Senior engineer on U.S.S. Equinox. Frequent attacks by the Ankari "spirits" have made her claustrophobic. Eventually became part of the U.S.S. Voyager crew.

name: Maxwell Burke
lore: First officer of U.S.S. Equinox. Almost dropped out of Starfleet. Was once romantically involved with B'Elanna Torres. Still the p'tak she claimed him to be.

name: Maxwell Burke
lore: First officer of U.S.S. Equinox. Almost dropped out of Starfleet. Was once romantically involved with B'Elanna Torres. Still the p'tak she claimed him to be.

name: Mitchell
lore: Operator of the junction room on deck 16 of U.S.S. Voyager. Knows the bowels of the ship better than almost anyone aboard – including Captain Janeway.

name: Mortimer Harren
lore: Solitary theoretician. Signed aboard U.S.S. Voyager to meet an admissions requirement at a cosmological institute. Not even his mother called him Mortimer.

name: Noah Lessing
lore: Acting science officer of U.S.S. Equinox. Fiercely loyal to Rudolph Ransom. Demoted to crewman by Kathryn Janeway when he joined U.S.S. Voyager.

name: Noah Lessing
lore: Acting science officer of U.S.S. Equinox. Fiercely loyal to Rudolph Ransom. Demoted to crewman by Kathryn Janeway when he joined U.S.S. Voyager.

name: Rollins
lore: Served at tactical aboard U.S.S. Voyager during Tuvok's absence in 2371. Received a promotion to lieutenant for exceptional service during the Caretaker incident.

name: Rudolph Ransom
lore: Accomplished exobiologist and diplomat. Captain of U.S.S. Equinox. Called "Rudy" by his crew. Lost in Delta Quadrant, has relaxed Starfleet protocols and principles.

name: Rudolph Ransom
lore: Accomplished exobiologist and diplomat. Captain of U.S.S. Equinox. Called "Rudy" by his crew. Lost in Delta Quadrant, has relaxed Starfleet protocols and principles.

name: Samantha Wildman
lore: Separated from her husband Greskrendtregk by the Caretaker's actions. Their child, Naomi Wildman, has been raised on U.S.S. Voyager. Head of xenobiology.

name: Stadi
lore: Female Betazoid representative of Starfleet helm officers. Has piloted a wide variety of Federation ships, most notably the prototype U.S.S. Intrepid.

name: The Doctor
lore: E.M.H. on U.S.S. Voyager. Years of continuous use have expanded his program to include a vast knowledge of Delta Quadrant species and a love of opera.

name: Thompson
lore: Typical U.S.S. Equinox crewman corrupted by Ransom and Burke's leadership. Science department head. Has also manned tactical since the security chief's death.

name: Thompson
lore: Typical U.S.S. Equinox crewman corrupted by Ransom and Burke's leadership. Science department head. Has also manned tactical since the security chief's death.

name: Tom Paris
lore: Best pilot aboard U.S.S. Voyager. Also acts as medical assistant. Led design and construction of the Delta Flyer. Profilic holodeck programmer. 20th-century history buff.

name: Tuvok
lore: Vulcan security chief of U.S.S. Voyager. Janeway's tactical officer and confidant for many years. Former instructor at Starfleet Academy. Breeds prize orchids.

name: Vorik
lore: Vulcan serving on U.SS. Voyager. Twin of Taurik. Tried to bond with B'Elanna Torres when enduring Pon farr in 2373. Purged the blood fever in ritual Koon-ut-kal-if-fee.

name: William Telfer
lore: One of several crewmen serving in the science labs on U.S.S. Voyager. Billy Telfer is a hypocondriac. Also afraid of medication and counseling. Friend of Tal Celes.

name: Dr. Arridor
lore: Served under Goss. While trapped with Kol in the Delta Quadrant, set up a lucrative exploitation of the Takarians by posing as one of their "Great Sages."

name: Kol
lore: Piloted a shuttle sent into the Barzan wormhole by Goss in 2366. After posing as the Takarians' "Lesser Sage," returned to the Alpha Quadrant via the same wormhole.

name: Corez
lore: Representative of Kazon aligned with the Pommar sect. Has served as bodyguard to Minnis. Stood watch over a group of Trabe being held prisoner on Sobras.

name: Culluh
lore: First maje of the Kazon-Nistrim. Romantically involved with Seska. Commands a Kazon Raider. Seeks to capture U.S.S. Voyager and its technology at any cost.

name: Haliz
lore: One of the greatest Kazon-Ogla warriors. Serves under Razik. Admired by many young Ogla, including Karden. Killed a Relora with his bare hands to earn his name.

name: Halok
lore: Kazon-Nistrim representative of technicians in Culluh's crew. Gained knowledge of bio-neural technology in his time aboard the commandeered U.S.S. Voyager.

name: Haron
lore: First maje of the powerful Kazon-Relora, blood enemies of the Nistrim. Commands countless soldiers and a vast fleet of ships – including his own Kazon Raider.

name: Jabin
lore: First maje of the Kazon-Ogla in 2371. Has laid claim to the Ocampa planet. His efforts to tap its subterranean resources have been thwarted by the Caretaker.

name: Karden
lore: Young Kazon-Ogla now come of age. Bravely earned his name like his brother, Kinell, before him. The only Kazon to ever form a real bond with a "Federation."

name: Loran
lore: First maje of the Kazon-Hobii. Has twice attended meetings with rivals in the hopes of ending skirmishes his small sect lacks the reserves to defend against.

name: Maniz
lore: Typical of warriors to the Kazon-Nistrim sect. Supervised repairs to U.S.S. Voyager after its capture in 2372. Resents Seska's hold over Culluh.

name: Minnis
lore: First maje of the Kazon-Pommar sect. Agreed to host negotiations between the Trabe and several Kazon sects in 2372. Gained little prestige from the debacle.

name: Narret
lore: Loyal Kazon-Nistrim typical of Culluh's soldiers. Stood proudly with his maje as a bridge officer on the captured U.S.S. Voyager.

name: Rabek
lore: Kazon-Nistrim physician. Typical of personal attendants often retained by a first maje. Seska did not find his abilities particularly impressive.

name: Razik
lore: First maje of the Kazon-Ogla. Personally oversees the training of new Ogla warriors. Intimately familiar with the base on Tarok. Commands a Kazon Warship.

name: Rettick
lore: Kazon-Nistrim serving under Culluh. Accompanied him at the Sobras conference. Received files from Jonas on Tom Paris' experimental transwarp flight.

name: Ril
lore: Representative of females throughout Kazon society. Has few rights, little power. Part of the Ogla sect. One of several woman romantically involved with Jabin.

name: Saldin
lore: Representative of non-military Kazon. Pledged to the Pommar sect. Bartender and cook at the dive frequented by Tersa. Remembers Neelix's last visit there all too well.

name: Tersa
lore: Kazon-Pommar well connected with Minnis. Has had prior dealings with Neelix. Infatuated with a dancer who works at a bar on Sobras. Not her type.

name: Tierna
lore: Kazon-Nistrim serving as Seska's aide. Assigned a suicide mission by Culluh as part of an elaborate plan to take U.S.S. Voyager. Determined to succeed.

name: Valek
lore: First maje of Kazon-Oglamar. Expertly uses the slim resources of his sect in hit-and-run attacks, often staged near nebulae and other astronomical phenomena.

name: Arturis
lore: Gifted linguist. Built the Dauntless to deceive and punish the Voyager crew. Blames them for the recent assimilation of his people, "Species 116," by the Borg.

name: Dr. Ma'Bor Jetrel
lore: Haakonian who developed the metrean cascade weapon. Deeply regretful of the hundreds of thousands of Talaxians killed by his invention. Dying of metremia.

name: Dr. Neria
lore: Vhnori thanatologist. Studied Harry Kim in the hopes of learning more about his people's afterlife. Believes the truth is out there.

name: Kes
lore: Four-year-old Ocampa. Mentored by The Doctor and Tuvok. Has begun to tap latent abilities few others of her species have. Was romantically involved with Neelix.

name: Kes
lore: Four-year-old Ocampa. Mentored by The Doctor and Tuvok. Has begun to tap latent abilities few others of her species have. Was romantically involved with Neelix.

name: Kurros
lore: Humanoid leader of Think Tank, an elite group that solves problems – for a price. Brilliant tactician. Often does the exact opposite of what an adversary expects.

name: Magistrate Drang
lore: Nechani official and chairman of his planet's judicial committee. Though his people divide spiritual matters from government, his faith is quite strong.

name: Neelix
lore: Talaxian jack-of-all-trades. Has served on a Trabalian freighter, mining colony, and Voyager. Serves as cook, morale officer, guide, and sometimes ambassador.

name: Neelix
lore: Talaxian jack-of-all-trades. Has served on a Trabalian freighter, mining colony, and Voyager. Serves as cook, morale officer, guide, and sometimes ambassador.

name: Nimira
lore: Telepathic Mari. Chief Examiner of the Constabulary. The unusual laws of her species have reduced crime, but created a black market for illicit violent thoughts.

name: Paxim
lore: Talaxian commander of a squadron garrisoned at the mining colony on Prema II. Tom Paris enlisted his help to reclaim Voyager from Kazon-Nistrim in 2373.

name: Penk
lore: Norcadian entertainment producer. Arrogant. Corrupt. Abducts alien from all over the sector and forces them to fight in the Tsunkatse matches.

name: Tanis
lore: Unusually old Ocampa male with strong psychokinetic powers. Follower of Suspiria. Delivered Voyager to her so she could avenge the death of her mate, the Caretaker.

name: The Pendari Champion
lore: Crowd favorite in the Tsunkatse matches broadcast by Penk. Electrifying Pendari known for his superior strength, bad temper, and keen sense of smell.

name: Dr. Telek R'Mor
lore: Romulan Astrophysical Academy member on deep space duty in 2351. Beamed to the present via a micro-wormhole to the U.S.S. Voyager.

name: Nevala
lore: Skilled pilot serving under Rekarl. Her family's brushes with the Tal Shiar have left her highly suspicious and distrustful of others – even by Romulan standards.

name: Rekar
lore: Seized and commanded the U.S.S. Prometheus. Planned to deliver it to the Tal Shiar. Didn't anticipate the resourcefulness of two Starfleet holograms.

name: Danara Pel
lore: Hematologist who treated a phage outbreak on Fina Prime. Became romantically involved with The Doctor when she spent nearly three weeks on U.S.S. Voyager.

name: Dereth
lore: Vidiian honatta to Motura. Tasked with obtaining new organs for his charge's survival. Duty-bound to take them from the living if a dead "donor" is unavailable.

name: Drenol
lore: Planned to ambush U.S.S. Voyager in 2371 in a region filled with subspace vacuoles. A vengeful version of Kes from five years in the future tried to aid his efforts.

name: Hophalin
lore: Representative of technicians serving the Vidiian Sedality. Posted to the Avery III installation. Confident in the sophistication of his data encryption routines.

name: Losarus
lore: Typical Vidiian researcher of astronomical and planetary sciences. Has a cardiovascular system highly susceptible to the phage. Has had 17 heart replacement surgeries.

name: Motura
lore: Vidiian sculptor. Would have died of the phage if not for lungs stolen from Neelix. Willing to be punished. When shown mercy instead, responded in kind to save Neelix.

name: Nadirum
lore: Commanded a Vidiian Cruiser. Attempted to harvest organs from the U.S.S. Voyager crew in 2372. Dozens like him are on the same single-minded mission.

name: Nirata
lore: Representative of Vidiian general medical practitioners. Chose to enter military service rather than pledge himself as honatta to a single individual.

name: Sethis
lore: Overseer typical of Vidiians in charge of slave labor at large facilities like that on Avery III. Gets the most from his captives before sending them to Organ Processing.

name: Sorum
lore: Typical prison worker and bodyguard serving aboard Vidiian ships and installations. Fears the phage will soon leave him too weak to continue his duties.

name: Sulan
lore: Chief Surgeon of the Vidiian Sodality. Divided B'Elanna Torres into two beings – fully Human and fully Klingon – to study the phage's effects on Klingon genetic material.

name: Telari
lore: Medical aide aboard a Vidiian Cruiser. When not assisting in surgery or harvesting, serves as relief science officer.

name: Thaden
lore: Representative of surgical technicians on Vidiian ships. Well versed in medical procedures and ship systems; supervises both repairs and organ harvesting missions.

name: Delta Flyer
lore: Designed and often commanded by Tom Paris. Sports an ultra-aerodynamic tetraburnium alloy hull, retractable nacelle, unimatrix shielding, and photonic missiles.
game_text: May report aboard your U.S.S. Voyager (for free). Download Evasive Maneuvers

name: Type 9 Shuttlecraft
lore: Typical of shuttlecraft carried aboard Intrepid-class sharships. U.S.S. Voyager carries an unusually large complement.
game_text: May report aboard your Intrepid- and Nova-class ships .

name: U.S.S. Equinox
lore: NCC-72381. Science vessel pulled from Alpha Quadrant by the Caretaker. Its rogue crew designed and enhanced warp drive, killing nucleogenic life-forms for fuel.
game_text: X=4 if any crew member has "U.S.S. Equinox" in lore.

name: U.S.S. Equinox
lore: NCC-72381. Science vessel pulled from Alpha Quadrant by the Caretaker. Its rogue crew designed and enhanced warp drive, killing nucleogenic life-forms for fuel.
game_text: X=4 if any crew member has "U.S.S. Equinox" in lore.

name: U.S.S. Intrepid
lore: Prototype introduced in the early 2370s. Its bio-neural circuits respond faster than optical relays. Average crew complement of 140. Capable of a sustained warp 9.975.

name: U.S.S. Voyager
lore: NCC-74656. Commanded by Kathryn Janeway. Pulled 70,000 lightyears from the Alpha Quadrant. Its crew has spent nearly seven years on a long trek home.
game_text: Download Bio-Neural Gel Pack Download Blue Alert

name: Kazon Raider
lore: Ship design stolen when the Trabe were overthrown in 2346. Favored by sects with more limited resources.
game_text: Kazon shuttlecraft may report, be carried, and launch aboard.

name: Kazon Shuttle
lore: Kazon shuttlecraft. Equipped with bow modifications designed to puncture a starship hull.
game_text: Once each turn, may take off or land. Download Boarding Party

name: Kazon Warship
lore: Enormous Kazon vessel used as a mobile base of operations. Dwarfs even D'deridex-class ships.

name: Bothan Vessel
lore: Standard ship design used by a reclusive, territorial race with powerful psionic abilities. Possesses technology which allows it to seem invisible to enemy vessels.

name: Vidiian Cruiser
lore: Largest starship in the Vidiian fleet. Capable of grappling onto an enemy ship, subduing it for boarding. Drenol commanded one.
game_text: Download Vidiian Boarding Claw.

name: Vidiian Interceptor
lore: Formidable ship favored for agility in battle. Suited to hit-and-fade attacks. Sulan commanded one prior to his promotion to Chief Surgeon of the Sodality.

name: Vidiian Scout Vessel
lore: Small, non-military Vidiian ship, still powerfully equipped in case of urgent medical needs. Both Dereth and Danara Pel have commanded one.

name: Ankari "Spirits"
game_text: Unless 3 Honor and INTEGRITY>35 present, place on ship. Now and start of each turn, kills two crew members (random selection). Cure with 3 ENGINEER and Exobiology.

name: Impressive Trophies
lore: Hirogen hunters always search for prey that provide the greatest challenge – and the most unique relics to adorn their ships.
game_text: Unless CUNNING>50, crew or Away Team member with the most Skill Dot icons OR highest CUNNING + STRENGTH (opponent's choice) is captured. Discard dilemma.

name: Invasive Procedures
lore: Srivani researchers covertly boarded U.S.S. Voyager in 2374. Using a phase variance to avoid detection, they performed invasive, and sometimes fatal, medical tests on the crew.
game_text: Unless a Defense Borg OR MEDICAL, CUNNING>35, and a phaser or disruptor present, place on ship; quarantined. Each crew member loses first-listed skill and is attributes all -2.

name: Photonic Energy Being
lore: A noncorporeal life-form took hostages when another of its kind was unknowingly captured and experimented on by the Voyager crew. The Doctor ultimately negotiated their safe return.
game_text: Three crew members (random selection) are held with dilemma atop mission; discard all when countdown expires. Cure with Hologram personnel OR Anthropology and Diplomacy.

name: Replicator Accident
lore: Nucleonic radiation from the explosion of a stolen – and incorrectly installed – food replicator mutated the cells of a Kazon-Nistrim crew, fusing them with inorganic matter.

name: Sabotaged Negotiations
lore: Kathryn Janeway convinced several Kazon majes to hold a peace conference with the Tabe leader Mabus. He in turn betrayed her trust and attempted to massacre the Kazon leadership.
game_text: To get past, four personnel present (random selection) "attend a conference." If their total INTEGRITY<24, each one without Treachery x2 is killed.

name: The Clown: Beneath the Mask
lore: The Clown was most interested in the minds of those who had truly known fear and could appreciate what he represented. He was most unreasonable when dealing with anyone else.
game_text: To get past, one personnel must have total attributes>23.

name: The Clown: My Festival
lore: The subconscious world of the Kohl settlers turned nightmarish when a character arrived to embody their anxiety and fears, playing games with them according to his own malicious rules.
game_text: To get past, crew or Away Team must have no fewer personnel than lowest INTEGRITY present and no more personnel than highest INTEGRITY present.

name: The Weak Will Perish
lore: During brief telepathic connections, Kes learned the purpose of Species 8472's invasion of the Delta Quadrant. As the Borg discovered, they were quite capable of carrying out their threats.

name: Transwarp Network Gateway
game_text: Seed one during outpost phase on any spaceline end OR play on any spaceline location where you have a Navigation Borg. Any player may play a Transwarp Conduit (or another copy of this doorway) to move any or all of that's player's ships from this Transwarp Network Gateway to another OR Downloads Transwarp Conduit (discard doorway).

name: Borg Data Node
lore: Borg information storage unit containing assimilation logistics, sensor telemetry, and vessel movements. Voyager salvaged these from the wreckage of a destroyed probe in 2375.
game_text: If present with a Communications Borg, once each turn, may download one Adapt card to hand OR glance for 10 seconds at crew of any one ship or top card of any player's draw deck.

name: Borg Nanoprobes
lore: Submicroscopic robots saturating a Borg's bloodstream. Injected into potential new drones, beginning their assimilation. Modified by the Voyager crew to use as a weapon against Species 8472.
game_text: Once per turn, where present, may abduct and assimilate one personnel just stunned by your Defense drone OR nullify a Species 8472-related dilemma (except Gravimetric Distortion).

name: Borg Vinculum
lore: Functions: Process and disseminate information relevant to the collective. Establish transneural connections between drones. Purge individuality; bring order to chaos.
game_text: If your Communications Borg present, all your Borg at this location present with a Communications Borg share regular skills (each has every such skill at highest level). (Immune to Disruptor Overload.)

name: Hirogen Disruptor Rifle
lore: Extremely high-powered weapon favored by Hirogen hunters. Constructed of solid monotanium. Over one meter in length. Equipped with a short-range tactical scanner for tracking prey.
game_text: Hirogen use only. Each of your Hirogen present is STRENGTH +4 and CUNNING +2, but loses all Diplomacy unless aboard your ship. (Cumulative.)

name: Hirogen Talon
lore: After cornering or capturing their prey, many Hirogen hunters prefer to use a simple blade weapon to prolong the exhilaration of making the kill.
game_text: Hirogen use only. Reports for free. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +1. (Cumulative.) May report to a just-initiated personnel battle involving your Hirogen card(s).

name: Maturation Chamber
lore: Functions: Prepare neonatal drones for integration into the collective. Protect and accelerate development. Restructure synaptic pathways; facilitate formation of thoracic nodes.
game_text: Once each turn, you may download to Chamber one Universal drone in place of one card draw OR report to Chamber one Universal drone (for free).

name: Activate Subcommands
lore: A single Borg cube often carries of a complement of over 64,000 drones. Most remain dormant in their alcoves until activated to perform a specific task.
game_text: Downloads one Communications Borg drone, one Navigation Borg drone and one Defense Borg drone. Discard event and draw no cards this turn.

name: Alas, Poor Drone
lore: The Borg Queen searched tenaciously for the interlink frequency connecting the errant drones of Unimatrix Zero. Analyzing those she had discovered brought her closer to finding them all.
game_text: Plays on table. Once each turn, you may download a Communications or Defense drone from hand or in play to draw one card (or two if drone was present with your Borg Queen).

name: Cranial Transceiver Implant
lore: Borg implant that interprets and logs all instructions sent to a drone. Operates on any array of transpectral frequencies capable of transmission across hundreds of light-years.
game_text: Plays on your drone; it is CUNNING +2. If a Communications Borg, once each turn, you may download any Borg Only objective OR discard your current objective.

name: Meditation
lore: "A-koo-chee-moya... to my father... Kolopak... if you can hear me among these unnamed stars, I ask you to continue to watch over me as you've always done... A-koo-chee-moya."
game_text: Plays on table. At any time, you may discard one card from hand. For rest of that turn, each time you draw a card, you may do so from the bottom of your draw deck.

name: Omega Particle
lore: Unstable molecule that can power up an entire planet – or render warp travel impossible in the wake of its explosion. Designated Particle 010 by the Borg, who regard it as harmonious perfection.
game_text: Plays on your outpost; any player may download Omega Directive or Harness Particle 010. When countdown expires, destroys outpost and all ships there; mission is span +3.

name: Quantum Slipstream Drive
lore: Advanced technology that can propel a ship many times faster than warp drive. Though the Voyager crew never reliably adapted the system, the Think Tank still took interest in the theory.
game_text: Plays on your ship that has full RANGE available (for free if U.S.S. Dauntless). Move ship to end of another spaceline OR elsewhere on same spaceline. RANGE is used; discard event.

name: Borg Outpost
lore: Identification: BORG OUTPOSTTask: Distribute resources in specified unimatirx.
game_text: Seed one at any Space mission with no affiliation icons OR build at such a mission (or at an assimilated planet) where you have a Borg ENGINEER.

name: Unicomplex
lore: Identification: BORG UNICOMPLEXTask: Centralize all collective operations. Coordinate.
game_text: Seed or plays at any Space mission with no affiliation icons. Once each turn, Borg Queen OR one unique drone OR one unique ship may report for free here.

name: Hirogen Outpost
lore: For 100,000 years, the nomadic Hirogen have hunted prey, establishing outposts throughout their territory.
game_text: Seed one at a Hirogen mission or any Space mission with no affiliation icons OR build at such mission where you have a Hirogen ENGINEER. Has a holodeck.

name: Cortical Node Implant
game_text: Plays on your Borg. If a Communications Borg, once each turn, may "transfer data" if present with a Borg Data Node; draw one card (may not be converted to a download). Also, each of your Borg with a Cortical Node Implant may, once every turn, suspend play to "regulate implants": subtract 2 from any attribute and add 2 to any other attribute until end of turn.

name: Feedback Surge
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. If opponent completes Establich Gateway targeting a mission they did not seed, you score those points (instead of opponent). Also, if opponent discards any seed cards using Ajur, Boratus, Senior Staff Meeting, or their own dilemma, you may immediately re-seed them under any mission(s); opponent loses 10 points for each such card.

name: Relics of the Chase
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once per battle, your Hirogen may capture an opposing personnel he just stunned. Also, once each turn, your Hirogen using a Hirogen Talon may place in point area one personnel he just killed in personnel battle (or, if he is an Alpha-Hirogen, one captive he is escorting); score points equal to that personnel's highest printed attribute.

name: Rituals of the Hunt
game_text: Plays on your prey (any opponent's personnel); you may return incident to hand at any time. (Unique.) Know your prey. Your Hirogen who have Anthropology add prey's printed regular skills. Stalk your prey. Your equipment and Hirogen personnel may report aboard your Hirogen ships. Capture your prey. If present with prey, your Hirogen using Hirogen Talon may capture them (discard incident).

name: Adapt: Modulate Shields
lore: Phased energy weapons are of limited effectiveness against the Borg. After only a few charges, a hive is able to modify the personal shields of its drones to absorb any further attacks.
game_text: Plays and remains on a phaser or disruptor just used to stun or mortally wound one of your Communications Borg. Your Borg are immune to all weapons with that exact card title.

name: Adapt: Negate Obstruction
lore: By 2375, the Borg had encountered and catalogued over 10,000 different species. This vast, accumulated knowledge is sufficient to overcome virtually any obstacle.
game_text: Nullifies a dilemma (except a Q-related dilemma ) just encountered by your Communications Borg if your Borg encountered that dilemma (or a copy) on a previous turn.

name: Awaken
lore: The Borg do not typically take preemptive measures against potential hazards. Once a threat is established, however, resources are allocated both swiftly and efficiently.
game_text: '''Downloads one Communications or Navigation drone. OR Plays at start of battle to download to one of your ships at that location one Defense drone (two if opponent initiated this battle).

name: Multivector Assault Mode
lore: New technology designed for the U.S.S. Prometheus, allowing it to split into three separate ships during a battle. Programmed with hundred of computer-controlled attack patterns.
game_text: Plays at start of battle (once per battle) involving your U.S.S. Prometheus OR at least three of your ships. One of those ships is WEAPONS and SHIELDS +5 until end of battle.

name: Narrow Escape
lore: The writings of ancient Chinese philosopher Sun Tzu on the art of warfare are still taught at Starfleet Academy. "He will triumph who knows when to fight... and when not to fight."
game_text: Plays on your staffed, undocked ship if its SHIELDS are less then half of opponent's total usable WEAPONS here. You may immediately move ship up to its total RANGE.

name: Corner Enemy Ship
lore: Dense nebula: Flush out enemy hiding amidst the radiation of this anomaly.
game_text: May attempt only if your total WEAPONS>15 here.

name: Establish Settlement
lore: Planet in Grid 622: Help Klingon pioneers begin a new Empire on this world very much like Qo'noS.
game_text: *Discard up to five Delta Quadrant Klingons for +5 each.

name: Hunt Alien (TB)|
lore: Uncharted asteroid belt: Stalk and kill wounded member of Species 8472.

name: Maintenance Overhaul
lore: Uninhabited planet: Set down on this world to perform complete repairs and upgrades on ship systems.
game_text: When you solve, you may download Divert Power.

name: Repair Null Space Catapult
lore: Interstellar space: Stabilize and make use of high-speed propulsion device built by alien explorer.
game_text: May relocate solving ship to any spaceline location.

name: Secure Station
lore: Hirogen relay station: Guard against violations of Hirogen property.

name: Assimilate Species
game_text: Plays on table; target (name) a species. Your Borg may beam to and battle a crew or Away Team containing a personnel of that species, but may not mortally wound. At end of battle, immediately probe (draw probe card, discard objective):Defense : Distinctiveness added. If you won battle, and your Borg Nanoprobes or Assimilation Table present, all stunned personnel of target species present are assimilated.

name: Assimilate Starship
game_text: Plays on table. Target an opponent's ship. Your Borg may scout that ship. (Whenever no active Borg aboard target during your turn, you may beam one scout aboard.) After scouting complete, if your Borg have Computer Skill aboard that ship, you may probe:Communications, Defense: Assimilated. Place on ship. May download one Objective card.

name: Omega Directive
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Place on your ship with matching commander aboard. (Nullified if no Command personnel aboard.) While ship is at same location as an Omega Particle, it may ignore affiliation attack restrictions, and end of each turn you must probe:Download : Threat eliminated. Discard Particle; draw two cards and score points; discard objective.

name: Reassimilate Lost Drone
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Target an opponent's non-Borg. If you have Borg Queen in play, you may probe: Defense, Defense : Coercion. If your Borg ship is at same location, target is abducted and relocated to that ship. Communications : Collaboration. If abducted target is present with Borg Queen, place on target (assimilated); worth 5 points per Skill Dot while objective on target (10 points per Skill Dot if target is One).'''

name: Borg Queen
lore: "We all originated from lesser species. I myself came from Species 125. But that's irrelevant now. We are Borg... Our thoughts are one... One order, one voice."

name: Eight of Eighteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: ANNEXATION DRONETASK: Facilitate assimilation of enemy vessels.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Eight of Fifteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: ANTITOXIN DRONETASK: Analyze biological and chemical weapons. Adapt.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Eleven of Eighteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: AUGMENTATION DRONETASK: Equip drones with cybernetic components.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Eleven of Twelve
lore: IDENTIFICATION: CONNECTIVITY DRONETASK: Monitor interlink aboard Borg vessels. Maintain.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Fifth
lore: Immature drone of Species 639, Norcadian; irrelevant designation: Mezoti. Detected Harry Kim's presence aboard her ship by the trail of playing cards he'd left.

name: First
lore: Immature, humanoid drone. Hostile and irrational. Self-designated leader of a group of neonatal drones activated prematurely by malfunctions aboard his cube.

name: Four of Nine
lore: IDENTIFICATION: HEURISTICS DRONETASK: Secondary adjunct of unimatrix zero one.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid; Species 571.

name: Nine of Fifteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: ISOTOPE DRONETASK: Study Particle 010. Disseminate findings.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Nine of Twelve
lore: IDENTIFICATION: NETWORK DRONETASK: Accelerate construction of transwarp gateways.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Bolian species.

name: Second
lore: Immature drone of Brunali species; irrelevant designation Icheb. A model of efficiency, yet failed to establish order among the young drones of his hive.

name: Seven of Nine
lore: IDENTIFICATION: PROFICIENCY DRONETASK: Tertiary adjunct of unimatrix zero one.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Human species

name: Seventeen of Eighteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: PURIFICATION DRONETASK: Process acquired resources. Optimize consumption.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Six of Twelve
lore: IDENTIFICATION: SENTINEL DRONETASK: Assess defensive measures. Classify. Overcome.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Third and Fourth
lore: Immature drones of Wysanti species; irrelevant designations: Rebi and Azan. Assigned by the First to accelerate the development of new drones in their hive.

name: Three of Nine
lore: IDENTIFICATION: TACTICIAN DRONETASK: Auxiliary processor of unimatrix zero one.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Bajoran species.

name: Two of Nine
lore: IDENTIFICATION: TRANSTATOR DRONETASK: Primary adjunct of unimatrix zero one.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Two of Twelve
lore: IDENTIFICATION: XENOLOGY DRONETASK: Assess suitability of alien cultures for assimilation.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Angelo Tassoni
lore: One of the U.S.S. Equinox crewmen stripped of rank by Kathryn Janeway upon joining the U.S.S. Voyager. Fit in with his new crew without major incident.

name: Angelo Tassoni
lore: One of the U.S.S. Equinox crewmen stripped of rank by Kathryn Janeway upon joining the U.S.S. Voyager. Fit in with his new crew without major incident.

name: Deanna Troi
lore: ½ Betazoid, ½ human counselor of U.S.S. Enterprise-E – and Reginald Barclay. After years of friendship, is once again romantically involved with William T. Riker

name: Equinox Doctor
lore: E.M.H. on U.S.S. Equinox. Designed and performed criminal experiments on alien life after his ethical subroutines were deleted by ship's crew.

name: Equinox Doctor
lore: E.M.H. on U.S.S. Equinox. Designed and performed criminal experiments on alien life after his ethical subroutines were deleted by ship's crew.

name: Hogan
lore: Maquis crewman who thought briefly of rebelling against Captain Janeway after a close friend's death in 2372. Ultimately found his place in the Voyager crew.

name: Hogan
lore: Maquis crewman who thought briefly of rebelling against Captain Janeway after a close friend's death in 2372. Ultimately found his place in the Voyager crew.

name: Reginald Barclay
lore: Dedicated member of the Pathfinder Project. Established a means for Voyager to regularly communicate with Earth from tens of thousands of light-years away.

name: Gegis
lore: DaiMon who reprogrammed the Federation hologram intercepted by Nunk. "Mastermind" of a plan to return Voyager to the Delta Quadrant through a geodesic fold.

name: Nunk
lore: Ferengi romantically involved with Leosa. Sent her to get information from Reginald Barclay on the Pathfinder Project. Plans to spend his payoff on lobe enlargements.

name: Yeggie
lore: Avaricious Ferengi. Plotted with Gegis and Nunk to extract the 3.6 million Borg nanoprobes from Seven of Nine's body and sell them at six bars of latinum per unit.

name: Davar
lore: Reckless hunter who tired of participating in holographic scenarios aboard the commandeered Voyager. Joined Turanj in hunting prey, against express orders from Karr.

name: Decaren
lore: Alpha-Hirogen who agreed to hunt alongside the crew of Voyager. A master in tracking, but overly prone to the fervor of an imminent kill. Commands a Hunting Vessel.

name: Donik
lore: Technician who programmed enhancements for the Hirogen holograms under orders from Decaren. Later joined Kejal to help build a better life for his creations.

name: Gann
lore: Belligerent Beta-Hirogen. Clashed with Decaren, Netek, and Kathryn Janeway during the hologram hunt. Finally came to respect the Voyager crew as worthy prey.

name: Hajur
lore: Hirogen captured by Penk on his son's first hunt. Has fought at Tsunkatse for nearly two decades. Trained Seven of Nine, hoping she could end his captivity.

name: Hajur
lore: Hirogen captured by Penk on his son's first hunt. Has fought at Tsunkatse for nearly two decades. Trained Seven of Nine, hoping she could end his captivity.

name: Harkan
lore: Typical mentor of fledgling hunters. Stationed at the training facility near the Ovion system. Prepares young Hirogen to join Decaren's hunting group.

name: Idrin
lore: Massive Alpha-Hirogen in command of a solitary Hunting Vessel. Less interested in the hunt than the spoils of his conquests, envy of his peers, and fear of his captives.

name: Jetarn
lore: Hunter ordered by Karr to assist in triage on Voyager crew members wounded on the holodeck. Like Jorik, performed cursorily at best.

name: Jorik
lore: Medic who built neural interfaces to subdue the Voyager crew. Patched them up after hunters stabbed, shot, beat, phasered, and bat'lethed them in Karr's holoscenarios.

name: Karon
lore: Diligent Alpha-Hirogen. Commanded a Hunting Vessel that stalked a member of Species 8472. Has an unrivaled understanding of the behavior of prey.

name: Karr
lore: Alpha-Hirogen who captured Voyager in 2374. Used its holodecks to study his prey's history. Hoped for lessons to save his own culture from stagnation and extinction.

name: Konuric
lore: Representative of headstrong hunters. Once punished by Netek with months of remedial training. Never believed holograms to be worthy prey.

name: Netek
lore: Impatient Alpha-Hirogen who took over the hunt for the escaped Hirogen holograms. Appreciated the irony of their prowess, but underestimated them nevertheless.

name: Ranjen
lore: Typical of Hirogen whose first loyalty is to a hunting group. Skilled pilot. Served as Beta-Hirogen under Idrin; challenged his obsession with collecting relics.

name: Takirac
lore: One of the hunters serving with Karr in 2374. Accepted an optronic datacore from Kathryn Janeway in cease-fire talks, bringing holographic technology to the Hirogen.

name: Turanj
lore: Rash hunter. Grudgingly took part in a holodeck scenario of Nazi Germany's 20th-century occupation of France. Never grasped Karr's aims in studying the Voyager prey.

name: Vurond
lore: Typical of relatively inexperienced hunters still learning more advanced techniques of stalking prey. Has pursued further training as Beta-Hirogen for Karon.

name: Lagren
lore: Kazon-Ogla who maintains the settlement on the Ocampa planet. Has searched unsuccessfully for a way to penetrate the Caretaker's subterranean shield.

name: Surat
lore: First maje of the Kazon-Mostral. Has slyly arranged many brief – but effective – alliances with other majes against larger sects. Commands a Kazon Raider.

name: Tanar
lore: Kazon of the Nistrim sect. Has served aboard Culluh's ship for many years. His opinions have come to carry a bit more weight with his maje than most.

name: Ch'Regha
lore: I.K.C. Voq'leng crew member. After an initial attraction to Harry Kim, became romantically involved with Neelix. She was his little par'machkai; he, her fearless warrior.

name: Kamok
lore: Typical crewman of I.K.C. Voq'leng. Has low regard for Kohlar. Eagerly aided T'Greth's bid to seize a new ship after the captain foolishly destroyed their battle cruiser.

name: Kohlar
lore: Captain of I.K.C. Voq'leng. Seized a chance to end his crew's long journey of hardship and isolation, casting the unborn child of B'Elanna Torres as the Kuvah'Magh.

name: Morak
lore: Tactical officer of I.K.C. Voq'leng. Devout believer in the prophecies of the Sacred Scrolls. Banded with T'Greth in an attempt to commandeer U.S.S. Voyager.

name: T'Greth
lore: Kohlar's first officer; scorned his reading of the Scrolls. Defeated in combat by Tom Paris when the Nehret set in. Cured by the Kuvah'Magh – with The Doctor's help.

name: B'Elanna
lore: An aggressive ½ Klingon, ½ human, B'Elanna Torres left Starfleet Academy during her second year. Joined the Maquis after Captain Chakotay saved her life.

name: Captain Chakotay
lore: Former Starfleet officer who resigned to defend his home colony. Chakotay leads a loyal group of Maquis rebels in raids on Cardassian targets near the Badlands.

name: Fennim
lore: One of only two humanoid members of the Think Tank. Instrumental in the mercenary group's discovery of a cure for the Vidiian Phage.

name: Kes
lore: In 2376, a vengeful Kes returned to Voyager, an outcast with powers far beyond any other Ocampa. Angry with Janeway, who encouraged her to unlock these abilities.

name: Lansor
lore: Humanoid mathematician once assimilated as the Borg, Two of Nine. Still linked with Marika and P'Chan.

name: Mabus
lore: Trabe governor. Constantly plotting vengeance on the Kazon sects that killed his parents, continuing a cycle of hatred and persecution between their peoples.

name: Marika
lore: Bajoran assimilated as a Borg while on U.S.S. Excalibur. Became Three of Nine. She escaped the Borg in 2375.

name: Marika
lore: Bajoran assimilated as a Borg while on U.S.S. Excalibur. Became Three of Nine. She escaped the Borg in 2375.

name: Mezoti
lore: Norcadian girl being raised on Voyager. Of the four Borg children rescued from a damaged cube, was quickest in reclaiming her individuality. Likes sculpting and bugs.

name: Mezoti
lore: Norcadian girl being raised on Voyager. Of the four Borg children rescued from a damaged cube, was quickest in reclaiming her individuality. Likes sculpting and bugs.

name: One
lore: Futuristic Borg created when The Doctor's holo-emitter accidentally fused with nanoprobes. His unique systems include reactive body armor and internal transporters.

name: Orum
lore: Romulan medic. Borg, liberated in 2368. Since then has worked with Riley Frazier, trying to forge cooperation among warring factions of Borg from his former cube.

name: Orum
lore: Romulan medic. Borg, liberated in 2368. Since then has worked with Riley Frazier, trying to forge cooperation among warring factions of Borg from his former cube.

name: P'Chan
lore: Humanoid who cared for his parents, Domar and Ansha, until the Borg assimilated him as Four of Nine.

name: Rebi and Azan
lore: Wysanti twins living under Seven of Nine's guidance. Freed from the Borg in 2376. Can still use their neural interfaces to share information – and cheat at Kadis-Kot.

name: Rebi and Azan
lore: Wysanti twins living under Seven of Nine's guidance. Freed from the Borg in 2376. Can still use their neural interfaces to share information – and cheat at Kadis-Kot.

name: Riley Frazier
lore: Human science officer of U.S.S. Roosevelt. Assimilated as a Borg at Wolf 359. Freed a year later when her ship was damaged. Romantically involved with Chakotay.

name: Riley Frazier
lore: Human science officer of U.S.S. Roosevelt. Assimilated as a Borg at Wolf 359. Freed a year later when her ship was damaged. Romantically involved with Chakotay.

name: Sullin
lore: Female, coelenterate life-form. Regarded by Kurros as perhaps the most gifted member of the Think Tank. Expert on temporal physics and tectonic instabilities.

name: The Artificial Intelligence
lore: Inorganic, genderless Think Tank member. Has the mind of a mathematician and the soul of an artist. Interviewed Seven of Nine to assess her worthiness as a recruit.

name: Thenelak
lore: Romulan female who assisted in the capture of U.S.S. Prometheus. Majored in warp theory at an academy located on a colony world 31 light-years from Romulus.

name: Dilanum
lore: Representative of maintenance workers assigned to Avery III. Alien prisoners made to assist him often wish they had instead been put to work digging tunnels.

name: Sinaren
lore: Vidiian researcher. Among many who believe a cure for the phage might be found by scrutinizing extinct civilizations who were wiped out by plague.

name: Borg Cube
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BORG CUBETASK: Assimilate new cultures and technologies. Add to the perfection of the collective.
game_text: Your equipment and Borg personnel may report aboard.

name: Borg Probe
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BORG PROBETASK: Explore unimatrices at the borders of Borg space. Locate biological and technological distinctiveness.

name: Borg Queen's Ship
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BORG QUEEN'S SHIPTASK: Execute assignments under personal command of the Borg Queen.
game_text: May be fully staffed by Borg Queen. Your equipment and Borg personnel may report aboard.

name: Borg Tactical Cube
lore: IDENTIFICATION: CLASS-4 TACTICAL CUBETASK: Respond to incursions into Borg space. Eliminate resistance.
game_text: Your equipment and Borg personnel may report aboard (for free, once each turn, if a Defense personnel).

name: U.S.S. Prometheus
