lore: ½ Vulcan, ½ Human son of Sarek and Amanda Grayson. Over 140-year-old ambassador. On private mission to Romulus. Mindmelded with Picard.

name: Bajoran Wormhole: Mirror Universe
game_text: Seeds (in any phase) or plays in Mirror Quadrant. Limit one. Inserts into spaceline to create a Bajor Region location (span 1); any player may download Bajoran Wormhole. Any ship may move between here and a Bajoran Wormhole if damaged or if ENGINEER and SCIENCE aboard, then is "stopped." OR Plays at any time to nullify any card which is closing or destroying Bajoran Wormhole (discard doorway).

name: Bajoran Wormhole
game_text: Requires two Bajoran Wormhole cards; each inserts into a spaceline to create a location (span 1). Play one in Alpha Quadrant (Bajor Region); download the other to Gamma Quadrant . Limit one per quadrant. While in play, any ship may move from one end to the other, then is "stopped." OR Plays at any time to nullify any card which is closing or destroying Bajoran Wormhole (discard doorway).

name: Slar
lore: Vicious Gorn Slavemaster of the Tholian Assembly who was assigned to gut the Starship Defiant in the Mirror Universe. He does not trust Terrans.

name: Handshake
game_text: Plays once each turn (for free) if you have played no cards this turn and have fewer in hand than opponent; they must choose to discard three cards or allow you to draw three. OR Plays to look at top five cards in any draw deck or discard pile for ten seconds; rearrange as desired. OR Plays if you have at least three other cards in hand; discard entire hand and draw seven cards. Discard incident after any use.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
lore: Rescued Borg counterpart. After returning to his command of the U.S.S. Enterprise, Picard developed a violent vendetta against the Borg.

name: Porthos
lore: Captain Archer's pet beagle. Likes cheese. T'Pol thinks he smells worse than even the humans do.

name: Antaak
lore: Physician responsible, albeit accidentally, for creating the disfiguring Klingon augment virus. Found a future in cranial reconstruction. Had a knack for diplomacy.

name: Rotation Damage Marker
game_text: Unprepared and naive of the dangers that they would encounter, the Enterprise took its share of damage in those first few years. The ship and crew held up remarkably well under pressure.

name: Rotation Damage Marker
game_text: The U.S.S. Constellation took heavy damage from the Doomsday Machine as it past through system L-374. The planet killer proved to be quite formidable in battle against two Federation starships.

name: Rotation Damage Marker
game_text: The Future Enterprise was more advanced after its refit. With more powerful engines and advanced firepower, it was able to dispense two Klingon attack cruisers while only taking minimal damage.

name: Rotation Damage Marker
game_text: The damage was heavy on both sides of the war between the Federation and the Dominion. While the Dominion held little regard for their fallen, the Alpha Quadrant species did not share that sentiment.

name: Rotation Damage Marker
game_text: With some help from the future, the U.S.S. Voyager was able to get past a Borg armada. One transphasic torpedo would damage a Borg cube, and two is enough to destroy it.

name: Rotation Damage Marker
game_text: When V'Ger came to Earth in search of its creator, it destroyed the Klingon vessels that penetrated the massive energy cloud. It viewed carbon based units aboard as a damaging infestation to be eliminated.

name: Rotation Damage Marker
game_text: While in command of the Reliant, Khan was able to damage the flagship of the Federation. Only by hiding in the Mutara Nebula was the Enterprise able to evade him long enough to destroy the Reliant.

name: Rotation Damage Marker
game_text: Unfortunately for James T. Kirk, the U.S.S. Enterprise 1701-B left spacedock without many of its key components installed. It was thus ill equipped to deal with the effects of the Nexus and was damaged.

name: Rotation Damage Marker
game_text: Only with the combined efforts of Earth's entire defenses and the return of the U.S.S. Enterprise-E, was Starfleet able to destroy the Borg cube that attacked at Sector 001. But by then, the damage was done.

name: Space-Time Portal
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Alternate cards may seed and play (once per turn). At any time, you may discard this doorway from table to download Alternate Universe Door OR nullify Temporal Rift OR play a second Wormhole interrupt OR return one of your ships in play, and all cards on it, to owners' hands OR (once per game) allow one Alternate ship to report with crew (each must be Alternate) at any location.

name: Betazoid Gift Box
lore: Traditional device for presenting important gifts. Its sculpted face comes to life boisterously presenting its content to the recipient.
game_text: Immediately look through your draw deck for up to thirty seconds and choose three cards to place in your hand. Reshuffle draw deck and discard artifact.

name: The Guardian of Forever
game_text: Plays on Gateway (limit one). Once per turn, one or more personnel present may time travel to a time location in this quadrant, or may return here from there (with any of owner's other personnel present). OR Plays once each turn to nullify any card that is closing Guardian, or to draw up to four cards if your Archaeology or Anthropology personnel just time traveled back to Guardian; place doorway out-of-play.

name: Temporal Shifting
lore: Time Travel can afford the user certain abilities that might not be available to those native to the current time.
game_text: Plays on a player. That player must choose to either discard three cards from hand or discard one Alternate card. If that player discards a Alternate card, he/she may draw up to four cards. Discard event.

name: Deep Space 9
lore: Formerly known as Terok Nor. Now a Bajoran trading center and administrative facility run by the Federation.
game_text: Seeds during dilemma at a Bajor Region location. If commandeered by any personnel who is not Bajoran or Federation affiliation, flip card over. (Not duplicatable.)

name: HQ: Secure Homeworld
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
game_text: Seeds or plays on a homeworld. Your Away Teams which include a personnel who matches homeworld's affiliation may attempt the mission using these requirements:Leadership x2 + SECURITY + (Honor OR Treachery) + any one attribute total > point value of missionWhen you solve mission, capture all opposing personnel on planet who do not match affiliation of homeworld.'''

name: Agent Garak
lore: Elim Garak joined the Federation in its fight against the Dominion. Served as a code breaker in spite of his fear he was betraying his homeworld.

name: Captain Nog
lore: In an alternate timeline, Nog served as captain of the U.S.S. Defiant. Aided Jake Sisko in an effort to reverse a time-altering subspace inversion.

name: George and Gracie
lore: Two humpback whales, male and female, raised in captivity on 20th-century Earth. Gracie is pregnant.

name: U.S.S. Voyager
lore: NCC-74656. Commanded by Kathryn Janeway. Pulled 70,000 light years from the Alpha Quadrant. Its crew has spent nearly seven years on a long trek home.
game_text: DownloadBio-Neural Gel Pack DownloadBlue Alert

name: Sternenflotten Phaserpistole
lore: [There are only two settings. Stun, and kill. Make sure to not get them mixed up.
game_text: [Starfleet use only. Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2 (or +3 if that personnel has Security). (Cumulative).

page_title: A Fast Ship Would Be Nice (VP TCC)
name: A Fast Ship Would Be Nice
base_name: A Fast Ship Would Be Nice
property_logo: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
lore: After beaming Kirk and Spock aboard the Qel'Poh to escape the destruction of Genesis, Maltz told Kirk he didn't deserve to live. Kirk replied, "Fine, I'll kill you later."
game_text: Kills one personnel (opponent's choice). You may substitute a bodyguard or Guard Drone present OR any empty ship here (moved to opponent's side of spaceline; commandeered).

name: Espionage: Bajoran on Dominion
lore: No strangers to oppression, many Bajorans fought the 2374 Dominion occupation from within. With Odo's help, Kira's small "resistance cell" paved the way for the Dominion withdrawal.
game_text: Plays on any Dominion mission (for free if you have Odo there). Your Bajoran personnel may now attempt this mission. Discard after mission completed.

name: Wall of Ships
lore: A wall display of all ships to bear the name Enterprise is a tradition built into each new ship of the line. This exhibit is in the ready room aboard Enterprise.
game_text: Downloads any Enterprise. Discard event. OR Plays on table. Adds 1 to RANGE, WEAPONS and SHIELDS of each of your Enterprises. (Cumulative.)

name: We Are the Borg
lore: "We have analyzed your defensive capabilities as being unable to withstand us. If you defend yourselves, you will be punished.
game_text: Downloads two Defense drones; discard event. OR Plays on table. Each turn, report one of your Borg cards for free or make an additional end-of-turn draw (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge).

name: Dr. McCoy
lore: Leonard H. "Bones" McCoy. Chief medical officer of the starship Enterprise. Awarded the Legion of Honor.

name: First Officer Spock
lore: ½ Vulcan, ½ human. History will record that Mr. Spock rose to command the I.S.S. Enterprise, then reformed the Empire and ultimately caused its downfall.

name: James T. Kirk
lore: Famous captain thought lost in 2293. Returned from the nexus 78 years later to make a difference once more.

name: Future Enterprise
lore: Commanded by Admiral Riker in an alternate future. U.S.S. Enterprise-D was fitted with a third warp engine nacelle, greatly enhancing its speed and power.

name: Enterprise
lore: Legendary prototype designed for deep space travel. Commanded by Jonathan Archer. First Starfleet vessel to bear the name that would symbolize Starfleet's elite.
game_text: This ship is attributes +1 for each Starfleet Command you have aboard it.

name: Dyson Sphere Door
game_text: Place one atop Dilemma side deck (up to 13 dilemmas) during the seed phase. Dilemma side deck is now open and in play (immune to cards which close doorways). You may seed Alternate dilemmas. Dilemmas you download must come from here (ignoring cards that prevent downloading). When opponent seeds Empok Nor, you may download and seed up to three dilemmas related to Empok Nor beneath station from here.

name: Defiant Dedication Plaque
lore: Commemorative inscription mounted on the bridge of the U.S.S. Defiant. Serves as an inspiration to the Defiant crew. Meant little to the soldiers of the Terran Empire.
game_text: Plays on table. Each of your ships with its matching commander aboard is RANGE +2, or +3 if ship is Defiant class. (Not cumulative. Captain's Order.)

name: Jean-Luc
lore: Like Melville's fictional Captain Ahab, the former Borg Jean-Luc Picard burned with vengeance. Piled upon the Borg the sum of all his rage and hate.

name: Phoenix
lore: Earth's first faster-than-light-ship. Launched via a Titan missile. Commanded by Zefram Cochrane.
game_text: May take off and land once per game. Worth points while in orbit.

name: Barclay's Protomorphosis Disease
lore: Contagious affliction which causes animals to de-evolve into ancestral forms. Disease named for Lieutenant Reginald Barclay.
game_text: Entire crew or Away Team (except Androids) de-evolves (dies) unless MEDICAL, SCIENCE and SECURITY present. Discard dilemma.

name: Denevan Neural Parasites
lore: Deadly flying parasites decimated the populations of Levinius V, Theta Cygni XII, Ingraham B, and finally Deneva, where they killed George Samuel Kirk and his wife, Aurelan.
game_text: Attacks half of Away Team (random selection, round up). You may protect one selected personnel for each phaser, disruptor, or unselected Defense Borg present; others are killed.

name: Quark's Isolinear Rods
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. You may ignore each opponent's Computer Crash. Also, you may nullify any or all cards preventing you from playing Q's Tent (discard incident after card taken from tent). Once per game, you may download to hand Intermix Ratio, The Big Picture or a non-OFFICER who has Computer Skill x2 (discard incident). Does not count down while you have any Quark in play.

name: Mutation
lore: Chakotay, along with many of Voyager's crew, suffered from bizarre symptoms as a result of genetic tampering. The Srivani responsible for the experimentation were not easy to uncover.
game_text: Plays to shuffle top two cards of any discard pile into owner's draw deck. OR Plays once each turn, discard one card to draw two.

name: Admiral McCoy
lore: Not a psychiatrist, mechanic, coal miner, bricklayer, scientist, physicist, moon shuttle conductor, escalator, magician or fish peddler. Just an old country doctor.

name: Deanna Troi
lore: Commander Deanna Troi is ship's counselor aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise-E. ½ Betazoid, ½ Human. Not much of a fan of Steppenwolf.

name: Quark
lore: Bartender and proprietor of Quark's Bar, Grill, Gaming House and Holosuite Arcade. Longtime nuisance to Odo.

name: Morn
lore: Lurian. Freighter captain. Frequent patron of Quark's. Part of the infamous Lissepian Mother's Day Heist. Hides a small fortune in latinum in his second stomach.

name: Ru'afo
lore: Leader of the Son'a, a people banished from their home planet by the Ba'ku. Will let nothing stand in the way of his revenge upon them, least of all his Federation allies.

name: Ezri
lore: Trill mercenary in the mirror universe. Unlike Ezri Dax, this Ezri is not joined to a symbiont. Partners with Mr. Brunt. Romantically involved with the Intendant.

name: The Pendari Champion
lore: Crowd favorite in the Tsunkatse matches broadcast by Penk. Electrifying Pendari known for his superior strength, bad temper, and keen sense of smell.

name: Hanonian Land Eel
lore: While stranded on a savage world by the Kazon-Nistrim, the crew of U.S.S. Voyager encountered a carnivorous creature with an appetite for Starfleet engineers.
game_text: Unless SECURITY, SCIENCE, and STRENGTH>50 present, kills Away Team member with lowest CUNNING or fewest Skill Dot icons (opponent's choice).

name: Mirror Terok Nor
lore: Cardassian ore processing facility commandeered by the Terran Rebellion in the mirror universe.
game_text: Seeds during dilemma phase at Bajor. If commandeered, new controller may flip card over. (Not duplicatable.) Quark's Bar may seed or play on this Nor; Bajoran Wormhole Ops may not.

name: Process Ore
game_text: Plays on an Ore Processing Unit. Start of each turn, if you control this Nor at a planet location and you have a matching ENGINEER or SECURITY personnel unopposed here, you may "process ore." Discard one card from hand, place bottom card of discard pile beneath draw deck or out-of-play, then draw up to two cards.

name: Christopher Pike
lore: Noted captain. Succeeded Robert April and commanded the Starship Enterprise for 13 years. Accepted promotion in 2263 and relinquished command to James T. Kirk.

name: Geordi La Forge
lore: In 2371, Chief Engineer Geordi La Forge received ocular implants that surpassed the functions of his old VISOR. Attended Zefram Cochrane High School.

name: Jadzia Dax
lore: Trill. Disregarded her commitments to both Starfleet and Trill custom in order to honor a Klingon blood oath sworn by her symbiont's previous host, Curzon Dax.

name: Anij
lore: Ba'ku female who became romantically involved with Jean-Luc Picard. In her 300 years, learned to sustain a perfect moment in time – but never learned to swim.

name: Dr. Telek R'Mor
lore: Romulan Astrophysical Academy member on deep space duty in 2351. Beamed to the present via a micro-wormhole to the U.S.S. Voyager.

name: Kobayashi Maru Scenario
property_logo: Star Trek: The Wrath of Khan
game_text: Seeds or plays on a mission; adds Computer Skill to mission requirements. At the start of each mission attempt here, one attempting personnel (random selection) is placed beneath this incident ("in play" for uniqueness only). When a player solves this mission, all of their compatible personnel beneath this incident join the solving crew or Away Team (any other personnel are discarded).

name: Continuing Mission
game_text: Seeds one on table. You may download one Warp Core card. Your personnel and ships that have a Star Trek: The Next Generation or Star Trek: Generations property logo gain TNG (even if not in play). Twice each turn, when you play a TNG personnel with four or fewer Skill Dot icons (and no Download), you may draw a card. Discard this incident if you play (or have played) a non-TNG personnel or ship.

name: Zefram Cochrane
lore: Inventor of warp drive. Reluctant hero. First human to make contact with an alien species. Ready to make history, even with a four-alarm hangover.

name: Quinn
lore: Member of the Q who felt immortal life had become futile, meaningless, and unendurable. Lobbied to be made mortal so he could commit suicide and upset the Continuum's status quo.
game_text: Thrice per game, nullifies an interrupt or event just played or revealed (even a Treaty), unless immune to Kevin Uxbridge or Amanda Rogers.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
lore: Captain Jean-Luc Picard of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Born in LaBarre, France. Has an artificial heart. Reads Shakespeare. Something of a Renaissance man.

name: John Harriman
lore: Son of a respected Federation official. Captain of U.S.S. Enterprise-B. Usually confident in dealing with reporters, but on the ship's maiden voyage was having an off day.

name: Koloth
lore: Called d'akturak, "ice man," by Curzon Dax due to his negotiating prowess. Commanded the I.K.C. Gr'oth during the Sherman's Planet sabotage mission in 2267.

name: Dr. Soong
lore: Reclusive genius who perfected the positronic brain originally proposed in the 20th century. Ex-husband of Juliana. "Father" of the androids Data and Lore.

name: Weyoun 6
lore: Activated after his predecessor's suspicious death, this clone of the Vorta Weyoun had subtle errors. He hoped to end the Dominion War by defecting to Odo's side.

name: U.S.S. Enterprise-B
lore: Third Federation ship so christened, launched on stardate 9715. Became fully operational the following Tuesday.
game_text: El-Aurians may report aboard.

name: U.S.S. Reliant
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
lore: NCC-1864. Placed at the disposal of Project Genesis to locate a suitable Stage Three testing site. Captured at Ceti Alpha V and subsequently commanded by Khan.

name: Camp Khitomer
lore: 2293 Khitomer: Site of the ground-breaking peace talks between the Federation and the Klingon Empire.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Native to this timeline: all cards with both Classic Films and Alternate icon. Once per turn, one such card reporting at this location may report for free.

name: Spacedoor
property_logo: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
game_text: Seeds on your outpost during outpost phase. Spacedoor is now open, reducing outpost's SHIELDS by 8 (cumulative). In place of your normal card play, you may either "overhaul" one of your empty ships here (return to ship to hand; nullifies any Static Warp Bubbles affecting you) OR download to here one Spacedock or Universal that is compatible with outpost. Then close (flip over) Spacedoor.

name: Hajur
lore: Hirogen captured by Penk on his son's first hunt. Has fought at Tsunkatse for nearly two decades. Trained Seven of Nine, hoping she could end his captivity.

name: Always A Chess Game
game_text: Plays on table. Once each turn, your TNG Romulan personnel (except Tal Shiar , CIVILIAN , or V.I.P.) may report for free to your Romulan outpost OR you may report (for free) to your ship its TNG Romulan matching commander. Once per game, score 5 points when your TNG Romulan personnel helps solve a non-Universal Neutral Zone mission.

name: Ferengi Infestation
lore: In anticipation of a prisoner exchange, a Dominion delegation boarded Empok Nor in 2374. They found that Ferengi were already entrenched there.
game_text: Opponent may download up to two male Ferengi to a facility at this location (or up to six if facility is Empok Nor). To get past requires 2 SECURITY and CUNNING>50.

name: Kamala
lore: The perfect mate, an empathic metamorph. Kriosian mutant romantically involved with Jean-Luc Picard. Dutifully married Alrik despite her bond to Jean-Luc.

name: Khan
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
lore: Genetically engineered criminal exiled to Ceti Alpha V by Kirk. Bent solely on avenging the death of his wife.

name: V'Ger
lore: Massive living machine created by an unknown race around the lost NASA space probe Voyager VI. Left a trail of destruction during its return to Earth in search of its creator.
game_text: Ship is destroyed unless 2 Empathy OR Diplomacy, Anthropology, and Computer Skill present. Discard dilemma.

page_title: What Does God Need With a Starship? (VP TCC)
name: What Does God Need With a Starship?
base_name: What Does God Need With a Starship?
lore: While orbiting Pollux IV, the godlike Apollo caused the wind to withdraw from the sails of the Starship Enterprise and demanded that the crew worship him and pay tribute.
game_text: Nullifies ^"God"#Star Trek 1st Edition|"God."çç OR Plays once every turn. Opponent chooses: you may download a ship to any location OR you may "stop" or "unstop" (your choice) any ship in play.

name: Construct Starship
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. In place of your normal card play, you may download any outpost or headquarters (if you have a matching ENGINEER at an appropriate location) OR download Spacedock (even to a docking site) OR download a unique ship to your facility that has a Spacedock (if you have an ENGINEER aboard who is that ship's matching commander). Discard objective OR draw no cards this turn.

name: Kor
lore: Dahar master. Legendary warrior. Former ambassador to Vulcan. Victorious at Klach D'Kel Brakt. Swore blood oath against the Albino. Sought the Sword of Kahless.

name: Maxwell Forrest
lore: Respected Admiral. Friend of Soval. Sent the crew of Enterprise out into the final frontier to go where no man had gone before.

name: U.S.S. Enterprise-A
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: Specially commissioned in 2286 to replace the famous ship lost one year earlier. Proudly continued the mission of its predecessor under the command of James T. Kirk.
game_text: Any Federation Classic Films personnel OR James T. Kirk

name: H.M.S. Bounty
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
lore: Bird-of-prey captained by Kruge on a covert mission to the Genesis Planet. Stolen and commanded by Admiral Kirk; re-christened with historical irony by Dr. McCoy.

name: Tsunkatse Ship
lore: Formidable vessel commanded by Penk, from which he broadcasts his popular fighting circuit. Heavily shielded to prevent anyone from abducting his competitors.
game_text: Your personnel with "Tsunkatse" in lore may report aboard.

name: U.S.S. Prometheus
lore: Prototype Starfleet vessel, NX-59650. Boasts ablative armor, regenerative shielding, and multivector assault mode. Captured by Romulans during a test flight.
game_text: May download Multivector Assault Mode when in battle.

name: Elim
lore: Elim Garak forced himself to interrogate Odo in an attempt to regain favor with his father, Enabran Tain.

name: Secret Agent Julian Bashir
lore: Bashir... Julian Bashir. Role in a holoprogram created by his friend Felix, of a spy for Great Britain in the Cold War of 20th-century Earth. Has escaped countless traps.

name: Reshape the Quadrant
game_text: Seed one on table. You may download one Reactor Core card. Your Nors, personnel and ships that have a Star Trek: Deep Space Nine property logo gain DS9 (even if not in play). Discard incident if you play (or have played) a non-DS9 personnel or ship.

name: DNA Clues
lore: Although a thorough analysis of a DNA sample can be a time-consuming endeavor, it can also provide information crucial to successfully dealing with biomedical hazards.
game_text: Place on mission. Further dilemmas requiring any MEDICAL here require 2 more if you continue OR 2 less if crew or Away Team has Exobiology and "stops" now to investigate.

name: Gomtuu Shock Wave
lore: Although some creatures have intricate greeting rituals, others will defend themselves violently at the first sign of danger.
game_text: Unless 2 Diplomacy and INTEGRITY>32 OR Empathy and INTEGRITY>35 present, all undocked ships at this location are damaged and relocated one location toward far end of spaceline.

name: Horta
lore: Silicon-based life-form native to Janus VI. Every 50,000 years, all Horta die off except one, which must repopulate the species through egg laying. Will kill to protect its young.
game_text: Place on planet. Now and end of every player's turn, kills one of that player's personnel present (random selection). Cure with 2 Leadership, 2 Mindmeld, and 2 Exobiology.

name: Baseball
lore: Benjamin Sisko was forced to abandon Deep Space 9 to spare Bajor from the Dominion's wrath. He left his prized baseball behind as a message to Gul Dukat that he would return.
game_text: Plays to score points if you just commandeered opponent's facility. Lose points if opponent regains control.

name: Evade Borg Vessel
lore: Paulson Nebula: Hide from pursuing Borg cube in dense, hazardous nebula.
game_text: Only one of your ships may battle here every turn.

name: Odo
lore: Changeling security chief of Deep Space 9. Not very good at pretense. Always investigates Quark.

name: Dukat
lore: Gul. Ex-prefect of Bajor. Commander of the Prakesh. Father of Ziyal. Cardassian Union liaison with Dominion. Desires to regain control of Terok Nor.

name: Yeoman Rand
lore: Janice Rand is yeoman to Captain Kirk aboard the Enterprise. Captain of the Academy Diving Team in 2264-65. Student of horticulture and xenobotany.

name: Kang
lore: Faced Kirk at Beta XII-A. Swore blood oath against the Albino with Kor, Koloth and Curzon Dax to avenge the death of his firstborn son.

name: Executive Authorization
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: In the interest of security, Klingon Chancellor Azetbur and the Federation president agreed to share the location of the forthcoming peace conference with only their most trusted aides.
game_text: To get past requires a President, High Council Leader, General, Legate, Chancellor, Proconsul, Chairman, Intendant, Minister, Kai, Founder, Nagus, Governor, Queen, counterpart, or PADD.

name: Tuvok
lore: Vulcan security chief of U.S.S. Voyager. Janeway's tactical officer and confidant for many years. Former instructor at Starfleet Academy. Breeds prize orchids.

name: Lore
lore: Evil Soong-type android. Data's "elder brother."

name: Mr. Spock
lore: Highly logical starship Enterprise first officer. First Vulcan in Starfleet. Suppresses his human half. Fascinating.

name: Defiant Volée
lore: En 2371, les maquisards ont commandé le U.S.S. Defiant lors d'une attaque contre les forces cardassiennes.
game_text: Ne peut pas contenir de vaisseaux sauf des navettes.

page_title: Female's Love Interest & Garbage Scow (VP TCC)
name: Female's Love Interest & Garbage Scow
The Higher..The Fewer
lore: The Parallax Poet's cosmic lesson for Alexander was, "Every moment requires a purpose. Every purpose requires a plan. The Higher... The Fewer."
game_text: Subtract X from your total score, where X=the number of personnel in this crew or Away Team.

name: General Quarters
lore: With a salt-draining entity loose aboard his ship, Captain Kirk placed the Starship Enterprise on security condition three, ordering off-duty crew to stay in their quarters for safety.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. May not leave play. All players may only download personnel into play once every turn.

name: Bluegill Infestation
game_text: Seeds on table; place up to seven unique personnel face up beneath here from outside the game. Your copies of those personnel in play are STRENGTH +5, considered Bluegills, and may not be stunned. Also, when one of your Bluegills is killed, you must randomly select a personnel from here; if it matches one who was killed, that personnel was considered to be the Bluegill Queen. (Unique.)

name: Deyos
lore: Vorta in charge of Internment Camp 371. Responsible for training and equipping Jem'Hadar troops. Accepts nothing less than perfect obedience.

name: Reginald Barclay
lore: Dedicated member of the Pathfinder Project. Established a means for Voyager to regularly communicate with Earth from tens of thousands of light-years away.

name: Ishka
lore: "Moogie" to Quark and Rom. Financial genius. Wears clothes. Earns profit. Secretly helps Zek run his empire.

name: Sisters of Duras
lore: Lursa and B'Etor, like their father before them, collaborated with the Romulan Star Empire.

name: Senator Vreenak
lore: Vice-Chairman of the Tal Shiar. Secretary of the War Plains Council. Key Romulan senator for over 14 years. Negotiated non-aggression pact with the Dominion.

name: Laas
lore: Changeling of great ability. One of the Hundred sent by the Founders to explore the galaxy. Dislikes monoforms. Linked with Odo. Occasionally fiery.

name: Seven of Nine
lore: Former Borg coerced into Tsunkatse competition. Trained by Hajur. Imperfect. Reaffirmed her humanity in the arena.

name: Saltah'na Clock
lore: Benjamin Sisko constructed a clock while being affected by the energy matrix of Saltah'na telepathic spheres. The spheres were storing the energy of an ancient power struggle.
game_text: Place on ship or facility here (opponent's choice). Personnel aboard must initiate battle whenever possible (no leader is required and affiliation attack restrictions do not apply).

name: Artillery Attack
lore: Jake Sisko and Julian Bashir were pinned down by Klingon artillery while attempting to retrieve a portable generator from their runabout on Ajilon Prime.
game_text: Kills X personnel (random selection); immediately probe: Skill Dot : X = number of Skill Dot icons on probe card.Equipment : X = 0 (discard probe card). Otherwise: X = 1.

name: Kukalaka
lore: Beloved childhood companion (and first surgical patient) of Julian Bashir. Loaned to, and especially treasured by, Leeta. A timeless symbol of innocence and security.
game_text: Your non-Borg personnel present are each INTEGRITY +2, or +3 if Leeta present. Also, each player is limited to one Brain Drain OR one Going to the Top every turn. (Unique.)

name: Kivas Fajo - Collector
lore: Zibalian trader Kivas Fajo has a spaceborne warehouse of rare cargo like hytritium as well as a private collection of unique and priceless treasures.
game_text: Choose any player to immediately draw three new cards from the top of their draw deck. Discard event after use.

name: The Art of Diplomacy
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Mirror Quadrant, Maquis, Resistance and Orion Syndicate personnel who are using a hand weapon may use 2 Treachery as if it were 1 Diplomacy (ignoring reductions from rifles) and, once each turn, may place incident out-of-play to kill one other personnel present. Once per game, you may discard incident to download one hand weapon to one of your personnel who has 2 Treachery.

name: Outgunned
lore: Surrounded by a fleet of Suliban ships, Jonathan Archer decided to save the lives of his crew by conceding to Silik's demands.
game_text: Commandeers opponent's only ship at a location if it is undocked and your total WEAPONS present > three times its SHIELDS. Opposing personnel aboard are captured.

name: Lovok Founder
lore: Changeling. Impersonated Colonel Lovok during the 2371 attack on the Dominion homeworld. Led the Romulan/Cardassian fleet into a Jem'Hadar ambush.

name: Martok
lore: Highly decorated general and High Council member. Accepted Worf, Alexander and Jadzia into the House of Martok. Lost his left eye battling the Jem'Hadar.

name: Senator Cretak
lore: Female Romulan. Kimara Cretak was liaison to Deep Space 9 in 2375. Coordinated a fleet of warbirds attempting to deliver weapons to a Bajoran moon.

name: Chula: The Drink
lore: One chula puzzle places the players in a cocktail party filled with poison gas. The antidote awaits the one who is clever (or foolish) enough to take a chance on a mysterious beverage.
game_text: To get past, four personnel present (random selection) must be "tested." All four are "stopped" unless one has CUNNING<6 OR CUNNING>9.

name: Mr. Quark
lore: Bartender who pretends to work for the Alliance. Quark secretly helps Terran slaves escape from Terok Nor.

name: Regent Worf
lore: Commander in chief of the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance, General Worf rules with an iron fist – often literally.

name: Smiley
lore: Terran slave Miles O'Brien was named and inspired by Mr. Sisko. "Fixer" favored by the Intendant. Repaired equipment for Overseer Odo.

name: Hero Worship
lore: Timothy suppressed the trauma of losing his parents by emulating his new hero, the android Data. Counseling the boy occupied much of Data's time.
game_text: "Stops" non-Borg crew or Away Team members with the most and fewest icons. (In case of ties, "stops" all tied personnel.)

name: Brainwash
lore: The Vori employ psychological conditioning on new recruits to make them hate their Kradin nemeses and believe they are vicious killers who would slaughter even innocent civilians.
game_text: Plays on one personnel you've captured. Captive reports to your outpost, is under your control and may mix with your personnel regardless of affiliation.

name: Blood Oath
game_text: Plays on a non-Borg personnel who has INTEGRITY<8 and no Honor. Adds Nemesis Red Left icon beginning at start of your next turn. OR Plays on table. While you have two Nemesis Red Right personnel present together, all Nemesis Red Left personnel lose their first-listed skill and, in place of your normal card draw, you may download to that location I.K.C. Ning'tao, I.K.C. Lukara, I.K.C. Gr'oth, Bat'leth, Blood Oath or one Nemesis Red Right personnel.

name: Make It So
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, if your staffed ship has its matching commander aboard, you may "unstop" it (once per game per Ship card title) OR download Ready Room Door (to download a Captain's Order) OR, if that ship is in battle (even during opponent's turn), download a Tactic card (once per game per Tactic card title). Discard incident after use, unless that matching commander has Enterprise- E icon.

name: Probe Alpha Quadrant System
lore: Unchartered Sector: Gather information about distant areas of the galaxy.
game_text: none

name: The Intendant
lore: Kira Nerys commands Terok Nor in the Mirror Universe. Enjoys being intimate with her friends - and enemies.

name: Seska
lore: Devious Cardassian operative. Broke her cover after becoming trapped in the Delta Quadrant aboard U.S.S. Voyager. Formed an alliance with the Kazon-Nistrim.

name: Gallatin
lore: Ru'afo's first officer. Once the most vengeance-minded of the Son'a, recent time with the Ba'ku - and a persuasive Federation captain - has softened his hatred.

name: U.S.S. Equinox
lore: style="text-align:left;width:500px;"|NCC-72381. Science vessel pulled from the Alpha Quadrant by the Caretaker. Its rogue crew designed and enhanced warp drive, killing nucleogenic life-forms for fuel.
game_text: X=4 if any crew member has "U.S.S. Equinox" in lore.

name: Quantum Incursions
game_text: Seeds like a Space/Planet dilemma.

name: Lwaxana Troi
lore: Female Betazoid ambassador who visited DS9 several times. Suffered the effects of Zanthi fever in 2371. Romantically involved with Jeyal and Odo.

name: Smoke and Mirrors
lore: In the mirror universe, the crew of the Starship Enterprise found it far easier as civilized men to behave as barbarians than for their counterparts to behave as civilized men.
game_text: While facing a dilemma, removes classification and all skills from one of your personnel until dilemma resolved, then discard interrupt.

name: Deranas
lore: Warbird commanded by Tomalak. Often assigned to the Neutral Zone. Encountered the U.S.S. Enterprise twice in 2366.
game_text: Attributes all +2 in Neutral Zone.

name: Tomalak
lore: Commander of a D'deridex-class warbird. Frequent nemesis of the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Cardassian Outpost
lore: Cardassia Prime is the homeworld of the Cardassians. The Cardassian Union establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Cardassian ENGINEER.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
lore: Captain Jean-Luc Picard of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Born in LaBarre, France. Has an artificial heart. Reads Shakespeare. Something of a Renaissance man.

name: Commander Archer
lore: Covetous commander of the Starship Defiant. A soldier all his life, Jonathan Archer was romantically involved with Comm Officer Sato.

name: Magic Carpet Ride OCD
lore: High-res encoding of 20th century rock 'n' roll, known for its enervating rhythms and unbearable volume. "You don't know what we can find... on a Magic Carpet Ride."
game_text: May seed at a space location. Owner may relocate any ship at this location (and ship's Away Teams, if any) to any planet location on spaceline. Discard artifact.

name: Scout Encounter
lore: The Vidiians use scout ships to explore uncharted space. One such vessel hid within the reflective interior of an asteroid to avoid detection and retain its cargo of harvested organs.
game_text: Opponent may download to this location one scout ship with one or two Universal crew members. That ship may (if possible) initiate battle against you or move away.

name: Theta-Radiation Poisoning
lore: With a damaged Malon freighter leaking theta radiation, the Doctor developed an innoculation to allow U.S.S. Voyager to beam over an away team to conduct repairs.
game_text: Place on any ship or outpost here (opponent's choice). End of each turn, one personnel present without Medical Kit killed (random selection). Cure with 6 ENGINEER.

name: The First Stable Wormhole
game_text: Seeds on table. You may download Bajoran Wormhole(s) (even from outside the game). When your ship travels through Bajoran Wormhole, you may discard a card from hand to download Wormhole Navigation Schematic (even from discard pile). Your Gamma Quadrant missions are span -1 for your DS9 ships. Doubles point boxes of your File Mission Report (for Gamma Quadrant missions) and Rescue Personnel (if Away Team on a Gamma Quadrant planet).

name: Ketracel-White
lore: Isogenic enzyme controlled by the Vorta. Genetically addicted Jem'Hadar need a constant supply of "the white" to stay alive. Withdrawal prevents shrouding and leads to killing rampages.
game_text: Where present, prevents "white deprivation." Counts down only if you have Ketracel White personnel present. (Your Vorta may "ration" just one Ketracel-White present to count down.)

name: Torture
lore: Captain Kirk was captured by the Vians on Minara II in 2268. He was subjected to intense physiological and psychological torment to explore the nature of self-sacrifice.
game_text: Plays on a personnel you've captured. When countdown expires, captive dies and owner loses points (including any Madred bonuses).

name: Captain Sulu
lore: After moving up through the ranks aboard Enterprise, Lt. Sulu was given the captaincy he deserved in 2290. Holds loyalty in high regard, his crew as dear as family.

name: Dr. Gillian Taylor
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
lore: 20th-century marine biologist. Helped Admiral Kirk safely bring George and Gracie to the 23rd-century, where she then signed on aboard a Starfleet vessel.

name: I.K.S. Lukara
lore: Bird-of-Prey commanded by Kang. Transported its commander and his comrades to Secarus IV in 2370, to confront the Albino in his stronghold.

name: Medical Crisis
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
lore: In the more primitive areas of the galaxy, such as the Delta Quadrant and 1986 Earth, medical supplies and those trained in their use are equally rare.
game_text: Randomly select a MEDICAL personnel. Killed if Kazon or Viddian, "stopped" otherwise. To get past requires 2 Biology and (2 MEDICAL OR a Nurse).

name: Orb of Wisdom
lore: Acquired by Zek from one of his contacts on Cardassia III. The Grand Nagus used the Orb to contact the Prophets, then sold it to the Bajoran government at a substantial profit.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. Your personnel present are each INTEGRITY +3. Each turn, one of your cards played here plays for free if your Orb personnel present. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Edo Probe
lore: When the Federation tried to contact the pre-industrial society on Rubicun III, the Edo Probe demanded in ship-shuddering tones that Jean-Luc Picard "State the purpose!"
game_text: Abandon mission attempt until any player completes a different mission OR continue but lose points if you do not solve mission this turn.

name: Undetected Beam-In
lore: Cybernetic life forms from a commandeered Earth research transport were able to beam aboard Enterprise without being identified. This led to a nasty surprise for her crew.
game_text: Opponent may download to this location up to 4 Borg drones or Rogue Borg Mercenaries (they do not battle now). Nullify dilemma with Shelby OR 4 SECURITY.

name: The Traveler: Transcendence
lore: Benevolent humanoid from Tau Alpha C who could transcend space and time with thought.
game_text: Place beside any player's draw deck. That player must draw one extra card at the end of each turn. Also, while in play, nullifies Static Warp Bubble. (Not cumulative.)

name: Commandeer Ship
property_logo: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
game_text: Plays on your Computer Skill personnel who is aboard opponent's empty ship (except a Borg cube). That personnel commandeers ship and, while objective in play, may meet up to three of its staffing icons. OR Seeds or plays on table. Opponent may not return to hand any ship which has your personnel aboard as an intruder or infiltrator.

name: Bareil
lore: Skilled thief and decryption expert. Bareil Antos was romantically involved with both the Intendant and Kira Nerys, who gave him an Orb experience.

name: Penk
lore: Norcadian entertainment producer. Arrogant. Corrupt. Abducts aliens from all over the sector and forces them to fight in the Tsunkatse matches.

name: Naprem
lore: Bird-of-Prey commanded by Dukat. Commandeered near the Cardassian outpost on Korma. Named for Tora Ziyal's mother. Carried Jodmos to Ty'Gokor in 2373.

name: Gowron
lore: Son of M'Rel. Leader of the Klingon High Council after defeating the Duras forces in the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: Battle Cruiser Bortas
lore: Warship commanded by Duras Son of Toral. Pursued rebels from Raatooras. Once engaged Enterprise in combat.
game_text: Attributes all +1 for each Klingon 22nd Century Command aboard (limit 5).

name: I.K.S. Bortas
lore: Flagship commanded by Gowron during the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68. Lieutenant Worf briefly served aboard as a weapons officer.

name: Wormhole
lore: An unstable tunnel through subspace that links to locations in normal space/time.
game_text: Requires two wormholes. Play one on your ship. Play the other at any location (even a time location). Ship relocates to that location (and then is "stopped").

name: Enterprise
lore: Legendary prototype designed for deep space travel. Commanded by Jonathan Archer. First Starfleet vessel to bear the name that would symbolize Starfleet's elite.
game_text: Attributes all +1 for each Starfleet Command aboard (limit 5).

name: Hippocratic Oath
lore: Beverly Crusher was detained by Ansata separatists on Rutia IV. She was compelled to ease the suffering caused by their repeated use of dimensional shifting.
game_text: To get past, most CUNNING MEDICAL present must help aliens (relocated with dilemma to nearest planet at another location). MEDICAL is "stopped" until countdown expires.

name: The Cloud
lore: In 2269, the Starship Enterprise was penetrated by a storm-like phenomena which attacked both the ship's technology and the nervous systems of the crew.
game_text: Unless 2 MEDICAL, 2 ENGINEER, and 2 Astrophysics present, ship is damaged and "stopped" until end of your next turn. Discard dilemma.

name: Lower Decks
lore: Many junior officers aboard the Starship Enterprise could be found socialising with their colleagues, relaxing from the daily perils of killer plants, salt-sucking aliens, and exploding rocks.
game_text: Plays on table. Each of your non-holographic, universal personnel is attributes all +2. (Captain's Order.)

name: Protect the Timeline
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
game_text: Seeds on a time location. (Unique.) Once each turn, one of your unique personnel reporting here may do so for free. You may not report personnel for free unless native to this timeline or reporting to a ship or facility here. Any ship may time travel between here and corresponding spaceline location (once per turn per ship), then is stopped unless ship or three personnel aboard are native to this timeline.

name: Going to the Top
lore: To determine if Data had the right to choose, Jean-Luc Picard asked Judge Advocate General Phillipa Louvois to rule on the matter. The unenviable task of prosecuting fell to Riker.
game_text: Plays if you have two Command personnel together on a facility. Download a compatible personnel with Leadership x2 to them (once per game per affiliation).

name: Duras Son of Toral
lore: Former captain demoted for failing to locate rebels harbored by Jonathan Archer. Given another chance by the High Council. Ancestor of Ja'rod.

name: Admiral Valdore
lore: Brilliant military strategist behind most of the campaigns of the Earth-Romulan War. A former senator expelled for challenging Imperial doctrine.

name: Jeremiah Hayes
lore: Diligent major and MACO commander. Expert at both armed and unarmed combat. Found a sparring partner in Malcolm Reed. Likes consistency.

name: Minister T'Pau
lore: Former dissident and Syrranite leader. Found the Kir'Shara with Jonathan Archer. In her hands, it was used to initiate reform of the Vulcan government.

name: Risa Shore Leave
lore: Risa: Have a good, relaxing holiday on the pleasure planet.

name: Comfort Women
game_text: Plays once each turn (for free) on your Gul or Senator present with a female of a different species. For rest of turn, this personnel gains any regular skill; discard incident. OR Seeds on Bajor. Your Bajoran females become Cardassian dissidents with "Terok Nor" in lore (even if not in play); download a site. OR Seeds on Verex III. Your Non-Aligned 22nd Century females are considered native to 2154 Time Locations.

name: Neelix
lore: Talaxian jack-of-all-trades. Has served on a Trabalian freighter, mining colony, and Voyager. Serves as cook, morale officer, guide, and sometimes ambassador.

name: Battle Bridge Door
game_text: Place one atop Battle Bridge side deck during the seed phase. Battle Bridge is now open and in play (immune to cards which close doorways). OR Stock in deck and play at start of ship battle (even during opponent's turn) if you have Leadership in that battle. Allows you to draw two extra Tactic cards (cumulative) or enhances each of your ships' and facilities' WEAPONS +1; then discard doorway.

name: Kivas Fajo
lore: Unscrupulous, murderous, conceited Zibalian trader. Collector. Notorious member of Stacius Trade Guild.

name: Jovis
lore: Zibalian transport and merchant vessel commanded by Kivas Fajo. Houses his collection of rare and one-of-a-kind objects. Used to imprison Data in 2366.
game_text: Once per game, you may capture an Android on an undocked ship here. Download Kivas Fajo

name: Navaar
lore: Experienced gift given to Jonathan Archer by Harrad-Sar. Alluring Orion slave girl and a master thief. Nearly succeeded in capturing Enterprise.

name: Altonian Brain Teaser
lore: To solve this holographic puzzle, its challenger must turn the multicolor sphere a solid hue using neural theta waves. The symbiont Dax tried unsuccessfully for over 140 years.
game_text: Most CUNNING personnel present is "stopped." If their CUNNING>15, bonus points score at this spaceline location do not count toward winning. Discard dilemma.

name: Incentive-Based Economics
lore: To obtain a rare gift for his father, Jake Sisko and his friend Nog bartered, swapped favors, stole a teddy bear, and even negotiated with Weyoun.
game_text: To get past requires Honor and no SECURITY OR CIVILIAN, Anthropology, Diplomacy, Youth, and a personnel with STRENGTH<8.

name: Kira Nerys
lore: Outspoken Major in Bajoran Militia. Assigned as first officer of Deep Space 9. Former member of Shakaar resistance cell. Romantically involved with Odo.

name: Bashir Founder
lore: Changeling posing as Julian Bashir. Tried to destroy an entire fleet by causing the Bajoran sun to go nova.

name: Miles O'Brien
lore: Chief of operations on Deep Space 9. Friend of Julian. Father of Molly and Kirayoshi. Husband of Keiko. Likes kayaking, darts and historical battle simulations.

name: Worf
lore: Klingon strategic operations officer aboard DS9. Often commanded the U.S.S. Defiant. Romantically involved with Jadzia Dax. Likes prune juice.

name: Jodmos
lore: The human Benjamin Sisko assumed the identity of Jodmos, son of Kobor, to help rid the Klingon Empire of a suspected changeling at Ty'Gokor.

name: Odo
lore: Odo donned civilian clothes and went aboard Deep Space Station K-7 in 2267 to search for an explosive tribble. Recently made human by the Great Link.

name: Quark's Bar
game_text: Morn and Ferengi may report here. Once each turn, a bartender, a dabo girl, a waiter, any Quark or any Rom may report here for free (or download here in place of a normal card play; player draws no cards that turn). Any player who has Morn unopposed here may draw an additional card at end of each turn. Any player who kills any waiters or dabo girls here in battle must discard two cards for each. Ferengi ships may report, dock, undock and repair at this Nor.

name: Restore Victims
lore: Talax: Attempt to restore civilians killed by metreon cascade weapon on the Talaxian moon of Rinax.
game_text: Talaxians may report on planet (for free).

name: Queen's Borg Cube
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BORG CUBETASK: Assimilate human home world by direct attack, Earth date 2373. Borg Queen commands.

name: Borg Queen
lore: "We all originated from lesser species. I myself came from Species 125. But that's irrelevant now. We are Borg... Our thoughts are one... One order, one voice."

name: Lemec
lore: Gul in command of the Reklar. Clashed with Captain Edward Jellico over troop and ship movements along the Federation-Cardassian border.

name: Preserver Obelisk
game_text: Seed one on table in facility phase; if you have no personnel in play, you may download up to 2 different OS personnel who name in lore a planet you seeded. Score 5 points whenever such a personnel helps solve the planet mission they name. You may not seed Assign Mission Specialists. OR Plays to download such a personnel whom you do not have in play.

name: Cytherians
lore: Race which explores the galaxy by giving other species the temporary ability and strong compulsion to come to them.
game_text: Place on ship. Ship must do nothing but travel to far end of spaceline at normal speed. When reached, discard dilemma. Score points.

name: Quantum Singularity Lifeforms
lore: Sentient dimensional beings whose young incubate in black holes. When nesting in a Romulan ship's artificial singularity engine, a frozen-time effect occurs.
game_text: If a Romulan ship present, all ships and personnel here are placed in stasis. Cure with Emergency Transport Armbands, Timepod Ring or new ENGINEER arriving.

name: Devidian Door
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, allows you to play a card "from the future." Once each turn, you may say "Devidian Door" and play one Personnel or Equipment card to any planet. At any time during your next turn (or at game end, if sooner), you must show a Devidian Door from hand and place it out-of-play, or you lose the game. (Immune to cards which close doorways.)

name: Temporal Vortex
game_text: Plays on a time location. While in play, any ships may time travel between here and corresponding spaceline location. OR Suspends play while you place doorway on Borg Ship dilemma or The Sheliak. While in play, dilemma disappears. OR Plays on table. While in play, dilemma disappears. OR Plays on table. While in play, nullifies Distortion of Space/Time Continuum. OR Relocates one of your ships at a time location to spaceline location of opponent's choice.

name: Timepod Ring
lore: Small device used to monitor the auto-timer on the time travel pod appropriated by Berlinghoff Rasmussen. As he was uncertain how to reprogram the timer, the ring was very precious to him.
game_text: Plays on table. Once each turn, you may peek at the top card of your deck. Also, you may discard this event and the top card of your draw deck to nullify an Alternate dilemma.

name: Out of Time
game_text: Plays for free at any time to take up to three personnel agents in your discard pile into hand OR to allow your temporal agent, any number of your personnel present, and/or your ship he or she is aboard to time travel between a time location and the corresponding spaceline location. Discard incident OR "stop" your temporal agent to place this on top of your draw deck.

name: Fissure Research
lore: Forkus Sector: Investigate quantum fissure between parallel universes reported here.

name: Silik
lore: Genetically-enhanced Suliban shape-shifter who led the Cabal in the 22nd-century. Temporal agent for a mysterious manipulator from the future.

name: Science Lab
game_text: Compatible SCIENCE-classification personnel, SCIENCE-related Equipment cards, I.P. Scanner and PADDs may report here. Once each turn, if station at a Space mission and player who controls station has a SCIENCE personnel unopposed here, that player may scan bottom seed card under mission. Matching SCIENCE personnel may file mission reports here.

name: Creatures of Duty
lore: Keras and his officers lived by the ideals of duty, obedience, and service to the Praetor, to the exclusion of all other concerns.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Romulan Original Series male personnel with OFFICER classification may meet dilemma requirements as if CIVILIAN or V.I.P. or female, then are stopped.

name: Population 9 Billion - All Borg
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. If your Borg have completed Stop First Contact (or Build Interplexing Beacon), place incident on Earth; you may download a Borg outpost there. Your Borg cards may subsequently report on Earth or to that outpost; and your subsequently completed Borg Only objectives targeting missions in the Alpha Quadrant score double points.

name: Implication
lore: Confronted with Manua Agpar's interpretation of events, William T. Riker found his reputation and his honor in question. "She's lying! That never happened!"
game_text: To get past requires 3 Diplomacy and INTEGRITY>30 OR Law and CUNNING>30.

name: Stellar Flare
lore: Stellar flares release tremendous amounts of energy and radiation. A particle beam, accurately directed at the surface of a star, can produce abnormally large and dangerous eruptions.
game_text: Damages and "stops" all ships at this location except those that are docked, landed, or carried OR have 2 Navigation and Astrophysics aboard OR have SHIELDS>11. Discard dilemma.

name: Barzan Wormhole
game_text: Seeds (in any phase) or plays in Gamma or Delta Quadrant (limit one). Inserts into spaceline; creates a location (span 2). Any ship may move between Wormhole Terminus mission and here, then is "stopped." OR Once each turn, plays to relocate Barzan Wormhole to a new location in Gamma or Delta Quadrant; discard doorway.

name: Computer Crash
lore: With Data, Troi, and O'Brien possessed by spirits encountered on a moon of Mab-Bu VI, Riker quickly rerouted command functions to prevent them from taking over the ship.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. No player may play a Q's Tent doorway, download any card or play any card that requires downloading. Discard event at end of your next turn.

name: Temporal Shifting
lore: Unknowingly assisted by Q, Jean-Luc Picard found himself jumping between different periods of his life.
game_text: Plays on a player. That player must choose to either discard three cards from hand or discard one Alternate Universe card. If that player discards an Alternate Universe card, he/she may draw up to four cards. Discard event.

name: Cybernetics Expertise
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, your android may report for free if Cybernetics present and may report to your personnel who has Cybernetics x2. Also, once each turn, you may exchange a card from hand for an android in your discard pile.

name: Docking Procedures
lore: Docking large starships within space facilities requires precision maneuvering to avoid potentially disastrous consequences.
game_text: Plays on any ship just as it begins to dock or undock at any facility. Ship and crew are "stopped." Docking or undocking complete at end of turn.

name: Emoathic Touch
lore: Assisted by Maques, Deanna Troi was able to enter Lwaxana Troi's metaconscious mind and resolve the hidden psychological issues which had caused her mother to withdraw there.
game_text: When your personnel is about to be killed, if your Empathy personnel is present, stop both personnel to prevent that.

name: Shipwreck
lore: In 2365, Worf attempted to build a model ship. The Klingon warrior struggled to master the delicate dexterity required.
game_text: Suspends ALL ship attribute enhancements for the rest of this turn. (May be played at start of battle.) OR Nullifies all Wall of Ships cards in play.

name: Evek
lore: Harsh interrogator who excels in extracting confessions from Maquis terrorists. Gul. Patrols the Badlands as captain of the Vetar.

name: Vetar
lore: Cardassian warship that surveyed Dorvan V. Pursued the Liberty into the Badlands. Commanded by Evek.
game_text: Download Any Pursuit card WEAPONS +2 vs. Maquis

name: Assign Support Personnel
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. (Unique.) Your "support personnel" (those who have exactly two skills, but no special skills) may report aboard your compatible ships that have two or more staffing icons. Once each turn, you may discard objective to download a "support personnel" (once per game per Personnel card title) to your matching ship that has two or more staffing icons, or to your matching facility.

name: Kressari Rendezvous
lore: Cardassia Region ● Near Cardassia: Complete covert weapons transfer to agents supplying the Circle.
game_text: * Discard up to four hand weapons for +5 each.

name: Sarek
lore: Illustrious Vulcan Federation ambassador. Over 200 years old. Married at least three times: to a Vulcan princess, to Amanda and to Perrin. Father of Spock.

name: Investigate Quarantine
lore: Talos IV: Determine origin of General Order 7, imposed on this planet in the 23rd century.
game_text: None

name: Captain Koloth
lore: Commander of I.K.C. Gr'oth. Sent to protect Klingon interests in Sherman's Planet. Dear to Captain Kirk

name: General Krim
lore: High-ranking Bajoran Militia leader. Member of the Circle. Took over Deep Space 9 in 2370, but returned the station when informed of Cardassian involvement.

name: Assault Vessel
lore: Mainstay of the Bajoran Militia. During the 2370 coup attempt by the Circle, assault vessels commanded by General Krim and Colonel Day invaded Deep Space 9.

page_title: HQ: Return Orb to Bajor (VP TCC)
name: HQ: Return Orb to Bajor
game_text: Plays on your Orb personnel. Where present, that personnel may earn Orb artifacts just encountered and may "reclaim" (steal) any Orb artifacts in play. If that personnel is on Bajor with Orb artifacts present, draw up to three cards for each one, discard objective and score points. (Each artifact may be "returned" only once per game.)

name: The Celestial Temple
lore: Infinity symbol Bajoran Wormhole: The Prophets of Bajor live outside of linear time.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. At any time, any player may relocate their unique non-Treachery personnel between here and their ship or facility at the Alpha Quadrant Bajoran Wormhole. Any player with an Orb personnel here may draw an additional card at the end of each turn unless total WEAPONS>9 at any Bajoran Wormhole. No capturing or battles allowed here.

name: Alien Abduction
lore: Upon beaming down to Sigma Iotia II, the crew of the Starship Enterprise were swiftly taken captive by henchmen working for Bela Okmyx, the crime boss of the Northside Territory.
game_text: Most CUNNING Away Team member (owner's choice if tie) is held by atop mission. Cure with 3 Leadership. Nullified when mission completed.

name: Borg Ship
lore: Gigantic cubic ship of the Borg collective. Possesses powerful weapons and remarkable regenerative abilities.
game_text: Place at furthest spaceline end. End of every turn: Attacks all ships, then moves. Worth points if destroyed in battle.

name: Hologram Ruse
lore: Admiral Dougherty conspired with the Son'a, planning to use a Federation holoship to transport the Ba'ku population without their knowledge.
game_text: To get past requires INTEGRITY>30 and CUNNING>30.

name: Black Hole
game_text: Plays between two adjacent Universal missions named Space. Creates a location (span 1). End of every turn, destroys all cards here. Also, when countdown would expire, instead destroy an adjacent location and all cards there (left first, then alternating, while possible), then countdown resets. Does not count down the turn it is played. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Duck Blind
lore: Anthropologists from many species use various covert techniques, such as cloaked observation stations and cloaked isolation suits, to observe seemingly less advanced civilizations.
game_text: Seeds or plays on your Alpha Quadrant planet mission (except a homeworld). End of each turn, if your 2 Anthropology present, draw an extra card. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Engage Shuttle Operations
lore: As starships grew in size, shuttlepod launch bays evolved into large hangars, able to launch and recover support craft.
game_text: Plays on table. Your shuttlecraft may take off and land (using full RANGE) and be loaded, carried, and launched by your ships with Tractor Beam and ENGINEER aboard (uses 0 RANGE).

name: Data Laughing
lore: In 2371, Data installed an emotion chip developed by Dr. Soong. Although overwhelmed at first, Data was able to experience new sensations, such as the gift of laughter.
game_text: Nullifies Calamarain OR doubles Data's Head this turn. OR Plays on a ship affected by Lore Returns; you gain control of that ship and all Rogue Borg Mercenaries aboard.

name: Q2
lore: Called by Q as an expert witness on the Q Continuum, Q provided testimony to himself during Quinn's hearing. "Ta-da!"
game_text: Nullifies any Amanda Rogers OR Kevin Uxbridge OR a Q icon dilemma OR a dilemma with the word "Q" in title.

name: Vulcan Mindmeld
property_logo: Star Trek: The Wrath of Khan
lore: Ancient Vulcan ritual which telepathically links minds to intimately share each other's thoughts and knowledge. Captain Spock stored his katra in Dr. McCoy using one. "Remember."
game_text: Plays on your Mindmeld personnel. Personnel gains the skills of one of your other personnel present until end of turn. Discard interrupt.

name: Odo
lore: Changeling who aided Damar's resistance. Frequent shape-shifting advanced the onset of the morphogenic virus. He posed as the Founder, Founder Leader.

name: Odo
lore: Changeling who aided Damar's resistance. Frequent shape-shifting advanced the onset of the morphogenic virus. He posed as the Founder, Founder Leader.

name: Odo
lore: Changeling who aided Damar's resistance. Frequent shape-shifting advanced the onset of the morphogenic virus. He posed as the Founder, Founder Leader.

name: Authorized Access Only
lore: With the U.S.S. Enterprise evacuated, Jean-Luc Picard took on a group of armed mercenaries single-handedly to prevent them from stealing dangerous trilithium resin.
game_text: To get past requires three personnel with Acquisition OR three personnel with OFFICER classification.

name: Friendly Fire
lore: Attempting to subdue a hostage situation in Ten Forward led to a phaser fight between Worf and his security forces and possessed crewmembers Deanna Troi, Data, and Miles O'Brien.
game_text: Unless 2 Leadership and 2 SECURITY present, kills one personnel (random selection); place dilemma on this mission (or this Empok Nor ); it cannot be attempted or scouted.

name: Federation Flagship: Recovered
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. If opponent's card just destroyed your only ship in play, place that ship here (with all cards aboard). Download one of the following to your matching facility or that spaceline's end: a different ship of the same class or identification OR any other Enterprise (if destroyed ship was any Enterprise). Relocate crew and equipment from here to downloaded ship (they are "stopped"). Discard incident.

name: Strategic Base
game_text: Seeds or plays on your outpost (except Neutral or Non-Aligned). Adds point value of this mission to outpost's DEFENSE total. Your leaders and SECURITY personnel at this location are attributes all +1. OR Once per game, seeds or plays on any mission. If you subsequently play an outpost here, discard incident and draw three cards.

name: Kai Opaka
lore: Revered Kai of Bajor. Lost her son in the Kendra Valley Massacre. First recognized Benjamin Sisko as the Emissary of the Prophets.

name: Turanj
lore: Rash hunter. Grudgingly took part in a holodeck scenario of Nazi Germany's 20th-century occupation of France. Never grasped Karr's aims in studying the Voyager prey.

name: Tierna
lore: Kazon-Nistrim serving as Seska's aide. Assigned a suicide mission by Culluh as part of an elaborate plan to take U.S.S. Voyager. Determined to succeed.

name: Sulan
lore: Chief Surgeon of the Vidiian Sodality. Divided B'Elanna Torres into two beings – fully Human and fully Klingon – to study the phage's effects on Klingon genetic material.

name: Ops
game_text: Compatible OFFICER-classification personnel may report here. Any player may, in place of their normal card play, download to an unopposed site on this station one card which may play there (if reporting a ship or personnel, must be of matching affiliation); player draws no cards that turn. Any Computer Skill personnel unopposed here may commandeer station.

name: Take Us Out!
lore: The late 23rd century saw many scientific and technological advancements. New ships were launched and older ships refurbished, each one worthy of celebration.
game_text: Seeds on table. If all your ships in play are Classic Films, they are RANGE and SHIELDS +2 while uncloaked. Nullified if you have in play both Camp Khitomer and a headquarters.

name: Goran'Agar
lore: First. Jem'Hadar soldier who overcame addiction to ketracel-white. Brought group of Jem'Hadar to Bopak III seeking freedom from the white and the Vorta.

name: Gelnon
lore: Vorta who ordered an attack on the U.S.S. Defiant in 2374. Skeptical of using Kudak'Etan and other Jem'Hadar alphas. His suspicions were justified.

name: O'Brien Founder
lore: Changeling posing as Miles O'Brien. Infiltrated Earth in 2372 with three other Founders. Gloated about their disruptive activities to Benjamin Sisko.

name: Hanok
lore: Karemma Commerce Minister. Helped to defuse a torpedo lodged in the hull of the U.S.S. Defiant. Learned of Ferengi business philosophy from Quark.

name: Professor Scott
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
lore: Mr. Scott visited Plexicorp in 1986, posing as a scholar from Edinburgh. Called "the miracle worker" by his friends. Scotty is an old Aberdeen pub crawler.

name: Confront Duplicate
lore: Bassen Rift: Challenge adversary in nebula that disrupts long-range communications.
game_text: None

name: Talosian Cage
lore: Telepathic aliens with the power to create illusory worlds, often based on the memories of life-forms they've captured. Starfleet General Order 7 forbids contact with their homeworld, Talos IV.
game_text: Unless 3 Empathy OR Christopher Pike present, opponent may choose to discard two females (random selection) OR male with most Skill Dot icons. Discard dilemma.

name: Ferengi Conference
game_text: Seeds or plays on Quark's Bar. When you have a Nagus here, you may download up one copy of the 75th Rule of Acquisition to each of your other Ferengi here who has Acquisition. Discard objective. OR Plays on your Nagus at Quark's Bar or aboard a Ferengi facility. Download to that Nagus one Hupyrian or any number of Ferengi CIVILIANs with up to 11 total Skill Dot icons. Discard objective.

name: Gaila
lore: Arms dealer. Owed his cousin Quark a shuttle. Made good on his debt, but booby-trapped the ship. Involved with Hagath. Helped rescue Ishka from the Dominion.

name: The Trois
lore: Tog abducted the Betazoid Lwaxana Troi and her half-human daughter Deanna Troi, beamed them out of their clothes, and planned to exploit their skills.

name: The Trois (AI)
lore: Tog abducted the Betazoid Lwaxana Troi and her half-human daughter Deanna Troi, beamed them out of their clothes, and planned to exploit their skills.

name: 1st Rule of Acquisition
lore: "Once you have their money, you never give it back."
game_text: Seeds or plays on your freighter, transport or Ferengi facility or ship. Gold-Pressed Latinum you download may come from your discard pile. Once per game, you may download to hand one Gold-Pressed Latinum and/or one Ferengi V.I.P.

name: Par Lenor
lore: Emissary of the Ferengi Trade Mission. Sabotaged his own ship to force a rescue by the U.S.S. Enterprise, creating the opportunity to bribe Ambassador Briam.

name: Emergent Life-form
lore: Following a magnascopic storm, the U.S.S. Enterprise's systems began to develop a new intelligence. It took control of the ship and sought out vertion particles for nutrients.
game_text: Place on ship. Now and start of each turn, opponent may move ship to another location (using its RANGE). If ship has Holodeck, cure with 2 ENGINEER and Astrophysics aboard.

name: In the Pale Moonlight
lore: "A guilty conscience is a small price to pay for the safety of the Alpha Quadrant, so I will learn to live with it. Because I can live with it… Computer, erase that entire personal log."
game_text: To get past requires a personnel who has INTEGRITY<4 OR a Federation Treachery personnel OR any Garak OR a Founder.

name: Captured
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. During your turn, your non-Borg crew or Away Team may capture one opposing personnel present (random selection) if you have more SECURITY present than opponent, or more hand weapons present than opponent. OR During any player's turn, you may capture one personnel just stunned in battle by your non-Borg SECURITY. Discard incident after either use.

name: The Undiscovered Country
game_text: Seeds on table. While all your personnel in play are Classic Films, you may draw an extra card at the end of your turn. Once per game, in place of your normal card play, you may nullify Homefront. Nullified if you have in play both Camp Khitomer and a headquarters.

name: Two of Nine
lore: IDENTIFICATION: TRANSTATOR DRONETASK: Primary adjunct of unimatrix zero one.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid.

name: Seven of Nine
lore: Borg freed from the Collective. Slowly reclaiming her human past and individuality, guided by Kathryn Janeway, The Doctor, and the rest of the U.S.S. Voyager crew.

name: Seven of Nine (AI)
lore: Borg freed from the Collective. Slowly reclaiming her human past and individuality, guided by Kathryn Janeway, The Doctor, and the rest of the U.S.S. Voyager crew.

name: U.S.S. Pasteur
lore: Medical Relief vessel. Starfleet registry NCC-58928. Captained by Beverly Picard in an alternate future.

name: I.K.S. Chang
lore: Patrolled the Devron system with sister ship I.K.S. Fek'Ihr. Formerly commanded by Governor Worf.
game_text: If your I.K.S. Fek'Ihr in play, it has a Nemesis Blue Left icon and both ships reduce staffing by one Alternate icon.

name: Parallel Romance
lore: Relationships in parallel universes take different courses. In the mirror universe, Comm Officer Sato was in a relationship with Captain Forrest.
game_text: Randomly select a male and a female. (If you cannot, discard dilemma.) Until countdown expires, each of them is stopped and has STRENGTH reduced by 2.

page_title: Battle Bridge Door: Auxiliary Control (330VP TCC)
name: Battle Bridge Door: Auxiliary Control
game_text: Seeds on (opens) Battle Bridge side deck (at least 13 Tactic , all different); may download Emergency Evacuation OR Make It So. When your ship or facility battles, you may draw up to 3 cards from here: play 1; discard others. Whenever amount of damage to opponent’s card not stated,Tactic Draw (for direct hits,Tactic Draw again). When Tactic leave play, place them face up here only; when side deck empty, shuffle to replenish it.

name: Preparation
lore: Mission briefings with senior staff are important for information sharing and planning, and have been used ever since the early days of space exploration.
game_text: Plays on your unexamined mission if you control personnel with four different classifications there. Examine bottom seed card. OR Nullifies Lack of Preparation (but still lose points).

name: The Power
property_logo: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
lore: With doubts about the identity of the being encountered on Sha Ka Ree, Captain Kirk experienced the energy that it could wield.
game_text: Plays once each turn to draw a card OR draw to and discard one of them (your choice) OR draw three and discard one (opponent's choice). (May not be converted to downloads.)

name: Answer Distress Signal
lore: Arrithean space: Respond to call for help from malfunctioning isomorphic projection alone on alien ship.
game_text: * +10 if a Hologram in crew.

name: Shakaar Edon
lore: Leader of Shakaar resistance cell. Farmer. Refused to return soil reclamators to provisional government in 2371. Old friend of Kira Nerys.

name: Miles O'Brien
lore: Transporter chief. Conn and Tactical expert. Loathes "Cardies." Loves Keiko. Begat Molly. He plays cello.

name: Dereth
lore: Vidiian honatta to Motura. Tasked with obtaining new organs for his charge's survival. Duty-bound to take them from the living if a dead "donor" is unavailable

name: I.K.S. Negh'Var
lore: Flagship of the Klingon Defense Force. Commanded by Gowron when first commissioned, and then by Martok during the 2372 invasion of Cardassia.

name: Rebuild Society
lore: Vidiia: Renew cultural highlights on the Vidiian homeworld, ravaged by the phage for millennia.

name: Terok Nor
lore: Newly constructed ore processing facility built during the Cardassian occupation of Bajor. Frequent target for sabotage and bombing by the Bajoran resistance.
game_text: Plays at 2346 Bajor. Only ships and personnel native to this timeline may report here.

name: Ancient Computer
lore: Vital information can be retrieved from old or damaged computer systems like this one aboard a derelict Promellian battlecruiser.
game_text: Cannot get past unless 2 Computer Skill OR 3 SCIENCE OR 3 ENGINEER present.

name: Matriarchal Society
lore: The planet Angel One was dominated by its women who were intolerant of dealing with men.
game_text: Cannot get past unless at least two female Away Team members are present.

name: Q-Net
lore: Q used an enormous forcefield grid in space to stop the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2364.
game_text: Plays between two adjacent spaceline locations. No ship may pass the Q-Net unless 2 Diplomacy aboard.

name: Hunt for DNA Program
lore: Vilmor II: Seek and secure last strand of DNA program on this desert planet.

name: Dr. Selar
lore: Dr. Selar is a female Vulcan medical doctor. Served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise for many years.

name: Mot the Barber
lore: Bolian male. Convivial barber aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Snappy conversationalist.

name: Duras
lore: Son of Ja'rod. Contender for leadership of the Klingon High Council. Member of a powerful political family.

name: Dr. Reyga
lore: Ferengi male scientist. Inventor of the revolutionary, but controversial, metaphasic shield technology. Endured skepticism from the scientific community.

name: Devoras
lore: Warbird used to accomplice the escape of Romulan spy Selak from the Federation in 2367. Commanded by Admiral Mendak.

name: Victory Is Life
lore: "I am First Omet'iklan. And I am dead. As of this moment we are all dead. We go into battle to win back our lives. This we do gladly, because we are Jem'Hadar. Remember... victory is life."
game_text: Once every turn, download an Equipment card to your Jem'Hadar who just helped solve a mission or win a personnel battle against another player; score points.

name: Stand-Off
lore: Joining forces with the Dominion required both mental and physical restraint to prevent the Klingon Worf and the Jem'Hadar Toman'torax from killing each other.
game_text: To get past requires three personnel with Anthropology OR three personnel with SECURITY classification.

name: Donald Varley
lore: Human captain of the U.S.S. Yamato. He retrieved a "Galactic Rosetta Stone" from Denius III to search for – and unfortunately find – the mythical planet Iconia.

name: Iconian Gateway
lore: Ancient, sophisticated portal which instantaneously transports people to distant planets. The attempted restoration of one by renegade Jem'Hadar on Vandros IV posed a galactic threat.
game_text: Place in hand. Play as Event on a planet mission: personnel present may walk to other planet missions.

name: Dathon
lore: Tamarian captain of the Tama. He said: "Darmok and Jalad at Tanagra. The beast of Tanagra. Picard and Dathon at El-Adrel. Sokath, his eyes uncovered!"

name: Time Travel Pod
lore: Craft from the future, stolen in the past by Berlinghoff Rasmussen for his own gain.
game_text: Immediately play on table as a Universal Space time location. Relocate opponent's ship here now OR once, at any time, relocate your ship here. Counts down only while a ship here. When discarded, return ship to former location.

name: Crystalline Entity
lore: Spaceborne life-form that converts biological matter to energy. Sensitive to graviton pulse resonance, shattering like crystal.
game_text: Planet Unless MEDICAL and SCIENCE, kills Away Team. Space: Unless Music OR SHIELDS>6, kills all personnel on ship. Then: Discard dilemma. Score points if overcome.

name: Anti-Time Anomaly
game_text: Plays on table. At the start of each turn, opponent may Flip one ship at any Devron System. When countdown expires, each player shuffles all personnel in play (even "for uniqueness only") that they own into their draw decks.

name: Distortion of Space/Time Continuum
lore: Time effects can be caused by the unusual warping or rifting of space.
game_text: Plays on your non-Alternate Universe ship just after opponent plays an Alternate Universe card. You may discard to unstop ship and crew OR restore full RANGE OR unstop an Away Team here. (Unique.)

name: Repair Mission
lore: Argus Array: Examine malfunctioning subspace radio telescope at the edge of Federation space.

name: Erik Pressman
lore: Human admiral and former captain of the U.S.S. Pegasus, which was lost in space following a failed experiment he oversaw.

name: Kurn
lore: Son of Mogh. Brother of Worf. Commands the I.K.S. Hegh'ta. Kept his true bloodline hidden prior to becoming a member of the Klingon High Council.

name: Ocett
lore: Cardassian female officer. Commander of the Bralek. Gul who pursued the DNA program.

name: Khazara
