lore: Warbird commanded by Toreth. Covertly used by N'Vek and Deanna Troi to accomplish the defection of Vice-Proconsul M'ret in 2369.

name: Maternal Instinct
lore: In 2267, a Horta began killing human miners on Janus VI in order to protect its young.
game_text: Plays on table. Your cards are all compatible with each other. Your Youth personnel are attributes all +1. Nullified if you own and control a personnel without printed Youth and without "Youth" or "non-Youth" in gametext.

name: Soong-type Android
lore: A recently produced Soong-type android ready to select its gender and appearance. Replicated using a method developed by Data.

name: Humuhumunukunukuapua'a
lore: A reef triggerfish, Rhinecamthus aculeatus, found near Earth's tropical islands. An animated version is a symbolic "guide" on the U.S.S. Enterprise schoolroom computers.
game_text: Plays on any location. Your Youth personnel here are CUNNING +4 and STRENGTH +4; opponent's personnel are here are CUNNING -4 and STRENGTH -4.

name: Icheb
lore: Borg rescued from the collective and his own people, the Brunali. Protege of Seven of Nine. Is taking Starfleet Academy's core classes, taught by Voyager's senior staff.

name: Icheb (AI)
lore: Borg rescued from the collective and his own people, the Brunali. Protege of Seven of Nine. Is taking Starfleet Academy's core classes, taught by Voyager's senior staff.

name: Lal
lore: Soong-type android daughter of Data. Created through replication of Data's positronic pathways. Named for the Hindi word for imzadi or beloved.

name: FGC-47 Research
lore: FGC-47: Study interior of nebula filled with energy strands that obstruct navigation.
game_text: X = 6 minus each Navigation aboard ship (minimum 0).

name: U.S.S. Enterprise
game_text: None

name: Jem'Hadar Warship
lore: Mainstay battle cruiser of the Jem'Hadar fleets. Capable of serving as a mobile base for attack ships. Equipped with shield-penetrating transporters.

name: Starship Enterprise
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
lore: Venerable Starfleet ship refit in 2270. Completed many successful missions before being transferred to Captain Spock's command and retired for use as a training vessel.
game_text: Download Crew Reassignment

name: Kurdon
lore: Commanded by DaiMon Bok during his quest for vengeance against Captain Picard. First officer Kazago commanded following Bok's arrest.
game_text: Download Any TNG Ferengi personnel

name: Hunting Vessel
lore: Small ship usually manned by a hunting pair. Often travels in groups like that which subdued Voyager in 2374. Its monotanium armor scatters enemy targeting scanners.
game_text: X=7+ number of your other staffed Hirogen ships here.

name: Regency 1
lore: Massive flagship of the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. Commanded by Regent Worf. Has a stolen cloaking device installed - and sabotaged - by Rom.
game_text: Download Stolen Cloaking Device

name: Husnock Ship
lore: With a single thought, Kevin Uxbridge killed the entire Husnock race (50 billion lives) everywhere in the universe. Their powerful ships remain.
game_text: None

name: Gal Gath'thong
lore: Commanded by Keras during the incursion of Neutral Zone in 2266. Possibly the first Romulan ship with a cloaking device. Named for the firefalls on Romulus.
game_text: Download Any Romulan Original Series personnel

name: Vidiian Cruiser
lore: Largest starship in the Vidiian fleet. Capable of grappling onto an enemy ship, subduing it for boarding. Drenol commanded one.
game_text: Download Vidiian Boarding Claw

name: D'kyr
lore: 22nd-century mainstay of the Vulcan fleet. Combat cruiser tasked to ferry Phlox and T'Pol home after Enterprise was temporarily recalled in 2152.
game_text: SCIENCE

name: Kitara
lore: Flagship of a Bajoran blockade in 2375. Commanded by Colonel Kira in opposition to the Romulan fortification of their medical facilities on Derna.
game_text: Download Souls of the Dead

name: Locutus' Borg Cube
lore: Identification: BORG CUBE Task: Eliminate resistance at location designation Wolf 359. Locutus of Borg commands.
game_text: WEAPONS and SHIELDS +3 at Wolf 359. Your equipment and Borg personnel may report aboard.

name: Keldon Advanced
lore: Faster than standard Keldon-class vessels. Secretly upgraded by Obsidian Order. Staged in Orias System.
game_text: Attributes all -3 unless Obsidian Order in crew.

name: Defiant
lore: Constructed by the Terran Rebellion using stolen plans of the U.S.S. Defiant. Commanded by Benjamin Sisko during the defense of rebel-held Terok Nor.
game_text: (cannot carry ships aboard except shuttlepods)

name: U.S.S. Rio Grande
lore: First runabout assigned to Deep Space 9. Towed the Prakesh through the Bajoran Wormhole. Commanded by Benjamin Sisko.
game_text: Download Activate Tractor Beam

name: Voyager
lore: In 2372, Culluh and Seska took command of the Alpha Quadrant vessel U.S.S. Voyager and its technology for the benefit of the Kazon-Nistrim sect.
game_text: Download Home Away From Home

name: I.K.S. Rotarran
lore: Bird-of-prey stationed at Deep Space 9 during the war against the Dominion. Commanded by Martok. Led many raids into Cardassian and Dominion space.
game_text: None

name: Fesarius
lore: Immense spherical vessel. Flagship of the First Federation. Commanded by Balok.
game_text: Your Balok may report aboard (for free).

lore: Legendary prototype designed for deep space travel. Commanded by Jonathan Archer. First Starfleet vessel to bear the name that would symbolize Starfleet's elite.

name: Betazoid Gift Box
lore: Traditional device for presenting important gifts. Its sculpted face comes to life boisterously presenting its content to the recipient.
game_text: Immediately download to hand up to three cards from your draw deck (ignoring opponent's cards that prevent downloading). Discard artifact.

name: Kir'Shara
lore: Legendary Vulcan artifact containing Surak's original writings. Thought lost for centuries, its rediscovery led to the Vulcan Reformation and a new period of enlightenment.

name: Female's Love Interest & Garbage Scow
game_text: FEMALE'S LOVE INTEREST: Relocates a female present (random selection) to furthest different planet on this spaceline. RADIOACTIVE GARBAGE SCOW: Place on mission; mission attempt ends. Mission can't be attempted here. Ship with Tractor Beam and 2 ENGINEER can tow Scow.

name: Alien Abduction: Test Subjects
lore: In 2369, aliens from a tertiary subspace domain abducted crew members from the U.S.S. Enterprise. The crew used the holodeck to jog their memories of the incident.
game_text: Three personnel (random selection) are held with dilemma atop mission, Cure with 2 Physics OR a Holodeck and CUNNING>40.

name: Armus: Sticky Situation
lore: Armus, a remnant of the Vagrans, engulfed William T. Riker in his skin of evil. Only the finesse and skillful negotiation of Jean-Luc Picard resulted in his release.
game_text: Away Team member with highest STRENGTH is stopped if another personnel present has Diplomacy and CUNNING>7, killed otherwise. To get past requires any personnel remaining.

name: Balancing Act
lore: In an attempt to save the lives of millions, James T. Kirk crossed onto an unstable bridge to obtain Dr. Tolian Soran's control PADD. The feat required balance and strength.
game_text: Each player whose missions with point boxes were mostly Space or mostly Planet (by a difference of 3 or more) loses 50 points (even if playing Borg).

name: Barclay's Protomorphosis Disease
lore: Contagious affliction which causes animals to de-evolve into ancestral forms. Disease named for Lieutenant Reginald Barclay.
game_text: Unless MEDICAL, SCIENCE and SECURITY present, kills all personnel present (except inorganics). Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma

name: Buried Alive
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
lore: With the Starship Enterprise powerless to help, Khan left Admiral Kirk as Kirk had left him: marooned for eternity.
game_text: If you did not seed this dilemma, place on mission and attempt ends. Adds Space (does not count for Balancing Act). (Unique.)

name: Cytherians
lore: Race which explores the galaxy by giving other species the temporary ability and strong compulsion to come to them.
game_text: '''Attempt ends. Target location at this spaceline’s far end. Place on ship; it must do nothing but move towards there. Discard when reached (score points)

name: Enemies of the State
lore: The Romulan government tried to suppress Ambassador Spock's underground movement and its efforts towards unification.

name: Enemies of the State
lore: The Romulan government tried to suppress Ambassador Spock's underground movement and its efforts towards unification.
game_text: Place on planet. Opponent may download three dissidents to planet. Now and start of each attempt here, Away Team stopped if INTEGRITY from up to X personnel < opposing INTEGRITY. X = number of opposing personnel on surface.

name: Entertaining Display
lore: The Platonians' psychokinetic abilities allowed them to turn Captain Kirk, Mr. Spock, Lt. Uhura and Nurse Chapel into playthings for their amusement.
game_text: Opponent may download up to two females to planet; place on mission. To solve mission, Away Team must have Anthropology > number of opposing females on surface.

name: Hero Worship
lore: Timothy suppressed the trauma of losing his parents by emulating his new hero, the android Data. Counseling the boy occupied much of Data's time.
game_text: Stops non-Borg crew or Away Team members with the most and fewest icons. (In case of ties, stops all tied personnel.)

name: Hippocratic Oath
lore: Beverly Crusher was detained by Ansata separatists on Rutia IV. She was compelled to ease the suffering caused by their repeated use of dimensional shifting.
game_text: To get past, most CUNNING MEDICAL must relocate with dilemma to nearest planet at another location (must still have MEDICAL upon arrival); stopped until countdown expires.

name: Mimetic Simbiot
lore: In 2153, Phlox created Sim from a Lyssarrian desert larva. Archer and his crew chose to end Sim's life to save Trip's.
game_text: To get past requires 3 MEDICAL OR INTEGRITY>30. Then, choose two personnel (random selection). One of those personnel dies (your choice).

name: Misinterpreted History
lore: With the meaning of the Yangs' "holy words" lost to them, Captain Kirk re-educated them about freedom and liberty.
game_text: Personnel with highest CUNNING OR most Treachery (if any) is killed (opponent's choice). To get past requires Law and Archaeology OR Exobiology and 2 Leadership OR a President.

page_title: Now Would Be a Good Time (HF) (Errata)
name: Now Would Be a Good Time
base_name: Now Would Be a Good Time
lore: A transporter chief in possession of a good sense of timing can work miracles.
game_text: Your Transporter Skill here with transporters may beam up Away Team. Otherwise, one personnel present (opponent's choice) is captured; others stopped. Discard dilemma.

name: Q
lore: Incorrigible, extra-dimensional member of the Q Continuum, a race of omnipotent beings. Q exhibits a child-like petulance and sense of playfulness.
game_text: Unless 2 Leadership and INTEGRITY>60, opponent may download up to 2 Q cards and place them atop their Q-Continuum side deck; crew or Away Team has a Q-Flash of 4 cards, then is stopped. Discard dilemma.

name: Q-uality Time
lore: Honoring his promise not to trouble Picard's ship again, Q took the good captain hostage in a shuttlecraft to ensure his request was heard.
game_text: Opponent chooses: they may download and seed here Q OR highest INTEGRITY personnel returns to hand unless 2 Leadership and CUNNING>30. Discard dilemma.

name: Radioactive Garbage Scow
lore: Barges containing dangerous waste can be adrift for centuries. One such barge threatened Gamelon V in 2367.
game_text: Place on mission; mission attempt ends. Mission cannot be attempted here. Ship with Tractor Beam and 2 ENGINEER can tow Scow.

name: Subspace Shock Wave
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: On Stardate 9521.6, the U.S.S. Excelsior monitored a "minor incident" on the Klingon moon Praxis.
game_text: Ship is damaged and two crew members are killed (random selection) unless a Navigation personnel who has CUNNING>7 present. Discard dilemma.

name: The Whale Probe
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
lore: Unstaffed alien communications device. Sent to the Terran solar system in 2286. Broadcasting signal disables all technology in its wake. Waiting for a specific response.
game_text: Place on mission. End of every turn, moves one location toward and off spaceline's long end. All ships, personnel, and facilities are in stasis while here. (Unique.)

name: Bajoran Wormhole: Mirror Universe
game_text: '''Seeds (in any phase) or plays in Mirror Quadrant. Limit one. Inserts into spaceline to create a Bajor Region location (span 1); any player may download Bajoran Wormhole. Any ship may move between here and another Bajoran Wormhole if damaged or if ENGINEER and SCIENCE aboard, then is "stopped." OR Plays at any time to nullify any card which is closing or destroying Bajoran Wormhole (discard doorway).

name: Devidian Door
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, allows you to play a card "from the future." Once each turn, you may say "Devidian Door" and play one Personnel or Equipment card to any planet. At any time during your next turn (or at game end, if sooner), you must show a Devidian Door from hand and place it out-of-play, or you lose the game.

name: Dyson Sphere Door
game_text: Seeds on (opens) Dyson Sphere side deck (up to 13 dilemmas). You may seed Alternate dilemmas and examine cards in this side deck. Dilemmas you download must come from here (ignoring opponent's cards that prevent downloading). When opponent seeds Empok Nor, you may download and seed beneath it up to three dilemmas with "Empok Nor" in gametext or lore.

name: Dyson Sphere Door
game_text: Seeds on (opens) Dyson Sphere side deck (up to 13 dilemmas). You may seed Alternate dilemmas and examine cards in this side deck. Dilemmas you download must come from here (ignoring opponent's cards that prevent downloading). When opponent seeds Empok Nor, you may download and seed beneath it up to three dilemmas with "Empok Nor" in gametext or lore.

name: Dyson Sphere Door
game_text: Seeds on (opens) Dyson Sphere side deck (up to 13 dilemmas). You may seed Alternate dilemmas and examine cards in this side deck. Dilemmas you download must come from here (ignoring opponent's cards that prevent downloading). When opponent seeds Empok Nor, you may download and seed beneath it up to three dilemmas with "Empok Nor" in gametext or lore.

name: Preserver Obelisk
game_text: Seed one on table in facility phase; if you have no personnel in play, you may download up to 2 different Original Series personnel who name in lore a planet you seeded. Once each mission, score 5 points when such a personnel you control helps solve the planet mission they name. Nullifies your Assign Mission Specialists. OR Plays to download such a personnel if no copies you own are in play.

name: Preserver Obelisk
game_text: Seed one on table in facility phase; if you have no personnel in play, you may download up to 2 different Original Series personnel who name in lore a planet you seeded. Once each mission, score 5 points when such a personnel you control helps solve the planet mission they name. Nullifies your Assign Mission Specialists. OR Plays to download such a personnel if no copies you own are in play.

name: Q's Tent
game_text: Seeds on (opens) Q's Tent side deck (up to 13 different cards). You may examine cards in this side deck. OR Once each turn, plays to take a card from your Q's Tent into your hand, either your choice (discard doorway) or random selection (place doorway on top of your draw deck). Must show card to opponent. Draw no cards this turn.

name: Q's Tent: Civil War
game_text: Seeds on (opens) Q's Tent side deck (up to 13 different cards face down and up to 13 different cards face up). You may examine cards in this side deck. Your Q-Continuum side deck is closed and cannot be opened. You may not play Q's Tent. You may not begin mission attempts with less than four personnel.

name: Space-Time Portal
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Alternate cards may seed and (once per turn) play. At any time, discard doorway to download Alternate Universe Door (except to table) OR play Wormhole on a location to relocate your ship there (stopped) OR nullify Temporal Rift OR return one of your ships to owners' hands OR (once per game) report with up to four Alternate personnel an Alternate ship to any location.

name: Space-Time Portal
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Alternate cards may seed and (once per turn) play. At any time, discard doorway to download Alternate Universe Door (except to table) OR play Wormhole on a location to relocate your ship there (stopped) OR nullify Temporal Rift OR return one of your ships to owners' hands OR (once per game) report with up to four Alternate personnel an Alternate ship to any location.

name: Spacedoor (open)
property_logo: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
game_text: Seeds on your outpost during facility phase. Outpost is SHIELDS -8 (cumulative). In place of your normal card play, you may return your empty ship docked here (and all cards played on it) to owners' hands, nullifying any Static Warp Bubbles targeting you OR download Spacedock or one compatible Universal ship to outpost. Flip Spacedoor over after either use.

name: Spacedoor (closed)
property_logo: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
game_text: You may use opponent's Red Alert! (only at this outpost) as if you had a copy in play. At the end of your turn, you may discard a card from hand to flip Spacedoor over. (Immune to cards that close doorways.)

name: Temporal Benefactor
game_text: Seeds on table. Place one personnel beneath here from outside the game; "Benefactor" in play for uniqueness only. Your unique Alternate personnel naming (or named by) Benefactor in lore are temporal agents and (when in play) gain Benefactor's skills. Once each turn, you may place a personnel from hand beneath draw deck to download to hand Timepod Ring or a card with "temporal agent" in gametext or lore. (Unique.)

name: Temporal Conduit
game_text: Seeds on table. Your Alternate cards may seed and (once per turn) play. Twice each turn, you may place a card from hand beneath draw deck to relocate your Away Team or staffed ship from a time location to the corresponding spaceline location, or vice versa. Once per game, you may download Stone Knives and Bearskins OR Out of Time OR Temporal Investigations.

name: Temporal Micro-Wormhole
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. You may play Alternate personnel and Equipment . Once per game, you may download Space-Time Portal OR nullify its "report with" OR download Dr. Telek R'Mor. Your personnel may report aboard your ships, regardless of affiliation (limit once each turn, twice per game; discard doorway each time). Personnel played this way are compatible with your cards until they leave play.

name: Temporal Vortex
game_text: Plays on a time location. While in play, any ships may time travel between here and corresponding spaceline location. OR Suspends play while you place doorway on Borg Ship dilemma or The Shielak. While in play, dilemma disappears. OR Plays on table. While in play, nullifies Distortion of Space/Time Continuum. OR Relocates one of your ships at a time location to spaceline location of opponent's choice.

name: The Nexus
game_text: Seeds like a Space/Planet dilemma. When encountered, place on far end of spaceline. End of every turn, moves one location toward other end. (Not duplicatable.) All personnel here are placed under Nexus (in play for uniqueness only). Destroys all ships here. At end of spaceline, place on table. At any time, players may relocate their personnel here to a planet mission or time location. (Immune to Revolving Door.)

name: Medical Kit
lore: Collection of medical instruments. Though no substitute for a fully equipped medical facility, such devices are often sufficient to save lives when nothing more is available.
game_text: Your OFFICER-classification personnel present gain MEDICAL.

name: Mission Briefing PADD
lore: Personal Access Display Device loaded with mission-specific details for ready reference. Used for tasks from reporting scans to repairing historic warp vehicles.
