game_text: Plays on Devolin System Asteroid Belt. Even if not in play, your non-Mirror QuadrantStarfleet22nd Century personnel lose Alternate and Starfleet but add Hologram and Federation, and they (and Chef) add TNG while Continuing Mission in play. In place of your normal card play, you may download Chef. Once each turn, a unique Hologram22nd Century with INTEGRITY>6 may report for free to Chef. If Chef helps solve this mission, you may download U.S.S. Pegasus here.

name: Where Opportunities are Made
game_text: Seeds or plays on your Ferengi facility in the Alpha Quadrant. While your DS9 Ferengi ship is at a Gamma Quadrant location, your DS9 Ferengi personnel, may mix and cooperate with your Dosi, Karemma, Dominion ships, and Dominion facilities; your DS9 Ferengi personnel may report as if Gamma Quadrant and may report to Dosi Trading Post (as if Dosi). Once per game, you may download Cross-Quadrant Expansion to this facility.

name: Workhorses of the Fleet
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, you may play a Universal Excelsior-, Miranda-, Oberth-, or K't'inga-class ship for free (once per game per class). While all ships in play that you own are Excelsior-, Miranda-, Oberth-, K't'inga-, Ambassador-, or Constellation-classes, your ships are attributes all +X where X = 1+the total number of missions any player has completed or placed a Borg Only objective on.

name: Writ of Accountability
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once per game, downloads an FCA personnel; discard incident. OR Seeds or plays on table. Place on your Ferengi FCA personnel. If opponent has used Subspace Schism or Brain Drain more than twice OR played Static Warp Bubble, Anti-Time Anomaly or Black Hole more than once OR used their own dilemma(s) to score more than 15 points or to discard other dilemmas, they lose the game.

name: A Change of Plans
lore: The Borg Queen's initial consideration of Admiral Janeway's deal dissipated once she triangulated the admiral's signal. The Borg then adopted to a more aggressive strategy.
game_text: Plays to do any or all of the following: discard your current objective; return it to your hand if you have Borg Queen in play; and download one Borg Only Objective card.

name: Double Dumbass on You!
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
lore: Navigating an unfamiliar culture, with its unique idioms and colorful metaphors, can be quite a challenge.
game_text: Plays (once every turn) just after a dilemma has stopped personnel. Choose an Away Team at same location and stop up to two additional personnel (random selection).

name: Escape
lore: Pursued by the natives of Kolarus III, Jean-Luc Picard decided that the best course of action was to drive straight off a cliff, into the safety of an awaiting shuttlecraft.
game_text: Just after a dilemma targets at least one personnel to die, if you randomly discard cards from hand equal to the total number of targeted personnel, they are all stopped instead.

name: Escape Pod
lore: Most vessels carry escape pods to save the crew in an emergency. In 2153, Jonathan Archer used one on a Klingon vessel to escape his captors.
game_text: Plays at a location just after your ship there is destroyed; relocate its crew(s) atop this card. You may later relocate them to your ship here, then discard interrupt.

name: Oof!
lore: Surprised by Benjamin Sisko's rather unconventional response to Q's antagonism, the allegedly omnipotent being protested, "You hit me! Picard never hit me!"
game_text: Once per game, opponent loses 5 points for each copy of Amanda Rogers, Kevin Uxbridge, and Q2 they have removed from this game. (Immune to Amanda Rogers.) OR Nullifies Fightin' Words.

name: Outgunned
lore: Surrounded by a fleet of Suliban ships, Jonathan Archer decided to save the lives of his crew by conceding to Silik's demands.
game_text: Plays at start of battle against opponent's only ship here. If undocked and your total WEAPONS involved > its SHIELDS x3: battle cancelled; ship commandeered and crew captured.

name: Q2
lore: Called by Q as an expert witness on the Q Continuum, Q provided testimony to himself during Quinn's hearing. "Ta-da!"
game_text: Nullifies Amanda Rogers OR Kevin Uxbridge OR Q icon dilemma OR a dilemma with the word "Q" in title.

name: Quinn
lore: Member of the Q who felt immortal life had become futile, meaningless, and unendurable. Lobbied to be made mortal so he could commit suicide and upset the Continuum's status quo.
game_text: Thrice per game, lose points to nullify an Interrupt or Event just played or activated, unless Shield or "immune" to Kevin Uxbridge or Amanda Rogers

name: Smooth As an Android's Bottom?
lore: Geordi once told Data that technological perfection can shave too close. That, of course, depends on the desired results.
game_text: Once each turn, plays to draw three cards from the bottom of your draw deck (may not be converted to downloads). Place each personnel card drawn out-of-play. OR Prevents the death of one Youth personnel.

name: The Wake of the Borg
lore: The New Providence colony on Jouret IV was scooped up by the Borg in 2366, just as Federation and Romulan outposts along the Neutral Zone had been destroyed in 2364.

name: The Wake of the Borg
lore: The New Providence colony on Jouret IV was scooped up by the Borg in 2366, just as Federation and Romulan outposts along the Neutral Zone had been destroyed in 2364.

name: The Wake of the Borg
lore: The New Providence colony on Jouret IV was scooped up by the Borg in 2366, just as Federation and Romulan outposts along the Neutral Zone had been destroyed in 2364.
game_text: Plays on opponent's Neutral Zone mission if they seeded 4 or more. End of opponent's next turn, all non-Borg ships, facilities and personnel there are returned to hand.

name: Vulcan Mindmeld
property_logo: Star Trek: The Wrath of Khan
lore: Ancient Vulcan ritual which telepathically links minds to intimately share each other's thoughts and knowledge. Captain Spock stored his katra in Dr. McCoy using one. "Remember."
game_text: Plays on your Mindmeld personnel. Personnel gains the skills of one of your other personnel present until end of turn. At the end of turn, discard interrupt.

page_title: What Does God Need With a Starship? (Errata) (VP)
name: What Does God Need With a Starship?
base_name: What Does God Need With a Starship?
lore: While orbiting Pollux IV, the godlike Apollo caused the wind to withdraw from the sails of the Starship Enterprise and demanded that the crew worship him and pay tribute.
game_text: Nullifies "God." OR Plays once per game. Opponent chooses: you may download a ship to any location or you may stop or unstop (your choice) any ship in play.

name: Wormhole
lore: An unstable tunnel through subspace that links to locations in normal space/time.
game_text: Requires two wormholes. Play one on your exposed ship. Play the other at any location (even a time location). Ship relocates to that location (and then is stopped).

name: Access Archives
lore: Memory Alpha: Acquire information from central Federation library, built in the 23rd century.
game_text: none

name: Cloaked Mission
lore: Romulus System Region • Romulus: Secretly escort covert operatives to the Romulan homeworld.

name: Excavation
lore: Kurl: Assist new archaeological dig.

name: Excavation
lore: Kurl: Assist new archaeological dig.

name: Expose Covert Supply
lore: Qo'noS: Uncover covert supply lines supporting rebels on the Klingon homeworld.

name: Oppress Population
lore: Vulcan: Quell dissension and ensure allegiance among native inhabitants of Vulcan homeworld.
game_text: [none]

name: Recruit Ally
lore: Near Goralis system: Rendezvous with Breen flagship in Dominion-occupied Cardassian space.
game_text: Once solved, your Breen ships may report with staffing here.

name: Search for Rebels
lore: Badlands Region ● Terran Hideout: Locate secret base of escaped slaves.
game_text: When seeded, you may download one Emblem card.

page_title: The Discovery of Sha Ka Ree (Errata) (TMPR)
name: The Discovery of Sha Ka Ree
base_name: The Discovery of Sha Ka Ree
lore: Great Barrier Region • Sha Ka Ree: "...to undertake the greatest adventure of all time..."
game_text: X=number of non-Sybok Sha Ka Ree personnel present (limit 6).

name: Assign Mission Specialists
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. You may download to one of your outposts up to two different mission specialists (personnel whose only skill is a regular skill) if no copies you own are in play. Once each mission, your mission specialist may score 5 points when they use their skill to meet a mission requirement. You may voluntarily discard objective at start of any of your turns. (Unique.)

name: Assimilate Homeworld
game_text: Plays on table. Target both a homeworld with no Borg Only objective on it and your matching counterpart. Your Borg may scout that homeworld. After scouting complete, if your matching counterpart is at that location, you may probe: Communications : Assimilated. Place on mission. Cards of that affiliation (except Alternate cards) may not report to any outpost for rest of game.

name: Commandeer Ship
property_logo: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
game_text: Plays on your unstopped Computer Skill personnel who is unopposed aboard opponent's ship (except any Borg Cube). That personnel commandeers ship and, while objective in play, may meet up to three of its staffing icons. OR Seeds or plays on table. Opponent may not return to hand any ship which has your personnel aboard as an intruder or infiltrator..

name: Defend Homeworld
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. When opponent voluntarily initiates battle against your card at a homeworld matching that card's affiliation, just after it is targeted you may download there any number of HQ cards and compatible ships, leaders, SECURITY personnel, and hand weapons. Once per game, you may discard objective to download a SECURITY personnel OR any HQ card (except Return Orb to Bajor).

name: General Order 7
game_text: Seeds or plays on Talos IV. Your FederationOriginal Series personnel may attempt this mission. Once each turn, in place of a card draw, you may download to hand Christopher Pike or any personnel who names him in lore. Your Starship Enterprise may use its full RANGE to move here from any spaceline location in the Alpha Quadrant.

name: Obsession
game_text: Seeds on table; you must download a Self-controlling dilemma (except Borg Ship), choose a spaceline, then put it into play at either end (opponent's choice). Once each turn, your Event that plays on your ship may play for free. When you destroy a Self-controlling dilemma without a point box, score points equal to double its printed RANGE. (Unique.)

name: Operate Wormhole Relays
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. once each turn, your staffed ship with two or fewer staffing icons and SCIENCE, Physics x2, and Astrophysics aboard may move through Barzan or Bajoran Wormhole (or between two Transwarp Network Gateways) by using RANGE equal to twice the span of the destination location, and is not stopped.

name: Prepare Landing Party
game_text: Plays on your Planet mission. At start of your first mission attempt here, you may download one Universal Original Series SECURITY personnel OR one Original Series equipment to Away Team. If three unique Original Series personnel with different classifications are present when you solve mission, discard objective to score points OR draw 3 cards. Nullified if you play (or have played) a non-Original Series personnel.

name: Reflection Therapy
game_text: '''Plays on a personnel (except Suna) if your Treachery > Honor present. Replace one regular skill with one level of another regular skill (discard if skill lost). Any player may nullify with 3 Empathy present. OR Plays on an opponent's personnel affected by Frame of Mind; personnel is captured. Discard objective if rescued or (on a later turn) to download Brainwash or Interrogation to this captive.

name: Reunite Legends
game_text: 'Seeds or plays on your outpost. Once per game, you may download a matching TOS Classic films ship here (except I.K.S. Kla'Diyus). When your crew completes a Space mission aboard a TOS Classic films ship, if crew included at least seven unique TOS Classic films personnel at start of attempt, discard objective to score points'''

name: Seek Hidden Reliquary
game_text: Plays on your Archaeology personnel (for free if Tallera OR The Katra of Surak present). Once per game, you may download and seed at a planet here an artifact with "Vulcan" in title or lore. When your Away Team including a personnel earns Kir’Shara here, you may download a Honor personnel (X=their printed INTEGRITY; discard objective).

name: Study Divergent History
game_text: Seeds or plays on Guest Quarters OR The Intendant's Quarters OR your Mirror Quadrant ship OR a headquarters. Once each turn, you may stop two personnel present from opposite quadrants to draw a card. Doubles point boxes of your File Mission Report in this quadrant (for opposite quadrant missions).

name: The Inner Light
game_text: Seeds or plays on Parvenium System; download and seed Ressikan Flute here. Your personnel may attempt this mission. When you acquire Ressikan Flute, choose a personnel (they are now Kamin). When Kamin helps solve a planet mission, you may download Drought Tree there. (If on Kataan or Kamin is Jean-Luc Picard, double Drought Tree points and they may not be nullified.) (Unique.)

name: The Squire's Rules
game_text: Seeds in doorway phase. At start of dilemma phase, shuffle all your dilemmas. You must seed them without looking at them. When your Space/Planet dilemma is revealed, if no other copies of that dilemma that you own have been revealed this game, it stops one personnel (random selection); otherwise, it is a mis-seed. All other cards you seed under missions are mis-seeds (except artifacts). You may not download dilemmas.

name: Akorem Laan
lore: Bajoran poet from the 22nd-century. Believed he was the Emissary of the Prophets sent to restore his people's d'jarras.

name: Bareil
lore: Skilled thief and decryption expert. Bareil Antos was romantically involved with both the Intendant and Kira Nerys, who gave him an Orb experience.

name: Brilgar
lore: Representative of Bajoran security officers serving aboard Deep Space 9. Often served as a bodyguard for visiting dignitaries and key personnel.

name: Teero Anaydis
lore: Excommunicated Vedek. Worked in counterintelligence for the Maquis. Experimented with using mind control to recruit agents. Honed his techniques on Tuvok.

name: Five of Fourteen
lore: Identification: Deployment DroneTask: Assess inter-hive resourcing. Optimize.Biological Distinctiveness: Humanoid.

name: Founder Leader
lore: Female changeling. Center of power for the entire Dominion. Key figure in the Great Link. Told Odo of his origin; greatly desires his return to the Link.

name: Hanok
lore: Karemma Commerce Minister. Helped to defuse a torpedo lodged in the hull of the U.S.S. Defiant. Learned of Ferengi business philosophy from Quark.

name: Admiral Janeway
lore: In an alternate future, the U.S.S. Voyager was lost for 23 years. So Kathryn Janeway travelled back in time to give her younger self a faster route home.

name: Ambassador Sarek
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: Vulcan ambassador. Assigned Spock to negotiate peace with Gorkon. Yielded to Klingon due process in Admiral Kirk and Dr. McCoy's trial for murder.

name: Anhaica
lore: Typical human settler on Dorvan V. He joined the Maquis after the colony was passed to Cardassian control following the U.S.S. Enterprise visit in 2370.

name: Anhaica (AI)
lore: Typical human settler on Dorvan V. He joined the Maquis after the colony was passed to Cardassian control following the U.S.S. Enterprise visit in 2370.

name: Captain Sulu
lore: After moving through the ranks aboard the Starship Enterprise, Lt. Sulu earned a captaincy in 2290. Holds loyalty in high regard, his crew as dear as family.

name: Chief Engineer Scott
lore: Mr. Scott is chief engineer of the I.S.S. Enterprise. Scotty is a relentless taskmaster. His department has the highest rate of turnover on the ship.

name: Christopher Pike
lore: Noted human captain. He commanded the Starship Enterprise, succeeding Robert April and preceding Captain Kirk. Explored many strange new worlds.

name: Dr. McCoy
lore: Leonard H. "Bones" McCoy. Chief medical officer of the starship Enterprise. Awarded the Legion of Honor.

name: James T. Kirk
lore: Famous captain thought lost in 2293. Returned from the Nexus 78 years later to make a difference once more.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
lore: Captain of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Human born in LaBarre, France. He has an artificial heart. Reads Shakespeare. Something of a Renaissance man.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
lore: Captain of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Human born in LaBarre, France. He has an artificial heart. Reads Shakespeare. Something of a Renaissance man.

name: Lt. Uhura
lore: Linguist quick to learn the rules of the game in the mirror universe. She distracted Security Chief Sulu.

name: Miles O'Brien
lore: Human chief of operations. Irish. He formerly served aboard the U.S.S. Rutledge and the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Mr. Scott
lore: Chief engineer. Scotty often served as acting captain of the Starship Enterprise. He has impeccable timing.

name: The Trois
lore: Tog abducted the Betazoid Lwaxana Troi and her half-human daughter Deanna Troi, beamed them out of their clothes, and planned to exploit their skills.

name: Yeoman Rand
lore: Janice Rand is yeoman to Captain Kirk aboard the Starship Enterprise. She was captain of the Academy Diving Team. Student of horticulture and xenobotany.

name: Gozar
lore: Talented Ferengi officer. Recruited by Bok to help in the capture and ransom of Jason Vigo. Devotee of the Rules of Acquisition.

name: Quark Son of Keldar
lore: Quark wedded Grilka by brek'tal ritual to head the House of Kozak (as the House of Quark) on Qo'noS. The Ferengi saved his be'nal from financial ruin.

name: Captain B'Etor
lore: B'Etor is the younger sister of Captain Lursa. Seeks to bring Security Chief Garak and The Intendant to trial for negligence and fraternizing with the enemy.

name: J'Ddan
lore: Klingon trained in the field of science. Smuggled Federation secrets to the Romulans in the form of amino acid codes.

name: K'Temoc
lore: Captain of the sleeper ship I.K.S. T'Ong, on a crucial mission ordered by the High Command in the late 23rd century. Awoke 75 years later in a much-changed galaxy.

name: George and Gracie
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
lore: Two humpback whales, male and female, raised in captivity on 20th-century Earth. Gracie is pregnant.

name: Dr. Tolian Soran
lore: El-Aurian refugee "rescued" from the Nexus in 2293 by the U.S.S. Enterprise-B. Spent the next 78 years obsessed with returning there, no matter the cost.

name: Excalbian Surak
lore: Excalbian who posed as the famous Vulcan scientist and philosopher. Abhors violence. Finds it more logical to heal than to kill. He went in peace to propose peace.

name: Excalbian Surak (AI)
lore: Excalbian who posed as the famous Vulcan scientist and philosopher. Abhors violence. Finds it more logical to heal than to kill. He went in peace to propose peace.

name: Khan
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
lore: Genetically engineered augment exiled to Ceti Alpha V by Admiral Kirk. Seeks to avenge his wife's death.

name: Lore
lore: Evil Soong-type android. Data's "elder brother."

name: Mas'ud
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
lore: Specimen of late 20th-century genetic engineering. Augment who swore loyalty to Khan. Studied the effects of the Ceti eel while trapped on Ceti Alpha V.

name: Rayna Kapec
lore: Android companion created by Flint. Struggled with her newfound emotional attachment to Captain Kirk.

name: Suna
lore: Military official of Tilonus IV. He twisted William T. Riker's mind using neurosomatic techniques. Typical of treacherous Tilonian government interrogators.

name: Vina
lore: Human survivor who became a green-skinned slave girl in an illusion. Attempted to seduce Christopher Pike for her Talosian captors.

name: Shinzon
lore: Human clone of Jean-Luc Picard. General of a Reman Army. Possibly the worst Praetor in the history of the Romulan Star Empire.

name: Taibak
lore: Scientist who developed a mind control device using E-band emissions. Controlled Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge through his VISOR.

name: The Viceroy
lore: Telepathic Reman advisor to the Praetor, Shinzon. Dominion War veteran. General of Reman army.

name: Tomalak
lore: Commander of the D'deridex-class warbird Deranas. He is a frequent nemesis of the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Maxwell Forrest
lore: Respected admiral. Friend of Soval. Sent the crew of Enterprise out into the final frontier to go where no man had gone before.

name: Naprem
lore: Bird-of-Prey commanded by Dukat. Commandeered near the Cardassian outpost on Korma. Named for Tora Ziyal's mother. Carried Jodmos to Ty'Gokor in 2373.

name: Vetar
lore: Cardassian warship that surveyed Dorvan V. Pursued the Liberty into the Badlands. Commanded by Evek.
game_text: Download Any Pursuit card. WEAPONS +2 vs. Maquis

name: Dosi Trade Vessel
lore: Standard commerce ship used by the Dosi. Uses a similar hull design as the ships of the Karemma, but equipped with better weaponry.
game_text: May report to Dosi planet.
characteristics: Dominion ship. Ship with a Skill

name: U.S.S. Enterprise
lore: The fifth Starfleet ship named Enterprise, launched in 2363. Built at the Utopia Planetia shipyards orbiting Mars.
game_text: None

name: U.S.S. Enterprise-A
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: Specially commissioned in 2286 to replace the famous ship lost one year earlier. Proudly continued the mission of its predecessor under the command of James T. Kirk.
game_text: Any Federation Classic Films personnel OR James T. Kirk

name: U.S.S. Enterprise-B
lore: Third Federation ship so christened, launched on stardate 9715. Became fully operational the following Tuesday.
game_text: El-Aurians may report aboard.

name: I.K.S. Bortas
lore: Flagship commanded by Gowron during the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68. Worf briefly served aboard as a weapons officer.

name: Phoenix
lore: Earth's first faster-than-light-ship. Launched via a Titan missile. Commanded by Zefram Cochrane.
game_text: May take off (score points) and land once per game.

name: Tsunkatse Ship
lore: Formidable vessel commanded by Penk, from which he broadcasts his popular fighting circuit. Heavily shielded to prevent anyone from abducting his competitors.
game_text: Your personnel with "Tsunkatse" in lore may report aboard.

name: Enterprise
lore: Legendary prototype designed for deep space travel. Commanded by Jonathan Archer. First Starfleet vessel to bear the name that would symbolize Starfleet's elite.
game_text: Attributes all +1 for each Starfleet Command aboard (limit 5).

name: Shuttlepod Two
lore: Typical Starfleet shuttlecraft of the mid-22nd century. Has plasma weapons and a ditanium hull.Has no transporters.
game_text: May report with 1 personnel to your NX-class ship.

name: Sh'Raan
lore: Vulcan combat cruiser dispatched to rendezvous with Enterprise. Efficiently disabled Mazarite attackers attempting to capture Ambassador V'Lar.
game_text: Tractor Beam, Navigation Combat-Ready: Tactical Reserve

name: Breen Disruptor Burst
game_text: ATTACK bonus +3 if you have a Breen ship firing.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Phase Cannons
game_text: ATTACK bonus +2 if you have a Starfleet ship firing.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Maximum Firepower
game_text: Hit = Tactic Draw (or Tactic Draw Tactic Draw if you have Future Enterprise, I.K.C. Chang, I.K.C. Fek'Ihr#Star Trek 1st Edition|I.K.C. Fek'Ihr]], Decius, any Alternate ship with the word "future" in its lore firing). Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: T’Pol/Soong Maneuver
game_text: ATTACK bonus +3 and DEFENSE bonus +2 if you have a NX-class ship firing. Hit = Tactic CurrentTactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic CurrentTactic DrawTactic Draw

name: 22nd-Century San Francisco
lore: 2154 Earth: San Francisco survived World War III and became a beacon of human progress.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; download Seat of Starfleet here. Each card with both Starfleet and Promo gains 22nd Century (even if not in play). Native to this timeline: all Starfleet cards, Non-Aligned 22nd Century personnel, Neutral 22nd Century cards, and 22nd Century equipment (except Mirror Quadrant cards). Non-22nd Century cards are excluded from battle here.

name: Drone Control Room
lore: 2154 Romulus: From the spies of Romulus, ten soldiers nearly conquered the galaxy.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; any player may download Admiral Valdore here. If any player has Empathy, Leadership, and Treachery here, that player's Drone-class ships may move and attack without staffing or a leader. Native to this timeline: all Romulan 22nd Century cards and 22nd Century equipment. Once per turn, one native personnel reporting at this location may report for free.

name: Halkan Council
lore: 2267 Halkan Planet: Site of dilithium deposits and obstinate inhabitants.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; any players may download one Mirror Quadrant Constitution-class ship here. Native to this timeline: all Alternate Mirror Quadrant Original Series cards, and all Original Series Equipment cards. Once per turn, one such card reporting at this location may report for free.

name: MACO Training Camp
lore: 2154 Luna: Military Assault Command Operations established a training facility on Earth's moon.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Any player who did not seed Earth may report a MACO for free here (once per turn) and may (if possible) relocate them to his or her NX-class ship. Any such player, in place of a normal card play, may download Military Assault Command Operations (even from discard pile). Native to this time: all Starfleet cards, Neutral 22nd Century cards, and 22nd Century equipment (except Mirror Universe cards).

name: Singha Refugee Camp
lore: 2346 Bajor: The Cardassian Union occupied Bajor, leaving the natives with few resources.

name: Temporal Vortex
game_text: Plays on a time location. While in play, any ships may time travel between here and corresponding spaceline location. OR Suspends play while you place doorway on Borg Ship dilemma or The Shielak. While in play, dilemma disappears. OR Plays on table. While in play, nullifies Distortion of Space/Time Continuum. OR Relocates one of your ships at a time location to spaceline location of opponent's choice.

name: Fair Play
lore: When Miles O'Brien discovered his publicized racquetball match was unfairly influenced by an alien gambling device, he refused to take advantage of an unfair situation.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; may not be nullified. No player may solve an opponent's unique mission unless its point box shows at least 40 points OR both players have a copy of it in play.
image_file: Fairplay RR v1 old copyright line.jpeg

name: Fair Play
lore: In 2372, Tom Paris concocted a sweepstakes to guess the daily radiogenic particle count, skimming a tenth of the proceeds for himself. Chakotay put a stop to the game, confiscating the pot.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; may not be nullified. No player may solve an opponent's unique mission unless its point box shows at least 40 points OR both players have a copy of it in play.
image_file: Fairplay RR v2 old copyright line.jpeg

name: Intermix Ratio
lore: Zefram Cochrane struggled to maintain the optimum balance of matter and anti-matter injection for the Phoenix warp systems. The proper ratio, of course, is 1 to 1.
game_text: Plays on table. If any player's ratio of bonus points to non-bonus points exceeds 1:1, the excess bonus points do not count toward winning. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Mirror Image
lore: Jean-Luc Picard reflected upon introducing an unstable element into a critical situation.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. All Red Alert!, Kivas Fajo - Collector, Masaka Transformations and The Traveler: Transcendence cards affect all players. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Shape-Shift Inhibitor
lore: Prototype device developed by the Obsidian Order. Emits a quantum stasis field that prevents a changeling from altering its biomolecular structure.

name: The Big Picture
lore: Jean-Luc Picard has to convince Lily Sloane that she was on a starship orbiting Earth. To defeat the Borg, Captain Picard's crew had to succeed on the ship as well as on the planet.
game_text: Plays on table. Each player who has not solved (or scouted) at least two missions with point boxes (one Space and one Planet) needs an additional 40 points to win. (May not be nullified.)
image_file: Thebigpicture RR v1 old copyright line.jpeg

name: The Big Picture
lore: Though facing a long voyage across uncharted space, Kathryn Janeway never lost sight of her ultimate goal – to get her ship and crew home.
game_text: Plays on table. Each player who has not solved (or scouted) at least two missions with point boxes (one Space and one Planet) needs an additional 40 points to win. (May not be nullified.)
image_file: Thebigpicture RR v2 old copyright line.jpeg

name: Villagers with Torches
lore: After years of poverty, the Takarians were eager to be rid of their Great Sages. Fortunately, Chakotay and Tom Paris were there to keep them from being sent away on "wings of fire."
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Whenever opponent begins a planet mission attempt with fewer than three personnel, all are killed unless opponent has Thermal Deflectors in play.

name: Feedback Surge
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. If opponent completes Establish Gateway targeting a mission they did not seed, you score those points (instead of opponent). Also, if opponent discards any seed cards using Ajur, Boratus, Senior Staff Meeting, or their own dilemma, you may immediately re-seed them under any mission(s); opponent loses 10 points for each such card.

name: HQ: Orbital Weapons Platform
game_text: Plays on any homeworld. Each time opponent initiates battle here against your ship or facility matching this homeworld's affiliation, just after it is targeted each of your Orbital Weapons Platforms here may "fire upon" an opposing ship present. Each ship fired upon is damaged = Tactic Draw for each Platform that targets it, and you may exclude that ship from that battle.

name: In the Zone
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. If a non-Borg player scores more than 50 points during a single turn (including this turn), those points in excess of 50 do not count toward winning. While your score is exactly 50 points, each of your ships has double RANGE and SHIELDS. Also, nullifies End Transmission and Preparation, and each player may call "Devidian Door" only during their turn (and only once per turn).

name: Intruder Alert!
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; nullifies all seeded Memory Wipe cards. At any time, you may capture a one- or two-person Away Team in your Ops or assimiliate one personnel intruder on your Borg ship or facility if your Talon Drone is present (discard incident) OR download Intruder Force Field (place incident atop event to protect it from nullification and extend its effects to all intruders on your ships).

name: It's Only a Game
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Limits each non-Borg report with crew action to four total personnel/equipment. Limits Red Alert! to one Personnel, one Ship and one Equipment card per turn. Limits probing and doubling for Visit Cochrane Memorial to once per game per persona. Also, whenever opponent draws three or more cards in one turn, you may download (even from discard pile) Scorched Hand, ignoring Computer Crash.

name: Q the Referee
game_text: '''Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, you may play one Referee card for free OR discard (or place beneath draw deck) one of your Referee cards from hand or in play to draw a card. Also, you may suspend play while you download any other Referee card (ignoring Computer Crash), then discard incident.

name: White Deprivation
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. At start of every player's turn, all of that player's Ketracel White personnel present together must battle (and stun or mortally wound when able) opposing non-changelings present, or (if none) any non-changelings present, or (if none) each other (split randomly into two equal groups). Also, one Ketracel White personnel in each of that player's crews and Away Teams dies (random selection).

name: Oof!
lore: Surprised by Benjamin Sisko's rather unconventional response to Q's antagonism, the allegedly omnipotent being protested, "You hit me! Picard never hit me!"

name: Scorched Hand
lore: Plasma gas from the ruptured coolant tank liquified all the organic skin grafted onto Data's endoskeletal structure.
game_text: Plays to cause each player who has more than 12 cards in hand to shuffle all but 6 (random selection) and place beneath draw deck. (Immune to Amanda Rogers.)

name: The Juggler
lore: The Juggler hosted Lwaxana Troi and Alexander Rozhenko's visit to the Parallax Colony, all the time juggling his three worlds.
game_text: Choose any player to re-shuffle the cards in their draw deck.

name: The Wake of the Borg
lore: The New Providence colony on Jouret IV was scooped up by the Borg in 2366, just as Federation and Romulan outposts along the Neutral Zone had been destroyed in 2364.

name: Klaestron Outpost
lore: Klaestron IV is a member of the United Federation of Planets. Its inhabitants also maintain a strong alliance with the Cardassian Union.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Klaestron ENGINEER.

name: Kasidy Yates
lore: Freighter captain for Bajoran Ministry of Commerce. Smuggled weapons for the Maquis in 2372. Loves baseball. Romantically involved with Benjamin Sisko.

name: Kira
lore: Ironically, Kira Nerys trained Legate Damar's freedom fighters in Resistance tactics. The Bajoran accepted a Starfleet commission to help ease the racial tensions.

name: Kira
lore: Ironically, Kira Nerys trained Legate Damar's freedom fighters in Resistance tactics. The Bajoran accepted a Starfleet commission to help ease the racial tensions.

name: Rom
lore: Brilliant yet befuddled Ferengi engineer. Works for the Bajorans aboard Deep Space 9. Quark's brother. Nog's father. Gaila's cousin. Has a crush on Leeta.

name: Tora Ziyal
lore: Half-Bajoran daughter of Tora Naprem and Dukat. Survived crash of the Ravinok on Dozaria. Rescued in 2372. Talented artist. Fond of Elim Garak.

name: Ilon Tandro
lore: Klaestron dignitary. Son of Enine and General Ardelon Tandro. In 2369, used Cardassian technology to gain access to Deep Space 9 in order to kidnap Jadzia Dax.

name: Overseer Odo
lore: The mirror version of Odo supervises ore processing on Terok Nor. Has strict rules of obedience. The only changeling his contemporaries have ever seen.

name: Data and Picard
lore: To search for Spock on Romulus, the Soong-type android Data and his human captain, Jean-Luc Picard, disguised themselves as Romulan citizens.

name: Koval
lore: Chairman of the Tal Shiar. Seeks appointment to the Continuing Committee. Suffers from Tuvan Syndrome. Conspired with Sloan to bring down Senator Cretak.

name: Major Rakal
lore: Physically altered, the half-Betazoid, half-human Deanna Troi was coerced to assume the identity of a Tal Shiar major in the 2369 M'ret defection plot.

name: Stefan DeSeve
lore: Former Federation officer who defected to Romulus in 2349. Later, apparently had second thoughts. Joined Spock's Romulan underground in 2369.

name: The Emissary
lore: Benjamin Sisko discovered the Celestial Temple in 2369. Reluctantly accepts Bajoran reverence.

name: Aluura
lore: Humanoid dabo girl. In three months she didn't spill a drink, mix up a food order or short-change a bill. Actually liked by other dabo girls – and even the Ferengi waiters.

name: Jake and Nog
lore: Jake Sisko and Nog are best friends. Loiterers. Frequently chased away from "their spot" by Odo. Briefly owned 100 gross of self-sealing stem bolts.

name: Leeta
lore: Bajoran dabo girl. Formed the Guild of Restaurant and Casino Employees with Rom. Amateur sociologist. Was formerly separated from Julian Bashir on Risa in 2373.

name: Mardah
lore: Bajoran entomology student. Dabo girl. Orphaned by Cardassians. Romantically involved with Jake Sisko. Accepted to the science academy on Regulus III.

name: Nog
lore: Dedicated, hardworking ensign. The first Ferengi in Starfleet. Friend of Jake. Briefly served as chief engineer of U.S.S. Valiant under Captain Watters.

name: Prot
lore: Ferengi ensign who manned the conn station in Barash's illusion. Riker thought him one of the few elements of the simulation he could get used to.

name: Garak
lore: Cardassian male. Virtual player in the Vorta scenario testing the resolve of Alpha Quadrant species. Risked his life in the defense of his comrades.

name: Stolen Attack Ship
lore: Jem'Hadar attack ship briefly commanded by Luaran. Upgraded with Breen weapon technology. Stolen by members of Damar's rebellion; commanded by Kira.

name: Battle Cruiser
lore: Klingon battle cruiser, circa 2267. Some were provided to the Romulan Star Empire in exchange for cloaking technology. Commander Charvanek captained one.
game_text: Download Any Universal Original Series Klingon or Romulan

name: Cha'Joh
lore: Small, obsolete, twenty-year-old Bird-of-Prey commanded by Lursa and B'Etor, the Sisters of Duras.

page_title: Where No Man Has Gone Before (CoC)
name: Where No Man Has Gone Before
base_name: Where No Man Has Gone Before
lore: Going boldly into the unknown frontiers of the galaxy, brave captains and crews cheat death in search of new life.
game_text: Plays on table. At start of turn, your undocked ships at any spaceline end are RANGE +3 until end of turn. Once per turn, when your ship moves from one spaceline to another, you may draw a card OR report an Alternate card aboard.

name: Benjamin Sisko
lore: Lieutenant Commander Benjamin Sisko was the executive officer of the U.S.S. Saratoga in 2366 during the Borg attack at Wolf 359.

name: Captain Kirk
lore: Kirk relied heavily on his senior officers and closest friends in his command of the Starship Enterprise.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
lore: Rescued Borg counterpart. After returning to his command of the U.S.S. Enterprise, Picard developed a violent vendetta against the Borg.

name: Kathryn Janeway
lore: Commander of the U.S.S. Voyager on a mission to retrieve her undercover security officer, Tuvok. Bailed Tom Paris out of jail. Likes dogs.

name: William T. Riker
lore: While in command of the U.S.S. Enterprise-E, Riker defended the ship against attack by the Son'a. Reminded Picard, "No uniform, no orders."

name: K'mpec
lore: Chancellor and leader of the Klingon High Council. Willing to dishonor Worf in order to avoid political division. Fat.

name: Starship Enterprise
lore: Its five-year mission: to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations, to boldly go where no man has gone before.
game_text: Download Where No Man Has Gone Before

name: U.S.S. Defiant
lore: Riker dubbed the U.S.S. Defiant a "tough little ship." Commanded by Worf when the Borg attacked Earth.
game_text: WEAPONS and SHIELDS +3 vs. Borg.

name: U.S.S. Enterprise
lore: Encountered the U.S.S. Enterprise-C in an alternate reality. Became the Future Enterprise in an alternate future. Visited by crew from the Starship Enterprise.
game_text: Download Wall of Ships

name: U.S.S. Enterprise-E
lore: The latest in the Enterprise line, it gets "all the easy assignments." Commanded by William T. Riker in the Briar Patch incident with the Son'a.
game_text: WEAPONS and SHIELDS +1 for each Enterprise-E aboard.

name: U.S.S. Voyager
lore: U.S.S. Voyager employed a tricyclic input manifold of the warp core, variable-geometry pylons and a rather large complement of shuttlecraft.
game_text: Shuttlecraft you download may come from discard pile.

name: I.K.C. Qam-Chee
lore: Flagship commanded by the Klingon Chancellor, K'mpec. Met with U.S.S. Enterprise to arbitrate the selection of a new Chancellor for the Klingon Empire.
game_text: Opposing cards here are attributes -1.

name: Scimitar
lore: Massive predator of a ship commanded by Shinzon. Its brief contact with the U.S.S. Enterprise-E would leave a lasting impression.
game_text: Download Any TacticDownload Engage Cloak

name: Off-Zel Vase
lore: Kivas Fajo kept one of the few surviving pottery vases created by Mark Off-Zel, a native of Sirrie IV. Former Klingon Chancellor K'mpec also owned a similar treasure.
game_text: Place in your point area. Z changes, where Z=the number of quadrants in which you have completed a mission (beyond the first.)

name: Damaged Reputation
lore: "I'm Captain Kathryn Janeway. This is Commander Tuvok. We're from the Federation starship Voyager."
game_text: If INTEGRITY>50, lose 5 points. To get past requires 2 Diplomacy OR any Intelligence and 2 Treachery OR STRENGTH>30 (STRENGTH>50 if this is a Delta Quadrant mission).

name: Displaced
lore: In 2373, Nyrians beamed aboard U.S.S. Voyager, attempting to hijack the ship by replacing her crew. Eventually, Captain Janeway and her crew reversed the process.
game_text: One personnel present (random selection) relocated to nearest planet. To get past requires CUNNING>30 (CUNNING>50 if this is a Delta Quadrantmission).

name: Distracted by Thoughts of Home
lore: After an encounter with the Timeship Aeon, Captain Janeway and her crew found themselves on Earth in 1996. The appeal of being on Earth – even in the past – was intense.
game_text: Place on mission. All personnel here are attributes all -1. Any player must discard a card from hand to attempt this mission. X=4 if this is a Delta Quadrant mission, otherwise 2.

name: Important Guests
lore: Ambassadors used to luxury accommodations are difficult to please while in the field. Commanding officers routinely assign their staff to placate the visiting dignitaries.
game_text: To get past requires V.I.P. OR CIVILIAN. For each your V.I.P.s and CIVILIANs present, randomly select an OFFICER OR SECURITY personnel to be "stopped."

name: Medical Crisis
lore: In the farthest reaches of the Delta Quadrant, medical supplies and those trained in their use are equally rare. Without them, even a minor injury can become lethal.
game_text: Randomly select a MEDICAL personnel. Killed if Kazon or Viddian, "stopped" otherwise. To get past requires 2 Biology and (2 MEDICAL OR a Nurse).

name: Oh No!
lore: Desperate to prevent the inevitable collapse of the universe, Jack and Patrick spent considerable time on a solution. After all, they only had seventy trillion years – at most.
game_text: If CUNNING>60, lose 5 points. To get past requires 3 Astrophysics OR any PADD and any tricorder OR INTEGRITY>30 (INTEGRITY>50 if this is a Delta Quadrant mission).

name: Skeleton Crew
lore: With Deep Space 9 evacuated of non-critical personnel during a local plasma disruption, it was an easy matter for a mercenary team to overwhelm those left behind.
game_text: Place on mission. You may not begin a mission attempt here with fewer than six personnel.

name: The Arsenal: Separated
lore: While investigating the Arsenal of Freedom on Minos, a sudden attack separated the crew of the Enterprise.
game_text: Divide your unique personnel into two face-down piles. One pile is "stopped" (opponent's choice). To get past requires CUNNING>27 remaining.

name: Vastly Outnumbered
lore: "The internal security net has been sabotaged... which suggests someone didn't want to be that easily found."
game_text: If STRENGTH>55, lose 5 points. To get past requires Anthropology and 2 Honor OR two hand weapons OR INTEGRITY>28 (INTEGRITY>48 if this is a Delta Quadrant mission).

name: Virus
lore: Ancient Iconian computer programs transmitted to the U.S.S. Yamato, U.S.S. Enterprise, and Haakona attempted to overwrite the ships' computer systems.
game_text: Unless you have 4 Computer Skill present, place on ship. This ship, and all your other ships of the same class, are attributes all -2. Cure with 6 Computer Skill personnel.

name: Body Armor
lore: Hirogen body armor can resist injuries from battle and environmental hazards. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: While present with your SECURITY-classification personnel, all hand weapons present lose cumulative. (Immune to Disruptor Overload.)

name: 45th Rule of Acquisition
lore: "Expand or die."
game_text: Plays on your Ferengi ship. Once per turn, your Gold-Pressed Latinum may report aboard (for free). Each time your Ferengi personnel aboard is killed by an opponent's dilemma, you may download one Gold-Pressed Latinum aboard or draw a card.

name: Romulan "Reunification"
lore: Restore the ancestral homeworld to the glory of the Empire.
game_text: Plays to report a Romulan SECURITY personnel to Vulcan if you have an unopposed Romulan ship in orbit (discard event). OR Plays on Vulcan; worth points if your opponent has fewer personnel here than you have Romulan personnel here.

name: Inspection
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
game_text: Plays on table. Your ships native to the Alpha Quadrant (and each personnel aboard) are attributes all +1 while three Admirals and/or V.I.P.s aboard. At the start of each of your turns, you may exchange an OFFICER personnel aboard your staffed ship with an Admiral or V.I.P. in your discard pile.

name: The Genesis Effect
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan

name: Critical Assistance
lore: Trained nurses like Alyssa Ogawa are vital aides in life-threatening situations.
game_text: Once per turn, stops your Nurse to download a MEDICAL-related equipment to his or her location OR unstops a MEDICAL-classification personnel present.

name: Driven
lore: The strain experienced by Lt. Bailey during his encounter with the Fesarius pushed him to the brink of mental breakdown.
game_text: When your Original Series OFFICER is facing a dilemma, discard an Original Series OFFICER from hand to make him or her attributes all +5 until the end of that dilemma.

name: I Feel Young
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
lore: Kirk felt renewed in the face of new life, in spite of the death of Spock. Dr. McCoy noted, "He's really not dead. As long as we remember him."
game_text: Adds Youth to one Classic Films personnel until end of turn. OR Downloads any Classic Films Kirk if any Spock was just discarded from play.

name: Aftermath II
lore: Lifeless world: Determine cause of disaster.
game_text: '''WORMHOLE: You may move your staffed ship between here and any other location if that location is a Wormhole Mission OR by playing one Wormhole interrupt there. Then flip this mission over.

name: Changeling Research II
lore: L-S VI: Investigate possible changeling life signs.
game_text: WORMHOLE: You may move your staffed ship between here and any other location if that location is a Wormhole Mission OR by playing one Wormhole interrupt there. Then flip this mission over.

name: Find Hidden Base
lore: Badlands Region ● Athos IV: Eliminate primary Maquis base of operations.
game_text: *+10 if no Maquis in Badlands Region.

name: Kurn
lore: Klingon living in exile. Brother of Worf. Son of Mogh. Recently deputized by Odo. Has a death wish.

name: Brunt of Borg
lore: Assimilated counterpart who spoke to the Alliance in a parallel universe. "The knowledge and experience of the Ferengi – Brunt – is part of us now.

name: Agent Garak
lore: Elim Garak joined the Federation in its fight against the Dominion. Served as a code breaker in spite of his fear he was betraying his homeworld.

name: Emok
lore: Typical Obsidian Order operative trained in exobiology and medical interrogation. Expert at surgically altering operatives for long-term assignments.

name: Tholun
lore: Vorta advisor sent to Deep Space 9 by the Founders. Replaced Weyoun. Witnessed the surrender of the Dominion to the Alpha Quadrant alliance.

name: Turan'Ekan
lore: Jem'Hadar bred in the Alpha Quadrant. Ordered by Weyoun to hunt for the traitor Damar. Killed Mila. Betrayed and killed by one of his Cardassian allies.

name: Admiral Kirk
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
lore: An original thinker, Captain Kirk took command of the Starship Enterprise as an admiral. He felt young.

name: Dexter Remmick
lore: Male human serving in the Inspector General's office. Found no evidence of wrong-doing aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise, in spite of his best efforts.

name: Sergey and Helena
lore: Retired chief petty officer Sergey Rozhenko is married to Helena Rozhenko. They have two sons, Nikolai and Worf, and one grandson, Alexander.

name: Captain Nog
lore: In an alternate timeline, Nog served as captain of the U.S.S. Defiant. Aided Jake Sisko in an effort to reverse a time-altering subspace inversion.

name: Dr. Reyga
lore: Invited aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise to demonstrate his innovative technology. The ensuing murder mystery proved it successful, but at a high cost.

name: Zivan
lore: Male Hirogen representative of inexperienced, overeager hunters. Trained by Harkan, who judged him to be too reliant on defense. Killed by Weiss.

name: Kazat
lore: Typical male member of the Kazon-Relora sect. Assistant to Haron. Spaced by Culluh and Seska for his master's refusal of an alliance against Voyager.

name: Captain B'Etor
lore: B'Etor is the younger sister of Captain Lursa. Seeks to bring Security Chief Garak and The Intendant to trial for negligence and fraternizing with the enemy.

name: Duras
lore: Son of a traitor, Ja'rod, and a traitor himself. Member of the Klingon High Council.

name: Porthos
lore: Captain Archer's pet beagle. Likes cheese. T'Pol thinks he smells worse than even the humans do.

name: 0413-Theta
lore: Typical Terran in the mirror universe. Caught trying to escape Terok Nor. Brought to the Intendant for sentencing by Security Chief Garak and Telok.

name: Allamill
property_logo: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
lore: Alien pilot that frequented a Starfleet bar in San Francisco. Offered to help Leonard McCoy, but would not go to the restricted Mutara sector.

name: Carol Marcus
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
lore: Intelligent scientist in charge of the Genesis Project. When showing off her results, she quipped, "Can I cook or can't I?"

name: David Marcus
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
lore: Young scientist involved with the creation of the Genesis Device. Son of Carol Marcus and James T. Kirk. Survived an encounter with Khan.

name: Falow
lore: Wadi head of the delegation from the Gamma Quadrant that visited station Deep Space 9 in 2369. After being cheated at dabo, made Quark play chula.

name: Ilandra
lore: Female Wadi. Part of Falow's delegation sent to Deep Space 9 to make first contact with the Alpha Quadrant. Skilled gambler and lover of games.

name: Vash
lore: Human. Former partner of Q. Marooned in Gamma Quadrant but rescued by Jadzia Dax. Brought a dangerous crystal artifact aboard Deep Space 9.

name: Sela
lore: Half-Human, half-Romulan female. Failed to subvert the Klingon Empire by assisting Lursa and B'Etor. Her future seemed dim after her failure to conquer Vulcan.

name: Subcommander Decius
lore: Officer in service aboard the Gal Gath'thong during the attack against the Federation in 2266. Reduced two steps in ranks for an unauthorized transmission.

name: Danica Erickson
lore: Devoted to her father, Emory Erickson. Spent fifteen years serving as his nurse after the loss of her brother, Quinn. Childhood friend of Jonathan Archer.

name: Delanh
lore: Typical Vidiian seeking to steal organs from live "donors." Remembered as a serious threat by Kathryn Janeway during a near-death experience.

name: Vetar
lore: Cardassian warship that surveyed Dorvan V. Pursued the Liberty into the Badlands. Commanded by Evek.

name: Renegade Borg Sphere
lore: Once freed from the Borg hive mind, General Korok commanded this vessel. Assisted the U.S.S. Voyager in the destruction of Tactical Cube 138.
game_text: Non-Aligned Borg may report aboard. WEAPONS and SHIELDS +4 vs. Borg

name: Sarajevo
lore: Small transport vessel used in the mid-22nd century to carry passengers to and from their destinations.
game_text: Attributes all +1 for each Transporter Skill aboard (limit 3). Emory Erickson

name: Determined Assault
game_text: ATTACK bonus +2 if you have a Non-Aligned ship firing. May not be used to fire upon a facility. Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw.

name: Blended
lore: Whether it be Kanar, Blood Wine, or Romulan Ale, a little libation can often yield valuable intelligence.
game_text: To get past requires Empathy, Diplomacy, Morn or any Scotty. All such personnel are "stopped," but if two or more present, one must continue (random selection).

name: Chula: The Chandra
lore: "Allamaraine, count to four. Allamaraine, then three more. Allamaraine, if you can see. Allamaraine, you'll come with me."
game_text: One person (random selection) continues, along with all crew or Away Team members who have at least one attribute number matching the personnel. Others are "stopped."

name: Chula: The Lights
lore: Julian Bashir's confidence after completing two shaps did not serve him well in the fourth shap of the Wadi game Chula.
game_text: Crew or Away Team member with total attributes closest to 22 (your choice if tie) returns to hand. To get past requires CUNNING>24 remaining.

name: Dal'Rok
lore: Despite his best effort, Miles O'Brien could not rally the villagers to defeat their feared enemy. Some people just aren't very good storytellers.
game_text: Place on mission. Now and start of each turn, kills personnel with lowest total attributes at this location. May be nullified by INTEGRITY+CUNNING+STRENGTH>150 at this location.

name: Dead End
lore: Risky business ventures often require those involved to alter information or logs that might leave clues. The head honcho personally assigns an underling to undertake this risky scam.
game_text: Unless you have at least 50 points, cannot get past; place dilemma atop mission; it may not be attempted by a player with less than 50 points. (Unique.)

name: Flim-Flam Artist
lore: The universe is full of hucksters, charlatans, swindlers, confidence men, and Ferengi.
game_text: Your opponent may immediately draw a card. To get past requires Diplomacy, and 2 Computer Skill OR Law and CUNNING>32 (CUNNING>50 if this is a Delta Quadrant mission).

name: Friendly Fire
lore: Only a seasoned leader can prevent disaster during tense situations.
game_text: Unless 2 Leadership and 2 SECURITY present, kills one personnel (random selection); place dilemma on this mission (or this Empok Nor ); it cannot be attempted or scouted.

name: "God"
lore: A powerful being who claimed to be Apollo. Appeared in the classic style and performed "god-like" acts, but failed to convince the crew of the Enterprise to worship him.
game_text: Unless two Away Team members each have INTEGRITY>7, place on mission; destroys one ship here (opponent's choice). You must have a ship here to attempt mission.

name: Maglock
lore: Magnetic security seals protecting hazardous areas sometimes employ triple-release safety latches. In unfamiliar environments, they can be difficult to operate properly.
game_text: To get past, crew must have at least 3 OFFICER with STRENGTH>5 each.

name: Murder Investigation
lore: Tuvok was forced to question many of U.S.S. Voyager's crew to solve a mystery. The efforts took focus away from his other duties.
game_text: Randomly select three personnel (or six personnel if more than nine personnel present). If any of those personnel has SECURITY, all of them are "stopped."

name: New Essentialists
lore: In 2373, Mr. Lubitsch, Mr. Hopkins, Mr. Marshall, and other New Essentialists sabotaged Risa's weather modification network causing a great deal of trouble in paradise.
game_text: Unless INTEGRITY>40 and 2 Honor OR CUNNING>40 and 2 Treachery present, place one non-Borg Away Team member (random selection) atop draw deck. Nullify with Jamaharon.

page_title: Now Would Be a Good Time (HF)
name: Now Would Be a Good Time
base_name: Now Would Be a Good Time
lore: A transporter chief in possession of a good sense of timing can work miracles.

name: Picking Up the Pieces
lore: Parts of B-4's assembly were found strewn across the Kolaran system. Many planetary scans were required to locate all of the positronic signatures.
game_text: To get past requires Geology or Computer Skill. All such personnel are "stopped," but if two or more present, one must continue (random selection).

name: Punishment Box
lore: In the mirror universe, methods of discipline are often agonizing. Incompetent superior officers are subjected to public torture as examples to the crew.
game_text: Place on planet. Now and start of each mission attempt here, cannot get past unless one OFFICER is "placed in the box" ("stopped") until end of turn.

name: Q's Vicious Animal Things
lore: Q and his creations have appeared as soldiers from medieval times, the American Civil War, the Napoleonic era, and World War II, in addition to other eras.
game_text: Unless 22<STRENGTH<55, one Away Team member is killed (random selection) and opponent re-seeds dilemma under a different unsolved planet mission.

name: Restricted Area
lore: To disable a station's deflector array (which has been turned into an anti-graviton beam), one could access the EPS feed and overload the waveguide. But there are alarms.
game_text: If nine or fewer personnel in crew or Away Team, one is "stopped" (random selection). If more than nine personnel in crew or Away Team, three are captured (random selection).

name: Subspace Shock Wave
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: On Stardate 9521.6, the U.S.S. Excelsior monitored a "minor incident" on the Klingon moon Praxis.

name: The Whale Probe
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
lore: Unstaffed alien communications device. Sent to the Terran solar system in 2286. Broadcasting signal disables all technology in its wake. Waiting for a specific response.

name: Chamber of Ministers
lore: Legislative body of Bajoran provisional government. Established following Cardassian withdrawal in 2369.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Bajor . A Nor may coexist here. Once per turn, one Bajoran Minister, Vedek or Kai OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Unicomplex
lore: Identification: BORG UNICOMPLEXTask: Centralize all collective operations. Coordinate.
game_text: Seed or plays at any Space mission with no affiliation icons. Once each turn, Borg Queen OR one unique drone OR one unique ship may report for free here.

name: Central Command
lore: The Central Command controls every Cardassian ship, outpost and space station from its great War Room.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Cardassia Prime. Once per turn, one Cardassian Gul or Legate OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: The Great Link
lore: Changelings intermingle in the Great Link, merging form and thought into one communal entity.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Founders' homeworld. Ketracel-White on planet does not count down. Once per turn, one Founder OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Office of the President
lore: From his office in Paris, the President of the United Federation of Planets leads the representative council.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Earth. Once per turn, one Federation Ambassador, Admiral, Vice-Admiral or President OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Terran Rebellion HQ
lore: Subterranean base of the Terran Rebellion. Hidden on a small planetoid in the treacherous Badlands.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Terran Hideout it is now the homeworld of Federation Terran Empire cards. Once per turn, oneTerran Empire personnel (except Alternate ) OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Tower of Commerce
lore: The Grand Nagus enjoys absolute control over Ferengi business affairs from his Chamber of Petitioners.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Ferenginar. Once per turn, one Ferengi V.I.P., CIVILIAN or Hupyrian OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: The Great Hall
lore: The Great Hall on Qo'noS is the seat of power for the entire Klingon Empire.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Qo'noS. Once per turn, one Klingon Emperor, Chancellor or personnel with "High Council" in lore OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Continuing Committee
lore: Praetor Neral presides over the Continuing Committee of the Romulan People, the final authority on Romulus.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Romulus. May coexist with Office of the Proconsul. Once per turn, one Tal Shiar personnel OR any Neral may report for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Office of the Proconsul
lore: The Proconsul heads the Romulan Senate. Neral was Proconsul during the 2368 Vulcan Unification ruse.
game_text: Seeds or plays on Romulus. Once per turn, one Romulan General, Admiral, Senator or Proconsul OR Sela or Tomalak OR one HQ card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Alter Records
lore: Bajor Region ● Bajor: Create false documents on Bajoran homeworld pertaining to Cardassian occupation.

name: Deliver Message
lore: Ferenginar: Convey documents to Grand Nagus Zek on the Ferengi Homeworld; beware enemy patrols.

name: Espionage Mission
lore: Sector 001 Region ● Earth: Infiltrate Starfleet HQ: compile intelligence dossier on the Federation homeworld.

name: Intelligence Operation
lore: Founders' homeworld: Covertly compile data on current Dominion homeworld in the Omarion Nebula.

name: Orb Negotiations
lore: Cardassia Region ● Cardassia Prime: Negotiate for return of stolen Orbs still on Cardassian homeworld.
game_text: Any number of Orb artifacts may seed here.

name: Cargo Pirates
lore: Slower Earth cargo ships such as the E.C.S. Horizon and the E.C.S. Fortunate often fall victim to faster pirates.
game_text: One personnel (random selection) is "stopped." Then, if you have a Delta Quadrant personnel in play OR if your opponent has three thieves in play, one personnel (opponent's choice) is " stopped."

name: Dial-Up
lore: In 1996, the warp signature of a stranded U.S.S. Voyager was detected by SETI engineer Rain Robinson. The ship's crew monitored her call to alert Henry Starling.
game_text: All personnel with Download in Away Team are "stopped." Place this dilemma on this mission; you may not download cards. Nullify with 3 Computer Skill and Anthropology.

name: Difference of Opinion
lore: Andorians despised Tellarites. Vulcan distrusted Andorians. Tellarites disliked everyone. Until they found a common ally in humankind, conflict in the region was inevitable.
game_text: All Non-Aligned personnel in crew or Away Team are "stopped" until end of your next turn. Discard dilemma.

name: Mimetic Simbiot
lore: In 2153, Phlox created Sim from a Lyssarrian desert larva. Archer and his crew chose to end Sim's life to save Trip's.

name: Rumplestiltskin
lore: Gamma Quadrant alien in the form of a fairy tale character taken from the mind of Molly O'Brien. Distracted the crew of Deep Space 9 as an attempt to study its inhabitants.
game_text: X personnel are "stopped" (random selection), where X = the number of personnel in Away Team with five or more Skill Dot icons. Discard dilemma.

name: Topological Anomaly 4747
lore: Invasive program created in 2368 by Data and Geordi La Forge to cause the total system failure of the Borg Collective.
game_text: Borg and Hologram personnel, androids, and one ENGINEER here (random selection) are placed in stasis. Cure on your next turn with new SCIENCE arriving or when countdown expires.

name: Grappler
lore: Sturdy metallic shaft tipped with magnetic claws. Used for towing by Starfleet's 22nd-century starships.
game_text: Plays aboard your NX-class ship. Adds Tractor Beam. When crew completes a space mission that requires an attribute, discard to score points.

name: Vulcan Tricorder
lore: Representative of scanning devices used by 22nd-century space-faring civilizations. Used aboard Enterprise as a complement to standard-issue devices.

name: Finally Ready to Swim
lore: "Today we're about to cross a new threshold. For nearly a century, we've waded ankle-deep in the ocean of space."
game_text: Seeds on table. Once every turn, when you play a 22nd Century card, you may draw a card. When you play a non-22nd Century personnel or ship, you must discard a card from hand.

name: Secondary Market
lore: Though they say that one man's trash is another man's treasure, nothing is worth more on the black market than a fast ship.
game_text: Plays to return a ship that you have commandeered to its owner's hand. Score points and draw up to five cards.

name: Treaty: Starfleet/Klingon
lore: In the 22nd-century, brief periods of peaceful cooperation existed between Starfleet and the Klingon Empire, such as the effort to stop the Qu'vat Colony virus.
game_text: Plays on table (for free if you have Antaak or Phlox in play). Your Starfleet cards and your Klingon 22nd Century cards recognize this treaty. They can now mix and cooperate.

name: We're Ready
lore: Ensign Sato felt she had much in common with Sluggo: out of place, far from home, and unsure if she could survive. But, she soon realized, "It's not that hard to adapt."
game_text: Plays on table if you have three Starfleet personnel in play. At the end of each of your turns, if you do not have a Non-Aligned card in play, you may draw an additional card.

name: Out of Time
game_text: Plays for free at any time to take up to three personnel agents in your discard pile into hand OR to allow your temporal agent, any number of your personnel present, and/or your ship he or she is aboard to time travel between a time location and the corresponding spaceline location. Discard incident OR "stop" your temporal agent to place this on top of your draw deck.

name: Absolute Power
lore: Genetically-enhanced ability often breeds enhanced ambition. Love, trust, and friendship are sacrificed in the name of power.
game_text: Once per game, kill your personnel to "unstop" all your augments of the same affiliation as that personnel. OR Once each turn, kill your augment to draw three cards.

name: Diverse Experiences
lore: The crew of Enterprise paved the way for interstellar cooperation because of their willingness to embrace alien cultures and knowledge.
game_text: Once each turn, when you complete a mission, draw a card for each 22nd Century personnel in crew or Away Team (maximum 5).

name: Automated Repair Station
lore: Tellarite cargo lane: Repair severe damage at automated facility.
game_text: Solving player may download and use Spacedock here.

name: Control Plague
lore: Qu'Vat: Prevent the spread of a lethal disfiguring virus – at any cost.

name: Free Orion Slaves
lore: Verex III: Rescue or purchase captive crew members kidnapped in pirate raids.
game_text: Orions may report here (for free, once each turn).

name: Observe Stellar Rebirth
lore: Near a stellar nursery: Observe cycle of rebirth with devout pilgrims.

name: Prevent Rebellion
lore: Coridan: Intercede on restless local planet to stabilize local space.

name: File Annual Report
game_text: Seeds or plays on your Earth. If you have completed a different mission, your Starfleet personnel may attempt Earth with the following requirements: OFFICER + any staffed Starfleet ship in orbit + INTEGRITY>30 When you solve, mission is worth 30 points (instead of printed value), and you may download one Universal Starfleet personnel.

name: Remote Interference
game_text: 'Seeds or plays on table. Twice each turn, when you move your Romulan Drone-class ship to a location where an opponent has a ship, you may draw a card. At start of each of your turns, you may return an empty Romulan Drone-class ship to hand OR discard a card to download a Romulan Drone''-class ship to hand. (Unique.)

name: Straight and Steady
game_text: 'Seeds or plays on table. When your 22nd Century card is attacked, you may discard objective to make each 22nd Century card involved attributes all +5 until the end of that battle. At the end of your opponent's turn, you may discard objective to move your 22nd Century ship one spaceline location toward your homeworld or facility. (Unique. Captain's Order''.)

name: Akorem Laan
lore: Bajoran poet from the 22nd-century. Believed he was the Emissary of the Prophets sent to restore his people's d'jarras.

name: Ensign Jameson
lore: Recruited as a temporal agent by the crew of the U.S.S. Relativity. Former Borg Seven of Nine saved Voyager from being erased from the timeline.

name: Antaak
lore: Physician responsible, albeit accidentally, for creating the disfiguring Klingon augment virus. Found a future in cranial reconstruction. Had a knack for diplomacy.

name: General K'Vagh
lore: Military director of the Klingon augment project. Judged Phlox to be weak-willed.

name: Laneth
lore: Representative of female Klingon augments. Relished the results of increased strength, speed, and stamina, but despised the new feelings of fear.

name: Marab
lore: Klingon augment. Son of General K'Vagh. As a test of his augmented abilities, led the team that boarded Enterprise – but was left behind.

name: Volok
lore: One of many Klingon augments experimented on by Antaak at the Qu'Vat colony. Even though they lost their cranial ridges, they remained Klingon.

name: D'Nesh
lore: Manipulative gift given to Jonathan Archer by Harrad-Sar. Beautiful Orion slave girl and thief. Seduced Kelby in a plot to capture Enterprise.

name: Harrad-Sar
lore: Slave of the situation created by D'Nesh, Maras, and Navaar. Orion captain of the Devna-Lev. A thief at heart, but a gracious host.

name: Maras
lore: Representative Orion slave girl. Secretly manipulates the Orion Syndicate, as many in her line of work do. Valued for her skills as a thief.

name: Navaar
lore: Experienced gift given to Jonathan Archer by Harrad-Sar. Alluring Orion slave girl and a master thief. Nearly succeeded in capturing Enterprise.

name: Silik
lore: Genetically-enhanced Suliban shape-shifter who led the Cabal in the 22nd-century. Temporal agent for a mysterious manipulator from the future.

name: Admiral Valdore
lore: Brilliant military strategist behind most of the campaigns of the Earth-Romulan War. A former senator expelled for challenging Imperial doctrine.

name: Gareb
lore: Blind Aenar male captured by Romulan agents. Told he was the last surviving Aenar. Manipulated into telepathically piloting the drone ships.

name: Gareb
lore: Blind Aenar male captured by Romulan agents. Told he was the last surviving Aenar. Manipulated into telepathically piloting the drone ships.

name: Nijil
lore: Designer of the Raptor prototype. Created the long-distance telepresence control system. Secretly informed Vrax about the project.

name: Dallas
lore: Representative of one of the many young female officers stationed on Enterprise. Their experiences aboard would be invaluable in their careers.

name: Daniel Leonard
lore: Cautious admiral responsible for overseeing portions of the NX project and removing "dead wood" from Starfleet's ranks.

name: Daniels
lore: Resourceful temporal agent from the 31st-century. Frequently "assisted" the Enterprise crew in preventing alterations to the timeline. More or less human.

name: Daniels
lore: Resourceful temporal agent from the 31st-century. Frequently "assisted" the Enterprise crew in preventing alterations to the timeline. More or less human.

name: Erika Hernandez
lore: Comparable captain of Columbia, the second Warp 5 ship. Romantically involved with Jonathan Archer.

name: Garrid
lore: Representative Starfleet officer serving aboard the NX-class ships in the 2150s. The crew routinely faced illness and injury in the line of duty.

name: Hoshi Sato
lore: Uneasy educator recruited to be Captain Archer's communications officer. Fluent in countless languages. Capable relief cook.

name: Jeffrey Pierce
lore: On the edge of known space, he was one of many Enterprise crew captured by Orion slavers. Did not sell well. Held it together long enough to be rescued.

name: Malcolm Reed
lore: Disciplined NX-01 senior armory officer. Recruited into a covert operations unit authorized by Article 14, Section 31, of the Starfleet Charter.

name: McDermott
lore: Representative of the veteran officers assigned to Enterprise. Starfleet hoped their experience would prove useful in deep space.

name: T'Pol
lore: Austere commander romantically involved with Charles Tucker III. Commander of Enterprise in Jonathan Archer's absence.

name: I.K.S. Nguq'Yab
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey originally commanded by Martrex. In 2153, commandeered and commanded by Raakin and then commanded by Malik.
game_text: Attributes all +1 for each augment aboard (limit 4).

name: I.K.S. Nguq'Yab
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey originally commanded by Martrex. In 2153, commandeered and commanded by Raakin and then commanded by Malik.
game_text: Attributes all +1 for each augment aboard (limit 4).

name: Raptor One
lore: First of two prototypes created from modified warbirds. Controlled remotely via telepresence. Carried adaptable triphasic weapon systems.
game_text: May report to any spaceline location .

name: Columbia
lore: NX-02. Boasted advanced hull plating and pulsed phase cannon upgrades based on Jonathan Archer's recommendation.
game_text: Download Warp Speed Transfer

name: 22nd-Century San Francisco
lore: 2154 Earth: San Francisco survived World War III and became a beacon of human progress.

name: Augment Research Facility
lore: 2154 Qu'Vat: Secret facility where the Empire created superior Klingon augments.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Native to this timeline: all Klingon 22nd Century cards, Neutral 22nd Century cards, 22nd Century equipment and all augments with both Alternate and 22nd Century. Once per turn, one such augment reporting at this location may report for free.

name: Drone Control Room
lore: 2154 Romulus: From the spies of Romulus, ten soldiers nearly conquered the galaxy.

name: Fascinating!
lore: The logical response to the discovery of a strange, new, or unusual thing.
game_text: Plays on your Mindmeld personnel just stopped by an opponent's dilemma. Raise an eyebrow to score points.

name: Matt Decker
lore: Commodore. Starfleet flag officer assigned as the commander of the U.S.S. Constellation. Willing to give his life in the line of duty. Son followed his footsteps.

name: Battle Bridge Door
game_text: Place one atop Battle Bridge side deck during the seed phase. Battle Bridge is now open and in play (immune to cards which close doorways). OR Stock in deck and play at start of ship battle (even during opponent's turn) if you have Leadership in that battle. Allows you to draw two extra Tactic cards (cumulative) or enhances each of your ships' and facilities' WEAPONS +1; then discard doorway.

name: Environmental Suit
lore: Self-contained garment for protecting personnel in a hostile environment. A variable magnetic field can be activated in the boots when working in zero-gravity.
game_text: You may discard this equipment to prevent a personnel present from being killed by a dilemma or a Tactic card (that personnel is stopped instead).

name: Tactical Console
lore: Standard display on most modern starships. Combines weapons control with target acquisition and analysis subroutines. Highly effective in the hands of a trained tactical officer.
game_text: Plays on your ship docked at your facility. While you have Miles O'Brien or a SECURITY-classification personnel aboard, ship is WEAPONS +3. (Captain's Order.)

name: Make It So
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, if your staffed ship has its matching commander aboard, you may "unstop" it (once per game per Ship card title) OR download Ready Room Door (to download a Captain's Order) OR, if that ship is in battle (even during opponent's turn), download a Tactic card (once per game per Tactic card title). Discard incident after use, unless that matching commander has Enterprise-E icon.

name: Attack Pattern Delta
lore: Upon encountering Dominion ships during a rescue attempt in 2370, Captain Keogh ordered the U.S.S. Odyssey and two runabouts to execute a predermined attack pattern.
game_text: Plays at start of ship battle. Doubles one Tactical Console until end of battle OR draw up to X additional Tactic cards, where X = the number of your ships in this battle.

name: Attack Wing
game_text: ATTACK bonus +1 for each of your ships firing. DEFENSE bonus +1 if you have a Jem'Hadar Attack Ship defending.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

game_text: ATTACK and DEFENSE bonus +2 if you have a Bajoran ship firing with Resistance or Navigation aboard (or +4 if one crew member has both skills). Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Borg Cutting Beam
game_text: If you hit, you may relocate one of target's crew members (random selection; from any one site if on a Nor) to one of your ships in this battle and assimilate that personnel. Hit or direct hit = Tactic Current.

name: Breen Energy-Dampening Weapon
game_text: Requires ship with Energy Dampener firing. Hit or direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw and, unless target is [[U.S.S. Sao Paulo#Star Trek CCG 1st Edition|U.S.S. Sao Paulo], is I.K.C. Ki'tang or has Energy Dampener, "power surge" also disables RANGE and WEAPONS.

name: Chain Reaction Pulsar
game_text: Requires a staffed ship which has three or more staffing icons firing. ATTACK bonus +1 if Akira class. Hit or direct hit = Tactic Current and nullifies one Event card enhancing target's attributes (once per turn).

name: "Crimson Forcefield"
game_text: Harmless pyrotechnic ruse nullifies opponent's Tactic card unless opponent has an OFFICER with CUNNING>8 aboard a ship or facility on this battle. Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw.

name: Evasive Maneuvers
game_text: DEFENSE bonus +2 if you have a ship with no staffing requirements defending.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.
