game_text: ATTACK bonus +1 if you have a Ferengi ship firing.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Full Phaser Spread
game_text: ATTACK bonus +1 if you have a Galaxy-class ship firing.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Isolytic Burst
game_text: Requires a Son'a Battleship or Li'seria firing. If you hit, randomly kills one additional personnel (on a Nor, one personnel at site of opponent's choice). Hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Phased Polaron Beam
game_text: ATTACK bonus +1 if you have a Dominion ship firing.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Phaser Banks
game_text: ATTACK bonus +2 if you have a Federation ship firing.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Photon Torpedo
game_text: ATTACK bonus +1 if you have an Akira-class ship firing.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Picard Maneuver
game_text: If you initiated ship battle with your matching commander aboard your ship, it appears to be in two places at once and has a 50/50 chance to avoid all damage this battle.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Plasma Energy Burst
game_text: ATTACK bonus +4 and DEFENSE bonus +2 if you have a D'Kora-class ship firing.Hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw Tactic Draw. Otherwise, causes electromagnetic disruptions (Tactic Current).

name: Plasma Torpedo
game_text: ATTACK bonus +2 if you have a Romulan ship firing.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

game_text: ATTACK bonus +2 if you have a Borg ship firing.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Pulse Disruptor
game_text: ATTACK bonus +2 if you have a Klingon ship firing.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Pulse Phaser Cannons
game_text: ATTACK bonus +1 if you have a Defiant-class ship firing.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Quantum Torpedo
game_text: ATTACK bonus +1 if you have a Sovereign-class ship firing.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Spiral-Wave Disruptor
game_text: ATTACK bonus +2 if you have a Cardassian ship firing.Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Strafing Run
game_text: ATTACK bonus +1 if you have a Hideki-class ship firing.Hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: T'Pol/Soong Maneuver
game_text: ATTACK bonus +3 and DEFENSE bonus +2 if you have a NX-class ship firing. Hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Target Engines
game_text: ATTACK bonus +2 if you have a Dominion ship firing.Hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Target Shields
game_text: Hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw Tactic Draw. Otherwise, drains target's SHIELDS (Tactic Current).

name: Target These Coordinates
game_text: Hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw (or Tactic Current Tactic Draw if target is affected by Weak Spot).Direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw Tactic DrawTactic Draw.

game_text: '''May not be used to fire upon a facility.Hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Target Weapons
game_text: ATTACK bonus +2 if you have a Dominion ship firing.Hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Armus: Energy Field
lore: When Counselor Troi's and Lt. Prieto's shuttle crashed on Vagra II, a mysterious field prevented the Enterprise from retrieving its stranded crew members.
game_text: One personnel (random selection) aboard each of your ships here is "stopped." To get past, crew must be able to meet mission requirements (even if playing Borg).

name: Armus: Roulette
lore: Armus' boredom and cruelty led to Data pointing his phaser at his crewmates and then himself.
game_text: If four personnel (random selection) have CUNNING>30 OR one of them has Leadership and INTEGRITY>7, discard dilemma. Otherwise, one is killed (opponent's choice) and the other selected personnel are "stopped." Mission continues.

name: Helpless
lore: Banished from the Continuum, Q lamented his transformation into a "normal, imperfect, lumpen human being."
game_text: One Away Team member is chosen (random selection). If that personnel does not have a skill in mission requirements, that personnel and one other personnel (random selection) are "stopped" (even if playing Borg).

name: High Rollers
lore: A simple game of probabilities can make a fortune or provide a way home.
game_text: Opponent may download and seed here any two Royale Casino dilemmas, then place on mission. Each Royale Casino dilemma you face here first "stops" one Away Team member (your choice).

name: Royale Casino: Elevator
lore: After Royale's clearly marked exits failed to provide an escape, Riker, Data, and Worf were forced to follow the clues: up.
game_text: Opponent may report a personnel. Return one of your Away Team members to hand (your choice). Compare those personnel; highest total printed attributes wins points. Discard dilemma.

name: Shore Leave
lore: "Our captain needs a holiday."
game_text: To get past requires a male and a female OR Honor + INTEGRITY>50. Opponent may then download and seed here up to two of the following (except Combo dilemmas): Female's Love Interest, Male's Love Interest, Parallel Romance, or Wind Dancer.

name: The Arsenal: Divided
lore: While confronting the Echo Papa 607 weapons system, Geordi La Forge ordered a saucer separation to protect the ship's crew. He took command of the stardrive section.
game_text: Divide your unique crew members into two face-down piles. One pile is "stopped" (opponent's choice). To get past, ship must be staffed and have INTEGRITY>27 remaining.

name: The Loss
lore: Even the strongest minds have weaknesses.
game_text: To get past requires 2 Empathy OR 2 Mindmeld OR 2 androids OR INTEGRITY>38. Opponent may then download and seed here up to two of the following: Bendii Syndrome, Helpless, System-Wide Cascade Failure, or Two-Dimensional Creatures.

name: The Vengeance Factor
lore: Old feud and lingering grudges can persist across years or even centuries, destroying many innocent lives.
game_text: Opponent may download and seed here up to two of the following (except Combo dilemmas): Microvirus, The Gatherers, or Yuta, then place on mission. Skill and attribute requirements of Microvirus and The Gatherers here are doubled.

name: Emergency Transport Unit
lore: Portable transport technology capable of beaming a single target over a short distance. Data carried a prototype version of the device.
game_text: You may return this equipment to hand to prevent a personnel present from being killed by a dilemma (that personnel is placed on your ship here and is "stopped").

name: All-Consuming Evil
lore: "You do not understand. I do not serve things evil. I am evil."
game_text: Seeds or plays on Vagra II. Doubles effects of all Armus dilemmas. Once per game, may suspend play to download any Armus dilemmas and seed it beneath any mission, then discard event. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: D'jarras
lore: Akorem Laan called for the reinstatement of the caste system abandoned during the Occupation. The Kira family name indicated Nerys' membership in the artists d'jarra.
game_text: Plays on table. All of your Bajoran OFFICER-classification personnel gain CIVILIAN. All of your Bajoran CIVILIAN-classification personnel gain OFFICER.

name: Duck Blind
lore: To avoid compromising the Prime Directive, the Federation uses camouflaged stations to observe primitive societies.
game_text: Seeds or plays on your Alpha Quadrant planet mission (except a homeworld). End of each turn, if your 2 Anthropology present, draw an extra card. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Federation Flagship: Renewed
lore: Over 100 years of refits and relaunches, the Federation's flagship kept its historic name and registry number.
game_text: Plays on your Federation Enterprise (except Original Series). End of each turn, if ship is undocked, uncloaked, and has its matching commander aboard at a Space mission, draw an additional card. (Unique).

name: Shades of Gray: Anguish
lore: Infected and facing death, Riker was forced to relive his past. "It's spread to the spinal column."
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Double requirements of each Cosmic String Fragment, Gravitic Mine, Menthar Booby Trap, and Null Spce, and personnel that help overcome those dilemmas are "stopped." (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Shades of Gray: Brutality
lore: Infected and facing death, Riker was forced to relive his past. "...the infection will spread to the brain within an hour."
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Doubles skill requirements of each Archer, Barclay's Protomorphosis Disease, Interphasic Plasma Creatures, Tsiolkovsky Infection, and Nanites. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Shades of Gray: Cruelty
lore: Infected and facing death, Riker was forced to relive his past. "Then all we've done is made things worse!"
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Adds 2 Exobiology to each set of requirements on each Alien Abduction; Chalnoth; Coalescent Organism; Shaka, When The Walls Fell; and Zaldan. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Shades of Gray: Despair
lore: Infected and facing death, Riker was forced to relive his past. "...I don't know if he can withstand it. He's extremely weak."
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Adds 1 to every printed number that appears on each Ancient Computer, Birth of "Junior", Nitrium Metal Parasites, and Rascals (except Combo dilemmas). (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Son'a Observatory
lore: Son'a facility constructed to oversee the Federation's process in evaluating the Ba'ku.
game_text: Seeds on Ba'ku planet. Cloaking Device. Your Son'a cards may report here (for free, once each turn). Twice per game, you may download a Son'a personnel OR Matthew Dougherty here.

name: Starbase One
lore: As Starfleet explored and expanded its territory, it began establishing outposts to provide repair and resupply services. The first was on Berengaria VII.
game_text: Build at your completed mission where you have Starfleet ENGINEER. Download Any Starfleet card.

name: Federation Flagship: Relaunched
game_text: Seeds on table; download U.S.S. Enterprise-E to your Federation Outpost (opponent may Tactic Draw). Your Enterprise-E personnel and Federation First Contact personnel may report aboard your U.S.S. Enterprise-E. Once each turn, one such personnel may do so for free. Your three Enterprise-E personnel present together may meet an additional Command staffing requirement. Discard this incident if you have a Federation personnel in play who is not Enterprise-E or First Contact.

name: Holoprogram: Historical Poker Game
game_text: Seeds or plays on your ship with a Holodeck. In place of your normal card play, you may download Albert Einstein, Sir Isaac Newton, or Stephen Hawking aboard. Once per turn, if all three are all aboard, you may "observe greatness": discard a card from hand, place bottom card of discard pile beneath draw deck or out-of-play, then draw one card (or up to two if Data is present).

name: Hotel Royale
game_text: Plays on Theta VIII. Your cards with "Hotel Royale" or "Royale Casino" in lore may report on planet (for free, once each turn). Points you score from Royale Casino dilemmas forced by your opponent's personnel do not count towards Writ of Accountability. OR Plays to download The Charybdis, or a personnel with "Hotel Royale" or "Royale Casino" in lore, then discard incident.

name: Seductive Dance
property_logo: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
game_text: Plays on table. Once each turn, when your Commander Uhura or slave girl is facing a dilemma, discard your event from play to choose one: one personnel present adds a skill from another personnel present until the end of the dilemma OR all personnel present are attributes all +1 until the end of the current mission attempt OR one personnel present about to be killed is "stopped" instead.

name: Warp Speed Transfer
game_text: Plays on table. When your crew is attempting a space mission aboard your ship; you may suspend play to move your other staffed ship on the same spaceline (up to double its full RANGE) to that mission and place one personnel aboard on the attempting ship; that personnel joins the crew. Each ship's RANGE for this turn is used, then place incident out-of-play. (Unique).

name: Cluttering Irrelevancies
lore: A hologram of Lewis Zimmerman wanted to delete The Doctor's growing interest in music to stabilize the EMH's program.
game_text: Once per turn, plays at start of mission attempt to target your Hologram personnel. That personnel gains any skill until the end of the mission attempt, then returns to hand.

name: Investigate Anachronism
lore: Theta VIII: Discover origin of 20th-century Earth material in orbit of alien planet.
game_text: When seeded, you may download Hotel Royale here.

name: Save Stranded Crew
lore: Vagra II: Locate and rescue stranded crash survivors held by evil entity.
game_text: When seeded,, you may download All-Consuming Evil.

name: Borg Queen
lore: "Species 10026 is already adding to our perfection. You can feel their distinctiveness coursing through us, enhancing us."

name: Six of Seven
lore: IDENTIFICATION: REQUISITIONS DRONETASK: Assess resources for evaluation. Obtain.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Human species

name: Aquiel Uhnari
lore: Female Haliian. Romantically involved with Geordi La Forge. Did not get along with officer Keith Rocha. Posted at Relay Station 47.

name: Mr. Tuvok
lore: Coldly logical soldier. In the mirror universe, the Vulcan Tuvok fought for the Terran Rebellion.

name: Mrs. O'Brien
lore: Married to Miles O'Brien. In 2369, Keiko O'Brien served as a school teacher on Deep Space 9.

name: Stephen Hawking
lore: Re-creation of the famed 21st-century physicist. Pursued the Unified Field Theory. Worked on the warp engine. Suffered from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.

name: Worf
lore: Klingon chief of security aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise-E. Returned to Starfleet after a hiatus as the Federation Ambassador to Qo'noS.

name: Grish
lore: Representative of Ferengi thieves in the 22nd century. Served as a nurse in Ulis' band of privateers. Had no other roles.

name: Krem
lore: Ferengi thief that succeeded his cousin Ulis as commander of the Quetsivoo. Held dominion over the crew's Andorian ale supply.

name: Muk
lore: Thief in Ulis' band of privateers. Likes tranya. Rattled by T'Pol's implication that his captain was trying to cheat him.

name: Ulis
lore: Captain of the Quetsivoo. The Ferengi thief served as leader of the privateers Grish, Krem, and Muk. Found a future as a cook and guide.

name: Rielat
lore: Kazon-Ogla serving under Jabin. Laid aside his varied interests to serve his sect as a guard.

name: Martrex
lore: Klingon captain of the I.K.S. Nguq'Yab. Commanded dozens of secret missions throughout the Empire on behalf of the Klingon High Council.

name: Neras
lore: Slave girl sold in the markets of Verex III. Orion female known for her extreme appetites and her innate, intimate skills.

name: Rishon
lore: Illusion of Kevin Uxbridge's wife, who was killed by the Husnock. Re-created to comfort her powerful husband.

name: The Bellboy
lore: Employee of the Royale Casino. Occasionally served as a waiter. Romantically involved with Rita.

name: The Foragers
lore: Male and female aliens from Devidia II. Served as a 19th-century doctor and nurse.

name: Senator Vrax
lore: Romulan senator. Old acquaintance of Admiral Valdore. Leveraged his political clout to sponsor the Raptor Drone project. Does not tolerate failure.

name: Phlox
lore: Denobulan doctor kidnapped and taken to the Qu'Vat colony. Forced to help the Klingons develop a cure to the augment virus. Specialist in immunology.

name: Phlox (AI)
lore: Denobulan doctor kidnapped and taken to the Qu'Vat colony. Forced to help the Klingons develop a cure to the augment virus. Specialist in immunology.

name: Phlox (AI) (with TCC watermark)
lore: Denobulan doctor kidnapped and taken to the Qu'Vat colony. Forced to help the Klingons develop a cure to the augment virus. Specialist in immunology.

name: Morulla
lore: Vidiian male. Broker of information. Former chairman of the Sodality's Bureau of Classical Art. Previously smuggler of antiquities, turned to smuggling organs.

name: Quetsivoo
lore: Small Ferengi transport ship favored by privateers in the 22nd century. Featured minimal crew quarters and a deceptively large cargo bay.
game_text: Attributes all +1 for each thief aboard (limit 4). Download Ferengi Gas Trap

name: Schoolroom
game_text: Youth personnel, professors, and teachers may report here. Once each turn, if player who controls station has a professor or teacher here, that player may place a personnel from hand with Archeaology, Anthropology, Astrophysics, Biology, Exobiology, Geology, Physics or Stellar Cartography on the bottom of their discard pile to give each of his or her Youth personnel in play that skill until end of turn.

name: Cardassian Processing
lore: Whether preparing captives for interrogation, trial, torture, incarceration, punishment, or other purposes, Cardassian methods are well-established.
game_text: Unless Diplomacy, Honor, Transporter Skill, and CUNNING>30 OR Law, SECURITY, and STRENGTH>40, one personnel is captured (random selection).

name: Dangerous Climb
lore: Deep underground passages such as those on Xantoras pose a problem for transporters. Without climbing skills, they may also pose a problem to away team personnel.
game_text: Unless STRENGTH>40 OR 2 Geology and CUNNING>20 present, kills one Away Team member (random selection).

name: Dedication to Duty
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
lore: Starship work is hazardous. When danger arises, one must place the good of the crew ahead of one's own life.
game_text: One unique personnel is "stopped" (random selection). Choose one: kill that personnel OR opponent may draw cards equal to the number of Skill Dot on that personnel. Mission continues.

name: Dignitaries and Witnesses
lore: The bitterness of defeat and the exultation of triumph have taught many leaders a great lesson: they must preserve in peace what they have won in war.
game_text: To get past requires INTEGRITY>20 and an Admiral OR STRENGTH>30 and a General OR CUNNING>20 and 3 Leadership OR STRENGTH>20 and a Maje.

name: Forsaken
lore: The Prophets would not respond to Kai Winn's prayers despite her zeal. Dukat, in his lust for power, twisted her rejection to the service of the Pah-Wraiths.
game_text: To get past requires 2 Honor OR 2 Treachery. Each Honor or Treachery personnel that helps overcome this dilemma is placed on the bottom of owner's draw deck.

name: Founder Secret
lore: Tales of changelings became a thing of legend in many cultures. Conflict with "Solids" drove them to become secretive, skilled infiltrators, and talented locksmiths.
game_text: To get past requires a changeling OR Interphase Generator OR Croden's Key OR CUNNING>40 and any tricorder OR STRENGTH>70 OR four Defense drones OR Breen CRM114.

name: Fractured Time
lore: In 2370, Data suggested Worf would be able to use an inverse warp field to restore the barriers between quantum realities. Thankfully, Mr. Data was correct, in every reality.
game_text: Nine personnel (random selection) continue. Place out-of-play all other personnel in this crew or Away Team.

name: Gomtuu Shock Wave
lore: Although some creatures have intricate greeting rituals, others will defend themselves violently at the first sign of danger.
game_text: Unless 2 Diplomacy and INTEGRITY>32 OR Empathy and INTEGRITY>35 present, all undocked ships at this location are damaged and relocated one location toward far end of spaceline.

name: Linguistic Legerdemain
lore: Sarda's contract with Quark allowed him to proposition his employees. The provision was hidden on page 21, subsection 12, paragraph D.
game_text: Unless Anthropology and Exobiology present, X=1+number of affiliation icons on this mission with no matching personnel present; place on mission; it cannot be attempted.

name: Ablative Armor
lore: Early 25th-century technology brought from an alternate future to the 2377 by Admiral Janeway. It allowed her shuttle to withstand Korath's attack.
game_text: While aboard your ship or facility, opponent's ATTACK total must be more than double that ship or facility's DEFENSE total to score a hit, and more than triple to score a direct hit.

name: Borg Nanoprobes
lore: Tiny microscopic machines used to repair, maintain, and assimilate new Borg drones. A single drone may contain thousands or even millions of nanoprobes.
game_text: Once per turn, where present, may abduct and assimilate one personnel just stunned by your Defense drone OR nullify a Species 8472-related dilemma (except Gravimetric Distortion).

name: Gold-Pressed Latinum
lore: Currency used in trade across the Alpha Quadrant. Available in slips, strips, bars, and bricks. The luxuriant Ferengi Nagal Residence even has latinum-plated waste extraction fixtures.
game_text: Once each turn, on a Trading Post, homeworld, or Quark's Bar, you may discard two Latinum (one if your Acquisition present) to download a non-Latinum Equipment card there.

name: Assassination Plot
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: General Chang, Admiral Cartwright, and others conspired to derail the Federation-Klingon peace process by assassinating key leaders on both sides.
game_text: Name a skill. Kill an opposing personnel (random selection) with that skill present with your assassin. Return your assassin to owner's hand. Discard event.

name: HQ: War Room
lore: From patrol logs to casualty reports, all information concerning Dominion and Cardassian war efforts in the Alpha Quadrant came through one room.
game_text: Plays on a homeworld. Your OFFICER, SECURITY, Leadership and Resistance personnel of same affiliation as that homeworld are CUNNING +2 and STRENGTH +2.

name: Isomagnetic Disintegrator
lore: Shoulder-mounted large-caliber energy weapon. Fires a large purple bolt. Primarily used against aerial targets. Not to be confused with a Tetryon Pulse Launcher.
game_text: Plays on table. Shuffle your hand into your discard pile, then exchange your discard pile for your draw deck. Draw four cards (may not be converted to downloads). Discard event.

name: Masaka Transformations
lore: In 2370, the D'Arsay archive transferred multiple mythical personalities into Data, including the sun goddess Masaka.

name: Space Boomer
lore: Some crave the adventure and mystique of deep space. They desire to explore the stars, navigate uncharted systems, and go boldly where no man has gone before.
game_text: Plays on your personnel with Navigation x2 or Stellar Cartography x2. While aboard a matching ship, if you have completed a Space mission, that ship is RANGE +3.

name: Transwarp Hub
lore: Identification: TRANSWARP HUBTask: Dispatch Borg vessels throughout the galaxy.
game_text: Seeds or plays at any nebula. Once each turn, your ship may move from here to any Transwarp Network Gateway, or vice versa.

name: Bribery
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, your Smuggling or Greed personnel may discard one of your Gold-Pressed Latinum present to add Ferengi mission icon to your mission there (except Ferenginar ) until end of your next turn OR to prevent one entire point loss of up to 9 points just incurred there (discard incident) OR to release (and relocate to that personnel) one of your personnel held captive there.

name: Dig
game_text: Plays on your non-Borg Archaeology personnel to place any one card in your discard pile beneath your draw deck, then draw a card (or two cards if Jean-Luc Picard or an Archaeology x2 personnel present) OR discard the top card of your deck to place any other card from your discard pile atop draw deck OR discard a card from hand to take any one card from your discard pile into hand. After any use, discard incident.

name: Diplomatic Contact
game_text: Plays on your non-Borg personnel with Diplomacy and Treachery. Once each turn, you may discard a non-personnel card from hand to place a personnel from your discard pile on top of your deck. If that personnel is the same affiliation as this personnel, discard incident.

name: Service the Collective
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Whenever your current objective targets either a homeworld OR your mission that has an affiliation icon matching your counterpart there, your Borg are not restricted from probing on same turn they complete scouting. Also, while a personnel you've assimilated as a counterpart is on your ship, that ship is WEAPONS and SHIELDS +4 against counterpart's former affiliation(s).

name: Cold Warriors
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: "Captain, there's no need to mince words: in space, all warriors are cold warriors."
game_text: Plays when facing a dilemma. Your personnel with Treachery x2 gain Diplomacy and Law until end of turn. OR Nullifies Ankari "Spirits".

name: Shape-Shift
lore: The Founders manipulate their expanding empire using their ability to appear in many forms. It has proven invaluable to their success.
game_text: Allows your Founder in play to morph into a different Founder (exchange it with one in hand OR discard it to download one there). (Immune to Amanda Rogers.)

name: Tactical Scan
lore: Long range sensor data is often used to project and anticipate the tactics of an adversary.
game_text: Glance at the top three cards of any Battle Bridge side deck for twenty seconds. OR Play one at start of battle to name a tactic. No player may play that tactic this battle.

name: Council of Warriors
game_text: Plays on your Klingon mission showing less than 30 points (or on Qo'noS), if unattempted. Nullified if you play (or have played) Scan, Full Planet Scan, or a non-Klingon personnel. If you solve by end of your next turn, place objective in point area: place here all ships your ships destroy in battle and all personnel your Klingons kill in personnel battle to score points equal to WEAPONS or STRENGTH printed on card.

name: Ranjen Koral
lore: Student of B'hala, the lost Bajoran City. Former Prylar promoted to the rank of Ranjen to serve as minister overseeing the excavation project.

name: Winn Adami
lore: Kai of Bajor formerly known as Vedek Winn. Won her post through ambitious political maneuvering. Fairly successful as a negotiator.

name: Four of Nine
lore: '''IDENTIFICATION: HEURISTICS DRONETASK: Secondary adjunct of unimatrix zero one.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid; Species 571.

name: Evek
lore: Harsh interrogator who excels in extracting confessions from Maquis terrorists. Gul. Patrols the Badlands as captain of the Vetar.

name: Ocett
lore: Dogged rival of Nu'Daq, Galathon, and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise in the pursuit of the DNA program. Female gul in command of the Bralek.

name: Toran
lore: Ambitious brute sent as an assassin to kill political dissidents in 2370. Rose to the rank of Gul. Not to be confused with the commander of Outpost 61.

name: Founder Agitator
lore: Changeling assassin posing as a sculpture at the Federation-Romulan Antwerp Conference. Planted a bomb that killed 27 attendees.

name: Odo
lore: The Great Link's savior, the changeling Odo became a Founder to save his people and secure peace at the close of the Dominion War.

name: Ambassador Sarek
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: Vulcan ambassador. Assigned Spock to negotiate peace with Gorkon. Yielded to Klingon due process in Admiral Kirk and Dr. McCoy's trial for murder.

name: Andrea Brand
lore: Academy Superintendent during the Nova Squadron incident in 2368. Promoted to a rear admiral prior to accepting the post. A formidable woman.

name: Brunt
lore: Liquidator with the Ferengi Commerce Authority. Rude. Arrogant. Corrupt. Despised and envied by Ferengi everywhere. Strives to ruin Quark.

name: Grand Nagus Gint
lore: The first Grand Nagus. Credited with the Rules of Acquisition. Appeared in Quark's dream; looked a lot like Rom. Told Quark the Rules were a marketing ploy.

name: Chancellor Gowron
lore: Beginning with his invasion of Cardassia in 2372, Gowron became increasingly prideful and paranoid. Nearly destroyed the Empire in his quest for glory.

name: Chang
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: Gorkon's Chief of Staff in 2293, General Chang is a powerful and vocal advisor to the High Council. Commander of the I.K.S. Kla'Diyus.

name: Nu'Daq
lore: Tenacious rival of Ocett and Jean-Luc Picard in pursuit of the DNA program. Commanded the I.K.S. Maht-H'a on behalf of the High Council.

name: Alidar Jarok
lore: Conscientious admiral who defected to the Federation in 2366. Disinformed by Romulan High Command. Neither a butcher nor a hero.

name: Karina
lore: Intelligence analyst who posed as a diplomat on Deep Space 9 for a briefing on the Dominion. She questioned Kira Nerys' friendship with "the Founder" Odo.

name: Ruwon
lore: Intelligence analyst sent to retrieve information on the Dominion threat. Secretly commanded the Kilhra to destroy Deep Space 9.

name: Selveth
lore: Tal Shiar pilot aboard the Serrola. She distrusts Cardassians, but willing to work with them to eliminate the threat posed by the Dominion.

name: Senator Letant
lore: Romulan military strategist. He studied, and grudgingly approved, Benjamin Sisko's plan for an attack on the Dominion shipyards at Chin'toka.

name: Tal'Aura
lore: Impatient senator and political dissident. Contempt for Hiren's bureaucracy led her to become an assassin for Shinzon. Consorts with high-ranking officers.

name: Burrows
lore: Diagnostic tech on the NX-01. Has a keen sense of hearing. Trained with Lt. Reed to become a bodyguard.

name: Charles Tucker III
lore: Self-taught Chief Engineer of Enterprise. Best friend and confidant to Jonathan Archer. From Panama City, Florida. Enjoys pecan pie.

name: Travis Mayweather
lore: Space boomer born aboard the ECS Horizon. Joined Starfleet to travel as far – and as fast – as he could. Enjoys ancient gangster stories.

name: Back to Basics
lore: With all political authority vanished, humanity teetered on the edge of its second Dark Age.
game_text: Your opponent shuffles each personnel and ship in their discard pile into draw deck. If fourteen or more cards were shuffled in, Away Team stopped. Discard dilemma.

name: Contingency Plan
lore: As their cube and then their sphere were destroyed, the Borg adapted to the changing situation, single-minded, implacably persistent.
game_text: Place on ship; cannot be attacked by Borg or returned to hand. Opponent may download A Change of Plans. Assimilate Starship targeting this ship is worth 35 points.

name: Crowded Bar
lore: For residents of 2063 Bozeman, after dealing with the Borg bombardment, temporal incursions, and drunk Betazoids, making their way to the bar takes everything they've got.
game_text: Each player draws a card. Stop one personnel for each card in hand (your choice if you have less than six cards in hand, opponent's choice otherwise). Discard dilemma.

name: Definitely Not Swedish
lore: After encountering drones in person, Lily Sloane revised her initial reaction to Picard's description of the Borg.
game_text: Opponent may download and seed here up to two of the following: Don't Call Me Ahab, My First Raygun, or Strict Dress Code. Discard dilemma.

name: Mission Briefing PADD
lore: Personal Access Display Device loaded with mission-specific details for ready reference. Used for tasks from reporting scans to repairing historic warp vehicles.

name: A Willing Companion
lore: The Borg Queen's search for a like-minded counterpart led her to Data. The android was more resistant than anticipated.
game_text: Plays on table. You may leave an additional counterpart in play. If this event leaves play, discard counterpart(s) down to allowed number. (Cumulative.)

name: Adapt: Allocate Resources
lore: The Borg hive mind allows assets to be quickly reassigned, bringing the entire Collective closer to perfection.
game_text: Plays on table. In place of your normal card play, you may discard this event to download any Borg Only Event or Interrupt card.

name: Optimize Drones
lore: Due to the limited complement aboard smaller Borg vessels, drones are often assigned multiple tasks to achieve optimal mission outcomes.
game_text: Plays on any mission. While your sphere is here, your Communications and Defense personnel here are attributes all +1. Discard when your objective targeting this mission completed. (Unique.)

name: Launch the Phoenix
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. You may seed Montana Missile Complex. Phoenix may not be played (but may be acquired). Once each turn, your card native to 2063 Earth may report there for free. If your Phoenix takes off with Enterprise-E (or any Lily Sloane) aboard, Launch Successful: Place objective on Phoenix, draw 3 cards. Your Alpha Quadrant Federation mission missions are worth +5 points while Phoenix in orbit.

name: Protect Historic Encounter
game_text: Seeds on Earth; you may download Launch the Phoenix. Your Enterprise-E personnel may attempt Earth using these requirements:Anthropology + Archaeology + CUNNING>30When solved, mission worth 30 points (instead of printed value) and you may download a personnel native to 2063 Earth.'''

name: Data of Borg
lore: Tempted by flesh, the Soong-type android Data filled Locutus' role as an assimilated counterpart to speak to the Federation.
game_text: Returns to hand when you complete an objective.

name: Six of Ninety-Six
lore: IDENTIFICATION: RECONNAISSANCE DRONETASK: Scout areas where resistance is anticipated. Secure.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Human species.

name: Twelve of Ninety-Six
lore: IDENTIFICATION: TEMPORAL DRONETASK: Calibrate and maintain chronometric particles.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Human species.

name: Jae
lore: Representative of versatile support officers on the U.S.S. Enterprise-E. Formerly served in operations. She enjoys swimming and shipboard artistic events.

name: Jean-Luc
lore: Like Melville's fictional Captain Ahab, the former Borg Jean-Luc Picard burned with vengeance. Piled upon the Borg the sum of all his rage and hate.

name: Suzanne Dumont
lore: Senior transporter operations engineer. Friend of Maggie Hubbell. Once romantically involved with Wesley Crusher. Way out of his league.

name: Queen's Borg Sphere
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BORG SPHERETASK: Contingency vessel. Assimilate human homeworld. Borg Queen commands.
game_text: May be reported aboard, carried aboard and launched from any of your Borg cubes . Optimize Drones

name: U.S.S. Akira
lore: Class of heavy cruiser designed for border defense. First ship of this design entered service after the dissolution of the Khitomer Accords.
game_text: Attributes all +2 if Enterprise-E aboard.

name: A Good Day to Lie
lore: The Duras family's untrustworthiness is equal to their ambition. Duras tarnished Worf's honor, tried to have Picard killed, poisoned K'mpec, and murdered K'Ehleyr.
game_text: To get past requires 3 Diplomacy OR 3 Treachery. If a KlingonTreachery personnel in play, opponent may then download Duras to anywhere at this location.

name: All Available Personnel
lore: In 2369, a skeleton crew was left aboard the Enterprise while the rest of the crew searched for their rogue android.
game_text: Opponent may download Balancing Act to table as Incident OR download Skeleton Crew atop any mission. Cannot get past unless you began mission attempt with at least six personnel.

name: Diplomatic Intervention
lore: The Federation often sends expert negotiators to defuse volatile situations before they spiral out of control.
game_text: Opponent may download up to two Federation ambassadors to planet; they cannot be battled this turn. Place on mission. To solve mission, you must have more Diplomacy here than opponent.

name: Divided Loyalties
lore: Torn between his allegiance to Starfleet and his Klingon heritage, Worf resigned his commission to serve his people in the Klingon Civil War.
game_text: All multi-affiliation and dual-personnel are "stopped" for your next two full turns. To get past requires CUNNING>20 (or CUNNING>40 if this is a Delta Quadrant mission).

name: Ferengi Ambush
lore: Despite prior agreements about cooperating in a joint exploration of Delphi Ardu IV, the Ferengi seized the chance to get the better of their Federation adversaries.
game_text: Opponent may download to this planet up to three different Universal Ferengi and/or one Ferengi Whip. They may initiate battle (if possible).

page_title: I'm Not Going to Fight You (TNG)
name: I`m Not Going to Fight You
base_name: I`m Not Going to Fight You
lore: Misinterpreting the Tamarian's intent, Picard was unable to comprehend the true source of danger on the planet.
game_text: Opponent may download and seed here up to two of the following: Chalnoth, El-Adrel Creature, Nausicaans, or Rebel Encounter, then place on mission. Each of those dilemmas here first "stops" one Diplomacy (your choice).

name: Local Trouble
lore: Even well-intentioned contact with less-advanced civilizations can still lead to disastrous repercussions.
game_text: To get past requires Anthropology and STRENGTH>24. Opponent may then download and seed here up to two of the following: Archer, Hunter Gangs, or Punishment Zone.

name: Magnetic Field Disruptions
lore: Proximity to severe stellar phenomena can disrupt shipboard systems. In 2364, intense magnetic fields from the Delas star overloaded many consoles on the U.S.S. Enterprise.
game_text: One personnel (random selection) is killed unless you "stop" a personnel with Astrophysics or Navigation. To get past requires CUNNING>24 remaining.

name: Microbrain
lore: Small, solar-powered, inorganic collective life-form native to Velara III. Sabotaged Federation terraforming operations to protest the destruction of its home.
game_text: To get past, one Exobiology OR Geology personnel (opponent's choice) is "stopped". Nullify with a personnel who has either 3 Exobiology OR 3 Geology.

name: Pinned Down
lore: Confronted with Sir Guy of Gisbourne's archers, Jean-Luc Picard, posing as Robin Hood, ordered his crew deeper into Q's recreation of Sherwood Forest.
game_text: To get past, two personnel (random selection) must be "stopped." Then, if any Q cards in play, another personnel (random selection) is "stopped."

name: Temptation
lore: Despite overtures of friendship from the House of Duras, the Arbiter of Succession was unswayed, noting they had manipulated the circumstances with the skill of a Romulan.
game_text: To get past, three personnel (random selection) must be "tempted." Each one without Honor OR Treachery is "stopped."

name: Tense Negotiations
lore: Experienced diplomats are willing to meet their opponents on their terms and to confront challenges to their integrity with appropriate invectives when necessary.
game_text: To get past, one Diplomacy OR Leadership personnel (opponent's choice) must be "stopped." Nullify with a personnel who has either 3 Diplomacy OR 3 Leadership.

name: Triage
lore: Prioritizing the most urgent cases first, as Dr. Crusher did on Rutia IV, requires swift evaluation and unbiased medical judgment to save as many lives as possible.
game_text: One personnel (random selection) is killed unless you "stop" a personnel with Biology or MEDICAL. To get past requires INTEGRITY>22 remaining.

name: War Games
lore: The crews of the Enterprise and the Hathaway were forced to abandon their simulated battle to confront a real adversary.
game_text: To get past requires 2 ENGINEER, SECURITY, and Navigation. Then, place on ship; if opponent's ship moves to this location, discard dilemma and opponent scores points.

name: Warp Bubble Mishap
lore: When one of his warp field experiments trapped his mother in a collapsing warp bubble, Wesley was fortunate an expert was on hand to aid in her rescue.
game_text: One personnel (random selection) is killed unless you "stop" a personnel with Physics or SCIENCE. To get past requires CUNNING>24 remaining.

name: Cowboy Diplomacy
lore: Spock undertook a personal mission to reconcile ancient enemies Romulus and Vulcan. Starfleet took a dim view of his brash actions.
game_text: Once per game, plays (for free) to score points if your Federation Diplomacy personnel is on a planet mission opponent seeded.

name: General Quarters
lore: During shipboard emergencies as Roga Danar's escape from the U.S.S. Enterprise brig in 2366, off-duty crew and civilians are advised to stay in their quarters for safety.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. May not leave play. All players may only download personnel into play once every turn.

name: Heart of Glory
lore: Disillusioned with a modern Klingon society corrupted by the illusion of peace, Korris and Konmel sought to live their lives like true Klingons.
game_text: Plays on your Klingon (for free if Korris or Konmel). X varies, where X=number of personnel this Klingon stuns or mortally wounds (limit three). (Unique.)

name: Let`s See What`s Out There
lore: Starship crews often venture beyond the reaches of known space to explore strange new worlds, broaden their knowledge, and expand their power in the universe.
game_text: Plays to draw two cards. If you have 4 TNG personnel at one or more missions opponent seeded where there is no facility, draw two additional cards. Discard event.

name: You Are a Monument
lore: An ancient humanoid race, realizing they were alone in their part of the galaxy, seeded new life on other Alpha and Beta Quadrant worlds as a monument to their existence.
game_text: Plays on table. May not leave play. Each player who has not solved (or scouted) an Alpha Quadrant mission needs an additional 40 points to win.

name: Equipment Replicator
game_text: Seeds or plays on your non-Delta Quadrant ship that requires Command or your non-Delta Quadrant outpost. Once each turn, in place of a card draw, you may download any Kit, PADD, Relay, Scanner, or Tricoder to your TNG personnel or 3 non-Alternate ENGINEER aboard.

name: Finest Crew in the Fleet
game_text: Plays on table. Once each turn, your TNG Federation personnel with "U.S.S. Enterprise" in lore may report (for free) aboard your U.S.S. Enterprise or to your Federation outpost. Once per game, if your matching commander is aboard your U.S.S. Enterprise, you may download one Federation Flagship card to hand.

name: Get It Done
game_text: Plays on table. Once each turn, you may place two TNG cards from hand on the bottom of your deck to choose: make a unique TNG personnel attributes +2 until end of turn OR make a TNG ship RANGE +2 until end of turn OR shuffle the bottom three personnel and/or ships from your discard pile into your draw deck. After any use, discard incident OR discard a TNG card from hand. (Captain's Order.)

name: Legitimate Leader of the Empire
game_text: Plays on table. In place of your normal card play, you may download Gowron to your facility. While your Gowron is at a non-homeworld mission , once each turn, your non-Treachery TNG Klingon personnel may report (for free) to him or to your Klingon outpost. When your TNGKlingon personnel targeted by Arbiter of Succession wins a battle or helps solve a mission, you may draw two cards.

name: Officer Exchange Program
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, in place of a card draw, you may download I.K.S. Pagh or any TNG personnel with "I.K.S. Pagh" in lore to hand. Once every turn, when you are about to place a Tactic on an opponent's ship involved in battle with your I.K.S. Pagh, you may place that Tactic out-of-play instead to score 5 points (once per game per Tactic card title).

name: "Tag!"
lore: The Ferengi were unprepared for the ingenious games, tricks, and toys the "children" used to retake the Enterprise. "You're it!"
game_text: Once per game, downloads (even from your discard pile) a TNG Youth personnel to replace (discard) your non-Youth TNG personnel.

name: A Matter of Honor
lore: To a Klingon, honor is everything.
game_text: Once per game, downloads (even from your discard pile) a TNG Honor x2 personnel to replace (discard) your non-Honor TNG personnel.

name: Business Gambit
lore: Many in the Alpha Quadrant, lacking the lobes for business, are wary of the Ferengi Alliance's capitalistic practices.
game_text: Once per game, plays to "stop" your Ferengi Greed personnel and an opposing personnel present. Steal an equipment present OR download an equipment there.

name: Acquire Surplus Ships
lore: Klingon Salvage Yard: Complete illicit sale of decommissioned B'rel-class hardware.

name: Amnesty Talks
lore: Near Acamar system: Mediate an end to Gatherer raids in this area.

name: Avert Solar Implosion
lore: Veridian III: Prevent annihilation of inhabited star system by deranged scientist.

name: Encounter at Farpoint
lore: Deneb IV: Negotiate with natives for use of their newly-constructed starbase.

name: Host Metaphasic Shielding Test
lore: Veytan: Test revolutionary shield design within star's superdense corona.
game_text: When you solve, may download Metaphasic Shields here.

name: Intercept Sleeper Ship
lore: Near Boradis system: Protect colonies from returning Klingon sleeper ship.
game_text: I.K.S. T'Ong may report here (with up to 3 personnel)

name: Investigate Destruction
lore: Neutral Zone Region ● Science Station Delta 05: Seek cause of missing outposts.

name: Revenge Plot
lore: Camor V: Lay genetic groundwork for vengeance against old foe.

name: Seize Freighter
lore: Neutral Zone Region ● Near Talarian Shipping Lane: Hijack ship in glorious battle.
game_text: *+5 if Korrps or Konmel in crew.

name: Steal Technology
lore: Gamma Tauri VI: Steal energy converter from remote Federation outpost.
game_text: When you solve, may download (or steal) an equipment here.

name: The Last Outpost
lore: Delphi Ardu IV: Investigate source of energy emanating from ancient T'Kon outpost.

name: Treat Plague Ship
lore: Near Haven: Provide medical assistance to last members of disease-ravaged culture.
game_text: *+10 if Plague Planet complete.

name: Visit Tranquil Colony
lore: Jouret IV: Make routine stop at hospitable world near enemy space.

name: Expand the Empire
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once per game, at the start of your turn, for each mission opponent seeded where you have TNG Klingon personnel, you may download to hand (even from outside the game) a different interrupt with "Klingon" in title or gametext. Discard objective after use.

name: Ferengi Commerce Operation
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once per game, at the start of your turn, for each mission opponent seeded where you have TNG Ferengi personnel, you may download one equipment there. Then, if you have TNG Ferengi personnel at six or more such missions, you may also download one "use as Equipment card" artifact to your Ferengi ship (as if earned). Discard objective after use.

name: Seek Out New Life
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once per game, at the start of your turn, for each mission opponent seeded where you have TNG Federation personnel, you may download to hand one TNG personnel whose species you do not have in play. Discard objective after use.

name: Barron
lore: Typical civilian researcher studying pre-warp civilizations throughout Federation space. Supervised an anthropological study on Mintaka III.

name: Beverly
lore: While hosting an experimental metaphasic shield test, Beverly Crusher took on the roles of diplomat, detective, coroner, and test pilot.

name: Daniel Kwan
lore: ½ Napean, ½ human representative of Starfleet engineers. Inherited his empathic sense from his mother. Formerly served at Utopia Planitia Yards.

name: Data
lore: Pinocchio-like in his desire, the Soong-type android would gladly trade his superior abilities to be human. Learning to whistle "Pop Goes the Weasel."

name: Davies
lore: Geochemist representative of science specialists assigned to Galaxy-class starships. Intrigued by the symbiotic nature of the Trill species.

name: Deanna Troi
lore: Ship's counselor and occasional ambassador. ½ Betazoid, ½ human. Formerly romantically involved with William T. Riker as his imzadi.

name: Dr. Christopher
lore: Subspace theoretician and husband of T'Pan. Invited to participate in a metaphasic shield test. Doubted Dr. Reyga's new technology.

name: Geordi La Forge
lore: Conn officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2364. Son of two Starfleet officers. Blind at birth, he has used the ViSOR to see since the age of five.

name: Kosinski
lore: Arrogant engineer believed to have improved engine performance on several ships in 2364. Finds problem solving highly therapeutic.

name: Lian T'su
lore: Typical relief operation officer in the 24th century. Relishes the chance to explore new frontiers. Originally considered a security career.

name: Lopez
lore: Representative of talented junior security officers aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Assigned to compile the duty roster for his department.

name: Martin
lore: One of many staff doctors assigned to the U.S.S. Enterprise. Took charge of sickbay in 2368 after Beverly Crusher was incapacitated.

name: Seth Mendoza
lore: One of many ambassadors serving in the Federation Diplomatic Corps. Distant relative of Earth politician. Gambler and poker player.

name: Baht
lore: Typical Ferengi technician. Previously served on a D'Kora-class marauder but chose to become a privateer under Lurin in search of bigger profits.

name: Captain Picard
lore: The former captain of the U.S.S. Stargazer, Jean-Luc Picard was manipulated into attacking his own ship.
game_text: If exposed, becomes under opponent's control.

name: DaiMon Bok
lore: Bok could not forgive Captain Picard for the death of his son. Vengeful commander of the Kurdon.

name: Dr. Arridor
lore: Conspired with Goss during the Barza negotiations. Explored the wormhole with Kol. Prefers analysis to speculation.

name: Kayron
lore: One of many junior crew members often found on D'Kora marauders. Part of Letek's landing party. Berik's nephew. Former assay assistant on Lappa IV.

name: Kol
lore: Ferengi scientist serving under Goss. Studied the Barzan wormhole with Dr. Arridor. Didn't realize the significance of the meson and lepton fluctuations.

name: Levin
lore: Typical nurse found throughout the Ferengi Alliance. Now working with the privateer Lurin. Cousin of Broik. Collects antique musical recordings.

name: Mordoc
lore: Representative Ferengi security officer. Often part of away teams to strange, new worlds. Helped steal an energy converter. Disgusted by clothed females.

name: Obol
lore: Typical Ferengi soldier. Aspiring inventor and employee of Lurin. Tired of Klingon rations.

name: Quark
lore: Opportunistic bartender on Deep Space 9. Traded information about the Sisters of Duras in exchange for erasing William T. Riker's gambling winnings.

name: Rata
lore: Profiteer representative of Ferengi second officers. Opposed Bok's decision to give away the salvaged U.S.S. Stargazer at no cost.

name: B'Somgh
lore: Warp drive specialist aboard the I.K.S. Pagh, representative of engineers in the Klingon Defense Force. Considered a gourmand by shipmates.

name: Captain Worf
lore: To persuade K'Temoc not to attack, Worf served as acting captain of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Mate of K'Ehleyr. Finds the command chair "comfortable."

name: Commander K'Ehleyr
lore: ½ Klingon, ½ human romantically involved with Worf. K'Ehleyr posed as first officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2365. She left Worf incomplete.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
lore: Appointed by K'mpec to serve as Arbiter of Succession. Asked to discover the Chancellor's poisoner and stave off a Klingon civil war.

name: Kahless
lore: "The greatest warrior of them all." Clone of the unforgettable Klingon leader. Fulfilled prophecy. Installed as ceremonial Emperor in 2369.

name: Kitrik
lore: "The Tyrant Molor" in the Kot'baval Festival. Eager to help warriors deepen their understanding of Klingon heritage. Researcher on Maranga IV outpost.

name: Konmel
lore: Former lieutenant in the Klingon Defense Force. Deserted with Korris and Kunivas to restore glory to the Empire. Expert at concealing weaponry.

name: Koroth
lore: High cleric of Boreth. Responsible for cloning Kahless in an attempt to restore hope to his people.

name: Korris
lore: Renegade captain that sought an honorable death. To him, peace was a living death. Deserted with Konmel and Kunivas to restore Imperial glory.

name: Losta
lore: Follower of Kahless. Representative of young male Klingons eager to study the teachings of Kahless at the sacred Boreth monastery.

name: Q'elyn
lore: Representative of low-level technicians throughout the Klingon Empire. Before serving on the I.K.S. Pagh, worked as a supply agent on Rura Penthe.

name: William T. Riker
lore: The first Starfleet officer to serve on a Klingon ship as part of an exchange program. Commanded the I.K.S. Pagh after relieving Kargan of duty.

name: Zegov
lore: Typical Klingon female inspired by the Sisters of Duras. Ruthlessly supervised the I.K.S. Pagh engine room. Curious about William T. Riker's endurance.

name: Livingston
lore: Male lionfish. Survived a crash-landing on Veridian III. Confidant of Jean-Luc Picard. Object of curiosity.
game_text: Reports only to your ship. Does not join Away Teams.

name: Dr. Syrus
lore: Tilonian psychiatrist created by Suna as part of a plan to brainwash Riker. Worked in Ward 47 of the Tilonus Institute for Mental Disorders.

name: Koral
lore: Dour smuggler of few words. Acquired part of the Stone of Gol for Baran. Commanded a Klingon shuttle. Disliked games and replicated bloodwine.

name: Koral
lore: Dour smuggler of few words. Acquired part of the Stone of Gol for Baran. Commanded a Klingon shuttle. Disliked games and replicated bloodwine.

name: Koral (with TCC watermark)
lore: Dour smuggler of few words. Acquired part of the Stone of Gol for Baran. Commanded a Klingon shuttle. Disliked games and replicated bloodwine.

name: Vash
lore: Treasure hunter, archaeologist, liar, and thief romantically involved with Jean-Luc Picard. Partnered with Q to explore distant Gamma Quadrant ruins.

name: Will Riker
lore: William T. Riker "went renegade" to penetrate Baran's crew during the hunt for the Stone of Gol.

name: Will Riker
lore: William T. Riker "went renegade" to penetrate Baran's crew during the hunt for the Stone of Gol.

name: Will Riker (with TCC watermark)
lore: William T. Riker "went renegade" to penetrate Baran's crew during the hunt for the Stone of Gol.

name: Ferengi Scout Vessel
lore: Typical of small Ferengi craft converted for long-range missions. Often used to search for new business opportunities.

name: Kurdon
lore: Commanded by DaiMon Bok during his quest for vengeance against Captain Picard. First officer Kazago commanded following Bok's arrest.
game_text: Download Any TNG Ferengi personnel

name: Batris
lore: Talarian freighter hijacked by three Klingons in pursuit of a warrior's death. Commanded by Korris, who then destroyed the I.K.S. T'Acog.
game_text: WEAPONS +5 vs. Klingon

name: Batris
lore: Talarian freighter hijacked by three Klingons in pursuit of a warrior's death. Commanded by Korris, who then destroyed the I.K.S. T'Acog.
game_text: WEAPONS +5 vs. Klingon

name: Batris (with TCC watermark)
lore: Talarian freighter hijacked by three Klingons in pursuit of a warrior's death. Commanded by Korris, who then destroyed the I.K.S. T'Acog.
game_text: WEAPONS +5 vs. Klingon

name: I.K.S. Pagh
lore: Klingon Defense Force Bird-of-Prey commanded by Kargan. Tritanium hull plating attracted subatomic bacteria in 2365.

name: Armus - Skin of Evil
lore: A malevolent being was formed when the inhabitants of Vagra II rid themselves of all the evil they had inside.
game_text: Kills one Away Team member (random selection). Discard dilemma.

name: Birth of "Junior"
lore: Large infant spaceborne life-form. Attached itself to the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368, sucking energy from the ship.
game_text: Place on ship . End of each turn, RANGE reduced by 1; if reduced to 0, ship destroyed. Nullify with 3 ENGINEER.

name: Radioactive Garbage Scow
lore: Barges containing dangerous waste can be adrift for centuries. One such barge threatened Gamelon V in 2367.

name: The Arsenal: Divided
lore: While confronting the Echo Papa 607 weapons system, Geordi La Forge ordered a saucer separation to protect the ship's crew. He took command of the stardrive section.
game_text: Divide your unique crew members into two face-down piles. One pile is "stopped" (opponent's choice). To get past, ship must be staffed and have INTEGRITY>27 remaining.

name: The Arsenal: Separated
lore: While investigating the Arsenal of Freedom on Minos, a sudden attack separated the crew of the Enterprise.
game_text: Divide your unique personnel into two face-down piles. One pile is "stopped" (opponent's choice). To get past requires CUNNING>27 remaining.

name: Topological Anomaly 4747
lore: Invasive program created in 2368 by Data and Geordi La Forge to cause the total system failure of the Borg Collective.
game_text: Borg and Hologram personnel, androids, and one ENGINEER here (random selection) are placed in stasis. Cure on your next turn with new SCIENCE arriving or when countdown expires.

name: Virus
lore: Ancient Iconian computer programs transmitted to the U.S.S. Yamato, U.S.S. Enterprise, and Haakona attempted to overwrite the ships' computer systems.
game_text: Unless you have 4 Computer Skill present, place on ship. This ship, and all your other ships of the same class, are attributes all -2. Cure with 6 Computer Skill.

name: Wind Dancer
lore: Sentry of the Parallax Colony. Only allows those whose hearts are joyous to pass.
game_text: To get past, Lwaxana Troi must be present OR at least one Away Team member must have: Youth OR Music OR STRENGTH>9.

name: Alternate Universe Door
game_text: Place one on table during the seed phase. Door is now open, allowing your Alternate icon cards to enter play. OR Stock in deck and use as follows:Plays to nullify one Revolving Door or Subspace Schism. (Discard doorway.) OR Allows one ship to pass through Q-Net. (Discard doorway.) OR Nullify one Temporal Rift, and return doorway to your hand.

name: Surprise Party
lore: Planning Lt. Worf's party was easy; translating "For He's a Jolly Good Fellow" into Klingon was hard. There didn't seem to be a Klingon word for "jolly."
game_text: Plays on table. Your opponent may immediately draw up to two cards. At the end of each of your turns, you may draw an extra card. (Unique.)

name: Federation Outpost
lore: Earth is a member of the United Federation of Planets. The Federation establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Federation ENGINEER.

name: Ferengi Trading Post
lore: Ferengi commercial centers are frequented by many races for trade, information, repair and resupply.
game_text: Seed one (you may also seed one Universal D'Kora face up here) OR build where you have a Ferengi ENGINEER. Each player's non-Borg cards may report and mix aboard regardless of affiliation.

name: Klingon Outpost
lore: The Klingon Homeworld is Qo'noS. The Klingon Empire establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Klingon ENGINEER.

name: Romulan Outpost
lore: Romulus is one of the two homeworlds for the Romulans. The Romulan Star Empire establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Romulan ENGINEER.

name: Botanical Research
lore: Unexplored planet: Gather plant life for medical research from planet with highly ionized atmosphere.
game_text: Atmospheric Ionization may seed here.

name: Impose Order
lore: Pre-unified world: Unify diverse nation-states via coercion and occupation.
game_text: * Unopposed OFFICER on planet may steal points.

name: Search for Weapons
lore: Demilitarized Zone Region ● Border planet: Search planet for illegal Maquis arms cache.
game_text: May seed hand weapons under here.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
lore: Rescued Borg counterpart. After returning to his command of the U.S.S. Enterprise, Picard developed a violent vendetta against the Borg.

name: Robert DeSoto
lore: Captain of the U.S.S. Hood and former commanding officer of William T. Riker. Years ago, he and Jean-Luc Picard served together as lieutenants on the same ship.

name: Shelby
lore: Lt. Commander Shelby is an ambitious Starfleet officer. Assigned to the U.S.S. Enterprise as a specialist on the Borg.

name: Sito Jaxa
lore: Ensign Sito Jaxa, a Bajoran, is one of a number of navigation officers aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Spock
lore: ½ Vulcan, ½ Human son of Sarek and Amanda Grayson. Over 140-year-old ambassador. On private mission to Romulus. Mindmelded with Picard.

name: Tasha Yar-Alternate
lore: Traveled to 2344 and helped prevent a disastrous war. Survivor of the Battle of Narendra III. Consort of Romulan general. Mother of Sela.

name: Worf
lore: Lieutenant Worf is chief of security on the U.S.S. Enterprise. Klingon warrior and Starfleet officer. Son of Mogh. Raised on Earth by foster parents.

name: Dr. Reyga
lore: Invited aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise to demonstrate his innovative technology. The ensuing murder mystery proved it successful, but at a high cost.

name: Duras
lore: Son of a traitor, Ja'rod, and a traitor himself. Member of the Klingon High Council.

name: Gowron
lore: Son of M'Rel. Leader of the Klingon High Council after defeating the Duras forces in the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: K'Temoc
lore: Captain of the sleeper ship I.K.S. T'Ong, on a crucial mission ordered by the High Command in the late 23rd century. Awoke 75 years later in a much-changed galaxy.

name: Kargan
lore: Captain of the I.K.S. Pagh when Commander William T. Riker served as an exchange officer.

name: Kurak
lore: Famed female Klingon scientist and warp-field specialist who evaluated the metaphasic shield.

name: Vekma
lore: Klingon female trained in Klingon anatomy and medicine. Propositioned Commander William T. Riker on the I.K.S. Pagh in 2365.

name: Baran
lore: Male captain of a mercenary ship raiding archaeological sites to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Jo'Bril
lore: Takaran male. Attempted to steal Dr. Reyga's metaphasic shield technology to claim as his own.

name: Tallera
lore: Female Romulan mercenary. In reality a physically altered Vulcan isolationist seeking the Stone of Gol.

name: Vekor
lore: Representative of female mercenaries operating throughout the galaxy. Worked with Baran to find the Stone of Gol.

name: U.S.S. Drake
lore: Starfleet vessel, registry NCC-20381. In 2364, was assigned to a routine mission of exploration in and around the Lorenze Cluster under the command of Paul Rice.

name: U.S.S. Enterprise
lore: Encountered the U.S.S. Enterprise-C in an alternate reality. Became the Future Enterprise in an alternate future. Visited by crew from the Starship Enterprise.
game_text: Download Wall of Ships

name: U.S.S. Oberth
lore: Class of small ships often used for scientific missions. Named for 20th century rocket scientist Hermann Oberth.

name: D'Kora Transport
lore: Ferengi trade vessel. Same specifications as the D'Kora-class marauder, but has a smaller crew complement and devotes far more internal volume to cargo capacity.

name: I.K.S. Bortas
lore: Flagship commanded by Gowron during the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68. Lieutenant Worf briefly served aboard as a weapons officer.

name: I.K.S. K'Vort
lore: Class of ships identical in configuration to the classic B'rel class Klingon Bird-of-Prey, although much larger.

name: Mercenary Ship
lore: Little-known ship. Difficult to track due to a unique hull design that renders it invisible to long-range scans. Baran captained one in 2370.

name: Science Vessel
lore: Specialized science ship used for an Interphase Generator experiment in 2368.

name: Balancing Act
lore: In an attempt to save the lives of millions, James T. Kirk crossed onto an unstable bridge to obtain Dr. Tolian Soran's control PADD. The feat required balance and strength.

name: Ready Room Door
game_text: Once per turn, plays to download to one of your ships its matching commander (draw no cards this turn) OR to download one Captain's Order. After any use, discard doorway; place it atop your draw deck; or place it atop one of your Captain's Order events to protect that event from nullification.

name: El-Aurian Phaser
lore: Unusual, easily concealed weapon carried by Dr. Tolian Soran. Capable of producing powerful bursts of phased energy. Targeting scope increases accuracy, in the right hands.
game_text: Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +1, or +3 if they have both Treachery and SCIENCE.

name: Mr. Tricorder
lore: Standard-issue tricorder. Geordi La Forge asked Data to use one to analyze solar probes discovered in a secret chamber of the Amargosa observatory. Data had other ideas.
game_text: May report to any Data. Your personnel present who have both OFFICER and ENGINEER all add Computer Skill. Androids here are attributes all -6.

name: Trilithium Weapon Control PADD
lore: PADD used by Dr. Tolian Soran to remotely control his solar probe and its trilithium-based nuclear inhibitor. Modified programming also governs launch and cloak functions.
game_text: Your Astrophysics and Stellar Cartography personnel present are CUNNING +1, or +3 if they also have Treachery.

name: Fajo's Gallery
lore: Kidnapped by Kivas Fajo, Data became part of an impressive collection of rare and one-of-a-kind items. Fajo had no problem with the morality of Data's imprisonment.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. You may draw two cards each time you capture a unique personnel, and one card each time one of your Fajo Collection cards or Mona Lisa enters play.

name: Regenerate
lore: The Borg use neural energy to collectively repair damaged biological and technological components. The Borg use alcoves to facilitate this process.
game_text: Plays to fully repair and "stop" any Borg Ship dilemma or Borg ship (nullifying any cards reducing its attributes) OR to shuffle your discard pile into draw deck. Discard event.

name: Seat of Starfleet
lore: The place that started it all. Changed the galaxy as we know it.

name: A Change of Plans
lore: The Borg Queen's initial consideration of Admiral Janeway's deal dissipated once she triangulated the admiral's signal. The Borg then adopted to a more aggressive strategy.

name: Qapla'!
lore: When threatened, fight. When in doubt, surprise them. Brute strength is not the most important asset in a fight. Real power is in the heart. A Klingon does not run away from his battles.
game_text: If an opponent attacks you, during that battle your Klingons with Honor add INTEGRITY to STRENGTH. (Not cumulative.)

name: Find Hidden Base
lore: Badlands Region ● Athos IV: Eliminate primary Maquis base of operations.
game_text: *+10 if no Maquis in Badlands Region.

name: Engage Cloak
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. When your staffed ship cloaks or phases, it may relocate here (capacity one ship). Just before that ship decloaks or dephases, return it to its former location; it may immediately move (up to its full RANGE) once for each of your full turns it was on this objective. (If ship returns to spaceline on your turn, it may also use that turn's RANGE.)

name: HQ: Defensive Measures
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your personnel with any Intelligence gain 1 Leadership and may initiate battle against their own affiliation. Also, opponent may not attempt any of your missions with more than one affiliation icon on each end unless opponent attempted to seed a copy of that mission OR opponent is using an appropriate Espionage card.

name: Reaching Out
game_text: Plays on your non-homeworld mission requiring Diplomacy (for free if your Jonathan Archer there). Limit one per mission. Your Starfleet personnel may now attempt this mission. When your Starfleet personnel solve, discard to score points if mission has at least two non-Federation mission affiliation icons.

name: Riker Wil
lore: In 2370, the human William T. Riker accompanied Ro Laren on a clandestine mission to investigate the Maquis. He posed as a Bajoran freedom fighter.

name: Borg Queen
lore: "I am the beginning; the end; the one who is many. I am the Borg.... I am the collective."

name: Locutus of Borg
lore: Assimilated counterpart who spoke to the Federation. "The knowledge and experience of the human – Jean Luc Picard – is part of us now."

name: Gul Madred
lore: Ruthless Obsidian Order officer. Madred's torture of Jean-Luc Picard quickly degenerated into a desperate attempt to break Picard's will. A pitiable man.

name: T'Lara
lore: Typical Vulcan admiral. She presided over Worf's extradition hearing in 2372. Threatened to hold both Worf and Ch'Pok in contempt of court.

name: Wesley Crusher
lore: Nova Squadron pilot during the collision on stardate 45703. Cadet third class. Lost a year's worth of academy credits for his part in the cover-up.

name: Tog
lore: DaiMon. Presented flowers to Lwaxana Troi. Abducted her from Betazed, hoping to exploit her empathic skills during negotiations.

name: Culluh
lore: First maje of the Kazon-Nistrim. Romantically involved with Seska. Commands a Kazon Raider. Seeks to capture U.S.S. Voyager and its technology at any cost.

name: Ja'rod
lore: Father of Duras, Lursa and B'Etor. Disappeared shortly after transmitting security codes to the Romulans, precipitating the Khitomer Massacre.

name: Jaglom Shrek
lore: Yridian informant. Told Worf of the secret prison camp in the Carraya system. Likes to tinker with his warp drive. Commanded a Yridian Shuttle.

name: Kathleen Tonell
lore: Inspired in 2063 with a new view of humanity's place in the cosmos, her work helped end post-atomic horror and led to world government in 2113.

name: Persis
lore: Loyal "daughter" of Arik Soong. Augment grown from a genetically engineered embryo kept from the time of Khan. Romantically involved with Raakin and Malik.

name: Sabrun
lore: Representative of the many senators navigating the perilous and delicate political landscape on Romulus. Seeks to better the Star Empire for his two sons.

name: The Viceroy
lore: Shinzon's protector and counselor. Reman general who kept the Praetor on task. Helped Shinzon invade Deanna Troi's mind. Not known for his beauty.

name: Tomalak
lore: Beguilling adversary of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Plotted to display its broken hull on Romulus as a symbol of victory. Commanded the Deranas.

name: Jonathan Archer
lore: Headstrong captain of the Enterprise NX-01. Son of warp engine designer Henry Archer. Negotiated with Vulcans, Andorians, Xindi, and Orions.

name: Bralek
lore: Cardassian warship commanded by Ocett. One of two vessels sent to investigate a significant Federation archaeological discovery in 2369.
game_text: Download Any TNG Cardassian personnel

name: Zalkonian Vessel
lore: Typical Zalkonian defense vessel. One commanded by Sunad traveled at warp 9.72, hunting the fugitive known as John Doe in the Zeta Gelis Cluster.
game_text: Kills untransfigured John Doe if at same location at end of your turn.

name: Trolarak
lore: Warbird involved in the 2369 race to unravel the DNA puzzle discovered by Richard Galen. Commanded by Galathon.

name: 22nd-Century San Francisco
lore: 2154 Earth: San Francisco survived World War III and became a beacon of human progress.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; download Seat of Starfleet here. Each card with both Starfleet and Preview gains 22nd Century (even if not in play). Native to this timeline: all Starfleet cards, Non-Aligned 22nd Century personnel, Neutral 22nd Century cards, and 22nd Century equipment (except Mirror Quadrant cards). Non-22nd Century cards are excluded from battle here.

name: Trilithium Weapon
lore: Trilithium-based nuclear inhibitor housed within a solar probe. Built by Dr. Tolian Soran to reshape gravitational forces and gain access to the joyous fantasy within the Nexus.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. Discard to rate your Mission card here (except a Mission II) so that your side now face opponent.

name: Antedean Assassins
lore: In 2365, two Antedeans planned to bomb the conference on Pacifica. Without Lwaxana Troi's help, Starfleet would not have learned their robes were lined with explosive ultritium.
game_text: To get past, one Anthropology OR Empathy personnel (opponent's choice) must be "stopped." Nullify with a personnel who has either 2 Anthropology OR 2 Empathy.

name: Captain's Holiday
lore: Thieves, time travel, mysterious artifacts, and digging in caves made for a refreshing change from the demands of commanding a starship.
game_text: To get past requires 2 Archaeology OR 2 Geology.

name: Devastating Communique
lore: Following the tragic news of the deaths of his brother and nephew, Jean-Luc Picard retreated to the seclusion of his quarters to mourn.
game_text: One personnel (opponent's choice) is "stopped" until end of your next turn. May be nullified by Subspace Interference.

name: Do You Smell Something Burning?
lore: Caught in the Nexus, where time had no meaning, James T. Kirk forgot he had been cooking Ktarian eggs for breakfast.
game_text: "Stops" half of your Away Team (random selection, round down). Nullify with a cook, ANIMAL, or Lure of the Nexus. Mission continues.

name: Invidium Leak
lore: A broken container of invidium disrupted the U.S.S. Enterprise's systems in 2366 before it was rendered inert by Geordi La Forge and Reginald Barclay.
game_text: Cannot get past unless crew has 3 ENGINEER OR a personnel with CUNNING>7 and MEDICAL OR a personnel with CUNNING>7 and Physics.

name: Ornaran Threat
lore: Suffering from felicium withdrawal, T'Jon threatened William T. Riker's life in an attempt to manipulate Jean-Luc Picard. Picard refused to enable the Ornaran's addiction.
game_text: Randomly select a personnel to be "stopped." Unless you have 2 Diplomacy and MEDICAL OR 2 SECURITY and STRENGTH>25, that personnel is killed.

name: Reluctant Informant
lore: When Yranac was unforthcoming with information about those responsible for Jean-Luc Picard's alleged death, William T. Riker used alternative methods to jog the Yridian's memory.
game_text: Lowest INTEGRITY personnel and one other Command (if present, opponent's choice) are "stopped" until end of your next turn. Nullify with Empathy OR a brig present.

name: Shall We Begin Again?
lore: In 2369, the Cardassians expended considerable resources to capture and interrogate Jean-Luc Picard. They failed to extract the Federation's defense plans for Minas Korva.
game_text: Opponent draws 3 cards, then reveals their hand. For each Command personnel revealed, "stops" one personnel present (random selection).

name: Trilithium Raid
lore: In 2371, after Lursa and B'Etor stole trilithium from a Romulan outpost, the Romulans came looking for it at the Amargosa observatory.
game_text: Opponent may download up to two Universal Romulans to a facility at this location (or up to six if facility is a station). To get past requires 2 ENGINEER and STRENGTH>40.

name: Undercover Agent
lore: Romulan security operatives such as Selok, who posed as Vulcan ambassador T'Pel for years, spy on governments throughout the quadrant. They could be anywhere.
game_text: If a Romulan ship in play, opponent may download to here Selok or a Romulan with an infiltration icon. To get past requires SECURITY, Biology, and (CUNNING>40 OR Law).

name: Venus Drug
lore: Illegal compound believed mythical by some. Used by Harcourt Fenton Mudd to improve the attractiveness of his "cargo." Its true power lay in the user's self-confidence.
game_text: Plays on any location. Your female personnel here gain Youth and are attributes all +2.

name: Always A Chess Game
game_text: Plays on table. Once each turn, your TNG Romulan personnel (except Tal Shiar, CIVILIAN, or V.I.P.) may report for free to your Romulan outpost OR you may report (for free) to your ship its TNG Romulan matching commander. Once per game, score 5 points when your TNG Romulan personnel helps solve a non-Universal Neutral Zone mission.

name: Federation Flagship: Recovered
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. If opponent's card just destroyed your only ship in play, place that ship here (with all cards aboard). Download one of the following to your matching facility or that spaceline's end: a different ship of the same class or identification OR any other Enterprise (if destroyed ship was any Enterprise). Relocate crew and equipment from here to downloaded ship (they are "stopped"). Discard incident.

name: Illegitimate Leader of the Empire
game_text: Plays on table. In place of your normal card play, you may download Klingon Civil War OR download to your facility any TNG Klingon or TNG Romulan card with "Duras" in title or lore. Once each turn, your non-Honor TNG Klingon personnel may report (for free) to your Klingon outpost, or to your Duras, Lursa, B'Etor or Sisters of Duras. Discard incident if you have Gowron or any Klingon with Honor in play.

name: The Romulan Underground
game_text: Plays on a Romulus System planet. Once each turn, Major Rakal, a TNG Romulan Dissident, or TNG Romulan personnel with "underground" in lore may report for free here. Your Away Team which includes such a personnel may attempt this mission. When you solve, you may discard incident and three TNG Romulan Honor personnel from that Away Team score points.

name: They Will Be Coming
game_text: Seeds during facility phase on spaceline end (on far end from Earth, if possible); may download one Borg ship here. Once each turn, you may report a Universal Borg to your Borg ship for free. Nullified if you seeded any non-Alpha Quadrant mission. (Unique).

name: A Family of Traitors
lore: Like their father Ja'rod and their brother Duras, Klingon sisters Lursa and B'Etor chose to betray their people and form an alliance with the Romulans in an attempt to seize power.
game_text: Once per game, downloads (even from your discard pile) a TNG Treachery x2 personnel to replace (discard) your non-Treachery TNG personnel.

name: Explain Your Presence
lore: While neither the Federation nor the Romulans may enter the Neutral Zone, chance encounters do occur. The Romulans manipulate such situations to look like the aggrieved party.
game_text: Once per game, place on your Romulan OFFICER if opponent's crew there. "Stop" that personnel and examine opponent's crew; score points.

name: Advanced Combat Training
lore: Inhospitable planet: Participate in tactical training scenarios in harsh environment.

name: Attend Mysterious Rendezvous
lore: Near Xendi Sabu system: Meet with old adversary to discuss a "gift."

name: Conceal Unlikely Society
lore: Carraya IV: Suppress knowledge about colony of Romulans and formerly imprisoned Klingons.
game_text: *Discard up to three Youth for +5 each.

name: Resupply Marauder II
lore: Clandestine base: Restock Ferengi vessel.
game_text: If destroyed, flip mission over.

name: Ensnared
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once per game, at the start of your turn, if you have TNGCardassian personnel at four or more missions an opponent seeded, name a unique personnel. If opponent has that personnel in play, place that personnel aboard your ship (captured).

name: We Are Back
