game_text: ATTACK and DEFENSE bonus +2 if you have a Condor-class ship firing in Demilitarized Zone or Badlands Region. Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Quantum Incursions
game_text: Seeds like a Space/Planet dilemma.

name: Crossover: An Invitation
lore: In 2372, the Terran Rebellion kidnapped Jake Sisko from Deep Space 9, knowing that Benjamin Sisko would promptly pursue his son to the mirror universe.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, your personnel native to the Alpha Quadrant may report (but not download) as if they were Mirror Quadrant.

name: Leader of the Sect
lore: A factionalized society, Kazon sects rely on the strong and dominant leadership of their Maje. Weakness is never tolerated.
game_text: Seeds on your Kazon facility. At the start of any player's turn, if you do not have a Maje in play, you may download a Maje here.

name: Investigate Anti-Time Eruption
lore: Neutral Zone Region ● Devron System: Analyze anomaly in politically delicate location.

name: Rak'tazan
lore: Jem'Hadar Sixth representative of soldiers stationed aboard Terok Nor during the Dominion occupation of 2374. Struggled to decipher Cardassian egotism.

name: Commodore Decker
lore: Matt Decker commanded the Starship Constellation. Vowed revenge on the machine that killed his crew. Father of Willard Decker. Dislikes practical jokes.

name: Kell Perim
lore: Trill serving on the U.S.S. Enterprise-E. Operations officer during the battle with Son'a warships in the Briar Patch in 2375. Not joined with a symbiont.

name: Lwaxana Troi
lore: Female Betazoid ambassador who visited DS9 several times. Suffered the effects of Zanthi fever in 2371. Romantically involved with Jeyal and Odo.

name: Worf
lore: Klingon strategic operations officer aboard DS9. Often commanded the U.S.S. Defiant. Romantically involved with Jadzia Dax. Likes prune juice.

name: General Korok
lore: Klingon warrior whose recessive gene allowed him to access Unimatrix Zero. Fought to free himself and his fellow Borg. Known as Six of Ten by his hive.

name: General Korok
lore: Klingon warrior whose recessive gene allowed him to access Unimatrix Zero. Fought to free himself and his fellow Borg. Known as Six of Ten by his hive.

name: Frederick La Rouque
lore: Professional gambler on late 19th century Earth. Always looking for an easy mark. French-speaking native of New Orleans. Fond of the waltz.

name: Orderly Mavek
lore: Typical Tilonian nurse created by Suna as part of a brainwashing scenario. Appeared to enjoy the torment he inflicted on the occupants of Ward 47.

name: Gannet Brooks
lore: Starfleet Intelligence agent. Posed as a reporter to investigate xenophobic organization Terra Prime. Romantically involved with Travis Mayweather.

name: My Ship, My Crew
lore: "I suppose you're worried about your fish, too."
game_text: Opponent names a classification. You choose: randomly select a personnel in crew or Away Team with that classification (if any) to be "stopped" OR randomly select three personnel in crew or Away Team without that classification to be "stopped". (May also be seeded as Space/Planet.)

name: U.S.S. Enterprise-E
lore: IDENTIFICATION: FEDERATION SOVEREIGN-CLASSTASK: Prevent first contact between humans and Vulcans in 2063. Borg Queen commands.
game_text: May report to Earth. Download Borg Queen

name: U.S.S. Enterprise
lore: Federation starship claimed under Ferengi Salvage Code. Captained by Lurin. A mysterious machine.

name: Close Call
lore: To outrun the reflexes and agility of his Jem'Hadar captors, Miles O'Brien used the even swifter response time of a transporter's energizing coil.
game_text: One personnel present (random selection) is killed if that personnel does not have Computer Skill or Transporter Skill. To get past requires 2 Diplomacy OR 3 SECURITY remaining.

name: Incentive-Based Economics
lore: To obtain a rare gift for his father, Jake Sisko and his friend Nog bartered, swapped favors, stole a teddy bear, and even negotiated with Weyoun.
game_text: To get past requires Honor and no SECURITY OR CIVILIAN, Anthropology, Diplomacy, Youth, and a personnel with STRENGTH<8.

name: Inter Arma Enim Silent Leges
lore: Section 31 went to great lengths to ensure their mole Koval gained a seat on the praetor's Continuing Committee over rival Senator Cretak.
game_text: To get past requires V.I.P. and no Treachery OR SECURITY, Exobiology, Computer Skill, and a personnel with INTEGRITY<5.

name: Nanobiogenic Fugitives
lore: On the run after a Kellerun attempt to wipe out all knowledge of the harvester virus, Bashir and O'Brien had to repair an old communications system to signal for rescue.
game_text: Choose two personnel with ENGINEER (or one personnel with Physics) to be stopped. To get past requires 2 Computer Skill and Physics remaining.

name: Subspace Accident
lore: Benjamin Sisko became trapped outside the normal flow of time after an accident caused by the 2372 subspace inversion of the Bajoran Wormhole.
game_text: Unless 3 Astrophysics OR 2 Physics and 2 SCIENCE present, personnel with most Skill Dot icons is held with dilemma atop mission. Discard both at end of your next turn.

name: The New Resistance
lore: Undermining the new administration of Terok Nor required careful planning, inside information, playing dumb, and plying Damar with kanar.
game_text: To get past requires Honor and no OFFICER OR Diplomacy, Leadership, Computer Skill, V.I.P., and a personnel with CUNNING<7.

name: Underestimating the Founders
lore: Although Enabran Tain was presumed dead after the failed attack on the Great Link, the spymaster was in fact captured by Dominion forces.
game_text: One non-Hologram personnel is captured (your choice if opponent currently has a captive; otherwise, random selection). Nullify with any 3 Intelligence.

name: A Better Alternative
lore: Appealing to Odo's sense of order and justice, Gul Dukat had the changeling investigate the chemist shop murder to avoid executing ten Bajorans at random as reprisal.
game_text: Plays on table. Once each turn, may discard a unique non-Borg card from hand to draw a card. If the discarded card was a site or a DS9 Cardassian card, draw two additional cards.

name: Mutual Distrust
lore: Despite their alliance to destroy the Founders, Tal Shiar and Obsidian Order agents did not trust one another. Watching for signs of betrayal kept them at peak efficiency.
game_text: Plays on your personnel (limit one each); target their Intelligence. Once each turn, when you play a personnel with different Intelligence, draw a card. (Cumulative.)

name: Dosi Trading Post
lore: Center of enterprise for the Dosi, other Gamma Quadrant citizens, and their associates.
game_text: Seeds on Dosi planet. Your personnel with Greed or Acquisition, and your Karemma and Dosi personnel, may report here (for free, once each turn).

name: Internment Camp 371
lore: Detention and interrogation facility for high-profile prisoners. Commanded by Deyos.
game_text: Seeds at Asteroid Camp. Has a Brig. Once each turn, you may play a personnel with "Internment Camp 371" in lore for free here. Training Ring

name: Dominion Hierarchy
game_text: Plays on your Founder; once each turn, Dominion Hierarchy plays for free. OR Plays on your Vorta present with a Founder and a Jem'Hadar to make that Vorta attributes all +2 and gain a skill of your choice until end of turn, then discard incident. OR Seeds or plays on your Dominion facility. You may suspend play while you download Jem'Hadar Sacrifice or Security Sacrifice, then discard incident.

name: Holographic Communicator
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Just after you report a DS9 ship with at least one Command or Staff staffing icon to your Alpha Quadrant facility, you may place this incident on that ship. This ship, and all your other ships of the same class, add Holodeck. If ship is destroyed, return incident to table.

name: Holographic Settlement
game_text: Seeds or plays on your Yaderan colony. Hologram cards may exist on this planet (and report activated). Your Rurigan and your Gamma Quadrant Hologram personnel may report here; once each turn, one such personnel may do so for free if Gamma Quadrant. Whenever a Hologram personnel on a planet is deactivated, it must be returned to its owner's hand (limit once each turn) or place beneath owner's draw deck.

name: Joint Operation
game_text: Plays on table; you may download Treaty: Romulan/Cardassian. Your DS9 Cardassian (except Mirror Quadrant) and DS9 Romulan personnel may report to your ship in the Orias System. Once each turn, your DS9 Cardassian or DS9 Romulan personnel with any Intelligence may report for free OR nullify Homefront where present.

name: Reward from the Founders
game_text: Plays on table. You may report only one Jem'Hadar each turn. Once each turn, you may play a DS9 Vorta for free, then draw a card if you do not have Dominion War Efforts in play. Twice per game, you may download Ketracel-White to your Vorta present with your Jem'Hadar. Discard incident if you voluntarily initiate a personnel battle with more than 2 of your Jem'Hadar.

name: Sucking Up to the Boss
lore: Benjamin Sisko exploited Ferengi loyalty to the Grand Nagus, forcing Quark to use his contacts with the Karemma to help Starfleet's search for the Founders.
game_text: Plays once each turn on your DS9 Ferengi personnel. Name a skill. For the rest of turn, while facing a dilemma with your 3 Acquisition present, personnel gains that skill.

name: Establish Medical Complex
lore: Bajor Region ● Derna: Build facility for wounded Romulans in allied government territory.
game_text: When you solve, may download Romulan Outpost here.

name: Expand Karemman Operations
lore: Karemman colony: Source new land to increase fleece production and trade potential.

name: Further Tulaberry Talks
lore: Dosi planet: Attend Karemma conference hosted by the Dosi to coordinate distribution.

name: Investigate Omicron Particles
lore: Yaderan colony: Determine source of unusual particle field.
game_text: When seeded, you may download Holographic Settlement.

name: Probe Alpha Quadrant System
lore: Uncharted sector: Gather information about distant areas of the galaxy.

name: Combined Strike
game_text: Plays on your Gamma Quadrant mission (for free if or Romulan mission). Your personnel may report here, to your matching Intelligence personnel aboard your ship native to the Alpha Quadrant. When solved by your non-Gamma Quadrant personnel, draw up to 5 cards, then discard objective to score points; if opponent has a Gamma Quadrant mission Dominion facility, you may download Combined Strike.

name: Disguise Encroachment
game_text: Plays on your unsolved mission. If at Derna or a mission where you have no facility, you may immediately report a Romulan Treachery personnel here. Once solved, if opponent subsequently solves (or has solved) a mission that is adjacent or in the same region, score points; opponent loses points (discard objective).

name: Training Ring
game_text: Plays on your facility with a Brig. Once each turn, you may target a captive in that Brig; then randomly select your Jem'Hadar or SECURITY personnel present. If your selected personnel has higher printed STRENGTH than captive, place captive in point area; he or she is worth X points, where X = printed STRENGTH of targeted captive.

name: Enabran Tain
lore: Retired mastermind planning a dramatic comeback. Working with the Tal Shiar and his fellow Cardassians to destroy the Founders. Mentored Elim Garak.

name: Enabran Tain
lore: Retired mastermind planning a dramatic comeback. Working with the Tal Shiar and his fellow Cardassians to destroy the Founders. Mentored Elim Garak.

name: Turo
lore: Cardassian posted aboard the Serrola as a liaison to the Romulans. Typical transporter forensics specialist. Glinn later interned by the Dominion.

name: Administrator Kilana
lore: Prior to contact with the Alpha Quadrant, the female Vorta Kilana mapped transport and patrol routes.

name: Administrator Weyoun
lore: Stalwartly loyal Vorta. Third incarnation of Weyoun. Dutifully directed the destruction of the New Bajor colony in 2370, as ordered by the Founders.

name: Amar'itak
lore: Sixth under Ikat'ika. One of many Jem'Hadar guards at Internment Camp 371. Grew to respect Klingons after seeing Worf's endurance in combat.

name: Guna'shan
lore: Typical Jem'Hadar Second aboard Weyoun's Warship. Assisted Weyoun during his encounter with Jake Sisko, Nog, and Elias Giger in 2373.

name: Jiten'parekh
lore: Jem'Hadar First present at Alpha Quadrant armistice signing; later ambassador to Qo'noS. Former bodyguard at Internment Camp 371.

name: Pimoo
lore: Typical Dosi bureaucrat. Assigned to audit off-world trade. She specializes in Alpha Quadrant transactions. Formerly first officer on a Dosi Trade Vessel.

name: Quark
lore: Ferengi bartender and trade envoy of Grand Nagus Zek. Assigned to negotiate with the Dominion. Oblivious to Pel's romantic intentions toward him.

name: Quark
lore: Ferengi bartender and trade envoy of Grand Nagus Zek. Assigned to negotiate with the Dominion. Oblivious to Pel's romantic intentions toward him.

name: Retana'var
lore: Typical Jem'Hadar Fourth, assigned as a bodyguard on the Founders' homeworld. Assisted Science Advisor Borath with maintenance of his equipment.

name: Science Advisor Borath
lore: Prior to the invasion of the Alpha Quadrant, the male Vorta Borath oversaw the Dominion research and development divisions.

name: Varen'agor
lore: Jem'Hadar Third previously assigned to the Dominion relay station on Callinon VII. Administrator Kilana's pilot on several key missions.

name: Prosar
lore: Typical Ferengi trade route manager. Secretly an informant for the FCA. He visited DS9 in 2370 to observe the wormhole. Played tongo at Quark's.

name: Colyus
lore: Village protector investigating recent disappearances but unable to produce results. Unaware that he, and his cloak, are holograms.

name: Croden
lore: Inexperienced Rakhari thief who spoke out against his government. Moved to Vulcan with his daughter, Yareth. Carries a morphogenic locket.

name: Laas
lore: Changeling of great ability. One of the Hundred sent by the Founders to explore the galaxy. Dislikes monoforms. Linked with Odo. Occasionally fiery.

name: Merruk
lore: Representative of holograms unaware of their projected nature. Physician and scientist of his small community. Has few patients.

name: Rurigan
lore: Yaderan chased off his homeworld by the Dominion. Holographically recreated it and its inhabitants on another planet. Very fond of his creations.

name: Taya
lore: Yaderan "granddaughter" of Rurigan's imagination. Hologram who banded with the changeling Odo. Almost ventured too far from the village.

name: Selan
lore: Typical Romulan scientist serving the Tal Shiar. He programmed an optimal bombardment dispersal pattern to destroy the Founders.

name: Dosi Trade Vessel
lore: Standard commerce ship used by the Dosi. Uses a similar hull design as the ships of the Karemma, but equipped with better weaponry.

name: Jem'Hadar Troopship
lore: Support vessel rebuilt for the mass transit of soldiers for ground operations. Shares basic design framework with other Dominion ships.
game_text: RANGE and SHIELDS +1 for each Jem'Hadar aboard (limit 3).

name: U.S.S. Mekong
lore: Scout vessel commanded by Odo during a mission to find Enabran Tain. Subsequently captured and carried into the Gamma Quadrant aboard the Serrola.
game_text: Rescue Personnel

name: Ferengi Freighter
lore: After the discovery of the Bajoran Wormhole, the Ferengi Alliance optimized their vessels for new trade opportunities.
game_text: Attributes all +1 in Gamma Quadrant.

name: Serrola
lore: Flagship commanded by Enabran Tain and Lovok. Led a Tal Shiar-Obsidian Order flotilla tasked to destroy the Founders and thereby collapse the Dominion.
game_text: Attributes all +2 in Gamma Quadrant.

name: Wardroom
game_text: Gamma Quadrant Non-Aligned personnel may report here, ignoring their Gamma Quadrant icon (or download here in place of a normal card play; player draws no cards that turn). Once each turn, one such personnel may report here for free if you have 2 V.I.P. here (or personnel of two different affiliations). Matching V.I.P. personnel may file mission reports here.

name: Orb of Prophecy and Change
lore: Third of the nine mysterious energy vortices called Tears of the Prophets by the Bajorans. Grants visions of the future. Only Orb not stolen by Cardassians during the occupation.
game_text: Use as Equipment card. Once each turn, you may glance at the top card of your draw deck. Insert it anywhere within your draw deck if you wish. (Not duplicatable.)

name: A Bad End
lore: Shot in the chest by the Lenarians, Jean-Luc Picard's life was left hanging in the balance due to the damage his artificial heart received.
game_text: Kills half of your "stopped" personnel at this location (your choice, round up). To get past requires 2 Biology.

name: A Good Day to Lie
lore: Duras, Son of Ja'rod, constructed a web of lies to hide his father's treacherous actions at Khitomer. Worf and his cha'DIch eventually uncovered the truth.
game_text: To get past requires 3 Diplomacy OR 3 Treachery. If a Klingon Treachery personnel in play, opponent may then download Duras to anywhere at this location.

name: Ancient Computer
lore: Control systems degrade over time. The Oracle of the People, a computer that guided the asteroid-like Yonada for millennia, required repairs after experiencing a malfunction.
game_text: Cannot get past unless 2 Computer Skill OR 3 SCIENCE OR 3 ENGINEER present.

name: Crew Advancement
lore: In some cultures, such as the Terran Empire, promotions are often achieved by the forced removal of one's superiors.
game_text: Opponent names an attribute. Crew or Away Team members with highest printed value of that attribute are "stopped." (In case of ties, "stops" all tied personnel.)

page_title: Don't Let It End This Way (HF6)
name: Don’t Let It End This Way
base_name: Don’t Let It End This Way
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: Two assassins boarded Kronos One, slaughtering any crew in their path and fatally wounding Chancellor Gorkon. Gorkon's final words begged Kirk to continue the peace initiative.
game_text: Kills half of your "stopped" personnel at this location (your choice, round up). To get past requires 2 SECURITY.

name: Frame of Mind
lore: William T. Riker was tortured using neurosomatic techniques and left unable to tell whether he was in a mental institution or a play set in a mental institution.
game_text: One personnel present (random selection) now becomes Non-Aligned with attributes of 3-3-3 and only two skills (opponent's choice). Cure with 3 Empathy present.

name: History Repeats Itself
lore: The Melkotians, a race of xenophobic telepaths, could project powerful hallucinations into the minds of trespassers in their territory, drawn from the historical images in their minds.
game_text: Randomly select three personnel (or six personnel if more than nine personnel present). If any of those personnel has Anthropology, all of them are "stopped."

name: It's Green
lore: The crew of the Starship Enterprise used distraction to regain control of their ship from the Kelvans. Mr. Scott, in fine naval tradition, put his stash of alcoholic beverages to good use.
game_text: Randomly select three personnel (or six personnel if more than nine personnel present). If any of those personnel has ENGINEER, all of them are "stopped."

name: Justice or Vengeance
lore: Tuvok performed a mindmeld on Lon Suder hoping to give a sense of order, but received homicidal rage in return.
game_text: Unless 2 SECURITY and Anthropology OR Honor, Exobiology, and INTEGRITY>32, opponent chooses: kills one Treachery personnel (random selection) OR kills two Delta Quadrant personnel (random selection).

name: Lack of Preparation
lore: An Away Team that is unprepared to complete its mission will undoubtedly experience delays. Mission progress may be impossible until additional personnel arrive.
game_text: Non-Borg: Cannot get past (lose 10 points) unless you could have met mission requirements at start of attempt. Borg: Must have Communications, Navigation and Defense personnel to proceed.

name: Malfunctioning Door
lore: After a Gatherer raid in 2366, the superior strength of the Soong-type android Data was needed to force open a sealed compartment and rescue the wounded survivors.
game_text: To get past requires a Soong-Type android OR STRENGTH>27 from up to four personnel.

name: Occipational Hazards
lore: In politics, mysterious gifts should be handled with care. A bottle of poisoned kanar may have no effect on Vorta but would have been fatal to Tekeny Ghemor.
game_text: Unless 2 Greed OR 2 Treachery OR CUNNING>45, one personnel (random selection) is killed.

name: Primitive Culture
lore: First contact requires caution, subterfuge or force. In the Mirror Universe, Terran aggression could cause first contact situations to go disastrously wrong.
game_text: To get past, requires 3 Vulcans OR Anthropology and CIVILIAN OR Vorta and 4 Jem'Hadar OR 2 Tal Shiar OR 2 Obsidian Order OR Acquisition and 2 Greed OR 6 Klingons OR 4 Defense Borg.

name: Q
lore: Incorrigible, extra-dimensional member of the Q Continuum, a race of omnipotent beings. Q exhibits a child-like petulance and sense of playfulness.

name: Seismic Quake
lore: Artificially-induced tremors on Ventax II led the natives to believe the end of their world was nigh. Geordi La Forge and the science team stationed there proved otherwise.
game_text: One Away Team member (random selection) is "stopped" if opponent's score is odd, killed otherwise. Cannot get past (shuffle back into seeds cards here) unless Geology present.

name: Shields Up!
lore: When unknown threats appear, priority is immediately placed on defensive systems and evasive actions.
game_text: To get past, "stop" a SECURITY personnel (random selection). If that personnel has Astrophysics or Stellar Cartography or Navigation, randomly select two additional personnel to be "stopped".

name: Unorthodox Preservation
lore: Facing the impending loss of the Boraalan people and culture due to the atmospheric dissipation, Nikolai Rozhenko circumvented the Prime Directive to try and save them.
game_text: To get past requires 2 Anthropology OR a personnel with OFFICER and Empathy OR a staffed ship with a Holodeck here.

name: Alternate Universe Door
game_text: Place one on table during the seed phase. Door is now open, allowing your Alternate icon cards to enter play. OR Stock in deck and use as follows:Plays to nullify one Revolving Door or Subspace Schism. (Discard doorway.) OR Allows one ship to pass through Q-Net. (Discard doorway.) OR Nullify one Temporal Rift, and return doorway to your hand.

name: Holding Cell Door
game_text: Seeds (during facility phase) or plays on your ship or facility (except a Nor). Adds a Brig. OR Downloads Brainwash, Interrogation or Torture to a captive in your Brig, if you have Tal Shiar, Obsidian Order, Resistance or Section 31 (or a personnel who has SECURITY and Treachery) present; discard doorway or place atop draw deck. OR Nullifies any card closing another Holding Cell Door; discard doorway.

name: A Second Chance at Life
lore: Q gave Jean-Luc Picard the opportunity to change the reckless mistakes of his youth and live a life free from danger.
game_text: Discard a non-personnel card from hand to report a personnel from your discard pile. Discard event.

name: Cellular Peptide Cake
lore: With mint frosting.

name: Defiant Dedication Plaque
lore: To maintain morale after the loss of the U.S.S. Defiant in 2375, Starfleet granted special dispensation to change its successor's name from U.S.S. Sao Paulo to U.S.S. Defiant.
game_text: Plays on table. Each of your ships with its matching commander aboard is RANGE +2, or +3 if ship is Defiant class. (Not cumulative. Captain's Order.)

name: Holo-ProjectorsTactical Scan
lore: The holographic projector at the center of the Yaderan settlement founded by Rurigan is an example of planet-based interactive holographic technology.

name: Line of Defense
lore: The threat of continued Dominion advances caused Starfleet to commit many ships and resources to the protection of Federation territory.
game_text: Plays on table. Your ships are SHIELDS +3 while at missions with matching affiliation icons.

name: Raktajino
lore: The stimulating Klingon coffee is a staple of Jadzia Dax's morning routine. She isn't awake until she's had her first cup.
game_text: Plays to make a unique personnel attributes +2 until end of turn OR shuffle the bottom three personnel and/or ships from your discard pile into your draw deck. Discard event.

page_title: Where No One Has Gone Before (HF6)
name: Where No One Has Gone Before
base_name: Where No One Has Gone Before
lore: The Traveler transcends space with thought. Took the U.S.S. Enterprise to Galaxy M-33, then to an even greater extragalactic distance.

name: Bajoran Outpost
lore: The Bajoran homeworld is Bajor. The Bajorans establish outposts throughout their territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Bajoran ENGINEER.

name: Borg Outpost
lore: Identification: BORG OUTPOSTTask: Distribute resources in specified unimatirx.
game_text: Seed one at any Space mission with no affiliation icons OR build at such a mission (or at an assimilated planet) where you have a Borg ENGINEER. Download Transwarp Network Gateway.

name: Cardassian Outpost
lore: Cardassia Prime is the homeworld of the Cardassians. The Cardassian Union establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Cardassian ENGINEER.

name: Dominion Outpost
lore: The homeworld of the Founders of the Dominion is shrouded in mystery. The Dominion establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Dominion ENGINEER.

name: Federation Outpost
lore: Earth is a member of the United Federation of Planets. The Federation establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Federation ENGINEER.

name: Terran Outpost
lore: Hidden enclave and meeting place for the Terran rebels of the mirror universe.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Terran Empire ENGINEER. May be seeded or built at Terran Hideout if no headquarters there.

name: Ferengi Outpost
lore: Ferenginar is a rainy, soggy homeworld of the highly capitalistic Ferengi people. The Ferengi Alliance establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Ferengi ENGINEER.

name: Hirogen Outpost
lore: For 100,000 years, the nomadic Hirogen have hunted prey, establishing outposts throughout their territory.
game_text: Seed one at a Hirogen mission or any Space mission with no affiliation icons OR build at such mission where you have a Hirogen ENGINEER. Has a holodeck. Download Hirogen Hunt

name: Kazon Outpost
lore: Since losing its homeworld, the Kazon Collective raids others, establishing outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one at a Kazon Mission or Non-Aligned mission OR build at such a mission where you have a Kazon ENGINEER. Has no transporters. Download The Kazon Collective

name: Klingon Empire Outpost
lore: In the mirror universe, the Klingon Empire is a member of the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. The Alliance establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Klingon Cardassian Alliance ENGINEER.

name: Klingon Outpost
lore: The Klingon Homeworld is Qo'noS. The Klingon Empire establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Klingon ENGINEER.

name: Romulan Outpost
lore: Romulus is one of the two homeworlds for the Romulans. The Romulan Star Empire establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Romulan ENGINEER.

name: Vidiian Outpost
lore: The Vidiian Sodality establishes outposts throughout its territory, often hiding them inside barren planetoids.
game_text: Seed one at a Vidiian Mission or Non-Aligned mission OR build at such a mission where you have a Vidiian ENGINEER. Download The Vidiian Sodality

name: Call for Reinforcements
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once per game, in place of your normal card play, you may download a Universal ship. Once per game, in place of your normal card play, you may fully repair your ship if you have a matching facility (or compatible Nor) in play.

name: Continuing Mission
game_text: Seeds one on table. You may download one Warp Core card. Your personnel and ships that have a Star Trek: The Next Generation or Star Trek: Generations property logo gain TNG (even if not in play). Once each turn, when you play a TNG personnel with four or fewer Skill Dot icons (and no Download), you may draw a card. Discard this incident if you play (or have played) a non-TNG personnel or ship.

name: New Arrivals
game_text: Seeds on table. Once each turn, you may place a Universal personnel you do not already have in play for free. End of each turn, you may draw an extra card. Discard incident if you play more than one personnel for free on any turn.

name: Reshape the Quadrant
game_text: Seed one on table. You may download one Reactor Core card. Your Nors, personnel, and ships that have a Star Trek: Deep Space Nine property logo gain DS9 (even if not in play). Discard incident if your play (or have played) a non-DS9 personnel or ship.

name: Escape Pod
lore: Most vessels carry escape pods to save the crew in an emergency. In 2153, Jonathan Archer used one on a Klingon vessel to escape his captors.

name: Assassination Attempt
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: A plot to maintain military tensions between the Klingons and the Federation targeted key personnel for elimination.
game_text: Opponent may download an assassin here. Unless Transporter Skill and a personnel with INTEGRITY>7 OR a personnel with SECURITY x2 present OR no assassin on planet, one personnel is killed (random selection).

name: Buried Alive
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
lore: With the Starship Enterprise powerless to help, Khan left Admiral Kirk as Kirk had left him: marooned for eternity.

name: Climbing the Ranks
lore: Chief Navigator Chekov attempted to advance his standing on the I.S.S. Enterprise by assassinating James Tiberius Kirk, who had himself eliminated Captain Pike.
game_text: Kills the highest STRENGTH OFFICER personnel present who does not have Leadership. To get past requires STRENGTH>24 remaining.

name: Disgraceful Assault
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: Surprise attacks and boarding parties, such as the incident orchestrated by Valeris and General Chang in 2293, can wreak havoc on unsuspecting vessels.
game_text: Opponent may Tactic Draw (or Tactic Draw if they have an Objective in point area). Unless 2 SECURITY and Transporter Skill present, one personnel (opponent's choice) is killed. Discard dilemma.

name: DNA Security Scan
lore: To deter tampering with its deadly mission, the Dreadnought's security systems included an identity check of anyone boarding the vessel.
game_text: To get past, must have 2 ENGINEER, 2 Computer Skill, and CUNNING>15X. X=number of Objective cards in opponent's discard pile (limit 6). Nullify with Scan Cycle Check.

name: Ensure Their Silence
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: Valeris eliminated her co-conspirators, Burke and Samno. "The first rule of assassination: kill the assassins."
game_text: One personnel (random selection) is killed. If opponent's infiltrator attempting, two more personnel (random selection) are killed and one such infiltrator (owner's choice) is exposed.

name: Explosive Decompression
lore: Though most starships are outfitted with emergency forcefields in the event of a hull breach, there is unfortunately a slight delay before they can be activated.
game_text: Kills X personnel (random selection), where X=number of opponent's Universal Space missions with point boxes. If >9 personnel remain, opponent may Tactic Download.

name: Exposed Power Relay
lore: When advanced technology is damaged, the power flowing through these systems can instead arc through adjacent walls and across passageways.
game_text: X personnel (random selection) are "stopped," where X=number of opponent's missions showing 25 points or less. Cannot get past if >9 personnel remain.

name: Eye to Eye
lore: When Kira Nerys encountered her doppelganger from the mirror universe, they were both taken aback by not only their similarities but also their differences.
game_text: Player with the most cards in hand chooses two personnel to be stopped. If tied, cannot get past.

name: Face to Face
lore: After encountering a quantum duplicate of herself and the U.S.S. Voyager crew, Kathryn Janeway worked with her doppelganger to try to prevent further death or damage.
game_text: Player with the least points chooses one personnel to be killed. If tied, ship is damaged and stopped until end of next turn.

name: Head to Head
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: When the Chameloid Martia took the form of Captain Kirk on Rura Penthe, the warden of the penal colony was unsure who was the escapee and who was the doppelganger.
game_text: Player with most points chooses a personnel to be killed. If tied, two personnel killed (random selection) and Away Team stopped until end of next turn.

name: One to One
lore: Thomas Riker, a transporter duplicate of William T. Riker, resented his doppelganger's authority and superior rank, and viewed him as a rival for the affections of Deanna Troi.
game_text: Each player reveals a personnel from hand (if none, CUNNING=0). Highest CUNNING scores points, others lose points. Cannot get past if tie.

name: Pursuit Just Behind
lore: While investigating mysterious positronic signatures, Jean-Luc Picard and his crew were forced to flee from attacking natives.
game_text: Kills X personnel (random selection), where X=number of opponent's Universal Planet missions with point boxes. If >9 personnel remain, destroys three Equipment present.

name: Rules of Obedience
lore: Overseer Odo's strict enforcement of order in the Ore Processing unit made life dangerous for any slave that stepped out of line.
game_text: Personnel with highest INTEGRITY OR fewest Skill Dot icons is killed (opponent's choice). To get past requires Geology and 2 Honor OR 2 SECURITY and 2 Treachery OR Smiley.

name: Tedious Soiree
lore: With Worf already excused, the remaining senior officers of the U.S.S. Enterprise were required to attend Calvin Hutchinson's formal reception on Arkaria.
game_text: Opponent names a classification or a subcommand icon. All but one personnel with that classification or icon (your choice) are stopped. Nullify by any Incoming Message.

name: Temptations of the Flesh
lore: To further the Collective's attempts to stop first contact and take over the U.S.S. Enterprise-E, the Borg Queen attempted to seduce Data by offering him a sensual tactile experience.
game_text: One personnel is stopped (random selection) for each objective in play (limit 5). To get past requires Command OR Enterprise-E OR any Queen.

name: Pride of the Fleet
lore: Klingons revel at their culture's prowess in battle. A mighty flagship embodies their power and dominance.
game_text: Seeds or plays on your Negh'Var-class ship. If, at end of turn, ship is staffed, undocked, uncloaked, and no other uncloaked ship in quadrant has higher WEAPONS, draw an extra card.

name: Rebellious Servants
lore: Although not technically slaves, Mr. Sisko and his crew spent their lives doing the Intendant's bidding. With Julian Bashir's influence, they rebelled, costing the Alliance bitterly.
game_text: Download different Mirror Quadrant Non-Aligned human and/or Vulcan personnel with up to 7 total Skill Dot icons to your Mirror Quadrant facility. Discard event (lose points).

name: Resistance Tactics
lore: Insurgents and guerilla fighters often use unorthodox techniques to keep larger enemy forces off-balance.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Discard event to cancel just-initiated battle involving your Resistance, Maquis, or DS9 Terran Empire personnel.

page_title: The Best of a Bad Life (CR)
name: The Best of a Bad Life
base_name: The Best of a Bad Life
lore: Having carved out an existence for himself and his crew better than most under the Alliance, Mr. Sisko was satisfied he hade made his contribution to improve the lives of Terrans.
game_text: Return up to two Non-Aligned KCA cards from your discard pile to hand. Discard event. OR Plays on table. Your Non-Aligned KCA personnel are attributes all +1 (Cumulative.)

name: Treaty: The Alliance
lore: In the mirror universe, the Cardassian Union and the Klingon Empire united with other smaller powers to take advantage of the peaceful reforms of the Terran Empire.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your KCA cards may mix and cooperate, and your KCA leaders may use your KCA ships. Your KCA leaders may attempt Klingon mission and Cardassian mission missions.

name: Warrior's Birthright
lore: A Klingon proverb holds that "if a warrior does not fight, he does not breathe."
game_text: Plays on your mission. Your Klingon, Kazon, Hirogen, Terran Empire, and KCA personnel may contribute their STRENGTH instead towards INTEGRITY and CUNNING requirements of mission, and dilemmas here.

name: Alliance Outpost
lore: In the mirror universe, the Cardassian Union is a member of the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. The Alliance establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a KCA ENGINEER.

name: An Important Victory
game_text: Plays on table. Once each turn, your DS9 Federation Terran Empire personnel reporting to Terran Empire Mirror Terok Nor may do so for free. Contain Boarding Parties may seed or play there. You may ignore the point box of Rebellious Servants when played as your normal card play. Nullified if you play or have seeded Terran Rebellion HQ.

name: Expert Pilot
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your unique ships with a personnel with Navigation x2 aboard are RANGE +2, are immune to Loss of Orbital Stability and Outgunned, and may download Evasive Maneuvers. When you complete a space mission, you may download Space Boomer. Doubles skill requirements of each Fly by the Seat of Your Pants.

name: Plenty of Captains
game_text: Plays on table; you may download A Safe Place to Hide. Your Terran Empire personnel lose KCA (even if not in play). Your DS9Terran Empire personnel and ships may report to any Mirror Quadrant Badlands Region Planet mission; once each turn, one such Federation or Non-Aligned personnel may do so for free. Nullfied if you seeded Mirror Terok Nor.

name: Taking Charge
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your personnel at a non-homeworld mission with an objective on it are attributes all +1. Once each turn, if your Admiral, General, Captain, Colonel, Gul, Legate, DaiMon, Maje, Alpha-Hirogen, or Jem'Hadar First is at your mission, you may download an objective onto that mission.

name: The Regent's Flagship
game_text: Plays on table; download Regency 1. Your KCA personnel lose Terran Empire (even if not in play). Your KCA personnel may report aboard Regency 1; once each turn, one such DS9Cardassian or DS9Klingon personnel may do so for free. In place of your normal card play, you may download a non-Non-AlignedKCA leader (once per game per affiliation). Nullified if you seeded Mirror Terok Nor.

name: Tinkerer
game_text: Plays on table. Once each turn, may "stop" your non-Borg personnel ENGINEER personnel to choose one: fully repair your ship or facility they are aboard (limit once per game) OR shuffle any number of non-hand weapon equipment from your discard pile into your deck OR discard an equipment present to download an ENGINEER-related equipment there.

name: You Can't Kill the Captain
game_text: Plays on table. At the start of each of your turns, your DS9 Federation Terran Empire personnel with the highest INTEGRITY (your choice if tie) gains V.I.P. until end of turn. When your DS9Terran Empirepersonnel dies, you may place them here. (Personnel here are not in play). Once each turn, you may discard a card from here to give one of your DS9Terran Empirepersonnel any skill until end of turn.

name: Shrouded Assailant
lore: In what he called a sacred moment, a member of the Pah-wraith cult stabbed Benjamin Sisko on Earth in 2375.
game_text: Once every turn, plays on your Treachery personnel using a blade weapon to kill one other personnel present (random selection) OR Nullifies Handshake.

name: Conduct Crossover Operation
lore: Bajor Region ● Near Derna: Seek and retrieve resources from opposite quadrant.
game_text: [none]

name: Enlistment Drive
lore: Remote colony: Recruit troops for conflict between the Alliance and the rebels.
game_text: [none]

name: Examine Disappearance Site
lore: Spatial interphase: Study remnant of trans-dimensional event in Tholian-annexed space.
game_text: [none]

name: Investigate Intrusion
lore: Bajor Region ● Denorios Belt: Evaluate threat posed by ship after sudden appearance.
game_text: [none]

name: Observe Alliance Operations
lore: Qu'Vat: Spy on Klingon/Cardassian Alliance military activity on outlying colony.
game_text: [none]

name: Oppress Population
game_text: [none]

name: Replenish Workforce
lore: Sector 001 Region ● Luna: Gather slave laborers from Terran colony.
game_text: When you solve, may download a KCA human here.

name: Secure Supply Lines
lore: Tellarite cargo lane: Re-establish Terran Empire trade route
game_text: [none]

name: Seek Knowledge Cache
lore: Badlands Region ● Class-M planetoid: Search for information hidden by former emperor.
game_text: [none]

name: Test Warship
lore: Bajor Region ● Near Bajor: Determinate battle capabilities of new warship.
game_text: * +5 points if Defiant or Regency 1 here when solved.

name: A Safe Place to Hide
game_text: Plays on table. While on the table, you may discard a card from hand to place this objective on your unsolved non-homeworld Mirror Quadrant mission. While on a mission, at the end of your turn, if your staffed Terran Empire ship at this mission is undocked, uncloaked, and not landed, you may draw an additional card. When this mission is completed, return this objective to table. (Unique.)

name: Emotional Blackmail
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; download Brainwash to a captive escorted by your Mirror Quadrant personnel at a non-Mirror Quadrant mission; captive does not relocate to an outpost. When that personnel helps you complete a Mirror Quadrant mission, you may discard objective and Brainwash to score points (captive is released and relocated to opponent's facility).

name: Evaluate Starship Systems
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. At any time, place on your Defiant, I.K.S. Negh'Var, or ship with "prototype" in lore; ship is attributes all +1 for each of your missions with "Test" in title and each of your objectives played on a mission (limit +4). When ship's crew completes a mission with "Test" in title or a mission with an objective on it, discard this objective to score points and draw 3 cards.

name: Historic Coming Together
game_text: Seeds or plays on your Mirror Quadrant planet mission. Nullified if you attempt with <5 (or >9) personnel. Just after you start a mission attempt here, if mission is unexamined, you may draw X cards, where X=the number of different affiliations among your DS9KCA personnel involved. If X>2, discard objective to score points. Otherwise, place objective out of play.

name: Process Ore: Mining
game_text: Seeds or plays on your non-homeworld Planet mission. Adds Geology to requirements. Start of each turn, while you have no facility here, you non-Borg Geology personnel present and unopposed may "process ore": discard one non-Referee card from hand, place bottom non-Referee card of discard pile in point area (worth 1 point), then draw one card (or two if 2 Geology present).

name: Raid Opposite Quadrant
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. At any time, place on your Mirror Quadrant ship docked at a Mirror Quadrant facility. If ship's crew or Away Team completes a mission in another quadrant, then ship returns and docks at that facility, you may discard objective to download up to two Equipment cards OR one "use as Equipment" artifact (as if earned) here.

name: Reap All the Glory
game_text: Seeds or plays on your space mission; it may be attempted by your crew with at least fourTerran Empire personnel. YourTerran Empire ships here are SHIELDS +2. When you solve missions with such a crew, score 5 points and relocate objective to table; yourTerran Empireships are attributes all +1.

name: Bor Kaffe
lore: Representative of loyal commandos serving The Intendant. Assisted in Mr. Quark's execution in 2370. Desires a greater role for Bajor in the Alliance.

name: Jalota Mar
lore: Typical ore processing technician. Served under Overseer Odo. Occasionally deputized by station security during emergencies on Terok Nor.

name: The Intendant
lore: Resourceful prisoner, seductress, and assassin. Kira Nerys left a trail of bodies behind while escaping her rebel captors. Misses her milk baths.

name: Merdan
lore: Representative of Terok Nor security officers under Security Chief Garak. Assisted the Intendant with her pursuit of Terran rebels in 2371.

name: Trepar
lore: Typical cultural attaché and legal expert. Discredited former legate trying to regain power by allying with Regent Worf. Rival of Security Chief Garak.

name: Ahanu
lore: One of many Terrans who joined the Rebellion against the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. Formerly part of Mr. Sisko's crew of mercenaries.

name: Al Vermont
lore: Typical Terran rebel. Tests innovative battlefield medicine techniques on wounded soldiers. Assisted Mr. Sisko on several key missions.

name: Banya
lore: Typical member of the Rebellion. Half Terran, half Betazoid friend of Captain Bashir. Has studied military history since joining the rebels.

name: Mr. Sisko
lore: Benjamin Sisko changed his mind and began the rebellion against the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. Terran captain married to Professor Sisko.

name: Professor Sisko
lore: Terran rebel scientist from a family of collaborators. Visited Benjamin Sisko in 2372. She kidnapped Jake Sisko to lure his father to the mirror universe.

name: Sarah Shaw
lore: Freedom fighter in the Terran Rebellion. One of many crewmembers aboard the Defiant in 2372. Fights to end Alliance oppression of her people.

name: Stoichkov
lore: Typical rebel who assisted in the construction of the Defiant. Struggled to calibrate the power system. Terran quartermaster and cook.

name: Nizari
lore: Humanoid dabo girl. Moved to Bajor after the Terran occupation. Works for Mr. Nog, but forced to covertly feed information to Security Chief Garak.

name: Nizari
lore: Humanoid dabo girl. Moved to Bajor after the Terran occupation. Works for Mr. Nog, but forced to covertly feed information to Security Chief Garak.

name: Captain Lursa
lore: Lursa is the sister of Captain B'Etor. Squadron commander serving under Regent Worf. Embraces the equal opportunities offered by the Alliance.

name: Nu'Tal
lore: Klingon captain who mistook Kira Nerys for the Intendant. Reported the incident to Security Chief Garak. Klingon opera soloist.

name: Regent Worf
lore: Hands-on general. Wishes to dispose of the rebels himself. Worf wished to acquire a cloaking device and more Hupyrian beetle snuff.

name: Errol
lore: Typical male Terran slave. Discussed grooming tips with a man posing as Mr. Sisko in 2371. Envious of Ezri's freedom but can't refuse the Intendant.

name: Guron
lore: Giant Terran mercenary and bodyguard who worked as part of Mr. Sisko's crew. Poor dabo player. Later joined the rebellion against the Alliance.

name: Marauder
lore: Typical Terran member of Mr. Sisko's crew. Hates the Alliance for causing the death of his wife. Despite a love for danger, declined a knife fight with Telok.

name: McKay
lore: Representative of Terran slaves who process ore on Terok Nor. Freed by Smiley in 2371. Abandoned his Alliance designation and adopted his birth name again.

name: Selot
lore: Typical Vulcan servant of the Intendant aboard Terok Nor. Trained nurse and masseuse, he secretly provides intelligence to the rebels.

name: Smiley
lore: Terran slave Miles O'Brien was named and inspired by Mr. Sisko. "Fixer" favored by the Intendant. Repaired equipment for Overseer Odo.

name: V'mor
lore: Male Vulcan hairstylist aboard Terok Nor. Encourages the Intendant to position herself as a fashion trendsetter in the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance.

name: Alliance Freighter
lore: Typical supply vessel used by the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. Moderately armed to defend against pirates and other raiders.

name: Mr. Sisko's Interceptor
lore: Commanded by Mr. Sisko. Used as a privateer for the Intendant. Later used as a raider for the Terran Rebellion.
game_text: May take off or land once each turn. X=3 vs. Klingon/Cardassian Alliance

name: Mr. Sisko's Interceptor
lore: Commanded by Mr. Sisko. Used as a privateer for the Intendant. Later used as a raider for the Terran Rebellion.
game_text: May take off or land once each turn. X=3 vs. Klingon/Cardassian Alliance

name: Ya'Vang
lore: Alliance warship captained by Nu'Tal on patrol in the Bajoran sector. Investigated the mysterious appearance of a damaged ship near Terok Nor.
game_text: X=1 in a region.

name: The Intendant's Quarters
game_text: The Intendant, KCA Vulcans, and any personnel who mentions The Intendant as a romantic partner may report here. Personnel who mention The Intendant in lore may file reports here. Once each turn a player may stop their The Intendant and another personnel present to draw one card. While station hasTerran Empire, The Intendant's Quarters are suspended.

page_title: A Fast Ship Would Be Nice (CRS)
name: A Fast Ship Would Be Nice
base_name: A Fast Ship Would Be Nice
lore: The mirror universe version of Bareil Antos unexpectedly beamed aboard Deep Space 9 and took Kira Nerys hostage. He demanded a ship in exchange for her life.
game_text: Kills one personnel (opponent's choice). You may substitute a bodyguard or Guard Drone present OR an empty ship here (moved to opponent's side of spaceline; commandeered).

name: Distraction
lore: "You aren't very persistent, Mr. Sulu. The game has rules; you're ignoring them. I protest... and you come back. You didn't... come... back."
game_text: One male or female present (random selection) "distracts" a personnel of the opposite gender (opponent's choice). If neither has Honor, both are "stopped."

name: Emergency Conversion
lore: With the field density between the mirror universe and their own closing quickly, Mr. Scott and Dr. McCoy rushed to complete modifications to the transporters.
game_text: To get past requires 2 Astrophysics and Transporter Skill.

name: Strict Dress Code
lore: If the holographic maître d' hadn't delayed the Borg, they would have killed Jean-Luc Picard before he could have completed his plan.
game_text: Sacrifice one Diplomacy, one Hologram or two Defense personnel present (killed); otherwise, one personnel present is killed (opponent's choice). Mission continues.

name: Bajoran Wormhole: Mirror Universe
game_text: Seeds (in any phase) or plays in Mirror Quadrant. Limit one. Inserts into spaceline to create a Bajor Region location (span 1); any player may download Bajoran Wormhole. Any ship may move between here and another Bajoran Wormhole if damaged or if ENGINEER and SCIENCE aboard, then is "stopped." OR Plays at any time to nullify any card which is closing or destroying Bajoran Wormhole (discard doorway).

name: Agonizer
lore: Pain-inflicting device developed by the Terran Empire. Fear of punishment drives crew members to maintain maximum efficiency at all times. Ensures alertness, loyalty, and obedience.
game_text: Where present, each of your Mirror Quadrant personnel and Original Series Klingons is INTEGRITY and CUNNING +1. (Cumulative up to +3.)

name: Mirror Dagger
lore: Small blade weapon used for personal protection. Ubiquitous in the mirror universe. Quite handy when an unexpected career-advancement opportunity presents itself.
game_text: Each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +1. (Cumulative.) May report to a Mirror Quadrant facility for free OR to a just-initiated personnel battle involving your Mirror Quadrant card(s).

name: Multidimensional Transport Device
lore: Modifies transporter function to allow beaming to an alternate universe. Developed in the mirror universe. Used by Smiley, Professor Sisko, the Intendant, and others to cross over.
game_text: Reports in Alpha or Mirror Quadrant. Twice each turn, where present, allows transporters to beam to opposite quadrant (anywhere at corresponding location), ignoring all SHIELDS.

name: Starfleet Phaser Pistol
lore: There are only two settings. Stun, and kill. Make sure to not get them mixed up.

name: Brainwash
lore: Geordi La Forge was mentally reprogrammed to do the Romulans' bidding by a machine that accessed his mind through his VISOR's direct neural implants.
game_text: Plays on one personnel you've captured. Captive reports to your outpost, is under your control and may mix with your personnel regardless of affiliation.

name: Crossover: An Invitation
lore: In 2372, the Terran Rebellion kidnapped Jake Sisko from Deep Space 9, knowing that Benjamin Sisko would promptly pursue his son to the mirror universe.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, your personnel native to the Alpha Quadrant may report (but not download) as if they were Mirror Quadrant.

name: Doppelganger
lore: On stardate 42679.2, the U.S.S. Enterprise encountered a duplicate of Jean-Luc Picard from six hours in the future. He was eventually killed by Jean-Luc Picard.
game_text: Plays on table. While in play, if a unique personnel moves to the same location as its duplicate, the duplicate is discarded unless Clone Machine in play.

name: Finally Ready to Swim
lore: "Today we're about to cross a new threshold. For nearly a century, we've waded ankle-deep in the ocean of space."
game_text: Seeds on table. Once every turn, when you play a 22nd Century card, you may draw a card. When you play a non-22nd Century personnel or ship, you must discard a card from hand.

name: Mirror Terok Nor (back)
lore: Cardassian ore processing facility controlled by the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance in the mirror universe.

name: Mirror Terok Nor (front)
lore: Cardassian ore processing facility commandeered by the Terran Rebellion in the mirror universe.

name: Agony Booth
game_text: Plays on your Mirror Quadrant ship. Once every turn, if ship, its crew or one of its Away Teams solve a mission or wins a battle against opponent's cards, you may draw up to three cards. But whenever they fail a mission attempt or fail to win such a battle, one of your personnel involved (random selection) must do nothing but return to ship (if not already aboard), then is "stopped."

name: Crossover
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, your Mirror Quadrant personnel may ignore their Mirror Quadrant icon when reporting OR just after you report Smiley, Benjamin SIsko, Professor Sisko, Jake Sisko, Bareil, The Intendant, Grand Nagus Zek, Maihar'du, Ezri, Rom, or Quark, you may download a Multidimensional Transport Device to that personnel (or vice versa, if you reported Device as your normal card play; discard incident).

name: Emblem of the Alliance
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; you may download The Art of Diplomacy. Your Klingon Cardassian Alliance cards, Grand Nagus Zek, Maihar'du, Rom, and Quark may mix and have no affiliation attack restrictions. Once each turn, you may report a Klingon Cardassian Alliance personnel for free if you have a Klingon Cardassian Alliance leader who names (or is named by) them in lore. Ore Processing Units on Mirror Quadrant Nors are immune to Reactor Overload if 2 ENGINEER present.

name: Emblem of the Empire
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; you may download The Art of Diplomacy. YourTerran Empirecards, Benjamin Sisko, Jake Sisko, Rom, and Quark may mix and have no affiliation attack restrictions. YourTerran Empirefacilities and staffed ships are immunne to Nvigate Plasma Storms. Ore Processing Unit on Mirror Terok Nor is immune to Reactor Overload if 2 ENGINEER present, and may Process Ore while under Federation control.

name: The Art of Diplomacy
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Mirror Quadrant, Maquis, Resistance and Orion Syndicate personnel who are using a hand weapon may use 2 Treachery as if it were 1 Diplomacy (ignoring reductions from rifles) and, once each turn, may place incident out-of-play to kill one other personnel present. Once per game, you may discard incident to download one hand weapon to one of your personnel who has 2 Treachery.

name: Transporter Mixup
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. (Unique). If up to four of your personnel are beaming up from a planet in their native quadrant, you may replace (discard) them by downloading an equal number of others to complete the transport. Each Universal personnel may be replaced by any Universal personnel native to opposite quadrant; others may be replaced only by opposite versions of their personas. Discard incident.

name: Automated Repair Station
lore: Tellarite cargo lane: Repair severe damage at automated facility.
game_text: Solving player may download and use Spacedock here.

name: Mine Dilithium
lore: Halkan Planet: Replenish dilithium supply from world conquered decades ago.
game_text: Solving player's ships are RANGE +1.

name: Search for Weapons
lore: Demilitarized Zone Region ● Border planet: Search planet for illegal Maquis arms cache.
game_text: May seed hand weapons under here.

name: Test Mission
lore: Praxillus System: Provide aid for a helium ignition project attempting to revitalize dying sun.

name: Test Propulsion Systems
lore: Remote sector: Test upgrades to faster-than-light drive components.
game_text: Solving player's ships are RANGE +2. (Cumulative).

name: Straight and Steady
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. When your 22nd Century card is attacked, you may discard objective to make each 22nd Century card involved attributes all +5 until the end of that battle. At the end of your opponent's turn, you may discard objective to move your 22nd Century ship one spaceline location toward your homeworld or facility. (Unique. Captain's Order.)

name: Javek Len
lore: One of many Bajoran nationals living aboard Terok Nor. The Intendant, quite a fan of his talents, often invites him to perform at special functions.

name: Odo
lore: Changeling security chief of Deep Space 9. Not very good at pretense. Always investigates Quark.

name: Overseer Odo
lore: The mirror version of Odo supervises ore processing on Terok Nor. Has strict rules of obedience. The only changeling his contemporaries have ever seen.

name: Romara Cal
lore: Typical of personal physicians employed by important Alliance officials. Assigned to the Intendant. Surprised at how frequently she comes in for an exam.

name: Taymar Bern
lore: Representative of security officers serving in the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. Part of the Intendant's elite assault team. Helped track down Professor Sisko.

name: Aramax
lore: Representative of Cardassians in the mirror universe. Strives to be noticed – without raising the ire of Security Chief Garak. Has done neither thus far.

name: Dorza
lore: Female Cardassian in the mirror universe. Science officer aboard Terok Nor. Occasionally keeps high-profile visitors under surveillance for the Intendant.

name: Overseer Mardel
lore: Overseer of ore processing on Terok Nor in the mirror universe. Less demanding than his predecessor, Overseer Odo, but just as hated by the Terran slaves.

name: Security Chief Garak
lore: Although the mirror-universe Elim Garak hates the Intendant, he is still able to please her now and then. Not Regent Worf's type.

name: Captain Bashir
lore: Hot-headed Terran rebel. Julian Bashir interrogated and tortured the Intendant. One of many "captains" fighting to overthrow the Alliance.

name: Captain Dax
lore: Aggressive, roguish Trill. Host to Dax symbiont. Once the mistress of Mr. Sisko, Jadzia Dax is now romantically involved with Captain Bashir.

name: Chief Navigator Chekov
lore: Ensign Chekov arranged an attack on his captain in the hopes of moving up in rank. Spent time in the I.S.S. Enterprise agony booth for his misguided ambition.

name: Chief Surgeon McCoy
lore: I.S.S. Enterprise chief medical officer. Dr. McCoy runs one of the most feared sickbays in the Empire. Never loses a subject before completing their interrogation.

name: Comm Officer Uhura
lore: Communications officer aboard the I.S.S. Enterprise. Lt. Uhura is the object of Security Chief Sulu's constant advances. Knows how to handle him.

name: Crewman Wilson
lore: Typical crewman on the I.S.S. Enterprise. Seeks any opportunity to be made an officer. Isn't likely to find one on Kirk's ship.

name: Ensign Davis
lore: Security guard aboard I.S.S. Enterprise. Easily dispatched by Dr. McCoy and Mr. Scott with the old "you distract him, I'll hit him with the hypo" trick.

name: Ensign Gaffney
lore: Dedicated crewman aboard I.S.S. Enterprise. Abandoned a promising career in the sciences for the greater advancement opportunities in security.

name: First Officer Spock
lore: ½ Vulcan, ½ human. History will record that Mr. Spock rose to command the I.S.S. Enterprise, then reformed the Empire and ultimately caused its downfall.

name: James Tiberius Kirk
lore: The ruthless Captain Kirk took command of the I.S.S. Enterprise by assassinating Captain Pike. Uses the deadly Tantalus Field to maintain his control.

name: Marauder
lore: Terran rebel who faithfully followed Mr. Sisko for many years. Lost an eye in a dangerous stunt.

name: Marlena Moreau
lore: The mirror version of Lt. Moreau is assigned to the I.S.S. Enterprise chem lab. Romantically involved with James Tiberius Kirk. Likes being a "captain's woman."

name: Mr. Andrews
lore: Former Terran slave on Terok Nor in the mirror universe. Liberated when the Rebellion seized control in 2372.

name: Mr. Tuvok
lore: Coldly logical soldier. In the mirror universe, the Vulcan Tvok fought for the Terran Rebellion.

name: Security Chief Sulu
lore: The mirror universe equivalent of Lt. Sulu is chief of security and second officer aboard I.S.S. Enterprise. Desires command of both the ship and Uhura.

name: Smiley
lore: Second leader of the Terran Rebellion. Miles O'Brien commanded the Defiant, which he helped construct using plans stolen from Deep Space 9.

name: Transporter Chief Kyle
lore: Transporter chief aboard the I.S.S. Enterprise. Lt. Kyle was punished by First Officer Spock for failing to compensate for a transporter malfunction in 2267.

name: Mr. Brunt
lore: Ferengi mercenary. Very good engineer and cook. Brunt is loyal to his partner, Ezri, with whom he is secretly infatuated. Unfortunately, he's not her type.

name: Mr. Nog
lore: Nog is thankful to the Intendant for making him the bartender and owner of his uncle's bar. Distrusts tall men. Likes tall women.

name: Mr. Quark
lore: Bartender who pretends to work for the Alliance. Quark secretly helps Terran slaves escape from Terok Nor.

name: Mr. Rom
lore: Ferengi soldier in the Terran Rebellion. The mirror version of Rom seeks vengeance against the Alliance.

name: Captain B'Etor
lore: B'Etor is the younger sister of Captain Lursa. Seeks to bring Security Chief Garak and The Intendant to trial for negligence and fraternizing with the enemy.

name: Korvek
lore: Typical section head in Regent Worf's crew. Frequent target of the Regent's temperamental outbursts. Finds being a bridge officer to be a mixed blessing.

name: Loreva
lore: Female Klingon representative of medical assistants throughout the Alliance. Sees very few patients, but has assisted in countless interrogations and autopsies.

name: Rukor
lore: Chief helmsman aboard Regency 1. Survivor of several Badlands expeditions in search of the rebel stronghold – more than any other pilot in the Alliance.

name: T'Vor
lore: Science officer in the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. Assigned to Terok Nor. Finds the station rife with gossip, backstabbing, and treachery. Likes it that way.

name: Telok
lore: Served for four years as a bodyguard in the house of Duras. Took a position aboard Terok Nor to escape the unpredictable demands of Lursa and B'Etor.

name: Vartoq
lore: First officer of the Alliance battle cruiser that intercepted Kira and Bashir's runabout when they first crossed over to the mirror universe.

name: 0413-Theta
lore: Typical Terran in the mirror universe. Caught trying to escape Terok Nor. Brought to the Intendant for sentencing by Security Chief Garak and Telok.

name: Ezri
lore: Trill mercenary in the mirror universe. Unlike Ezri Dax, this Ezri is not joined to a symbiont. Partners with Mr. Brunt. Romantically involved with the Intendant.

name: Mr. Sisko
lore: Afters years collecting duties for (and being romantically involved with) the Intendant, the mirror Benjamin Sisko became leader of the Terran Rebellion.

name: Professor Sisko
lore: Scientist who abandoned her work for the Alliance to join the Rebellion at the urging of Benjamin Sisko. Bonded with Jake, the son she would never have.

name: Alliance Galor
lore: Typical Cardassian warship in the mirror universe. Type 3 designation. Part of the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance fleet. Stationed at Terok Nor.

name: Defiant
lore: Constructed by the Terran Rebellion using station plans of the U.S.S. Defiant. Commanded by Benjamin Sisko during the defense of rebel-hold Terok Nor.

name: I.S.S. Constitution
lore: Typical battle cruiser of the Terran Empire. Outfitted for a variety of mission profiles, including conquest, domination, subjugation, and Imperial enforcement.
game_text: Download Any Universal Terran Empire Original Series personnel

name: I.S.S. Enterprise
lore: Imperial starship. Credited with many successful and profitable missions. I.S.S. Enterprise officers are frequently promoted - usually through assassination.
game_text: Download Any Terran Empire Original Series personnel

name: Rebel Interceptor
lore: Interceptor/fighter used by Terran rebels in the mirror universe. Typically stolen from the Bajorans. Smiley enhanced and commanded this one.
game_text: May take off or land once each turn. X=3 if moving within a region.

name: Alliance Vor'cha
lore: Fast and powerful battle cruiser. Backbone of the Alliance fleet. Their only weakness is in their targeting systems; they've been known to chase warp shadows.

name: Regency 1
lore: Massive flagship of the Klingon/Cardassian Alliance. Commanded by Regent Worf. Has a stolen cloaking device installed - and sabotaged - by Rom.
game_text: Download Stolen Cloaking Device

name: Halkan Council
game_text: Seeds or plays on table; any players may download one Mirror Quadrant Constitution-class ship here. Native to this timeline: all cards with both Original Series icon and Mirror Quadrant icon, and all Original Series Equipment cards. Once per turn, one such card reporting at this location may report for free.

name: A New Game
lore: After the Ferengi attempted to cheat him at dabo, Falow introduced Quark to the game of chula.
game_text: Opponent may download and seed here up to two Chula dilemmas (except The Chandra or The Game). Place on mission; one personnel (opponent's choice) is excluded from random selections of each Chula dilemma here.

name: Alien Abduction: Test Subjects
lore: In 2369, aliens from a tertiary subspace domain abducted crew members from the U.S.S. Enterprise. The crew used the holodeck to jog their memories of the incident.

name: Attractive Antiquities
lore: Quark auctioned off several Gamma Quadrant artifacts in 2369. One valuable item disrupted station operations and was sought by both DS9's crew and wealthy bidders alike.
game_text: To get past requires Acquisition and 2 Greed OR Honor, OFFICER, SECURITY, and INTEGRITY>20X, where X=number of opponent's Gold-Pressed Latinum in play (limit 3).

name: Between Duty and Respect
lore: While coordinating the evacuation of the Bajoran moon Jeraddo, Kira Nerys found herself sympathizing with the stubborn farmer Mullibok.
game_text: To get past requires Geology, Leadership, and OFFICER OR Honor, Archaeology, and SCIENCE (all requirements doubled if 4 or more Bajor Region missions in play).

name: Caretaker's Wave
lore: Causing heavy damage to the ships it encountered, the Caretaker used a displacement wave to bring vessels from all over the galaxy to his array.
game_text: Unless Astrophysics and Stellar Cartography OR 3 Navigation present, you choose: opponent may Tactic Draw Tactic Draw OR opponent may Tactic Draw and/or relocate ship to Caretaker’s Array.

name: Dangerous Derelict
lore: Neglected facilities often hold hidden dangers. According to standard Cardassian procedure, abandoned facilities like Empok Nor were booby-trapped to deter potential looters.
game_text: Opponent may download and seed here up to two Empok Nor-related dilemmas (except Friendly Fire or Ferengi Infestation).

name: Excluded
lore: A Vorta scenario shut Romulus out of treaty negotiations. T'Rul's protests terminated her further involvement.
game_text: For each affiliation present that does not include a V.I.P., one personnel of that affiliation is discarded (random selection), and others are stopped. Nullified if entire Away Team shares a faction icon. Discard dilemma.

name: Exe-Q-tioner
lore: To save her life in Q's recreation of Sherwood Forest, Vash reluctantly agreed to marry Sir Guy of Gisbourne.
game_text: Unless Treachery and INTEGRITY<29 OR CIVILIAN and INTEGRITY>49, one personnel (random selection) is killed and opponent re-seeds dilemma under a different unsolved mission.

name: Looking for Par'mach
lore: With help from Jadzia Dax and Worf, Quark rehearsed his Klingon seduction techniques, with successful results.
game_text: To get past requires a male and a female OR OFFICER and CUNNING>60. Opponent may then download and seed here up to two of the following: Distraction, Strange Bedfellows, Brief Romance, or Unexpected.

name: Misdirection
lore: A changeling disguised as Ambassador Krajensky nearly tricked the crew of the U.S.S. Defiant into starting a war.
game_text: Unless SECURITY, Exobiology, and any tricorder OR Section 31 OR Mindmeld OR a changeling present, play on table as Event: Your personnel present with an infiltrator are CUNNING -2.

name: Nausicaans: Pirates
lore: Brutal predators often target unprotected shipping lanes, plundering vulnerable freighters and non-military vessels. Only the most fortunate escape such encounters.
game_text: Unless you have 2 Navigation, 3 SECURITY, and STRENGTH>40 OR a Cloaking Device and CUNNING>40, two personnel (random selection) are killed. Discard dilemma.

name: Q-uality Time
lore: Honoring his promise not to trouble Picard's ship again, Q took the good captain hostage in a shuttlecraft to ensure his request was heard.

name: Routine Physical
lore: Starfleet protocol requires medical staff to regularly conduct and record physical examinations of starship personnel. Crew members are often reluctant to undergo such procedures.
game_text: Stops X lowest STRENGTH personnel (your choice if tie), where X=number of different MEDICAL personnel present. To get past requires 2 Computer Skill remaining.

name: Umexpected
lore: Charles Tucker's experimentation with Xyrillian granules at Ah'len's suggestion led to surprises culinary, romantic, and even obstetric.
game_text: Unless you have Astrophysics and 2 Exobiology OR a female who has MEDICAL, one personnel (random selection, excluding females) is placed atop owner's draw deck.

name: Habit of Disappearing
lore: James Tiberius Kirk's enemies often vanished mysteriously. Security Chief Sulu had to gather power with care.

name: Covert Agent
lore: None
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Opponent may not return a ship to hand if your infiltrator aboard. When opponent reports a personnel or ship to same location as your infiltrator, you may draw a card (once per turn per infiltrator). When a mission attempt or battle begins at same location as your infiltrator, you may download to hand a morph card or an infiltration-related card (once per game per card title).

name: Getting to Know You
game_text: Plays to draw a card. Then draw an additional card for each different infiltration icon you have in play that does not match any opponent's cards (maximum 3). OR Download Insert Undercover Agent. OR Plays (for free, once each turn) on an opponent's personnel present with your infiltrator. Your Founders and personnel with any Intelligence add target's regular skills until end of your turn. Discard incident after any use.

name: Protect the Timeline
game_text: Seeds on a time location. (Unique.) Once each turn, one of your unique personnel reporting here may do so for free. You may not report personnel for free unless native to this timeline or reporting to a ship or facility here. Any ship may time travel between here and corresponding spaceline location (once per turn per ship), then is stopped unless ship or three personnel aboard are native to this timeline.

name: Station Briefing
game_text: Seeds or plays on Commander's Office. No player may commandeer station unless that player has 2 Leadership unopposed at this site. While your facility commander present: once each turn, your Captain's Order or File Mission Report may play for free, and any of your personnel may "file a mission report" here.

name: Supplant Opposite
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your non-Mirror Quadrant personnel with "mirror universe" in lore gain infiltration icons (Terran Empire if Federation or Starfleet, otherwise Klingon/Cardassian Alliance, even if not in play; may be exposed by their opposite), and may report as if Mirror Quadrant (once each turn). When reported as your normal card play (or downloaded by Transporter Mixup), such a personnel may gain any skill until end of turn (once per game per card title), and you may draw a card.

name: Valuable Prisoner
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. (Unique.) Place on your personnel who is about to be killed; relocate (as a captive) to opponent's crew or Away Team in same quadrant; worth points if rescued. OR Place on an opponent's personnel who is about to be killed; relocate (as a captive) to your crew or Away Team in same quadrant (or to Internment Camp 371); you may download Impersonate Captive or a Punishment card.

name: Renewed Spirit
lore: During the Dominion War, crew morale was often low. In his quest to give his father a baseball card, Jake Sisko lifted everyone's spirits and a new optimism swept through DS9.
game_text: Nullifies half of a Combo dilemma. OR Unstops your non-Borg Away Team or your non-Borg ship and crew at your Universal mission (once per game per Mission card title)

name: Smoke and Mirrors
lore: In the mirror universe, the crew of the Starship Enterprise found it far easier as civilized men to behave as barbarians than for their counterparts to behave as civilized men.
game_text: While facing a dilemma, removes classification and all skills from one of your personnel until dilemma resolved, then discard interrupt.

name: Assemble Rescue Team
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Start of each turn, if your unique Ferengi personnel is a captive, you may download The Emperor’s New Cloak OR Prisoner Exchange OR Quark OR Nog OR Leck OR a non-Mirror Quadrant Ferengi personnel with "Quark" in lore. Once per game, you may discard objective to score points when your captured Ferengi personnel is released from a non-Alpha Quadrant location.

name: Assume Identity
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. If an opponent's non-Borg Universal personnel was just killed, place on your Founder (except Odo Founder) in same quadrant. Founder morphs to impersonate killed personnel. Founder's classification and staffing icon change to those of killed personnel. Founder gains infiltration icon(s) for killed personnel's affiliation(s). May morph back at any time (discard objective).

page_title: Fear Will Keep Them in Line (TtLG)
name: Fear Will Keep Them in Line
base_name: Fear Will Keep Them in Line
game_text: Seeds or plays on a Mirror Quadrant mission. In place of your normal card draw, you may download Agony Booth or an Agonizer to your Alternate Universe Terran Empire ship here. Each of your Alternate Universe Terran Empire ships with an Agony Booth are attributes all +1. When you solve mission, score Bonus points equal to your total WEAPONS from staffed Alternate Universe Terran Empire ships at this mission (limit 15 points), then discard objective.

name: Get Back
game_text: Plays on table. When Transporter Skill aboard, your Transporter Mixup may work "in reverse" (replace personnel with their opposites native to this quadrant). When four unique personnel are replaced in this way, discard objective to score points. OR Plays on a non-Mirror Quadrant ship docked at a Mirror Quadrant facility. If ship and non-Mirror Quadrant crew subsequently dock at a non-Mirror Quadrant Nor, discard objective to score points (once per game).

name: Imperial Intimidation
game_text: Seeds or plays on your Alternate Universe Federation Terran Empire ship. Doubles attribute bonuses to this ship from special skills. End of each turn, if this staffed ship orbiting an unsolved, non-homeworld planet mission, you may probe: Terran Empire, Equipment : Intimidation. Draw a card. Interrupt, Objective : Exploitation. Play a non-Federation personnel. Non=Aligned, Doorway : Rebellion. Discard a card from hand.

name: Insert Undercover Agent
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. May discard from table to relocate one of your personnel to an opponent's crew or Away Team which they can infiltrate, and/or download Covert Agent. OR Once per game, place on your personnel with an infiltration icon (unless infiltrating); icon changes to match an opponent's affiliation or faction present; exposed (if infiltrating) when countdown expires.

name: Kira Nerys
lore: First officer of DS9. She accidentally entered the mirror universe while commanding the U.S.S. Rio Grande in 2370. Spitting image of the Intendant.

name: Benjamin Sisko
lore: Commander of DS9 who twice visited the mirror universe. Briefly romantically involved with Captain Dax and the Intendant. Helped launch the Defiant.

name: Captain Kirk
lore: Briefly captained the I.S.S. Enterprise in the mirror universe. Profoundly influenced First Officer Spock.

name: Crewman Bredahl
lore: Typical Terran bodyguard aboard the I.S.S. Enterprise. Assisted Chief Navigator Chekov's attempt to assassinate James Tiberius Kirk.

name: Crewman Peart
lore: Representative of Terran medical assistants throughout the Empire. Occasional bodyguard of James Tiberius Kirk. Dealer of illicit art forms.

name: Dr. McCoy
lore: Surgeon who assisted Mr. Scott in a plan to escape the mirror universe. Saved First Officer Spock's life.

name: Ensign Caggiano
lore: Typical Terran member of Security Chief Sulu's department aboard the I.S.S. Enterprise. Assisted efforts to improve the agony booth's pain quotient.

name: Ensign Chagwiza
lore: Typical Terran technician aboard the I.S.S. Enterprise. Manned the bridge engineering station in 2267. Appreciates the low mortality rate of his section.

name: Ensign Kjolholm
