lore: Representative of Jem'Hadar soldiers posted to Terok Nor in 2374. Second assigned to protect the Founder Leader during visits to Odo's quarters.

name: Admiral Patrick
lore: Genetically enhanced imposter. In 2375, Patrick used his "rank" to bluster past any opposition.

name: Dorian Collins
lore: Acting chief petty officer on the U.S.S. Valiant. Red Squad cadet from Tycho City, Lunar Colony. She misses the beauty of dawn on the moon.

name: Foster
property_logo: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
lore: Typical cadet aboard the Starship Enterprise in 2285. Trainee medevac shuttle pilot. Only son of a Starfleet Intelligence agent. Always up for a party.

name: Jack
lore: Maladjusted misfit and genetically enhanced genius. He visited DS9 with Lauren, Patrick, and Sarina.

name: Jean Hajar
lore: Nova Squadron navigator. In 2368, she attempted to perform an illegal Kolvoord Starburst maneuver with Wesley Crusher and Sito Jaxa. Talented cadet.

name: Karen Farris
lore: Rigorous leader promoted to first officer of the U.S.S. Valiant by Tim Watters. Icy Red Squad cadet. Fiercely loyal to her captain.

name: Katherine Pulaski
lore: Chief medical officer who succeeded Beverly Crusher in 2365. Talented doctor and cardiothoracic surgeon. She makes a mean chicken soup.

name: Lauren
lore: Flirtatious, genetically enhanced visitor to DS9. Found Nog attractive. Self-styled femme fatale.

name: Marie Kaplan
lore: Observant officer serving aboard U.S.S. Voyager. In 2373, she accompanied Chakotay on a shuttle mission to conduct a survey of the Nekrit Expanse.

name: Nog
lore: Ferengi cadet and former waiter. Attends Starfleet Academy. Aspires to join Red Squad. Son of Rom.

name: Patrick
lore: Idiot savant who visited DS9 to meet Julian Bashir. Genetically enhanced and emotional. Likes parties.

name: Revised Chakotay
lore: Imposturous first officer in a 31st-century recreation. Chakotay oversaw brutal interrogations, despite describing himself as a "man of peace."

name: Revised Doctor
lore: Mass murderer in a 31st-century recreation. An Emergency Medical Android, The Doctor designed bio-weapons that killed eight million Kyrians.

name: Revised Janeway
lore: Cold-blooded killer, Kathryn Janeway. She captained the U.S.S. Voyager in a 31st-century recreation.

name: Revised Kim
lore: Interrogator who assisted in the prolonged torture of several Kyrians. 31st-century recreation of Harry Kim. Always looking for ways to advance his career.

name: Revised Kizar
lore: Typical Kazon-Ogla crewman, captured and made to work as part of the combat forces in a 31st-century recreation of U.S.S. Voyager.

name: Revised Kizar (AI)
lore: Typical Kazon-Ogla crewman, captured and made to work as part of the combat forces in a 31st-century recreation of U.S.S. Voyager.

name: Revised Neelix
lore: "Hedgehog" ops officer in a 31st-century recreation. Neelix was one of several subjugated crewmen.

name: Revised Paris
lore: Ensign chaser. Tom Paris was considered the least inaccurate 31st-century recreation of U.S.S. Voyager crewmembers. He prefers a direct assault.

name: Revised Seven of Nine
lore: Shock-trooper in a 31st-century recreation. Seven of Nine was captured from the Borg and assimilated into Starfleet. She neutralized a Kyrian boarding party.

name: Revised Tuvok
lore: Evil instrument of destruction who directed the orbital assault against the Kyrians. 31st-century recreation of Tuvok.

name: Riley Shepard
lore: Confident cadet ordered by Admiral Leyton to sabotage Earth's power grid in 2372. Red Squad member later assigned to the U.S.S. Valiant.

name: Sarina
lore: Genetically enhanced introvert. She became romantically involved with Julian Bashir on DS9.

name: Seth Matthews
lore: Red Squad cadet typical of those assigned to train on the U.S.S. Valiant in 2373. Although loyal to Tim Watters, he secretly misses home.

name: Tim Watters
lore: Valiant captain given a battlefield commission. Overconfident cadet determined to succeed. Proud member of Red Squad. An inspiration to his crew.

name: Leosa
lore: Grifter, thief, dabo girl, teacher, vedek - whatever the customer wants. Human working for Nunk. Briefly romantically involved with Reginald Barclay.

name: Alexander Rozenko
lore: "Good luck charm" aboard the I.K.S. Rotarran with a talent for mishaps. 3/4 Klingon, 1/4 human son of Worf and K'Ehleyr. Joined the House of Martok.

name: B'amara
lore: Typical surgeon serving under Martok. Former nurse and arms dealer. She developed new combat stimulants and advised the High Council on their use.

name: Meraht
lore: Typical Klingon operative. She was ordered by Gowron to observe commercial operations within the Bajoran sector of 2373. Collector of bronze statues.

name: Curator Quarren
lore: Kyrian historian in charge of a 31st-century museum. Discovered an E.M.H. backup who helped him to revise the Kyrian and Vaskan history books.

name: Sarda
lore: Not a legal expert - just a dabo girl. Complained about the lurid requirements in her contract with Quark. Later advocated the abolition of such terms.

name: Sarda (AI)
lore: Not a legal expert - just a dabo girl. Complained about the lurid requirements in her contract with Quark. Later advocated the abolition of such terms.

name: Togaran
lore: Tamarian first officer. One of many sons of Tama. "Kiteo, his eyes closed. Picard and Dathon at El-Adrel. Mirab, with sails unfurled. Temba, at rest."

name: Chagrith
lore: One of many Reman soldiers under the command of Shinzon. Former deuterium purification specialist. He helped develop the thalaron radiation generator.

name: Dralvak
lore: Typical Reman surgeon. Doctor who worked under The Viceroy aboard the Scimitar in 2379. He studied the cloning techniques used in creating Shinzon.

name: Jorvas
lore: Representative of Reman navigators serving aboard the Scimitar. A former assault trooper, he was recruited to join a boarding party in 2379.

name: Thexor
lore: Characteristic of Reman assault troops. Soldier who fought in many conflicts during the Dominion War. He is eager to serve Shinzon and The Viceroy.

name: Kitara
lore: Flagship of a Bajoran blockade in 2375. Commanded by Colonel Kira in opposition to the Romulan fortification of their medical facilities on Derna.
game_text: Souls of the Dead

name: U.S.S. Valiant
lore: Red Squad training ship caught behind enemy lines during the Dominion War. Captained by Tim Watters.
game_text: Training Cruise

name: Museum of Kyrian Heritage
lore: 3074 Kyrian-Vaskan planet: Exhibition of ancient artifacts and historical recreations.
game_text: Seeds on table during facility phase; any player who did not seed Ocampa planet may download a non-Borg Delta Quadrant ship here and/or Holoprogram: The Voyager Encounter. Native to this timeline: all Delta Quadrant Alternate cards with "31st-century" in lore. Once each turn, one such card reporting at this location may report for free.

name: Nagilum: Test Subjects
lore: To learn about death, Nagilum attempted to obtain information on it through experimenting on the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise.
game_text: Place on ship. Now and start of each turn, kills one crew member (random selection). Cure with 2 SCIENCE, Diplomacy, and Physics OR Auto-Destruct Sequence.

name: Klingon Death Yell
lore: Warning for the dead to beware; a Klingon warrior is about to arrive. In Klingon myth, killed warriors with honor go to Sto-Vo-Kor. Dishonored dead go to Gre'thor.
game_text: Plays on any just killed Klingon with Honor. Yell to warn the dead and earn bonus points. May play only one death yell for each such Klingon.

name: Examine Battle Site
lore: Near Orelious IX: Chart cataclysmic final battle from the Menthar-Promellian war.
game_text: none

name: Investigate Energy Readings
lore: Alpha Onias III: Pinpoint source of subspace probe that emanated from this inhospitable world.
game_text: When you solve, may download Barash here.

name: Prepare War Game Scenario
lore: Braslota System: Ready crew for combat simulation designed to hone tactical skills.
game_text: None

name: Reported Activity
lore: Xendi Sabu: Probe reports of mysterious Ferengi activity in this sector.
game_text: None

name: Tajor
lore: Typical Cardassian military aide. Fleet logistics expert and skilled negotiator. Glinn who assisted Lemec in 2369. Friend of Corak.

name: Alyssa Ogawa
lore: Nurse Alyssa Ogawa is a medical assistant and friend to Dr. Beverly Crusher.

name: Anhaica
lore: Typical human settler on Dorvan V. He joined the Maquis after the colony was passed to Cardassian control following the U.S.S. Enterprise visit in 2370.

name: Anhaica (AI)
lore: Typical human settler on Dorvan V. He joined the Maquis after the colony was passed to Cardassian control following the U.S.S. Enterprise visit in 2370.

name: Aletia
lore: Typical humanoid employee of Omag. Retained for her expertise in biochemical weaponry and her talents for the tympanic tickle. Mentor to Calandra.

name: Aletia (AI)
lore: Typical humanoid employee of Omag. Retained for her expertise in biochemical weaponry and her talents for the tympanic tickle. Mentor to Calandra.

name: Follis
lore: Representative of Ferengi trained in the field of commercial security. He helped Lurin take over the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2369.

name: Krunk
lore: Transporter technician under the command of Lurin. Guarded a U.S.S. Enterprise transporter room during his DaiMon's unsuccessful takeover attempt.

name: Taar
lore: Representative Ferengi DaiMon. First member of the Ferengi Alliance to make visual contact with humans. Claimed he sought "only what is equitable."

name: Divok
lore: Male trained in Klingon anatomy and medicine. Studied the effects of Tribbles on the Klingon nervous system.

name: J'Ddan
lore: Klingon trained in the field of science. Smuggled Federation secrets to the Romulans in the form of amino acid codes.

name: Larg
lore: Typical Klingon captain. Enjoys drinking with friends and enemies alike. Commanded a squadron for the House of Duras during the Klingon Civil War.

name: Qup'ta
lore: Representative of senior advisors living on Qo'noS. Has loyally served the Klingon High Council since his appointment by K'mpec. Collects antique bat'leths.

name: Vol'Jin
lore: Typical Klingon physician. Personal surgeon to Kargan. Became romantically involved with Vekma while serving aboard the I.K.S. Pagh.

name: Aaron Conor
lore: Genetically engineered human and leader of an isolationist colony on Moab IV. He became romantically involved with Deanna Troi in 2368.

name: Alexana Devos
lore: Rutian chief of police. Takes a hard line on terrorism. Pledges to end the Ansata violence. Has survived three assassination attempts on her life.

name: Dacres
lore: Typical humanoid mercenary. Colleague of Narik and Vekor. In 2370, he worked with Baran to find the Stone of Gol. Distrusts Galen.

name: Tayar
lore: Characteristic of disconnected Borg. Assault team member on Ohniaka III. Assigned by The One to identify the Starfleet forces encountered there.

name: Jacen
lore: Typical member of the Romulan underground. Colleague of Dr. Koramar. Impersonated a security officer to apprehend Jean-Luc Picard and Data.

name: Mengran
lore: Typical Romulan underground sympathizer. Chief engineer aboard the Khazara. He aided N'Vek in misaligning the cloak. Collects antique globes.

name: Nefets
lore: Representative of versatile bridge officers serving aboard the Haakona under Taris. He later returned to Romulus and joined the Romulan underground.

name: Palteth
lore: Romulan trained in the field of engineering. A specialist in artificial quantum singularity. Served aboard the Khazara in 2369.

name: Kreechta
lore: Ferengi marauder. Under the command of Bractor in 2365, interrupted a mysterious battle between the Federation starships Enterprise and Hathaway.

name: Starfleet Phaser Pistol
lore: "There are only two settings. Stun and kill. It would be best not to confuse them.

name: Revisionist History
lore: One might meet an unfortunate end if the timeline were to be altered.
game_text: Seeds or play on table. Once per turn (thrice per game), you may discard a card from hand to search your discard pile for any one Alternate event and take it into hand.

name: Temporal Shifting
lore: Time Travel can afford the user certain abilities that might not be available to those native to the current time.
game_text: Plays on a player. That player must choose to either discard three cards from hand or discard one Alternate card. If that player discards an Alternate card, he/she may draw up to four cards. Discard event.

name: Seat of Starfleet
lore: The place that started it all. Changed the galaxy as we know it.
game_text: Seeds or plays on 2154 Earth. Once per turn, one Starfleet personnel may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)Download UFP: One Small Step

name: Charles Tucker III
lore: Self taught Chief Engineer of Enterprise. Best friend and confidant to Jonathan Archer. From Panama City, Florida. Enjoys pecan pie.

name: Elizabeth Cutler
lore: Hard working scientist, gourmet cook, and amateur bartender. Always eager to be selected for special assignments.

name: Emory Erickson
lore: Inventor of the transporter and father figure to Jonathan Archer. Dreams big. Honorary President of the Association of Transporter Technicians.

name: Ethan Novakovich
lore: Tends to leave jobs quickly. Tried working as a cook, bartender, waiter, fan club president and event student senator before joining Starfleet.

name: Hoshi Sato
lore: Communications officer on board Enterprise, NX-01. Didn't want to come along, but after listening to some Klingon, she felt motivated.

name: Jeremy Lucas
lore: Chairman of research at Cold Station 12. Close friend of Phlox. His optimism sometimes leads him to jump to dangerous conclusions.

name: Jonathan Archer
lore: Captain of Enterprise, NX-01. Leaped into deep space to make the future quantifiably better for all mankind.

name: Malcolm Reed
lore: Head of Security aboard Enterprise. Experienced weapons expert, qualified bodyguard and crack shot.

name: Maxwell Forrest
lore: Respected Admiral. Friend of Soval. Sent the crew of Enterprise out into the final frontier to go where no man had gone before.

name: Phlox
lore: Denobulan miracle worker. Former chairman of immunology at his alma mater. Has a great smile.

name: T'Pol
lore: Female Vulcan first officer of Enterprise, NX-01. Finds humans to be fascinating. Dislikes the smell of dogs.

name: Travis Mayweather
lore: Crack pilot aboard Enterprise, NX-01. Itching to get into deep space. Loves the sweet spot.

name: Enterprise
lore: Legendary prototype designed for deep space travel. Commanded by Jonathan Archer. First Starfleet vessel to bear the name that would symbolize Starfleet's elite.
game_text: This ship is attributes +1 for each Starfleet Command aboard (limit 5).

name: T'Pol/Soong Maneuver
game_text: ATTACK bonus +3 and DEFENSE bonus +2 if you have a NX-class ship firing. Hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Kazon PADD
lore: Standard Kazon Personal Display Device for computerized information. Such equipment has been developed by many races throughout the Delta Quadrant.
game_text: May be used only by a non-Federation Delta Quadrant personnel. Each of your personnel present is CUNNING +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Hirogen Hunt: Coordinated Effort
lore: When pursuing particularly dangerous prey, Hirogen hunting groups would often join forces in a multi-pronged attack.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, if all your ships in play are Hirogen or a Self-controlling card is in play, you may report a Universal Hirogen personnel for free. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Treaty: Cardassian/Kazon
lore: In 2371, the Cardassian agent Seska formed a pact with the Kazon-Nistrim, covertly supplying them with Federation technology.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table (plays for free if you have Seska in play). Your Cardassian and Kazon affiliations recognize this treaty. They can now mix and cooperate.

name: Homestead
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. If you have completed three missions (including at least one Planet mission and one Space mission), you may ignore any effect that requires you to score "an additional 40 points to win." Nullified if you have seeded a mission showing more than 30 points.

name: Bypass Warzone
lore: Class 9 Nebula: Use dense astronomical phenomenon to avoid local conflict.
game_text: * +10 points if no Non-Aligned in crew.

name: Preliminary Incursion
lore: Wormhole Terminus: Scout immediate area and ascertain potential for conquest.
game_text: None

name: Janeway
lore: Captured by Karr and altered to appear Klingon. Human captain Kathryn Janeway fought in Hirogen training simulations. She's no one's prey.

name: Janeway (AI)
lore: Captured by Karr and altered to appear Klingon. Human captain Kathryn Janeway fought in Hirogen training simulations. She's no one's prey.

name: Culluh and Seska
lore: In 2371, First Maje Culluh of the Kazon-Nistrim allied himself with the Cardassian spy Seska and took her as his mate. They had a son together.

name: Tom Son of Owen
lore: In 2377, Tom Paris accepted T'Greth's challenge of a fight to the death. Human nurse, husband of B'Elanna Daughter of Miral, and father of their child.

name: The Beating Heart
lore: In 2374, Jadzia Dax was severely wounded on a critical mission. Worf was compelled to save the woman he loved, ignoring the mission and the consequences for the Federation.
game_text: Plays on table. You may stop your personnel to prevent their romantic partner present from being killed by a dilemma (that personnel is stopped instead).

name: Curzon Odo
lore: As part of Jadzia Dax's zhian'tara ritual aboard DS9, former Ambassador and host Curzon Dax was merged with the changeling Odo in 2371.

name: Curzon Odo (AI)
lore: As part of Jadzia Dax's zhian'tara ritual aboard DS9, former Ambassador and host Curzon Dax was merged with the changeling Odo in 2371.

name: Dr. Renhol
lore: Typical symbiont host. Trill Symbiosis Commission member. She evaluated Jadzia Dax as an initiate.

name: Lenara Kahn
lore: Trill scientist. Host of the Kahn symbiont. In 2372, she became romantically involved with Jadzia Dax.

name: Worf and Jadzia
lore: The Klingon Worf and his Trill bride Jadzia Dax opted for a Klingon ceremony to differentiate from other weddings her symbiont had experienced.

name: Worf and Jadzia (AI)
lore: The Klingon Worf and his Trill bride Jadzia Dax opted for a Klingon ceremony to differentiate from other weddings her symbiont had experienced.

name: Joran
lore: Violent, unstable pianist embodied in the human Benjamin Sisko during Jadzia Dax's zhian'tara. By 2286, he had murdered a total of three people.

name: Lela
lore: Pioneering legislator. One of the first councilwomen appointed on Trill. Was embodied in the Bajoran Kira Nerys during Jadzia Dax's zhian'tara.
characteristics: :Category:Skill level 2 personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)Skill level 2 personnel

name: Torias
lore: Pilot embodied in the human Julian Bashir during Jadzia Dax's zhian'tara. Knows life is too short.

name: Yedrin Dax
lore: Part human, part Trill descendant of Jadzia Dax who inherited the symbiont in an alternate timeline. Felt liable for the accidental creation of the Gaia colony.

name: The Book
lore: In 2168, a copy of the book Chicago Mobs of the Twenties was left on planet Sigma Iotia II by a crew member from the Starfleet vessel Horizon.
game_text: Immediately name a non-Borg affiliation and a regular skill; place on table. Your Non-Aligned personnel gain the named affiliation and skill (even if not in play).

name: Augment Aggression
lore: Genetically engineered for greater strength and ambition, human augments can be intimidating foes. The Starship Enterprise encountered some in suspended animation in 2267.
game_text: Opponent may download to this location up to three augments. If you have Archaeology and MEDICAL, these augments are in stasis until the end of your next turn.

name: Crippling Injury
lore: Fleet captain and former Starship Enterprise commander Christopher Pike was exposed to disfiguring delta particle radiation in the line of duty while saving trainees and cadets.
game_text: To get past requires 2 OFFICER OR 2 Leadership. Then, place on a unique leader present (opponent's choice); loses all regular skills and has NO STRENGTH.

name: Dikironium Cloud Creature
lore: Gaseous predator which feeds on red blood cells. Killed 200 crewmen from the Starship Farragut in 2257.
game_text: End of every turn: Kills four of each player's personnel here (their choice, human if possible), then moves. Worth points if destroyed in battle.

name: Entertaining Display
lore: The Platonians' psychokinetic abilities allowed them to turn Captain Kirk, Mr. Spock, Lt. Uhura and Nurse Chapel into playthings for their amusement.

name: Koon-ut-hal-if-fee
lore: Translated as "marriage or challenge", this ritual requires Vulcans, driven by the neurochemical imbalance known as Pon Farr, to take a mate or fight a challenger in combat.
game_text: Randomly select one Vulcan male OR opponent chooses one personnel. To get past, personnel must relocate to matching homeworld OR battle strongest other male present.

name: Misinterpreted History
lore: With the meaning of the Yangs' "holy words" lost to them, Captain Kirk re-educated them about freedom and liberty.

name: Planet Killer
lore: Automated machine capable of destroying entire planets with an antiproton beam and consuming the debris for fuel.
game_text: End of every turn: Attacks all ships here, then moves. Worth points if destroyed in battle

name: Primal Urges
lore: Mutated into a different stage of human evolution, Tom Paris and Kathryn Janeway reverted to their animal instincts and procreated.
game_text: To get past, one male and one female (your choice) must run off to furthest planet. Nullify with 2 ANIMAL.

name: Space Amoeba
lore: Large, space-dwelling, single-celled organism. Surrounded by a field of negative energy, toxic to humanoid life.
game_text: All attributes of ships and personnel at this location (and each adjacent location) become 5. End of every turn: Moves.

name: Thasian Powers
lore: Enhanced with inhuman abilities, Charlie Evans took control of the Starship Enterprise. By turning on all shipboard systems, Captain Kirk proved the young man had overreached himself.
game_text: You may discard any number of cards from hand. To get past requires CUNNING>(40 + 5X), where X = number of cards in your hand.

name: Five Year Mission
lore: The 23rd century was a period of expansion and exploration for many spacefaring races.

name: M-5 Computer
lore: Advanced multitronic computer prototype created by Richard Daystrom in 2268. More sophisticated than the duotronic computer. Its self-preservation instinct proved dangerous.
game_text: Plays on your Original Series ship OR non-Borg ship with 2 Computer Skill aboard. Ship may move and initiate battle without staffing or leader aboard. (Unique.)

name: Recreation Room
lore: During their off-hours, Starfleet officers in the 23rd century would frequently gather in crew lounges for socializing over some food, listening to music, and playing card games.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Once each turn, when you play a unique Original Series card, you may draw a card and then place a card from hand on the bottom of your deck.

name: To Boldly Go
lore: Exploration of the stars, encounters with different cultures, and the potential for knowledge and advancements were driving forces for expansion in the 23rd century.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. For every mission you seeded with "23rd century" in lore, your Original Series ships are RANGE and SHIELDS +1 (limit 3). (Captain's Order.)

name: Urgent Warning
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
lore: "The transmissions of an orbiting Probe are causing critical damage to this planet... Save your energy, save yourselves. Avoid the planet Earth at all costs. Farewell."

name: Ravenous Hunger
game_text: Plays on an opponent's non-homeworld Planet mission (once per game, may play for free). End of every turn, if Planet Killer is here and did not move or battle here this turn, and no ships here, planet is converted to a Space mission. If unsolved, Space mission now worth 30 points. Planet Killer may not move from here while this is a Planet mission (but may "fly by").

name: Risk is Our Business
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. End of each turn, if your Federation Original Series ship is exposed with two unstopped Original Series personnel aboard at a mission with "23rd century" in lore, draw a card. At the start of your first mission attempt of each mission, you may download Prepare Landing Party OR Where No Man Has Gone Before OR Where No One Has Gone Before OR Preserver Obelisk OR Recreation Room OR Corbomite Device.

name: Scotty, Beam Me Up!
property_logo: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

game_text: Solving player may immediately cure one dilemma.

name: Let Me Help
game_text: Seeds on table if you seeded at least 18 cards under opponent's missions. Love Interest dilemmas affect one additional personnel. On dilemmas with "male" or "female" in gametext (except Distraction), every printed number is increased by 1. Such dilemmas are considered Borg-related; UniversalBorg personnel encountering them are considered male and female.

name: Captain Kirk
lore: Youthful commander of the Starship Enterprise who succeeded Christopher Pike. Talented strategist who can outwit a computer or a Vulcan.

name: Chief Pitcairn
lore: Typical transporter operator. Human who served under Christopher Pike in 2254. He had a brother who briefly worked in security.

name: Commodore Stone
lore: Decorated flag officer and commander of Starbase 11 on Planet M-11. He acted as president of the court during Captain Kirk's court martial in 2267.

name: Dr. Boyce
lore: Chief medical officer of the Starship Enterprise in 2254. Human doctor, he also served as bartender, counselor, and confidant to Christopher Pike.

name: Lt. Commander Giotto
lore: Security chief aboard the Starship Enterprise in 2267. He led the security forces that attempted to track down the Horta on Janus VI. Dislikes computers.

name: Lt. José Tyler
lore: One of many navigators who served aboard the Starship Enterprise under Christopher Pike. He joined the initial landing party to Talos IV in 2254.

name: Lt. Kevin Riley
lore: One of many navigators on the Starship Enterprise. Irishman who survived the Tarsus IV massacre. Later sought vengeance on Governor Kodos. Talented singer.

name: Lt. Palamas
lore: Expert in ancient civilizations. Human who served aboard Starship Enterprise and visited Pollux IV in 2267. Apollo selected her to be his queen.

name: Lt. Sulu
lore: Head of Astrosciences aboard the Starship Enterprise in 2265. He joined the ship shortly after the departure of Christopher Pike. Born in San Francisco.

name: Number One
lore: Analytical first officer, talented with computers. She frequently commanded Starship Enterprise when Christopher Pike was part of a landing party.

name: Richard Daystrom
lore: Genius who designed the duotronic computer and later developed the M-5 computer. He has won both the Nobel and Zee-Magnees prizes.

name: Samuel T. Cogley
lore: Attorney at law living on Planet M-11. Human who never uses computers. Prefers his library of books, from the Magna Carta to The Statutes of Alpha III.

name: Vanderberg
lore: Typical of chief engineers on mining colonies. Administrator for the Janus VI pergium operation. Came to accept the Horta, despite their appearance.

name: Yeoman Colt
lore: Representative of yeomen serving in Starfleet in 2254. Newly assigned to Christopher Pike. She is one of only a few humans ever to visit Talos IV.

name: Qol
lore: Lascivious lackey of Par Lenor. Typical member of the Ferengi Trade Mission. He tried to free Kamala.

name: Claudius Marcus
lore: Typical corrupt politician, obsessed with television ratings. Proconsul of a Roman Empire. Hails from Planet 892-IV. Fan of gladiatorial combat.

name: Leila Kalomi
lore: Typical human settler and botanist on Omicron Ceti III. She became romantically involved with Mr. Spock during his euphoria after exposure to local spore plants.

name: Mea 3
lore: Native of Eminiar VII and daughter of Anan 7. She was vocal in defending the Eminian philosophy of humane war, horrified by the prospect of a real one.

name: Miramanee
lore: Human tribal priestess living on the planet Amerind. Fell in love with and married Captain Kirk, whom she knew as Kirok. Had faith he would save her people.

name: Qatai
lore: Hunter and pilot. Humanoid obsessed with killing the soulless telepathic protoplasmic beast that devoured his family. Has an icy and robotic disposition.

name: Tepo
lore: Typical gangster boss from Sigma Iotia II. Ruled a territory there, like fellow bosses Bela Okmyx and Jojo Krako. Former jewel thief. Likes soup.

name: The Keeper
lore: Talosian magistrate who oversaw a menagerie of extraterrestrials on Talos IV. He tried to add Christopher Pike to his collection as a mate for Vina.

name: Starship Constellation
lore: Starfleet registry number NCC-1017. In 2267 investigated vast destruction in systems L-370 through L-374. Commanded by Commodore Decker.

name: Classic Phaser Banks
lore: Code One Emergency: Federation Original Series ships may attack this ship, ignoring affiliation attack restrictions.
game_text: ATTACK bonus +2 if you have a Constitution-class ship firing. Hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: It Must Be Destroyed
lore: None
game_text: If battling a Selfless card, ATTACK bonus +4 and your ships and crews are not stopped afterwards (but may not initiate battle again this turn).Hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Current Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Transwarp Network Gateway
game_text: Seed one during facility phase on any spaceline end OR play on any spaceline location where you have a Navigation Borg. Any player may play a Transwarp Conduit (or another copy of this doorway) to allow moving any or all of that's player's ships from this Transwarp Network Gateway to another OR Downloads Transwarp Conduit (discard doorway).

name: Distribution Node
lore: Functions: Disseminate assimilated knowledge and reallocate Collective resources.
game_text: Your TNG Borg here share first-listed skills at highest level. Once each turn, you may discard your drone here to make your drones here all gain any skill until end of turn.

name: Redirected Effort
lore: After the U.S.S. Enterprise retaliated to the initial assault by the Borg in system J-25, the Collective re-prioritized all drone activity into regenerating the ship.
game_text: Plays on table. Once each turn, if you have two TNG drones present together, you may place one card from hand beneath draw deck, then draw a card. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Relentless
lore: None

name: The Ultimate User
lore: None

name: Adapt: Negate Obstruction
lore: Confronted by a Starfleet assault team and unable to modulate shielding to their rotating phaser frequencies, Locutus adapted and used physical force to resist their efforts.
game_text: Nullifies a dilemma (except a Q-related dilemma) just encountered by your Communications Borg if your Borg encountered that dilemma (or a copy) on a previous turn.

name: Examine Distant Sector
lore: System J-25: Evaluate ominous disappearance of local infrastructure.
game_text: none

name: Consume: Outpost
game_text: Plays on table. Target an unsolved Neutral Zone Region mission you have not examined with no Borg Only objective on it; download an outpost there (ignoring ENGINEER requirement) from outside the game, uncontrolled. Your TNG Borg may scout that location. After scouting complete, if your staffed TNG Borg cube here, Objective complete: place on mission; place outpost out-of-play.

name: Consume: Resources
game_text: Plays on table. Target an unsolved non-homeworld planet mission with no Borg Only objective on it. Your TNG Borg may scout that planet. After scouting complete, if your staffed TNG Borg cube there, Objective complete: Place on mission; your Archaeology present may acquire any artifacts here. Your TNG Communications drones gain non-Intelligence skills in mission requirements (at their highest level).

name: Consume: Technology
game_text: Plays on table. Target your unsolved space mission requiring Computer Skill with no Borg Only objective on it. Your TNG Borg may scout that mission. After scouting complete, if your staffed TNG Borg cube there, Objective complete: Place on mission; your TNG Navigation drones gain non-Intelligence skills in mission requirements (at their highest level).

name: Eight of Twenty
lore: IDENTIFICATION: ASSEMBLY DRONETASK: Produce enhanced components. Upgrade.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid

name: Eighteen of Twenty
lore: IDENTIFICATION: ASTROMETRIC DRONETASK: Catalog interstellar phenomena. Analyze.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid

name: Eleven of Fourteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: BIOHAZARD DRONETASK: Assess biological organisms. Evaluate.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid

name: Nineteen of Twenty
lore: IDENTIFICATION: OBSERVATION DRONETASK: Collect data on new species. Relay.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid

name: One of Fourteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: PRODUCTIVITY DRONETASK: Assess data transfer protocols. Enhance.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid

name: Q of Borg
lore: In one universe, Q explored life as a Borg to better understand the hive mind, and determine how best to use the Collective to torment other races.

name: Six of Fourteen
lore: IDENTIFICATION: REACTION DRONETASK: Assess progress of hive objectives. Facilitate.BIOLOGICAL DISTINCTIVENESS: Humanoid

name: J-25 Cube
lore: IDENTIFICATION: identification: BORG CUBETASK: Patrol system J-25. Pursue and eliminate resistance. Adapt to unfamiliar weaponry.
game_text: Your equipment and Borg personnel may report aboard. Regenerate (if damaged).

name: Eminian Disintegration Protocol
lore: Eminiar VII was in a simulated war with Vendikar for 500 years. Shipboard and ground-based deaths were determined by computer and completed at disintegration stations.
game_text: One SECURITY (at Planet) or one ENGINEER (at Space with most Skill dots is killed. To get past requires 2 SECURITY (at Planet) OR 2 ENGINEER (at Space) OR six non-Borg Universal personnel.

name: Experience Bij!
lore: In his efforts to commandeer the U.S.S. Enterprise, Kavok would use "punishments" to slow the progress of the remaining Starfleet personnel aboard from reaching the bridge.
game_text: Attempt ends. Place on mission; cannot be attempted or scouted. May be nullified by any player encountering another dilemma OR if Dead End is on this mission.

name: M-113 Creature
lore: Last member of a telepathic, shape-shifting species. Craves salt. Will extract it, often fatally, from other creatures.
game_text: Place on mission. Now and end of every player's turn, kills one of that player's personnel here (opponent's choice; human if possible). Cure with 2 Exobiology here.

name: Nelvana Trap
lore: Having discovered no covert base on Nelvana III, the U.S.S. Enterprise was caught in the act of violating the Neutral Zone by two D'deridex class warbirds.
game_text: Opponent may relocate up to two of their Romulan Original Series or The Next Generation Romulan ships from any Engage Cloak to here (decloaked). Those ships may initiate battle or move away.

name: Nuclear Disarmament
lore: In 1968, Gary Seven assumed the mission of two deceased temporal agents and caused a nuclear missile malfunction, preventing further proliferation of atomic weapons.
game_text: Kills all your temporal agents in play (if 3 Anthropology present, stopped instead). To get past requires 2 Computer Skill and INTEGRITY>40 OR Physics and ANIMAL.

name: Poor Quality Workmanship
property_logo: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
lore: Mr. Scott was not impressed by the newly launched U.S.S Enterprise-A and the numerous repairs needed. "Half the doors won't open, and guess whose job it is to make it right?"
game_text: To get past requires 4 personnel with (ENGINEER OR Computer Skill) OR discard any Kit (at Planet) OR discard any PADD (at Space).

name: Shuttle Crash
lore: In 2367, an accident aboard the Nenebek, a mining shuttle transporting Jean-Luc Picard and Wesley Crusher to Pentarus V, caused it to crash land on one of the moons orbiting Pentarus III.
game_text: Stops one Youth personnel (opponent's choice) then one OFFICER (your choice). To get past requires 2 Navigation and (CUNNING>45 at Space] OR STRENGTH>45 at Planet).

name: Tricyanate Poisoning
lore: Kivas Fajo kept the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise busy dealing with a contaminated water table on Beta Agni II to avoid further investigation into the explosion of Data's shuttle.
game_text: Unless requirements of nearest planet mission (at Space) OR requirements of nearest space mission (at Planet) present, place on mission; mission worth zero points. (Unique.)

name: White Rabbit
lore: Time-obsessed recreation from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland encountered by Dr. McCoy. Caused shore leave to be delayed until such anachronisms could be explained.
game_text: Unless Physics and Archaeology present, place on mission. When countdown expires, if mission unsolved, reduce points by 10. Nullified by any pocketwatch.

name: Creatures of Duty
lore: Keras and his officers lived by the ideals of duty, obedience, and service to the Praetor, to the exclusion of all other concerns.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Romulan Original Series male personnel with OFFICER classification may meet dilemma requirements as if CIVILIAN or V.I.P. or female, then are stopped.

name: Shape-Shift: Fluidity
lore: Inside the Link, an intimate sharing of thought and form, idea and sensation, concepts like gender are meaningless. Outside the Link, changelings can take any form, male or female.
game_text: Plays on table. Each changeling in play is a romantic partner of every other changeling in play and, once each turn, may change their gender (until end of turn).

name: Strategic Sector
lore: The burgeoning Maquis activity in and around the Demilitarized Zone began to draw intense scrutiny from both the Cardassian Union and the Federation.
game_text: Plays on a mission in a region. If not playing Borg, you may draw a card for every two missions in that region (plus one if you have no facilities in that region). Discard event.

name: Earth Outpost
lore: After the Earth-Romulan War, Starfleet constructed a series of outposts along the Neutral Zone.
game_text: Seeds (limit one) or plays at a Neutral Zone Region mission.

name: Community Leader
game_text: Seeds on table. Once per game, at any time, you may download Quark's Bar and/or one Holosuite. Your Quark gains Leadership. Your Quark, Rom , and your DS9Ferengi bartenders, dabo girls, and waiters may mix with your cards. All personnel may mix at Quark's Bar.

name: Hard-Working, Happy Androids
game_text: Seeds on Exo III or Planet Mudd. Your androids, Cravic Warships, and Pralor Warships may report here. While you have no more than one non-android personnel in play, once each turn you may "conduct upgrades": place one android from hand underneath deck to draw 2 cards (one android drawn may report to your Cybernetics personnel). Once per game, you may download Lore's Fingernail.

name: Long Live the Empire!
game_text: Seeds on Imperial Palace. If you seeded 6 Mirror Quadrant missions and have no ship in play, at the start of your turn you may download one Mirror Quadrant NX-class ship here. Once each turn you may discard 2 or more cards from hand to put top two cards of draw deck beneath Watch Dog and/or keep one event from counting down this turn.

name: The Neutral Zone
game_text: Seeds on table if you seeded at least 5 different Neutral Zone missions and no homeworld. All ships are RANGE +2 in Neutral Zone. Once per game, you may download Test for Weakness OR Consume: Outpost. End of every player's turn, that player may draw an extra card if their staffed, exposed, non-Federation ship is at a Neutral Zone mission.

name: Cloaked Maneuvers
lore: With the vapor trail of comet Icarus IV to further obscure their movements, the Gal Gath'thong was able to change course and evade the pursuit from their Starfleet adversary.
game_text: Plays on your undamaged ship with a Cloaking Device. Ship cloaks (even if stopped or it has decloaked this turn). Shuffle back into deck if ship is Romulan Original Series].

name: I…Have Had…Enough of You!
property_logo: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
lore: Filled with rage following the death of his son, Admiral Kirk angrily ended Kruge's quest to acquire the secret of Genesis.
game_text: Once per game per persona, plays on any Benefactor OR on a personnel to prevent a Download they just initiated (after start of next turn, Download considered unused). Target personnel loses all skills until end of turn.

name: Not Programmed to Respond
lore: With a physical show of force futile, the crew of the Starship Enterprise planned to use confusion and illogic, forcing the androids to consult Norman for advice.
game_text: Plays to stop your android. If Norman is in play, one of your other androids present with him gains a skill of your choice until end of turn. OR Nullifies Kelvan Show of Force.

name: Breach Detection Grid
lore: Neutral Zone Region • Border Crossing: Evade tachyon beams and pursuing vessels.
game_text: none

name: Evade Sensors
lore: Neutral Zone Region • Comet Icarus IV: Hide near comet discovered in 23rd century.
game_text: none

name: Investigate Decaying Radiation
lore: Neutral Zone Region • Gamma Hydra IV: Study aftereffect from 23rd century comet.
game_text: none

name: Provide Purpose
lore: Planet Mudd: Give direction to a society of androids first discovered in the 23rd century.
game_text: Owner's androids may not mix with aligned personnel.

name: Study Cybernetic Relics
lore: Exo III: Examine android components and systems uncovered during the 23rd century.
game_text: Owner's androids may not mix with aligned personnel.

name: Test for Weakness
game_text: Plays on a Neutral Zone Region mission. Once per game, you may download Earth Outpost here (under opponent's control). Doubles WEAPONS of your Romulan The Original Series ships here when attacked or if attacking alone versus outposts. When an opposing outpost is destroyed here, score points (discard objective).

name: Shah'Razad
lore: Representative of virtual players in the Vorta scenario testing designed by Borath. Jem'Hadar Third trained in the fields of engineering and wormhole theory.

name: Lt. Stiles
lore: Navigator and weapons controller. Has a phenomenal hatred of the Romulans, as many of his ancestors served and died during the Earth-Romulan War.

name: Alice Series
lore: Representative of androids found on Planet Mudd. She was not programmed to respond in all areas.

name: Andrea
lore: Android built on Exo III by Dr. Roger Korby. She found human emotions to be very confusing. Assisted in producing an android duplicate of Captain Kirk.

name: Barbara Series
lore: Characteristic of androids native to Planet Mudd. Lt. Uhura was impressed by her estimated lifespan.

name: Dr. Brown
lore: Android recreation of Dr. Roger Korby's assistant. Survived underground on Exo III. Often talks about his great Scottish ancestry. A student of all sciences.

name: Kirk-Android
lore: Android recreation of Captain Kirk built on Exo III by Dr. Roger Korby. Expressed annoyance at Mr. Spock and his half-breed interference.

name: Norman
lore: The only android of his model. Acts as central control locus for his fellow androids. Native to Planet Mudd. Diverted the Starship Enterprise there in 2268.

name: Rayna Kapec
lore: Android companion created by Flint. Struggled with her newfound emotional attachment to Captain Kirk.

name: S'Salk
lore: Gorn captain. He ordered the destruction of the outpost on Cestus III. Immensely strong. Forced by the Metrons to fight Captain Kirk. Snappy conversationalist.

name: Stella Mudd
lore: One of many strict and unpleasant androids on Planet Mudd. Proficient at nagging Harcourt Fenton Mudd.

name: Sybo
lore: Typical Argelian and wife of Prefect Jaris. Descended from ancient priestesses, she tried to use empathic contact to solve a series of murders on Argelius II.

name: Borix
lore: Characteristic of mid-23rd century Romulan soldiers. Diligent in his sentry duty. Aspires to command his own ship in service of the Star Empire.

name: Centurion Kirk
lore: Surgically-altered human thief. Captain Kirk was under secret orders from Starfleet Intelligence.

name: Centurion Kirk (AI)
lore: Surgically-altered human thief. Captain Kirk was under secret orders from Starfleet Intelligence.

name: Dividius
lore: Assistant to Subcommander Tal who intercepted covert transmissions in 2268. Secretly an undercover Tal Shiar operative. He was later promoted to general.

name: Govas
lore: Typical Romulan officer, assigned to guard the cloaking device in 2268. Asked Centurion Kirk for his authorization. Easily distracted.

name: Mr. Spock
lore: 1/2 Vulcan, 1/2 human science officer. Briefly became romantically involved with Commander Charvanek as part of a covert operation in 2268.

name: Praxus
lore: Sensor specialist and bridge officer who served under Keras aboard the Gal Gath'thong in 2266. Did not wish to use the cloak to run from a reflection.

name: Ptol
lore: Romulan technical officer serving under Commander Charvanek. He confronted and was incapacitated by an unidentified centurion in 2268. Ale connoisseur.

name: Pytron
lore: Representative of junior officers serving the Romulan Star Empire in 2268. Trained as a field nurse. Along with Gorrus, took part in a hostage exchange.

name: R'Moog
lore: Typical Romulan thruster specialist. Assigned to guard the brig. Studied the unusual radiation effects recently discovered on Gamma Hydra IV. Enthusiastic cook.

name: Telman
lore: Characteristic of mid-23rd century Romulan soldiers. Diligent in his sentry duty. Aspires to command his own ship in service of the Star Empire.

name: Veznik
lore: Typical sensor operator on the Gal Gath'thong under the command of Keras. Surveyed Gamma Hydra IV prior to Federation colonization.

name: Ensign Tamara
lore: Typical biotechnology technician. Former teacher of genetics at University of Chicago. Conscripted into Starfleet to develop more resistant radiation shielding.

name: Bird-of-Prey, Mk II
lore: Prototype warbird. Based on an earlier 22nd century design. Became a mainstay of the Romulan fleet in the 23rd century, alongside the D-7.
game_text: X=2 in Neutral Zone Region.

name: Primary Turbolift
game_text: Compatible personnel may report (but not download) here. Once every turn, when a DS9 personnel reports (but is not downloaded) using their classification to another site on this Nor, that personnel's owner may draw a card.

name: Primary Plasma Weapon
lore: Damaged Crew Morale: Staff Personnel aboard are attributes all -2.
game_text: Requires a Romulan Original Series ship firing. ATTACK bonus +3 vs. Facilities. Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw

name: The Great Teacher
lore: Computer interface from Sigma Draconis VI. Ancient technology which temporarily imparts knowledge, spanning topics such as neurosurgery, astrometrics, philosophy, and card game rules..
game_text: Use as Equipment card. (Unique.) Immediately choose a personnel present. While present, chosen personnel gains two of every regular skill.

name: Beta XII-A Entity
lore: Non-corporeal energy being fueled by anger and hatred. Could transmute matter, turning everyday objects into weapons.
game_text: End of every turn: If no personnel here, moves. Otherwise, on planet surface and aboard each ship and facility here, two strongest personnel must battle each other.

name: Klingon Troop Deployment
lore: When new worlds are absorbed into the Klingon Empire, such as Organia in 2267, a battalion of Klingon warriors quickly subdues the population and suppresses any resistance.
game_text: Opponent may download to this planet up to three different Universal Klingon TOS personnel and/or one Classic Disruptor. They may initiate battle (if possible).

name: Redjac
lore: After killing a string of women on Argelius II, the murderous entity possessed the computer banks of the Starship Enterprise.
game_text: End of every turn: Kills one of each player's Universal personnel (random selection) on planet surface, on each non-Nor facility here, and aboard each exposed ship here, then moves.

name: Spock's Brain
lore: In 2268, Mr. Spock's brain was removed and taken to Sigma Draconis VI to act as a computer control system for the Eymorg.
game_text: To get past, most CUNNING SCIENCE must relocate to a planet with "23rd century" in lore (your choice; dilemma nullified if no such planet); they are stopped until countdown expires. Nullify with The Great Teacher present.

name: The Metrons' Arena
lore: To resolve the conflict between the Gorn Hegemony and the Federation, the Metrons arranged for the two representative captains to battle for survival.
game_text: One personnel (opponent's choice) is relocated to nearest planet with no personnel on surface; opponent may download S'Salk there. Attempt ends.

name: Flintlock Rifle
lore: Primitive hand weapon developed by many races. Uses chemical combustion to fire projectiles over a long distance.
game_text: Once each turn, discard your Universal Non-Aligned or Non-Aligned Original Series personnel here to unstop up to X non-Honor Klingon}12px personnel in your Away Team here. X = number of Skill dots on the discarded personnel.

name: Klingon Baldric
lore: Largely ornamental Klingon garment. Often used ceremonially to denote membership of a specific Klingon house. A cunning wearer can conceal weapons within as part of a strategic plan.
game_text: Your non-Treachery Klingons present are INTEGRITY +2. Your Worf OR one of your Klingon leaders present may pair first in personnel battle (and select their adversary).

name: Library Record Tape
lore: Computer memory storage medium. During the 23rd century, much historical data and distant star charts were stored on such devices. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Once each turn, you may select Anthropology OR Stellar Cartography. Until re-selected, your Original Series OFFICER personnel and Computer Skill personnel present gain that skill. (Unique.)

name: Painstik
lore: Electrified baton used throughout the Klingon Empire. Requires incredible endurance to withstand it. Often used by prison guards or during Klingon ceremonies.
game_text: When reported, name a skill. Your Klingon personnel present with that skill are STRENGTH +2. Opponent's personnel present without that skill are STRENGTH -1. (Cumulative.)

name: Technology Sharing Treaty
lore: Fueled by a mutual hatred of the Federation, the Klingon Empire and the Romulan Star Empire formed a brief alliance to share technology in the 2260's.
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Your Klingon Original Series and Romulan Original Series cards are compatible and may use your D-7-Class ships. Your D-7-Class ships gain Cloaking Device.

name: Assignment: Earth
game_text: Seeds or plays on Earth. Your Gary Seven, Isis, and Roberta Lincoln gain Original Series (even if not in play) and may report to any corresponding time location. Your facilities, personnel, and ships at same location as your Gary Seven are immune to timeline disruption effects of Build Interplexing Beacon and Stop First Contact.

name: Organian Annexation
game_text: Seeds on Organia. You may only play personnel and ships if they are Klingon Original Series or Non-Aligned Original Series. Once each turn, when you report a personnel, you may report an Original Series equipment or equipment with "Klingon" or Klingon in gametext to that personnel for free OR place an equipment, personnel, or ship from discard pile beneath draw deck.

name: The Savage Curtain
game_text: Seeds or plays on Excalbia. Captain Kirk and Mr. Spock in play gain Honor and Nemesis Orange Right . Once each turn, in place of a card draw, you may download to hand a Nemesis Orange Right or Nemesis Orange Left. When you solve this mission, you may draw a card for each Geology personnel who helped solve, then may report an Honor personnel for each Nemesis Orange Right who helped solve, then may report a Treachery personnel for each Nemesis Orange Left who helped solve.

name: Team of Ambassadors
lore: The diverse nature of the Federation diplomatic corps resulted in many conflicting views, but allowed for the collected wisdom of the various ambassadors to find optimal solutions.
game_text: Plays on your unstopped personnel with V.I.P. and Diplomacy to cause a random selection present to be cancelled and re-selected. OR Nullifies Misinterpreted History.

name: Access Dilithium Cache
lore: Tellun System Region • Troyius: Negotiate for dilithium, stockpiled here since the 23rd century.
game_text: none

name: Assassinate Diplomat
lore: Near Babel: Ambush high ranking official travelling to famed site used since the 23rd century.
game_text: none

name: Attend Disciplinary Proceeding
lore: M-11: Participate in court-martial at starbase established in the 23rd century.
game_text: none

name: Attend Royal Function
lore: Tellun System Region • Elas: Adhere to strict formal protocols imposed since the 23rd century.
game_text: none

name: Destabilize Region
lore: Disputed Sector: Fuel political unrest in system contested since the 23rd century.
game_text: none

name: Examine Morality
lore: Excalbia: Make contact with rock-based life-form first encountered in the 23rd century.
game_text: none

name: Mourn Victims
lore: Tarsus IV: Attend remembrance event for those massacred in the 23rd century after food shortages.
game_text: none

name: Obtain Mining Agreement
lore: Capella IV: Renegotiate topaline deposit rights, first granted to the Federation in the 23rd century.
game_text: When you solve, you may draw two cards.

name: Pursue Origins
lore: Beta XII-A: Track entity feeding on hostility, first encountered her in the 23rd century.
game_text: none

name: Renegotiate Pact
lore: Beta Thoridor: Renew technology-sharing agreement from the 23rd century.
game_text: When seeded, you may download Technology Sharing Treaty.

name: Upgrade Munitions
lore: Planet Neural: Re-arm faction after initial military interference in the 23rd century.
game_text: none

name: Ancient Citadel
game_text: Seeds or plays on your Planet mission with "23rd century" in lore. Your Non-Aligned Original Series personnel who name in lore this planet become Klingon (even if not in play). OR Plays on your crew or Away Team with at least 4 Klingon Honor or 4 Klingon Original Series SECURITY. Draw up to three cards; discard objective.

name: Military Protectorate
game_text: Seeds or plays on your non-homeworld Klingon mission. When your Away Team of at least four Klingon Original Series personnel solve this mission, you may download Colony here; it becomes Klingon and compatible cards may report here. While a Colony is here, personnel who name this mission in lore and your Klingon Original Series SECURITY-classification personnel here gain CIVILIAN.

name: New Civilizations
game_text: Seeds on table if each of your non-homeworld missions shows 30 points or less. When you have completed a planet mission, a space mission, and four total missions, you win the game.

name: Lt. McGivers
lore: Historian and artist. Human who betrayed her crew when she became romantically involved with Khan Noonien Singh. Later exiled with her beloved Khan.

name: Lt. McGivers (AI)
lore: Historian and artist. Human who betrayed her crew when she became romantically involved with Khan Noonien Singh. Later exiled with her beloved Khan.

name: Apella
lore: Native of Planet Neural and leader of a village there. He was supplied with advanced weapons by Krell to attain power and act on behalf of the Klingon Empire.

name: Bielsa
lore: Loyal henchman. Security chief serving under Captain Kang. Acted as bodyguard to Mara while aboard the Starship Enterprise in 2268.

name: Captain Kang
lore: Klingon warrior who encountered Captain Kirk on Beta XII-A. Tried to avenge the destruction of his ship and the deaths of 400 soldiers. Husband of Mara.

name: Captain Khod
lore: Klingon fleet captain. Commanded the I.K.S. Molor in 2268. Co-ordinated with the Elasian traitor Kryton to attack a sabotaged Starship Enterprise.

name: Dorigo
lore: Representative of junior science officers serving in the Klingon Defense Force in the 23rd century. He is good with a blade. Member of the House of D'Ghor.

name: Governor Kor
lore: Fleet captain and Dahar master. Klingon warrior and military strategist who reports directly to the High Council. Hero of the glorious Baltar campaigns.

name: Krell
lore: Klingon arms dealer working for the High Council. Provided "advanced" weapons to Apella to tip the local balance of power. Descendant of Admiral Krell.

name: Kryton
lore: Stiff, robotic Elasian bodyguard. Part of a noble family on Elas. He conspired with the Klingons, jealous that Elaan was promised in marriage to a Troyian.

name: Mara
lore: Science officer and wife of Captain Kang. She was initially skeptical about an alien fueling tensions.

name: Mok'Rand
lore: Typical soldier in the Klingon Defense Force. Friend of Korax. Relayed information to Arne Darvin during the Sherman's Planet affair. Talented linguist.

name: Piabok
lore: Representative of deflector technicians serving in the 2260s. Part of Captain Kang's crew for many years, eventually rising to chief engineer of the I.K.S. K'elric.

name: Radebe
lore: Characteristic of Klingon soldiers assigned under Governor Kor. Stationed on Organia in 2267. Despite trying, could not provoke any Organians to fight him.

name: Trader Worf
lore: The Klingon Worf visited Deep Space Station K-7 near Sherman's Planet in 2267. Hates Tribbles.

name: Trader Worf (AI)
lore: The Klingon Worf visited Deep Space Station K-7 near Sherman's Planet in 2267. Hates Tribbles.

name: Yeboah
lore: Typical Klingon battlefield surgeon serving in the 2260s. She was one of 40 survivors from her ship rescued by the crew of the Starship Enterprise.

name: Ambassador Petri
lore: Troyian diplomat and emissary sent to act as teacher for Elaan before she reached Troyius. Got a knife in his back for trying to educate her in manners.

name: Baroner
lore: The human Starfleet officer Captain Kirk posed as a native on Organia to hide during its occupation by the Klingons. Appointed as liaison. A ram amongst sheep.

name: Baroner (AI)
lore: The human Starfleet officer Captain Kirk posed as a native on Organia to hide during its occupation by the Klingons. Appointed as liaison. A ram amongst sheep.

name: Elaan
lore: Dohlman of Elas who became queen of Troyius. Elasian promised in marriage to create peace. Her tears can intoxicate men. Not used to anyone defying her will.

name: Excalbian Genghis
lore: Excalbian who posed as the human military strategist who united the Mongol tribes and became their emperor. He likes the sugar rush from certain foods.

name: Excalbian Green
lore: Excalbian who posed as a genocidal human colonel for a morality play on Excalbia. He euthanized countless radiation victims. Genetic purist. Inspired Terra Prime.

name: Excalbian Kahless
lore: Excalbian who posed as the legendary Klingon, drawn from the limited Starfleet data available in 2269.

name: Excalbian Kahless (AI)
lore: Excalbian who posed as the legendary Klingon, drawn from the limited Starfleet data available in 2269.

name: Excalbian Lincoln
lore: Hero of Captain Kirk who fought to abolish slavery. In truth an Excalbian who posed as the human president. Helped confront the forces of evil on Excalbia in 2269.

name: Excalbian Surak
lore: Excalbian who posed as the famous Vulcan scientist and philosopher. Abhors violence. Finds it more logical to heal than to kill. He went in peace to propose peace.

name: Excalbian Surak (AI)
lore: Excalbian who posed as the famous Vulcan scientist and philosopher. Abhors violence. Finds it more logical to heal than to kill. He went in peace to propose peace.

name: Excalbian Zora
lore: Excalbian who posed as the Tiburonian governor. She experimented on many subjects' body chemistry.

name: Gary Seven
lore: Supervisor 194. Temporal agent sent to 1968 Earth to protect Earth's future. Genetically enhanced human and pilot. Travels everywhere with Isis.

name: Isis
lore: Alien shape-shifter and telepath posing as a cat. She is assistant to Gary Seven. Travelled to 1968 Earth to protect the future. Enjoys confusing Roberta Lincoln.

name: Joaquin
lore: Loyal henchman and right-hand man to Khan. Genetically engineered augment who was loyally exiled with his leader. Father of Joachim.

name: Khan Noonien Singh
lore: Genetically engineered augment revived from suspended animation in 2267. After he tried to kill Captain Kirk, Khan was marooned on Ceti Alpha V.

name: Roberta Lincoln
lore: Human secretary from 1968 Earth. Erratic, but possessed a high IQ. She had many adventures as Gary Seven's companion. Doesn't trust Isis.

name: Thelev Impersonator
lore: Surgically altered Orion who posed as Thelev, an Andorian ambassadorial aide. Assassin who wanted to derail the Coridan admission conference on Babel.

name: Yarnek
lore: Excalbian shape-shifter. He studied whether good or evil was more powerful through a test on Excalbia.

name: I.K.S. Molor
lore: Imperial cruiser that patrolled the Tellun system. Commanded by Captain Khod. Attacked the Starship Enterprise to trigger sabotage to their warp core.
game_text: Download Any Federation Infiltrator Original Series personnel

name: Class J Cargo Ship
lore: Typical independent transport used by many Alpha Quadrant traders in the 23rd century. Harcourt Fenton Mudd commanded one.
game_text: Download Any Universal Non-Aligned Original Series personnel

name: Frontal Assault
game_text: ATTACK and DEFENSE bonus +2 if you have a Klingon Original Series ship firing OR multiple non-Borg ships here..Hit = Tactic Draw. Direct hit = Tactic Draw Tactic Draw.

name: Morphogenic Virus
lore: Debilitating pathogen developed by Section 31. Engineered to specifically target the morphogenic matrix of changelings, the elusive leaders of the Dominion.
game_text: Place on one personnel present (random selection). That personnel and all your personnel of your same species are attributes all -2. Cure with 3 Biology OR any 2 Intelligence.

name: Plasma Currents
lore: Doing her best to suppress her space sickness, Ezri Dax disabled the engines of her runabout and drifted through the Badlands to retrace the path of Worf's escape pod.
game_text: To get past requires STRENGTH>(50+10X), where X = number of other missions in this region, if in a region; otherwise, X = 0.

name: Romulan Mind Probes
lore: Unable to cure the morphogenic virus, Julian Bashir and Miles O'Brien used an illegally obtained Tal Shiar memory scanner to search the depths of Luther Sloan's mind.
game_text: One personnel (random selection) continues, along with all crew or Away Team members who have at least one printed skill matching that personnel. Others are stopped.

name: Some Day I'll Retire Here
lore: In 2375, Benjamin Sisko purchased twelve hecapates of land in Bajor's Kendra province, intending to build a house there, just as soon as the Dominion War was over.
game_text: To get past requires INTEGRITY>(40 + 10X), where X=number of other missions in this region, if in a region; otherwise, X=0.

name: Terrorist Explosion
lore: Taking a lesson from Kira, Damar's resistance movement did not limit their attacks to non-Cardassian targets, ensuring the Dominion couldn't use Cardassian lives as a shield.
game_text: Damages your facility here (opponent's choice) unless 4 SECURITY OR Resistance present. Discard dilemma.

name: Mantle of the Empire
lore: Ceremonial robes worn by the Klingon chancellor. Worf briefly wore them before naming Martok the new chancellor.
game_text: If with your Klingon chancellor, they are attributes all +1 and your Klingon SECURITY present gain Leadership. May discard to prevent your chancellor present from being killed by a dilemma.

name: Attack Plans
lore: During the Dominion War, Deep Space 9 became a key facility to plan and strategize the joint military efforts of the Federation, the Klingon Empire and the Romulan Star Empire.
game_text: Plays on Ops. If your opponent's personnel or ship has ever initiated battle against your DS9 Federation cards, your cards have no affiliation attack restrictions. (Captain's Order.)

name: HQ: Shipyards
lore: Unable to access their resources in the Gamma Quadrant, the Dominion looked to their Cardassian allies for help in constructing new vessels to bolster their combined fleet.
game_text: Seeds or plays on your headquarters. If there is no Nor here, once each turn, when you play a ship here as your normal card play, you may draw a card.

name: Treaty: Alpha Quadrant Alliance
lore: The assassination of Senator Vreenak, after he uncovered Dominion plans to invade Romulus, resulted in a military alliance between Romulan, Klingon, and Federation forces.
game_text: Plays on table. If you seeded missions only in the Alpha Quadrant, your DS9 Federation, DS9 Romulan, DS9 Klingon", and DS9 Bajoran cards are compatible. You may not play Cardassian or Dominion cards.

name: Alliance with the Son'a
game_text: Seeds on table. Your Non-Aligned Son'a cards become Dominion and (while your Reshape the Quadrant is in play) gain DS9. While your Son'a personnel is in play, you may ignore White Deprivation. Nullified if you seeded a Gamma Quadrant mission. Your Invasive Beam-In is nullified.

name: Dominion Command
game_text: Seeds on Cardassia Prime if you have not seeded any Gamma Quadrant missions; you may download Central Command here. Your compatible Vorta, Founders, and Thots that are native to the Alpha Quadrant may use Central Command as if Cardassian Guls. Once per game, in place of a card draw, you may download one Universal Dominion ship native to the Alpha Quadrant here.

name: Staging Ground
game_text: Plays on Starbase 375 OR Docking Pylons at Deep Space 9; download Treaty: Alpha Quadrant Alliance. You may not report personnel for free. In place of your normal card play, you may report one DS9 ship native to the Alpha Quadrant here with up to 3 compatible DS9 personnel native to the Alpha Quadrant (each of a different affiliation) and up to one aboard. Your Crossover is nullified.

name: We All Serve
game_text: Plays on table; download Treaty: Cardassian/Dominion. Nullifies your Dominion War Efforts. Once each turn, one DS9 Dominion OR DS9 Cardassian personnel with four or fewer Skill dots (and no Download) may report for free, then you may draw a card. Discard if you have played a personnel not native to the Alpha Quadrant OR a Cardassian Honor personnel.

name: Distorted Reflection
lore: After years as a puppet of the Dominion, Damar could no longer recognize the man he had become, and decided to rise up and reassert Cardassian autonomy.
game_text: When your Cardassian personnel with "resistance" in lore helps solve a Cardassian Region mission, you may score points OR opponent must discard 3 cards

name: I Want the Cardassians Exterminated!
lore: Tired of the uprisings, disloyalty, and betrayal, the Founder Leader ordered the execution of the Cardassians. All of them.
game_text: Kill three of your non-Hologram Cardassian personnel (X = their total Skill dots) present with your Founder to peek at the bottom seed card there (once per unattempted mission) and score points.

name: Secret Sabotage
lore: To defeat the occupying Dominion forces, Damar and his compatriots adopted guerrilla warfare techniques, taught to them by Kira Nerys from her days in the Bajoran resistance.
game_text: Plays once each turn, at the end of your turn, on an opponent's undamaged ship. If you have 3 Cardassian personnel with "resistance" in lore here, you may Tactic Draw.

name: Increase White Production
lore: Devos II: Mass-produce ketracel-white to maintain Jem'Hadar soldiers' biochemical balance.
game_text: *+5 points for each Son'a present (limit 3).

name: Recruit Ally
lore: Near Goralis system: Rendezvous with Breen flagship in Dominion-occupied Cardassian space.

name: Resist Occupying Forces
lore: Cardassia Region • Vanden Prime: Establish covert base and train in guerrilla warfare.
game_text: *+10 if Cardassian Liberation Front in play.

name: Steal Breen Armament
lore: Kelvas V: Covertly penetrate facility and retrieve newly installed weapons technology.
game_text: None

name: Decimate Homeworld
game_text: Plays on a homeworld if you have solved two missions (one Planet and one Space). Your Breen and Xindi ships may ignore Strategema here when initiating battle. If you destroy a headquarters here (or at a corresponding time location) that your opponent seeded or played, you score points, where X = printed SHIELDS of that headquarters.

name: One Big Happy Family
game_text: Plays on your non-Gamma Quadrant mission (limit one per mission). At the start of your first mission attempt here, if you have Cardassian and/or Dominion personnel here from at least four different species, you may draw three cards. Once solved, your Cardassian and non-Gamma Quadrant Dominion ships with personnel of three different species aboard are attributes all +2, or +4 if in a region with this mission (cumulative).

name: Anjohl and Winn
lore: The Cardassian Dukat, anointed by the Pah-wraiths, became romantically involved with former Vedek Winn, now Kai of Bajor. He acted as her guide.

name: Bronok
lore: Typical member of Damar's resistance. Dissident who performed many acts of terrorism against the Dominion. One of Rusot's most experienced soldiers.

name: Chaban
lore: One of many battlefield nurses on Cardassia Prime. Dissident who was angered by the loss of Cardassian lives. He vowed to join Damar's resistance efforts.

name: Disik
lore: Typical loyal Cardassian glinn. Friends with Ekoor. Joined Damar's resistance movement against the Dominion. Wanted to avenge Lakarian City.

name: Elim Garak
lore: Cardassian tailor and former spy. He assisted Legate Damar's resistance efforts to free Cardassia.

name: Elim Garak (AI)
lore: Cardassian tailor and former spy. He assisted Legate Damar's resistance efforts to free Cardassia.

name: Mason
lore: Representative of Cardassian citizens, living under the Dominion occupation. Upon seeing Damar, he was inspired to rise up and join the resistance efforts.

name: Odo
lore: Changeling who aided Damar's resistance. Frequent shape-shifting advanced the onset of the morphogenic virus. He posed as the Founder, Founder Leader.

name: Odo
lore: Changeling who aided Damar's resistance. Frequent shape-shifting advanced the onset of the morphogenic virus. He posed as the Founder, Founder Leader.

name: Odo (AI-2)
lore: Changeling who aided Damar's resistance. Frequent shape-shifting advanced the onset of the morphogenic virus. He posed as the Founder, Founder Leader.

name: Baas
lore: Breen security specialist. Patrolled the holding cells where Worf and Ezri Dax were held. He helped Thot Gor to plan the attack on Earth.

name: Damar
lore: Cardassian legate and head of state. Holds no true power in the Dominion. Hates the Vorta. Drowns his woes with alcohol. He arranged a surgeon for Dukat.

name: Draz
lore: Representative of Breen medics. He was charged with ensuring that prisoners such as Worf and Ezri Dax were not killed during interrogation.

name: Fel
lore: Typical Breen scientist. He supervised the interrogation of Worf and Ezri Dax. Accompanied Thot Gor for the initial meeting with the Dominion.

name: Flet'ika
lore: Typical Jem'Hadar First bred in the Alpha Quadrant. Served during the battle to retake the Chin'toka system, which saw the U.S.S. Defiant destroyed.

name: Founder Leader
lore: Diseased changeling trapped in the Alpha Quadrant. Her negotiations brought the Breen into the war.

name: Luaran 9
lore: Vorta clone activated in the Alpha Quadrant near the end of the war after the death of her predecessor. Luaran helped negotiate the peace accords.

name: Rayva
lore: One of many Vorta bred in the Alpha Quadrant. Was instructed to continue the viral research of his predecessor. Witnessed the Treaty of Bajor signing.

name: Weyoun 8
lore: Overconfident Vorta. The last Weyoun clone. Activated in the Alpha Quadrant after his predecessor was killed by Worf. Lives to serve the Founders.

name: Lieutenat Nog
lore: Ferengi serving on Deep Space 9. One of Benjamin Sisko's final acts was to promote Nog. Future Starfleet vessels would bear his illustrious name.

name: Grand Nagus Rom
lore: Former waiter Rom married Leeta in 2373. He was selected by Grand Nagus Zek as a kinder, gentler, more benevolent Nagus to succeed him.

name: Chancellor Martok
lore: Honored General. Martok became High Council leader after the death of Gowron. Soldier who detests politics. Commands the I.K.S. Rotarran.

name: Chu'vok
lore: Klingon general and military aide to Chancellor Gowron. He commanded a Modified Vor'Cha during the Dominion War. Collects rare, vintage bloodwine.

name: Worf Son of Mogh
lore: Putting aside his oath to Starfleet, the Klingon Worf killed Chancellor Gowron in ritual combat. Was briefly romantically involved with Ezri Dax.

name: Worf Son of Mogh (AI)
lore: Putting aside his oath to Starfleet, the Klingon Worf killed Chancellor Gowron in ritual combat. Was briefly romantically involved with Ezri Dax.

name: Vic Fontaine
lore: Self-aware holographic singer. After he helped Nog to recover, his program was left running permanently.

name: General Lar
lore: Typical military negotiator. She attended the signing of the Treaty of Bajor as the highest-ranking Romulan officer after Velal's death at the Battle of Cardassia.

name: Hideki Cruiser
lore: Heavy duty military vessel outfitted with the latest Dominion security protocols. Damar's resistance used one to infiltrate the Kelvas V shipyards.
game_text: Strafing Run OR Activate Tractor Beam

name: Enhanced Warship
lore: Upgraded warship constructed in the Alpha Quadrant. Had Breen energy-dampening technology built into its arsenal. Luaran 9 commanded one.

name: Tykk
lore: Breen flagship commanded by Thot Pran. One of the few vessels to survive the attack on Earth.
game_text: Attributes all -3 unless Breen in crew.

name: U.S.S. Magellan
lore: NCC-71820. Fought in Operation Return. Briefly commanded by Admiral Ross. Served as his flagship during the Battle of Cardassia.
game_text: '''If DS9: Line of Defense

name: Modified Vor'Cha
lore: Klingon heavy cruiser used during the Dominion War. Upgraded in 2375 to counteract recently encountered Breen energy-dampening technology.
game_text: Energy Dampeners here are off line.

name: B-Type Warbird
lore: The Romulan fleet rearmed to replace the Tal Shiar ships destroyed in 2371. Ruwon commanded one.
game_text: Attributes all -2 unless entire crew is DS9.

name: Rovaran
lore: Flagship of the Romulan forces stationed at Deep Space 9 during the final stages of the Dominion War. Commanded by Velal.
game_text: WEAPONS and SHIELDS +2 vs. Dominion.

name: Abandon Ship!
lore: Krenim attacks repeatedly damaged the U.S.S. Voyager. Failing life support systems led Kathryn Janeway to order the evacuation of all personnel except senior staff.
game_text: If ship damaged or RANGE reduced, personnel not needed for staffing are placed with dilemma atop mission. Rescue (opponent may capture) personnel with different ship here.

name: Armus: Sticky Situation
lore: Armus, a remnant of the Vagrans, engulfed William T. Riker in his skin of evil. Only the finesse and skillful negotiation of Jean-Luc Picard resulted in his release.
game_text: Away Team member with highest STRENGTH is stopped if another personnel present has Diplomacy and CUNNING>7, killed otherwise. To get past requires any personnel remaining.

name: Hippocratic Oath
lore: On stardate 49066.5, rogue Jem'Hadar detained Julian Bashir on Bopak III. He was compelled to seek a cure to their genetically engineered addiction to the drug ketracel-white.
game_text: To get past, most CUNNING MEDICAL must relocate with dilemma to nearest planet at another location (must still have MEDICAL upon arrival); stopped until countdown expires.

name: Make Us Go
lore: "We are Pakleds. We look for things...things to make us go. You are smart. Can you make our ship go? Do not try to trick us. We can tell."
game_text: To get past, place most CUNNING ENGINEER present atop mission with dilemma. At the end of your next turn, place both out of play if you do not have CUNNING>24 here.

name: Unscientific Method
lore: As part of his plan to steal the newly developed metaphasic shield technology, Jo'Bril sabotaged the initial testing, faked his own death and killed the inventor.
game_text: Most CUNNING SCIENCE personnel present without Greed or Treachery is killed. To get past requires CUNNING>24 remaining.

name: Spacedoor
game_text: Seeds on your outpost during facility phase. Outpost is SHIELDS -8 (cumulative). In place of your normal card play, you may return your empty ship docked here (and all cards played on it) to owners' hands, nullifying any Static Warp Bubbles targeting you OR download Spacedock or one compatible Universal ship to outpost. Flip Spacedoor over after either use.

name: Treaty: Federation/Romulan/Klingon
lore: Three major Alpha Quadrant powers, in an uncharacteristic show of solidarity in 2373, focused their resources against the Dominion threat in a united stand at station Deep Space 9.
game_text: Plays on table. While you have no open side decks, your Federation, Romulan and Klingon affiliations are compatible and ignore affiliation battle restrictions. They may not attempt opponent's missions.

name: Husnock Outpost
lore: The sudden eradication of the entire Husnock race left it's many outposts vacant. Various affiliations take advantage of these available facilities.
game_text: Seed at any Non-Aligned location. You may seed one Universal Husnock Ship face up here. Extends only 25% of its SHIELDS to ships.

name: Establish Relations
lore: Independent planet: Conduct negotiations to establish peaceful rapport and cultural exchange.
game_text: When you solve, download a Non-Aligned personnel here.

name: Impose Order
lore: Pre-unified world: Unify diverse nation-states via coercion and occupation.
game_text: *Unopposed OFFICER on planet may steal points.

name: Mineral Survey
lore: Planetoid: Survey planetoid with minimal atmosphere to determine value of mineral deposits.
game_text: When you solve, draw up to two cards.

name: Test Propulsion Systems
lore: Remote sector: Test upgrades to faster-than-light drive components.
game_text: Solving player's ships are RANGE +2. (Cumulative).

name: Open Diplomatic Relations
game_text: Seeds on table during doorway phase; you may seed one Treaty during this phase (cumulative). At any time, you may exchange two cards in hand for a Treaty in your discard pile. OR Plays on opponent's ship. Your Away Teams which have a V.I.P. may beam to and from that ship, and it may not voluntarily move while your V.I.P. aboard. Discard objective if your personnel battle aboard that ship.

name: Reflection Therapy
game_text: Plays on a personnel (except Suna) if your Treachery>Honor present. Replace one regular skill with one level of another regular skill (discard if skill lost).
