lore: Re-creation of a male Romulan. Alien entity assumed this body in 2369.

name: Toreth
lore: Female captain of Imperial Romulan warbird, Khazara. Father killed by Tal Shiar. Uncovered M'ret defection plot.

name: Varel
lore: Representation of female Romulans trained in the field of science. Assigned to assist with interphase generator project.

name: Runabout
lore: Resembles a large shuttle. Contains living accommodations. Modular design can be re‑configured for different mission profiles.

name: Type VI Shuttlecraft
lore: Modern Federation shuttle with warp capability. May be armed for special missions.

name: U.S.S. Brittain
lore: Starship found trapped in a Tyken's Rift in 2367. All but one of crew killed by REM sleep deprivation.

name: U.S.S. Enterprise
lore: The fifth Starfleet ship named Enterprise, launched in 2363. Built at the Utopia Planetia shipyards orbiting Mars.

name: U.S.S. Excelsior
lore: First launched in 2284 as a test for what proved to be the unsuccessful transwarp drive project. Now uses standard warp drive.

name: U.S.S. Galaxy
lore: Prototype in this elite class of ships was the U.S.S. Galaxy, after which the class was named.

name: U.S.S. Hood
lore: Registry number NCC-42296. Named for the 20th century admiral, Sir Horace Hood. Commanded by Captain Robert DeSoto.

name: U.S.S. Miranda
lore: Small ship class from the late 23rd century. Named for a character in Shakespeare's play, The Tempest.

name: U.S.S. Nebula
lore: Modern class of ship featuring large upper equipment modules customizable for specific mission uses.

name: U.S.S. Oberth
lore: Class of small ships often used for scientific missions. Named for the 20th century rocket scientist Hermann Oberth.

name: U.S.S. Phoenix
lore: Commanded by Captain Benjamin Maxwell. Last assigned to the Cardassian/Federation border.

name: U.S.S. Sutherland
lore: Named for Horatio Hornblower's fictional flagship. Briefly commanded by Lt. Commander Data during the Klingon Civil War blockade.

name: U.S.S. Yamato
lore: Named for a Japanese WWII battleship. Sister ship of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Commanded by Captain Donald Varley.

name: I.K.C. Bortas
lore: Flagship commanded by Gowron during the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68. Lieutenant Worf briefly served aboard as a weapons officer.

name: I.K.C. Buruk
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey used to transport Gowron to rendezvous with the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2367.

name: I.K.C. Hegh'ta
lore: Bird-of-Prey commanded by Kurn in support of Gowron during the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: I.K.C. K'Vort
lore: Class of ships identical in configuration to the classic B'rel class Klingon Bird-of-Prey, although much larger.

name: I.K.C. Pagh
lore: Battle cruiser under the command of Captain Kargan. Commander William T. Riker served aboard as an exchange officer in 2365.

name: I.K.C. Qu'Vat
lore: Attack cruiser that carried Governor Torak on an investigation into the death of a Stafleet officer at Relay Station 47.

name: I.K.C. Vor'Cha
lore: Large attack cruiser. The modern mainstay of the Klingon Defense Force.

name: I.K.C. Vorn
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey used to transport Duras to meet with the Klingon Arbiter of Succession in 2367.

name: Combat Vessel
lore: A little-known class of attack craft. One such vessel attacked the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368 at Surplus Depot Zed-15.

name: Husnock Ship
lore: With a single thought, Kevin Uxbridge killed the entire Husnock race (50 billion lives) everywhere in the universe. Their powerful ships remain.

name: Mercenary Ship
lore: Little-known ship. Difficult to track due to a unique hull design that renders it invisible to long-range scans. Baran captained one in 2370.

name: Yridian Shuttle
lore: Common shuttlecraft used by Yridian agents and others for covert activities.

name: Zibalian Transport
lore: Common class of merchant vessel used by traders such as Kivas Fajo.

name: D'deridex
lore: Imperial Romulan Warbird. A massive ship significantly larger than a Galaxy class starship.

name: Devoras
lore: Warbird used to accomplice the escape of Romulan spy Selak from the Federation in 2367. Commanded by Admiral Mendak.

name: Haakona
lore: Subcommander Taris' warbird. Responded to the Federation incursion of the Neutral Zone, near Iconia.

name: Khazara
lore: Commander Toreth's Warbird. Covertly used by N'Vek and Counselor Deanna Troi to accomplish the defection of Vice-Proconsul M'ret in 2369.

name: Pi
lore: Ship suspected of attempting a covert mission to Galorndon Core in Federation territory.

name: Science Vessel
lore: Specialized science ship used for an Interphase Generator in 2368.

name: Scout Vessel
lore: Class of small, versatile ships used by the Romulan Star Empire for reconnaissance and science missions.

name: Betazoid Gift Box
lore: Traditional device for presenting important gifts. Its sculpted face comes to life boisterously presenting its contents to the recipient.
game_text: Immediately download to hand up to three cards from your draw deck (ignoring opponent's cards that prevent downloading). discard artifact.

name: Horga'hn
lore: Mysterious symbol of sexuality from the pleasure planet of Risa. To own one is to call forth its powers. To display one is to announce that the owner is seeking jamaharon.
game_text: Immediately plays on table. Each turn, gain an additional normal card play OR at end of turn, draw an extra card.

name: Interphase Generator
lore: Experimental Romulan device that both cloaks and phases matter, allowing it to pass through normal matter.
game_text: Use as Equipment. Where present, nullifies Introductory Two Player Game dilemmas.

name: Kurlan Naiskos
lore: Statues which open to reveal a multitude of similar but smaller figurines inside, representing the belief that each person is a community of individual voices and desires.
game_text: Place in hand. Plays as Event on a ship: while OFFICER, ENGINEER, MEDICAL, SCIENCE, SECURITY, V.I.P., and CIVILIAN aboard, triples ship's attributes.

name: Thought Maker
lore: Outlawed Ferengi mind control device. Transmits signals that implant sensory experiences and triggers emotions and memories.
game_text: Place in hand. Plays as Interrupt: Name a card type, then take all cards with that card type from opponent's draw deck, shuffle them, and place them on bottom of deck.

name: Time Travel Pod
lore: Craft from the future, stolen in the past by Berlinghoff Rasmussen for his own gain.
game_text: Immediately play on table as a Universal Space time location. Relocate opponent's ship here now OR once, at any time, relocate your ship here. Counts down only while a ship here. When discarded, return ship to former location.

name: Tox Uthat
lore: Dangerous quantum phase inhibitor invented in the future by Kal Dano who hid it in the 22nd century for safekeeping.
game_text: Place in hand. Plays as Event : Plays on table; you may not play Supernova this turn. Discard if used to play Supernova. OR Plays as Interrupt : Nullifies Supernova. Discard artifact.

name: Varon-T Disruptor
lore: Only five of these pistols were made before being banned by the Federation. These vicious weapons disrupt the body from the inside out, causing a slow and painful death.
game_text: '''Use as Equipment. Doubles the STRENGTH of each of your personnel present.

name: Vulcan Stone of Gol
lore: Ancient Vulcan telepathic weapon. Kills by magnifying aggressive and violent thoughts, but can be blocked by peaceful thoughts.
game_text: Place in hand. Plays as Event on any Away Team: kills all personnel present without Youth OR CUNNING>7. Discard artifact.

name: Alien Abduction
lore: Solanagen-based aliens, existing in a subspace domain, can access our universe and abduct humanoids for study.
game_text: Places most CUNNING Away Team member atop mission (in stasis) with dilemma. Cure with 3 Leadership. Released when mission completed (discard dilemma).

name: Alien Parasites
lore: Intelligent parasites enter and take control of a humanoid. Their presence can be detected by a gill like protrusion on the back of a host's neck.
game_text: Unless INTEGRITY>32, opponent controls Away Team and/or your ship and crew here (opponent's choice) until start of your next turn (not compatible with opponent's other cards).

name: Anaphasic Organism
lore: A male non-corporeal life-form that lives inside a female host which he enchants, as in the case of Dr. Beverly Crusher's late grandmother.
game_text: Unless MEDICAL and SECURITY present, discards female with highest total attributes. Discard dilemma.

name: Ancient Computer
lore: Vital information can be retrieved from old or damaged computer systems like this one aboard a derelict Promellian battlecruiser.
game_text: Cannot get past unless 2 Computer Skill OR 3 SCIENCE OR 3 ENGINEER present.

name: Archer
lore: Indigenous inhabitants, such as this Mintakan bowman, often attack an Away Team out of fear.
game_text: Unless MEDICAL and SECURITY present, kills Away Team member with highest total attributes. Discard dilemma.

name: Armus: Skin of Evil
lore: A malevolent being was formed when the inhabitants of Vagra II rid themselves of all the evil they had inside.
game_text: Kills one Away Team member (random selection).

name: Barclay's Protomorphosis Disease
lore: Contagious affliction which causes animals to de-evolve into ancestral forms. Disease named for Lieutenant Reginald Barclay.
game_text: MEDICAL, SCIENCE and SECURITY present, kills all personnel present (except inorganics). Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.

name: Birth of "Junior"
lore: Large infant spaceborne life-form. Attached itself to the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368, sucking energy from the ship.
game_text: Place on ship. End of each turn, reduces RANGE by 1; if this reduces RANGE below 1 (or RANGE already below 1), destroys ship. Nullify with 3 ENGINEER..

name: Borg Ship
lore: Gigantic cubic ship of the Borg collective. Possesses powerful weapons and remarkable regenerative abilities.
game_text: Place at furthest spaceline end. End of every turn: Attacks all ships, then moves. Worth points if destroyed in battle.

name: Chalnoth
lore: Anarchistic lupine race of humanoids with the reputation of violent responses to a variety of situations.
game_text: Unless 3 SECURITY OR STRENGTH>40 present, kills one Away Team member (opponent's choice). Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.

name: Cosmic String Fragment
lore: A long space object as thin as a proton but with the gravitational attraction of a hundred stars.
game_text: Unless Engineer OR Astrophysics OR Navigation present, destroys ship. Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma

name: Crystalline Entity
lore: Spaceborne life-form strips biological energy from planets and ships. Sensitive to modulation much like crystal can shatter from a high pitch note.
game_text: Planet mission: Unless MEDICAL and SCIENCE, kills Away Team.''Space mission: Unless Music OR SHIELDS>6 , kills all personnel on ship. Then'': Discard dilemma. Score points if overcome.

name: Cytherians
lore: Race which explores the galaxy by giving other species the temporary ability and strong compulsion to come to them.
game_text: Attempt ends. Target location at this spaceline's far end. Place on ship; it must do nothing but move towards there. discard when reached (score points).

name: El-Adrel Creature
lore: Nearly invisible predatory electromagnetic creature. First encountered by Dathon and Captain Jean-Luc Picard on El-Adrel IV.
game_text: Targets the two strongest members in Away Team (your choice if tie). Unless they have STRENGTH>16, kills one of them (random selection). Discard dilemma.

name: Female's Love Interest
lore: A genetically-engineered leader. Once romantically involved with Deanna Troi.
game_text: Relocates a female present (random selection) to furthest different planet on this spaceline.

name: Firestorm
lore: With advanced technology, personnel can work together to survive natural phenomenon such as the firestorms on Bersallis III.
game_text: Kills all Away Team members with INTEGRITY<5. Discard dilemma .

name: Gravitic Mine
lore: Free-floating weapon used against space vehicles. The U.S.S. Denver struck such a mine, which caused it to crash in the Mericor System.
game_text: Unless SCIENCE and Navigation present, damages ship. Discard dilemma.

name: Hologram Ruse
lore: Holograms can be used to create realistic fantasy worlds.
game_text: To get past requires INTEGRITY>30 and CUNNING>30.

name: Hyper-Aging
lore: Disease created accidentally at the Darwin Genetic Research Station on Gagarin IV. Causes rapid aging and death.
game_text: Place on Away Team; quarantined. If countdown expires, kills Away Team (except inorganics). Cure with 2 MEDICAL and SCIENCE (score points).

name: Iconian Computer Weapon
lore: Highly destructive virus from the ancient extinct Iconians. Transmitted to target vessels via a probe.
game_text: Unless SCIENCE present, reveal hand, discarding all non-personnel cards revealed. Then, draw a card for each card discarded this way. Discard dilemma.

name: Impassable Door
lore: Forcefields across door or hallway openings are commonly used to bar entry.
game_text: To get past requires Computer Skill .

name: Ktarian Game
lore: Psychotropically, mesmerizingly addictive game device. One by one, its players are made susceptible to complete mental control.
game_text: Place on ship. Now and start of each turn, one personnel aboard (random selection) is disabled. Cured with CUNNING>30 OR android.

name: Male's Love Interest
lore: One of the many beautiful women who reside on the paradise planet of Risa.
game_text: Relocates a male present (random selection) to furthest different planet on this spaceline.

name: Matriarchal Society
lore: The planet Angel One was dominated by its women who were intolerant of dealing with men.
game_text: Cannot get past unless at least two female Away Team members are present.

name: Menthar Booby Trap
lore: Relic from ancient Menthar-Promellian war. Aceton assimilators trap passing ships, drain power, then emit deadly radiation.
game_text: Place on ship; it cannot move. Unless MEDICAL present, one crew member killed (random selection). Cure with 2 ENGINEER.

name: Microbiotic Colony
lore: Rare subatomic spaceborne life-form that can cause severe damage to a starship's hull.
game_text: Unless OFFICER, ENGINEER, and SCIENCE present, damages ship. Discard dilemma.

name: Microvirus
lore: Genetic weapon designed to attack humanoids who have specific DNA sequences.
game_text: MEDICAL and SECURITY present, kills one personnel present (opponent's choice), except an inorganic. Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma

name: Nagilum
lore: Extra-dimensional entity willing to kill in order to understand the concept of mortality.
game_text: Unless 3 Diplomacy OR STRENGTH>40 present, kills half of crew (random selection, round down). Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.

name: Nanites
lore: Originally, submicroscopic robots used for medical therapy. Now, self-replicating sentient life-forms who can disable computer systems.
game_text: Unless 2 SCIENCE OR Diplomacy present, damages ship. Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.

name: Nausicaans
lore: Tall humanoid species with a quick temper. A Nausicaan once stabbed Jean-Luc Picard through the heart with a knife.
game_text: Unless STRENGTH>44, kills one personnel (random selection). Discard dilemma.

name: Nitrium Metal Parasites
lore: Microscopic life-forms that normally live in asteroids but can infest and damage ships by ingesting nitrium.
game_text: Place on ship. Ship is destroyed when countdown expires. Cure with 2 SCIENCE OR 2 ENGINEER.

name: Null Space
lore: A rare, invisible pocket of space caused by turbulence during star formation. Absorbs all energy.
game_text: Unless 2 Navigation present, damages ship. Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.

name: Phased Matter
lore: Phased personnel vibrate out of sync with normal matter, rendering them undetectable. Phased people cannot interact with non-phased people.
game_text: Divide Away Team into two groups. Place on larger group (your choice if tie); they are in stasis. Cure with ENGINEER and SCIENCE.

name: Portal Guard
lore: Portal 63 is the last remaining protector of the Tkon Empire, which went extinct 600,000 years ago. Challenges those who awaken him.
game_text: Unless at least one Away Team member has CUNNING>7 OR Honor, immediately beam entire Away Team off planet surface OR kills entire Away Team.

name: Q
lore: Incorrigible, extra-dimensional member of the Q Continuum, a race of omnipotent beings. Q exhibits a child-like petulance and sense of playfulness.
game_text: Unless 2 Leadership and INTEGRITY>60, opponent may download up to 2 Q cards and place them atop their Q-Continuum side deck; crew or Away Team has a Q-Flash of 4 cards, then is stopped. Discard dilemma.

name: Radioactive Garbage Scow
lore: Barges containing dangerous waste can be adrift for centuries. One such barge threatened Gamelon V in 2367.
game_text: Place on mission; mission attempt ends. Mission can't be attempted here. Ship with tractor beam and 2 ENGINEER can tow Scow.

name: Rebel Encounter
lore: Belligerent rebels from war-torn worlds often hide out on other planets and can endanger an Away Team.
game_text: Unless STRENGTH>44 OR you destroy an Equipment present, kills one personnel (random selection). Discard dilemma.

name: REM Fatigue
lore: A crew can go insane from lack of REM (rapid eye movement) sleep.
game_text: Place on crew or Away Team; quarantined. Kills them when countdown expires. Cure (score points) with 3 MEDICAL OR (if on ship) by docking.

name: Sarjenka
lore: Alien child from Drema IV. Her radio pleas for help were answered by Lt. Commander Data in violation of the Prime Directive.
game_text: You may stop all Away Teams at this location to score points and discard dilemma. Otherwise, mission continues

name: Shaka, When the Walls Fell
lore: "Shaka, when the walls fell," means inability to understand. The incomprehensible Tamarians spoke entirely in metaphors.
game_text: To get past requires 2 Diplomacy and CUNNING>30.

name: Tarellian Plague Ship
lore: Ship containing the survivors of a Tarellia war plague. Infected from biological weapons, they are now refused entry everywhere.
game_text: Beams a personnel (your choice) to this card (in space), if possible. Score points if MEDICAL aboard this card. If not, your crew dies. Discard dilemma

name: Temporal Causality Loop
lore: Localized distortion causes time to repeat ad infinitum. U.S.S. Bozeman was trapped for 90 years in a temporal loop that held the U.S.S. Enterprise for 17.4 days.
game_text: Unless SCIENCE and CUNNING>35 present, returns here (re-plays) all cards in discard piles discarded from here this attempt (re-seed cards); turn ends. Otherwise, score points. Discard dilemma.

name: Tsiolkovsky Infection
lore: Variety of water-based Psi 2000 virus. Passed by perspiration. Creates dangerous intoxication-like instability among a crew.
game_text: Place on ship; personnel aboard lose first-listed skill. Cure with 3 MEDICAL.

name: Two-Dimensional Creatures
lore: Perfectly flat spaceborne creatures from a two-dimensional spatial continuum. Ensnared the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2367 and impeded Counselor Deanna Troi's empathic abilities.
game_text: Place on ship. Empaths aboard are disabled. Ship cannot move. Cure with ENGINEER and SCIENCE.

name: Wind Dancer
lore: Sentry of the Parallax Colony. Only allows those whose hearts are joyous to pass.
game_text: To get past requires Music OR Youth OR a personnel with STRENGTH>9 OR Lwaxana Troi.

name: Engineering Kit
lore: Representative of specialized engineering instruments. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Your OFFICER-classification personnel present gain ENGINEER.

name: Engineering PADD
lore: Representative of Personal Access Display Devices designed specifically for engineering functions. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Your SCIENCE-classification personnel present gain ENGINEER .

name: Federation PADD
lore: Standard Federation Personnel Access Display Device for computerized information.
game_text: If your Federation personnel present, each of your personnel present is CUNNING +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Klingon Disruptor
lore: Phase-disruptor used by Klingons and other races. Similar to a phaser.
game_text: If your Klingon or Non-Aligned personnel present, each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Klingon PADD
lore: Standard Klingon Personnel Access Display Device for computerized information.
game_text: If your Klingon personnel present, each of your personnel present is CUNNING +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Medical Kit
lore: Representative of specialized medical equipment. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Your OFFICER-classification personnel present gain MEDICAL.

name: Medical Tricorder
lore: Representative of specialized tricorder optimized for medical use. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Your SCIENCE-classification personnel present gain MEDICAL.

name: Romulan Disruptor
lore: Directed-energy weapon used by Romulans and other races. Disruptor fire can be identified by a high residue of antriprotons that linger for several hours.
game_text: If your Romulan or Non-Aligned personnel present, each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Romulan PADD
lore: Standard Romulan Personnel Access Display Device for computerized information.
game_text: If your Romulan personnel present, each of your personnel present is CUNNING +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Starfleet Type II Phaser
lore: Handheld weapon can be set for stun, heat and disruption. PHASER is an acronym for PHASed Energy Rectification.
game_text: If your Federation or Non-Aligned personnel present, each of your personnel present is STRENGTH +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Tricorder
lore: Representative of multipurpose handheld device combining sensors, computers and recorders. Such equipment has been developed by many races.
game_text: Your ENGINEER-classification personnel present gain SCIENCE.

name: Alien Probe
lore: Space probes of unknown origin are frequently encountered by starships. Often such probes seek information or contact.
game_text: Plays on table. Players play with their hands revealed.

name: Anti-Time Anomaly
lore: "Oh! Nothing happened. See what you've done?" "…I caused the anomaly, and the anomaly somehow disrupted the beginnings of life on Earth?"
game_text: Plays on table. At the start of each turn, opponent may Tactic Draw one ship at any Devron System. When countdown expires, each player shuffles all personnel in play (even "for uniqueness only") that they own into their draw decks.

name: Atmospheric Ionization
lore: Charged particles in the atmosphere of planets which can disrupt transporter beams.
game_text: Plays on a Planet. Personnel may only beam to/from this planet one at a time, and only if their controller has beamed no more than three personnel this way this turn. (Unique.)

name: Bynars Weapon Enhancement
lore: Binary race closely integrated with computers. Always work in pairs. Bynars have the ability to enhance specific computerized systems.
game_text: Plays on ship. Ship is WEAPONS +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Distortion Field
lore: Atmospheric phenomena that inhibits use of transporters, as on Nervala IV.
game_text: Plays on a Planet. End of each turn (even while face down), flip card over. While face up, prevents all beaming to or from this planet. (Unique.)

name: Espionage: Federation on Klingon
lore: Federation intelligence-gathering has often relied upon sympathetic informants and electronic surveillance.
game_text: Plays on a Klingon mission. Your cards may attempt it as if it were Federation . Discard when solved (just after points are scored).

name: Espionage: Klingon on Federation
lore: Klingon espionage against the Federation has included data stolen from Relay Station 47 by Morag.
game_text: Plays on a Federation. Your cards may attempt it as if it were Klingon. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).

name: Espionage: Romulan on Federation
lore: Romulan spies are everywhere.
game_text: Plays on a Federation mission. Your cards may attempt it as if it were Romulan . Discard when solved (just after points are scored).

name: Espionage: Romulan on Klingon
lore: Romulan espionage against Klingons has included efforts to de-stabilize the Klingon government by programming assassins and supporting rebel forces.
game_text: Plays on a Klingon mission. Your cards may attempt it as if it were Romulan. Discard when solved (just after points are scored).

name: Gaps in Normal Space
lore: Pockets of space, such as those in the Mar Oscura nebula, dangerously phase out when coming in contact with a ship.

name: Genetronic Replicator
lore: Medical device invented by Dr. Toby Russell. Capable of growing replacements for damaged organs.
game_text: Plays on table. When a personnel is targeted to die, you may stop 2 MEDICAL present (who are not also targeted to die) to return that personnel to hand instead.

name: Goddess of Empathy
lore: Lt. Reginald Barclay created a fantasy holodeck simulation of Counselor Deanna Troi. Her empathic abilities help other personnel anticipate danger.
game_text: Plays on table. Interrupt cards (except Referee, Q, Kevin Uxbridge and Q2) cannot be played.

name: Holo-Projectors
lore: The hologram projector on Minos is an example of planet-based interactive holographic technology.
game_text: Plays on a Planet. Hologram cards may exist on this planet (activated or deactivated). If nullified, Hologram cards that depended on these Holo-Projectors for existence are erased.

name: Kivas Fajo: Collector
lore: Treacherous collector of rare one-of-a-kind antiquities. Once tried to add Lt. Commander Data to his collection.
game_text: Choose a player to draw three cards. Discard event.

name: Lore Returns
lore: Data's charismatic android brother. Identical except has more emotional ability. Had a negative effect on Data. Became Borg leader known as The One.
game_text: Plays on opponent's empty ship with Rogue Borg aboard. You gain control of those Rogue Borg, who commandeer ship (as Bob-Aligned). While Rogue Borg aboard, ship is staffed; it may initiate battle and beam your Rogue Borg. (Unique.)

name: Lore's Fingernail
lore: Circuitry in Lore's finger was used to control and manipulate Lt. Commander Data with emotions.
game_text: Plays on table. All inorganics (except Hologram) become Non-Aligned.

name: Masaka Transformations
lore: Masaka attempted to transform the U.S.S. Enterprise into an ancient temple and grounds by rearranging its matter.
game_text: Choose a player. That player shuffles their hand, places it beneath their draw deck, then draws an equal number of cards. Discard event.

name: Metaphasic Shields
lore: Revolutionary shields using overlapping subspace fields. Invented by Ferengi Dr. Reyga.
game_text: Plays on your ship. SHIELDS +2 for each Science-classification personnel present.

name: Neural Servo Device
lore: Device which can be used to control a crew by activating pain causing implants.
game_text: Plays on a Non-Aligned ship without 2 SECURITY aboard. Until end of turn, ship and crew are under your control, but are not compatible with your other cards.

name: Nutational Shields
lore: Nutation adjusts the shield frequency phase rotation, thereby increasing shield efficiency. Used against the Borg in 2367.
game_text: Plays on your ship. SHIELDS +2 for each of your ENGINEER-classification personnel present.

name: Pattern Enhancers
lore: Devices which amplify transporter signals to enhance transporter beam power in hazardous areas.
game_text: Plays on table. You may ignore any effect on a dilemma, event, or mission that prevents beaming or targets your just-beamed personnel or equipment.

name: Plasma Fire
lore: Intensely hot combustion of ionized plasma gas. Dangerous fire which can destroy a ship.
game_text: Plays on a non-Borg ship. At the end of each of its controller's turns, ship damaged. May be nullified by SECURITY.

name: Q-Net
lore: Q used an enormous forcefield grid in space to stop the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2364.
game_text: Plays between two adjacent spaceline locations. No ship may pass the Q-Net unless 2 Diplomacy aboard.

name: Raise the Stakes
lore: Weekly poker game aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise honed the tactical and bluffing skills of many officers.
game_text: Opponent chooses: You win the game OR Plays on table. The winner of this game may randomly select and keep one card from opponent's game deck. (Cumulative.)

name: Red Alert!
lore: The state of maximum crew and systems readiness aboard starships.
game_text: Plays on table. In place of your normal card play, you may play up to five personnel and/or Equipment. When nullified, any player may immediately download Yellow Alert.

name: Res-Q
lore: Q once saved Captain Jean-Luc Picard's life following an injury from a compressed teryon beam.
game_text: Plays to take a card from your discard pile to your hand. Discard event.

name: Spacedock
lore: Orbital repair and building facility for starships. Such facilities have been developed by many races.
game_text: Plays on your outpost. Just after your ship docks here, repair all its damage.

name: Static Warp Bubble
lore: Dr. Beverly Crusher experienced a shrinking universe, shaped by her own thoughts, inside a static warp bubble created by Ensign Wesley Crusher.
game_text: Plays on table. At the end of each of their turns, opponent must discard a card (their choice).

name: Subspace Warp Rift
lore: Dr. Serova proved in 2370 that disastrous rifts occur in the fabric of space due to the excessive use of warp drive. Discovery led to a Federation-wide speed limit of warp 5.
game_text: Plays on a spaceline location. Ships that fly by here are damaged. Ships that move to here are damaged if they move again on same turn (unless relocated).

name: Supernova
lore: The explosion of a star, usually caused by natural processes toward the end of its life cycle.
game_text: Requires Tox Uthat. Plays on a mission. Destroys all ships and facilities here. For rest of game, mission is unattemptable and unscoutable, converts to Space (if Planet ), and loses gametext, point box, and affiliation icons.

name: Telepathic Alien Kidnappers
lore: Unknown aliens abducted Captain Jean-Luc Picard for telepathic studies about authority in 2366.
game_text: Plays on table. At end of each turn, name a card type. Then, randomly select a card from opponent's hand. If it has that card type, discard it.

name: Tetryon Field
lore: Intense masses of subspace particles, unstable in normal space, which require ships to route through safe corridors.
game_text: Plays on a spaceline location. Ships may not fly by here. Ships that move to here require Navigation aboard to use RANGE again this turn.

name: The Traveler: Transcendence
lore: Benevolent humanoid from Tau Alpha C who could transcend space and time with thought.
game_text: Plays on table. Nullifies each Static Warp Bubble . Choose a player. End of each turn, that player must draw a card.

name: Treaty: Federation/Klingon
lore: Past treaties between these powers included the Treaty of Alliance creating mutual aide and defense without intervention.
game_text: Plays on table. Your Federation and Klingon cards are compatible

name: Treaty: Federation/Romulan
lore: Past treaties between these powers included the Treaty of Algeron, which created a neutral zone and outlawed Federation cloaking devices.
game_text: Plays on table. Your Federation and Romulan}16px cards are compatible.

name: Treaty: Romulan/Klingon
game_text: Plays on table. Your Romulan}16px and 16[px cards are compatible.

name: Warp Core Breach
lore: In warp propulsion systems, if the magnetic confinement field collapses, matter and antimatter collide causing the ship to explode.
game_text: Plays on a non-Borg ship. At the end of its controller's next turn, destroys ship. May be nullified by ENGINEER.

page_title: Where No One Has Gone Before (PR)
name: Where No One Has Gone Before
base_name: Where No One Has Gone Before
lore: The Traveler transcends space with thought. Took the U.S.S. Enterprise to Galaxy M-33, then to an even greater extragalactic distance.
game_text: Plays on table. You may move ships between locations at opposite ends of a spaceline as if those locations were adjacent.

name: Federation Outpost
lore: Earth is a member of the United Federation of Planets. The Federation establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Federation ENGINEER.

name: Klingon Outpost
lore: The Klingon Homeworld is Qo'noS. The Klingon Empire establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Klingon ENGINEER.

name: Romulan Outpost
lore: Romulus is one of the two homeworlds for the Romulans. The Romulan Star Empire establishes outposts throughout its territory.
game_text: Seed one OR build where you have a Romulan ENGINEER.

name: Alien Groupie
lore: Lanel, a Malcorian nurse, agreed to help Commander William T. Riker, but only if he would...
game_text: Plays on an Away Team that just solved a planet mission. One male present (random selection) is stopped until countdown expires.

name: Amanda Rogers
lore: Female Q raised as a human on Earth. Was taken to the Q continuum by Q after she could not resist the benevolent use of her powers.
game_text: Nullifies an Interrupt being played (except Shield). Place this Interrupt out-of-play.

name: Asteroid Sanctuary
lore: Hoping to avoid detection by a Romulan Warbird, the U.S.S. Enterprise entered a giant asteroid cavern in 2370.
game_text: Plays on your exposed ship (even at the start of battle). While your 2 Navigation aboard, cancels any battle initiated against it. Discard at end of turn.

name: Auto-Destruct Sequence
lore: Computer controlled self-destruct countdown which can be set by the senior officers aboard a ship.
game_text: Plays on your ship. When countdown expires, destroys ship. Then, damages all other ships present with SHIELDS<8.

name: Crosis
lore: Fanatical Borg lieutenant of Lore. Captured Lt. Commander Data with the lure of emotions.
game_text: Plays on a ship. Doubles STRENGTH of all Rogue Borg present. At start of next turn, discard interrupt. (May be targeted as a Rogue Borg by Six of Nineteen.)

name: Disruptor Overload
lore: A directed-energy weapon can be set on overload and left to explode like a bomb.
game_text: Plays on either player's crew or Away Team (except on their facility). Destroys one of that player's non-Shield Equipment present (random selection).

name: Distortion of Space/Time Continuum
lore: Time effects can be caused by the unusual warping or rifting of space.
game_text: Plays on your non-Alternate Universe ship just after opponent plays an Alternate Universe card. You may discard to unstop ship and crew OR restore full RANGE OR unstop an Away Team here. (Unique.)

name: Emergency Transporter Armbands
lore: Devices which allow quick remote activation of a transporter when in danger.
game_text: Plays on your crew or Away Team, even during battle or while facing an Emergency Trasporter Armband dilemma. Any of your personnel present may immediately beam away. (May not be played while two adversaries are in combat.)

name: Energy Vortex
lore: Whirlpool-like space/time phenomena that can destroy a ship, as it nearly did the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2365.
game_text: Plays while opponent's normal card play is being played. Cancels that card play; card returns to hand. Opponent may play a different card as their normal card play instead. (Other costs remain paid.)

name: Escape Pod
lore: Angosian escape pod used by Roga Danar in 2366. Escape pods can be used in an emergency to save a crew.
game_text: Plays at a location just after your ship there is destroyed; relocate its crew(s) atop this card. You may later relocate them to your ship here, then Discard interrupt.

name: Full Planet Scan
lore: Sensor instruments can make detailed scans of a planet surface and atmosphere.
game_text: Plays at the start of your turn on your ship with at least two staffing icons at a Planet mission. Stop your Computer Skill and Geology aboard to examine the bottom seed card here.

name: Honor Challenge
lore: The call to glory inspires the Klingon warrior to maximum fierceness and honor, as symbolized by the Bat'telh (sic) championship trophy.
game_text: Plays at the start of a personnel battle. Each of your Klingons with Honor may kill an opposing personnel present with Treachery. (Cumulative.)

name: Hugh
lore: The Federation named a rescued Borg, Hugh. When he returned, his newly acquired self-aware personality collapsed the Borg collective.
game_text: Plays to cancel a battle just initiated by a Borg card or Borg Ship dilemma. OR Plays to kill all Rogue Borg at one location.

name: Incoming Message: Federation
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals amplified by networks of relay stations.
game_text: Plays on a Federation ship; its controller targets one of their Federation facilities on this spaceline (nullified if none). Ship must do nothing but move toward it. Nullified on arrival at its location.

name: Incoming Message: Klingon
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals amplified by networks of relay stations.
game_text: Plays on a Klingon ship; its controller targets one of their Klingon facilities on this spaceline (nullified if none). Ship must do nothing but move toward it. Nullified on arrival at its location.

name: Incoming Message: Romulan
lore: Messages and directives are sent, faster than light, on subspace radio signals amplified by networks of relay stations.
game_text: Plays on a Romulan ship; its controller targets one of their Romulan facilities on this spaceline (nullified if none). Ship must do nothing but move toward it. Nullified on arrival at its location.

name: Jaglom Shrek: Information Broker
lore: Yridian dealer of information who uncovered the Romulan prison camp in the Carraya system.
game_text: Examine opponent's draw deck, then replace unshuffled.

name: Kevin Uxbridge
lore: Immortal omnipotent being called a Douwd. Lived secretly as a human. Took a human wife who was killed by the Husnocks at Delta Rana IV.
game_text: Nullifies an Event (except a Shield or Treaty). Place this Interrupt out-of-play.

name: Klingon Death Yell
lore: Warning for the dead to beware; a Klingon warrior is about to arrive. In Klingon myth, killed warriors with honor go to Sto-Vo-Kor. Dishonored dead go to Gre'thor.
game_text: Plays just after a Klingon with Honor dies (limit one each). Score points, and you may yell to warn the dead.

name: Klingon Right of Vengeance
lore: Under Klingon law, Lieutenant Worf claimed right of vengeance against Duras in 2367.
game_text: Just after a personnel battle where a Klingon died, your Klingons present may immediately attack same opponents, even without a leader (STRENGTH doubled for this battle).

name: Life-form Scan
lore: A special form of sensor scan capable of detecting life-forms on planets or in space.
game_text: Examine the cards in your opponent's hand.

name: Long-Range Scan
lore: Detects ships and phenomena at interstellar distances using ship sensors.
game_text: Examine the cards aboard a ship (except a ship with Long-Range Scan Shielding).

name: Loss of Orbital Stability
lore: If a ship's orbit decays, it can drawn toward a planet and burn out in its atmosphere.
game_text: Plays on a ship orbiting a Planet. Ship has NO RANGE until end of turn. If SHIELDS>4, discard interrupt. Otherwise, ship destroyed at end of its owner's next turn. (Cumulative.)

name: Near-Warp Transport
lore: Physically disconcerting transport at high-speed.
game_text: Plays to beam up to six cards (personnel and/or Equipment) from your exposed ship with transporters to an adjacent spaceline location (if possible).

name: Palor Toff - Alien Trader
lore: Rich merchant and trader from an unknown race. Friend of Kivas Fajo. Snappy dresser.
game_text: Exchange this card for any non-Personnel card in your discard pile.

name: Particle Fountain
lore: Experimental orbital station built by Dr. Farallon for mining a planet from space. Rumored to be effective for atmospheric depletion.
game_text: Plays if your Away Team just solved a planet mission. If 2 ENGINEER in Away Team, score points.

name: Q2
lore: Member of the Q who observed Q's act of self-sacrifice and re-instated him in the Q continuum.

name: Rogue Borg
lore: Upon Hugh's return to the Borg collective, the Borg became self-aware. Soon, many unquestioningly followed their first leader, Lore.
game_text: Plays on an occupied ship. X = Number of Rogue Borg present; they form an Away Team. End of every player's turn: That Away Team battles that player's personnel present.Integrity: NO Cunning: NO Strength: X

name: Scan
lore: Sensor instruments can detect life signs and molecular signatures at a distance with accuracy.
game_text: Plays at the start of your turn on your ship with at least two staffing icons at a Space mission. Stop your Computer Skill and Stellar Cartography aboard to examine the bottom seed card here.

name: Ship Seizure
lore: Tractor beams are focused linear graviton beams which can be used to seize or tow objects in space.
game_text: Plays on your ship with Tractor Beam. Discard another empty exposed ship here.

name: Subspace Interference
lore: Disruptions of subspace communications can be caused by nebulae and other phenomena.
game_text: Nullifies Incoming Message OR Hail OR Subspace Schism.

name: Subspace Schism
lore: Solanogen-based aliens from another subspace domain accessed our space to abduct people for experiments.
game_text: Plays when a player would draw a card (limit once every turn). Discards that card. (Player draws next card.)

name: Tachyon Detection Grid
lore: Network of active tachyon beams between many ships. Devised by Lt. Commander Geordi La Forge in 2368 to detect cloaked vessels.
game_text: If you control four exposed ships, plays on a cloaked ship. It de-cloaks (even if it is stopped or has cloaked this turn). It may not cloak.

name: Temporal Rift
lore: Time displacement caused by ultra high energy explosions such as that which affected the U.S.S. Enterprise-C at Narendra III.
game_text: Plays on table as a Universal Space time location; relocate one of your exposed ships OR a dilemma here. Counts down only at the start of your turn. When nullified, return that ship or dilemma to its former location.

name: The Devil
lore: Ardra recreated the human mythical figure the Devil on Ventax II.
game_text: Nullifies Horga'hn OR Wind Dancer OR one Treaty.

name: The Juggler
lore: The Juggler hosted Lwaxana Troi and Alexander Rozhenko's visit to the Parallax colony, all the time juggling his three worlds.
game_text: Choose any player to re-shuffle the cards in their draw deck.

name: Transwarp Conduit
lore: New Borg technology which creates an artificial subspace tunnel that increases effective warp speed.
game_text: Plays on a ship. Its full RANGE is doubled. At end of turn, discard interrupt.

name: Vulcan Mindmeld
lore: Ancient Vulcan ritual which telepathically links minds to intimately share each other's thoughts and knowledge.
game_text: Plays on your Mindmeld personnel. Personnel gains the skills of one of your other personnel present until end of turn. At end of turn, discard interrupt.

name: Wormhole
lore: An unstable tunnel through subspace that links to locations in normal space/time.
game_text: Requires two wormholes. Play one on your exposed ship. Play the other at any location (even a time location). Ship relocates to that location (and then is "stopped").

name: Avert Disaster
lore: Artrea: Aid project to delay solidification of the planet's core.

name: Cloaked Mission
lore: Romulus System Region • Romulus: Secretly escort covert operatives to the Romulan homeworld.

name: Covert Installation
lore: Neutral Zone Region • Devora: Build hidden monitoring station in the Neutral Zone.

name: Covert Rescue
lore: Galorndon Core: Retrieve crashed scout ship in Federation territory.

name: Cultural Observation
lore: Mintaka III: Aid observation of primitive society.

name: Diplomacy Mission
lore: Peliar Zel: Mediate dispute between civilizations on Peliar Zel's two moons.

name: Evacuation
lore: Demilitarized Zone Region • Dorvan V: Evacuate American Indian colony.

name: Evaluate Terraforming
lore: Velara III: Evaluate progress of terraforming station.

name: Excavation
lore: Kurl: Assist new archaeological dig.

name: Explore Black Cluster
lore: Sector 97: Study and evaluate enormous cluster of collapsed protostars.

name: Explore Dyson Sphere
lore: Norpin V: Study gigantic structure completely enclosing a star.

name: Explore Typhon Expanse
lore: Typhon Expanse: Trace time distortion reported in this desolate region.

name: Expose Covert Supply
lore: Qo'noS: Uncover covert supply lines supporting rebels on the Klingon Homeworld.

name: Extraction
lore: Cerebus II: Secretly acquire age-reversal drug reportedly under development.

name: Fever Emergency
lore: Nahmi IV: Coordinate aid for Correllium Fever outbreak.

name: First Contact
lore: Malcor III: Make initial contact with advancing civilization.

name: Hunt for DNA Program
lore: Vilmor II: Seek and secure last strand of DNA program on this desert planet.

name: Iconia Investigation
lore: Neutral Zone Region • Iconia: Investigate Federation incursion in the Neutral Zone.

name: Investigate "Shattered Space"
lore: Neutral Zone Region • Near Neutral Zone: Study fragments of distorted space/time reported in this sector.

name: Investigate Alien Probe
lore: Parvenium System: Study and evaluate mysterious probe sighted in this sector.

name: Investigate Anomaly
lore: Gamma Arigulon II: Trace radiation anomalies reported at this location.

name: Investigate Disappearance
lore: Hakaris Corridor: Trace disappearance of a medical transport ship.

name: Investigate Disturbance
lore: Boreth: Investigate disturbance at Boreth monastery.

name: Investigate Massacre
lore: Tarod IX: Initiate investigation into destruction of distant outpost.

name: Investigate Raid
lore: Ohniaka III: Investigate report of Borg attack.

name: Investigate Rogue Comet
lore: Sector 1156: Study unusual comet sighted in this sector.

name: Investigate Sighting
lore: Beta Stromgren: Investigate sighting of Gomtuu, an interstellar creature code-named, Tin Man.

name: Investigate Time Continuum
lore: Devidia II: Trace mysterious time-traveling aliens living in a parallel time continuum.

name: Khitomer Research
lore: Khitomer: Reopen investigation into Khitomer massacre.

name: Krios Suppression
lore: Krios: Aid suppression of warring factions.

name: Medical Relief
lore: Beta Lankal: Respond to reported medical emergency.

name: New Contact
lore: Tau Alpha C: Seek contact with advanced civilization at this distant planet.

name: Pegasus Search
lore: Devlin System Asteroid Belt: Search for U.S.S. Pegasus, reported lost in this sector.

name: Plunder Site
lore: Barradas III: Search ancient civilization site for treasures or artifacts.

name: Relief Mission
lore: Penthara IV: Alleviate planet of Ice Age conditions following type-C asteroid impact.

name: Repair Mission
lore: Argus Array: Examine malfunctioning subspace radio telescope at the edge of Federation space.

name: Restore Errant Moon
lore: Bre'el IV: Restore moon knocked off orbit by passage of nearby black hole.

name: Sarthong Plunder
lore: Sarthong V: Plunder rich ruins at this famous archaeological site.

name: Secret Salvage
lore: Wolf 359: Attempt retrieval of floating Federation wreckage at Borg massacre site.

name: Seek Life-form
lore: Alpha Omicron: Study new spaceborne life-form reported in this system.

name: Strategic Diversion
lore: Neutral Zone Region • Nelvana III: Aid preparations for an offensive invasion.

name: Study "Hole in Space"
lore: Morgana Quadrant: Investigate mysterious void.

name: Study Lonka Pulsar
lore: Lonka Cluster: Research vibrating neutron star

name: Study Nebula
lore: Gamma Erandi Nebula: Study and chart nebula.

name: Study Plasma Streamer
lore: Igo System: Study stream of plasma flowing between binary stars.

name: Study Stellar Collision
lore: Detrian System: Study rare collision between two gas giants.

name: Survey Mission
lore: Mar Oscura Nebula: Study and chart dark matter nebula.

name: Test Mission
lore: Praxillus System: Provide aid for a helium ignition project attempting to revitalize dying sun.

name: Wormhole Negotiations
lore: Wormhole Terminus: Study and negotiate for exclusive use of Barzan wormhole.

name: Albert Einstein
lore: Holographic re-creation. He is based on the famed 20th century physicist and author of the theory of relativity.

name: Alexander Rozhenko
lore: 3/4 Klingon, 1/4 human son of Worf and K'Ehleyr. He was born on the 43rd day of Maktag.

name: Alynna Nechayev
lore: Human admiral and antagonistic superior of Jean-Luc Picard. She was often responsible for liaising on matters relating to the Cardassians or the Maquis.

name: Alyssa Ogawa
lore: Human nurse and medical assistant. She is a trusted friend and colleague of Beverly Crusher. Promoted to lieutenant junior grade in 2370.

name: Benjamin Maxwell
lore: Human captain of the U.S.S. Phoenix. He has a bitter hatred of the Cardassians, after his family was killed during a Cardassian attack.

name: Beverly Crusher
lore: Human doctor and chief medical officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Dancer and thespian. Widow of Jack Crusher. Mother of Wesley Crusher.

name: Calloway
lore: Human ensign who is representative of Starfleet medical technicians. She served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2370.

name: Christopher Hobson
lore: Lieutenant commander representative of human officers in Starfleet. He served aboard the U.S.S. Sutherland in 2368.

name: Darian Wallace
lore: Human ensign. Representative of Starfleet security officers. He has held numerous positions aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Data
lore: Sentient Soong-type android created by Dr. Soong. Desires to be human. Lieutenant commander with a positronic brain. Once left his head in San Francisco.

name: Deanna Troi
lore: ½ Betazoid, ½ Human empath. Imzadi to William T. Riker. Counselor and lieutenant commander serving on the U.S.S. Enterprise. She loves chocolate.

name: Dr. La Forge
lore: Dr. La Forge is a Starfleet specialist in xenology and exobiology. Human father of Geordi La Forge. He is the husband of Silva La Forge.

name: Dr. Leah Brahms
lore: Holographic re-creation. She told Geordi La Forge "Every time you look at this engine, you're looking at me. Every time you touch it, it's me."

name: Dr. Selar
lore: Dr. Selar is a female Vulcan medical doctor. Served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise for many years.

name: Erik Pressman
lore: Human admiral and former captain of the U.S.S. Pegasus, which was lost in space following a failed experiment he oversaw.

name: Exocomp
lore: Sentient inorganic life-form considered by many to be its own species, not merely a tool. Created by Dr. Farallon. It uses a microreplicator to make repairs.

name: Fleet Admiral Shanthi
lore: Human admiral. She authorized the blockade of Romulan forces covertly supporting the Klingon Civil War in 2368.

name: Geordi La Forge
lore: Human lieutenant commander and chief engineer of the U.S.S. Enterprise. He has a great sense of humor and is an experienced holodeck programmer.

name: Giusti
lore: Ensign representative of human staff officers in Starfleet. She served at the Ops console aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2370.

name: Hannah Bates
lore: Genetically engineered human scientist from Moab IV. She was granted asylum aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
lore: Captain of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Human born in LaBarre, France. He has an artificial heart. Reads Shakespeare. Something of a Renaissance man.

name: Jenna D'Sora
lore: Human lieutenant who was briefly romantically involved with Data after the android wooed her using crystilia flowers from Telemarius IV.

name: K'Ehleyr
lore: 1/2 Klingon, 1/2 human female. Federation ambassador to the K'mpec government. Mate of Worf. Mother of Alexander Rozhenko.

name: Kareel Odan
lore: Famous ambassador. Romantically involved with Beverly Crusher. Trill with symbiont who moved to this female host after the last host died in 2367.

name: Leah Brahms
lore: Human warp field theorist and doctor of engineering. She was responsible for much of the warp engine design for Galaxy-class starships.

name: Linda Larson
lore: Human lieutenant. She is representative of staff engineers serving in Starfleet.

name: Lwaxana Troi
lore: Betazoid mother of Deanna Troi. Daughter of the Fifth House, Holder of the Sacred Chalice of Rixx, Heir to the Holy Rings of Betazed.

name: McKnight
lore: Human ensign who is one of many helm officers serving aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. She is a distant relative of a famous 20th century game designer.

name: Mendon
lore: Benzite ensign representative of science specialists within Starfleet. He served aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2365. Looks like Mordock.

name: Morgan Bateson
lore: Human captain of the U.S.S. Bozeman. He and his crew were caught in a temporal causality loop from 2278 to 2368. Born in Seattle.

name: Mot the Barber
lore: Bolian male. Convivial barber aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise. Snappy conversationalist.

name: Nella Daren
lore: Human specializing in stellar cartography. She is an accomplished pianist. Lieutenant commander who became romantically involved with Jean-Luc Picard.

name: Nikolai Rozhenko
lore: Worf's human foster brother. Son of Sergey and Helena. He operated a cultural observation post in 2370.

name: Norah Satie
lore: Retired human admiral. Assigned Jean-Luc Picard to the U.S.S. Enterprise. A zealous investigator, she helped expose the alien conspiracy of 2364.

name: Reginald Barclay
lore: Human lieutenant who is a talented but socially shy systems diagnostic engineer. He is a former victim of holodiction. Has a phobia of traveling by transporter.

name: Richard Galen
lore: Professor and mentor to Jean-Luc Picard. Human considered the greatest archaeologist of the 24th century. He discovered the DNA program.

name: Riva
lore: Deaf mute Ramatin. Famed mediator from Ramatis III. He spoke with a chorus of three telepaths.

name: Ro Laren
lore: Bajoran ensign. Protégé of Jean-Luc Picard. She is sympathetic to the Maquis. A bit of a renegade.

name: Sarek
lore: Illustrious Vulcan ambassador. Father of Spock. Over 200 years old. He has been romantically involved with a Vulcan princess, Amanda Grayson, and Perrin.

name: Satelk
lore: Vulcan captain and Starfleet officer. He presided over the inquiry into Joshua Albert's death at the Academy Flight Range in 2368.

name: Shelby
lore: Ambitious human Starfleet officer. She was assigned to the U.S.S. Enterprise as a specialist on the Borg.

name: Simon Tarses
lore: Crewman first class. Representative of Starfleet medical technicians. He is 1/4 Romulan, 3/4 human.

name: Sir Isaac Newton
lore: Holographic re-creation. He is based on the famous 17th and 18th century mathematician, who originated the classic laws of physics.

name: Sirna Kolrami
lore: Famed Zakdorn strategist. He is a grandmaster of the game Strategema.

name: Sito Jaxa
lore: Bajoran ensign. She is one of a number of navigation officers aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Soren
lore: Androgynous-gender J'Naii. Became romantically involved with William T. Riker. Illegally chose to be female. Underwent therapy for this "perversity."

name: T'Pan
lore: Vulcan director of the prestigious Vulcan Science Academy. She is a doctor of astrophysical sciences and a preeminent expert in subspace morphology.

name: Taitt
lore: Human ensign representative of science specialists from Starfleet Academy. She helped the U.S.S. Enterprise destroy a Borg vessel in 2370.

name: Tam Elbrun
lore: Betazoid male with exceptional empathic abilities. Participated in the notorious Ghorusda disaster. Specialist in first contact with new life-forms.

name: Tasha Yar
lore: Lieutenant who served as chief of security on the U.S.S. Enterprise. Courageous human orphan from Turkana IV. She proved Data fully functional.

name: Taurik
lore: Vulcan lieutenant. He is representative of engineering junior officers serving in Starfleet.

name: Thomas Riker
lore: Starfleet lieutenant. Human double of William T. Riker. He was created during a transporter accident in 2361.

name: Toby Russell
lore: Doctor and controversial human neurogeneticist. She created the genetronic replicator therapy for spinal injury that saved Worf.

name: Vash
lore: Extraordinary archaeology treasure hunter. Traveled with Q. Human romantically involved with Jean-Luc Picard. Lovable character, but she's not to be trusted.

name: Wesley Crusher
lore: Ensign and child prodigy. Human protégé of The Traveler. Son of Beverly Crusher. He saved the U.S.S. Enterprise 3 1/2 times as a teenager.

name: William T. Riker
lore: Commander, gourmet cook, and jazz musician. Human executive officer of the U.S.S. Enterprise. He is imzadi to Deanna Troi, his beloved.

name: Worf
lore: Chief of security on the U.S.S. Enterprise. Klingon warrior and Starfleet lieutenant. Son of Mogh. Raised on Gault, and later on Earth, by his foster parents.

name: B'Etor
lore: Plotted with Lursa to seize power from Gowron with the support of the Romulans. Younger of the two Duras sisters. The pretty one.

name: B'iJik
lore: Typical Klingon male trained as an officer for the Klingon Defense Force. Served as junior adjutant to the diplomatic delegation for Gowron.

name: Ba'el
lore: 1/2 Klingon, 1/2 Romulan. Briefly romantically involved with Worf. She was born in a Romulan prison camp on Carraya IV.

name: Batrell
lore: Klingon representative of officers trained for the Klingon Defense Force. He was formerly in command of the Narendra III outpost.

name: Divok
lore: One of many trained in Klingon anatomy and medicine. He studied the effects of tribbles on the Klingon nervous system.

name: Dukath
lore: Klingon characteristic of those trained in the field of science. Studied the effects of Berthold rays on plant life. He served aboard the I.K.S. Pagh.

name: Duras
lore: Son of Ja'rod. Contender for leadership of the Klingon High Council. Member of a powerful political family.

name: Fek'lhr
lore: Holographic re-creation of mythical Klingon beast. He is the guardian of Gre'thor, where the dishonored go to die.

name: Gorath
lore: Typical Klingon trained in security. Guarded the High Council chamber in the year of Maktag. He served as security chief for the Hegh'bat division.

name: Gowron
lore: Son of M'Rel. Leader of the Klingon High Council after defeating the Duras forces in the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: J'Dan
lore: One of many Klingons trained in the field of science. He smuggled Federation secrets to the Romulans in the form of amino acid codes.

name: K'mpec
lore: Klingon High Council leader prior to Gowron. He appointed Jean-Luc Picard as Arbiter of Succession in 2367.

name: K'Tal
lore: Senior member of the Klingon High Council. He presided over the installation of Gowron as head of the council in 2367.

name: K'Tesh
lore: Typical holographic re-creation for simulated Age of Ascension rituals. He is based on the engineer who perfected current painstik design for ritual use.

name: K'Vada
lore: Klingon captain. He transported Jean-Luc Picard and Data on an undercover mission to Romulus.

name: Kahless
lore: Cloned reincarnation of Klingon spiritual icon Kahless the Unforgettable. He was installed as ceremonial emperor in 2369.

name: Kargan
lore: Captain of the I.K.S. Pagh. William T. Riker served under him as an exchange officer.

name: Kell
lore: High Council emissary. Covert agent for the Romulan Star Empire. He attempted to use Geordi La Forge to assassinate Vagh, a Klingon governor

name: Klag
lore: Second officer of the I.K.S. Pagh. He is representative of Klingon warriors throughout the Klingon Empire.

name: Kle'eg
lore: Typical Klingon trained in the specific field of security. He was a bodyguard for the House of K'mpec when K'mpec was poisoned in 2367.

name: Konmel
lore: Klingon warrior. He destroyed the cruiser I.K.S. T'Acog and hijacked the Talarian ship Batris with Korris.

name: Koral
lore: Tall Klingon male. Captain of a shuttle who traded with mercenaries in 2370.

name: Koroth
lore: Klingon high cleric at Boreth Monastery. He was responsible for creating Kahless, a clone of Kahless the Unforgettable, in 2369.

name: Korris
lore: Klingon warrior. He destroyed the cruiser I.K.S. T'Acog and hijacked the Talarian ship Batris with Konmel.

name: Kromm
lore: Klingon characteristic of those trained in the field of engineering. He is reputed to have consumed fifteen rokeg blood pies in one sitting.

name: Kurak
lore: Famed female Klingon scientist and warp-field specialist who evaluated the metaphasic shield.

name: Kurn
lore: Son of Mogh. Brother of Worf. Commands the I.K.S. Hegh'ta. Kept his true bloodline hidden prior to becoming a member of the Klingon High Council.

name: L'Kor
lore: Klingon warrior. Believed killed at Khitomer massacre. He was actually held prisoner by the Romulans on Carraya IV.

name: Lursa
lore: Elder of the two Duras sisters. Plotted with Sela, a Romulan, to start the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: Morag
lore: Klingon officer. He stole Federation data from Relay Station 47.

name: Nu'Daq
lore: Captain of the I.K.S. Maht-H'a. He pursued the DNA program in 2369.

name: Toq
lore: Klingon male, born in a Romulan prison camp on Carraya IV. Protégé of Worf.

name: Torak
lore: Klingon governor. He served near the Federation border commanding Sector 2520 in 2369.

name: Toral
lore: Illegitimate son of Duras. Claimed a leadership position on the High Council at the bidding of the Sisters of Duras, Lursa and B'Etor.

name: Torin
lore: One of many Klingons trained in the field of science. He studied the effects of warp propulsion on subspace.

name: Vagh
lore: Klingon governor of Krios. He was the target of an assassination attempt by Geordi La Forge, acting under Romulan mind control.

name: Vekma
lore: Klingon female trained in Klingon anatomy and medicine. Propositioned William T. Riker on the I.K.S. Pagh in 2365.

name: Amarie
lore: Four-armed pianist. Humanoid information broker and ex-wife of an arms smuggler. Lounge performer on Qualor II, she knows Aktuh and Melota. Salt sucker.

name: Baran
lore: Male humanoid captain of a mercenary ship raiding archaeological sites to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Bok
lore: Former Ferengi DaiMon. His son was killed by Jean-Luc Picard in battle. Seeks revenge at all costs.

name: Devinoni Ral
lore: 1/4 Betazoid, 3/4 human. Skilled negotiator. Abused his empathic powers to gain advantage. Became romantically involved with Deanna Troi.

name: Dr. Farek
lore: Dr. Farek is representative of male Ferengi trained in medicine. Threatened to seize control of the D'Kora-class Ferengi Marauder Krayton in 2366.

name: Dr. Reyga
lore: Ferengi male scientist. Inventor of the revolutionary, but controversial, metaphasic shield technology. Endured skepticism from the scientific community.

name: Etana Jol
lore: Ktarian female. Attempted to use a psychotropically addictive game to gain control of the Federation in 2368.

name: Evek
lore: Gul Evek, Cardassian male officer. Administers area ceded to Cardassians in a treaty with the Federation.

name: Gorta
lore: Male of Dopterian race. Representative of non-aligned agents. An opportunist. Had an encounter with the Sisters of Duras in 2370.

name: Ishara Yar
lore: Human sister of Tasha Yar. Once betrayed the U.S.S. Enterprise crew in an attempt to aid the rebels on Turkana IV.

name: Jo'Bril
lore: Takaran male. Attempted to steal Dr. Reyga's metaphasic shield technology to claim as his own.

name: Narik
lore: Representative of male mercenaries operating throughout the galaxy. Worked with Baran to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Ocett
lore: Cardassian female officer. Commander of the Bralek. Gul who pursued the DNA program.

name: Roga Danar
lore: Angosian male. Biochemically altered into a formidable perfect warrior ranked Subhadar.

name: Vekor
lore: Representative of female humanoid mercenaries operating throughout the galaxy. Worked with Baran to find the Stone of Gol.

name: Alidar Jarok
lore: Conscientious admiral who questioned Romulan policy. He eventually stole a scout ship and defected to the Federation in 2366.

name: Bochra
lore: Centurion serving the Romulan Star Empire. He was once marooned on Galorndon Core with Geordi La Forge.

name: Galathon
lore: Romulan officer representative of those serving the Romulan Star Empire. He pursued the DNA program in 2369.

name: Jaron
lore: One of many Romulans trained in the field of security. He is rumored to be a former member of the Tal Shiar intelligence service.

name: Jera
lore: Holographic re-creation of a female Romulan. An alien entity assumed this form in 2369.

name: Mendak
lore: Admiral and commander of the warbird Devoras. He aided the escape of Romulan operative Selok from the Federation.

name: Mirok
lore: Romulan scientist. He was in charge of developing and testing the interphase generator in 2368.

name: Movar
lore: Romulan general. He secretly provided military supplies to Duras family forces during the Klingon Civil War in 2368.

name: N'Vek
lore: Member of the Romulan underground. He spearheaded the defection of Vice-Proconsul M'ret to the Federation.

name: Neral
lore: Senator who became proconsul of the Romulan Senate. He plotted with Sela and Pardek to invade Vulcan.

name: Palteth
lore: Typical Romulan trained in the field of engineering. A specialist in artificial quantum singularities. He served aboard the Khazara in 2369.

name: Pardek
lore: Male senator from the Krocton Segment of Romulus. Delegate at the 2293 Khitomer conference. Betrayer of Ambassador Spock.

name: Parem
lore: Male Romulan officer accidently phased by an interphase generator experiment.

name: Sela
lore: 1/2 Romulan, 1/2 human female. Daughter of Tasha Yar from an alternate timeline. Powerful operative and key figure in the Romulan hegemony.

name: Selok
lore: Subcommander and female Romulan agent. Successfully posed as T'Pel, a Vulcan ambassador.

name: Taibak
lore: Scientist who developed a mind control device using E-band emissions. He controlled Geordi La Forge through his VISOR.

name: Takket
lore: Typical Romulan male trained in Romulan anatomy and medicine. Extensively trained in exobiology.

name: Tallus
lore: Romulan officer representative of those serving the Romulan Star Empire. He is a former commander of private forces under Sela.

name: Tarus
lore: Representative of male Romulans trained in the field of science. Specialist in the study of extra-dimensional life-forms.

name: Taul
lore: Typical Romulan male trained in the field of security. Assistant to Commander Konsab of the Romulan Intelligence Academy.

name: Tebok
lore: Commanding officer of a Romulan warbird. His ship crossed the Romulan Neutral Zone in 2364.

name: Thei
lore: Subcommander representative of officers serving in the Romulan Star Empire. He was an ally of the Sisters of Duras during the Klingon Civil War.

name: Tokath
lore: Romulan commandant. He established a secret prison camp in the Carraya system for dishonored Klingon survivors of the Khitomer massacre.

name: Tomalak
lore: Commander of the D'deridex-class warbird Deranas. He is a frequent nemesis of the U.S.S. Enterprise.

name: Tomek
lore: Holographic re-creation of a male Romulan. An alien entity assumed this form in 2369.

name: Toreth
lore: Female captain of the Imperial Romulan warbird Khazara. Her father was killed by the Tal Shiar. Uncovered the Vice-Proconsul M'ret defection plot.

name: Varel
lore: Representative of female Romulans trained in the field of science. Assigned to assist with an interphase generator project.

name: Runabout
lore: Auxiliary support vehicle. Contains living accommodations. Modular design can be re-configured for different mission profiles.

name: Type VI Shuttlecraft
lore: Modern Federation shuttle with warp capability. May be armed for special missions.

name: U.S.S. Brattain
lore: Starship found trapped in a Tyken's Rift in 2367. All but one of crew were killed by REM sleep deprivation.

name: U.S.S. Enterprise
lore: The fifth Starfleet ship named Enterprise, launched in 2363. Built at the Utopia Planetia shipyards orbiting Mars.

name: U.S.S. Excelsior
lore: First launched in 2284 as a test for what proved to be the unsuccessful transwarp project. Refitted to use standard warp drive.

name: U.S.S. Galaxy
lore: Prototype in this elite class of ships was the U.S.S. Galaxy, after which the class was named.

name: U.S.S. Hood
lore: Registry number NCC-42296. Named for the 20th century admiral, Sir Horace Hood. Commanded by Robert DeSoto.

name: U.S.S. Miranda
lore: Small ship class from the late 23rd century. Named for a character in Shakespeare's play, The Tempest.

name: U.S.S. Nebula
lore: Modern class of ship featuring large upper equipment modules customizable for specific mission uses.

name: U.S.S. Oberth
lore: Class of small ships often used for scientific missions. Named for the 20th century rocket scientist Hermann Oberth.

name: U.S.S. Phoenix
lore: Commanded by Benjamin Maxwell. Assigned to the Cardassian/Federation border in 2367.

name: U.S.S. Sutherland
lore: Named for Horatio Hornblower's fictional flagship. Played a pivotal role in the Klingon Civil War blockade.

name: U.S.S. Yamato
lore: Named for a Japanese WWII battleship. Sister ship of the U.S.S. Enterprise. Commanded by Donald Varley.

name: I.K.S. Bortas
lore: Flagship commanded by Gowron during the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68. Worf briefly served aboard as a weapons officer.

name: I.K.S. Buruk
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey used to transport Gowron to rendezvous with the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2367.

name: I.K.S. Hegh'ta
lore: Bird-of-Prey commanded by Kurn in support of Gowron during the Klingon Civil War of 2367-68.

name: I.K.S. K'Vort
lore: Class of ships identical in configuration to the classic B'rel-class Klingon Bird-of-Prey, although much larger.

name: I.K.S. Pagh
lore: Battle cruiser under the command of Kargan. William T. Riker served aboard as an exchange officer in 2365.

name: I.K.S. Qu'Vat
lore: Attack cruiser that carried Torak on an investigation into the death of a Starfleet officer at Relay Station 47.

name: I.K.S. Vor'Cha
lore: Large attack cruiser. The modern mainstay of the Klingon Defense Force.

name: I.K.S. Vorn
lore: Klingon Bird-of-Prey used to transport Duras to meet with the Klingon Arbiter of Succession in 2367.

name: Combat Vessel
lore: A little-known class of attack craft. One such vessel attacked the U.S.S. Enterprise in 2368 at a surplus depot orbiting Qualor II.

name: Husnock Ship
lore: With a single thought, Kevin Uxbridge killed the entire Husnock race (50 billion lives) everywhere in the universe. Their powerful ships remain.

name: Mercenary Ship
lore: Little-known ship. Difficult to track due to a unique hull design that renders it invisible to long-range scans. Baran captained one in 2370.

name: Yridian Shuttle
lore: Common shuttlecraft used by Yridian agents and others for covert activities.

name: Zibalian Transport
lore: Common class of merchant vessel used by traders such as Kivas Fajo.

name: D'deridex
lore: Imperial Romulan Warbird. A massive ship significantly larger than a Galaxy-class starship.

name: Devoras
lore: Warbird used to accomplish the escape of Romulan spy Selok from the Federation in 2367. Commanded by Admiral Mendak.

name: Haakona
lore: Warbird commanded by Taris. Responded to the Federation incursion of the Neutral Zone, near Iconia.

name: Khazara
lore: Warbird commanded by Toreth. Covertly used by N'Vek and Deanna Troi to accomplish the defection of Vice-Proconsul M'ret in 2369.

name: Pi
lore: Ship suspected of attempting a covert mission to Galorndon Core in Federation territory.

name: Science Vessel
lore: Specialized science ship used for an Interphase Generator experiment in 2368.

name: Scout Vessel
lore: Class of small, versatile ships used by the Romulan Star Empire for reconnaissance and science missions.

name: The Village is Strong!
lore: "The Dal'Rok is a fearsome enemy. The mountains tremble with its fury. But our prosperity is its misery. Our unity is its vulnerability. And our strength is its doom."
game_text: Plays on table. Once per game, prevent the death of any one CIVILIAN OR discard your just-revealed dilemma to download and seed Dal'Rok there. Then, discard event.

name: Maternal Instinct
lore: Xindi-Insectoid eggs can spray a neurochemical, causing potential attackers to instead form a protective bond.
game_text: Plays on table. Your cards are all compatible with each other. Your Youth personnel are attributes all +1. Nullified if you own and control a personnel without printed Youth and without "Youth" or "non-Youth" in gametext.

name: Surprise Reinforcements
lore: With encouragement from Neelix, a group of Klingon warriors crossed from one holoprogram to another so they could join a battle in the French town of Sainte Claire.
game_text: Plays on table if all your missions are Delta Quadrant. Your Karr, Klingon personnel, and Universal Hirogen cards are compatible.

name: Miles O'Brien
lore: Human who was briefly appointed Sirah of a Bajoran village. He failed to drive off the Dal'Rok in 2369. Hovath could, cementing himself as the new Sirah.

name: Phlox of Borg
lore: In a parallel universe, the Denobulan - Phlox - was too slow to irradiate his nanoprobe infection. Assimilated as a counterpart who spoke to Starfleet.

name: Iliana Ghemor
lore: Cardassian daughter of Tekeny Ghemor. In an alternate timeline, she successfully infiltrated a Bajoran terrorist cell by posing as Kira Nerys.

name: Kira Nerys
lore: After the Dominion commandeered DS9, the Bajoran stayed aboard to represent her homeworld, as Bajor had signed a non-aggression pact with the Dominion.

name: Kira Nerys (AI)
lore: After the Dominion commandeered DS9, the Bajoran stayed aboard to represent her homeworld, as Bajor had signed a non-aggression pact with the Dominion.

name: Captain Pike
lore: Christopher Pike commanded the I.S.S. Enterprise prior to James Tiberius Kirk. Talented cook, but no one trusts his food.

name: Jadzia Dax
lore: Trill with symbiont and expert Tongo player. Brings out the best in the Ferengi. Despite their primitive, misogynistic attitudes, she finds them a lot of fun.

name: Neelix
lore: Talaxian who was altered to appear Klingon in one of Karr's holoprograms. Experienced warrior. The son of Eximar likes to drink heavily on the eve of battle.

name: Neelix (AI)
lore: Talaxian who was altered to appear Klingon in one of Karr's holoprograms. Experienced warrior. The son of Eximar likes to drink heavily on the eve of battle.

name: The Doctor
lore: A doctor, not a counterinsurgent, who unwittingly joined the Kazon-Nistrim. He told Seska he didn't care who was running Voyager.

name: The Doctor (AI)
lore: A doctor, not a counterinsurgent, who unwittingly joined the Kazon-Nistrim. He told Seska he didn't care who was running Voyager.

name: Prisoner Kirk
property_logo: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
lore: Following the murder of Chancellor Gorkon, the human Captain Kirk was sentenced to a life of mining on Rura Penthe. Had a price on his head.

name: Captain Worf
lore: A Satarran memory wipe resulted in the Klingon Worf briefly commanding the U.S.S. Enterprise.Discarded at start of your turn.

name: Duras
lore: High Council member. Klingon who conspired with Romulans. His family started the Klingon Civil War.

name: Duras (AI)
lore: High Council member. Klingon who conspired with Romulans. His family started the Klingon Civil War.

name: Zefram Cochrane
lore: Human pioneer. Attended the dedication ceremony at the Warp Five Complex in 2119. Plans for statues and theme parks drove him to explore space again.

name: Kes
lore: Ocampa, former nurse, and temporal agent. Confused by her psychic abilities, she traveled to the past intending to trade her shipmates to the Vidiians.

name: T'Mir
lore: Vulcan ancestor of T'Pol. She crash-landed on Earth in the 20th century. Aided Mestral's effort to remain in Carbon Creek. Introduced humanity to Velcro.

name: Jonathan Archer
lore: Human captain who obsessively protected a nest of Xindi-Insectoid eggs which had imprinted on him. He was assisted by Jeremiah Hayes.

name: Jonathan Archer (AI)
lore: Human captain who obsessively protected a nest of Xindi-Insectoid eggs which had imprinted on him. He was assisted by Jeremiah Hayes.

name: Environmental Suit
lore: Self-contained garment for protecting personnel in a hostile environment. A variable magnetic field can be activated in the boots when working in zero-gravity.
game_text: You may discard this equipment to prevent a personnel present from being killed by a dilemma or a Tactic card (that personnel is stopped instead).

name: Espionage: Bajoran on Dominion
lore: No strangers to oppression, many Bajorans fought the 2374 Dominion occupation from within. With Odo's help, Kira's small "resistance cell" paved the way for the Dominion withdrawal.
game_text: Plays on any Dominion mission (for free if you have Odo there). Your Bajoran personnel may now attempt this mission. Discard after mission completed.

name: Shape-Shift Inhibitor
lore: Prototype device developed by the Obsidian Order. Emits a quantum stasis field that prevents a changeling from altering its biomolecular structure.
game_text: Plays on table. Each player must first discard a personnel card in order to download a non-Borg personnel. (Immune to Kevin Uxbridge.)

name: Timepod Ring
lore: Small device used to monitor the auto-timer on the time travel pod appropriated by Berlinghoff Rasmussen. As he was uncertain how to reprogram the timer, the ring was very precious to him.
game_text: Plays on table. Once each turn, you may peek at the top card of your deck. Also, you may discard this event and the top card of your draw deck to nullify an Alternate dilemma.

name: Treacherous Advice
lore: For many months, a changeling posing as General Martok manipulated the Klingon Empire through choice lies whispered in the ear of Chancellor Gowron.
game_text: Peek at an opponent's hand. You may discard one of those cards for each Leadership personnel present with one of your infiltrators who is infiltrating. Discard event after use.

name: Bluegill Infestation
game_text: Seeds on table; place up to seven unique personnel face up beneath here from outside the game. Your copies of those personnel in play are STRENGTH +5, considered Bluegills, and may not be stunned. Also, when one of your Bluegills is killed, you must randomly select a personnel from here; if it matches one who was killed, that personnel was considered to be the Bluegill Queen. (Unique.)

name: Kobayashi Maru Scenario
property_logo: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
game_text: Seeds or plays on a mission; adds Computer Skill to mission requirements. At the start of each mission attempt here, one attempting personnel (random selection) is placed beneath this incident ("in play" for uniqueness only). When a player solves this mission, all of their compatible personnel beneath this incident join the solving crew or Away Team (any other personnel are discarded).

name: Strategema
