game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Launch Portal, Ooby Dooby, Revolving Door, and Rogue Borg Mercenaries are nullified. Q's Planet may not be played. Your opponent may not initiate battle against your card at a homeworld matching that card's affiliation. For each personnel or ship card a player reports using Barzan Wormhole or Caretaker's Array, that player loses 10 points (even if playing Borg).

name: Changeling Sweep
lore: Changelings will be forced into a gelatinous state by a mid-level phaser stun. In 2372, special units were placed in many Starfleet facilities to ensure that empty rooms were in fact truly so.
game_text: Plays to "sweep" an opponent's discard pile: examine it and place any interrupt cards (except Borg or Referee cards) out-of-play.

name: Dimensional Shifting
lore: Powerful form of folded space transport, capable of penetrating all known shields and forcefields. Repeated use of the technology causes a fatal degradation of the subject's cellular chemistry.
game_text: During your turn, discard a random card from hand to place any number of your personnel and equipment at one mission aboard any ship at the same mission.

name: Empathic Touch
lore: "It's accelerating. You have no more time for games."
game_text: When your personnel is about to be killed, if your Empathy personnel is present, stop both personnel to prevent that.

name: In for a Trim
game_text: Seeds or plays on table. Barber Pole and Mot's Advice play for free. Once each turn, if you have Barber Pole in play, you may "take a little off the top": peek at the top X cards of opponent's draw deck, where X is the number of your non-Borg Barbering personnel in play. You may discard any events, incidents, or interrupts (except Borg Only and Referee cards), then replace the rest in any order.

name: Colonel Kira
lore: During Captain Sisko's absence after the death of Jadzia Dax, Kira Nerys was promoted to command DS9. She soon learned the responsibilities of the captain's chair.

name: Shandor
lore: Prylar representative of members of the Bajoran clergy. Maintains the shrine aboard Deep Space 9.

name: Admiral Janeway
lore: In an alternate future where Voyager had remained lost for 23 years, Kathryn Janeway decided to travel back in time and guide her younger self to a faster route home.

name: Admiral Riker
lore: Commander of Starbase 247 in an alternate future. At odds with Governor Worf. Battled Klingons near Devron.

name: Christopher Pike
lore: Noted captain. Succeeded Robert April and commanded the Starship Enterprise for 13 years. Accepted promotion in 2263 and relinquished command to James T. Kirk.

name: Gideon Seyetik
lore: Gifted terraformer who in 2370 planned to crown his career by reigniting the burned-out star Epsilon 119. Failure – and modesty – do not agree well with him.

name: Lt. Palmer
lore: Representative of relief officers on Federation starships. Such officers routinely fill in for crewmembers on shore leave or restricted duty.

name: Miral Paris
lore: ¼ Klingon, ¾ human daughter of B'Elanna Torres and Tom Paris. Has her father's charm and mother's temper. In a possible future, helped Janeway negotiate with Korath.

name: Miral Paris
lore: ¼ Klingon, ¾ human daughter of B'Elanna Torres and Tom Paris. Has her father's charm and mother's temper. In a possible future, helped Janeway negotiate with Korath.

name: Raymond Boone
lore: Starfleet officer who served on the U.S.S. Rutledge in the Federation/Cardassian war. Captured at Setlik III in 2347 and subsequently killed while in captivity.

name: Robert DeSoto
lore: Captain of the U.S.S. Hood and former commanding officer of William T. Riker. Years ago, he and Jean-Luc Picard served together as lieutenants on the same ship

name: Yeoman Rand
lore: Janice Rand is yeoman to Captain Kirk aboard the Enterprise. Captain of the Academy Diving Team in 2264-65. Student of horticulture and xenobotany.

name: Uri'lash
lore: Typical Hupyrian. Hired by Brunt as a bodyguard during his brief stint as Grand Nagus in 2374.

name: K'Temoc
lore: Captain of the sleeper ship I.K.C. T'Ong, on a crucial mission order by the High Command in the late 23rd century. Awoke 75 years later in a much-changed galaxy.

name: Anij
lore: Ba'ku female who became romantically involved with Jean-Luc Picard. In her 300 years, learned to sustain a perfect moment in time – but never learned to swim.

name: Artim
lore: Twelve-year old Ba'ku child. Son of Sojef. Taught Data the importance of play and having a little fun every day.

name: Raimus
lore: Farian crime lord and thief. Oversees a significant Orion Syndicate operation based on Farius Prime. When he tells you to do something, you just do it.

name: Sojef
lore: Leader of the small community of Ba'ku that settled a new world in the Briar Patch. Ardent supporter of a simple way of life, free of advanced technology.

name: Sunad
lore: Typical Zalkonian captain. Sought to capture criminals undergoing a dangerous mutation before they could further disrupt society.

name: Tournel
lore: Chief engineer of the ship that first brought the Ba'ku to their new home in 2066. Now one of the more respected "elders" in their idyllic community.

name: Weyoun 6
lore: Activated after his predecessor's suspicious death, this clone of the Vorta Weyoun had subtle errors. He hoped to end the Dominion War by defecting to Odo's side.

name: Reklar
lore: In response to tensions along the Cardassian/Federation border, this ship was sent to attend diplomatic talks with the U.S.S. Enterprise.
game_text: WEAPONS +2 and SHIELDS +1 while you have a captive.

lore: Science vessel assigned to survey and investigate the Genesis Planet in 2285. Named for one of Earth's earliest space explorers.

name: Geological Instability
lore: With Drema IV on the verge of tearing itself apart, the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise used harmonic resonators to alleviate the tectonic stresses and save the inhabitants.
game_text: Unless total ENGINEER+Geology present>7 - mission span, place on mission. Now and at start of each attempt here, one personnel (random selection) is killed.

name: No Buffer Time
lore: The introduction of timed deadlines for the crew of the U.S.S. Cerritos resulted in chaos and inefficiency as the crew struggled to meet their strict timetable.
game_text: Stops 9-X personnel (random selection), where X=this mission's span. Opponent may re-seed dilemma beneath a mission with more affiliation icons facing you than this mission..

name: Send in the Clones
lore: With only five surviving colonists from the S.S. Mariposa being insufficient to build a colony, the remaining scientists used cloning to increase their population.
game_text: Plays on any mission requiring Biology and MEDICAL OR Boreth. When you solve, may discard to download here a copy of a personnel in play you own (ignoring uniqueness).

name: Abandoned Cube
lore: The Borg Collective can isolate faulty ships, leaving drones independent and free from the hive mind.
game_text: Seed one at any Delta Quadrant mission with "Borg" in lore. Once each turn, you may draw a card when you play a Borg Communications, Borg Navigation, or Borg Defense personnel aboard.

name: Group of Individuals
lore: Hugh's attack on Lore proved that the Rogue Borg didn't need to follow anybody and could think for themselves.
game_text: Plays on your mission. When you solve with a crew or Away Team that includes at least 6 personnel who are Non-Aligned Borg or Nemesis Yellow Left, you may discard incident to download a Nemesis Yellow Left or unique Non-Aligned Borg personnel.

name: Acquire Food Replicator
lore: Uninhabited Nistrim planet: Receive stolen technology on planet rich in leola roots.

name: Cleanse Telepaths
lore: Devore Territory: Inspect and scan all vessels and purge any telepaths detected.
game_text: When solved, kills all Empathy and Mindmeld in Delta Quadrant.

name: Collapse Spatial Vortex
lore: Star Desert Region • Spatial vortex: Escape void and close Malon waste route.

name: Equalize Treatment Levels
lore: Dinaal: Ensure fair and equitable treatment for all patients.

name: Evade Assailants
lore: Vaadwaur Prime: Shelter on irradiated world and avoid revival of local conflict..

lore: Artificial asteroid: Utilize ancient hideout constructed from neutronium alloy.

name: Dala
lore: Humanoid con artist, thief, and liar who impersonated Kathryn Janeway. She took advantage of the Federation's trustworthy reputation for personal gain.

name: Derran Tal
lore: Varro dissident who became romantically involved with Harry Kim. She designed a synthetic parasite to attack and dismantle the Varro's generational ship.
